title: Neolithic First City-States
description: Neolithic: First City-States is a Historical Strategy Game. Though Neolithic doesn't fall easily into popular strategy genres, the game is heavily influenced by games such as Age of Empires, Civilization, Caesar III, and to a lesser extent games like RimWorld. The game includes aspects of City-Building, RTS-like gameplay and deeper characters. It is essentially a full-time solo dev project.

title: Kirikou
description: Kirikou is a 2001 platform video game based upon the 1998 French film Kirikou and the Sorceress.

title: Benjamin Blümchen: Das Große Zoofest
description: In this game you help Benjamin Blümchen, a friendly elephant known from the popular German children’s audio play series of the same name, and his friends Otto and Stella to prepare for the upcoming zoo festival over the course of 13 mini games.

title: Prison Architect: Undead
description: Undead brings a whole new scenario to Prison Architect: one where the only objective is to survive! With this new, spooky, expansion wardens will have to fight off the undead attacks to save their inmates and free the prison from an unprecedented catastrophe.

title: Train Simulator: Huddersfield Line - Manchester: Leeds Route
description: The challenging and stunning Pennines await in Train Simulator, with the new Huddersfield Line: Manchester - Leeds route!

title: Terror Time
description: "Terror Time" is a classic tower defense game in an unusual and bright setting. Defend the base and get upgrade points.

title: Healthy Plane
description: Destroy the unhealthy foods! Avoid fat and sugar! Complete the levels, collect points and dominate the leaderboard!

title: Suffer the Night
description: The envelope is just the beginning. Burn it. Destroy it. Don't play his game. When you see the pale man, it’s already too late. Suffer The Night is a first-person survival horror experience.

title: Sokobear: Summer
description: Summer heat is on! Bear found a new season job serving coconut water. Visit 40 places in this charming forest neighbourhood and solve sokoban style puzzles to help Bear open the coconuts. Job done, enjoy some freshness!

title: Sokobear: Cave
description: Bear has a shiny new job! There are lots of caves inside this mine full of glowing rocks, and he must collect the precious stones. Help Bear in these sokoban-like puzzles. Plan your moves, break the crystals blocking your way! Gathering gems can get quite tricky.

title: Far Cry 6: Game of the Year Edition
description:
Far Cry 6 Game of the Year Edition includes the base game, all Season Pass content, all game updates, the Ultimate Pack, and the new expansion, Lost Between Worlds (coming soon).

Welcome to Yara, a tropical paradise frozen in time. The award-winning Far Cry 6 thrusts players into a modern-day guerrilla revolution. Become a guerrilla fighter and liberate Yara, in solo or co-op.

title: The Story of Barker
description: A mysterious detective story on an abandoned ship with an unexpected ending. You need to figure out what happened to the main character, solve many puzzles and tasks. On your way, unforgettable adventures await you.

title: Humankind: Together We Rule
description: Unite Humankind with the Together We Rule Expansion Pack!

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Futanari Threesome
description: Challenging 6 by 6 jigsaw puzzles, featuring adult images of a couple and a futanari, having an erotic threesome.

title: Hippo Eating Banana
description: A casual game that controls hippo eating bananas.

title: L.S.S II
description: L.S.S the fast paced wave shooter returns with all new game mechanics and enemy types to make the game even faster!

title: Splash Jumper
description: Splash Jumper - miniature arcade clicker game about jumping on platforms. Each click is a jump. Your task is to jump and recruit points.

title: Splash Fly Fire
description: Flappy Fly Fire is a game in which you need to control fire. The game ends when the fire touches the dynamite and everything explodes.

title: Win the Diamond
description: Win The Diamond is a 3d side scroller action adventure sci-fi shooter game where there is a Diamond hidden somewhere in the level. The player needs to find the diamond and collect it, in order to win the diamond. But collecting it will not be an easy task.

title: Elimination Games
description: Play 'red light green light' with a creepy giant mechanical doll in the ultimate knockout elimination tournament! Reach the far wall without the doll catching you to win and progress to the next round.

title: Dungeon Master
description: In Dungeon Master, you either try to escape a randomly generated dungeon as a survivor or hunt down survivors as the Dungeon Master. It's a cross-platform game where your role determines your goal.

title: Dream Football Club
description: Is the foreign soccer hand tour too tiring? And domestic cannot control too boring? "Football Dream Team"-Easy Control Strategy Competition! Realize the dream of football fans for many years!

title: Morrow
description:
Morrow is a time survival game combined with RPG elements.
Your goal is to survive the waves of enemies charging you, gaining levels and expanding your skillset to become stronger, while also searching for lost artifacts to progress within each level.

title: Need for Speed Unbound: Palace Edition
description:
Need for Speed Unbound Palace Edition and get 3 days early access plus exclusive Palace branded content including:
- 4 stunningly intense new Custom Cars
- Palace Clothing Pack containing 20 items
- Palace Driving Effects
- Loads more bitz

title: Tahoe Dragon: The Beginning
description: They warned us in the 1980s, "You don't want to know what is down at the bottom of lake Tahoe." The year is 2042. And earthquake beneath the lake removed rocks from underwater tunnels that set the beast free.

title: Stickman's Arena
description: Stickman's Arena is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a stickman wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of enemies. Choose from a variety of upgrades and combine your weapons to create unique and game-breaking builds.

title: Franchise Hockey Manager 9
description: Franchise Hockey Manager 9 is the latest (2022) version of the Franchise Hockey Manager series. Releasing in October of 2022, FHM9 continues to build off of its previous versions and has added a variety of new features. Franchise Hockey Manager is the only NHL Licensed game on PC.

title: Haunted: Live
description: Haunted: Live is a game where you explore abandoned ruins far away from the city. They is a channel that has just begun to attract attention. They came here to do a broadcast introducing ghost stories related to this place along with the abandoned house experience.

title: VariDungeon
description: In VariDungeon, you are a hero exploring a dungeon. It may sound classic, but each run is different because its structure changes every time you start again ! Power-ups, enemies, bosses, traps, ... You need to adapt to all these elements in order to defeat the final boss and save the King !

title: Japanese Goblins
description: Charming fairy-tale heroes. Puzzle game.

title: My Life: Pet Vet
description: Take care of sick and injured animals in your own small animal practice. Use various examination techniques, make the right diagnosis and give your little patients the right treatment - just like a real-life vet.

title: Rush Hour Deluxe: The ultimate traffic jam game!
description: Can you skilfully manoeuvre the red car out of the traffic jam? Slide the vehicles blocking it in their lanes forwards and backwards – until the road ahead is clear for the red car! Not only can you play Rush Hour Deluxe alone, but go head-to-head with your friends and family.

title: The Occult Chronicles
description: The Occult Chronicles is a strategy game of adventure and exploration. You take on the role of an Occult Defense Directorate (O.D.D.) agent who has been assigned a mission to investigate an ancient estate out in the country. You start your adventure in the Main Entry Foyer and then proceed to explore the creaky old mansion encountering all manner of strange and haunted things. Your mission will take you to the caverns and dungeons below the mansion where you must confront and defeat an unspeakable evil.

title: Piggy Gambit
description: Piggy Gambit is a game that harmoniously combines the elements of chess, box puzzles, and flow control into a coherent puzzle game about a piggy searching for the meaning to his life.

title: Vivamus in Fabula
description: Vivamus in Fabula is a short dark fantasy visual novel of around 1000 words, including a bonfire, medieval Irish art, dying people and relaxing music.

title: The Sinking City: Deluxe Edition
description:
Upgrade your experience with the Deluxe Edition which includes:

- The Sinking City game
- The Worshipers of the Necronomicon - 3 new quests in which Charles Reed investigates unsolved cases and sets out in search of mysterious spell books that harbor unspeakable powers.
- Merciful Madness - 3 new quests that explore Lovecraft’s iconic stories and bring to light the mysteries of Oakmont and its demented citizens.
- Investigator Pack - Upgrade your gaming experience with an exclusive private investigator outfit and access to a first aid kit, antipsychotics and a crafting materials starter pack.
- Chicago Organ Grinder - This DLC grants early access to the most powerful weapon in the game, the Tommy gun, and comes with a golden skin of the weapon.
- Experience Boost - This DLC includes a skill point that can be used from the start of the game. Use it wisely to upgrade your combat skills, vigor or mind.

title: Horizon Chase Turbo: Ayrton Senna Edition
description:
This bundle includes the Horizon Chase Turbo base game and its biggest expansion yet, Senna Forever.

Check out the individual store pages for the base game or the DLC if you want to know exactly what’s in each of them.

Full throttle and have fun!

title: Mikos Wish
description: Novelty three consumer development, unique capsule system, and special CG transformation system, are you still heartbroken?

title: Tits Okay Tits Fine: Need more Tits creampie
description: tits okay tits fine is a sex Simulator

title: Cross the Log Bridge
description: You control a character on a bicycle. and ride up, down, and jump through a three-dimensional course. and jump through three-dimensional courses. There are more than 30 different courses!

title: Fantasia Medieval
description: A short Visual-Novel, made with Artificial-Inteligence art, about a party of adventurers on a medieval setting.

title: Infinity War Land
description: "Infinity War Land" is a roguelite dungeon shooter.

title: King of Water
description: Bigger fishes swallow smaller fishes. hunt or be hunted. Evolve by the time. Interact with both water environment and land environment. More than 10 different types of fishes. Complex conditions from the land. Mysterious Monsters. Complex and interesting game elements interaction.

title: Multiverse Mercenaries
description: Multiverse Mercenaries is a pixel art roguelike that will allow you to defy death by jumping from obstacle to obstacle in 2D, devastate your deadly foes with a sword or arm cannon as a mercenary, and buy items to supercharge your character all In diverse dimensions in the Multiverse.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 1 - Cyberpunk
description:
New heroes join the fight and all-new rewards await in Overwatch 2 Season 1, including the Season 1 Battle Pass, which offers players 80 tiers of rewards through the season.
As a part of the free track, players can earn and unlock Overwatch 2’s new support hero “Kiriko”, Epic skins, and a collection of new cosmetic items.

title: Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy: Bonus Edition
description: A combined physical release of the N. Sane Trilogy alongside its two new DLC levels.

title: Class of Heroes: Anniversary Edition
description: Particus Academy is ready for a new school year! Return to school in the hit DRPG, choosing from different races and traits to create your ideal cohort of students, and throw them at the dungeons! Will you come out stronger or wind up in the infirmary, only one way to find out!

title: Kommissar Kugelblitz: Das Geheimnis von Spooky Hill
Open Course
description: Fun Exciting Island Golf! Test your ability on this challenging island golf course, where precision is needed for every shot!!!

title: Dance of Decapods
description: A minimalist single screen bullet hell where your space insect must survive waves of enemies. Evolve to fight back with more than 30 different parts, from bio weapons to bullet enhancement.

title: Moonday
description:
One night a UFO crashes somewhere in rural fields. Ushitsuki, local farmer (and a cow girl) finds the alien who now needs to repair his space ship using colors hidden in Ushitsuki's dreams.

Moonday is heavily inspired by Yume Nikki and shares some mechanics with it - exploration of dream worlds via going to bed, finding/equipping special "effects" which change character's appearance/abilities, etc.

title: Catabasis
description:
Rescue your brother from an untimely demise.
As you explore circles of the afterlife, you may learn a “Pentacle”.
These “Pentacles” can be drawn to bend angels to your will.

title: Fairy in a Jar
description:
Fairy in a Jar is a short but enchanting fairytale. It tells the story of a fairy who lost their memory and was kept in a jar by a human.

The fairy awakens in the glass enclosure with no memories. From the moment they open their eyes, the little fairy sees nothing but white lights. They meet Mr. Giant, who is scary but also a bit clumsy...

In a completely unknown world, with limited living space and a captor who speaks a different language... What should the fairy choose? To escape this prison, or...?

title: Animal Fight Club: Australia Export
description: Get over 300 new animal combinations, 5 new creatures, and a new map!

title: An Average Day at the Cat Café
description:
Cats, ducks, and mysterious beings galore.

All manners of creatures line down the block to get your signature drinks!
But how long can you keep the cafe open, when strange customers arise in the night?

title: Ante Holic
description: Ante Holic is a small prequel to Ego Holic, set in the same universe, featuring 11k words, 15 CGs, painted backgrounds noir-style and grumpy demons.

title: Invisible Sign: Isu
description:
Fifteen years ago main character's older brother Rin got kidnapped. As a result mother went mad and father lost interest in life, so family's private psychiatrist had to care of the young Shun. The boy starts to attend school with his only friend but a dreadful murder of student occurs there one day. Shun starts to see visions of the killed student and nightmares where some man wants to catch him. Overcome with fear, he occasionally loses control over his consciousness.
A police investigator finds a lot of similarities of this murder with the case fifteen years ago. People around Shun get involved in the investigation, including a classmate girl with the same name as his disappeared brother.
Will the mystery be revealed?

title: Invisible Sign: Isu - Nemureru Mori
description: It is still a story about the mystery of the unsolved incident happened 20 years ago that has something to do with present suspicious events, but the main difference is in the big number of different endings. There are also new characterswith their own stories and endings and the possibility to see the true end with the eyes of another protagonist.

title: Kaze no Satsui: It's a Long Way Round
description: Six members of the broadcasting club gather at a villa in the mountains for a farewell party for former club director Haruki who leaves for the USA. Main character Kazuya secretly has romantic feelings for the members of the club. He organizes this this farewell party with quite a few surprises.

title: Ghosted
description: A 1-5 player co-op horror comedy where YOU'RE the ghosts. Haunt the living, possess objects, and make your friends say ridiculous custom voice commands to trigger scares.

title: Anata wa Akumade Watashi no Mono
description:
The protagonist, Akito Asagumo, was on a summer trip with his close classmates. There, at his friend's villa on an unpopulated island, Akito becomes involved in a horrific murder.

A suspense BL visual novel.

title: Last Bet
description:
--Around 4:30 pm on June 5, a male student (14) from a private junior high school fell from the roof of the school he was attending. The boy died shortly after the fall at the hospital he was transferred to.

The police treated the case as an accident and the investigation was over. A bad event that happened unexpectedly. The misfortune that happened unexpectedly and unintentionally.

Is it okay to end this tragedy that happened about a month ago as an accident?

title: Shounen D no Kokuhaku
description: A short melancholic BL kinetic novel with the theme of adolescence and juvenile delinquency.

title: Tsumannai
description:
"Who killed her?"

The main character, Amasawa Minato, had a lover named Nanaka Watanabe. However, one day, Nanaka is killed by someone.

A short BL visual novel.

title: Sugar-Coated
description:
My only immediate family died. I relied on my uncle and moved to Mokari village, where my father's home was.
The words that cross my head are words relentlessly repeated since childhood.
"Suoh, no matter what, I will never return to that village. Even if its body is destroyed, the demon's grudge will never go away."
Surrounded by friendly friends and beautiful features, gradually getting used to a new life.
The world peeped at the poison under the sugar coating, as if watching it.

title: Woods of Disturbance
description: You woke up in the middle of the forest, next to you is a freshly dug grave, your hands are tied and you don't remember how you ended up here. You must survive and get out of this forest at any cost.

title: Ceaseless Night
description: Ceaseless Night is a strategic roguelike that captures the essence of dungeon crawling in a bleak world. In a world of stolen sunlight, the flickering flames of a campfire lure unwitting travelers to face the dungeons below. Conquer the dungeons, defeat the Lich King, and end this Ceaseless Night!

title: Horny Elves and a Moral Orc
description: ased on a 4-panel comic by Tomokichi about the only suvivor of the orc tribe and a pervert elf who gets aroused by the orc.

title: Meitantei Shikkaku na Kanojo
description: There is a boarding high school. Konoha meets a girl on the entrance ceremony day. Her name is Karen and she suddenly says to Konoha, "You're the culprit." According to her, the mysterious thief who sent theft notice to the school the other day is Konoha. She doesn't know what's going on, but Karen believes that Konoha is the culprit...

title: Ren'ai Shoshinsha
description:
Nozomi, who works at the detective office of Une, will be asked to infiltrate the boys' school with the childhood friend Karin!
A thrilling trouble-loving comedy!

title: Utakata no Hana ga Chiru
description:
Karen, head of the Literature Club, accompanied her childhood friend Himawari, from the Photography Club, to attend the drama club's training camp as a photographer.

At the training camp, twins Asagao and Yuugao asked Himawari to participate with them. After greeting each club member and being shown around the mansion, Karen and the others participate in the rehearsal as photographers.

The next day, a corpse is found in the mansion's greenhouse.

Is this an accident or an incident?

title: Shinoda Shinjuku Tantei Jimusho Karajishi Botan
description:
The protagonist - Usui Yoshihito works at Shinoda Shinjuku Detective Agency.
The agency received a classified assignment from the Shinjuku Central PD.
A joint-investigation behind the wide-spread drug smuggling route within Shinjuku area.

His partner from the police department, Agumo is a diligent detective.
Having a shady past, he feels umcomfortable working with Agumo,
but the job itself is right up his alley.
Soon, the undercover operation begins.

In the meanwihle, he encounters a mafia named Hata, who seems to know Usui's past...

title: Itoshi no My Master
description:
Once there lived a normal madam and maid in a village.
They were perfectly normal.
Normal life, normal relationship, but kind of abnormal.
This is how things changed.

title: PokéROM: Sunflora
description: 1 of 30 collectible discs in the Mystery Series of PokéROMs.

title: Tower Song: Eternal Knight
description:
This is a playable prelude to the game that became Tower Song.

Short story told in the RPG Maker MZ engine, with turn-based combat and top-down exploration. Players build a four-character party from seven different playable characters and classes (berserker, brawler, engineer, hedge witch, knight, mystic and sniper).

The land is plagued by monsters and earthquakes, but a group of plucky adventurers are out to set things right. Little do they know their mission is already doomed - and at the hands of one of their own.

title: Magical Drop VI
description:
The legendary Japanese arcade game is back! Choose your favorite character—will it be World, the Overseer of the Magical Land, the mighty Justice, or the devious Black Pierrot?—and play in one of the numerous game modes available.

Solve diabolical puzzles or beat strong opponents in Arcade match. Follow an adventure in Story or Path of Destiny modes, full of twists and turns.
Challenge your friends and the best players online!

title: Contra: Locked 'N' Loaded
description: Contra: Locked 'N' Loaded is a run-n-gun shooter developed as an attempt to remake the original Konami classic, Contra, using the OpenBOR engine. It features more playable characters and 3 missions, with two additional stages that can be unlocked.

title: I'm looking for 3024 people
description: Can you run, swim and use a shotgun without your eyes? —I'm looking for 3024 people is an alternate reality game whose story spans from 1974 to the present. In the continuation of this adventure, you will have to complete missions with other players and participate in a blind experiment.

title: Quriocity
description: Quriocity is a sci-fi city builder game set on a bare alien planet very similar to Earth. Build and upgrade a wide variety of units to extract resources and provide services, such as maintenance, food production, education, entertainment and many more.

title: Thwack
description: Funky-legged tennis

title: Owl Rescue
description: Owl Rescue sounds the alarm! A class full of young post owls has been kidnapped! Help their teacher Keeper discover their whereabouts. Follow the trail of the kidnapper through a mix of Hidden Object and Match 3 gameplay. Discover the clues that will lead you to the thief with the help of companion Bella. Take flight with Owl Rescue today!

title: Fragment's Note
description: Fragment's Note is a slice-of-life Visual Novel with a touch of sci-fi. The story centers around two main protagonists and the Yanderes that they have to deal with.

title: Reality Rash
description: Reality Rash is a 3D beat 'em up inspired by classics such as Jackie Chan Stuntmaster, Streets of Rage, and TMNT... Action takes place in 4 different worlds each one with unique enemies! Play solo or in 2 player co-op, It’s a nostalgic and modern beat 'em up!

title: Bones of Halloween
description: How long can you survive the night of the pumpkin skeletons? A small but spooky first-person shooter with a Halloween theme

title: Abstract Grind
description: A simple short survival roguelite where you build you character by picking up various skills and boons.

title: Step By Step Hero
description: A Walking Simulator Adventure in a randomized world where every step counts!

title: Joy Flight
description: Joy Flight is an open world VR flight game where players will explore, unlock runways with daring landings and complete missions across a large chain of islands!

title: Symbol Sudoku
description: Classic Sudoku, but with a twist--solve the game using Greek symbols.

title: Elin
description: Successor to the roguelike RPG "Elona". Adventure, survival, crafting, home-building, myths passed down, and stories of humans and Elea spun. What scars will you leave on the land of Ylva?

title: Never Rain
description: Enter a mysterious village, cursed by an evil entity. Discover what happened to its residents and survive against what lurks in the darkness. Never Rain is a singleplayer horror experience waiting for the player to unveil its secrets.

title: Kind Heart Defenders
description: Kind Heart Defenders is an experience that brings the best of Space Shooter with the best of Tower Defense. Have fun building towers, trying different ships, laughing at the characters' jokes, and battling through intergalactic scenarios and gigantic bosses.

title: Stagdraft
description: Top-down 2D Pixel PvP set on Medieval Fantasy World Deploy to battle in Teambased PvP attempting to Capture Flags, Defeating Players, Looting NPCs, Defeat Bosses Gather, Craft, Battle, Loot your way up to conquer the Kingdoms

title: Memory Traces: Egypt
description: Memory Traces:Egypt. is a 3D puzzle game where the player needs to repair destroyed artifacts.

title: Deadly Harvest
description: Defend your farm from an invasion of evil pumpkins in this spooky casual roguelite! Upgrade your weapons and retrieve mystical artifacts to keep the horde at bay and uncover the secret to defeating the legendary Headless Horseman.

title: Chip Off the Ol' Stumbling Block
description: A physics-based runner where you weave between obstacles, set off explosives, and use your environment to reach the end. Travel through five unique environments, conquer nine different obstacle types, and make it to the other side in one piece!

title: Where is Earth?
description: Where is Earth is a top-down vehicular combat game. Traverse planets, evading threats and obstacles, in search of your crew. Gather resources to assemble upgrades, landing vehicles, space craft, weaponry and support modules to aid you in your fight against an unknown enemy.

title: Demiurges
description: Demiurges is a strategic roguelike game. Build your deck, develop your city, upgrade your heroes, and defeat your enemies in turn-based battles to save your world from destruction. Immerse yourself in a rich fantasy world. Collect new cards to create new strategies and increase your chances.

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 9
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: A Bit of Tactics
description: In the farms of Abitof monsters are grown for their yield of rare items. But a successful harvest is not easy, for these crops fight back. As with all creatures their hearts yearn for tactics. Use this as your advantage, progress through the dungeon defeat their boss and reap the rewards.

title: Book of Coin
description: Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy world that is inspired by traditional text-based adventure and interactive fiction games.

title: Routemania
description: Routemania is a relaxing, colorful puzzle game where you build routes around the world. Solve 25+ puzzles by discovering the most efficient way to connect cities using your available pieces.

title: The Land Beneath Us
description: The Land Beneath Us is a turn-based rogue-lite action dungeon crawler. Use powerful skill combos and stylish weaponry to battle your way through the Underworld known as Annwn. Defeat the Seven Lords and rescue The Creator and her vital Soul-Tech.

title: Dreadhunter
description: Plough through hordes of deadly monsters and defeat vicious bosses in an intense fast paced shooter RPG where all items are “legendary”, levels are ever-changing and combat is razor-sharp.

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 8
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Orbtangle
description: Orbtangle is a simplistic puzzle game which requires you to swap the positions of orbs in order to untangle the lines with which they are connected.

title: CyberTD
description: Help protect the core of cyberspace from mutant viruses in this innovative tower defense game packed with roguelite elements! Will you be able to build the ultimate line of defense?

title: Monstir Iradicator
description: Monstir Iradicator is a game about saving the galaxy of Icoa, Transverse 4 different planets and destroy the Monstirs residing there. This game is based off of games like Asteroids following a similar Shoot 'Em Up style gameplay.

title: Closer to Home
description: Closer To Home is a dialogue-focused walking simulator with light puzzle elements and item collection. Navigate connections between reality and dreams, look for weird stuff and make friends. There is no reason to fear death.

title: Jump'n'Brawl
description: Jump'n'Brawl is a 2D brawling game where two to four players compete for the highest score.

title: Missing Pieces
description: Missing Pieces is a story-driven adventure in a vibrant alien world, full of hidden secrets, a plethora of languages and a sparkling cast of characters: lovable rogues, heartbroken families, and questionable allies. Find friendship and love, learn about yourself and discover who you really are!

title: Sinister Entity
description: Third-Person horror game . The game contains many puzzles and mysteries. The game contain escaping and hiding from evil entity.

title: Digit Factory
description: 《Digit Factory》 is a game that allows you to give full play to your creativity and enjoy the fun of thinking. Design your own pipeline to perform calculations on various combinations of numbers. In the endless demand, find a design that responds to changes with the same. Come , challenge your mind!

title: IceLine
description: The game "Iceline" is the story of the Ice Magician, who collects magic crystals and takes his skills to the next level. This is a puzzle game with unique mechanics in which the player character leaves an ice trail behind him and thus changes the playing field for himself!

title: Gust
description: A retro 2.5D action-runner game settled in a dark world. Race with other players for a spot in the global leaderboard. Interact with your spells. Pass challenging levels. Run and fight for your life to reach absolution.

title: Puny BOB
description: Puny BOB - Explore the bright fantasy world of the Mediterranean kingdom! Meet unusual characters and help them complete their tasks by making difficult decisions. Your journey is unique - these stories tell the story of a simple farmer.

title: Pip 5
description: Pip 5 - cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes.

title: Poly Puzzle: Dinosaurs
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal puzzle game with dinosaurs.

title: On Dark Terms
description: Explore an online co-op open-world horror void of hope and shadowed by darkness where you and your feline companion will investigate a post-apocalyptic world searching for evidence so that you might piece together the story that started it all and hopefully find a way to end it.

title: The Lies We Tell Ourselves
description: The Lies We Tell Ourselves is an episodic first person psychological action-adventure game with introspective/horror elements and a focus on subtle storytelling and atmosphere.

title: Midnight Calling: Wise Dragon - Collector's Edition
description: A visit to your father takes a dark turn as you find your hometown in flames! Your only hope is to find the Wise Dragon, but are they friend or foe? It’s up to you to find out!

title: Computer Physics Simulator 2023
description: Computer Physics Simulator 2023 - sequel of CPS 2020, innovation simulator about construct PC with physics of parts. There you can using operating system, using security camera(for watch street), listen music, watching videos and photos, play in games of different eras of game industry.

title: Talon's Blade
description: Talon's Blade is a third person adventure RPG with an advanced direction based melee combat system. Experience the journey of Marcus Veridius as he is set on the path of vengeance. Explore a world plagued with war and corruption as the very foundations of an empire crumble around you.

title: Dragonspire
description: Embark on an epic journey into the anime world of Asteria. Bring your friends along and delve into endlessly different scenarios in this action-packed cooperative roguelike.

title: Cult: Chapter One
description: Find what you came for and escape, before they get what they want...

title: Vajont VR
description: This interactive first-person VR experience is set in the Vajont valley, some hours before the disaster. A wife and her husband are talking about their future: the woman senses the danger and wants to leave; her husband dismisses the idea of danger. The player will determine the end of their story.

title: Alexandria IV
description: Tasked with commanding of one of the most challenging sectors of the galaxy, the future of the Alexandria IV space station depends on your diplomatic and strategic capabilities. How far will you go to prevent a war?

title: Planet Surfer
description: Dodge Obstacles. Purchase upgrades. Save the world. Planet Surfer is a non-stop anti-gravity survival racer and the ultimate forward scrolling don’t run into stuff game developed as a love letter to the temple run quintet and the early 3d sonic games.

title: Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum
description: Garbage Pail Kids are back in this Long-Lost, All-New platforming adventure. Featuring four playable characters, six secret-filled levels, and a trading-card system, Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum is a throwback to the golden era of 80s gaming.

title: Punzel: Chapter I - Toujours la Meme Histoire
description: Imagine you are a captured princess...but the hero never arrives. Join Punzel in her adventure of trying to escape her tower prison. Experience the boredom of captivity, the daily frustrations of haggling with your captors and crows. Lots of crows.

title: Kitsu's Destiny
description: Kitsu's Destiny is a clicker-style RPG made in RPG Maker. It has a dynasty mechanic, the more damage you deal, the more Gold and Experience your get try again. You have equipment and boosts to purchase, and you get more powerful insignias as you go on. It's like speedrunning grinding!

title: Tiny Solar System
description: A single player space game where you fly a rocket around a tiny solar system with realistic physics, including take off, orbiting, orbital transfers and landings. Help settling other planets and moons. No time limits, no stress. If you crash you just get rescued.

title: Evard the Hermit: Through Fears
description: Evard's gift and a curse — the ability to absorb other people's fears and phobias. Immerse yourself into Evard's story and discover the secret of his origins. Explore his medieval Metroidvania world, look for the sources of fears and overcome them.

title: Tilecraft
description: 'Tilecraft: A New Horizon' is a minimalist and relaxing strategy game about discovering and building on your explored tiles. Explore a procedurally generated set of resources across the map in this unique and casual atmosphere.

title: The Villager and the Werewolf
description: In this game, when you fit the last piece of each jigsaw, you will hear a fantastic werewolf story written by Marta Machado and illustrated by Alexandre Rocha.

title: Counterpact
description: Fight against other players or take on the Gilded Spire in this 2D platform-shooter. Customize and play as one of seven characters with unique mechanics and items.

title: Trains: Through Electric Storms.
description: There is an insane electrical revolution in the world of the XX Century. Anna’s father left her before death a great but yet dangerous and mysterious legacy. Find all the answers in the tense world of tesla punk.

title: The Trader: Good Dealer Simulator
description: Build your own shop. Run the shop and buy new furnitures. Manage your own economy, buy 50 and above items and sell. To be successful, stay out of crime and serve your customers in a good manner.

title: Slime Ranger
description: You are on a quest to find and defeat the Slime King. With a limited movement, you need to think carefully about every step until you reach the door. Push boxes, find keys, beware of traps, and slay every slime that get in your way!

title: Supermarket Duck Dash
description: Knock products off the supermarket shelves and into your shopping cart with your wings, as you help old people by doing their grocery shopping for them. Featuring funky physics and over 125 products. How much money can you make before you run out of time?

title: Sokobear: Goo
description: An entire village threatened by yucky jelly goey creatures, and only Bear can save them! Explode the Goos by solving a sokoban style puzzle. Help Bear along the attacked places in his neighbourhood and be the hero amongst the Forest Folk.

title: Bunny Eureka
description: A cozy game. Build a bunny town, and take care of cute bunnies. grow plants and add buildings, and enjoy happy bunnies living in your town. Let these soft cute bunnies be with you.

title: Jester's Quest
description: ✓ Fairy tale metroidvania with some RPG elements ✓ Hand drawn pixelart with frame by frame animation ✓ Open world map to more than 50+ different levels ✓ Medieval fantasy with magic, quests and dragons ✓ You don't have to read a single line of text ✓ Combo combat system

title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked
description: Jump, Dash, Collect! Play solo and with your friends and loved ones! Explore this cute 3D platformer where you play as Boti, a brave and adorable data bot. Join Boti on an adventure to save the cyber-world of Byteland from bugs and viruses!

title: I Did Not Buy This Ticket
description: A short horror story about losing your identity. Face your traumas while riding a mysterious bus.

title: Half-Life: VR Mod
description: A fan-made highly immersive Virtual Reality mod for the classic Half-Life from 1998.

title: First Bite: Bad Blood
description: An LGBTQ+ Vampiric Visual Novel. So you think you’re above the law because you’re undead and have perfect hair? Think again.

title: Phyakh
description: Story-driven, action adventure combining exploration with fast-paced combat games. Phyakh, a creature who was saved from death in bio-robotic suit. He comeback to help his wife from under arrested by invader, The army troop from the earth. Post-Nuclear war and virus epidemic swept the world.

title: Saturn Quest: R.U.N.E. 3000
description: Saturn Quest: R.U.N.E. 3000 is a tragic Alien Space Opera featuring asystematic Action-RTS battles and epic plot of mythological proportions.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XIV: Message in a Bottle
description: Help Hercules uncover the mystery of strange messages in bottles and save Olympian gods!

title: A Spooky Teaparty
description: Take the role of Rover, Summer, Britton and Marina in this fun, exploration-based Halloween adventure that takes place just after the events of Aplestia! Find treats, solve puzzles, battle with spooky monsters, enter secret rooms and meet with undead, funny characters! Welcome to Duruduru Castle!

title: Klitorax
description: Hurry Up, Klitorax needs to find the next toillet! Faith is in your hands and if you dont hurry, it will also be in your pants . . . and on the floor . . .

title: Azazel's Christmas Fable
description: A wacky 8-bit retro-style point and click Christmas adventure, reminiscent of '90s classics. Explore Santa's village as a devilish imp with a mischievous knack for getting into trouble. Solve puzzles and uncover mysteries while meeting some peculiar characters along the way.

title: Walking in the Abyss: Definitive Edition
description: Explore a mysterious castle in the middle of the forest and discover its secrets in this 2D horror game.

title: Editor's Hell
description: It’s been two days since you assigned to the editor job on the newspaper. After months of unemployment; you just had to took it. Maybe you have no idea how to do this but; you have a family to look after. Dreams, nightmares, don’t matter anymore; you have a new opportunity in your life.

title: 2 of Me
description: Defy the ancient goddess of war and free the Agency from the forces and anomalies that have captured it in this scrolling shooter and action roguelike game.

title: Mount Farewell
description: Denial, anger, bargaining, depression and acceptance. Five stages to overcome on Mount Farewell. This game is a difficult 2D precision platformer about grief for those who like a challenge.

title: Voice of the Wizard by Brett Farkas
description: Voice of the Wizard is a 100% voice recognition controlled adventure game. Explore an open world of forests, fields, and shorelines. Learn spells, solve mysteries, and defeat enemies. It's up to you to be the Voice of the Wizard.

title: Together With Me
description: Rotate the obstacles with the mouse until the yellow and pink balls connect

title: Office Run: Halloween Run
description: New environment with spooky atmosphere and themed obstacles. Updated and improved gameplay of the base game’s Arcade mode introducing new cycle system and monsters hunting the player. You better run for your life!

title: ChaosWorld
description: A magically controlled medieval large map and a multiplayer survival open world game with randomly generated caves on the large map by the program. Use combat, building, farming, automating to create your own medieval village or town, and defeat magic with magic.

title: Chiky Poky
description: Chiky Poky is an old-school 2D puzzle inspired by games like The Key of Solomon and Caliper. Help Chiky to return the brother kidnapped by the portal from the mysterious forest.

title: Keep of the Witch
description: An Anime inspired 3D adventure game were you ascend a castle with puzzling and platforming, leading to Boss fights at the end of each floor. You are to save the princess with 4 separate characters, 8* different endings, and a maid that supports you along the way.

title: Space Intern
description: You finally got an internship in the intergalactic space station, congrats! Now you just need to survive on different planets, experience gravity inversion, and weightlessness, talk to burn-out workers, and of course - avoid getting killed by local aliens.

title: Don't Look Away
description: A frightening asymmetrical multiplayer experience! Survive as the Human or terrorize as the Entity that can only move when it isn't being watched.

title: Novastella Island
description: This is a slow-paced building game. Accidentally traveled to an island in another universe, you decided to collect resources and make tools to find a way home. But you'll also lead an amazing life, make some friends with the local Lilles, build a home, and reform the island while finding a way back.

title: Glass Hearts
description: Gripping psychological thriller Yaoi game full of difficult choices. Can you trust your own mind?

title: Bunny Box Breakout
description: Break blocks. Rescue bunnies. Collect bunnies. All the bunnies. ALL THE BUNNIES.

title: Angel Droid
description: Vampire Survivors meets Magicka! Welcome to Angel Droid, the game of experimentation and reflection. Craft thousands of spells to fight demons within the human mind, whether the human wants the help or not.

title: The Demon Within Me
description: The Demon Within Me is a first-person psychological horror game featuring a dark, lonely, and atmospheric environment that offers an immersive and disturbing experience.

title: Troubleshooting
description: An FPS in your old family computer. Hunt a virus, fix the WiFi, and become an actual JPEG. Contains BSODs, a massive homework folder, and maybe even a paperclip. Your old computer needs you one last time.

title: Hot Cleopatra
description: The scorching sun of the desert pleasantly warms the skin, and the air is filled with the aroma of flowers growing near the palace. The mistress of seas, sands, and hearts is ready to travel the Nile.

title: Furry Love & Sex
description: Furry Love & Sex is a match3 game with live2D animations. Claw - the main character, performed dirty for the evil corporation Cosgrove tek. Then instead of paying him the corporation decided to kill him. Miraculously surviving he is now trying to repay the debt.

title: How a Retired Strategist Saved the Country
description: This is a real-time strategy simulation game in which players develop their country while managing and operating its resources. Players are asked for help by various heroines, including elves, beastmen ......, and others, and command the armies of their countries.

title: Monstrous Love
description: Monstrous Love contains three adult short stories, focusing on women discovering their sexuality and freedom with gentle yet ferocious monsters. Be seduced by a world of love, sex, and claws in this sex-positive gaming experience!

title: Junjou Gal to Shiawase no Katachi: Shape of Happiness
description: A childhood friend reunited with you after several years has turned into a "Gyaru"!? Just how will the girl who loves the protagonist even after her makeover, and our troubled protagonist's relation turn out? Will they be able to find their shape of happiness?

title: My Mistress
description: My Mistress is a relaxing puzzle game that makes you happy. Finish the puzzle and enjoy yourself alone with the ladies!

title: Heroes of Eroticism: New Beginnings
description: Experience the first 3 episodes of Heroes of Eroticism in this one convenient package, full of excitement, romance and tough choices. After having once been entirely eradicated, superpowers are suddenly returning. Will this generation handle them better than the last one?

title: Strip n Play with Valerie
description: Fun, quick, adult game with sexy women and amazing animated scenes!

title: Mosaique Neko Waifus 5
description: Unique hentai puzzle about flirting with cute anime Neko girls. "Neko Waifus" is a series loved by millions around the world.

title: 3 Seasons
description: A slice of life, romance and fantasy dating sim featuring 3 love interests, romance/friendship routes and an original soundtrack.

title: The Crimson Flower that Divides: Lunar Coupling
description: A fictional world that's full of exoticism. This is a romance adventure game for women that depicts rich romantic relationships that involve the character's countries, along with conflicts and beliefs.

title: Together We Live
description: Kyoya awakens in a dimly lit room. According to the girl who happened to pass by, the world has perished. Reluctant to believe, Kyoya sets off with the girl to search for other living beings, journeying through the ruined world together. However, the girl had a purpose. To atone for the sins of humanity, she must continue to die. Again and again, dozens of times, hundreds of times, thousands of times, tens of thousands of times. She dies and then comes back to life. As he watches her, who knows only suffering, Kyoya starts to desire to teach her about happiness. Together We Live is a new version of the visual novel Stand By You, featuring completely redrawn graphics and a new improved translation.

title: Half-Life: Peaces Like Us
description: Half-Life: Peaces Like Us is a singleplayer modification for Half-Life, by Koumei Satou with a Xen setting.

title: The Ship
description: Imagine a game in which you don't know who to trust, you don't know who may be about to kill you, in fact you don't even know who is human and who is artificial. Played online, your quarry is another human player but can you find them amongst the AI inhabitants of the Ship? Once you know who they are, find yourself a weapon but keep an eye out for security guards and cameras. If you're spotted trying to murder someone you'll be transported to the Brig and suffer a hefty fine. If you succeed in killing your quarry Mr. X will reward you with a cash prize, depending on how entertaining he found your murder. At the same time you must look after yourself, wash, sleep, eat and have fun and remember - always look over your shoulder because somewhere there's a player looking for you!

title: En Route 66
description: Jose Reynolds, a journalist, for the “Santa Fe Times” in New Mexico, obtains interesting information from his sources, that a few hours ago, not far from “Route 66″, strange animals were found dead. Without hesitation, he left the office and hit the road, riding the highway, and after some time came across one of these…

title: Lightning
description: Fast-paced competitive FPS with character abilities. combining realistic settings with superpowers. geared toward esport.

title: Kevin Costner's Waterworld
description:
A large scale real imagining of the 'fake' Waterworld arcade game that Milhouse plays during a 10 second joke in a 1997 episode of The Simpsons.

All the greatest and most memorable parts of the movie are recreated here in Simpsons videogame form!

title: Friday Night Funkin': The Trollge Files
description: The Trollge Files is a horror mod for Friday Night Funkin' directed by Malicious Bunny about Agent Blueballs, an agent for the Trollge Containment Facility who trap and contain corrupted trolls. When Agent Blueballs is tasked to take down a particularly dangerous troll, he gets trapped inside his own subconscious and has to face his inner demons one by one to escape, and save his world.

title: Idle Cyber Dungeon
description: This is a Cyberpunk style role-playing game. Players don't need a lot of operations, they just need to think about some strategies to complete the victory.

title: Valkkryes: Ashes of War
description: Play Valkkryes: Ashes Of War, Infiltrate strategic locations, gather supplies and be armed, alert and alive to become the hero who stands tall on the battlefields. Drop a lot of traps and surprise objects while collecting reinforcements,

title: Yuukyuu no Campanella
description:
The kingdom of Atlastia --

North of the world, there's a group of flying islands - this is where the flying continent of Atlastia and its well-known titular kingdom is located. And not only in Atlastia itself - everywhere across the flying islands - the legend of a particular clan is being passed down from generation to generation.

The legendary heroes clan, "Oasis."

Even though they had saved the continent 100 years ago, their sub-commander Chester Silver has laid dormant for ages now. Now, about 100 years have passed and as Chester wakes up from his long arduous slumber he...

...bears witness to the Idol Princess Claria singing her songs to entertain the public. He wakes up as being one of her supporters cheering her on.

And then --

Spurred on by Claria's admiration for the Heroes Clan "Oasis," Chester Silver gathers his former companions, the twin sisters Angelique and Juliet Gilbert, to embark on a new adventure.

At the same time, a mysterious woman who had woken up from her slumber in the crypt of a ruin, Colette says:

"Now that Colette has woken up, this world's fate is sealed."

Strange incidents begin to occur in the world and with the causality of 100 years past intertwining, the adventure Chester seeks is closer than he thinks.

title: Dungeon Cross
description: A Python + Pygame stand-alone, reimplementation of Zachtronic's Dungeons and Diagrams.

title: Mensalão, O Jogo
description: Mensalão, O Jogo is a game based on the Mensalão scandal where you need to consult the records of the testimony of the Parliamentary Commission of Inquiry and find the four suspects who will be indicted in the ensuing administrative process, with the purpose of hunting down their respective mandates.

title: Deathwatch
description:
Deathwatch is a horror game in which you are tasked to observe haunted locations, log supernatural events and eradicate any potential paranormal threats.
You'll need to keep a keen eye on every camera and even your present location for any supernatural occurrences. Possible events vary from Audio to Victims and paranormal sightings, plus many more. Using your computer systems you must log each event to gather enough data to eliminate the entity, before it eliminates you!
Deathwatch puts you in a vulnerable state where your only chance of survival is to successfully log enough supernatural events in order to survive the night. You need to constantly be aware of your own surroundings because you may not be the only one observing.

title: StarHeroes
description:
StarHeroes is a top-quality third-person space shooter (TPS) which combines the best features of games like Everspace, Fortnite or Counter-Strike.

All this is to provide the player with dynamic multiplayer spaceship combat. In the game, you take on the role of a spaceship pilot - Star Hero - who, along with his team, competes against other players in one of two modes: Adventure Mode or Ranked Mode.

Both modes are skill-based and free to play, as we believe sustainable economy needs to be based on the fun arising from playing a game rather than playing to earn.

title: Hazuki Makimura's Love Story
description: Hazuki Makimura's Love Story is the Nintendo Switch port of the 2021 romantic visual novel where after a series of misfortunes, with the protagonist, Kayabuki Akira, being trapped after a tree fell into his apartment and the wall connecting his temporary apartment room to his neighbor's collapses, he's now forced to live with his neighbor, Makimura Hazuki, and deal with living together and getting to know each other better.

title: Littlebird/TrueEyes
description: A Nintendo Switch port.

title: Pokémon Soulstones
description:
An entirely new Pokemon storyline set in the modern era and near future. This Pokemon fan game features pokemons up to the 7th generation, a level cap of 175, 35+ hours of content and a narrative focused adventure through the Epoch region as you hunt down legendary trainers known as Soul Keepers.
It also features over 200 new regional forms for existing pokemons and 60+ new mega forms.

title: Salvus: Aries
description: A mature slice of death and adventure fantasy otome visual novel that begins at the bad ending.

title: Path to Christmas
description:
Path to Christmas is a cute holiday Mystic Square classic 15 puzzle interpretation about Mr. Gift.

Demonstrate savvy and help Mr. Gift to get in time under your Christmas tree!

title: Gyakuten Saiban
description: A straight port of Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney released in Japan as an episodical game.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney
description: A remaster of the original Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, released exclusively as part of the Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy bundle.

title: Gyakuten Saiban 3
description:
The third installment of the Gyakuten Saiban/Ace Attorney series of text adventure video games. It is the last installment in the Gyakuten Saiban Trilogy. In addition to featuring three episodes in which Phoenix Wright faces off against a mysterious new prosecutor named Godot, the game also features the first two cases of Mia Fey's law career.

Like the other two games in the trilogy, it was first a Game Boy Advance exclusive title and only released in Japan (until the Nintendo DS port in 2007).

title: Ananke
description:
Ananke is an adventure and exploration game set in the premises of a strange company.

Who are you? Why have you been sent to work there? And what is Exafan Consulting exactly doing?

Explore the company, talk the employees, find out what's going on... But try to be discrete or else snooping around could lead to dramatic consequences.
Ananke is an innovative narrative experience built around a first-person pixel art engine.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake - BFF Edition
Metavoidal
description: Play as a drummer seeking revenge on a Metal Band of Eldritch Monsters in this wacky roguelite brawler. Fight through hordes of enemies with only your drumsticks & drumming techniques as your weapons. Tap into the power of their music by finding corrupted music discs to increase your strength to defeat each of the band members. Are you good enough to escape the corrupted hellscape, once and for all?

title: This is Hell
description: Taking inspiration from rage-games like Getting Over It, Jump King, and Pogostuck, This is Hell is a frustrating experience with difficult controls. Each of the 2 joysticks on your controller move his massive fists, and your goal is to reach the pearly gates above. What awaits you in eternal paradise?

title: Bus Parking 3D
description:
Park something bigger.
One of the most realistic Bus Driving game and Bus Simulator.
If you like Bus Games, you should definitely try this game.
In this legendary Bus Game, you will drive and park different buses.

title: Dusk Hollow
description: Dusk Hollow is a horror hack-and-slash game that follows a miner braving the depths of an underground cave system, to rescue his friends who have seemingly been taken by the cave itself. Using what tools he finds around him, the protagonist has to fight against monsters inhabiting the cavern.

title: Unified
description: Unified is a short, 2,596 word kinetic (linear, no choices) visual novel about universal consciousness. Everything is connected viaa a conscious intelligence that runs the universe. It's about dropping the ego - the idea of being a person itself.

title: Quiz.com
description:
Play 1000s of free quizzes on your PC. Challenge your friends on any device.
Use phones or tablets as controllers and compete in multiple question types.

title: Unusual Times
description:
Spring is coming, but winter still does not want to let go of everyone! You will be waiting for a very unexpected story! You will play the role of winter, which fights with spring!
The game is a famous tower defense genre, but instead of ordinary towers you will have snowflakes or ice that will fight off spring plants and beetles. Also, you will observe changes not only in the gameplay, but also in the game menu.
And how it all unfolds, you have to find out in the game itself.

title: Pokémon Empyrean
description:
Embark on a mesmerizing Pokémon adventure in the captivating Omuran and Deshret regions! Immerse yourself in an epic tale of spies tackling an impending cataclysm, while exploring a breathtaking world brought to life in the beloved art style of Pokémon's third generation. Prepare to encounter a host of captivating new Pokémon and awe-inspiring forms, as well as unveil the true power of Mega Evolutions.

Harness the extraordinary ability to fuse with your Pokémon, forging an unbreakable bond like never before. Unleash your strategic prowess with the revolutionary GP system, placing a captivating emphasis on breeding. Get ready for an adventure that will ignite your imagination and challenge your skills as a Pokémon Trainer!

title: Noctuary
description: Two young illuminators, Fancia and Alina, start their adventure in the bright and fascinating Inlixaland... ...in pursuit of becoming trustworthy "Arborangers."

title: Acrophile
description: There's an island in the Atlantic Ocean that doesn't show up on maps. A constant storm guards it from outsiders, and makes it impossible to tell day from night. There are rumours of an uncontacted tribe on the island... the discovery of a lifetime. Brought to you by PORTAL emulator.

title: Resident Evil 2: Pix' N Love Limited Edition
description:
Below the content of that rare edition produced in Europe:

- Copy of the Game
- A richly illustrated 80-pages book on the creation of the original Resident Evil 2 game in 1998, and its 2019 remake
- A numbered PVC card with the “Lab Card Key” design from Resident Evil
- 4 lithographs of illustrations made for the game Resident Evil 2 (2019)
- An exclusive gamebox with hot red highlights

title: Summer Vacation
description: Mathieu a young man goes to his uncle's for his last holidays before entering college. Little did he know it would be a quest to explore his sexuality with a little help from his older cousin and other characters you'll find along the way. Join the game for an unexpected summer vacation where you will make fantasies come true.

title: Garnet Cradle
description:
Miku belongs to the literature club. One day, she takes charge of writing a scenario of a play staged at the school festival and is given the original book. As she reads it, she gradually feels doubtful about its ending.

Several days later, she accidentally falls down into a mysterious fountain that is located deep inside the school and goes to another world. There also live her friends and classmates, but they show different personalities to her. Like this, she starts living at two worlds, but the same story written in the book happens in another world and a tragic ending happens.... When she notices, she comes back to the real world. However, time has gone back and she is given the original book again.

She finally understands that the real world and the other world are like a mirror and repeat the same time. She decides to rewrite the story to avoid a tragic ending for the future of her beloved person. Who will Miku save? Who will Miku hurt? No one knows until the end of the story... No one knows if she will be able to save her beloved person....

title: Gosen-sou
description: An infinite runner starring Lilith from Machikado Mazoku. You can play as her humanoid and statue forms.

title: Hira Hira Hihiru
description: "Hira Hira Hihiru" is a visual novel set in a fictional Taishō Era. It tells the story of its two protagonists' struggle against Aerodema, a terrifying disease which brings the dead back to life.

title: Root: The Riverfolk Expansion
description:
Two new factions and Vagabond variants bring new challenges to Root!

Riverfolk Company
The Riverfolk Company is open for business – the woodland may be at war, but there's no reason you can't make a profit! Establish trade posts and earn your victory!

Lizard Cult
Spread the scaly gospel of the Lizard Cult! Tend your gardens to radicalize new acolytes, and reveal the true extent of your proselytizing power!

New Vagabond Variants!
Three new Vagabonds skulk into the woodland to help you swindle your way to victory!
The Scoundrel torches the woodland rather than see others rule it
The Vagrant starts fights that others have to finish
The Arbiter offers their services...for a price, of course!

title: PGA Tour 2K23: Tiger Woods Edition
description:
The PGA TOUR 2K23 Tiger Woods Edition includes all of the content from the Deluxe Edition, including the Michael Jordan Bonus Pack, Golden Club Pack, Tiger Woods Signature Sunday Pack, and Tiger Woods Edition Bonus Pack.

PGA TOUR 2K23. More Golf. More Game.

title: Thief City
description: Steal a little and they'll put you in jail, steal a lot and they'll make you #1. Thief City is a low poly, indie, cross-platform multiplayer, casual & action game. Select your community, battle it out, and climb to the top of the leaderboard!

title: Still Joking
description: What do mirror reflections do once they have no one to repeat after anymore? This game offers you a few ideas to explore.

title: Numeral Lord
description: minimalism strategy game

title: Witch Potion
description: Play mini games to gather magic ingredients, use the ingredients to make potions, then test them to see... Witch Potion is Which? You need to make a bird potion so you can fly to the party

title: Idol-Mahjong: Final Romance R
description: The third entry in the Idol Mahjong series.

title: Palais de Carnaval
description: A fandisc for Palais de Reine for PC.

title: Palais de Royale
description: A fandisc for Palais de Reine.

title: Mystic Mind: Yureru Omoi
description: Allows the player to choose between a male or a female (Kei Katsuragi or Megumi Kawai) to play with, depending on that choice the game will be different and the characters that the player will meet too (male or female ones).

title: Feathered Run
description: Feathered Run is a 4-button precision platformer-runner with 2D graphics. Embark on an exciting escape through Antarctica. Playing as one of the seemingly helpless penguins.

title: The End is Nigh: Shattered Spectrum
description: The End is Nigh: Shattered Spectrum is a fan-made expansion for The End is Nigh. It's a new campaign with many new areas to explore. It expands upon the lore and story of the original game.

title: Stockwrk7
description: A short First Person Horror-Adventure on a single Floor. Explore the Floor and try to solve the riddles. But don't get too deep into it. You don't know what you'll find.

title: Half-Life 2 Mirrored
description: Half Life 2 but flipped!

title: Relayer Advanced
description: This game depicts the fierce battle between the "Starchildren" and the extraterrestrial "Relayer" and lets you use the "Hate" and "Big Bang" systems to lead the battle to victory!

title: Slicing Slicing
description: "Slicing Slicing" is a casual game where players can score points by cutting a small ball that appears on the screen in half.

title: Magnetic Structures
description: Colourful magnetic rods and balls are at your command, Well, everything is ready, so it's time to build. Beautiful magnetic structures will be made by your hands.

title: Tiny Talents
description: Tiny Talents is a small game focused on growing your pet's various skills by feeding it candy. When you feel your pet's skill is good enough (buy a report card!), send it off to the local talent show for a chance to win a shiny trophy. Your pet will get tired after a few too many shows so be sure to only send them to one once you're sure they'll win.

title: Dear My Abyss
description:
One day Subaru receives a weird book from an anonymous sender. The book has a putrid smell and is sealed. Within it is a message stating that she should never read it and that it’s impossible to dispose of, even by burning or cutting it to bits.
Rather than being disgusted or afraid, Subaru thinks of it as a good way to pass time and decides to show it off to Misuka and Kazumi. They decide to try burning it but not before Subaru reads a bit of it.

A few days later, strange things start to happen; the nice teacher who was Kazumi’s only ally disappears, strange people appear all around town looking for a book, and a transfer student immediately takes an interest in Subaru.

title: DnD Adventure: Rogue's Choice
description: With debts to pay to the underworld, you need to make a lot of coin fast! Perhaps worse, you're wanted by the King's men for desertion. Survival is your first priority...

title: XGamer: AI Revolution
description: XGAMER - AI Revolution is a sci-fi third-person RPG game. In the main world, it is divided into 4+1 areas, the first 4 areas are: phantom, earth, void and heat. Each core has 20 programs. Find out The Key is. By getting to know The Key and finding the world code, you will know the truth.

title: Trials of the Illuminati: Women of Beauty Jigsaws
description: Trials of the Illuminati: Women of Beauty Jigsaws is an animated jigsaw puzzle game for a casual relaxing time. Game features 42-piece, 150-piece, and 351-piece puzzle varieties. Two extra modes also exist for each of the piece counts. Illuminati Rank 1 takes half the pieces away from top, bottom, left, or right.

title: Words Plus
description: Words Plus is a third-person narrative game. In the game, you will play the role of a daze AI boy, through a total of 9 scenes, including caves, galleries, theaters and so on, using the language of the concrete text model to interact with the scene, and experience the extremes of online language.

title: My Furry Teacher
description: You find yourself stuck in an empty school with your sexy goth trainee. Although she may seem annoying at times, spending an entire night together might just change your perception of her... right?

title: Hentai Furry 3
description: Hentai Furry 3 is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful art.

title: The Infinite Black 2
description: The Infinite Black 2 casts the player in the roll of a Captain managing a fleet of ships to hunt aliens, trade resources, loot treasures, and craft equipment. Join player-run corporations with friends to build shipyards, discover (and use) strange alien technology, and vie for territorial control. Test your mettle in a PvP Arena against other Captains, or declare yourself an Outcast Corporation, waging a never-ending intergalactic war against all who oppose you!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Awoken
description: Patch 2.1, the very first major version update for Final Fantasy XIV, sees large-scale additions and refinements made to Eorzea. Featuring the first installment of the Crystal Tower 24-man raid, the housing system for free companies, and rebalanced job actions.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Through the Maelstrom
description: Patch 2.2 contains myriad additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea. Players seeking the thrill of combat can face off with Leviathan or brave the new twists and turns of the Binding Coil. Artisans can try their hand at demanding new recipes, and master anglers can reel in legendary denizens of the deep. From new dealings with the beast tribes to new dances sweeping the land, there is much to see and more to do in the ever-changing realm of Eorzea!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Defenders of Eorzea
description: Patch 2.3 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea including new story quests, a new primal battle, Frontline, the Hunt, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Dreams of Ice
description: Patch 2.4 – Dreams of Ice adds a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea including new story quests, a new primal battle, dungeons, recipes, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Before the Fall
description: Patch 2.5 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea, including new story quests, a new primal battle, a new Frontline battle, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: As Goes Light, So Goes Darkness
description: Patch 3.1 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea, including new story quests, new beast tribe quests, exploratory missions, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: The Gears of Change
description: Patch 3.2 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea, including new story quests, new beast tribe quests, battle class adjustments, and more!

title: No Man's Sky: Waypoint
description: Access the universe of No Man’s Sky from anywhere in update 4.0, Waypoint! Launching for the first time on Nintendo Switch, and overhauling fundamental elements of gameplay including game modes, inventory size and usability, milestones, journey cataloguing and much more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Revenge of the Horde
description: Patch 3.3 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea, including new story quests, beast tribe quests, dungeons, recipes, and more!

title: No Man's Sky: Endurance
description: Dramatically expand your capital ship in update 3.94, Endurance! Introducing deeper and more varied freighter base building, including exterior platforms and catwalks; enhanced nebulae and deep space storms; fleets of organic frigates; and so much more!

title: No Man's Sky: Outlaws
description: Become an interstellar rebel in Update 3.85, Outlaws! Introducing outlaw systems; the ability to recruit your own squadron of pilots; improved space combat; a stunning Solar Sail Starship, and much more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Soul Surrender
description: Patch 3.4 brings myriad additions and refinements to the realm. Challenge seekers can test their mettle against fellow adventurers in duels and the Feast custom matches. Those who'd rather sit back and watch can enjoy the action with the new spectator mode. Whether you're relaxing in your new apartment or exploring the realm to collect wondrous tales, there's something for everyone here in Eorzea!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: The Far Edge of Fate
description: Patch 3.5 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm of Eorzea, including new story quests, dungeons, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: The Legend Returns
description: Patch 4.1 brings a multitude of additions and refinements to the realm. Band together with your friends in search of the legendary land of Ivalice, explore the ancient city of Skalla, or face an old foe in a reimagining of your battle with the legendary dragon Shinryu. Whether you’re relaxing in the new residential area, Shirogane, or testing your mettle in PvP, there’s something for everyone in this exciting new update!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Rise of a New Sun
description: Patch 4.2 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm, including new story quests, the Duty Recorder, additions to the Feast, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Under the Moonlight
description: Patch 4.3 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm, including the second installment of the Return to Ivalice saga, cross-world linkshells, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Prelude in Violet
description: Patch 4.4 brings a myriad of additions and refinements to the realm, including the continuation of the Four Lords and Omega sagas, new features such as mannequins and the Leap of Faith GATE, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: A Requiem for Heroes
description: Patch 4.5 includes a host of new features such as the very first limited job - blue mage, final chapters of the Four Lords saga and Return to Ivalice, and brand-new main scenario quests.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty
description: Patch 5.1 follows the Scions' continued adventures on the First, and features the first installment in the new alliance raid series, YoRHa: Dark Apocalypse, courtesy of guest creators Yosuke Saito and YOKO TARO!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Echoes of a Fallen Star
description: Patch 5.2 follows the Scions of the Seventh Dawn on their continued adventures, while the first chapter of the Sorrows of Werlyt marks the arrival of the deadly Ruby Weapon. This patch also brings the brand-new Qitari beast tribe quests, ocean fishing, and a host of additions and improvements.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Reflections in Crystal
description: Patch 5.3 brings a conclusion to the Shadowbringers story! This patch also brings the second installment of YoRHa: Dark Apocalypse, courtesy of guest creators Yosuke Saito and YOKO TARO. Other additions and refinements to the game include the addition of dwarf tribe quests, Faux Hollows, Unreal trials, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Futures Rewritten
description: Patch 5.4 follows the Scions of the Seventh Dawn as they resume their adventures in the Source. This patch also brings a conclusion to Ryne and Gaia's journey in Eden's Promise. Other additions and refinements to the game include the next installment of the Sorrow of Werlyt quest series, the new Explorer Mode, and more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Death Unto Dawn
description: In Patch 5.5 the stage is set for a cataclysmic battle that will lead into the story of Endwalker. This patch also introduces the third installment of YoRHa: Dark Apocalypse─the Tower at Paradigm's Breach─courtesy of guest creators Yosuke Saito and Yoko Taro, a new event to celebrate the Firmament's completion, and much more!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Newfound Adventure
description: Patch 6.1 follows the Warrior of Light's first steps on a new journey after claiming victory in the battle for the fate of the star. This patch also features the first installment in the new alliance raid series, Myths of the Realm, which delves into the mysteries surrounding the Twelve. A host of other additions includes the new Crystalline Conflict PvP content, the Duty Support system, and more.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Buried Memory
description: Patch 6.2 follows the Warrior of Light and their companions on a perilous journey into the void. This patch also introduces the next raid dungeon Pandæmonium: Abyssos, a challenging new trial, and Island Sanctuary for those adventurers seeking a taste of the slow life.

title: Black Mesa: Azure Sheep
description:
A remake of the Half-Life 1 mod Azure Sheep.

This is the story of Justin Barnes, Black Mesa security guard who goes to rescue his colleague after an Incident.

title: Bitter Silver
description: A choose-your-own-adventure, space western visual novel. Play as a bounty hunter leading a team of bickering misfits as you track down targets with your words or your weapons in a reactive story where your choices matter.

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 3 - Collector's Edition
description: Visit 9 European countries and search for interesting items in unforgettable old European towns and play a bunch of new mini games.

title: Hot Pussy College
description: Hot Pussy College is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel thanks to which you will plunge into the romantic world of students. A game filled with humor, sex, romance and drama awaits you. From romantic sex to the most specific kinks, Hot Pussy College is sure to satisfy you!

title: Zombie Apocalypse Survival Simulator
description: From the creators that brought you The Test Trilogy & many other experiences, comes Zombie Apocalypse Survival Simulator. Will you survive in the new world? Or will you become just another victim to looters, bandits, or worst of all... The Voracious Dead. There's only one way to find out...

title: Brigand: Battles
description: Brigand: Battles is a small DLC that uses some old modified maps and makes the player fight major battles. You can select one of three maps at the beginning to challenge you with extremely difficult and action-packed combat.

title: Dream Swing
description: Grapple and air-strafe your way to the top of the Leaderboard in this fast-paced movement-based time trial. Collect as many candies as possible within 5 minutes as you dip and weave around the ruins in the sky. Can you handle the speed?

title: Midnight Mercenaries
description: Midnight Mercenaries is a game that combines the fast-paced gameplay of Hotline Miami with the characters and mechanics from Team Fortress 2 and expands on both concepts.

title: My Little Pegasus: Kizuna DoPonyPachi
description: It's My Little Pony in the style of a Cave shoot em up. Play as either Rainbow Dash or Fluttershy and fight against the hordes of evil to save Equestria! Careful though; the evil forces have taken control of your friends, and they now pilot enormous battleships!

title: Streamers' Secret Life
description: Discover the secret life of these beautiful streamers in this exciting sliding puzzle jigsaw.

title: PuchiTamaWalker
description: PuchiTamaWalker is a fangame that allows you to explore the neighborhood of Sakuragaoka as seen in Machikado Mazoku. Familiar faces and locations await for fans of the show.

title: La Prision
description:
La Prision (The Prison) is a massively multiplayer role-playing game online (MMORPG), set in a prison as a persistent game world, to be played exclusively through the Internet.

Players take the role of a prisoner in a special jail, living under the rules of the game, interacting with other players (for better or worse) and venturing into the intricacies of the world and its characters.
