The player's character in the game is a prisoner sentenced to life imprisonment. To introduce a new player in the game world, he must create a character, give him a ASPECT (sex, constitution, hairstyle, clothing ...), select a crime for which he has been imprisoned and some defining features.

To improve the character and increase the level he need to get experience. This is obtained from fights, but also helping many of the Bots doing several missions. He can fight in groups to share the experience of a difficult fight, although a senior level, players are often organized in clans to communicate better and help, establish a uniform etc.

The character has a set of skills depending on the chosen crime. Some of them require that the character and his training have reached a certain level of experience. He can also try to steal items from action bots. When caught, a fight can be started, but also at any given moment with another character.

As in other games, there are several trade skills, here for instance by going to the kitchen and combining objects in the oven, or finding books in libraries to learn recipes, concepts of mechanics, the art of chemical or sewing. The game has an advanced and configurable chat system to improve the communications between players.

The point of view in the game is third-person. The character can also be seen from different fixed cameras, depending of the room where he is in. When in combat, the player enters a special "combat mode" where he can control the cameras of the scene. Up to 32 players can be immersed in a battle between prisoners or bots.

title: Sangoku Rensenki: Otome no Heihou! Omoidegaeshi
description: A Fandisc with after stories.

title: Sangoku Rensenki Sakigake
description: Set in a time prior to the previous 'Sangoku Rensenki' games. A completely new work with brand new characters.

title: Gakuen Rensenki
description: An otome game based on the popular bonus drama CD of the Sangoku Rensenki series.

title: Tokimeki Factory Vol.1
description:
Tokimeki Factory is a storytelling game developed by ActMind and published by Konami for PC and MacOS. The game allows players to create and write their own scenarios featuring one of six boys. Players can customize the backgrounds, boys' clothes, dialogue, and music. Over 1,000 lines of voiced dialogue were recorded for the game.

It was split into two volumes (Tokimeki Factory Vol. 1 and Tokimeki Factory Vol. 2), each featuring different characters. A complete box set featuring both volumes was also released.

title: Tokimeki Factory Vol.2
description:
Tokimeki Factory is a storytelling game developed by ActMind and published by Konami for PC and MacOS. The game allows players to create and write their own scenarios featuring one of six boys. Players can customize the backgrounds, boys' clothes, dialogue, and music. Over 1,000 lines of voiced dialogue were recorded for the game.

It was split into two volumes (Tokimeki Factory Vol. 1 and Tokimeki Factory Vol. 2), each featuring different characters. A complete box set featuring both volumes was also released.

title: Tokimeki Factory Complete Box: Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side
description: A bundle of both Tokimeki Factory Vol 1 & 2.

title: Utakata no R: Houkai
description: "Utakata no R: Houkai" is a role-playing game created by "R Man 44", released in 2020.

title: No Man's Sky: Sentinel
description: Fight alongside your own personal robotic companions and battle an array of new foes in the Sentinel Update! Introducing a total overhaul of weapon systems; new lore and stories; all-new Sentinel enemies and combat behaviours; the ability to reprogram and adopt your very own friendly AI drone; and much, much more!

title: No Man's Sky: Frontiers
description: Become Overseer of your very own procedurally generated alien settlement in update 3.6, FRONTIERS. Make choices, guide your citizens, develop new structures and defend your people from the Sentinels. Or, take advantage of a massive overhaul of base building to construct your own dream base.

title: No Man's Sky: Prisms
description: Update 3.5, Prisms, dramatically refreshes the No Man’s Sky experience with a range of new visual features and technologies. The universe has never looked better, with reflections, new texture effects, more biome detail, improved lighting, new skies, new warp effects, creature fur, and a host more besides.

title: Altair Breaker: Legend Set
description: Set of additional "Avatars" and "Weapons" that can be used in the game "ALTAIR BREAKER".

title: Gleeb Glob
description: GleebGlob is a physics based 2D precision platformer where you play as an emotionally drained employee of a very large corporation, who's only trying to slack off by immersing himself within a video game to delay the inevitable pile of work he must address.

title: Frog In the Well
description: Frog just wants to get out of the well.

title: Stormworks: Industrial Frontier
description: The Stormworks: Industrial Frontier DLC is an expansion for the world of Stormworks, including a 400sqkm arid biome, road and rail lines, mining and refining, predator, prey , farm animals, pet dogs, and more!

title: CyberTitans
description: CyberTitans is a multiplayer strategy game with crazy mechanics where you lead your Titans against the world. Recruit your Titans, position them on the field and send them into the battleground. Choose the smartest way to manage your economy during the game, merge Titans, level up your Totem or roll the cybershop to summon up to 44 unique characters.

title: Wojak This Game
description: Simple rules apply! Be a Wojak and stay away from any traps! It won't be that simple, though. Will you be able to get beyond the irksome challenges and terrains that keep appearing in your path?

title: No Man's Sky: Expeditions
description: Update 3.3, Expeditions, introduces a brand new way to play No Man’s Sky. Start a fresh journey in a brand new game mode, master a unique set of challenges with revitalised mission mechanics, earn exclusive new rewards, visit bustling hub worlds, and much more!

title: No Man's Sky: Companions
description: Adopt an alien creature and explore the universe side-by-side in the Companions update! Take care of your new friend as they find hidden resources and protect you from hostile aliens, or genetically modify their eggs and breed unique, never-before-seen creations!

title: No Man's Sky: Next Generation
description:
Update 3.10 brings a graphically enhanced and smoother No Man’s Sky to the next generation of consoles. All enhancements are available to PC players.

Continue your journey in a universe with bigger bases, lusher planets, more players, faster warp speeds and more – free for all existing players.

title: No Man's Sky: Origins
description:
Update 3.0, Origins, dramatically expands the universe of No Man’s Sky. Explore a stranger, richer and more varied universe, with deeper planetary diversity, dramatic new terrain, a host of new creatures, new weather conditions, colossal buildings, and much more.

Our journey continues.

title: SpiritSurge
description: SpiritSurge is a turn-based, classic RPG set in the odd-yet-fantastical world of Launell. You fill the shoes of Nathaniel Andrews, a citizen of the chaotic country Conterra. He and his peers find themselves unwillingly wrapped up in the machinations of the many corporeal and spiritual powers that be, engaging in combat when needed

title: Wonderworld
description: This is a real-time strategy game where you can command the Little Glutinous Legion to fight against hostile forces. The characteristics are controlled by genes, and there are trillions of combinations. The game includes three modes, and Little Glutinous welcomes you to their world.

title: Forgiven
description:
FORGIVEN is an upcoming RPG game detailing the adventures of four kids
and the powers that arise with spiritual unity and focus

title: Play Rough
description: Play Rough is a roleplaying game set in the surreal, post-apocalyptic wasteland of what was once California. It's a place where humans live side-by-side with living cartoons, twisted abominations of ink and flesh, and... Clowns...?

title: Astra Hunter Zosma
description: Astra Hunter Zosma aims to be a short treasure-hunting RPG with a focus on combat, exploration, and a blossoming friendship between a buddy duo!

title: Attack Retrieve Capture
description: Attack Retrieve Capture was a free multiplayer, 2D computer game created by John Vechey and Brian Fiete, who would go on to co-found PopCap Games, as a college project and was later published by Hoopy Entertainment in 1995. The game was primarily capture the flag, but other game modes existed.

title: Judero
description: A handmade action/adventure game based on the rich folklore of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

title: Under the Black Moon
description:
Can you believe your luck? Travelling in a transport plane you get shot down! You survive and things only get worse.

Work your way through the area into the base and do whatever you have to do to get picked up. Take you time as the enemy has had plenty of time to prepare for your arrival (not that they were expecting you)

title: Sweet Half-Life
description:
Sweet Half-Life is a single player science fiction and Manga-based Mod of Valve's first-person shooter Half-Life, set at a similar time to the original game and following a similar storyline. It is played through the eyes of Gordon McGinley, and follows his plight to escape from the crumbling Black Mesa Research Facility.

It includes 3 new weapons and 5 new enemies.

title: Focalpoint
description:
A few hours after Adrian Shephard and his squad got scattered allover the Black Mesa Complex, headquarter sent a rescue team to search the lost crew.

Finding himself in the misery a soldier tries to do the best out of his lonely situation. Searching for allies he quickly becomes a major part in an issue he's never been training for.

title: Heart of Evil: Napalm Edition
description: Heart of Evil: Napalm Edition (HOE NE) is a remake of the original Heart of Evil.

title: Smart Decoy
description: You are sent to an underwater base. Your objective is to reach and destroy the “machine”.

title: Radix
description:
You find yourself on a spaceship, which seems to be researching Xen lifeforms. Follow the clues to a spot on the ship and then ignore the sign.

At this point things turn fun! Are you fast and smart enough to escape? Only time will tell….

title: The Xeno Project
description:
The terraformation of Xen has begun. The planet now supports a breathable oxygen-nitrogen atmosphere and earth-like gravity. A scientific facility called the Xeno Project has been set up on the planet for continuing research into portal technology. Tension on the planet is running high due to the secrecy surrounding the project and the military’s distrust of the scientific community.

You are Gordon Freeman. Your mission is to report to the underground test lab at the Xeno Project.

title: ETC: Earthquake Test Centre
description: All that matters is that you find yourself in a BM-style base with aliens and army trying to kill you. It’s clear that you need to find a way out. In fact, there’s a working portal, if only you could reach it!

title: ETC: Earthquake Test Centre 2
description:
ETC finished with Freeman heading into the teleporter. Where it took him was not revealed. So, where did Freeman go?

The military weren’t there just to clean out the creatures. They weren’t there to remove Freeman. They weren’t there to silence the innocents.

The military were there in need of information. ‘Xen’ was news to them. They had to know more. The teleportation unit they uncovered was merely an accessory allowing them to gain access to the facility. And Gordon went the wrong way. But Gordon was not prepared for this. You couldn’t be.

title: Nuclear Winter
description: Nuclear Winter is a single player mission for Half-Life Opposing Force. It comprises 29 new maps plus a ton of new scripted scenes, models, artwork, character voices, sound effects and music.

title: Crescent Prism
description: Crescent Prism is a story-driven RPG that follows the story of Lunita, a young girl from the bustling hamlet of Merryday Village.

title: Scientist Slaughterhouse
description: Gordon Freeman is an agent of an advanced weapons corporation called Death & Destruction Inc. (DDI). DDI on the other hand takes orders from an alien military force known as the Nephilim Alliance (NA), originating from an alternate dimension. The problem is loads of scientists are appearing out of nowhere and they need someone to get rid of them...

title: Crack Life
description: Crack Life was made from total boredom. It features a bunch of overused jokes and memes that only get more annoying every time you hear them.

title: Astromeda
description: Astromeda is an adventure RPG, featuring unique fast-paced and turn-based battles in a mysterious, charming world. You are a human who returns to an Earth inhabited by intelligent Bacteria. Explore a rich world, befriend or fight quirky characters, and uncover the mysteries of the Bacteria race. The game is inspired by Undertale, H

title: Cthulhu: An Unspeakable Mod
description: You play Ranulf Stafford, an occult investigator in Arkham in the year 1928. Drawn into a nightmare chain of events, you find yourself the only thing standing between mankind and the return of Cthulhu, one of the most dreadful of The Great Old Ones.

title: Jamie's Mod
description: After Black Mesa plummeted into the ground 200 years after the incident, it was brought back to life by a group of Blue-Headed men all named "Jamie". Jamie and all his friends now work at the lab, and ironically enough the same exact thing that happened 200 years ago happens again. Even with Gordon Freeman brought back from the dead.

title: Retro Abyss
description:
You Have Loved Games Since You Were Little.
But You Have Grown Up Without Defeating The Final Boss.
The Final Boss Remains In Your Heart And Leads You Into The Retro Abyss...

title: Pantazil
description: The Pantazil is a 2D exploration and platform game with a pixel art style.

title: Category I: Shisenjou no Survivor
description: A Japanese visual novel about survival in a deadly situation, where the protagonist and others must navigate life-and-death choices that shape the outcome of their fate.

title: Incubus: A ghost-hunters tale
description: You are on your first solo ghost hunt, under the watchful instructions of Bear and Jen from the O.P.G paranormal team. Use real gadgets in a real location, a house investigated by the developers on the request of three different owners. It is a case worthy of a video game, so welcome to Incubus.

title: Bomber Command
description: Take command of what would become the greatest air armada in history! Build, plan, coordinate, and command your forces into a mighty aerial armada against a smart German economy that adapts to your attacks, researches tech, and smartly reacts to your moves. Take over the Bomber Command.

title: Minion Masters: Torment
description:
The Torment DLC is a great +300% value bundle to unleash fire and fury on your enemies! including the legendary Crakgul Doomcleaver! It also gives you a headstart in this month’s Season Pass.

Includes:
- Magma Court Arena
- Volco (Master)
- Demolisher Volco Master Skin
- 3x Crakgul Doomcleaver (Legendary card)
- 5x Incubus (Supreme card)
- 20x Assassin
- 40x Magma Storm
- 5x Power Tokens (Get 5 extra random surprises)
- 3x Season Pass Tiers

Embrace your demon within with Volco, who enrages your melee Minions. Crakgul Doomcleaver strong attacks makes your Voidborne cards cheaper to play with each fresh kill, which lets you overrun your opponent with demonic horrors such as the Assassin and Incubus! The pack also includes the fiery Magma Court (custom arena) which is the perfect setting to unleash doom on your opponents!
With this DLC, you have the perfect kit to start your reign as a demonic overlord!

title: My Life: Riding Stables 3
description: Put your heart and soul into looking after the well-being of your beloved four-legged friends on a beautiful stud farm, which you can expand over the course of the game. Climb into the saddle and enjoy challenging training sessions, fantastic tournaments…

title: SnowRunner: Rezvani Hercules
description: Expand your SnowRunner garage further with the Rezvani Hercules, a high-performance 6-wheel Scout truck with a fierce and unique modern look.

title: Runefall 2: Collector's Edition
description:
Embark on an epic match-3 journey with your old friends from Rivermoor. The people didn’t have long to celebrate their previous victory after finding all the long-lost runes.

The Collector's Edition includes 25 extra levels, additional achievements, a strategy guide, the making of Runefall 2, a full game soundtrack, and desktop wallpapers.

title: Tales of Symphonia
description:
An HD remaster of the Playstation 2 version of Tales of Symphonia that comes with extra content. It is also bundled in the Tales of Symphonia Chronicles collection for the Playstation 3.

Over 80 hours of gameplay in this epic, emotionally charged storyline. Experience the fierce, action-packed battle system. Combine hundreds of special attacks and magic spells.

In a dying world, legend has it that a Chosen One will one day rise from amongst the people and the land will be reborn. The line between good and evil blurs in this epic adventure where the fate of two interlocked worlds hangs in the balance.

title: Crimson Snow
description: Story driven horror game with Christmas theme. It has a dialogue system and multiple endings.

title: Half-Life 2: Capture the Flag
description: Half-Life 2 Capture the Flag brings the familiar Capture the Flag game to HL2. It pits the Rebels against the Combine in a fast-paced battle over the flags within the graphics rich environment of the Source engine.

title: Jelly God
description: Jelly God is a colourful, casual, jelly management game. Design your character and play at your own pace in a procedurally generated open world. Grow your jelly tribe by figuring out recipes, spawning new chunks of land, and colouring the environment to unlock new resources.

title: The Girl in the Window
description: The Girl in the Window is the first point and click game the Dark Dome with which the series of a dark town called Hidden Town would begin surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room.

title: Lunch Box
description: A peaceful animal kingdom, everyone was attacked by ferocious animals that suddenly appeared while having a good day. Survive the purple animals as if they were infected. Either carry a gun to survive, or they'll be lunch boxes.

title: Horror Night: Spooky Night Vol. 1
description: Enjoy the spooky season by wearing this amazing costumes and masks while playing Horor Night :)

title: Omni Magic!
description: The Kingdom of Elaire was protected by Goddess. When the treasure was stolen, the King called for investigators, whose mission was to research monsters and bring the treasure back. The newly appointed magician Anemone goes on the adventure, using the item-based magic, "Omni Magic"...

title: Suika Game
description: A game where you drop fruits. When two of the same fruit meet, they form a bigger fruit, which can then combine to create an even bigger fruit, until eventually you form a watermelon!

title: No Man's Sky: Desolation
description: Scavenge and survive in the haunted wreckage of derelict freighters with the Desolation update. Introducing procedurally-generated freighters, more story content, combat improvements, freighter customisation and more!

title: Utakata no R: Kako-hen Awayuki
description: "Utakata no R: Kakohen Awayuki" is a role-playing game created by "R Man 44", released in 2021.

title: Linia Stripes
description: Linia Stripes is the new compelling “clear the board” game. Sit down, relax and collect patterns while you discover thousands of mesmerizing colorful levels!

title: Fluff
description: A game where you collect fluff balls that are loose and fill them into jars, all while being accompanied by a feline companion.

title: The Thing at the Window
description:
You live with your father in the rural American midwest. He left you home alone while he's out of town for the weekend, and you heard on the radio that there's a large storm heading your way.

You live in a rather underdeveloped part of the country so you're off the power grid, but fortunately your dad's pretty handy and he's wired up your old farmhouse to a gas generator, which you moved to the basement to keep it out of the storm. The basement smells kind of funny and it's really hazy down there, but it should be okay for now. There's a big fuel tank outside where you can refill your jerry can, and dad refilled it before he left. There's also a big pile of wooden boards out front from when your dad renovated the barn over the summer, so you can use those to board up the windows just in case.

The storm should be here soon and you're as prepared as you can be, but still you feel uneasy; something's not quite right... you feel as if something's lurking out there, watching.

Your goal is to survive three nights of the Thing trying to force its way into your home, by barricading doors and windows. The thing really doesn't like light, so you can drive it away with your rechargeable flashlight. You can also "reinforce" parts of the house by turning lights on, which will slow the thing's attacks at the cost of draining more power and needing to refill the generator more frequently.

title: Portal War
description: "Portal War" is a classic 2D "Tug of War" strategy game. You need to plan and send correct uncontrollable troops towards the enemies and hope they beat them.

title: Strategy Battles​
description: Strategy Battles is a real time strategy game.it has many fields such as diplomacy, military and science.but the economy has a weighted mechanics..build cars, chemical factories..you can sell or import your products.you can use many more methods for the welfare of the people.

title: Lost Hammer
description: Lost Hammer - This is a 3D adventure with puzzle elements and first person view. You have to take on the role of a city dweller who dreams of becoming a blacksmith's apprentice.

title: Mission In Space
description: 2d space shooter game where need avoid and destroy enemies and big boss

title: Sliiide!
description: Pair cuddly jello blocks into groups to melt your way onward across a zen and atmospheric landscape. Though deceptively simple, this game will make use of your wit, test your abstract thought and encourage you to think multiple moves in advance. Collect all the stars to solve the puzzle perfectly!

title: The Most Awesome Game Ever Made
description: Do you really want to live your life knowing that you never played 'The Most Awesome Game Ever Made?'... I didn't think so! Wishlist it right now so you don't miss out on the fun!

title: E.E.R.I.E2
description: E.E.R.I.E 2 is a tactical shooting game. In the modern Gensokyo, play the role of fairy Luna, and uses a variety of modern light weapons and tactical equipment to join in a war that decides the fate of Gensokyo.

title: Lisa: The Painful - Fractured Bonds
description: Lisa: The Painful - Fractured Bonds is a mod for LISA: The Painful that revolves around Brad's childhood friends Rick, Sticky, and Cheeks. The mod includes lots of new enemies to fight and new story cutscenes.

title: Annventure
description: Annventure is a RPG Maker horror game inspired by Earthbound.

title: The Brains & The Brawn
description: The Brains & The Brawn is a RPG Maker game inspired by LISA: The Painful.

title: Annventure of a Lifetime
description: This is the second game in the Annventure trilogy of horror RPGs created by Yoobi

title: An Annventure to End Them All
description: The final game in the Annventure trilogy of Earthbound inspired horror RPGs

title: This Way Madness Lies
description:
Let us begin our tale, in the quiet city of Verona, Italy. A town for lovers... and giant, mutant flower attacks.

As the leader of the Stratford-Upon-Avon High Drama Society, Imogen is no ordinary girl! Sure, she goes to school every day and helps produce plays for the community, but beyond that, she's a magical girl! With her powers, she can teleport to alternate dimensions based on Shakespeare plays, fight back the forces of Nightmare, and still get back in time for dinner!

Join Imogen, Paulina, Viola, Rosalind, Miranda, Beatrice, and Kate on an epic adventure throughout the Shakespearean metaverse in this comedy JRPG!

title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
(Content of "Atelier Ryza: Digital Deluxe Edition")
- The game "Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout"
- Costume Set "Another Fashion"
- Costume Set "Summer Style"
- Hideout Parts "Pixie Forest"
- Hideout Parts "Lakeside Hideout"
- Initial Dash Item Set
- Extra Large! Rebuild Gem Pack

The concept of this title, the latest in the series to depict a new "Atelier" world, is "True-to-life youths that develop together, even if just a little bit".
It is the story of a girl and her friends who are about to become adults, discovering what is most important to them.
To depict the story of the main characters discovering things they've never seen before, we've created fields with natural shadows that allow you to feel the breath of the world. Graphics have been further enhanced, allowing for a world of daily-life and adventure to be depicted in a new way.

title: Fairy Tail: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Magic × Guilds × RPG! Based on the fantasy adventure comic about Natsu, a Dragon Slayer of the rowdy Fairy Tail magician guild and his unique group of friends battling against no less unique and memorable enemies.

From popular fan-favorite episodes to original in-game episodes, players can experience the magical world of Earth Land and fight with Fairy Tail in the exhilarating story!

Fairy Tail's Digital Deluxe Edition comes with:
- Costume set: Grand Magic Games team costumes
- Bonus Lacrima set
- DDX limited costume: Ryza costume for Lucy

title: Pierre's Adventures in French
description: Want to improve your French? Need a break from flash cards and listening exercises? Ready to put what you've already learned into practice? Félicitations! This is the game for you.

title: Half-Life: Abeyance
description: Abeyance is the final entry into the trilogy of mods featuring the protagonist Jane Doe, the first two being HTC and Autonomy Lost. You play as Jane Doe, a HECU grunt, while hunting for the assassin who left you and your buddies for the Grim Reaper.

title: Half-Life: Uplinked
description: Uplinked is a series of eleven maps that aims to be an extension to “Forget About Freeman!”. You now have to tune the transmitter to gain access to the Lambda Complex. It contains several new puzzles along the way.

title: Half-Life: Science and Industry
description: Science and Industry is a teamplay mod for Half-Life, in which players assume the role of Security Officer in one of two rival corporations striving for domination in the cutthroat world of chemical and weapons research and development.

title: Half-Life Randomizer
description: This mod randomizes almost everything in Half-Life to give it a new, fresh way to play. You could get a hornet gun instead of the crowbar. A headcrab could be an assassin. Anything is possible, and no matter how many times you've played Half-Life, you'll never see what's coming.

title: Soda Hunt
description: Party sucks, all you want is to leave and drink a refreshing Soda. But everyone's up to stop you.

title: Half-Life: Hour-Glass
description:
After turning down the G-Man's offer, you manage to escape using an intergalactic teleporter that returns you back to Earth. But soon, that calm peacful feeling of returning back to normal is replaced with fear as you realize that your wife has disappeared along with several people from your apartment that have seemingly
disappeared.

title: Half-Life: Crowbar-Deep in the Dead
description: Half-Life: Crowbar-Deep in the Dead is a complete re-imagining of the first episode of DOOM (1993), taking all of the original levels from Knee-Deep in the Dead and remaking them in the style of Half-Life and its many expansions.

title: War: The Savior's Order
description: Step into the shoes of Tony Snyder - a former Navy Seals operative who just joined TSO, a top secret worldwide military organization. A new terrorist threat has been discovered, and they are planning something big. Uncover their secrets and plans as you fight against them and save the day.

title: Half-Life: Loop
description: Codename: Loop is a twin-stick shooter game based on Half-Life.

title: Half-Life: Recovery
description: Half-Life: Recovery is a Modification which continues the plot of the official add-on Decay after the events of the original add-on. The main character - Colette Green (partner of Gina Cross), looking for a way to leave Black Mesa along with Dr.Keller. A portable teleportation device will help them to do it. Taking possession of it is considered as a matter of life and death.

title: Half-Life: Hard Duty
description: Welcome to Hard Duty. This is a Half-Life modification with the objective of expanding the Half-Life universe with new content. Explore the Black Mesa Research Facility like never before and fight your way through hordes of enemies! How will you engage the situation? How will you survive?

title: Half-Life: Soldier
description: Find a way to enter into the enemy base, and destroy it. This is your only chance soldier.

title: Half-Life: Timeline 1
description: You are Gordon Freeman, formerly a scientist at Black Mesa Research Establishment, now reluctantly employed by a mysterious organisation as a troubleshooter. You are contacted by the Man in Blue. He seems strangely worried; something has ruffled his normally impenetrable character.

title: Half-Life: Rally
description: Half-Life Rally is a racing modification for the highly acclaimed and everlastingly popular game, Half-Life by Valve Software. Unlike most mods currently being made for the Half-Life Engine, the goal of HL-Rally is not to blast your enemy to smitherines with relentless repetition prone to excessive cheating and hacks, but to race cars and be the first and fastest across the finish line, out-running your opponents in any way possible to gain a few milliseconds on them.

title: Project: Quantum Leap
description: A Half-Life single player episode with a bit of a twist: each map is by a different mapper - 20 maps, 15 authors, one hell of an incoherent map pack!

title: Lisa: The Purposeful
description: This Lisa fan game tells the story of Richard Weeks from the original game and what happened to him after Brad and Sticky left him.

title: Action Half-Life
description: Action Half-Life is a multiplayer game that aims to simulate to experience of being in an action movie like Hard Boiled, Face Off, and Die Hard.

title: Liza: The Ungrateful
description: LIZA: The Ungrateful is a story about a woman who neglects the safety of her baby during pregnancy and seeks to find the one who caused the flash.

title: Action Quake 2
description: Action Quake 2 was originally developed in 1998 to recreate the look and feel of an action movie, having a fast pace and a semi-realistic damage system. It features many maps recreating realistic settings, such as city streets and office buildings, with a balanced range of weapons and equipment inspired by action films. Polished and prepared for modern re-release, we're inviting everyone to revisit what we call Aqtion!

title: Crypto-Shots
description: Crypto-Shots is a browser-based First Person Shooter Play to Earn game native to The WAX blockchain. The project has begun on the 19th of October'21 and has been ever developing since. In Crypto-Shots you can collect weapon parts, blend them into cool NFTs and use them to take down enemies across different planets. Or, if you like adrenaline, even challenge your friends in the arenas.

title: Cryogenics
description:
Cryogenics is a four-level PWAD for boom-compatible source ports designed by bemused and released in December, 2017. All four levels are designed around the slaughter map trope; extremely detailed geometry, massive architecture and high density of enemies are landmarks of the mapset. Cryogenics is designed for pistol start. It includes new textures and music.

Cryogenics was named as a runner-up during the Cacowards 2018.

title: Micro Slaughter Community Project
description:
Micro Slaughter Community Project (MSCP for short) is an eighteen-map Doom II megawad for Boom-compatible source ports. The project was led by Bauul and was aimed at creating a set of short and accessible slaughter maps with a par time of five minutes. The WAD uses textures from the OTEX texture set.

It was released on the Doomworld forums on January 28, 2021, and was uploaded to the idgames archive on April 23, 2021. The mapset received an honorable mention at the 2021 Cacowards.

title: Ar Luminae
description: Ar Luminae is a single-level PK3 for Doom II and the GZDoom source port that was released in November 2020. It was designed by Aurelius and Kaito and uses several music tracks: "Wolverine" and "Atomic" by James Paddock (Jimmy), "Fission Dance" by Brayden Hart (AD_79), and a MIDI rendition of "Gerudo Valley" from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. It received one of the 2020 Cacowards. The map integrates the gameplay changes of the Supercharge mod.

title: Black Snow
description: Welcome to Amaluuk research station, we hope your stay is a productive and pleasant one.

title: NoReason's Speedmaps 2
description: NoReason's Speedmaps 2 is a collection of new speed running maps.

title: The Glitched Attraction
description: Welcome to the new Fazbear Horror Attraction! Here, you will have to escape from the popular and safe animatronics of the old but improved Fazbear Entertainment! Complete the puzzles and get out of the rooms before time runs out!

title: Half-Life: Visitors
description:
You play the young lawyer Dr. Alan Green, who was sent to the desert as a safety evaluator to carry out a safety report of Black Mesa.

After a brief walk towards your temporary office you suddenly find yourself in a situation you are not prepared for. Can you use what you have around you to escape this nightmare?

title: Half-Life: Prison
description:
Prison Takes place on a Large Underground Prison Facility, Located on Siberia. In a Distress, Under This System is a Prison Dungeons Alien Hive and Once the Aliens come From Xena.

Gordon Freeman travels to the Destroyed Prison Overuned by Aliens and Travels to the Prison Dungeons Alien Hive, Where he Faces A Large Population of Aliens and Attempt to stop an Unknown Being that is Creating a Chaos.

title: Half-Life: Cleaner's Adventures
description: You play as Bryan Anderson, a Black Mesa janitor who is unfortunate enough to get caught up in the Resonance Cascade and must now combat the vicious Xen forces and the hostile HECU.

title: Half-Life: In Deep
description: This mod reinterprets Half-Life as closer to what the beta version was.

title: Plants vs. Zombies 2: Reflourished
description:
Introducing PvZ 2: Reflourished, a PvZ 2 mod that aims to bring back the classic pre-2017 feel to PvZ 2, while adding a bunch of new content as well!

From humble beginnings, this mod started as a remake of the classic Holiday Mashup experience, but kept growing, and growing, until we had a whole new game on our hands! With a whole team of modders, designers, and artists, we bring you: PvZ 2: Reflourished!

title: Fhtagn Simulator
description:
Fhtagn Simulator is a Roguelike card game inspired by deck-building games such as Luck be a Landlord, Slay the Spire, and Monster Train. If you don't collect enough spirit within the time limit, you will face punishment from the ancient gods resulting in game failure.

The world of Cthulhu is chaotic and disorderly, so cards always enter the roulette in a chaotic order, and each round may produce a different result. Except praying, there is one way to fight against Chaos, and that is to manage the card slots on the roulette. With a little change, you can maximize value of your cards.

During the course of the game you will experience various events, as well as obtain various cards, powerful mythical monsters, humble human sacrifices, evil spells and so on. In addition to this, relics rewarded by the evil gods have the ability to change the game. Use them well to get more spirit!

title: Eden's Edge
description: Eden's Edge is a 2.D vertical doujin Shoot 'em Up developed by x.x.

title: Project Sushi
description: A simple platformer with a little sushi's goal to reach the end as fast as possible! Go through the levels, weather your running on a chess table or in space, you'll be sure to have a fun and challenging time with this game.

title: Doki: Maternal
description: Doki: Maternal is a Brazilian educational game for PC

title: Minecraft: Pretty Scary Update
description: Minecraft: Pretty Scary Update adds several new mobs such as witches, bats, zombie villagers, wither skeletons, wearable and placeable heads, a new boss called The Wither, the command block, the anvil, the beacon, new food such as potatoes, carrots, and pumpkin pies), carrots on sticks for controlling pigs and new decoration items such as item frames, flower pots, and cobblestone walls).

title: Minecraft: Redstone Update
description: Minecraft: Redstone Update adds several new redstone-related blocks, including the comparator, hopper, dropper, daylight sensor, trapped chest, weighted pressure plates, and block of redstone, as well as a new block called block of quartz, a scoreboard system, a new texture pack format, and a lighting engine optimization.

title: Minecraft: Horse Update
description: Minecraft: Horse Update adds many new features such as horses, baby zombies, leads, coal blocks, carpets, resource packs, and a new launcher.

title: Minecraft: The Update that Changed the World
description: Minecraft: The Update that Changed the World adds many new features such as a new terrain generator, many new biomes and biome variations, stained glass, red sand, new tree types, a new spawn system, new fish and a new fishing system with rewards, many new flowers, many more customization options, custom-size Nether portals up to 23×23, command blocks in minecarts, and many new commands.

title: Minecraft: Bountiful Update
description: Minecraft: Bountiful Update adds 36 new blocks, 4 new mobs, a new underwater dungeon content called the ocean monument and other changes.

title: Minecraft 1.9: Combat Update
description: Minecraft 1.9: Combat Update completely overhauls the combat system, among other additions and changes.

title: Minecraft: Exploration Update
description: Minecraft: Exploration Update is a major update for Minecraft that adds the Woodland Mansion and its mobs, cursed enchantments, new villager professions, mobs, and items.

title: Minecraft: World of Color Update
description: Minecraft: World of Color Update is a major update for Minecraft, which added new and changed colored blocks to be more vibrant. It also added the Parrot, the recipe book and the knowledge book, new commands, and other additions.

title: Minecraft: Update Aquatic
description: Minecraft: Update Aquatic is a major update to Minecraft that focuses on revamping the oceans in the game, adding many new aquatic mobs, blocks, items, and structures.

title: Half-Life: Black Guard
description:
Dr. Eddy has been up to no good. To be honest, that seems like most scientists at Black Mesa. You are part of the Black Guard, I suppose that’s like Black Shift, but maybe not.

Without warning, things really get crazy and you find yourself in the middle of it. Do what BMRF has paid you to do: Kick some butt!

title: Half-Life: Operation Rift
description: This is the second part of HECU Corporal Timothy Collins story and another sequel to Half-Life: Operation Rosenberg.

title: Half-Life: Brave Brain
description: You play as Thomas Redgrave, a friend of Gordon Freeman, who works in different laboratories of Black Mesa on the same day of the accident. You are taking a refresher training course when things go wrong. Do your best to survive until you meet some other scientists, who tell you exactly what you need to do.

title: Half-Life: The Alpha Unit
description:
You play as Corporal Daniel Fletcher and your mission is to recover data from the Anomalous Materials Laboratory.

Along the way you will encounter all sorts of enemies and eventually rejoin your unit. Can you complete your objective?

title: Half-Life: Dark Future
description: The last part of the Rosenberg trilogy.

title: Shall we date? Eternal Vows: Love Beyond Time
description:
Originally released as Nise no Chigiri in Japan for PSP & PC.
Published by NTT Solmare in English for iOS and Android.

title: Garnet Cradle: Sugary Sparkle
description: Fandisc of Garnet Cradle.

title: Escape Simulator: Wild West
description: This level pack includes four new escape rooms set across iconic locations that capture the spirit of the Wild West. Put on your best cowboy hat and escape from a jail, visit a shady saloon, raid the bank, and run away on a luxury train!

title: Black Ops
description: You are a black ops male agent, sent to eliminate DR. Gallagher, former member of the Black mesa science team, who is hiding in the Dead end night club. You aren't able to find him, but in the warehouse, you hear a .357 Magnum being fired. It was DR. Gallagher, that commited suicide. You pick up the bomb (As seen in the case in Opposing Force, with 2 Black ops activating the bomb), Let yourself captured by the grunts, in the jail, go to a dirty rotten cell. you make your way out, get to Black mesa. When you set the bomb, you are shot by Adrian Shepard, but NOT killed. You see the G-man re-arming the bomb, you wake up, but you must get out of there.

title: Half-Life: Operation Rosenberg
description:
At the end of Blue Shift you escape with a few scientists. Dr. Rosenberg is one of them. In this mod, you continue that story.

You are Corporal Timothy Collins, an HECU marine sent from Black Mesa to the mysterious Area 99. Your mission: recapture Dr Rosenberg who escaped from Black Mesa and go to A-99.

title: Half-Life: Weapon Edition
description: A multiplayer mod that aims to have as big of an arsenal as possible.

title: Half-Life: Timeline III - The Heart of Darkness
Half-Life: The Gate
description: The Gate is a single player modifcation with a difference, featuring a 30 plus strong team of voice actors, and authentic WWII weaponry and heart pumping classical music.

title: The Gate 2
description: The story continues from where the last game left off, this time The TimeGate will take the player to amazing new world in distant universes. Unlike the first Game The Gate II will feature many more enemies to fight! Some Alien some Human and a few more besides.. We have a full inventory of Professional voice actors on our team so The Gate II will of course feature a full movie style script. The Gate II like its predecessor will also be released with a full classical musical score.

title: Autonomy Lost
description: Autonomy Lost is the sequel to HTC . Once again you play as the HECU grunt Jane Doe, set directly after the events of HTC.

title: HTC
description: HTC is a small map pack for Half-Life in which you take control of Jane Doe, a HECU grunt, while hunting for the assassin who left you and your buddies for the Grim Reaper.

title: Vagalumancer
description: There's a little fella that wanders through the darkness of the night... a master of luminic magic whose power is sufficient to conquer the evil ones that were brought upon this land. The sly firefly called... Vagalumancer.

title: Minecraft: Village & Pillage
description: Minecraft: Village & Pillage is a major update for Minecraft themed around revamping villages, adding a new subset of illagers known as pillagers, vindicators, evokers, and vexes, and redesigning village architecture to match the biome where it is located. This update also includes many new blocks and mobs, a revamp of the crafting system by moving some functionalities to different blocks, updates the taiga biome with foxes, and berries, and adds a new bamboo forest jungle variant along with pandas, bamboo, and The Texture Update, allowing for a complete retexture of different items in the game.

title: Adrenaline Gamer
description: Adrenaline Gamer is a full Half-Life Deathmatch replacement mod and is considered to be the OSP mod for Half-Life. For those of you who are unfamiliar with Adrenaline Gamer, think of it as an extension to HLDM which offers more choices, more control, more options, more features... and ultimately more fun!

title: Battle Grounds
description:
Set during the American revolutionary war, the Battle Grounds is a Half-Life Modification where you and your teammates will need to fight together strategically in order to overcome the enemy forces.

In The Battle Grounds you can play as a soldier in one of two opposing armies: 'The British Army' and 'The Colonial Continental Army'

title: Arctic Incident
description: The action takes place in a scientific complex, which is located somewhere in the Arctic. In the caves, scientists have found a new form of life, which is resistant to frost and incredibly aggressive to intrusion. The staff at the complex do not have sufficient means to counter it. As a consequence they are forced to ask for help from the military, but the military, apparently, have their own plans for the incident.

title: Buzzing Cars
description: BuzzingCars is a totally crazy racing game where you'll not only need to be fast but also smart. You must carry out various missions such as drive robots around, chase flying saucers, electrocute aliens and of course race against the clock.

title: Minecraft: Buzzy Bees
description: Minecraft: Buzzy Bees is a major update for Minecraft, mainly focused on bees and the items relating to them, as well as also fixing bugs from previous versions.

title: Half-Life: Reamped
description:
Years have passed since the Black Mesa incident. Since then, things have gone to hell. People are being killed by the millions by a force beyond our comprehension, the world is in absolute chaos, destruction washes over like a roaring sea of agony, and the human race is closing on it's demise. Absolute doom is inevitable, and all hope is lost.

None of that matters, though, because you've been awoken from your slumber... and you're really pissed about it.

title: Izzy's Adventure
description: Izzy's Adventure is an adventure game based on Izzy, the Atlanta 1996 Summer Olympics mascot, released for the PC in 1996. It is an educational adventure game and notable for being one of the last games by British developer and publisher U.S. Gold.

title: Kanmuri wo Motsu Kami no Te
description: A free Japanese raising simulation and visual novel in which a child marked as a potential royal successor spends a year at court, developing their abilities and forming complex relationships that shape their future and determine whether they claim the throne.

title: Pirates, Vikings and Knights
description: PVK is a modification to Valve Software's Half-Life, featuring three-way action between very unique teams, each from wide-ranging historical time periods, and composed of very unique classes. Here in the PVK universe, fun is emphasized over realism: there's plenty of fun to spread around! Both team cooperation and individual merit may play large roles at different times. Similarly, calculated genocide and reckless kamikaze attacks will coexist! You'll find all the sadistic, maniacal gore or absurdist existential humor anyone could want! So no matter who you are, you will be able to find your "bag" here, baby.

title: Glowgrass
description: You play as a xenohistorian on an expedition. You've been dropped (more literally than you planned) by a dropship over the ground of the Ancients. Your equipment was scattered and the dropship crashed. Now it's just you, your wits, and the Ancients to help you find a way home.

title: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
description: This new package includes the base game, all updates made to Age of Empires IV since launch, including the Anniversary Update, and the two new civilizations — the Ottomans and Malians — in one package.

title: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Honey Milk Disc
description: Honey Milk disc focus on the three main guys for entry no. 1-3: Ninomiya Yuuto (Entry no.1), Misaki Kotarou (Entry no.2), and Momose Ayumu (Entry no.3)

title: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Super Mint Disc
description: Super mint disc focus on the three main guys for entry no.4-6: Kirishima Iori (Entry no.4), Lucy (Entry no.5), and Kujou Takumi (Entry no.6)

title: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Dark Cherry Disc
description: Dark cherry disc focus on the three main guys for entry no.7-9: Rudo Jesus (Entry no.7), Moroboshi Tetsu (Entry no.8), and Hamada Shinnosuke (Entry no.9)

title: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Fresh Ginger Disc
description: Fandisc of the Yamanote Boys series featuring Misaki Kotarou (Honey Milk), Kirishima Iori (Super Mint), and Moroboshi Tetsu (Dark Cherry).

title: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Black Vanilla Disc
description: Fandisc of the Yamanote Boys series featuring Ninomiya Yuuto (Honey Milk), Lucy (Super Mint), and Hamada Shinnosuke (Dark Cherry).

title: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Pure Raspberry Disc
description: Fandisc of the Yamanote Boys series featuring Momose Ayumu (Honey Milk), Kujou Takumi (Super Mint), and Rudo Jesus (Dark Cherry).

title: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Sweet Jelly Beans Disc
description: A Tokyo Yamanote Boys All Star Disc.

title: Dead Cells: Everyone is Here!
description: Crossover content with Hyper Light Drifter, Curse of the Dead Gods, Guacamelee, Skul, Blasphemous, and Hollow Knight.

title: Zettai Meikyuu Grimm Director's Cut: Nanatsu no Kagi to Rakuen no Otome
description: Adds new stories and CGs not included in the PSP release.

title: Leftovers
description:
Your mum is cooking dinner. Saddened by the amount of leftover and not wanting it to go to waste, she tasked you the job to give it all away to your neighbours.

You, who was just minding your own business watching cartoons. You who your mum have told many times to not talk to strangers. But yet, you have no right to deny the request.

Armed with limited skills of communication, meet all the quirky and creepy neighbours to finish the task before your mum finish you first...literally.

title: Bananas in Pajamas: It's Fun Time
description: Children join B1 and B2 on a wonderful adventure through the fun-filled world of Cuddles Avenue. With spectacular 3-D graphics, songs, and the Bananas humour, children will have fun as they develop important learning skills such as critical thinking, pattern recognition, and environmental awareness.

title: Bobo the Cat
description: The neighbours are often annoyed by naughty cat Bobo. One day they decide to get rid of him. Little Bobo wakes up far away and all alone. Will he find a way back home?

title: 99Moves
description: After 99Bullets and 99Seconds, the saga continues. Now your problem will be the movements.

title: 99Seconds
description: The saga continues after 99Bullets. Now your problem isn't the number of bullets, rather the amount of time.

title: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix
description: Originally released exclusively in Japan. An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix was finally released globally for the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX."

title: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix
description: An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix, which was originally exclusive to Japan. It was released globally for the first time as part of the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX".

title: Liberty Step
description:
Become an adventurer and explore the vast land of the Godrealm.

Select and train party members from eight different professions, collect and craft powerful equipment, and discover dangerous and uncharted lands.

title: Show do Milhão 4
description: Show do Milhão is an interactive game where you learn by playing with Silvio Santos and have your name registered on the general scoreboard. Become a champion! The more answers you get right, the more points you earn.

title: Dreadful Tales: The Fire Within - Collector's Edition
description: When Jill and Josh Weaver take their daughter on a relaxing hike, they’re hoping for photo opportunities and family bonding, but they get more excitement than they bargained for as disturbing messages and menacing pranks escalate into physical threats. Soon Jill is all alone, stalked by a terrifying figure wielding a flamethrower. With the fog closing in and her family still missing, it becomes clear that her nightmare has only just begun! Can you reunite Jill’s family and uncover the secret of Coldfell Forest’s dark past? Find out in this thrilling hidden object puzzle adventure!

title: Perseus: Titan Slayer
description:
Perseus: Titan Slayer is an over-the-top hack and slash, rogue-like adventure that focuses on depth and branching choices which allow for multiple unique runs. Branching choices allow for custom runs and many opportunities to play again and try new builds. Wield a Sword, Dagger, Bow, or Katana, each with their own special abilities. Feel like a real Olympian and explore the secrets of each weapon.
Meet Zeus, Poseidon, Hermes, and many other Olympians and gain their legendary upgrades.
Hack and slash through hordes of enemies as you make your way into Tartarus on an epic journey to fight Hades and the Titans.
It doesn’t matter how you want to play this game or what style you want to use. A shopkeeper system allows players to make unique builds whether you want to be a Tank, Agile, DPS or even a double spell caster on your adventure.

title: Marblous
description:
Marblous is a marble roll and jump, platform "runner".

You just roll and jump platforms, with a few special platforms.
You have to control momentum and speed so it's not just a straight forward runner.

title: No Man's Sky: Exo Mech
description: Soar and stomp across the landscape with the Exo Mech update. Introducing a fully controllable mechanical walker, new Exocraft technologies, improvements to base building, and much more.

title: Orderless: New Skies
description: Orderless: New Skies is a 2D action-turn RPG where players can avoid enemy attacks and increase their damage with well timed button presses, replacing RNG elements with hand-eye coordination and skill. Explore an alien world and discover secrets as you try to find a way back home.

title: Dreamspace
description: Dreamspace is an atmospheric game about dreams. Explore surreal locations and meet different NPCs. The game contains 17 unique dreams and takes about 30 minutes to complete. The game was made for LSDJam 2023 in 3 months.

title: Lisa: The Joyful - Arkantos
description: A fan DLC/expansion to Joyful, it takes place in a new continent called Arkantos with its own story and characters. Features 100's of new battles and enemies and six new warlords to defeat.

title: JoyTale
description: A LISA x Undertale fangame set an a alternate universe where the Flash occured in the Undertale universe

title: Azu-Cola
description: A doujin puzzle game reminiscent of Columns featuring Azumanga Daioh characters.

title: Lisa: The Clueless
description: A Lisa The Painful fan game that's about two fishmen that leave their village and have to collect three items to be able to return to their home.

title: Lisa: The Wishless
description: A Lisa: The Painful fan game where you play as a soldier of the Rando Army who misses his past, and is ready to perform any task, no matter how tough or dirty.

title: Rubato
description: A collect-a-thon about a frog fixing the solar system after it explodes for some reason.

title: Koezaru ha Akai Hana After Disc: Ayanasu Mirai
description: A fandisc to Koezaru wa Akai Hana

title: Cosmo Battle XXX
description: Crush your enemies. Fly and win.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 7 - Otonari Keiji no Sousa Memo
description:
A lost Chihuahua and a kind town police officer. With their ideal image of a detective in their hearts, this mismatched duo races through the city!

A small police box at the crossroads in front of the station, the police station in front of Marihamadai Station.
A lost puppy was entrusted to Officer Otonari, who was still working at the police box as a police officer at that time.
The dog breed is Chihuahua. According to the attached collar, the name is Chappie.

Officer Otonari, tasked with searching for the owner of Chappie, got an eyewitness testimony that a person who seemed to be the owner entered the Marihama Grand Hotel as a result of the interview in front of the station.

As long as you know where you are, the solution is near. The man and the dog began their investigation in the hotel lobby, but when a guest came running in with a pale face, they were drawn into further incidents...

Otonari Koichi, 26, is always by your side in heart. To protect the peace of Marihamadai, he runs through the town with his little partner!

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 10 - Eigou-kai Jiken
description: The year is 1999. The end of the century is a whirlwind of ominous prophecies and incidents. What is the purpose of the "Eigo-kai," an unidentified organization involved...

title: G-Mode Archives+: Megami Tensei Gaiden - Shinyaku Last Bible
description: Together with the demon, we will open up our destiny. The story that is the end of everything and the beginning of everything.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Megami Tensei Gaiden - Shinyaku Last Bible II - Hajimari no Fukuin
description: Boy, be the light that illuminates the world. The gospel of the beginning rings out in the land covered with despair.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 2 - Kairoukan Satsujin Jiken
description:
The "Kailoukan", a strange building surrounded by the sea on all sides. Inside a mansion closed underwater, the curtain rises on a tragedy.

Hello, everyone.
My name is Ikurumi, a game scenario writer.

Do you know the previous work "Masked Fantasy Murder Case"?
This time, I would like to introduce an incident that happened in a strange building called "Kairokan" six months after that incident.

It is said that it was built by the former chairman of a famous architectural company as a stranger. This story begins from the place where we are invited to the inauguration event of the mansion.

7 invited guests who visited. The owner of the mansion who will not appear forever. And...

A tragedy that happens in a mansion closed in the sea.
Who is the culprit? What's the motive? And what is the secret hidden in this building? The truth is, in the dark sea...

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 1 - Kamen Gensou Satsujin Jiken
description:
Online RPG "Takrimakus" that dies when you play. Uncover the secret hidden in the game, the truth.

Hello, everyone. My name is Ikurumi, a game scenario writer.

This is the first mobile phone game series that introduces the activities of my friend detective "Ryosuke Kibukawa".

This incident started with an investigation of a rumor of an online game that you will die if you play it. At first, I thought it was a simple request, but really one after another...

Choose an action (command) and enjoy the many mysteries woven by complex human patterns.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 3 - Shisha no Rakuen
description:
Shangri-La, an amusement park named after an ideal world In a paradise overflowing with smiles, a banquet in the name of judgment begins.

A few months have passed since the nightmare of the previous work, "The Kairoukan Murder Case." Running out of material, Ikuo visits his friend, Kibukawa.

When he returns to the office for the first time in a while, he is approached by Haruna Kikukawa, a beautiful secretary working at the much talked about amusement park, "Shangri-La."

The request is to provide security and investigate the cult-like threatening letters and creepy pranks that have been sent to the amusement park.

However, the president, Hiroshi Kimijima, asks that the matter be handled confidentially and without telling the police.

Though harboring doubts, Ikuo and Izuna decide to head to "Shangri-La."

An invitation from paradise brought by the beautiful secretary. A banquet called "judgment" begins from there.

Are the cheers echoing through the amusement park, named after a utopia, shouts of joy? Or...?

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 4 - Shirasagi ni Aka no Hane
description:
This year, red leaves are dancing in the hearts of the white herons left behind. The story of assistant detective Shirasagisu Itsuna and her unknown past.

“I… where was I trying to go? ”

This story begins with the protagonist, who has lost her memory, waking up in a mountain forest filled with autumn leaves.

The protagonist is rescued by a high school girl who calls herself ``Taihouin Izuna'' and learns that this is Momoshiro Village, a small village deep in the mountains of A Prefecture.

Who am I? Why did you come to such a remote village? Why did I lose my memory?

As the protagonist works with Ituna to unravel her memories, she becomes embroiled in the inheritance issues swirling around the village.

This is a sad and heartbreaking incident that leads her to pursue her career as a detective. In this work, you can enjoy the first and second parts of "Crimson Feathers on the White Heron".

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 6 - Tsuikou Saku Jiken
description:
Serial murder case x female secretary disappearance case.
Uncover the hidden truth from two intertwined perspectives.

A series of murders have been occurring mainly in Marihamadai since last year.
Detective Otonari, who is concerned that the victims have no connection with each other and that there is no clue to solving the case, asks his assistant detective Sagishima Izuna to join the police in their investigation.

Meanwhile, scriptwriter Ikuo Masao, who is almost forced to take on work for the detective agency, receives a request from a certain company to search for someone. The woman who is the subject of the investigation, Hamakawa Yumiko, is a contract employee working in the secretarial department. After working for a month, she suddenly becomes unreachable...

Izuna and Ikuo. The two encounter two cases. What is the truth that awaits them at the end?

title: G-Mode Archives+: Danmaku Kentei Shiken - DaiOuJou-hen
description:
Dear Danmaku believers, it's time for a deadly trial. Prove your strength in front of your ever-growing opponent.

Cave's shooting games are all about danmaku.
But how good am I really? A work that answers that question has finally appeared.

This work, "Danmaku Kentai Shikan" is a shooting game that diagnoses your ability to respond to barrage by continuing to fight against opponents who become stronger each time you defeat them.

In this work, which is called ``DaiOuJou-hen'', the brutal bosses of ``DoDonPachi DaiOuJou'' will block your challenge.

In addition to the in-game class evaluation, this game also supports online rankings, so you can further hone your skills by competing with users from all over the world.

Those who are not afraid of death, aim for the top of the barrage.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 8 - Kamen Genei Satsujin Jiken
description:
This is a Switch port of the mobile port of the DS remaster of the first game in the Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan series.

Embraced by illusions, I put on a mask... A mysterious serial murder case intertwines with the virtual world and the real world.

In April 2003, 8 months after the first work in the series, "Masque Fantasy Incident,"
Masao Ikuo, the scenario writer for this game, received an invitation to the beta test for the new network game ``Misty Online.''

``Misty Online'' was Japan's first MMOADV, and it was an unprecedented game in which players and their friends solve incidents that occur in a world that closely resembles a real city.

A response from a player playing the role of a corpse who participated in a beta test with Izuna Sagishima of the Igawa Detective Agency and tried to solve a fictional murder case, butdied after falling from a height. Gone...

Reality and fantasy. present and past. The countless threads intertwined in a complex and mysterious manner create illusions that envelop people's hearts.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 9 - Samidare ha Nibiiro no Shirabe
description: I follow his shadow in the pale dull sky.... Eight years ago, the Kibukawa Detective Agency, another great detective.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 5 - Kurai Hako no Ue
description:
``What's on top of this...? ”
A creepy urban legend turns into a nightmare that erodes reality.

"Late at night, when you call for an elevator on the first floor of a haunted apartment, a ``hako'' slowly descends from the rooftop, which is supposed to be off-limits .

When the elevator reaches the first floor and opens its mouth, the entire interior is dyed in bright red..."

A friend of game scenario writer Masao Ikurumi, a freelance writer who makes a living writing articles on the occult. Mirokuin Renji heads to the apartment building where the urban legend ``Red Elevator'' is believed to have originated.

A strange house full of empty rooms, residents who keep their mouths shut, and the ``incident from eight years ago'' that is said to be cursed if you speak about it.

Mirokuin, who pursues the truth hidden in urban legends, confronts his fear that night.

title: G-Mode Archives 39: Flyhight Cloudia IV - Eien no Kizuna
description:
There is something we must protect with everything we have. We will once again confront the dark clouds of fate that surround us.

Flyhight Claodia series is popular as a full-fledged mobile phone RPG. The latest work "Flyhight Cloudia 4" started to happen one after another in the world "Cloudia". It depicts the mystery of mysterious events and the bonds of the people involved in it.

This work supports the first "wide screen" function of G-MODE Archives. You can enjoy the adventure of the sky on a powerful large screen instead of a conventional square screen.

The combat system adopts multi-weight battles that have been inherited in the series.
In addition to enjoying highly strategic battles with easy operation, a convenient "AUTO" mode is also available. You can enjoy fighting with lower-rated enemies without stress and immerse yourself in the story.

title: G-Mode Archives 28: Sepas Channel
description:
If we lose something one by one,
The world will fall apart.

"Sepas Channel" is an RPG that explores identity.

"What is the meaning of your existence to be recognized by others?" " What is freedom and what is time?"

A boy who lost his memory, a girl who lost his shadow, and a dog looking for a missing owner.
Set in a mysterious world with a sci-fi and fantasy atmosphere, a story surrounding the radio broadcast by the mysterious DJ "Sepaschan" will unfold.

If you use the "channel change" system that holds the key to the game, you can switch the characters and groups you operate.

Please use the range of action and abilities of the main characters and cooperate with each other to advance the story.

title: G-Mode Archives 22: Heracles no Eikou III - Kamigami no Chinmoku
description:
"Glory of Heracles" is an RPG based on Greek mythology.
Since the release of the first work "Tojin Makyoden: The Glory of Heracles" in 1987, it is a popular RPG series that has spun stories with a number of hardware, and this work is the best scenario and famous title in the series.

The story is independent of other series works, and you can enjoy it alone.

In a world where day and night change with the passage of time, the people and shops you can meet will change.

While confronting strong enemies while making full use of 7 kinds of characteristic weapons and magic learned in temples in various places, in battles with weak enemies, the characters will fight automatically battle only with striking attacks by switching to auto battle mode, so it's stressful. You can play without it.

title: Azu-Tama
description: A doujin game in which you can play as Chiyo or Osaka, defending themselves during a snowball fight against other members of the Azumanga Daioh cast.

title: The Xeno Project II
description:
After fighting your way across Xen and escaping in a rocket, you are captured and imprisoned aboard an Earth vessel full of grunts, lead by the our old friend the G-Man.

What happens next? I’m afraid that’s up to you. Good luck. You’ll need it.

title: Mistake -1
description: Mistake-1 is a half life mod, telling the story of Steve's past and how a murder changed everything.

title: TWHL Tower
description: Back in February 2015, a group project was set up at The Whole Half Life (TWHL). Each mapper would be given a set amount of space in order to create a floor in a tower. The gameplay, appearance and story of each floor is unique, decided by the mapper. After a few months, the final maps were sent to Urby, who linked them together, added a start and end map, and the result was TWHL Tower!

title: TWHL Tower 2
description: TWHL Tower 2 is the follow-up to the collaborative mod TWHL Tower from 2016. A group of regulars at The Whole Half-Life site created a map (or 2, or 3!) that make up the floors in this tower. Each floor has a very small footprint but each has its own unique style, for you to fight/puzzle/sneak through on your way down from the roof. Reach the ground floor and finally escape!

title: No Man's Sky: Living Ship
description: Explore space from a different perspective with the Living Ship update. Introducing a new class of biological ship, a new story mission, mysterious space encounters, space NPCs and more.

title: Q Remastered
description: This game "Q Remastered" is a simple puzzle game that anyone can enjoy! You can freely draw lines and shapes on the screen. The drawn object will fall down due to gravity. You will use the object to solve more than 1200 missions. Can you get the ball out of the cup? Let's challenge!

title: Poly Memory: Furries
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal memory game with furries.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Scar's Kingdom
description: The first major content update for Disney Dreamlight Valley is here! Meet and team up with one of the Pride Land’s most well-known villains, Scar, to bring back the Sunlit Plateau to a green and vibrant state. Open the new Star Path and progress your way through to unlock tons of new cosmetics to help you express your villainous side.

title: Island_Name_Here
description: Play as the developer of a tropical island game in this unique puzzle adventure! Edit various object properties to achieve your goals and unlock more of the story. Experiment, undo, and repeat; no action is irreversible. Flex your creative skills to make an experience that is entirely your own!

title: Miko Monogatari!
description: "Miko Monogatari!" is a medium-length novel game. You develop your character in the game. It was created in 2022 by "R Man 44".

title: Detective Solitaire: The Ghost Agency 2
description: Do you like solitaire games? Do you like to solve mysterious riddles, examine clues and catch dangerous criminals, or maybe you have always dreamed of joining the Ghost Agency? Then this game will not leave you indifferent!

title: O-Sim 22
description: An orienteering simulator for all runners who want to test their skills digitally and for those who want to try the sport once.

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Raven - Collector's Edition
description: The renowned archaeologist Alan Dillinger is dead, seemingly by his own hand. At his side is a note detailing his love for a woman named Lenore. It seems to be a simple case of romance gone wrong. But the mysterious client who summoned you isn't so sure. He believes Alan was murdered! And he's not the only one. Join the brilliant detective Dupin and dive into a world of lies, betrayal, and revenge. You'll soon find yourself on the trail of the enigmatic White Crow, who takes a more deadly approach to solving the case. Can you uncover the truth? Find out in this chilling hidden-object puzzle adventure game!

title: Hentai Sexy Nurses
description: Hentai Sexy Nurses is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Silence Coffee Shop
description: Silence Coffee Shop is a JRPG where you'll act as a regular customer. Unveil the truth of Silence Coffee Shop behind it conflicting rules.

title: Mittin
description: Mittin is a library of dynamic modules which foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community. Designed to support special education transition-related instruction, these virtual resources are free and available to parents, schools, educators, and students in Michigan.

title: Half-Life: The Evasion
description:
Playing as Adrian Shephard set shortly after the nuclear bomb that devastated the Black Mesa Research Facility. You find yourself on a Xen “island” being kept out of harms way.

Fortunately, you have managed to contact a scientist back on Earth and he can help you return. Whether that’s a good thing only time will tell!

title: Futanari Sex: Unexpected Roomate
description: An explicit erotic visual novel about two attractive roommates sharing an apartment. Everything takes a turn when Ava finds out what Mila is actually hiding in her panties.

title: Great Toilet Simulator
description: Great Toilet Simulator is a first-person indie horror telling you the story of a man who has his car broken on his way home, in the middle of a thick forest. What makes the situation even worse is that the main character is really in need of a toilet.

title: G-man Invasion
description: The G-Men are everywhere! They're invading out dear planet are trying to kill you, kill me, kill everyone! It's your job to stop them!

title: Chemical Existence
description: Chemical Existence puts you in the role of Reece Max whom simply is in the wrong place at the wrong time. He gets mixed up with fighting gangs, evil corporations and mutated creatures…

title: X.E.T. Xen Exploration Team
description: You take you on the roll of XET member Bill Freeman. XET is supposed to be the survey team mentioned late in the game and in parts of Blue-Shift. You will visit new parts of Black Mesa and old parts of it; you will, of course, also visit Xen.

title: Resident Evil: Cold Blood
description: Cold Blood is an online story driven coop mod based in the Resident Evil universe. You'll come across many areas from the games, plus a few original areas you'll have never seen before. Using weapons you thought you'd never use, you'll dispatch dozens of different kinds of monsters from Hunters to Giant Spiders to our favorite deadites, zombies.

title: Half-Life: Military Duty
description: You're Alexander Shepard - Corporal and a soldier of the Hazardous Environment Combat Unit. You don't know exactly what's going on. But orders came in to pack up everything and head out for a highly classified mission. The destination - Black Mesa research facility. Nobody knows for sure what has happened down there but you will find out soon enough.

title: Dopusk 31
description: Once a simple and frostbitten Moscow digger, wanted to find a special place, is an old shelter to number 31, TK he climbed all the available underground location. After a long search and the Internet, the location of the object 31, in the end, he Founded Path Transportation go through the rails in the subway, through the ventilation in the subway. As soon as he got into unknown lab in his eyes happened to PE, as later proved scientists have tried to reveal the material of an unknown object, discovered recently and brought here from Antarctica.

title: Dead Sector
description: The year is July 18th, 1993, off the coast of Britain to the North East, there is an island that had a dark secret. A terrible epidemic had started to occur only, but a few months ago. A horrendous and violent infection had began to spread all across the island attacking anything or anyone in it's path with tremendous speed and savage force leaving few survivors in it's wake.

title: Poop Killer
description:
A killer who kills people who shit and don't flush... Jhon is working night shifts at a vhs tape store. After a customer clogs the toilet with poop... the poop killer will chase Jhon.

Don't forget to flush!

title: Half-Life: The Core
description: Half-Life: The Core is a classic retelling of the events surrounding the Resonance Cascade disaster from a new perspective; that of Engineer Maurice Andrews.

title: Half-Life: Intolerable Threat
description: As Gordon Freeman, you must face down the Administrator for the last time. The Administrator has taken control of "HANGAR 16" a government command and control facility in the desert. From here he is possibly planning a coup against the government of the United States, and vengeance against those who have opposed him in the past. You need to meet with an agent who has the access codes to enter the heavily guarded base, infiltrate it and prepare the way for friendly forces to attack.

title: Silent Hill 2: Enhanced Edition
description: Silent Hill 2: Enhanced Edition is a project of enhancement packages that makes the PC version of Silent Hill 2 compatible with modern hardware and playable in widescreen aspect ratios, while improving visuals, audio, and bugs. Examples of what Silent Hill 2: Enhanced Edition provides are: The use of a widescreen camera; high definition resolutions; upscaled fonts and 2D images; PlayStation 2 quality audio, fog, and shadows; restored post-processing effects; better controller support; and much more. Made by a collaborative team of programmers, modders, and artistse.

title: Escape Academy: Escape From Anti-Escape Island
description: After surviving an eventful first year at the Academy, it’s time for a well-earned summer vacation! But when the Escape Jet is shot down over an uncharted island, relaxation turns to mayhem in this outlandish Escape Academy DLC! Escape from Anti-Escape Island includes 5 brand new escape room levels, an exciting new narrative, and more original music from doseone!

title: Silent Hill 2
description: Silent Hill 2 Remake is a ground-up reimagining of the 2001 psychological horror game. It follows James Sunderland as he searches for his deceased wife in the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill. The remake features entirely rebuilt visuals in Unreal Engine 5, over-the-shoulder gameplay, reworked combat, and new voice acting.

title: Silent Hill: Townfall
description:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.
