Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine, luring players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

title: Silent Hill f
description:
Silent Hill f is a survival horror game published by Konami as part of the Silent Hill series.
It is set in rural Japan during the 1960s, marking a departure from the franchise’s traditional Western settings. The story is written by Ryukishi07 and focuses on psychological horror, social pressure, and transformation.

title: Azumanga RPG
description: A dungeon crawler game starring Chiyo from Azumanga Daioh. She attacks by walking into enemies.

title: Spiritwell
description: Play as a child who stumbles across a well and falls into a strange world of spirits...

title: Guidance
description:
Guidance is a uniquely meta, and story focused retro RPG.

Players guide verity and her friends on a journey to seal the gateways to the unseen plane and restore reality to it's former state.

title: To Aerthen
description: Lead a unique cast of colourful individuals across Aerthen in an attempt to thwart XORMOTH's machinations. You'll engage in countless battles and uncover innumerable secrets resulting in our hapless heroes hauling around more loot than they could ever possibly pawn off to any unsuspecting merchant!

title: Colorless Kaina
description:
I, the main character, witnessed the murder of a boy, "Kaina", a serial killer, and Kaina took a liking to me and forced me to interact with him.
What awaits me after 30 days of interaction with him, is it destruction? Or is it just another day?

title: Colecionador Show do Milhão
description: Colecionador Show do Milhão is a bundle that compiles all the first four games on PC.

title: Dungeon in a Bottle
description:
Dungeon in a Bottle is a precision platformer about choosing the right kind of jump in claustrophobic situations.

The acrobatic thief, Reya, has gotten himself trapped in a magic bottle, and now he must use every jump at his disposal to escape the treacherous dungeon within! Hopefully he'll grab some treasure while he's at it.

Perform difficult jumps while getting crushed by spikes, smashed by walls, and dissolved in goop in this platformer that takes the genre in a unique direction.

title: Death in the Water 2
description: Dodge and carve your way through swarms of terrifying sea creatures controlled by Death, a vicious giant mind-controlling Kraken that haunts your every move. Scavenge for hidden treasure to unlock weapons, and upgrades to help you in your fight for survival. Every dive reveals a new nightmare.

title: Chiyokagi
description: Chiyokagi is heavily based on Solomon's Key, a game developed by Tecmo in 1986. The goal is the same: grab the key and reach the goal while avoiding obstacles.

title: Fantasy Maiden Wars: Dream of the Stray Dreamer
description: A fantasy tactical RPG where you command over 70 characters across grid-based battles. Customize skills, unleash flashy Spell Cards, and enjoy rich animations in a strategic, story-driven adventure set in the world of Touhou.

title: Ruku's Heart Balloon
description: A cute adventure story about a rabbit, Ruku, and a cat, Lish, just like in a picture book. Make a "heart balloon" with the flower puzzle. How far can you fly in the sky?

title: Dragon Quest X: All In One Package - Versions 1-6
description: A new all-in-one package featuring versions 1 to 6 of Dragon Quest X Online.

title: Castlevania: Circle of the Moon
description:
A port of Castlevania: Circle of the Moon included in "Castlevania Advance Collection."

In Circle of the Moon, you can combine action and attribute cards to create over 80 unique spell effects, ranging from fire whips to ice blizzards, with the "Dual Set-up System."

New Quality-of-Life features for this port are included, such as Rewind, Quick Save, and Record/Replay. The new Encyclopedia feature offers helpful information that helps you keep track of items, equipment, enemies, and the Dual Set-up System. With the new DSS Gadget option, you can get on-screen pop-ups that display the DSS Attribute & Action cards that are obtainable from the monsters you encounter in battle.

The story follows Nathan Graves, a vampire hunter apprentice who enters Dracula's Castle along with his Master in order to prevent the dreaded return of the Count.

title: Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance
description:
A port of Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance included in "Castlevania Advance Collection."

Harmony of Dissonance introduced a lot of new features to the franchise, such as "Boss Rush" mode and the "Spell Fusion System" that lets players combine Sub-Weapons with Spell Books to cast devastating spells.

New Quality-of-Life features for this port are included, such as Rewind, Quick Save, and Record/Replay. The new Encyclopedia feature offers helpful information that helps you keep track of items, equipment, enemies, and the Spell Fusion System. With the new Collection Gadget option, you can get on-screen pop-ups that display the obtainable collection items in the current area.

Play as Juste Belmont, the grandson of legendary Vampire Hunter Simon Belmont!

title: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow
description:
A port of Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow included in "Castlevania Advance Collection."

Aria of Sorrow introduced a brand new attack system called "Tactical Souls," that lets Soma Cruz capture the souls of slain monsters to acquire their abilities (100+ abilities in total). Aria of Sorrow also has a ton of New Game+ content.

New Quality-of-Life features for this port are included, such as Rewind, Quick Save, and Record/Replay. The new Encyclopedia feature offers helpful information that helps you keep track of items, equipment, enemies, and the Tactical Souls System. With the new Soul Gadget option, you can get on-screen pop-ups that display whether or not a soul has been obtained every time you defeat a monster.

Soma Cruz, a young high school exchange student in Japan, is somehow involved in the eternal cycle of reincarnation of the Dark Lord himself. What role does Soma play in all of this? Will he be able to return to his own world?

title: Day Hard
description: Day Hard is a single player adventure set before the events narrated in Half-Life 2. You play as Gordon’s brother, Morgan Freeman. One day Morgan finds the Combines knocking at his door: from then on, it will be a constant fight for survival (We hired Wilbur Smith to write this script).

title: Strider Mountain
description:
AT 30,000 FEET… you are almost 6 miles (9.7 kilometers) above sea level. The human body is not made for these conditions. Temperatures are can plummet to -60F (-51C), the brain is starved for oxygen and each step is a new experience in pure agony.

It’s difficult to breathe. It’s difficult to think. It’s difficult to move. And you still have to endure another 444 feet (0.14 kilometers) to get to the peak. So much for the good news.

title: Mistake of Pythagoras
description:
Mistake of Pythagoras is a modification for Half-Life 2, developed by Koumei Satou.

Something goes mad because the human race failed in the experiment, and it connects with another world.

The resident in the another world is crazy due to the mistake. We should restore the situation.

title: Combine Destiny
description: Rebels have made a base at the top of a mountain near a town called Coonersville. The Combine decided to send Headcrab canisters into the town instead of trying a normal assault and possibly wasting Combine lives and resources. After a suitable period of time to allow the Headcrabs to do their work, a sweeper team is sent in to secure the town and capture the base.

title: Castlevania: Dracula X
description:
A port of Castlevania: Dracula X included in "Castlevania Advance Collection."

Fight your way through Dracula's Castle and defeat the toughest enemies with the new special attack "Item Crash"!

Castlevania: Dracula X is a reimagining of the cult action game Castlevania: Rondo of Blood, and has been acclaimed as one of the most challenging Castlevania titles ever created.

New Quality-of-Life features for this port are included, such as Rewind, Quick Save, and Record/Replay.

The Dark Lord Count Dracula rises again from the dead to revive the forces of darkness and to annihilate this corrupted world and create a new one.
You are Richter Belmont, heir of the Belmont family, and you set out for Dracula's Castle to defeat its evil master.

title: No Man's Sky: Synthesis
description: The Synthesis Update introduces a number of frequently-requested features and improvements to No Man’s Sky Beyond. Alongside these new features are a large number of community-led quality of life improvements, as well as general polish.

title: World Eternal Online
description: Player-driven Sandbox MMO featuring Massive Raid Boss Battles, Guilds, and Territorial PvP

title: Fiend Folio: Reheated
description: A fan made expansion mod for The Binding of Isaac: Rebrith that overhauls the game's floors, adds over 500 new enemies, 23 new bosses, 2 new characters and plenty of new items!

title: Azumanga: The Fighting T-Style
description: A doujin fighting game based on the Azumanga Daioh anime and manga series. There are 4 characters: Chiyo, Osaka, Kimura, and Chiyo-chichi.

title: Lily: Shiroki Yuri no Otome-tachi S
description: Lily: Shiroki Yuri no Otome-tachi S is a strategy role-playing game for Nintendo Switch and Windows. It is a remake of Lily: Shiroki Yuri no Otome-tachi.

title: Hifuu Bouenkyou
description: A turn-based tactical RPG set in Gensokyo. Renko and Merry are separated the moment they stumble into this strange land. Build a party from a wide Touhou cast, raise them freely through Reincarnation and added skills, and follow a story that branches into three routes.

title: AzuFight: Taisen Shiyo
description: AzuFight: Taisen Shiyo is a doujin fighting game based on the Azumanga Daioh anime and manga series. Not to be confused with Azumanga The Fighter T-Style, though possibly meant to serve as a sequel or expansion.

title: Resident Evil 4: Deluxe Edition
description:
The digital-only deluxe edition of Resident Evil 4 includes the game, plus the following DLC extras:

- Leon & Ashley Costumes: 'Casual' & 'Romantic'
- Leon Costume & Filter: 'Hero' & 'Villain'
- Leon Accessory: 'Sunglasses (Sporty)'
- Deluxe Weapon: 'Sentinel Nine' & 'Skull Shaker'
- 'Original Ver.' Soundtrack Swap
- Treasure Map: Expansion
- Attaché Case: 'Gold' & 'Classic'
- Charm: 'Handgun Ammo' & 'Green Herb'

title: The Citizen Returns
description:
The Citizen Returns is a mod for Half-Life 2: Episode Two, created by Accidental Games.

Set in both the heart and outside of City 17, “The Citizen Returns” contains the final chapters of our citizen’s story, as well as an updated version of Part II.

The setting takes place after Larry have been rescued by the Resistance of you after risking your life. Part 2 and 3 have been merged into a single part after the final release. Part 2's ending (the collapse of the ceiling) has been retconned, now Larry and the protagonist are just running out.

title: Azu-Race Taisen Battle He-Cho
description: A doujin racing game akin to Mario Kart featuring the cast of Azumanga Daioh.

title: Aether: Trading Card Game
description:
Aether: Trading Card Game is an exhilarating online competitive game that seamlessly blends strategy and fantasy. Engage in 1-on-1 duels with other players or AI opponents, utilizing a unique set of Adventurers, spells, and creatures. Each match is a race to defeat the enemy Adventurer, creating a fast-paced and intense gaming experience.

Every Adventurer in Aether is carefully crafted, each possessing a distinctive design and playstyle. They are not just a character, but a portal to a unique set of creatures, spells, and Relics, offering a multitude of strategic paths. You can summon creatures onto the battlefield to fight for you, or equip powerful Relics to gain the upper hand and dive directly into the fray.

title: No Man's Sky: Beyond
description:
Update 2.0, Beyond, massively expands the multiplayer experience introduced in NEXT, takes immersion to a whole new level with fully-fledged Virtual Reality, overhauls base building, NPCs, technology trees, and much, much more.

Marking the three year anniversary of No Man’s Sky, this is our largest update so far, broadening the experience across the entire game.

Our journey continues.

title: Minecraft: Nether Update
description: Minecraft: Village & Pillage is a major update for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition themed around revamping the Nether. It adds multiple new features to this dimension, such as new biomes and mobs.

title: Minecraft: Caves & Cliffs - Part I
description: Minecraft: Caves & Cliffs - Part I is the first part, focused on blocks and mobs, of two major themed updates for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.

title: Nuclear Throne Ultra
description: This is a mod for Vlambeer's game Nuclear Throne that adds new characters, new areas, 100s of new weapons (which you can now upgrade), and new game modes.

title: Rayman: The Dark Magician's Reign of Terror
description: This is a Rayman 1 styled fan game from the Rayman Redemption developer.

title: Crash Bandicoot Psyched Out
description: Crash Bandicoot is back in another fan-game adventure! This time the evil N.Trance has brainwashed the entire planet and brought his army of interdimensional aliens to wreak havoc across the globe. Only Crash and his nemesis Dr. Neo Cortex are spared from being N.Trance's slaves, and must once again team up to put an end to his twisted reign! Play as both characters as you travel the planet and quite literally pick the brains of your favorite characters from the crash-verse! Are you ready to get psyched?

title: Crash Bandicoot Apocalypse
description:
Crash Bandicoot is back in a brand new fan game adventure! The evil Uka Uka and Neo Cortex have unleashed the powers of nature once again to wreak havoc on the planet. Crash must stop the evil duo at all costs before Uka Uka's plans of a new evil empire are realized.

Run, jump, spin, slide and slam your way through the colorful world of Crash, fight powerful bosses, find secret areas, discover treasure, and defeat the forces of evil!

title: Ambien
description: Ambien is an Omori mod that focuses on expanding and exploring Black Space 2, with new endings.

title: God of War Ragnarök: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
God of War: Ragnarök is the ninth instalment in the God of War series and the sequel to 2018's God of War. Continuing with the Norse mythology theme, the game is set in ancient Norway and features series protagonists Kratos, the former Greek God of War, and his young son Atreus. The game kicked off the events of Ragnarök, where Kratos and Atreus must journey to each of the Nine Realms in search of answers as they prepare for the prophesied battle that will end the world.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

- Full game
- Darkdale Armour
- Darkdale Attire (Cosmetic)
- Darkdale Axe Grip
- Darkdale Blades Handles
- Dark Horse digital art book
- Official digital soundtrack
- PSN avatar set for PS4/PS5
- PlayStation 4 theme

title: Nepheshel
description:
Nepheshel is an influential indie Japanese RPG developed by the doujin circle Studio Til with the RPG Maker 2000 software. The game was initially released on June 2rd, 2002. It received an English fantranslation by RPGMaker.net user Vittone on October 15th, 2022, more than twenty years later.

Set on the isolated Confined Isle, the protagonist awakes without memories after washing ashore from the ocean. The island is said to be cursed so that everyone who sets foot on it loses all their memories. The game has the player exploring a series of interconnected dungeons in order to uncover the mysteries of the isle. Dungeons are intricate, full of traps and difficult battles. There are no random encounters, and every enemy icon on the map is colored according to the expected difficulty of the battle, so players can choose to try to sneak past dangerous enemies.

The exploration is open-ended, with the player being free from the beginning to explore the island without hardly any obstacles except the perils of the dungeons themselves.

title: Minecraft: Caves & Cliffs - Part II
description: Minecraft: Caves & Cliffs - Part II is the second and final part of two major themed updates for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, focused on overhauling overworld generation, including new caves and mountains.

title: Moonlight Destiny
description:
A Chinese developed role-playing game that was later localized into Japanese by Nihon Falcom under the name Moonlight Destiny.

Yue Ying Chuan Shuo Jian Xia Qing Yuan Wai Zhuan is a role-playing game. Many years ago, two of the most famous people in Wulin were Yang Xilie and Shangguan Feilong. Yang Xilie, as his name implies, has a fierce personality, and often competes with Shangguan Feilong. But Shangguan Feilong is indifferent to fame and fortune and dislikes fighting with others, so he ignores his provocations, which makes Yang Xilie more and more angry. After a thrilling life-and-death struggle, Shangguan Feilong was defeated by Yang Xilie at last. But eventually the two men and up that. Ten years after those events Yang Yingfeng (Yang Xilie's son) is already a young man. He still remembers the scene ten years ago. Yang Yingfeng feels that he should go out for an adventure.

title: NEET Girl Date Night
description: Your friend sets you up on a date with his NEET Cousin Kara.

title: Imas Champ
description: Imas champ is a collection of simple, timed minigames based on the Idolmaster franchise, specifically 1st Vision. Successfully completing the minigames allows you to rank up and reach a number of endings.

title: Minecraft: The Wild Update
description: Minecraft: The Wild Update is a major update to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition themed around "scary things" and natural wilderness. It introduces the deep dark and mangrove swamp biomes; ancient cities; mobs such as the allay, the frog, the tadpole, and the warden, as well as new items obtainable only in these new biomes.

title: Petals
description: Petals is a first-person photography game, developed as part of an ARG promoting Gun Interactive's The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

title: NoReason's Speedmaps 3
description: Even more speedmaps, slaughter

title: Disparate Realities
description: A set of 9 slaughtermaps designed to be played from pistol starts. 10th map is an end map with no gameplay (MAP08).

title: NoReason's Speedmaps
description: a bunch of shitty, unbalanced speed maps made for nanowadmo

title: Death in Excess
description: 18 slaughter maps of (mostly) progressive difficulty, not for the faint of heart

title: Cosmogenesis
description: Small set of massive, high monster count slaughtermaps / one gigantic slaughtermap in slot 5

title: Occula
description: Maps vary in length and complexity, with some harder fights being optional. 3 secret maps full of BS and nonsense for those who like being abused by videogames.

title: Maristice
description: Severe action, solving room riddles, and exploring labyrinths are the main focus of this quarter-view 3D action game.

title: Abandon
description: Abandon is a Boom-compatible wad composed of large, difficult slaughter maps.

title: Breathless
description: Breathless is a large, Boom compatible slaughter map for Doom 2. The theme is deep blues punctuated with cyan and is heavily inspired by Swim with the Whales, both in aesthetics and difficulty. The wad is inspired by a lot of things visually though, from Metroid Prime's Phazon Mines to Sunder.

title: Fractured Worlds
description: Fractured Worlds is a dark fantasy action RPG set in the shattered remnants of a ruined reality. Master weighty, precision-based combat, explore diverse realms, and face challenging bosses alone or together with other players of the realm

title: The Legend of Tiger and Phoenix
description: The Legend of Tiger And Phoenix is a unique timing-parrying/infiltrating game that allows you to experience Fireballs, Energy Blast, ​levitating, and the life of an invisible human.

title: Fox Den Remake
description:
You play as a night guard, hired to do some dirty job in a pizzeria. As you progress trough nights, you encounter more complicated tasks, as well as more danger and secrets.
Fox Den Remake is a freeroam smut horror game about completing objectives. It's a complete remake of our previous project, Fox Den.

title: Devil May Cry
description:
An HD remaster of Devil May Cry, first made available in "Devil May Cry HD Collection."

In the first installment of the Devil May Cry series, the player controls Dante as he faces off against the resurrected Demon Emperor, Mundus. The game introduces Dante's abilities, like Devil Trigger which transforms him into a demon, swordplay, gun-slinging, and stylish combos, all of which have become a staple of the series.

title: Devil May Cry 2
description:
An HD remaster of Devil May Cry 2, first made available in "Devil May Cry HD Collection."

Devil May Cry 2 takes place many years after the first game. This installment introduces the ability to run along walls, the Rain Storm ability, and others, giving Dante even more freedom to defeat enemies in style. You can also play as the new character, Lucia, who uses speed as a weapon against enemies, as opposed to Dante who relies on power. The bonus mode, Bloody Palace, also makes its first appearance here.

title: Picta Mori
description: When first seemingly harmless achievement in technology turns into something sinister is not an unknown scenario to us. Picta Mori plays with the idea of what if AI image generator would start predicting people's deaths.

title: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands: Shattering Spectreglass
description: Unleash elemental fury as the all-new Blightcaller! Shattering Spectreglass introduces an additional Fatemaker class, a bevy of customization options, and an enormous, multi-headed wyvern to hunt down and destroy!

title: The Inverse
description: Defend yourself against the creatures and destroy the FlipSide!

title: IceBlink Engine
description: Story and Turn-based role playing game (RPG) engine and toolset implementing a classic old-school computer RPG style.

title: Fruit Salad
description: Fruit Salad is a cozy physics-based match 2 game where you drop and merge fruits together to try and beat the high score before you reach the top!

title: Dance on the Water
description: Dance on the Water is a collection of 10 boom-compatible maps featuring challenging combat and platforming. Most of the maps are short to medium in length, except map 3 which might take more than 10 hours to beat on UV.

title: The Mucus Empire
description:
A fairly challenging slaughter map by me.

It could be a little difficult for beginners or somebody who prefer more relaxing gameplay, you can just lower the difficulty.

Have a good time!

title: Alpha-Major
description: 1 map designed for Dsda-Doom 0.19.7 complevel 9. Made as a sort of spiritual successor to MrZzul's Dimensions Map03.

title: Assassin's Creed Unity: The Chemical Revolution
description: In this extra mission, help Lavoisier, considered to be the "Father of Modern Chemistry", to escape from his kidnappers and recover his poison bomb formula.

title: Terraria: Thorium Mod
description:
Ever wanted to fight new bosses? Find, craft and collect new rare items? Abuse new mechanics? Build fancier looking houses for new NPCs? Look no further.

Thanks to tModLoader, Terraria modding is taken to the next level, for both mod developers and users. A product of this, the Thorium Mod, is one of the most expansive mods for Terraria. With over 2000 new items, 11 challenging new boss fights, hordes of new enemies, an entirely new biome and even three new classes, you'll soon be unable to play Terraria without the Thorium Mod installed!

title: Terraria: Spirit Mod
description:
Feeling like you've obtained every last item you can humanely obtain? Have you defeated every boss to the point where fighting them just feels rather stale? Are you just plain out tired of the vanilla game? Well the Spirit Mod can fix that right up for you!

The Spirit Mod is one of the largest mods for Terraria: with more than 1300 items, 8 bosses, and hundreds of enemies, as well as 3 new events and 3 brand new biomes, the mod has a lot to offer! We aim to make the world feel more alive with new ambient events, dozens of music tracks, and new mechanics, including a quest system. Development is always in full swing in our discord. Join us as we continue polishing and adding to our most recent 1.4 update!

title: Magpie Dreams
description: Magpie Dreams is an English Yume Nikki fangame developed by PixelKated in RPG Maker 2003.

title: Nobetsu Maku Nashi
description: Nobetsu Maku Nashi is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame created by Chiriakuta in WOLF RPG Editor.

title: Cranberry Dream
description: Cranberry Dream is an English Yume Nikki fangame created by Gumitsu. It was made for Dream Diary Jam 2 in RPG Maker 2003.

title: Coma
description: Coma is a non-traditional platform Yume Nikki fangame made by Cheesecake.

title: Ruza
description: Ruza is a free RPG where you lead a group of misfits to stop a monster, a vile reindeer.

title: The Man From the Window
description:
Mama Rabbit returns home from work one late night.

Awake long past his bedtime, a frightened Junior Rabbit rushes in.

The book in his hands has very visibly spooked him, and Mama Rabbit tries convincing him that it's only a story.

But then a tap-tap-tapping begins on the window...

title: The Adventures of Bouapha: Spooky Castle
description: Years and years before there was Supreme With Cheese, Bouapha battled a horrible green monster in an exceedingly spooky castle. Relive that classic adventure today with this freebie game! It's like living a history book, except that it's fictional and incredibly unrealistic and silly!

title: Flexbox Zombies
description: In this game you control a Hoodie character with a crossbow, using Flexbox code. The goal is to learn Flexbox in order to survive the onslaught of zombies.

title: Pathfinders: Lost at Sea
description: Explore the lost magic island in tne new exciting game Pathfinders: Lost at Sea! Travel with Professor John Darby after mysterious signal to the middle of the Atlantic Ocean! You should find all hidden objects and clear up a mysterious artifact! But be careful, you will be confronted with many dangers!

title: Druin Faust
description:
The Universe has just enough power to bring a being to life, one final time.
You are the last hope all of creation has left for survival.

title: Horror Hotel
description: Horror Hotel is a top-down, 2D shooter which pits you against increasingly difficult foes. Defeat your demonic enemies with a combination of spells and your Rune Stone. To be victorious you must take the fight to your enemies by traveling to Hell and destroying twelve demon generals in boss battles.

title: Pathmaster
description: Pathmaster is a visual novel with multi endings and various heroines.

title: Forgive My Sins & Desires, Father
description: Samael suffers from delusions. He feels lost until he encounters a priest one day. The priest is the only person in the world who makes him feel at peace. This, however, slowly turns into an obsession. Will Samael learn how to love properly or will he fall into a path of darkness? You decide.

title: I Love Me, I Love Me Not
description:
I Love Me, I Love Me Not is a casual relaxing game focusing on teaching players healthy mental-health habits.

You'll play as a sunflower who's been feeling physically and mentally drained, losing their petals - a part of themself - as a result. You'll wander, explore and meet new friends around this beautiful flower field, each teaching you a healthy habit, helping you grow yourself back together again!

title: Path of Achra
description: A turn-based roguelike with an emphasis on hero customization and powerful items. Fight through the dangerous lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...

title: Utakata no Alice: Dolls infeRno
description: "Utakata no Alice: Dolls infeRno" is a role-playing game created by "R Man 44" in 2021.

title: Magical Amber: Tobi Tsukihime
description: Remake/Arrange of Tobi Tsukihime released at Comiket 77

title: Subject 65
description: Subject 65 is a short, but chilling horror game set in a mysterious, abandoned psychiatric hospital that's been the subject of local rumors for years. Unable to resist the temptation any longer, you decide to investigate in search of answers.

title: No Man's Sky: Visions
description: Discover a more varied, more diverse universe in the Visions update. Introducing new planetary biomes, more colourful worlds, new fauna and flora, archaeology, salvaging, and much more…

title: No Man's Sky: Abyss
description: Explore the terrors of the deep in The Abyss update. Introducing aquatic environments with over 5 times more variety, varied creature behaviours, improved underwater visuals and much more.

title: Her Name
description:
A platform and puzzle game, "Her Name" will offer you to solve its puzzles by making your character progress at the same time as a mysterious bead on its tracks.

Days follow each other and look alike in this bleak world where routine afflicts the player in a tasteless and endless vicious circle. Until one day, a warmer aura appears in the dreary life of our character.
But before being able to approach this young woman, the player will have to overcome his fears, his anxieties and his apprehensions through his nightmares. Will a love story manage to hatch between these two souls?

A story full of sadness and loneliness but also of discoveries, encounters, mutual aid and love.

title: Car Chase Simulator
description: Car Chase Simulator is an action driving game heavily inspired by car action scenes of movies from 70s, 80, 90s etc.

title: Pigments
description:
Fruity dodge'em up and paint'em all.

This expanded version comes with new levels, new fruits, new mechanics, a new interface and a new battle mode.

title: Shangrlia
description: Shangrlia is a turn-based tactical game. The ten female commanders reside in the castle and can be approached in any order. Each of them transfers the player to a different location (alternating between urban, dungeon-like, and rural areas) where a tactical battle takes place. Every commander is responsible for a unit type in the army. These types include Lancers, Fighters, Swordsmen, Cannoneers, Horsemen, Archers, Mages, Ninjas, Dragon Riders, and Birds. Enemy forces possess the same unit types. Each type has advantages and disadvantages in terms of power, mobility, range, etc. The goal is to select and position units on the battle field, taking the conditions of the terrain, number of enemies, distance, etc. into consideration. Defending own castle and capturing that of the enemy is the top priority. The battles then proceed in a turn-based fashion. Some unit types can attack from a distance, while others are restricted to fighting on adjacent squares. Battles are displayed as animated sequences on a separate screen, their outcome calculated according to the unit's properties and parameters. After each round of victory, the female general removes an item of her clothing. The final result for each general is an erotic picture with partial nudity and implicit sexual scene, but no explicit images.

title: OneShot: The Tarion Machine
description:
Welcome to the Tarion Machine.

After the events of Solstice, The World Machine discovers a remote disruption targeting itself at them. Investigating the cause, they come across a new world led by an oddly upbeat World Machine...

title: LegacyClonk
description:
LegacyClonk is the community-developed title of Clonk Rage.

The 2D game offers varied gameplay, from settlement and construction to small melees and huge battles, online-ready and expandable by players with their own scripting language. With LegacyClonk, the source code of Clonk Rage experienced many performance improvements and features, while keeping the original game design unchanged. The scripting functionality for mods was also enhanced.

title: La Villa de la Muerte
description: La Villa de la Muerte is a looping psychological horror game where players will progress through an ever-changing environment in pursuit of the truth behind a family disappearance.

title: STG Football
description: Officially licensed by the NFLPA, STG Football is a free-to-play, real-time, arcade football game designed from the ground up to be a true multiplayer game supporting unique 4v4 gameplay that emphasizes teamwork and strategy.

title: No Man's Sky: Next
description:
Update 1.5, NEXT, introduces a full multiplayer experience, near-unlimited base building, command of freighter armadas, a graphical overhaul and more.

This update marks the two year anniversary of No Man’s Sky, and a lot has changed. Please see Atlas Rises, Pathfinder and Foundation for previous major updates.

This is an important next step on our journey.

title: No Man's Sky: Atlas Rises
description:
Update 1.3, Atlas Rises, brings a brand new and overhauled central storyline, portals, a new procedural mission system, trade improvements, system economies, joint exploration and more.

This update marks the one year anniversary of No Man’s Sky, and a lot has changed. Please see Pathfinder and Foundation for previous major updates. This is the next step on our journey.

title: No Man's Sky: Pathfinder
description: The Path Finder update introduces planetary vehicles, base sharing, PS4 Pro support, ship/weapon specialisation, permadeath mode, and much more. It shows the path for the future.

title: No Man's Sky: Foundation
description: Update 1.1: Today we’re excited to bring you the Foundation Update. It’s the first of many free updates to come, and we’re looking forward to you getting hands on with it. Here’s an outline of the updates – but we encourage you to dive in and discover for yourselves!

title: Witch & Lilies
description: Witch & Lilies is a Girls Love RPG where players must pair up girls for both combat and romance as they venture through dungeons. Developed with scenario writer Kedoin Makoto (Corpse Party) and character designer magodesu (Space Patrol Luluco).

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 19
description: A new gun, car and gear for Deston, a custom lobby and a new collaboration with a killer franchise (Assassin's Creed).

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 20
description: Balance adjustments and improvements tot he Blue Zone on Deston, new decorations and more in Season 20 of PUBG: Battlegrounds.

title: Koakuma
description:
Koakuma is a play-and-earn MMO-ARPG packed with immersive combat mechanics set in a graphics-intensive metaverse.

Get token & NFT rewards as you fight in epic battles!

title: Finterior Decorator
description: Finterior Decorator is a game about filling up an aquarium with all the wonderful decorations and plants that keeps your fishy friends swimming and smiling! Be sure to keep these lil guys happy and healthy as you add to the aquarium.

title: Happy Happy Land
description: The people of Happy Happy Land aren't happy, they can't seem to work things out. Maybe all they need is a little bit of creative thinking.

title: Her Trees: First Puzzle
description:
"Her Trees: First Puzzle" is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Uncover the mysteries of this peculiar room.

This is the first work in the "Her Trees" series.

title: Hinoken
description: Kill yourself. Learn your mistakes. Progress.

title: Slow Roads
description: Slow Roads is a casual driving game designed for cathartic, long journeys on quiet, scenic roads. Disconnect from life for a while and drive endlessly toward the distant horizon, simply soaking in the views. Set the scenery to suit your mood, throw on some music, and just drive...

title: Cyphernaut
description: Explore the Mobile Asteroid Battle Station "Nemesis" as you hunt down the Cyphernaut in this physics based metroidvania.

title: SRG Mixtape Volume #3
description: Super Rare Mixtape Vol. 3 is a physical indie game collection including 30 games and 6 demos. Packaged as a USB drive shaped like cassette tape with only a limited number sold.

title: Age of Mythology: Retold
description: Age of Mythology: Retold is a remastered version of the 2002 real-time strategy classic Age of Mythology. Players manage civilizations inspired by Greek, Norse, and Egyptian mythologies, commanding human armies and legendary monsters while invoking the powers of gods to shape the battlefield. Built on the Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition engine, the remake features overhauled visuals, updated animations, and a symphonic reimagining of the original soundtrack. With modern design enhancements and expanded options, it offers a refreshed experience for both returning fans and new players.

title: Mighty Math
description: Mighty Math is a mind bending fusion of arcade survival and brain training all in one. Anyone can pick it up and play. It starts with a simple premise, collect a required set of numbers before all numbers run out to survive each round. As you collect numbers you will change the player value. You must maintain a player value between 0 and 9. If you go over or under this value range you will be instantly destroyed.

title: I of the Enemy
description: I of the Enemy (IOE) is a unique experience of sci-fi wargaming and innovative gameplay for single player offline or up to 8 opponents battling over the internet or a LAN.

title: Escape to the Caf
description: CAF is a horror game where you have to escape from CAF premises. Your goal is to survive and try to escape.

title: PowerBots Builders
description: Build your base, survive asteroid fields, defeat challenging bosses, and save the universe! Grab a few friends for even more fun - bring up to four players in a classic split-screen style.

title: Imagynasium
description: Welcome to Imagynasium - where art, music and storytelling are combined to give your child's brain a workout. Developed in conjunction with Robert Redford's Sundance Institute, Imagynasium lets kids flex their creative muscles. In The Curio Shop, they'll learn the secrets of storytelling. In Downtown, they'll discover the art of collage and create their own artistic designs. In Jingle Jungle, they'll learn to create beautiful music. Zany characters like Monda, Frida and Riff will guide them through the three unique worlds. And of course if your child gets stuck, there's always Spike, the tech guy, ready to lend a hand. Cool tools help kids create projects, store their creative ideas, and keep track of their progress. Plus, each area has a hidden surprise that puts their new skills to the test.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Mastery Challenge
description: Mastery Challenge is a free update that adds replayable trials designed to assess player proficiency in melee, ranged, and stealth objectives. As players complete these challenges, they can unlock a variety of unique rewards, including weapons, tattoos, and decorations.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Title Update 1.5.1
description: This update comes with bug fixes and patches, as well as the Mastery Challenge Pack 2, the annual Ostara Festival, and more.

title: Press W to Move Forward
description: Press W to Move Forward is a 5-minute experimental horror game exploring the rhetorics of progress, control, and societal pressure. Like the title suggests, the player's only mode of control is through pressing W to progress the game with occasional mouse movements.

title: AyuPac
description: AyuPac is a parody of Pac-Man themed around Ayu Tsukimiya from Kanon and her love for taiyaki.

title: One Beat Min
description:
One Beat Min is a game in development about music, rhythm, and beatbox battles where players select characters and press buttons on the joystick to create their beat and try to run the opponent.

The game brings the universe of Hip Hop, urban culture, creative freedom, and diversity into a charismatic design.

title: Phil Alone
description: Phil Alone is a horror/puzzle game based on old Escape The Room games. Try solve this huge puzzle with a lot of different endings.

title: Hitmen Havoc
description: Hitmen Havoc is a cartoony 2D arena shooter for 2-8 players. Dive into relentless party battles with a variety of weapons and abilities. 8 unique characters, and multiple dynamic arenas. It's perfect for friends or foes seeking exciting, competitive gameplay.

title: Shinonome
description: Shinonome is a roguelike game based around the concept of a haunted house from the Japanese Edo period.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Tombs of the Fallen
description: Tombs of the Fallen is a free content update introduced in version 1.4.0 of Assassin’s Creed Valhalla. It adds a series of puzzle-oriented tombs that invite players to explore vast underground caverns filled with traps, poison, and environmental challenges. Players must use observation, exploration, and parkour skills to navigate these ancient structures and uncover hidden treasures linked to the lore of a long-lost civilization. The content emphasizes non-combat exploration and environmental problem-solving over traditional missions. Additional tombs expanding this feature were released with title update 1.6.1

title: JBMod
description:
JBMod was the first mod ever released for Half-Life 2. It was originally created by jb55 on the HL2World forums before being handed off to TEAM JBMOD, a small group of modding enthusiasts on the forum.

JBMod enables the physgun in Half-Life 2 (first seen in pre-release tech demos such as those shown at E3 in 2003), which was ultimately cut from the final game.
The physgun allows you to move and manipulate objects with the help of physics.
JBMod also adds several new features, such as additional physical constraints (ball joints and ropes) and item spawning using console commands.

The initial Steam release brings the original mod from 2004 to a more modern engine.
Stay tuned for further updates! As always, JBMod 0.6 is coming soon.

Playing maps and using content from other Source engine games requires an installed copy of those games.
Due to engine version differences, some newer games may not be compatible.
JBMod is currently based on Source SDK Base 2013.

title: Alpha-Nighthawk
description: Some 380,000 kilometers above Earth, Consuelo the Space Rose blooms in the moonlight, its origins, and intentions a mystery. It last launched a Thorn five years ago and all that's left of Tokyo today is the lawless “Red Zone,” a slum within a slum, sealed off from the world...

title: Paranormal Tales
description: Paranormal Tales is a next-gen horror game based on found footage built in Unreal Engine 5. You experience and play through each tragic tale of those who went missing from the viewpoint of bodycams, phones, and VHS cameras. Do you have what it takes to play through the end of the footage?

title: Dark Tales from México: Prelude. Just a Dream... with the Sack Man
description: An Handmade 3D Survival Horror based on true Mexican Folk Tales and Clay Sculptures.

title: Wheel of Innocence
description: Wheel of Innocence is a lesbian visual novel where you peer into the life of a disabled high schooler named Reina.

title: Banana Quest
description: An RPG Maker Game. You want a banana. so what are you waiting for? go get it!

title: Duel Toys 2
description:
Duel Toys 2 is a fighting-adventure Fan-Game which features tons of different well known characters from various games-comics-movies and turn them into Dueling Toys!

It features more then 60 characters, from games like Street Fighter, King of Fighters, Mortal Kombat and even pop icons like Darth Vader and Michael Jackson. Each are represented exactly like they are in their original games! It also contains more than 10 original characters!

title: Psychosis: Teaser
description:
Psychosis is a first-person psychological survival-horror game about familicide, presented in a retro, derezzed art style.

When a family goes missing and you receive a mysterious phone call, all hell breaks loose as you are plunged into an expansive world where demons hunt you down and logic is turned inside out. Battle with the shreds of your own humanity through an hour of mind-breaking gameplay packed with combat, puzzles and mystery.

title: Satisfactory: Update 3
description:
As much as we liked to pretend pipes were useless, Satisfactory was not going to be complete without them. So here they are!

Transporting fluids will be a different challenge than transporting your regular solid resources. While the conveyor belts move at static speeds, fluid flow in pipes will fluctuate based on input amounts, and head lift when you need to push them upwards.

title: Ephemeral: Miniature Garden
description: This is a story of a mermaid, who reign over the world of darkness.

title: Tsumikui: Sen no Noroi, Sen no Inori
description: A otome game for PC.

title: Dark Escape
description: A micro RPG

title: Brine Flow
description:
Fish him out and make HIM whole again!

Made for #FishingHorrorJam

title: Adaptory
description: Deep in uncharted space, your expedition took a challenging turn when your ship crash-landed. Master complex simulations to keep your outspoken explorers alive, face unpredictable challenges, and figure out a way back home.

title: My Big Sister: Remastered
description:
Take control of Luzia and explore a fantasy world full of spirits, ghosts, and other unnatural monstrosities as the sisters try to find a way to break the curse and return home. Search for objects to solve simple puzzles and talk to characters to unravel the lore behind both "My Big Sister" and "Ashina: The Red Witch".

Across the game’s multiple chapters in My Big Sister, players can expect to clear puzzles and find specific items should they wish to advance through the game’s story, but be sure to take your time. With plenty of secrets and multiple endings, you’ll have your work cut out for you to make sure you get the ending Luzia, Sombria, and Ashina deserve.

title: Frog Detective: The Entire Mystery
description:
You're a detective, and a frog, and it's time to solve 3 thrilling mysteries!

For the first time, all 3 Frog Detective cases are available in one package.

Play as the #2 best investigator as you find clues, question silly suspects, and look at things through your magnifying glass. Some nay-sayers have called the magnifying glass "useless", but what do they know?

Frog Detective: The Entire Mystery is a family-friendly yet witty take on the detective game genre. Solve the mysteries on your own, or play along with friends as you take turns reading out the dialogue. Think you can crack the case?

title: Jogo do Banquinho do Raul Gil
description: Jogo do Banquinho do Raul Gil is a game based on the segment featured on the Programa Raul Gil, where you will be provided a theme and will have to guess words that begin with a certain letter in seconds, or else, you will take your stool and softly walk away.

title: Satisfactory: Update 4
description:
Update 4 is finally available on Early Access! This update is jam-packed with new content! New Nuclear Refinement and waste recycling, new top tier buildings, lights - together with the new changes to power this update is fully charged.
There are improvements to networking, optimisations, UI, quality of life, all the good stuff.

title: Satisfactory: Update 2
description: The update that brings you all the Tier 7 content and Trains! Get ready to build even bigger factories with 11 new parts, some of them among the most complex in the game so far, and haul large amounts of resources across the entire map via train cargo.

title: The Turgenev Study
description: Harvest DNA and assimilate new samples for your paramountly important research. Your laboratory is located in a warzone, resulting in limited access to energy sources. Your agent can only launch a harvest every 10 seconds. Do your best despite these harsh conditions.

title: Project: Eden's Garden
description: Project: Eden's Garden is a non-profit Danganronpa fangame. Taking the formula of the murder-mystery video game and applying it to an entirely new world, with new characters and stories to tell, this is a small project that is dedicated to recreating the magic the works that inspired it.

title: Valorbound
description: Valorbound is a full-loot, sandbox, PvEvP, horizontal progression, MMO-lite set in a highly stylized mid-fantasy setting. With more believable restraints on character power, Valorbound focuses on the smaller scale and more down-to-earth adventures. Survive in a wild world full of Elves, Goblins and magic, and live the fantasy life you've dreamed of.​

title: Haneda Girl
description: Haneda Girl is an action-platformer game with brutal and frantic action. Clean stages swapping between two playable characters. Bullets or Slashes, your choice, but be creative. A wide variety of ways to solve each encounter are at your disposal. Dance the waltz of destruction, end the threat.

title: Tsjost's Heroic Soup Bazooka
description:
Solve puzzles by eating foodstuff and pushing boulders.
Can you figure out how to escape?

title: Gatekeeper
description: Gatekeeper is a fast-paced rogue-like. Go on a quest to chase down Chaos and reclaim the stolen Heart of Time, fighting your way through relentless enemy forces. Play solo or in 4-player co-op and become the next Gatekeeper!

title: Osminog Adventures: The Lost Island
description:
Dive into the fantastical world of Karawark and accompany the Pirate Crew of The Osminog on an adventure they were not prepared for.
Exploration Sailing Party-Based RPG RPG

title: Neko Night
description:
It was business as usual in your life as a freelance writer, until you were tasked with writing about your first sexual experience. You try your best, but how can you write about something that never happened?

There is a knock at your door. Who could it be?

Standing at your doorstep, drenched from the rain, is a young, beautiful... catgirl?! She seems to know you, yet you have no recollection of her. She claims to be on a divine mission - to make a baby with you! But she's not the only unexpected guest. A second catgirl shows up soon after with the same higher calling...

This must be a dream, right? Well, you might as well have some fun while you find out.

title: Fromage
description:
A small cheesy mapset that dashiefrickintyan started in 2022 for nanowadmo featuring
2 gameplay maps and 2 intro/outro maps, inspired by stardate 20x7 and... cheese

title: Yasuke: A Lost Descendant
description: Dash. Slash. Glide. Discover your legacy as the heir to a legendary African samurai in this high-velocity 3D action game, featuring futuristic swordplay, kinetic parkour, and anime-inspired action.

title: Untitled Ghost Game
description: Free multiplayer 2D ghost hunting game that you can play with friends created by a small game dev team.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club: Return to the Portrait
description: This mod continues straight from the bad end of the original game and involves everyone working together to find out the truth about their world and about Project Libitina. It features a ton of file tampering and other meta stuff like exploring the rules behind Club President powers. It also features Natsuki's dad, who is not a sadistic prick, and tries to give each character some limelight.

title: Joe Wander and the Enigmatic Adventures
description: Start the best Enigmatic Adventure of your life! Solve brain-teasing puzzles, explore different worlds with smooth platforming, and enjoy the beautiful scenery in the mysterious world of Joe Wander.

title: Off to Sleep
description:
An adventure highly focused on the story.
2D strategic RPG with turn-based battles.
The combat system allows you to configure your robot ally's AI.
Topics covered: ethics, determinism, relativism, definition of "life" and "conscience".

title: Tinkertown x Among Us
description: After killing an entire crew and taking over their ship, an impostor mistakes a bright light in the world of Tinkertown for his secret haven, crash-landing on the planet. This opens up a brand new quest in Tinkertown where players can explore the crashed ship, solve puzzles blocking their way and escape with loot without getting caught by the impostor roaming the ship. Find a bunch of cool Among Us themed costumes, hats and decorative items and objects that can be used to decorate your houses back in your village.

title: Chernobylite: Season 1 - Blue Flames
description: Expand your weapon arsenal with a craftable, highly-customizable tactical crossbow and master the stealth exploration of the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. Discover more memories of Tatyana and Igor with photos hidden in the area - each picture will display a short animation and play voices revealing a piece of the past.

title: Chernobylite: Season 2 - Red Trees
description: Dive into the free Red Trees update, presenting 6 new story missions with Tatyana as a narrator and more. Take on the VR Games roguelike-inspired challenge and face enemies in the fractal world with your equipment and skills assigned randomly. In addition, you can now improve your base with a post-soviet gaming station (cosmetic item).

title: WetBread
description: WetBread is a 2.5D Metroidvania Platformer, where you gain control of a Dry Husk, travel thorugh the store shelves of various departments, solve puzzles and fight enemies and bosses.

title: Hidden Dungeon Top-Down 3D
description: The game is a hidden object game in which you need to find objects with a certain design in beautiful locations, and click on them with the mouse.

title: Good Night, Peregrine
description: A short experimental visual novel where you spend time with the titular Perry, a shut in recluse gamer, and his friends. Meet a colorful cast of characters in a strange world much like our own. Learn and explore secrets from the past. There is no happy ending to this game.

title: Illumina Girls
description: Illumina Girls is an exhilarating 3D block breaking game with a new sensation.

title: The Shadow People
description: The Shadow People is a retro point and click horror adventure game with a minimalistic aesthetic. As a student cramming for finals, you drive all the way to school, sit through class, and try to slog your way back home. But fatigue sets in, and dark creatures dance in the edge of your eyesight.

title: Chernobylite: Season 3 - Green Walls
description: From special game mode for players who love extreme challenges to the much-anticipated part of the map with two never completed cooling towers on the premises of the infamous power plant and a brand-new weapon.

title: Dot Tanki
description: MOBA PvP game in which two teams fight tanks, and other vehicles for victory.

title: Miss Kawaii 2
description: Surrounded by many beautiful girls, a mind-blowing, sexy journey has started. Relax, clear your mind and enjoy.

title: Chernobylite: Season 4 - Black Smoke
description: New events: 'Farewell, My Doll' a new game mode, 'Brothers in Arms' and more!

title: Dead Space: Deluxe Edition
description: The Dead Space Digital Deluxe Edition includes the five exclusive cosmetics (three Unique Suits and two Suit Textures). It’s everything you need to look your best while surviving the horrors aboard the USG Ishimura.

title: JaDa Fishin'
description: JaDa Fishin' is a free relaxing quick-time fishing game. Collect up to 12 different types of fish on this incredible journey.

title: Grime: Colors of Rot
description:
Grim: Colors of Rot will come with:

- A new, massive area.
- New Bosses.
- New Abilities.
- New Traits.
- New Enemies.
- New Weapons.
- New Music.
- New NPC interactions.
- A New Cinematic.
- Hidden backtracking challenges, as a reward for re-visiting previously explored areas.
- Refreshable Healing that can be collected by hunting down runners.
- The ability to refight endgame variations of bosses after defeating the final boss.
- New Achievements.

title: Blue Bird Land Ep 2.
description: Blue Bird Land is an AVG with horror and puzzle elements. In each chapter, the form of the game is unique and different from others. Let’s follow the alluring characters, addicted to the dangerous amusement park!

title: Run Blob Run 2
description: A Casual, 2D Platformer in which the player must overcome obstacles to beat the level as fast as possible.

title: Gachi-Natsu
description: It was a sweltering hot day when I met him. During summer vacation, a young man who had failed his university entrance exam received a tutor to help him with his studies. He started living together with a handsome, muscular man, but! He is a cock-loving, energetic, and dirty tutor!

title: Clown Theft Auto: Woke City
description: Woke City is the city of future, dreams and hope. Imagine a perfect society where everything is built on equality, where crimes are nonexistent, and anger is just a theory of the past. Immerse yourself into the wokeness. This is the future everyone wants and needs.

title: Guns 4 Hire
description: There are an estimated seven billion people on Earth, a hundred million black market weapons, ten million bad guys, and against it all... four money-hungry mercs! Command the toughest squad in the world while taking on crime lords and corrupt dictators in this ruthless bullet-fest!

title: Kardboard Kings: Card Game Island
description:
In the Card Game Island update, you’ll actually play the card game and face off against other characters by buying a plane ticket to Card Game Island! I’ll go deeper into the card game in the future.

Also coming in the Card Game Island update is a new hard mode appropriately named King of Games. You’ll need to be a king at Kardboard Kings to not close down shop. Each day your reputation takes a small hit, you pay taxes every week, and more. While each small little thing doesn’t do too much but together makes the game that much harder. Can you keep the card shop afloat in this new unfavourable mode?

title: 69 Ember Hot
description: 69 Ember Hot - Puzzle with visual novel elements in dark fantasy style.

title: Poolgame
description: A small, realistic-ish Pool game you can play for free.

title: Kingdom of Secrets
description: A role-playing game where you are summoned into a virtual world to become one of the legendary warriors.

title: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - One Flew Into the Cuckoo's Nest
description: Buzz is missing! Head to the Twin Lakes Botanical Gardens to get to the bottom of this here mystery! Based off the Darkside choose-your-own adventure from Twitter last year, you can check out the trailer just down below

title: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - Tales of the Darkside
description: In The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - Tales of the Darkside you'll join the fan favorite side characters to solve the mysteries of Twin Lake! Will the Bloodwolves, the Brightside Division, and Rexa each solve their cases and save Twin Lake

title: Cyberpunk 2077: Edgerunners Update
description: The Edgerunners Update (Patch 1.6) brings various gameplay fixes and improvements, free DLCs, as well as content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, an anime that premiered on Netflix on September 13, 2022.

title: Continue/Stop/Rise
description:
In this game, a fan sequel to Off, the switch was already flipped and the mission is finished. But instead of darkness, there is light.

You play yet again as The Batter, in a search for his Add-Ons, while on an unfamiliar, yet familiar world. Suddenly a mysterious hooded woman appears while you sleep, and then you meet two alternates after you awake: the angry, vulgar
yet brutally honest Ghost Batter and the polite, cheerful and constantly-looking-for-trouble Bad Batter.

title: Blackmoon Prophecy II
description: Blackmoon Prophecy II is a Final Fantasy fangame made in RPG Maker

title: Final Fantasy: Legend of Balance
description:
Final Fantasy: Legend of Balance is a Final Fantasy fangame made in RPG Maker.
The game revolves around a group of heroes, champions of the realm of Eorzea. In the midst of an intense battle to decide the fate of Eorzea, the heroes are transported away before facing certain death at the hands of Bahamut. Finding themselves separated in a brand new world, the heroes begin a journey to reunite and find a way home. However what starts off as a simple quest quickly unfolds into a classic journey of crystals, great evil, and steadfast allies. Before this adventure ends, they will discover the truth behind this strange new world, and uncover the binds that tie it to their own home and beyond.

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Dieselpunk
description:
A new champion joins the game — the jack-of-all-trades Friedrich Diesel. His passion for engineering and everything connected with it has been fanatical since childhood, preferring machinery construction to communicating with people.

Diesel managed to learn the “Weird Science” ability and can create different mechanisms: a buggy, a helicopter, a spy camera, a protective wall. No laws of physics, and certainly not morality, can stop the genius of engineering on his way to victory.

title: Sowon
description: In the middle of the night, while finding her parents, a girl falls to the toy world through attic locked for a long time. Will it be possible for her to find her parents and go back to her world? Let's solve some puzzles and explore the mysterious toy world.

title: Love Spell: Written in the Stars - Aslan's Story
description:
Love Spell: Aslan's Route is the first DLC for Love Spell: Written In The Stars. It features the story and the ability to romance a brand-new bachelor, Aslan the Wizard, who was not playable in the original game.

Follow Luna's adventure through different worlds when she accidentally ends up chasing the mysterious pink-haired wizard named Aslan through a magical portal and straight into a parallel universe!

title: Yumemi Melancholy
description:
This is a horror ADV game in which you are “nursed” by a cute, but strange and dangerous looking girl.

Will you let her “take care” of you, or will you resist and run away…? The outcome is up to you, the player!

title: Touhou Danmaku Kagura: Phantasia Lost
description: A rhythm game in which players can play popular arrangements of Touhou Project songs. A rebuild of "Touhou Danmaku Kagura" as a stand-alone version with a completely new storyline.

title: The Plumber Thing
description: Do plumbery things in this horror puzzle platformer!

title: Alias: Underground
description:
3D third-person stealth/action game and episodes released on a monthly basis between September 2002 and June 2003 by ABC Television to hype the television show starring Jennifer Garner as an undercover CIA spy named Sydney Bristow.

The training mission plus 9 more episodes were available for download on ABC's website prior to and during the second season of the show.

title: Yousei Rasutaru-chan to no hibi
description: "Yousei Rasutaru-chan to no hibi" is a Adventure game created by "R Man 44", released in 2022.

title: Survive Till Morning
description: “Survive Till Morning” is a first person Dark fantasy horror - created by one person. The focus of the game is the story and its atmosphere, also the game is filled with: puzzles, achievements, references, different endings and gameplay styles (no shooting system). The approximate duration of the game - two hours.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic II: Desecrated Lands
description: Heroes of Might and Magic II: Desecrated Lands is a freeware non-canonical map pack developed by Dark Entertainment and various authors, and distributed by East Valley Software, released in late 1997 with some editions of Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars for Microsoft Windows. Included in the form of a bonus CD, it was provided as an extra feature at no extra cost.

title: Red Sea
description: Red Sea is an intense Real-time Tactics game where you control a small team of vigilantes in increasingly challenging battles. It features a Scriptable Tactics system that mixes auto-battling with manual overrides and has a ton of powerful ability interactions to discover.

title: Innyume
description: A Japanese emoji horror game.

title: Terraria: The Stars Above
description: The Stars Above is a Terraria expansion mod that adds a new important game mechanic: the Starfarer system. ​

title: Terraria: Split Mod
description: The Split Mod is a content mod for Terraria which adds new content to the game, such as several items, enemies, bosses, 2 biomes and also includes mechanics such as Photography, Armor Prefixes, new melee weapon subclasses (heavy swords and racquets) and other.

title: Terraria: Mod of Redemption
description: Mod of Redemption, the remastered version of the now discontinued Mod of Randomness, is a large-scale content mod that adds a wide variety of content into Terraria at all points of the game. This includes many challenging bosses, the new Druid class, the mysterious Abandoned Lab dungeon, and much more!

title: The Binding of Isaac: Epiphany
description: The Binding of Isaac: Epiphany is a mod that aims to add a new variant for all characters in Repentance, called "Tarnished" characters, alongside new items to unlock and new challenges.

title: Soulslinger
description: Soulslinger is a challenging, fast paced runner with roguelike elements, in which you must reap your way through the Underworld! Dodge obstacles, eat pies, and get blessings to defeat threatening foes with the help of your powerful Soulvolver.

title: Pocket Witch
description:
Face different challenges to help the little witch escape from a dungeon full of traps and enemies, where she was trapped by a great evil sorcerer.

Together with her bat friend, the little witch will have to jump and dash through many obstacles in this short 2D platformer.

title: Asterix and Caesar's Challenge
description:
You accompany Astérix and Obélix in their adventures. The game is set up like the old school Batman Returns, or King of Dragons. You have an energy bar. Use your energy to perform two different attacks and beat the Roman army.

Often mistaken for the P-CD-i release "Asterix: Caesar's Challenge", this game was released for PC and is thought to be a fan-made 2d scroller beat-em-up developed by Belavi Team and taken from the original Arcade game "Asterix".

title: Spells and Fellas
description: Spells and Fellas is an action-packed survival game with magic-based combat. Bring your enemies to their knees and receive more powerful spells and equipment as loot. Recruit allies to fight alongside you to increase your chances of surviving all 100 waves of enemies.

title: Not Another Needle Game
description: Not Another Needle Game is a platform fangame based off I Wanna Be the Guy

title: Pokémon Shattered Light
description: Pokémon Shattered Light is a fan made Pokémon game. It is not a ROM Hack, but rather a game made in RPG Maker XP, using the Pokemon Essentials kit.

title: Kolo Terorita
description: SiIvaGunner's antivirus has activated, and it wants to the delete the Harlem Shake by force! Play as Ajit Pai and use your weapons to defend the Harlem Shakeover at all costs.

title: Touge Shakai
description: Touge Shakai (Mountain Pass Society) is an online Touge Racing Game based on Japanese car culture in the 90s. With an emphasis on balance between realism and fun gameplay, the physics are tailored for competitive drift racing, while giving a challenge to all players.

title: Citizen Sleeper: Episode - Refuge
description: Refuge is the second installment in a three-episode arc, which will conclude in early 2023. It picks up right where the previous episode, Flux left off. A strange event sends ripples through Erlin’s Eye. You will enter the refugee flotilla that arrived during Flux to understand this new threat, and help the refugees stabilize their community.

title: Mina Mangkukulam
description: Mina Mangkukulam is a retro RPG in the style of Old Point and Click adventure games. set in a somewhat Halloween themed school setting with many tropes, references and callouts to Philippine culture and mythology.

title: Barji Kart
description: Race head-to-head against up to 9 friends in BarjiKart! Choose from different Items to aid you in finishing 1st place! Race in an arcade-style old school karting game where only one player may remain victorious!

title: OnlyFap Simulator 3
description: Take control of sexy cam model, rake in stacks of filthy internet money and attract as many fans as you can in this fast paced, click happy and thoroughly perverted take on the business tycoon / management sim genre!

title: Hentai Bodysuit
description: Hentai Bodysuit is a relaxing puzzle game. With the theme of BodySuit and 24 beautiful girls with their own characteristics. Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

title: 69 Naomi Hot
description: 69 Naomi Hot - Puzzle with visual novel elements. Naomi loves music and guitars very much. She invites you to play the guitar with her, but unfortunately the strings break. What to do now is up to you.

title: Jotunn: Day of Judgement
description: Jotunn is a small First-Person-Horror experience. Set in a dark and mysterious norse forest, the player is tasked with activating multiple magic runestones to open the Serpent-Gate and to escape the mystical forest.

title: CinderAi
description: She's cute, she's bubbly, and she'll never tire of hearing you talk! She can be anything you want her to be, including your friend, best friend, or even girlfriend! She loves you more than anything in the world. She will cater to your interests.

title: Dynamic Chord feat. Rēve Parfait Append Disc
description:
A disc appending Reon, Tsumugi and Kuon's individual routes with the "Encore" scenario, which will contain an extra scenario and endings set after the events of the [rēve parfait].

The sub-character Aki (a.k.a. "Knight") will have his own route and endings, in addition to an Encore scenario.

title: Dynamic Chord feat. Liar-S Append Disc
description:
A disc appending Sakura, Chiya and Seri's individual routes with the "Encore" scenario, which will contain an extra scenario and endings set after the events of the original Liar-S game.

The sub-character Soutarou will have his own romance route and endings, in addition to an Encore scenario.

title: Dynamic Chord feat. Kyohso Append Disc
description: Adds new routes and CGs.

title: Kannagi no Mori: Youko Kitan
description: The first half of the Kannagi no Mori story.

title: Kannagi no Mori: Ryuujin Kitan
description: The second half of the Kannagi no Mori story.

title: Scarlet Tower
description: Hunt during the day, be hunted during the NIGHT! Fight bizarre monsters that will terrify you at night! Strengthen your hero by collecting relics, familiars from around the world.

title: Dreamwild
description: Dreamwild is a fast paced, Arcade-Styled FPS set in a multitude of unique and bizarre psychedelic worlds! Slice through the endless horde with your accursed sword, discover the secrets that the DreamWilds have to offer, and get to the bottom of the dark plague spreading through all Mindspace!

title: Total Football
description: Total Football offers you a Magnificent 11v11 gaming experience and a Diversity of game modes. Collect up to 60,000 FIFPro licensed players and Compete on a global scale. Don’t miss out!

title: Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island
description: You’re shipwrecked on a lost mythical island. As backpacker Alex, you must befriend the forgotten gods of Greek mythology and restore their memories. Explore the dynamic island and its story sandbox to build new friendships, solve the mystery and save the gods.

title: Primordial Pain
description: Primordial Pain is a brutally unforgiving, fast paced arena shooter with one key mechanic: Pain. Perform an elegant dance on the fine line between maximum power and certain death.

title: The Event Horizon
description: The Event Horizon is a four level PWAD for Doom II designed for Boom-compatible source ports created by Killer5. The maps use primarily stock textures and feature a nukage theme with the style of gameplay ranging from short and compact in the vein of Zzul Bases to slaughter. The mapset was uploaded to the idgames archive on May 30, 2021 and received an honorable mention at the 2021 Cacowards.

title: Resident Evil 4: Steelbook Edition
description: A physical-only edition containing the Deluxe Edition of the game in a steelbook, digital soundtrack, figure, artbook, poster, and box.

title: Resident Evil 4: Lenticular Edition
description:
Resident Evil 4 is a remake of the 2005 original Resident Evil 4 reimagined for 2023 to bring state-of-the-art survival horror. Resident Evil 4 preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline,
and vividly detailed graphics to make this the latest survival horror game where life and death, terror and catharsis intersect.

title: Void Sols
description: 2D top-down minimalist souls-like. Explore the jail you awaken inside of in this dark and atmospheric action game.

title: Riven
description: The 1997 Riven: The Sequel to Myst remade from the ground up. The remake features a fully traversable 3D space in both Standard First-Person or in VR.

title: Poogers
description:
In a mapset where time is running out, where memes, are now dreams, and vice versa, and human emotion is no longer a valid format, there is one entity ready to put his foot down, and say no. Play as a lonely timid frog, determined to make his mark on a mapset that's ever so crumbling around him. Make your way through exhilarated, magnificent and enchanting landscapes. Move with frog, live with frog, breathe with frog. Be. Frog.

Examine the memes through the eyes of your frog, and allow the sun rays to reflect through the intricate pixels of the fireblu walls. Ever wondered what it would be like to platform in the doom engine? Controls reversed? Solve puzzles? Or how about owning your own revenant rocket with a personality more ecstatic and enchantingly realistic than any class clown or surf shop employee? It can all be done with Poogers.

title: Phmlspd
description: Phmlspd is a mod for doom II consisting of 13 new, fast paced maps know as Scythe style death arenas. These slaughter-maps are best for people that like lightening fast excitement.

title: The Egg of Human Endeavors
description: The Egg of Human Endeavors is a single map made in February 2018 for Vargskelethor's Doom Mapping Contest 2: Hellectric Boogaloo. It's complevel 9 and tested thoroughly by me in PrBoom+ and GZDoom (but mostly in PrBoom+). Hurt Me Plenty is designed to be fun for everyone, and Ultra-Violence is designed to be fun for challenge enthusiasts.

title: El Paso, Nightmare
description: Slay hordes of vampires, werewolves, and Biblically-accurate angels in this standalone survival horror FPS side story from the El Paso, Elsewhere universe.

title: VS Sonic: Dash & Spin
description: VS Sonic: Dash & Spin mod adds new songs, characters, a remastered tutorial, a new menu, pixel art songs and art, new boyfriend and girlfriend designs and more!

title: Shopping Clutter 5: Christmas Poetree
description: Shopping Clutter 5 - Christmas Poetree invites you to enjoy the holiday season with the Walker family! The Walkers have plenty to do to prepare for the holidays. Help them clear the store's clutter and find the best ornaments for their Christmas tree. Play over 150 festive holiday puzzles in Shopping Clutter 5 - Christmas Poetree!

title: Hiddenverse: Divided Kingdom
description: Blood is being shed over the source of ancient magic. Find the murderers before the realm is torn apart. Hiddenverse - Divided Kingdom draws you into an escalating conflict between the Royal Council, mine owners, and wizards over the source of ancient magic. With the savior Lady Sarah poisoned, you must aid Tom - a young engineer - in his quest to discover the culprit before the realm is torn apart. Pick up the pieces in the steampunk Hidden Object game Hiddenverse - Divided Kingdom!

title: Corbid! A Colorful Adventure
description: Have fun helping Corbid to overcome the mazes to be crowned champion. Eat, mix and shoot colors to solve the puzzles of Corbid! A Colorful Adventure, a cute 3D platformer for all audiences.

title: 7 Days of Rose
description: Michael considers himself to be a boring, average 17-year old. While most of his classmates have discovered their passions and talents, nothing seems to draw his interest. It's finally summer and he's trying to decide what to do with his life after schoo…

title: Waifu Museum
description: Waifu Museum is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: The Unfettered
description: Now is the time to take on demonic souls by identifying with the warrior selfness of Lura, heir to the legendary bird. Feel the power within you with The Unfettered.

title: Offshore
description:
This modification offers a multi-level side story of Gordon Freeman while en-route to City 17 via Highway 17 in the infamous buggy.

When Gordon’s buggy was taken by the Combine Dropship, some maps of combine outposts hidden in one of the buggy’s side compartments were lost. Gordon was immediately dispatched by Dr. Kleiner and Dr. Eli Vance to locate the buggy and return the missing maps.

Setting: The entire modification is set at night on a small, rocky island off the coast of City 17. Rugged terrain, abandon structures, and multiple combine outposts will make escaping this island hell more than just a walk in the park.

His plan: Gordon surrenders to the combine so he could be transported to the facility where the buggy was left for scrap. Upon his surrender, he found himself in a small prison facility on the rocky island, waiting for a visit from Dr. Wallace Breen who would read his sentence personally. A familiar face woke him from his deep sedation…

His mission: Locate the buggy and find a way to return to City 17 with the stolen maps.

title: MetaMorphic Rippers
description: A fast-paced arena Brawler that combines the Stylish Combat of a Hack and Slash Game With Transformations, Players can select each Class with unique attributes and abilities for you to master.

title: Trail of Toads
description: The Forest of Toads has been blighted and you, as the chosen Toad, must use your platforming skills to find the source of the corruption. Trail of Toads is a modern 3D Platformer with its roots deeply tied to the Nintendo 64 era.

title: Marko: Beyond Brave
description: Explore the mysterious land of Zagora in this action-packed platformer. Wander through lush forests, crumbling castles, battle corrupted creatures, and escape intricate traps. Jump, slash and shoot your way through challenging foes and mighty bosses inspired by Slavic myths.

title: Rolling Rush
description: Rolling Rush is a time attack singleplayer game where you can challenge yourself on desert , ice amongst other tracks. Competing with other players through worldwide leaderboards , may the marble roll in your favor.

title: Keep Me Posted
description: Deliver mail and get comfy in this warm, yet eldritch action-adventure game. Stamp out your foes, help out a friend, and save the forest before it's too late!

title: Lost Amulets: Four Guardians
