This Bishojo Game originally released under the "Genyukyo" brand has been reworked for the "CS Novels" so that they can be enjoyed by players all over the world.

title: Help! No Brake
description: Your car won't brake anymore. So better clear all the levels to get it fixed!

title: Golazo! 2: Qatar International Stars
description: You'll be able to participate in the challenging Qatar Cup 2022. Choose one of the 32 participating, win the group stages and playoffs and become World Champion!

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga - Character Collection 2
description:
Enjoy the critically acclaimed LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga with more heroes and villains. Expand your collection with 6 new downloadable character packs and play as heroes and villains from the galaxy.

Includes
Obi-Wan Kenobi
Andor
The Book Of Boba Fett
The Clone Wars
Rebels
Summer Vacation

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga - Character Collection 1 & 2
description:
Enjoy the critically acclaimed LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga with more heroes and villains. Explore the galaxy with over 400 characters in Character Collection 1 and 2.

Includes:
Character Collection 1:
Classic
Trooper
Mandalorian Season 1
Mandalorian Season 2
The Bad Batch
Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
Solo: A Star Wars Story

Character Collection 2:
Obi-Wan Kenobi
Andor
The Book Of Boba Fett
The Clone Wars
Rebels
Summer Vacation

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R - Risotto Nero DLC
description: The leader of La Squadra Esecuzioni, Risotto Nero, has joined the roster of All-Star Battle R! Have your opponents say their prayers when they fight against Risotto Nero's metallic manipulation!

title: New Scuffed Epic Visual Novel
description: This is New Scuffed Epic Visual Novel, which is a story set in the world of New Scuffed Epic BHOP Simulator, play as a character of your choice, as you run into some new, and familiar faces along the way.

title: Kanji RPG
description: An RPG-lite game where you learn how to read Japanese by battling cute monsters! Track your progress by collecting stamps and unlock new areas as you go.

title: It Returned to the Desert
description: Unique mix of turn-based strategy and adventure. Defend the town of Glint Rock against radioactive giant ants! Dr. Mill is a geologist that came to town to examine the recent meteor crash. Now he has to convince the towns folk that something's going on.

title: In the Rural Village of Nagoro
description: In The Rural Village of Nagoro is a short, side-scrolling game with minimalist gameplay ‘Interact button’ to tell a fate that falls on Nagoro village. Explore and press ‘F' button’ to greet all cheerful neighborhood.

title: Into the Spiritwell
description: Go forth little forest spirit and make your way through River of Life. Forge a path through thick forests, dark caves, and vast seas. Fight bosses and master elemental alchemy with your friends in a beautiful Ghibli inspired scenery.

title: InVertia
description: Invertia is a fast-paced sidescrolling platformer with a twist: You can't jump! You have to use your power to flip gravity to avoid obstacles and get to the doors in time.

title: I'm Not Happy
description: A singleplayer, post-horror exploration game that gives you the opportunity to unravel the events that've taken place in a seemingly normal home.

title: ImpossiBot
description: Challenge your finger dexterity like never before by helping the cute Bot navigate through an obstacle course full of enemies and reach his final destination in this action packed puzzle game.

title: The Guardian Stone
description: The Guardian Stone is a online third person Action Tower Defense Game with Rpg elements and mulitplayer. Set in the fantasy world of Elrone, You play as a hero protecting the realm from the forces of evil.

title: Hungry Caveman
description: Run, jump, and use your spear to attack animals and gather meat. It's up to you to use a variety of items to help with the hunt and keep the hungry caveman well-fed. Are you ready to embark on a prehistoric adventure with the Hungry Caveman?

title: Incur Survival
description: A Survival open-world game. Gather resources, Hunt, Craft tools and armor, Tame Animals, Ride Animals, Build, and defend your base from creatures, and other players.

title: Across the Obelisk: Spooky Night in Senenthia
description: A sinister moon rises over Senenthia and our heroes dress up for the occasion. With this DLC, you will get 7 new Halloween themed skins and 1 exclusive cardback for your heroes.

title: Depot Dungeons
description: Depot Dungeons is a box-pushing, bug-squishing, problem-solving, post-apocalyptic puzzle RPG by Otto Germain, built with the Megazeux game creation system, and designed to emulate old DOS games.

title: The Sacred Pools
description:
The Sacred Pools is an unreleased FMV game by Sega, planned for release in 1997.
Thanks to Joe Cain, former game tester at Sega of America and associate producer David Gray it was uncovered and uploaded in October 2022.

title: Death end re;Quest: Rook's Traveler Set
description: Rook's Traveler Set unlocks 3x sets that will assist you in your traveling needs!

title: Steel Division 2: Blood Feud in Transylvania
description: Steel Division 2: Blood Feud in Transylvania focuses on allies turned enemies. Command six new divisions as Axis Hungary, German, or Allied Romania. Relive the Battle of Turda with a new Army General campaign, and lead dozens of new units to victory on the blood-soaked battlefields of Transylvania.

title: Ages of Conflict: World War Simulator
description: Ages of Conflict is a versatile Map Simulation game where you spawn and observe custom AI nations battle it out across an infinite number of worlds. Command nations to nudge the world events into your liking.

title: Jewel Run
description: Introducing Jewel Run, the ultimate multiplayer action game that puts a hilarious spin on burglary! Join the heist as two teams with distinct gameplay styles go head-to-head: Will the cunning thieves outsmart the magical orchard's vigilant guards, or will the guardians protect their treasures?

title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Siege at Firemoth
description: Siege at Firemoth is an official plugin that adds a small island chain southwest of Seyda Neen, and a small quest involving taking out a large army of skeletons. Unlike most areas in the game, this place is very combat-oriented—you may find yourself facing dozens of enemies at one time. At the end, you will face Grurn, the leader of the island's undead, and a powerful lich to boot. You will be rewarded with the Ward of Akavir, a shield with a constant effect Fortify Luck enchantment.

title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Helm of Tohan
description: Helm of Tohan is an official plugin that includes a new quest to find the titular legendary artifact. The quest can be started by asking for rumors around Dagon Fel, which will direct you to the Daedric ruin of Onnissiralis. Outside the ruin are two warring brothers, one of whom will accompany you as you enter the ruins to find the artifact. It is not an Artifact in the usual sense in TES games, as it does not come pre-enchanted.

title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Master Index
description: Master Index is an official plugin that adds a new quest to find all ten Propylon Indices. The quest can be started by talking to Folms Mirel at the Guild of Mages in Caldera. Completing the quest will earn you the Master Propylon Index, which allows for easier transport via the propylon chamber system.

title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Entertainers
description: Entertainers is a plugin that adds the option to entertain the patrons of the Eight Plates in Balmora for Dulnea Ralaal. You can perform a variety of tricks to receive a small cash reward.

title: Lamento: Beyond the Void - Treasure Disc
description:
Fandisk for 'Lamento: Beyond the Void'.

The characters of Lamento: Beyond the Void gather for a celebration in the largest town for the Winter Festival. What happens on one night in particular in Bardo's inn is unexpected when a sly slip was done.

title: Way to a Vampire's Heart
description:
Being one of the youngest Vampire Hunters, Lucian Lockhart didn't expect to encounter one of those bloodthirsty creatures in his lifetime. After all, vampires were on the brink of extinction and no one heard about a single apparition of them for more than fifteen years.

However, the opportunity unexpectedly appears and Lucian finds himself face to face with the enemy he had only known from told stories and books. As if fighting a vampire for the first time wasn't astounding enough, Lucian also discovers one thing about his family's past that could tear apart everything he had believed to be true.

title: Dreamfall Chapters: Book One - Reborn
description:
Book One: Reborn is the first part of Dreamfall Chapters, released on October 21st, 2014.

Expanding on the saga of The Longest Journey and Dreamfall, Dreamfall Chapters is an episodic adventure game about choice and consequence, about dreams and reality, magic and science, chaos and order, and about the people whose actions may change the course of history in all worlds.

title: Dreamfall Chapters: Book Two - Rebels
description:
Book Two: Rebels is the second part of Dreamfall Chapters. It was released on March 12th, 2015.

Expanding on the saga of The Longest Journey and Dreamfall, Dreamfall Chapters is an episodic adventure game about choice and consequence, about dreams and reality, magic and science, chaos and order, and about the people whose actions may change the course of history in all worlds.

title: Dreamfall Chapters: Book Three - Realms
description:
Book Three: Realms is the third part of Dreamfall Chapters. Although the episode was widely expected to be available in early June, RTG postponed the release until after E3. Eventually, a release date of June 25th, 2015 was announced.

Expanding on the saga of The Longest Journey and Dreamfall, Dreamfall Chapters is an episodic adventure game about choice and consequence, about dreams and reality, magic and science, chaos and order, and about the people whose actions may change the course of history in all worlds.

title: Dreamfall Chapters: Book Four - Revelations
description:
Book Four: Revelations is the fourth part of Dreamfall Chapters. Between Books 3 and 4, RTG ported the game to Unity 5.2 – a prerequisite for the impending PS4 version and a necessity to profit from further Unity patches. It was released on December 3rd, 2015.

Expanding on the saga of The Longest Journey and Dreamfall, Dreamfall Chapters is an episodic adventure game about choice and consequence, about dreams and reality, magic and science, chaos and order, and about the people whose actions may change the course of history in all worlds.

title: Dreamfall Chapters: Book Five - Redux
description:
Book Five: Redux is the fifth, concluding part of Dreamfall Chapters. It was released on June 17th, 2016.

Expanding on the saga of The Longest Journey and Dreamfall, Dreamfall Chapters is an episodic adventure game about choice and consequence, about dreams and reality, magic and science, chaos and order, and about the people whose actions may change the course of history in all worlds.

title: Neverwinter: Fury of the Feywild
description: Neverwinter: Fury of the Feywild is the 1st campaign expansion module for the Neverwinter massive-multiplayer role-playing game. Released in August 2013, the expansion added a new campaign, adventure zone, skirmish, and a new dungeon, along with numerous other updates.

title: Sakura Tempest
description:
You will be playing Shōtarō, an average boy trying to survive his college years. Through his first year at his new college, many adventures await him – especially once he gets involved with four handsome upperclassmen!
Will he spent summer in the mountains with his childhood friend? Or train with the sports club? Or maybe go to the beach with the student council? Or get in trouble with a certain delinquent?

title: Legend of Rune
description: Legend of Rune is a fantasy BL / gay visual novel game. It follows the adventures of Rune, a young fire mage who has been destined to destroy the world. On his journey to escape his destiny, Rune meets four other mages that wish to aid him in his travels. The game also features a puzzle-battle system, where battles are fought through a tile-matching game.

title: Unotale: Card Game
description: Unotale: Card Game is an Undertale implementation of the famous card game where you try to eliminate all your cards first! And torture your friends with skips and draw cards!

title: Mixtape
description: Mixtape is a narrative adventure game developed by Beethoven & Dinosaur and published by Annapurna Interactive. Set during the last night of high school, it follows three friends as they revisit memories connected to music, youth and leaving home. The game combines story scenes with playable vignettes, including skating, parties, and other moments, all framed by a licensed soundtrack.

title: Yume no Kirby
description: Yume no Kirby is an English Kirby/Yume Nikki fangame created by Ondaja in RPG Maker 2003. It was developed as an entry for Dream Diary Jam 6.

title: B:(ursed
description: B:(ursed is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame created by Mizkura in RPG Maker VX Ace.

title: Tintin Reporter: Cigars of the Pharaoh
description: Tintin and his faithful companion Snowy are going to experience some extraordinary adventures…After meeting Professor Sarcophagus whilst cruising the Mediterranean Sea, the famous reporter sets out in search of the tomb of the Pharaoh Kih-Oskh.

title: After Solitary
description: The story of a man's life after solitary confinement.

title: R-Type Final 2: DLC Set 9
description: Includes 3 new stages.

title: Massi
description: Massi a retro pixel art game. It is the story of a Numidian king who lost his kingdom and fights to get it back. Massi is a performer with souls like and metroidvania features. A worthy descendant of 90s game: Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap

title: Sandbox
description: This is a pixel sandbox game where you can place multiple different elements into the scene to create a unique little world.

title: OlliOlli World: Finding the Flowzone
description: OlliOlli World: Finding the Flowzone is the final expansion that can be purchased individually or as part of the OlliOlli World Expansion Pass or OlliOlli World Rad Edition. OlliOlli World base game is required to play expansions. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

title: PenguInn
description: PenguInn is a classic single-player 2D platformer that takes you on a journey through a dream world made in AI-generated art. Collect beautiful art by completing 100 levels before waking up from your dream.

title: Phantom Tides
description: Set your course and explore a variety of environments on the seas in Phantom Tides. Battle various enemies and bosses as you collect items to help you on your journey. This 2D style platformer will challenge your skills and wit.

title: Blue Fire: Void of Sorrows
description:
The Void of Sorrow DLC is an end-game content expansion for Blue Fire that includes:

2 new Areas: the Void Gate, a secret wing of the Fire Keep; and the Sealed Land, a forgotten place hidden away for ages.
16 new mind-blowing Voids which will have you prove your limit
1 new epic boss fight where you'll uncover an unbelievable truth
Several hours of new gameplay
Exclusive tunics, swords and a new NPC
Lore expansion & cutscenes

title: Ragnarok Begins
description: Introducing Ragnarok Begins! Reminiscent of the original Ragnarok Online Become the hero of an epic adventure set in a swift side-scroll MMORPG Here lies a fantasy world of mysterious monsters and epic characters. Explore legendary kingdoms and mythical dungeons in this open-world role-playing game!

title: Overknight Dungeon
description:
Overknight Dungeon is an action-packed-dungeon crawler platformer inspired by some arcade classics, featuring an amazing retro pixel art style and an awesome OST made by Richar Rest!
Pick up your sword and make your way through this ever-changing dungeon, collect coins, and get new power-ups to help you in your quest to save your BFF!
Are you up to the challenge?

title: Mystical Mixing
description: Enter a world of magic and wonder with Mystical Mixing.

title: Last-Hit Defense
description: Defense game in which you build towers to block enemies from approaching.Action game in which you control a hero to eliminate monsters.An innovative 'Action-Defense' game created by merging two game genres !

title: The Barker & Mustard Files
description:
The Barker & Mustard Files is a 2D/3D Mystery-Adventure game where you play as a dashingly daring dynamic duo of Dog Detectives by the names of Harvey Barker and Frank Mustard.

Point and click your way through the luxurious Clydesdale Hotel, meet the multitude of suspicious sweeties and dubious degenerates contained within, and solve a wide variety of puzzles on your journey to unravel the mysterious disappearance of the bashful Beaver, Stuart "Flappy" Brown.

It's a tough gig, being a detective. And it's tougher still when nobody gives you the respect you deserve. Harvey and Frank have been pounding the proverbial pavement for years, doing big-time work for small-time pay, only to get credit snatched away by the (sometimes literal) Vultures at the Scarlet City Police Department.

But all of that changed when the case of a lifetime fell right into their laps... along with a couple of trigger-happy, gun-toting thugs. But a little bullet-themed office redecoration courtesy of those two-bit toughs wasn't about to scare Harvey Barker and Frank Mustard off the biggest case (and biggest paycheque) they've ever had...

So grab a good snack, your beverage of choice, and head on down to the Clydesdale Hotel... because it's time to crack this case wide open!

title: Killer Koobs
description: Killer Koobs is a twin-stick shooter with a focus on CQB and weapon handling. Shoot and kill koobs to get resources, use the resources to buy better guns and upgrades.

title: Into Ruins
description: Jump down holes, fight monsters, and collect orbs as you make your way through cave formations and crumbling dungeons in this chaotic pico8 roguelike.

title: StarCraft: Precursor
description: StarCraft: Precursor (also known as StarCraft: Loomings) campaign is a series of single-player mission which take place approximately a month before StarCraft Episode I and depicts much of the Battle of Chau Sara. In this campaign, the player takes the role of an Alpha Squadron lieutenant, and zerg are always referred to as "xenomorphs".

title: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars - Call of the Paragons
description: When the event of Trinity is near, the restless spirits of Aphes Paragons become disturbed and the rifts to Phantasma open across the whole city. Hilda must rise up to the challenge and prove to be the Heroine that determines the fate of Aphes.

title: Asian Cargo Sim
description: You only need a few seconds to enter this atmosphere.

title: Astonishing Basketball Manager
description: The ultimate basketball manager game. Become the best coach of the league and build your own basketball dynasty!

title: Just Push the Button
description: All you have to do is just push the button. It should be easy, although it's been a long time I didn't do it myself, so who knows? For example, the mouse no longer worked and I had to quickly patch keyboard to control pointer. Just use arrow keys, X and C. Hope I didn't mess things up. Coding is strange: you let everything for a while and when you're back, it's like functions have started a life of their own and nothing works like it used to be. Oh well.

title: How 2 Dreams
description: Collaborative flatgame anthology showing in 10 chapters how dreams are made.

title: Zeeverse
description: Zeeverse is a creator platform built on top of a blockchain-based game centered around a vast collection of unique little creatures called ZEE NFTs. Collect and battle more than 250+ different ZEE kinds with unlimited variations. Each unique, each only yours. In Zeeverse you explore various dungeons, hunt for treasures, battle epic bosses with friends, battle other players, build and farm on your lands, discover treasures, and travel Zeeverse to discover epic adventures.

title: Berserk and the Band of the Hawk: Additional Warhorse Set
description: This is a set of 4 additional warhorses. The following warhorses are included in this package: Berserk: Additional Horse "Red Hare" Berserk: Additional Horse "Matsukaze" Berserk: Additional Horse "Berserker Warhorse" Berserk: Additional Horse "Unicorn"

title: Black Clover: Quartet Knights - Royal Magic Knight Set: Wizard King
description: DLC2 includes the Wizard King, Julius, as a playable character, as well as the new "Sea Goddess" outfit for Noelle.

title: Black Clover: Quartet Knights - Royal Magic Knight Set: Blue
description: Add-on installment #1 includes the new playable character Charlotte and a new Japanese-style outfit for Yami.

title: Darkdire: The Advanced Set - Greencastle Expansion
description: The kingdom of Union Port long ago built a large stone wall circling the kingdom, but the wall wasn't built to keep out invaders. It was built to seal off the center of the kingdom. Anyone that knows why it was built isn't revealing any secrets.

title: SoulCalibur VI: Character Creation Set F
description: Celebrate 20 years of SOULCALIBUR with an all new Character Creation set!

title: Atomic Heart: Premium Edition
description: The Premium Edition includes Atomic Heart, the Atomic Pass, two unique weapon skins and a digital artbook.In a mad utopian world, fight for freedom against robots in spectacular combat. If you want to reach the truth, you'll have to pay in blood.

title: Atomic Heart: Gold Edition
description:
The Gold Edition includes the base game Atomic Heart and the Atomic Pass.

In a mad utopian world, fight for freedom against robots in spectacular combat. If you want to reach the truth, you'll have to pay in blood.

title: Human Zoo
description: Beautiful teenagers, dreams, grotesque orgies. When no one in the world is awake anymore, is your sanity an alternative madness? A turn-based surrealist psychological horror game with beautiful L2D combat artwork and a deep, philosophical plot.

title: Neverwinter: Shadowmantle
description: Neverwinter: Shadowmantle is the 2nd campaign expansion module for the Neverwinter massive-multiplayer role-playing game. Released in December 2013, the expansion added a new campaign, adventure zone, skirmish, and a new dungeon, along with numerous other updates.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Season 3 - Plaguefall
description: The Rivals have been pushed back for the moment, but only just in time for a brand new threat to rear its ugly head. An insidious lithophage, a sickness of the very rock beneath our feet, has struck Hoxxes. Nicknamed the 'Rockpox', this planetary pathogen is spreading through the caves, infecting the rock and even directly affecting the local fauna. Even the hardy Dwarves can feel its insidious grasp. Prepare for PLAGUEFALL!

title: Gore Screaming Show
description: Gore Screaming Show is a horror visual novel developed by Black Cyc, where a boy named Kyoji seeks to unravel the mysteries that have taken root in his hometown while he was away. Mysteries are tied to a young girl named Yuka, and her companion, the horrific Gore Screaming Show.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Supporter Upgrade
description:
So you like Deep Rock Galactic, but it’s just not enough? You want more? Well, then the Supporter Upgrade is for you! Help fuel further development of the game, while getting your grubby mining-gloves on this tasty bag of exclusive treats:

- Gold plated Paintjob for Bosco in the game!
- Supporter-only gold-plated skins for all weapons in the game!
- VIP treatment at the ingame Abyss Bar - Get the SUPPORTER EDITION of the tasty Glyphid Slammer for your whole team, served in the gaudiest of golden tankards!
- A unique Ghost Ship Games themed helmet, marking you as a permanent member of the Skeleton Crew!
- Your chat name will be gold, to show off your Supporter status!
- The unique Supporter Badge, shown next to your name ingame! (NEW: And in chat!)
- An exclusive set of blinged-out armor for each class! NEW This is now a Paintjob and can be applied to all armors!
- Our heartfelt and eternal thanks and gratitude <3

title: Surmount: A Mountain Climbing Adventure
description: Surmount is a free-flowing, physics-based platforming adventure where you’ll experience the joys of mountain climbing. Make your perilous ascent through the various handcrafted and procedurally generated challenges of Mount Om, all the while following a silly story with eccentric folks along the way. Master your own unique style of climbing either alone or with a friend, upgrade and customize your climber to stand a better chance, and maybe just maybe, you'll be the first ever to reach the top!

title: Sunshine Shuffle
description: Sunshine Shuffle is a narrative poker adventure featuring talking animals with criminal pasts and adorable outfits! Play Texas Hold 'Em with the remaining members of the 'Morning Shift', a group of working-class creatures turned would-be Robin Hoods who crossed the Fishie Mob, and mostly lived to tell the tale. Unravel the story of how the largest bank on the Eastern Seaboard was robbed in a single afternoon as you play. Win hands to earn tokens and decorate the S.S. Sunshine with new light fixtures, chairs, card decks, and more. And try to boogie to the game's vibrant, wiggle-inducing original ska soundtrack as you stare into the cold eyes of a 12 year-old kitten with nothing left to lose.

title: Nameless: The Departed Cycle
description: Nameless: The Departed Cycle is a dark fantasy/horror visual novel with LGBTQ+ elements. Make choices to determine Israh's fate, and strive to survive -- perhaps even slay -- the monster stalking the Umbral Forest.

title: Zettai Kaikyuu Gakuen Shiawase-iro no Tobira
description: Successfully crowdfunded and officially announced on Sweet Princess vol. 27.

title: Geometric Feel the Beats
description: Inspired by a space theme and with touches of “Tron” (we love this movie!) the game is fun and competition accompanied by frantic music.

title: Catacomb Kitties
description: In a nutshell: - A micro RPG with about 2-4 hours of play for each run - Randomized worlds, dungeons, and cities - A cool personality profile at the end of each game based on your actions during play - 6 Kitty classes to choose from!

title: Ore ga Watashi ni Kawatta Hi...: Becoming a She
description: Becoming a girl in a year!?Shyly, ended up transferring to a girl's academy in girl's clothes...

title: Idle Hamburgers Save the World
description: Your goal is just to keep producing hamburgers and solve the global food crisis.

title: Hunt: Showdown - Fear the Reaper
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter, two Legendary weapons and one Legendary Tool: The Reaper (Hunter), Quietus (Specter 1882 Compact), Memento Mori (Winfield M1876 Centennial), and The Scythe (Throwing Axe).

title: Hot Milf 9
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

description: One VR app to play, sing, chat, relax, teach or even preach. A world of fantasy and real life simulations all to be experienced in VR.

title: HerrAnwalt: Lawyers Legacy
description: You’re a Lawyer who tries to save students from a crazy headmaster. You need to survive a variety of school lessons and fight the different teachers

title: Her Heart's Desire: A Landlord Epic
description: Become a landlord, sublet your two available rooms to 3 beautiful women, and explore relationships with all three of them. Customize your name, the relationship, and each of the love interests names. Features fully a mix of animated and non-animated content in this delightful visual novel.

title: GhostBros
description: Ghost Brothers is a rogue-lite where you control a snake of multiple heroes, each with their own attacks, passive skills, and classes. Inspired by the auto-chess genre, each hero in Snake has a set of classes, and combining enough heroes of the same class can give you additional class bonuses.

title: Ghost Village
description: My grandmother was originally from the village, but after the environmental disaster that occurred 30 years ago near their settlement, she moved to our city and lived with us.

title: Ginnung
description: You find yourself trapped in a void of Norse spirits, who are out to help you… or destroy you. Find your escape in this tight platformer with emphasis on speedrunning. Use the simple but versatile movement to the best of your ability!

title: Gabenwood: 99 Hidden Bucks
description: This is a hidden objects puzzle game what will test your wit and attentivnes. Save the Universe from destruction! Go to the Gabenwoods and find 99 bucks transferred there by some evil guy from our world.

title: Furry Meow
description: Furry Meow - is a classic 2D game in the memory genre which is about you find the same pictures and enjoy different images of furry beautiful kitties.

title: Frog Jump
description: Jump, climb, push others with your tongue, and reach the top to win the princess's kiss! (Up to 8 Players)

title: From the Ashes
description: The country is ravaged with fiends and bandits, people are all trying to survive and start again while hoping their champion, the Great Knight Callan, manages to defeat the necromancer. Whether he succeeds or not, the country has to rebuild, from the ashes.

title: Free Bees
description: A brick-breaker reimagined with hexagons, honey, and heavy-duty chains! Free the bees by chaining together projectiles in unique visual settings using new brick-breaker mechanics. Create & share your own custom levels, chill with the freed-bees in the sanctuary, and, most importantly, FREE THE BEES!

title: Fourspell Survivors Online
description: Join friends online to survive endless hordes of monsters in this online coop "survivors" game! Evolve your spells, defeat bosses and develop the best character builds and party formations. Cooperation is key to survive in this action roguelike with unique characters.

title: FlipScapes
description: Flip, bounce and roll through a Pinball universe filled with playful characters. Pick your favorite hero and immerse yourself in arcade fun!

title: Flunky Farm
description:
Flunky Farm is an amazing game that takes you to a world full of action and fun!
Dr. Tiroliro, the big bad, has been captured by the neighborhood superhero, now it's up to your clever son to plan a “rescue” mission with the help of some not-so-serious helpers - you!
But only the highest value minions will be chosen for the big ransom. Then you need to prove yourself in the children's arena, where you take control of adorable mischievous creatures, each with their own set of skills and play style, adding an extra dose of fun and unpredictability to the battlefield, making each match a unique experience.
Players enter combat with the objective of reducing their opponents' weight and expelling them from the arena. Managing the weight of your character and your opponents becomes crucial in Flunky Farm. Players must find a balance between dealing damage to reduce the weight of opponents and avoiding attacks so that their own weight does not fall too much.
Here's the deal: kick, dodge and throw your rivals out of the ring to become the ultimate champion!
But wait, here comes the lightning, like it's making a surprise entrance to the party, and suddenly everyone's like, “Oh, I need to find shelter!” It's like a game of musical chairs, but instead of music, you have thunder!
Flunky Farm is more than just a game, it's a thrilling adventure, full of action and excitement that you absolutely can't miss. Whether you enjoy intense battles, challenging strategies, or just want some casual fun, Flunky Farm offers all that and more.
Climb the ladder of evil and each step will bring you closer to being the villainous boss!

title: Final Boss
description: Fight through a pixel-art beat ’em up, then face off in a cinematic 3D boss battle! Based on Tyler Kirkham's hit Image Comics series, Final Boss blends side-scrolling action, fighting game precision, and animated comic storytelling into a nostalgic co-op adventure.

title: Fear & Hunger 2: Termina
description: Fear & Hunger 2: Termina is oppressive, relentless and hopeless. A mix of jRPG and Survival Horror. Turn-based combat meets resource management. 3 days to explore the wicked town of Prehevil and find out about its dark secrets. 3 days until the pale and sickly green moon rises at its apex. Termina is upon us!

title: Farmistic
description: Farmistic is a top-down farming simulation game in early developement by an independant developer. Start small, work your fields, buy more land and equipment, and automate!

title: Fantasy Madness: Bloodbath
description: Fantasy Madness: Bloodbath is a roguelike action-survival game where forces of nature fight against hordes of evil. Gain new skills, loot powerful items and defeat all who stand in your way… By all means!

title: Fantasy Memory Card Game
description: Finding pairs might sound easy, but this game will definitely challenge your brain! Train your memory, concentration, accuracy, attention, the speed of thinking and logic skills and much more. This game is a great way to exercise your memory and keep your brain fit!

title: Fall of Bali
description: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy simulator city set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided in many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has fall in warring era for nearly 2 centuries and now the threat of imperialism come. With all your kingdom potential, can you survive and win this era?

title: Fallen Knight: Rebellion of the Fallen
description: Are you ready? Fallen Knight’s second DLC, Rebellion of the Fallen, is here! After successfully saving Neo-utopia from the attack of the Purge, Lancelot once again enters battle as he must fight to protect what he believes in. In this DLC, play in a rushdown-like style as Lancelot must face off against new bosses as fast as he can to save his friend as time is running out!

title: Fake Heart
description: Fake Heart is an "Interactive-Visual Novel" game about an episode between elderly fairy tale writer Jade and granddaughter Sarah.

title: Tales of Fablecraft
description: Fablecraft is a cooperative digital tabletop roleplaying game set in the vibrant, hopeful world of Mythas. Our platform integrates interactive battlemaps, video, audio, and text chat, digital dice and unique game system, and a library of artwork and music, to bring your stories to life.

title: Fairy Biography 2: Confidante
description: Players can obtain game qualifications by using magic balls to attach naughty elves to the Elder Scrolls, unlocking and collecting different types of beautiful elves.

title: Exostation
description: Exostation is a sci-fi real-time strategy game. Reach sustainable planet economies by building, allocating, mining, and selling wisely. Allow humanity to spread and conquer new solar systems not by war but by ensuring its planet's resources are not exhausted.

title: Ember's Love
description: Ember's Love is an RPG adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: Empyreal Dawn
description: Empyreal Dawn is a Gothic Fantasy Adventure where you lead a party named Caeruleum. Together with your Swordsmaiden partner, Alice Starwell, undertake your first steps toward becoming legendary heroes! Featuring professional voice acting, an original soundtrack, and more!

title: Edge Islands
description: Build your colony, train your team, explore and engage in turn-based tactical battles to protect and expand your domain! Shape unique stories by managing moods, relationships and ambitions in your group of adventurers.

title: Echo Divide
description: Explore unique worlds, fight demons and save the world in this open world hack and slash hybrid.

title: Early Worm
description: Early Worm gets the Apple! Fun puzzle platformer full twisty action!

title: Eagle Hunting Journey
description: Play Eagle Hunting Journey, survive the day, and soar through the skies. If you are a fan of animal simulator games, our game is made just for you. You can experience the thrill of being a real eagle in the wild - hunt prey in order to survive, raise a family and take care of your young ones.

title: Dragon Princess is Hungry
description: Eva, the half-dragon, half-human princess. Pfuel, the steward, who serves Eva. They visit a mysterious isolated island infested with monster girls, and Pfuel collects food for Eva on the island. However, there is a secret hidden on the island.

title: Dreamcutter
description: The Dreamcutter, a mysterious scythe with an ulterior motive, promises sexy rewards and a chance at escape. What strange dangers and exotic encounters will you find inside your own mind?

title: Don't Bow
description: Old school shooter. Gibs give you ammo, going Berserk gives you health. Kill them all.

title: Dicey Birdball
description: Dicey Birdball is a strategy sports game where you manage a team of birds playing football. Roll dice and assign them to your athletes to maneuver, score goals, and earn seeds to improve your team.

title: Didactic Jesus Game
description: An ideal game to read the Gospel in an original and fun way. You will play the role of Jesus to save the world from evil, and you will learn how much he loves you. Are you ready to know his path full of Truth and Life?

title: Deterrence
description:
Artificial intelligence has plotted a path to a sustainable future, but humans aren't included. Defend humanity against the A.I. in this instant action tower defense, real-time strategy hybrid.

Deterrence is a tower defense, real-time strategy hybrid that offers a midcore single-player experience. Play as the human race in the not-too-distant future and fight malfunctioning artificial intelligence. Choose your own conflicts in the nonlinear campaign that's complete with mission rewards and research tree.

Each level is a puzzle to solve using strategy. Depending on your skill level, you will have to play an active role in helping your troops withstand the enemy onslaught whether that be repairing defenses, reallocating troops to another front, designating artillery strike zones, or destroying bridges.

Command your troops to victory by taking advantage of everything the battlefield has to offer. Garrison troops in civilian structures for quick defense. Build artillery batteries to pound enemy advances. Jam the enemy signals to gain an advantage. Call in air strikes, artillery strikes, and warheads to turn the tide of battle.

title: Detective Agency: Gray Tie - Collector's Edition
description: Avi Games presents the first game from the Detective Agency "Gray Tie" series. This exciting hiden object game is packed with beautiful locations, diverse and interesting ways of searching for items, as well as new mini-games.

title: Defenders of Tetsoidea: Chrono Chonus

description: This Bonus Package contains a selection of signed plugin scripts for X3: Terran Conflict, created by members of the Egosoft forum community and validated by Egosoft.

title: Friday Night Funkin': VS Shy-Girl
description: Boyfriend somehow ended up on Yoshi's Island but he soon noticed that this isn't the normal Yoshi's Island he loved as a kid.

title: MagicCraft
description:
MagicCraft is a PVP Multiplayer Online Battle Arena game (MOBA) launched on Binance Smart Chain, beginning as a quick action mobile game, with numerous play-to-earn opportunities, NFT characters and mini quests within each game.

Launching first with 15 main characters, each with different traits, skills, powers and abilities, the MagicCraft world is completely scalable, built to gradually expand from a MOBA game into a complex and challenging massively multiplayer metaverse experience.

Players can enter battle as a single player, or form clans to fight in huge multiplayer battles, all for prizes in our native cryptocurrency, $MCRT.

title: Mislight
description:
A Side Scroller Adventure game with a slight touch of Thriller.
Use the powers of your flashlight to light up the shadow creatures that roam trought the forest and seek your way out!

title: Little Inferno: Ho Ho Holiday
description: Return to the world of Little Inferno with an all new scary holiday story, a mysterious new character, a new catalog, new toys, new combos, and lots of new holiday content to keep you warm.

title: The Temple Of
description:
The Temple Of is a Roguelike Dungeon Crawler game. It is 3D, procedurally generated, and packed with ancient horror around every corner! Use your torch to find secret passageways, treasures, and mysteries all while avoiding (or seeking?) the supernatural. Explore ever changing environments, from dusty and forgotten tombs to subterranean jungles.

Experience exploration like never before in a brand new horror adventure beneath the sands of Egypt! Grab your torch and load your pistol, for there's treasure to find, mysteries to solve, and nightmares to uncover.

title: Voices of the Void
description:
You work as a scientist in the isolated research lab in the mountains of Switzerland. Your task is to gather signals from space, analyze them, process them and sell them to get points.

You can get regular signals and objects like dwarf planets and stars, or you can get something "unusual" or even "strange" and "unexplainable".

title: Nordland Mahjongg
description: "Nordland Mahjongg" offers many hours of challenging gaming fun for both beginners and passionate Mahjongg players. Enjoy different, hand-drawn tiles sets that can be coordinated with beautiful backgrounds.

title: Star Conflict: Plague Doctor
description:
This pack includes:
Jericho interceptor “Plague Doctor” (Jericho rank 13)
Coating “Easy target”
Decor “Blades”
Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

description: Celebrate the Rainbow Six Siege Pro League with Clash's Gold Chibi charm, Celestial Glory uniform, Challenger headgear and Halcyon Flux weapon skin for the SPSMG9 and the CCE Shield.

title: Rune II: Wolf Armor + Weapon Set
description: In honor of Víðarr’s valiant act, weapons and gear were forged by the blacksmith’s of Midgard and are bestowed upon the most worthy of warriors. Don a Wolf Hood as you wield a mighty Iron Wolf Shield and Mace, showing your enemies that you are not a Viking to be trifled with.

description: A set that includes additional events that can be played with the "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIV" and the "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIV: Diplomacy and Strategy Expansion Pack Bundle".

description: Songstress's Garb Appearance Set & 5th Weapon for Yuna

Released in November 2014, the expansion added a new adventure zone, skirmish, and raid dungeon, along with an expansion of the Tyranny of Dragons campaign and numerous other updates.

title: Bacchikoi!
description: The young transfer student, Toshu Kanada, gets himself recruited in a nearly-falling apart baseball club. His once small world opens up as he gets to know his teammates Ichiru and Masaru. Lead Toshu with his choices and take teamwork and friendship to a whole new level!

title: Neverwinter: Elemental Evil
description: Neverwinter: Elemental Evil is the 6th campaign expansion module for the Neverwinter massive-multiplayer role-playing game. Released in April 2015, the expansion added a new class, increased level cap, expansion of the game's profession system, a new campaign and several new adventure zones.

title: Neverwinter: Strongholds
description: Neverwinter: Strongholds is the 7th campaign expansion module for the Neverwinter massive-multiplayer role-playing game. Released in August 2015, the expansion added the feature of stronghold guild halls to guilds, added a new event, a new form of PvP gameplay, and introduced a form of premium membership.

title: Neverwinter: Underdark
description: Neverwinter: Underdark is the 8th campaign expansion module for the Neverwinter massive-multiplayer role-playing game. Released in November 2015, the expansion added a new campaign, adventure zone, skirmishes and raids, along with numerous other updates.

title: Neverwinter: The Maze Engine
description: Neverwinter: The Maze Engine is the 9th campaign expansion module for the Neverwinter massive-multiplayer role-playing game. Released in March 2016, the expansion added a new campaign, re-introduced four previously-removed dungeons, along with a new system for in-game mounts.

title: Neverwinter: The Cloaked Ascendancy
description: Neverwinter: The Cloaked Ascendancy is the 11th campaign expansion module for the Neverwinter massive-multiplayer role-playing game. Released in February 2017, the expansion added a new campaign, adventure zone, skirmish, and even more.

title: Seiyuu Danshi!: After Stories
description: After stories is a compilation of extra Seiyuu Danshi episodes that deviate from / out of scope of the game's original setting. Additional episodes are released on a monthly basis and are exclusive for patrons.

title: Fighting EX Layer: Character - Terry
description: Adds Terry Bogard character to the main game.

title: The Ball 2
description: The Ball 2 is a 2.5D physics based Platformer where you play as a Ball. You can finish little puzzles or play them against others in the Online mode. You can also play in the Challenge mode where you can play different challenges and compete with all other players for the fastes finish Time! The Ball 2 also has a Level editor and Steam Workshop Support for levels made by the community. The Ball 2 also saves Replays of your best best runs and if you got the world record your run gets uploaded so that all other players can see it.

title: Metroid: Origins
description: Metroid Origins is a short fangame of Metroid developed in MEngine by Hackmi. If features 3 Areas, 2 boss variations, original music, brand new game mechanics, a refined engine made in Game Maker Studio, overdetailed environments and lots of custom artwork.

title: The Contract Bound
description: The Contract Bound is a linear, fully voiced kinetic-NVL that's a bit audio-book + a bit puppet show + a bit D&D-inspired tomfoolery!

title: Melvor Idle: Throne of the Herald
description: Throne of the Herald is the first expansion to Melvor Idle and continues the story of our hero as you discover more about the mystic forces that surround the lands of Melvor, and the dark forces that remain hidden outside of the Capital.

title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip - Playable Character Juan
description: Remember Juan? He has gone from being an NPC mentioned in just a few lines to a fully playable character with lots of art. Back then you couldn't see Juan; now you can't not see him! With Juan, your road trip will be abs-olutely fantastic!

title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip - Playable Character Glitch
description: Would you define yourself as a creature of mischief? Then Glitch might be the playable character for you! Bring chaos to "Monster Roadtrip" by playing as this little obnoxious (yet adorable) bastard.

title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip - Playable Character Hazel
description: Hazel is a smol bean. Hazel is a chill charming moth person. Hazel is what'd happen if you turned "lo fi" into a person. Does this speak to you? Now you can play "Monster Roadtrip" as Hazel!

title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip - Playable Character Zoe
description:
We all love Zoe, don't we?

She's passionate about her interests. She's horny 24/7. She's a lover of many fandoms, always writing a fanfic or drawing fanart. She's snarky, chaotic, and ultimately good-hearted. She's more than ready to explore her own truth and to be unapologetically herself.

We love her partly because she's like us. We love her partly because she's what we'd like to be.

That's the charm of our beloved and adorkable eldritch cutie.

In a way, she IS us.

So maybe... today we can be her.

title: Affairs of the Court: Choice of Romance - Play as the Consort
description: If you start a new game beginning in Episode 2, this unlocks the ability to play as the monarch's consort, rather than as the monarch's lover.

title: Dragon Age: Origins - A Tale of Orzammar
description: A Tale of Orzammar is a promotional module for Dragon Age: Origins that was created by BioWare and released as a bonus with the December 2009 edition of PC Gamer. It is an unvoiced storyline that serves as a prologue to the Dwarf Noble Origin and was created in collaboration with the magazine as an example of what could be made with the modding toolset. The module is also included with the GOG release of Dragon Age: Origins via an update patch.

title: The Witcher: The Price of Neutrality
description:
The Price of Neutrality is a premium module for The Witcher, created by CD PROJEKT RED and released on April 10, 2008, together with the D'jinni Adventure Editor. The original adventure required Patch 1.3 to work, but had no voice acting. The next patch, version 1.4 or The Witcher: Enhanced Edition, added Side Effects premium module, and voice acting for both modules.

While the plot itself is new, the locations were originally meant to be included in the main game, but were cut from the final version.

title: The Witcher: Side Effects
description: Side Effects is a fully voiced premium module for The Witcher, created by CD PROJEKT RED. It was released on September 16, 2008 as part of the The Witcher: Enhanced Edition.

title: Disciples II: Rise of the Elves Gold
description: This version features all of the campaigns found in the original game and a brand-new mini campaign not found in any other editions of Disciples II, which consists of the 3 maps and continues the storyline of the Elven Race. It also includes 14 new skirmish maps to test and hone your skills.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Iris F-15E/I/SG
description:
An addon for Microsoft Flight Simulator X. This addon is also compatible with Prepar3D. You can download from fs-freeware.net. This specific version contains:

F-15E Strike Eagle
F-15I Ra'am
F-15SG Strike Eagle

title: Galshell 2
description: Galshell 2 is a self-described "grotesque shooting game."

title: Nose
description: An easy [climbing] game by a gentle author.

title: Thick as Thieves
description:
Enter the shadows in this introduction to Thick as Thieves. In the shadow-draped streets of Kilcairn, fortune favours the bold. As a member of the Thieves' Guild, you'll undertake daring heists to claim precious heirlooms and uncover arcane secrets hidden within this alternate-history 1910s Scottish city, where magic and early technology have begun to collide.

Whether working alone or playing online co-op, only the most cunning will seize their fortune in Thick as Thieves!

title: Hot Heat Reset
description: A fast-paced maze action game where you play as an unknown speedster hiding under a skull who is in pursuit to recover his stolen lands and is about to deal with a lot of Explosion! Get ready to RESET everything!

title: Sunset Routes
description: Sunset Routes is an easy and intriguing roguelite game. You can choose your crew, put them in the cabins, select your destination, and set sail. Through a series of choices, you can earn profits during the emergency period of the New World and even decide its fate - unintentionally or on purpose.

title: SlasherRPG
description: Slasher RPG is game with many features, combining fantasy farming, action and survival. You can hunt, build, raise animals and hack and slash.

title: The Quarry: '50s Throwback Character Outfits
description: Travel back in time with your favorite counselors!

title: Technophobia: Dead Metal Tournament
description: Robots smash each other to pieces in one on one hand to hand combat to prove they are not junk. 1 or 2 player 3d fighting game that is 2d in principle Use carefully timed directional and button inputs to execute moves and combos.

title: Metal Survivor
description: A base-building action-roguelite horde-survival game. Build up your base and defend it with a customized armored vehicle. Set-up defenses, upgrade your weapons, improve your vehicle and be ready to shoot down an ever growing horde of enemies to survive each night.

title: Engineered to Purpose
description: A sci-fi tower defense game where the player designs their own towers to control how they defend against attackers.

title: Doom 64
description: Fight against demons in your crusade to hunt down the Mother of Demons and stop Hell's invasion. As the player battle through more than 30 action-packed levels, they have to be on the lookout for enhanced weapons and secrets to help them put an end to the demonic threat.

title: Friday Night Funkin': CG5 Edition
description: You've finally made it to the big leagues of the music world, but of course there's a twist. To prove your worth, you have to beat the prolific CG5 in a battle of lyrical wits. Show him what you got!

title: My Cute Succubus
description: A simple and fun satirical visual novel with “Match3” gameplay, featuring the Christian Hell setting. Meet the Succubus and other inhabitants of Hell!

title: Italo-Doom
description: Italo-Doom is a 20-map megawad for Doom II created by Zach Stephens (Ribbiks) and Daniel Jakobsson (dannebubinga) and released in January 2016. It has a reputation for being extremely difficult, with slaughter maps and other challenges. One difficulty guide states that "each map is brutally crushing and will take a lot of grinding to beat." It's also notable for all maps being named after italo disco songs.

title: Seed World
description: A hardcore cold-weapon VR combat game like Soul, players need to defeat the bosses on each level through their own efforts and finally reach the top level to pass.

title: Great Pilots
description: Great Pilots is a fun 2D side scrolling retro airplane combat game set in WWI. Fly a wide array of historically authentic aircraft in missions that guide you through different scenarios of WWI. Earn more advanced planes as you test your skills against unique challenges!

title: Find the Key
description: A strange game with skeletons and giant aliens.

title: Naval Battle Online
description: Are you ready to conquer and plunder the seas with your fleet?

title: Mala Petaka
description: 2D Pixel Art Shooter inspired Sci-fi FPS runs on GZDoom. You play as 'Petaka', an angry amnesiac that just wants to kill every ugly green aliens and annoying drones he encounters while trying to restore his memories by exploring various universes through warp portals.

title: The Enemy Approached the Walls
description: "The Enemy Approached The Walls"is a war strategy game. You will play a commander, choose different card combinations to improve the combat effectiveness of the army, recruit and deploy soldiers in real time according to the battlefield situation, and finally repel the enemy.

title: Lamina Island
description: The legendary hero trainer Evolym has taken on a new pupil. Being cursed as a slime, she will need your assistance. It is up to you to take the promising mage Neemu from zero to hero.

title: The World of the Candy Girl
description: The World of The Candy Girl is an action game in which you are a young female shooter with super powers, and must destroy hordes of enemies to save all the candy in the world.

title: Uproot
description: Uproot is an indie point-and-click adventure and puzzle game. Help Ygg the mandrake reclaim his special purple leaf stolen by the Rat King.

title: Angry Angus
description: Angry Angus is a Bullet Heaven game, where the player and enemies are driving in cars, using momentum and turning mechanics instead of just walking unrestricted. Gather experience, gain new weapons and upgrades, and try to survive the whole 15 minutes.

title: Puzzline
description: This is a 2-4 player board game connecting cards like a puzzle! Each card has a special effect. Play them strategically and get the victory! Online play is also supported!

title: RainyCloud
description: Experimental game where you control a cloud and try to turn the floor to water. If you rank top your steam name will be shown and influence the game of all other players too.

title: Run Foxy, Run!
description: Run Foxy, Run! This is an endless runner-platformer with procedural world generation. Set free your friends from the captivity of poachers to unlock new abilities and set highscores!

title: Ease Out
description: A 5/4/3/2/1 key rhythm game with fixed key rather than tracks

title: Mining Copper
description: Place the copper smelting game, buy upgraded equipment to smelt copper plates

title: Underwater Diving
description: You are an underwater diver surrounded by aggressive fish and mines. Collect the black corals to clean the idols. USP: The diver's energy represents both his life and his stamina, but also his oxygen.

title: Infected Friend
description: Infected Friend is a 3rd person online pvp shooter. One of the players becomes infected at the beginning of the round. His goal is to infect all other players. Other players will have to hold out for 60 seconds to win the round.

title: Super Dark Deception
description: Super Dark Deception is a fun retro take on the hit horror game, Dark Deception! This is the first chapter of the game and contains the first 4 levels. All future Super Dark Deception DLC chapters are included in the price. This means that once the game is purchased, CH2 & CH3 DLC content will be installed for free upon release.

title: Escape From This Planet
description: You will travel through countless planets and encounter strange vegetation and life that may not like your presence. Run away from them and survive this unknown journey.

title: International Basketball Manager 23
description: Become the basketball manager of the moment and leave your mark by leading your own dynasty. Control all the management tools that International Basketball Manager 23 puts at your fingertips to take your team to the top. Manager, your time has come!

title: Happy Trap House
description: A fun 3D roguelike trap runner where you, as a toy zombie, must rescue your zombie friends from a house. But be warned, the house is full of deadly dangers!

title: Uprooted
description:
Uprooted is a 2D platformer that explores themes of assimilation and heritage loss common to immigrant narratives by forcing the player to sacrifice abilities in order to progress through the world.

As part of a fully POC team completely new to game development, we drew heavily from our own experiences and those of our parents to craft this game. Just as the player finds it exponentially more difficult to accomplish previously simple tasks with the loss of each ability, some of our parents, for instance, struggled with language barriers that made even setting up simple doctors appointments (or self-advocacy at them) daunting. In just ten short weeks, we set out to replicate their experience.

Join Dru as she faces the same trials, leaving everything she knows behind and sacrificing both her native tongue and abilities in order to pursue a new life elsewhere.

title: Red Rebellion
description: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

title: Spirit Mancer
description: Slash, Shoot and Break demons, Capture their spirits and summon them out into your battle in the beautiful yet dangerous world of Inferno, Fight against hordes of demons from Ars Goetia and stop the evil queen with the power of the Spirit Mancer.

title: Cluppets
description: You are trapped in an endless labirynth with mysterious evil Cluppets lurking in every corner. Use the power of your third eye to see through the unknown. Summon the spirit world and enter the reverse to harness it's energy against the darkness. Can you survive all the Cluppets and find a way out?

title: Vosphia
description: Vosphia is a singleplayer RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Encounter various enemies to fight, build your own base in the world of Vosphia, craft numerous items, and explore the vast world of Vosphia.

title: Escape From Ithara
description: A one player first person escape room-like exploration game. Discover the Ithara temple and the secrets it hides! The temple is divided into 4 rooms with unique puzzles and thematic. Will you be able to escape?

title: Paradise Tomb
description: Explore Islands and treacherous underground of Paradise Tomb in short 2D action platformer.

title: Return the Backrooms
description: Return the Backrooms is a Co-op horror game for 1-4 players where you can have a great time with your friends. Think, Explore, Wander, find the key items and try to escape. but be careful because something is lurking in the dark...

title: Idle Gem Quest
description: Idle Gem Quest: is a clicker game set in a fantasy world. Slay monsters, unlock new classes, upgrade heroes, and travel to new lands. Buy upgrades and unlock achievements to develop your team of Idle heroes.

title: Oceans
description: Adapt your Species to survive and thrive in the Oceans depths in this turn-based strategy game based on the hit board game Oceans.

title: Daemonum
description:
A Heart To Reclaim
Call for help and horror

title: Letters to Arralla
description: Deliver letters, parcels, and packages to the residents of Arralla, a small fictional island off the coast of Australia populated by big booty cutie fruits! In this relaxing RPG, you play as a mail delivery turnip covering the holiday of the previous mailman. It’s your job to get the mail where it needs to go by solving visual puzzles and exploring.

title: Two Skateboards Driving Simulator
description: The game Two Skateboards Driving is a simulator about teamwork.

title: Methods: The Canada Files
description: Methods: The Canada Files is a mystery visual novel set three years before the events of Methods. In the last few stages of the Canadian detective competition, Detective Larika Downs is determined to discover the truth at all costs!

title: Last Holiday
description: Last Holiday is set in a picturesque North Bohemian village during the holidays in year 2000, where a good little singer seeks refuge from an angry old man. You have to take care of all your needs, such as food, drink, cigarettes, beer, girls and just about everything that goes with village life.

title: The Gravehouse
description: Take on the role of a defenseless man in this survival-horror game and experience frightening evil firsthand: A trap leads you straight into a gloomy mansion where gruesome things are going on. A creepy life and death adventure begins that will take you to dark cellars, jails and even worse places..

title: Pleh!
description: Pleh! is a short psychological horror walking simulator which tells the story of a depressed game developer, his intrusive thoughts and his dark mysterious secrets.

title: Terfenstein 3D
description: Terfenstein 3D is a short retro first-person shooter game about escaping a gender-fascist concentration camp. Unleash your pent-up fury upon the gender-critical tyrants with an arsenal of deadly weapons and tactics in cathartic bliss.

title: Unluckily in Love
description: A wholesome BL VN about a young man, Yuel, struggling to come to terms with his father’s death. Seeking solace, he turns to his older cousin, Tavi, for help, and their relationship takes a surprising turn as Yuel begins to develop feelings for Tavi that are more than just familial.

title: Tears of Magic
description: Fantasy RPG where you play as a dragon in a beautiful pixel art 2.5D world with rich story, colorful characters and fluid mechanics.

title: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
description: The Magnificent Mion is a warrior queen from Wharevarland. She battles a malignant verse-making kraken, tries to win the love of Count De Loboda, studies at an ordinary magical school, and she's also... crazy! Absurdism. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.

title: Summer of '69
description: A collection of rejected and discarded maps from Sunlust

title: The Bunnyman
description: Your roommate, Tyler, decided to go camping with some friends a couple of weeks ago near Fairfax Station. He hasn't been seen in almost a month. Although you have tried to reach out and contact him, he has not responded. Fearing the worst, you decide to go and investigate to see if you can find him. Along the way, you realize that something sinister is happening behind the scenes.

title: Moonflower
description: When the source of the kingdoms magic is in danger, High Alchemist Nika Skylar has no choice but to intervene. Joined by a mysterious detective Skylar must act before the kingdom is plunged into darkness.

title: Devil's Advocate: Alexander Twist
description: Can you defeat the world's oldest mastermind in their own game? Stretch your wits and deduction skills to the maximum as you battle in Paris' craziest court. Here, only those who sacrifice everything reach the truth. What are you willing to betray to make it out alive?

title: Eternal Slumber Party
description: Eternal Slumber Party (often shortened to ESP) is a 2014 megawad for Doom II, created by TimeOfDeath and released on September 1, 2014. It is a collection of maps that TimeOfDeath had previously released as standalone PWADs, or as submissions to larger community projects. It received a sequel, Eternal Slumber Party II, in 2018.

title: WorldShards
description: WorldShards is a Sandbox-RPG with a levelless progress system. Explore the mysterious fantasy world of Murrlandia, solve its mysteries, and help its tiny inhabitants to rebuild their home!

title: A Path to the Princess
description: Find best way to fulfil your dream.. That's obviously getting the girl - or should I say "saving the princess"? Between you and your dreams, there is only simple puzzles! Beware the holes, be fast, get her!

title: Pogo Party
description: Pogo Party is a wacky multiplayer party game, all centered around a unique bouncing pogo stick mechanic and griefing your friends! Dominate them round after round by forcing all kinds of devious weaponry in their faces.

title: Arena Champion
description: "Arena Champion" is a side-scrolling 2D arena shooter with frenzied dynamics and hundreds of armed enemies.

title: Super Cave Boy
description: Super Cave Boy is a challenging platforming puzzler where advance in a dungeon full of puzzles. The game structures the dungeon in rooms / stages where you only have a limited amount of actions to do in order to finish.

title: The Good Ghouls
description: The Good Ghouls is a brawler-meets-adventure game combining beat 'em up gameplay with campy horror fun. Play and upgrade your favorite ghoul, meet quirky characters alongside a killer soundtrack, and fight a demonic robot uprising to take back the town of Ghoulcrest.

title: Me With Me
description: Control your cat and your imagination dark cat and go on an adventure to explore and save the world

title: Poly Memory: Dinosaurs
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal memory game with dinosaurs.

title: Times Dungeon
description: It is a game that appeals to everyone who wants to spend time with its simple, fast gameplay focused on action and adventure, set in a fantastic universe. It's time to go on an adventure with its side scroller and unique graphics.

title: Blocks Tracks Trains
description: A relaxing sandbox train set diorama. Build your world, create buildings, set up your track network, and watch your trains go.

title: Feathered Run: Worlds
description: Feathered Run: Worlds - This is a 4-button platformer runner for accuracy, made in 2D graphics. Embark on an exciting escape across any part of the world, for example, to Antarctica, the desert or the jungle!

title: Evil Awaits
description: Uncover the mystery of Archdale Castle when a sudden explosion exposes a new epidemic.

title: Sector Sweep
description: Choose your character from many Sector Sweepers and clean the next planets from ever-growing enemies in this top-down action roguelike shooter. Unlock new sectors by defeating enemies and upgrading your weapons or hero powers. Be the best Sector Sweeper the company ever had!

title: Load Slinging VR Training
description: Train your professional skills in Load Slinging VR Training safely and in full correspondence with international standards!

title: Ghostboy
description: Would you return from death to help your loved ones through grief? Make fate turning decisions, micromanage the family’s relationships and defeat the negative thoughts on tower defense levels. Watch out, your job will be harder the more severe their mental disorder is.

title: Labyrinth: Immortal Oblivion
description: Labyrinth: Immortal Oblivion is a singleplayer, story-driven, dante inspired, horror adventure. You'll explore a 3D Horror Maze where you'll solve puzzles and fight powerful monsters to uncover its sinister past. Escape before you too are consumed by this twisted place...

title: Skull Survivor
description: Swing your nimble weapon at hordes of enemies! Collect the souls of your fallen enemies and reinforce your skull. Exterminate thousands of Vampires, Zombies, and Demons. Choose the best build and compound your abilities to deal the most damage possible to the onslaught.

title: Synthwave Glider
description: Synthwave Glider lets you blast through an abstract world inspired by the 80s, have fun as you chase after your friends high score!

title: Dark Days: Devil Hunt
description: Fight with many demon goblin golems that invaded all over the Middle Ages Use your special powers.

title: Garden Renovator
description: Garden Renovator is an engaging simulator allowing you to take on the mantle of a professional gardener. Use various fun tools to your advantage and make your clients happy with your garden designs!

title: Total World Liberation
description: Open World Survival Automation Crafting Building Turn-Based game, yup that's a huge mix of genres and it works!

title: Taddle Quest
description: This is an adventure RPG with a focus on boss battles, defeating powerful enemies and gaining lots of equipment rewards. With different equipment to enhance yourself, challenge more powerful bosses and uncover the secrets of this fantasy world.

title: Mauri Mursu's Hangover
description: Help Mauri Mursu on his adventure on the Walrus Islands and cure his hangover!

title: Puppet Master: The Game
description:
Puppet Master: The Game is a Free to Play online multiplayer game that celebrates the series' 30 year legacy. Revisit iconic locations, Select from a large roster of playable characters from the movies.

Ever wanted to flip the standard Asymmetrical Multiplayer Horror Game formula? Where 3 heinous Puppets stalk a lone Human survivor? As a Human you must steal Andre Toulon's secrets of reanimation and escape with your life. As the Puppets must protect your Master’s secret at all cost! Sneak up on your prey and unleash a pint-sized siege of terror!

title: Relaxing Lawnmower Simulator
description: Sit back and relax while calmly mowing grass in a wide field near the ocean. Or, if you want a challenge, try to mow the residents lawn before they get annoyed at you...

title: Hyper Drill
description: Hyper Drill is a speedrunning runner game, where you fly at supersonic speed and destroy everything in your path. Drill through any obstacle, jump between different galaxies, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

title: Creepy Forest
description: Creepy Forest, a scary plot puzzle game, is full of strange things waiting for you to discover the truth on the mysterious mountain.

title: Motordoom
description: Motördoom is a freestyle-sports-shooter that combines high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and trick mechanics. Perform gnarly tricks while defeating grotesque monsters and upgrade your character with demonic offerings to become ever more powerful.

title: Dizzy Rogues
description: Dizzy Rogues is an auto-runner roguelike with "turn" based combat. Bounce your weapon off enemies and objects, rack up your combo, and purchase unique items.

title: Justice For All
description: A 2D side-scroller shooter

title: Wanderful
description: Wanderful is about forging your very own adventure by placing tiles in procedurally generated worlds, exploring what encounter might be waiting around the next corner. You decide the pace: Marvel at the beautiful landscape, be amazed by the obscure things that you might encounter on your journey or simply race to the end of the world. Are you ready for a challenge whilst besting the ultimate adventurer’s high score? How far can you venture before running out of tiles?

title: Senli 307
description: Senli 307 is a top-down shooter where you can turn, accelerate, and decelerate using only WASD (or arrow keys), and repeatedly search for and destroy enemies.

title: Drug Dealer Simulator 2
description: What turns a person into a drug dealer? A drug dealer into a drug lord? Find out in DDS2, a first-person sim set in a dynamic open world. Make contacts, cook drugs, and manage your cartel on Isla Sombra, where power is the only law.

title: Green Valley
description: Farmer ? Hunter ? Trader ? Everything is under your control in the green valley. Sow your field, feed your animals, and go hunting in the forest. Don't forget to develop your products and sell them for a much higher amount of gold!

title: Secret Agent 001
description: Welcome to another mission Mr. Agent 001. Are you ready for a new theft?

title: In & Out
description: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

title: Eve of Calamity
description: Turn-based fantasy RPG freedom. Prevent a world-ending Calamity your way.

title: Atlanta 1864
description: Refight the battle for Atlanta during the American Civil War in 1864.

title: Argonisos
description: Argonisos is an Open World Survival Crafting RPG for 1-10 players, set in a massive 617.76mi2 (1,600km2) replica map of Greece. Survive and fight countless enemies based on Greek Mythology. Explore, Fight, Gather Resources, Build your base and overcome all, to become Zeus' next Demi-god!

title: Primal Survivors
description: Throw colossals bones and big rocks in an ever growing horde of primal creatures to survive in the jungle. Choose from a variety of upgrades to create unique and game-breaking builds. Unlock a diverse cast of classes and weapons with unique powers.

title: The Exorcist's Story
description: You are in the role of a young priest Antonio, who previously had experience in the rites of exorcism, but one day everything went wrong and a girl died during the rite.The devil Asmodeus was stronger.Antonio avoided prison, but promised himself never to perform exorcisms again.

title: Lost and Found Co.
description: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

title: Dungeon Dungeon!
description: Dungeon Dungeon! is a turn-based RPG with roguelike elements and a loot system. Recruit companions, upgrade skills, collect loot and build up your team to conquer the dungeons!

title: Herogue
description: This game fused turn-based game and roguelikes. You will play the role of the team leader, and build the team's skill genre by upgrading. Experiment with different characters and upgrade options to find your winning formula!

title: Jet Dancer
description: Jet Dancer is an explosive and sexy sci-fi action platformer. Play as Jenna Delgado, a super heroine armed with rocket boots. Using flaming kicks, high-speed dashes and a flexible fighting system, destroy mechanized enemies, traverse challenging obstacles and duel Jenna's deadly, superhuman sisters!

title: Throw Wizard
description: A Roguelite, Top-Down, Action, Adventure where a Silly Little Wizard Braves the Depths of a New Dungeon! Battle Tenacious Monsters and Enemies who will not relent until the Squid Lord has his Claim on the Land!

title: Knock'Em Out
description: Fight with your whole body. If you lose an arm, it's just a scratch. If you lose the other, it's a flesh wound. If you lose your legs, headbutt them. FIGHT, FIGHT, FIGHT!

title: Moto X
description:
Revive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994.

Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders.Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage!

Compete against a friend in 2 player mode (split screen) and discover once and for all who is the best Moto X racer.

title: The Wayhaven Chronicles: Book Three
description: Your decisions will shape who is friend or foe, who will share in your secrets, and just how your romance with a certain vampire will grow!

title: Carbonflesh

description: The Helper is a fast-moving, energetic, fun and madness-packed 2D video game that allows you to play as “The Helper” (hence the name, duh!), a lad that helps The Professor by gathering Gravity Crystals for his secret experiment.

title: Station 117
description: In an undisclosed location, somewhere on the floor of the Pacific ocean, is Station 117 - a classified research facility doing totally secret work. What you discover will change everything.

title: MeiQi 2023
description: This collection is the latest collection of the MeiQi Series, which will include the S09E06 and the 10thSeason.

title: Cardlike
description: Cardlike is a roguelike game in which you build a deck and fight with cards you collect as you dive deeper into the randomly generated dungeon. You can play as three different classes, each with unique abilities and cards to discover.

title: Timmy's Adventures
description: Have you ever dreamed of fighting gangsters from the 20's? No? Me neither, really, but don't miss the opportunity to try this incredible game that takes us back to those crazy years.

title: D.H.M.

To survive the night you will need to solve puzzles and face the unseen horrors in the dark by using your wits and what little resources you can find. Will you be able to bring back order, or succumb to the chaos?

title: The Moon Hell
description: The Moon Hell is a very difficult third-person action RPG set in a fantasy mood in all game elements: sound, levels, light, atmosphere and other.
