description: Capture, train, and fuse together minions into your ultimate weapon against foes and the gym leaders of Seabrook. Become the resident Monster Expert and collect them all!

title: Small Cell
description: Play as a Small Cell that has just come to life and seeks to understand the purpose of its existence. Your objective is to help this mini-hero to discover the meaning of its life in this mini-environment.

title: The Gods Are Fickle
description: Your army of souls has been summoned by vain gods - fight for their glory or spit in their face! Embark in roguelite campaigns or fight other players. Discover new Souls & Artifacts, create quirky builds. Anticipate moves & checkmate your opponent in this tactical turn-based meets card collectable!

title: Speedonauts
description: Compete against the galaxy in this fast-paced speedrunning game. Create and share levels. Break records. Be the best.

title: Timeloop: Sink Again Beach

description: A mystical heartfelt adventure for those of all ages. Action combat, quests, and custom combos keeps your logic brain satisfied, while the atmosphere and characters spark the interest of your right brain.

title: Beam Cat
description: Beam Cat is a challenging platformer game where you charge a laser cannon to propel yourself or to slay your enemies. Climb to the top of the map to escape with your rescued brethren.

description: Are you good at math? Or do you think you need to improve your logical thinking? Tower Numbers is a game that tests your skill with numbers in a relaxed way.

title: Songs of the Chalice
description: Song of the Chalice is a simple 3D realtime strategy for a single player with tower defense mechanics, inspired by the events of the Hussite era (1419-1420).

title: Combat Beans: Total Mayhem
description: Battle online in frantic third person arena-based combat. Customize your bean with unique cosmetics and bully your buddies across multiple game modes.

title: Neolithic Dawn
description: Neolithic Dawn is an open-world primitive survival game built exclusively for VR. Play as a lineage of 10,000 BC hunter / gatherers on a journey too great for one lifetime. Fight prehistoric beasts, or tame them to aid in your survival!

description: Space Ranger: First Meet... is a short first-person shooter. In this game, you have to fight your way through hordes of robots in search of a safe place. You will use the environment to overcome obstacles and find a way out.

description: Rhythm based aiming game focused around hard electronic music. Aim the blaster with your mouse as it blasts rhythmically to the music, and aim at the falling blocks!

title: Neopunk
description: An open world cyberpunk retro RPG. Start a new life as an agender mercenary who moves to the dark and neon lit streets of Kaanalos City. Freedom awaits you in Neopunk. Solve a murder. Buy apartments. Deliver pizza. Who will you be?

title: Simantik
description: First-person action with an open world, steampunk and RPG elements, many types of weapons, both firearms and cold weapons, as well as steam or electric ones to confront hordes of enemies.

title: Salvation of the soul
description: Salvation of the soul is a first person game. You need to perform a ritual to save the soul of the girl, while not being killed.

description: The only roguelite where you must pet animals to survive. Each animal comes with its own unique weapons and passive abilities. Pet animals, mixing and matching abilities to create unique skill builds and conquer the Beyond.

description: A mega X Touhou fangame with no X again.

description: New Citizen is a modern-themed roleplay adventure game set in the vast open world of the USA. The game focuses mainly on the player, creating an environment that feels alive and that is constantly moving.

description: The Horde is coming, but you're ready to fight it! Arm your team to your liking and discover which synergies work best against thousands of the undead. Survive, evolve, and break the limits in this casual yet heart-pumping rogue-lite reverse bullet hell.

description: Metro Manager LA is a strategy simulation game about connecting communities throughout Los Angeles. Manage maintenance, security, wait time, and train capacity as you attempt to keep the riders of Los Angeles happy.

description: Beyond Myths is a Metroidvania, where the player traverses a futuristic Chinatown split between dimensions with high mobility and difficult combat encounters.

description: Embark on an adventure inspired by popular Fantasy Action RPGs. Travel to different realms fighting monsters and gaining new abilities as you seek to bring back peace to the Luminous Realms.

description: In this interactive tale of love and war, carve a place for yourself in a world that has disregarded you for too long. Be the force of reason that your kingdom needs, or perpetuate its reputation as a force of destruction. Find love and weave friendships, or cast it away for the sake of retribution.

A journey through a vibrant alien world filled with unique box-pushing puzzles.

This bishojo game released in 2020 from the brand "Calcite" has been remade for the "CS Novel Club" platform so that it can be enjoyed by people of various ages around the world.

Asha Edition is a short version that includes a story focusing on "Asha," the healing rabbit tribe.

title: Mischief Dungeon Life: Isekai Tensei shita Ore no Itazura Dungeon Life - Kuraara Edition
description:
“Mischief Dungeon Life" is an isekai fantasy novel game in which Renji is reborn in another world as a demon. He encounters various heroines while playing a big role in the fates of both the Demon Clan and the Human Tribe.
This bishojo game released in 2020 from the brand "Calcite" has been remade for the "CS Novel Club" platform so that it can be enjoyed by people of various ages around the world.

Clara. The "Clara version" is a short version that includes a story focusing on "Clara," the female heroine of the Elven tribe.

title: Mischief Dungeon Life: Isekai Tensei shita Ore no Itazura Dungeon Life - Janice Edition
description:
“Mischief Dungeon Life" is an isekai fantasy novel game in which Renji is reborn in another world as a demon. He encounters various heroines while playing a big role in the fates of both the Demon Clan and the Human Tribe.
This bishojo game released in 2020 from the brand "Calcite" has been remade for the "CS Novel Club" platform so that it can be enjoyed by people of various ages around the world.

Janice Edition is a short version that includes a story focusing on "Janice," a dragoness who hates the occult.

title: Bubbles Swimsuit
description: Play the classic bubble pop game, match 3 colors until clean the levels. In reward for solving the puzzles you can discover new girls in an adventure pixelated.

title: Bride Corruption
description: Do you need a wedding planner, by any chase? "Weddings & Co." will organise your wedding, take care of everything you need, and as a bonus - corrupt the bride!

title: Rugby Union Team Manager 4
description: The fourth instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby Union Management Game”. Rugby Union Team Manager 4 gives you full control of managing your own Rugby Union team. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors, facilities and more.

title: Run Run Boy
description: Run Run Boy game is a casual game based on the idea to run as fast as possible and so that no one can catch you.

title: Santa's Gifts
description: Ho, ho, ho! It feels better that the winter holidays are approaching. Have you been dutiful this year? Are you ready to help Santa? Clear his way so that he can make all children happy this year too, besides, what else is magic for? It's not so hard, just put your brain on and help Santa! Merry Christmas everyone!

title: Savage: Ultimate Boss Fight
description: Savage is a single-player action game that allows players to experience MMORPG-style battles. Many bosses are included this game. Unravel the gimmicks hidden in the attacks, find a strategy, and try to clear the stage.

title: SD Gundam G Generation Cross Rays: Added Dispatch Mission Set 3
description: The Added Dispatch Mission Set ③ DLC package contains four Dispatch Missions.

title: SD Gundam G Generation Cross Rays: Added Dispatch Mission Set 4
description: The Added Dispatch Mission Set ④ DLC package contains four Dispatch Missions.

title: Seductive Solitude
description: Seductive Solitude is a horror adventure game. Where you need to escape from the house by solving the mysterys, but do not be too insightful, because you are not alone and the house is changing.

title: Shadow Empire: Oceania
description: The new maps being generated with Oceania DLC change the feel and ambiance of the game completely. But it also changes the gameplay a lot and will make you experience a different style of game.

title: Sitri: Shadow Walk
description: As an agent of the Demon Lord's army who has infiltrated human society, you must seize the Holy Sword and carry out your mission.

title: Slugmania
description: Worldeater Slug is threatening the world and the only way to beat it is to gather and train a team of diverse, friendly slugs! Slugmania is a cute, fast-paced, creature-collection roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Slippery Richard!: He's Taller Than My Husband
description: An unplanned shotgun wedding! This isn’t the first time Yaya has made a mess of things and expected her mother to clean up... “When you truly love someone, you plan ahead—marriage is supposed to come before all that other stuff! Now I guess it’s up to me to test if he’s really husband material...”

title: Super Planet Life
description: Being a planet in space can be very lonely, but fortunately there is life out there. Search the corners of the universe for new friends, who will help you on your quest to become a happy little place to live. Manage your resources, upgrade tools, and fight through jerk-infested dungeons to advance.

title: Tales of Agaris: The Legendary Rion
description: An Action RPG game with a LINEAR REAL TIME battlle system made on RPG Maker MV.

title: Tales of Spark
description: "Tales of Spark" is a Hack & Slash Action RPG with an Eastern flair. Players assume the role of a young wandering swordsman, exploring the vast desert, seeking treasures, defeating powerful bosses, and even slaying gigantic celestial dragons.

title: The Adventures of Snacky
description: The Adventures of Snacky is a cute and fun platform jumper. You as snacky the vending machine must run jump and shoot your way through this new and hostile world, avoiding obstacles Emery's finding checkpoints and coins.

title: Unboxing
description: An idle game about unboxing and selling items! Optimize and automize your work with drones and relax watching them work while you manage and upgrade new contracts!

title: Train World
description: Train World is a railroad simulator that allows you to design, manage and operate your own railway network. Start at the dawn of railroad technology and evolve into a modern railroad company. Deliver cargo and transport passengers, open new regions and expand your network.

title: Touhou: Red Empress Devil
description:
Touhou: Red Empress Devil is a bullet-hell shooting roguelike action game.
Set in The Scarlet Devil Mansion, the inhabitants of Gensoukyou go on a rampage!

title: Tkium Underground
description: Tkium Underground is a short horror escape game taking place in an unknown tunnels facility. Activate generators, levers, and find a specific object to unlock the exit door, then find it. You were not the first one to be in this situation, but will you be the first one to escape alive?

title: Togum
description: Priscilla was enjoying the holiday eve at her house, however, her friend Nara discovers a series of codes and hidden messages inside an abandoned house. Could these codes be related to the strange lights that have appeared in the middle of the sea? Based on a true story...

title: Cats Kill Zombies
description: In this fast-paced action roguelike, mutant cats hidden from the world for years find that life outside is so cool, they don’t want to go back home. For that, you'll have to fight through and conquer the heart of the zombie-infested County of Ravinbrook. It's the only way to Catland.

title: The Secret Pyramid
description: A VR shooting game with Roguelite elements on the theme of ancient Egyptian tomb exploration.

title: The Lord of the Parties: AmamaNia
description: “AmamaNia”, a hard working game Vtuber who likes singing, watching plays, and chit chatting has joined The Lord of the Parties!

title: The Lord of the Parties: Byakko Akine
description: “Byakko Akine”, the energetic Vtuber that loves FPS games and energy drinks has joined The Lord of the Parties!

title: Eternal Mist
description:
Eternal Mist is a game that involves real-time tactics where you will be in charge of commanding different types of squads including paladins, hunters, and mages. Each squad possesses unique skills that can be improved as you progress in the game.

Elements such as bonfires, cauldrons, and other objects on the battlefield have an impact on the abilities of your warriors. Placing your units near these objects can provide a significant tactical advantage.

The Mist is a source from which hordes of creatures emerge. These formidable beings represent a relentless force that poses a significant threat to all who cross their path. Their agility and speed allow them to swiftly traverse the terrain, making them a daunting challenge to overcome. Only a skilled commander can give confident and well-thought-out orders to inspire their soldiers and guide them towards victory.

title: The Extraterrestrials Museum of Earth Exploration
description: The alien lifeforms welcome you to The Extraterrestrial Museum of Earth Exploration! Get lost in the exhibits, meet new friends and take up a job at the museum to help these aliens learn about Earth from a real-life Earthling!

title: Super Woden GP 2
description: Super Woden GP 2 is a love letter to the world of motor sports, offering a unique experience. Arcade-style isometric racing meets unrivaled campaign depth and a huge variety of vehicles to buy, sell and unlock.

title: Meat II: Absolute Zero
description: Brutal boomer shooter FPS inspired by genre classics. Tear apart mutants, fight powerful bosses, and conquer the hell created by the MBSXII Sect in a dark world full of gore and chaos.

title: Follow the Crown
description: Join a thrilling adventure with an Ambassador of the United States & a Hungarian Crown Guard to keep the Hungarian Holy Crown from Nazis and return it to Hungary during the Cold War. You can't trust anyone on this journey; only your wits.

title: Memory Puzzle: Mile High Fun
description: Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sexual adventures of a Futanari flight attendant and her 2 passengers on a private jet, in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match.

title: Cyber Dungeon: Excalibur
description: Cyber Dungeon: Excalibur, brings fun and an action-adventure experience with frantic combat, hail of bullets and robots. Can you stay alive until the end?

title: Strength & Virtue: Lord of Midchester
description: Take on the monumental task of managing a small town caught between two powerful city-states in this 2.5D RPG! Rebuild your township, explore dungeons, hire underlings, grow your town's prosperity and catch the attention of powerful potential allies or foes... you decide!

title: Platonically Mauled by a Magic Cougar
description: As nuts as Jun is about his wife, he can’t help but drool over Towaka Minefuji. So when Jun is asked to attend his wife’s school committee meetings in her place, his brain goes into overdrive at the thought of him and Towaka being in the same room together...

title: Stunts Contest Monster Car
description: Stunts Contest : Monster Car presents a funny racing game that involves adrenaline and courage. In this game you will perform all kinds of stunts (jumps, 360 degree turns, avoidance of obstacles when car rush).

title: Maboroshi Caravan
description: maboroshi caravan is an abandonment and simulation game in which you watch over a caravan traveling through the desert. Many are represented by small, abstract pixel arts. Set out on a journey through a vast desert with diverse expressions with companions. The game is played with mouse and keyboard.

title: Road to Devadatta
description: Road to Devadatta is a first person adventure game focused on story and puzzle solving in order to progress. Explore an ancient temple find out why you are there! Use your wits and skills to escape from him! But be careful because you are not alone!

title: Dark Corridors
description: Explore, survive and report! A horror-based exploration game. Experience a story of betrayal, hate, and human rights violations as Jake Swanson. Bring the truth to the public.

title: Twin Jet Racer
description: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

title: Main Event: Wrestling Manager
description: Main Event: Wrestling Manager is a wrestling booking simulator where you will hire and develop talent and staff, book matches, handle logistics and the media and much more in order to build your promotion into the best wrestling empire that has ever existed.

title: Loser's Romance
description: The no social skills dating sim.

title: Pricia Defense
description: One day, the North Fortress of the kingdom Enerf is invaded by northern sorcerers. The princess of the kingdom Enerf, "Pricia", with "trap magic" in her hands, which is only available to the royal family of Enerf, stands up.

title: Grotesque Realm
description: Grotesque Realm is a Scary, Creepy. Horror, Survival team work game Many unknown grotesque creatures are waiting you in dark! Play if you are brave enough!

title: Margaritari
description: "Margaritari", a JRPG-style narrative game. Consisting of 9 chapters, the story begins with the encounter of two 17-year-old girls. Help the protagonist discover the secret of humanity and love, and that will be the redemption for both herself and her love.

title: Magic Bubbles
description: Match 5 or more bubbles of different colors and types by relocating them on an 81 squares board. Game mechanics change as you advance to next levels so the tactics you've learned in the past must be adapted for the future.

title: Lie of Caelum
description: Giant robots. Technology abusing magic. Conflict between countries. Join a group of fated individuals and liberate the planet of Caelum from the shackles of its people. Discover the mysteries behind their powers, and dwell in their lives in this Sci-fi JRPG.

title: RealFlight Evolution
description: RealFlight is the industry-leading flight simulator for radio-controlled airplanes, helicopters, and drones. Fly more than 300 hyper-realistic vehicles in an immense, open world right from your desktop. This RC classic is a must-have tool for flight enthusiasts of all skill levels!

title: Gum Ball Run
description: Gum Ball Run is a free to play fast paced 3D platformer with online multiplayer where Gum Balls race against each other through procedurally generated obstacle courses to become the #1 Gum Ball in the Gummieverse!

title: DobbyxEscape: Halloween Adventure
description: A fun Halloween inspired Room Escape game!

title: Queen Beast
description:
Humble miller Otto's quiet days are thrown into chaos when he emerges from his bed one morning to discover his sister Bronwyn has been kidnapped!

The person responsible is a mysterious knight in dark armor; the only clue he left behind is a bag of gold coins bearing the profile of an unknown woman.

Joining forces with the beautiful and enigmatic adventurer Switch, and the mischievous fairy Echo, our hero sets out on a journey through the forgotten places of his native land in search of the dark knight and the sinister forces that power him. But on his way, Otto will discover much more than he anticipated in this story of romance, non-stop action and adventure!

title: Murder Next Room
description: Murder Next Room is a multiplayer role-playing game. You are trapped in a location with others and one or more of them are killers. The police has been called and in the mean time try to survive. You can try to report the killer but there is no guarantee that the phones will be working.

title: Pressure Within
description: A post-apocalyptic third-person shooting game that reminds you of the true horrors of the apocalypse. Where do I use the bathroom? Rid the streets and suburbs of zombies and other monstrosities while you solve awful riddles.

title: Princess Dating Sim
description: Princess Dating Sim is an non-linear visual novel where you court multiple princesses at the same time. You'll need to woo them, and see what their tastes are before you can pick a partner to marry! But don't worry, there are no wrong answers here!

title: Jewel Match Twilight 2
description: Make your blood run cold... with this spooky match-3 adventure! A scourge has taken over the kingdom and destroyed its strongholds. Traverse a dark land full of haunted horrors! Keep evil at bay in 90 enormous levels designed to delight and fill you with fright.

title: Robbie
description: Robbie it's a hardcore platformer 2D that will challenge your puzzle-solving skills and patience

title: Graveyard Architect
description: Can you manage to create an ideal cemetery? Will you provide appropriate conditions for its residents? Be careful! If you do not meet all the requirements, you will have to deal with the rebellious undead.

title: Murder on the Stella
description: It's a murder mystery. It's an adventure. It's a cruise vacation simulator. It's different each time you play.

title: Dark Sweeper
description: Dark Sweeper - a shooter about a soldier, which takes place in the wastelands filled with various creatures and marauders. You are a young corporal sent to a military operation, your task is to defeat the enemies.

title: Robotization: A Last Human
description: Robotization: A Last Human - a first person survival horror. Be afraid of unknown creatures that may be waiting for you. Survive in this scary world, where you are alone...

title: Creeping Deck: Pharaoh's Curse
description: Creeping Deck is a strategic roguelite deck-builder with RPG elements. Build and refine your deck as you progress through each dungeon, facing off against bosses and enemies. Upgrade, and unlock new skills, options, and artifacts to protect all of Egypt!

title: Life Eternal
description: A necromancer awakens in a dilapidated tower he once knew as a pristine stronghold for his lord and sorcerer that he was apprenticed under. Somehow, the necromancer slept through it all in a sleep so sound, not even his lord's death woke him up. But that's all right; his lord had foreseen this coming and made sure the necromancer had the knowledge and training so he could raise his dead lord all on his own.

title: A Happy Valentine
description: A side story that takes place after 40 Days and 40 Nights of Rain. It's a special day, and Kyrie is trying to celebrate this special day for Yuu.

title: A Heart of Butterblue
description: It is under these circumstances that Phebe finds herself moving to the isolated frontier town of Edgeville. Rumors have it that monsters roam the lands after dark and anyone caught outside is never heard from again. With eerie murderous howling heard every night, Phebe has no choice to become accustomed to this new life if she wants to find her missing grandfather.

title: Ziva and the Wolves
description:
Ziva is dying. There is no cure.
Two men are looking for a sword that would save the realm. But to wield it would kill them.
This group of three ventures deep into the depths of the Goddess' temple, to find...?

title: The Sun Atop a Column
description: A short KN about belonging, set in a world where there is no sun.

title: Cave Story Encore
description:
Experience art style and gameplay of classic indie game Cave Story in brand new upscaled environment.

Cave Story Encore is a fan remake of the hit indie
action-explore game Cave Story by Daisuke 'Pixel' Amaya and Nicalis.

This project is a labour of love lead by Dr. Minty Fresh,
with others helping with art, music and story.
The goal of this project is to give our old beloved game a new coat of paint and fun new additions while maintaining the feel of the original.

title: Lisarune
description: Play as Spamton and struggle through the post-apocalyptic world of LOWER OLATHE, a cavernous expanse filled with combat and exploration.

title: The Girl With the Gray Hair Awakens
description: "A girl wakes up in a strange room, unsure of who she is... Play multiple times to uncover the full story!"

title: Liars Maze
description: "All I need is this spell of my own making, one more time, one more time, one more time..."

title: Touch Theory
description:
Oh, I'm crying now, authentic tears,
They flow out of me when I think about you,
Cause you're the only person in the world who'd understand,
Cause you're the only person in the world who'd understand the meaning of this!

title: Yarrow Valley
description: "What kind of flower will we find today?"

title: Solanaceae: Another Time
description: When Sal, a satyr, bumps into someone with his bike, flashes of a past life sparkle before his eyes. Funnily enough, the person he rams into, Battam, is a witch who suddenly exclaims they are reincarnated lovers from over one hundred years ago! Sal leaves in disbelief, but once he starts having prophetic dreams that night, he finds himself wondering more about the mysterious witch. Join Sal as he discovers whether or not Battam is telling the truth!

title: The Far Rings
description: Play as Athena, a doctor of mixed heritage torn between two worlds, as she tries to find her true home alongside two possible suitors!

title: Beyond the Deep
description: Discover what lies outside your world!

title: The Life Threads
description: A teacher and his bodyguard on a journey across the desert sands, what sort of fate awaits them?

title: Elvine
description: Fleeing from a deadly attack on their village, Elvine, her father and a dragonkin soldier named Lukas must flee to an abandoned castle in the woods. There they await the news of what happened to the rest of their village while Elvine herself might find something else hidden among the walls of the castle...

title: Cupid Date
description: A short visual novel about three and a half "love stories" starring a gay alien boy named Kale, whose matchmaking roommate Sugar is determined to help him find true love. But when Sugar's a cupid with his own agenda and all K

title: A Werewolf Opportunity, Obviously
description: On the heels of his best friend getting married and tired of letting all his relationships fizzle out before they even get started, 20-something Eddie decides he's going to find a boyfriend and give it his all in a serious relationship! But in a town where magic is lurking just below the surface, can Eddie make it work — or will the more human side of life hold him back again?

title: Love and Formaldehyde
description:
Nineteen year old Prince is terrible at telling almost anyone how he feels, and even worse at showing it. Without the ability to let his emotions show on his face, he's always had a hard time making friends — even in the mortuary program at a welcoming technical college, Prince only spends time with roommate Daniel while nursing a distant crush on classmate Aodh.

When their professor assigns them to do a temporary internship together at a local funeral home in the two weeks leading up to Valentine's Day, will Prince finally have the chance to confess his feelings?

Or will life — and death — get in the way?

title: Late Night Talks
description: A short, late-night conversation with an exorcist. Who's also your boss.

title: Gospel of Eve
description: An exorcist that doesn't believe in ghost. A drop-out that's lost about his path in life. The duo's adventure continues in this sequel to Silver Thread as they investigate an allegedly haunted church!

title: Café Bouvardie
description:
Basically, the human body has an in-built limit to how many times it can be forced to move across the timeline. It is a hard limit; it can't be known, and it most certainly can't be changed.

Its value is different in any given individual, and - although many have theorized - nobody knows whether it depends on genes, luck, physical health, spiritual inclination or pure happenstance.
It happens to every Time Agent sooner or later... even you.

title: Run Away With Me, Empress!
description:
Enrolled in a super-exclusive school full of beauties, take advantage of your luck.

You've been scouted to attend the most prestigious, exclusive school of the nation, surrounded by girls at least as beautiful as you (and you're pretty good-looking). Years of hard work have finally paid off.

You and your peers are to be "shaped up to accompany the elite of society". You've been told you'll get assigned an Emperor's Title at one point, but most of your breathtakingly beautiful classmates already have one. In the meanwhile, maybe you can get closer to one of them...?

title: The Citizen Kane of Video Games
description: Memories at once real and imagined! Experience Citizen Kane as never before! From the palatial Xanadu to the deathbed of Charles Foster Kane! Be amazed by a spectacle of sight and sound. Play through Every Single Shot of The Classic Movie! (for 5 minutes) At long last! The Citizen Kane of Video Games!!

title: Hitme 2
description:
A new chapter in the story of HITME.

In the first chapter, Astra & Dei taught me to love. Now, a new boy has fallen onto an orange tree. His sadness reminds me of mine. Will I know how to teach others what I learned from Astra & Dei?

title: A Bark in the Dark
description: Bring on your point and clicking skills as it's time for a brand new homemade BONTE game: A bark in the dark!

title: Loose the Moose
description: Loose the moose and escape the room!

title: JoJo's Diner
description: Finding home in space is a tricky thing.

title: Love is in Bloom
description:
When Heather's mother invites herself for dinner, she expects to meet her daughter and her girlfriend.
Wait, girlfriend? Heather has no girlfriend! She has two days to find herself someone who poses as her girlfriend for that dinner...

title: Friday Night Funkin': VS Spider-Man - Volume II
description:
Fight against the one and only Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man in the new FNF mod "Vs. Spider-Man".

But that's not all, fight against a guy who leaks your IP address (Mysterio).

A symbiote who's fallen from space and took captive of an innocent human (Venom).

Now with v2, fight along with Spider-man to defeat his greatest enemies such as Doctor Otto Octavious, A man who fell into a pool of eels! (Electro) and last but not least, the man Spider-man hates the most.. the one and only Norman Osborn aka Green Goblin.

title: Undercover: Blood Bonds
description: Help Vera find her missing sister as strange things emerge as night falls!

title: Up All Night: Rumination
description:
Years after the events of Up All Night, Nick Torres remains haunted by the ghosts of his past. Seeking help, or at least solace, he reaches out to licensed therapist Patricia Rathburn for guidance.

Much to her dismay, Nick's presence proves a harrowing reminder of Patricia's own inner demons... but can she see past her clouded judgement to help this troubled young man?

Unfortunately, therapy can't fix everything.

title: Red Riding Hood
description:
With Red’s Mother falling ill, it’s left to Red and her friend Alex to collect medicine from her Grandmother on the other side of the forest.

Through the time spent together, it’s made clear there’s some underlying tension between the two of them. Playing as Red, your choices will affect whether or not you can resolve this issue.

A retelling of a classic fairy tale.

title: Just Kiss Him Already!
description: "Just Kiss Him Already!" is a fluffy high school boys love story about two idiots who need a gentle push in the right direction to get together — and you're here to help with that!

title: Sherbert In A Bottle
description: "Sherbert In A Bottle" is a short visual novel about wrestling with decisions relating to one's life path, and the positive impact online friends can have on a person.

title: Little Red Riding Hood B
description: The classic children's story, as a top-down rpg-style game. It is a simple game, but has two different endings. Use the arrow keys to play.

title: Little Red Riding Hood A
description: The classic children's story, as an interactive point and click game with gorgeous artwork. It is a simple game, but has two different endings.

title: Geunyeoga Dasi Noraehal Ttaekkaji
description: My friend has become a girl after I came back from army? Visual novel with TS heroine.

title: Desktop Soccer 2
description: Turn your desk into a soccer field! Divvy up the Joy-Con and play with up to 4 players! You won't be able to put down this easy-to-play game!

title: Metal Gear Solid 2: The Substance of Subsistence
description: "Metal Gear Solid 2: The Substance of Subsistence" is mod for "Metal Gear Solid 2: Substance" that adds the third person camera view and game controls from "Metal Gear Solid 3: Subsistence".

title: Dead Cells: Everyone is Here Vol. 2
description: Introducing 6 new famous character (Shovel Knight, Hotline Miami, Katana Zero, Risk of Rain 2, Terraria & Slay the Spire) in this new cross over update. 6 new Outfits and Weapons based on 6 indie games crossovers!

title: Dream Escaper
description:
Dream Escaper is a non-traditional Yume Nikki fangame centered around exploration. This game has a unique feature in which players can warp to different worlds (known as "layers" in-game). It features various chasers among these layers that will send the player to a game over sequence when caught. The game also includes the ability to talk to most NPCs and save from the menu.

The goal of the game is to explore, collect Items which will grant the player new abilities and achieve one of the game's three endings. As the game goes on, players can unlock various features from the title screen including a minigame, a music player and a Memories section which logs certain accomplishments the player has fulfilled.

title: Kyukkyu-kun Game
description: Kyukkyu-kun Game is a Yume Nikki-themed dodging game.

title: Memories of Replica
description: Memories of Replica is a metroidvania Yume Nikki fangame. It is a sequel to Houchou Shoujo Gensoukyoku, although it is different in both art style and gameplay. The game borrows characters and dream worlds from the original Yume Nikki while giving them actions and positions different to their original counterparts. You play as Poniko who wields scythe as her main weapon.

title: Yume Nikki Smash Dream
description: Yume Nikki Smash Dream is a Yume Nikki-inspired fighting game. You have a choice of three characters: Madotsuki, Poniko and Seccom Masada-Sensei.

title: Yume Nikki Tetris Minigame
description: Yume Nikki Tetris Minigame is a Yume Nikki-inspired fan version of Tetris. It plays just like Tetris, but instead of blocks you play with Yume Nikki effect eggs.

title: Sword Art Online: Last Recollection
description:
Based on Sword Art Online’s War of Underworld anime arc, a new story unfolds with tough challenges that await our beloved hero, Kirito, and his new friends. Players will unmask the Dark Knight and find out if Kirito and the crew will survive the relentless battling against the forces of the Dark Territory!

It’s the perfect game to introduce during SAO’s 10th Anniversary, when everyone can reminisce about their favorite SAO memories while meeting their favorite character again.

The newest installment of the SWORD ART ONLINE video game series comes to next-gen consoles with a cast featuring characters from previous SAO anime.

SWORD ART ONLINE Last Recollection boasts a brand new, original storyline that explores what would have happened if Kirito, Eugeo, and their allies didn’t meet their tragic end in The War of the Underworld.

Experience an exciting and elevated battle system with your friends against familiar foes from the Sword Art Online series!

title: Alice fell to Neverland
description:
Caroline and Lewis are two 14 year-old students at St. Mary's Boarding School, who have fallen into a deep hole in the middle of the forest. With no way to climb out, the only clue they have to return is a strange white rabbit.

Finish puzzles, find your way home and learn the truth behind the dark place you've stumbled upon.

Are you the one destined to fulfill the role of Alice?

title: IW4x
description: A modded PC client for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009). It adds support for dedicated servers, custom maps, and weapons.

title: Yume Nikki Hazard
description: Yume Nikki Hazard is an Yume Nikki mod. In it, the game basically follows the rule of the original gameplay - you play as Madotsuki to search for the effects in her dream world, except now she will have guns as her weapons, and some of the NPCs in the dream world are now dangerous enemies. Madotsuki can now receive health damage in the dream world and be forced to wake up if she's defeated. Players earn money and 3 kinds of medals: Gold, Silver and Copper, by killing the enemies in a single map or triggering the events.

title: Melodia
description: Melodia is a Yume Nikki fangame. As the title suggests, has a major musical motif. The objective is to collect Melodies throughout the dream world, accessed through falling asleep in front of the TV. Collecting Melodies causes more doors to appear at the Nexus.

title: Single Line
description: Single Line is a Chinese Yume Nikki fangame.

title: My Favorite
description: My Favorite is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Kanariya, a young girl in a birdcage. The goal is to explore, collect effects and items to try and find out Kanariya's past. The game has multiple alternate endings depending on the locations visited, items collected and other values

title: Connected Dreams
description: Connected Dreams is a Yume Nikki fangame, starring two girls named Nika and Mota. The goal is to explore and find items. One unique feature of this game is a collectible CD compartment that allows the player to assign the effects of their choices to the 1, 2, 3 or 4 hotkeys, allowing for quick effect equipping. The game also includes a combat system.

title: Pippi
description:
Pippi Longstocking is a well-known fictional character in northern Europa. She is a little girl that never grows up and lives with no adults in Villa Villekulla, an abandoned house, with a horse (with no name) and a monkey, Mr. Nilsson. She says her mother is in heaven and her father is king of a pacific island. But who really knows ? The original stories, written by Astrid Lindgren since 1945, were adapted into films and television series. Here, is a computerized version where children will discover her little world. First, they'll have to enter Villa Villekulla, by the door, of course.

Players will explore the rooms in the Villa (hall, kitchen, bureau, bedroom, and attic) and solve different types of puzzles (i.e. jigsaw, memory). There's also a book activity where children can choose among three books and start these stories with screen texts that can be turned on or off. Texts are available in twelve (say, eleven because of British/American english) different languages.

title: Cannon World: Target
description: Casual puzzle shooting

title: Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare - Digital Legacy Edition
description:
The Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare - Digital Legacy Edition includes Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

It also includes the Terminal Bonus Map and Zombies in Spaceland Pack.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown – XFA-27 Set
description: A carrier-based stealth fighter designed for ultimate performance. Its variable sweptback wings, canards, and unique wing construction featuring four tail wings grant it overwhelmingly superior mobility, making it a powerful force in any battle.

title: Be my sword!
description:
An action RPG where you challenge barriers by making full use of sacred tools
"Be my sword!" has been translated into English. At first, the hero can only attack with a sword. If you take an item in the Yashiro, various actions are possible. Tactics vary depending on the combination of items. Aim to clear levels with your own strategies.

title: Rocksuki: The Rescue of Ember!
description: A fan game made for the live streamer Selen Tatsuki of Nijisanji EN.

title: Clea: Complete Collection
description:
Clea is a jump scare free, skill-based survival horror adventure.

Mum and Dad have been experimenting on Chaos Servants, but now, the monsters have been let loose. Clea, with her brother in tow, must escape from the Whitlock Mansion.

title: Bounce Paradise
description: Choose your own story as you take over a beach resort, of course it's not all fun and games but at least the park is filled with an array of beautiful women to distract you. Your choices will determine the story and whether romance is in the air and how your beach visit will end.

title: Signal & Echo: Iris is Missing
description:
A point-and-click mystery adventure with innovative detective mechanics.
Help Ollie, a fledgling journalist on his first day at the Signal & Echo newspaper, to find out what happened to missing schoolgirl Iris Wood.

title: Mea Culpa
description: MEA CULPA is a Yume Nikki fan game, that follows a non-traditional format. You play as a young man, Isaiah who enters a dream-like state after listening to an old music box.

title: Yume Mienai: Pocket Version
description:
Yume Mienai is a GameBoy-style Yume Nikki Fangame made by Annie-Mienai in RPG Maker VX Ace in 2019. The first version was made for Dream Diary Jam 3.

Like Yume Nikki, you can sleep, explore, and get effects, but with the difference that there are RPG-style battles and dialogues.

title: Botany Manor
description: Welcome to Botany Manor, a stately home in 19th century England. You play as its inhabitant Arabella Greene, a retired botanist. Explore your house and gardens, filled with botanical research, to figure out the ideal habitat for a collection of forgotten flora. Grow each plant to discover the mysterious qualities they hold…

title: REM
description:
REM is an atmospheric dream exploration game. Explore surreal spaces and architecture. Collect all of the dream seeds and plant them.

Every dream remembers the last one, and every dream is shaped by the garden you tend when you're awake.

title: Mild Dream
description: Mild Dream is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2. One differing feature is that there are two different types of effects: Normal and Lucid. In order to use Lucid effects, the player must enter a state of lucidity by interacting with one of the various bees found within the dream world.

title: Shards
description: A game for the Dream Diary Jam 2018. An ordinary girl wakes up in a strange place and goes searching for shards of a portal to get home.

title: PowerPutt Legend
description: PowerPutt Legend is a unique minigolf game with RPG elements, meant to look and feel like it's straight out of the NES. Slay monsters, level up, and unlock a series of items to improve your strategy.

title: Oblivion
description: Oblivion is a short, story-driven first-person horror game. Uncover the truth hidden within an abandoned school — but beware, some memories were never meant to return.

title: Madotsuki's Story: Retrograde
description: Madotsuki's Story: Retrograde is a sidescrolling platform fangame based on Yume Nikki. Alongside enemies and obstacles, there are Relics that can be collected, which can be used to unlock other stages.

title: Strange Diary
description: Strange Diary is a Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2.

title: Nasu Pinball
description: Nasu Pinball is a Yume Nikki fangame. As the name suggests, this is a pinball-style game with a Nasu theme. Your goal is get as high of a score as possible.

title: Super Nasu Bros
description: Super Nasu Bros is a Super Mario Bros-inspired Yume Nikki fangame. You gain points by collecting eggplants and jumping on famicom demons.

title: PuPu's Adventure Park
description: Build an Adventure Park from the ground up! The PuPu clan had just rented a new "playground" from the Dark Goblins. Manage the park, construct park facilities, and grow your clan to serve the expansion of the Park for "hero" customers summoned from other planets!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II - Season 01
description: Get Ready for a New Era — Season 01 Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 will deliver action on all fronts: the next iteration of the massive free-to-play Battle Royale experience featuring the much-anticipated DMZ mode, reimagined maps in Multiplayer, and an additional Special Ops mission prior to the first Raid Episode. There will be plenty of content across both games through all-new Battle Pass, football-themed event, and more.

title: Rhygar e os Soldados do Rei
description:
Rhygar is a farmer who lives with his father on their ranch. One day, he needs to sell their cow, only to watch his father being murdered by monsters on the way back home. Now, begins his journey to become a Knight of the King in order to get revenge on the monsters who killed his father.

Rhygar e os Soldados do Rei (Rhygar and the Knights of the King) is one of many free indie brazilian games created using RPG Maker 2000 during the boom of the engine in Brazil in the 2000s. Like others of its kind, it's very unpretentious and full of typos and goofy jokes. It became somewhat of a forgotten classic among brazilian gamers of that era, and its relative success helped the aforementioned boom of other small RPG Maker 2000 brazilian games, including two lesser known sequels.

title: These Trees Are Spectral Fingers
description: Your car has broken down in the middle of nowhere. Surrounded by age-old trees, you walk down the road in search of help,… with no idea of what lurks in these old forests.

title: Super Ninja Miner
description: He slices! He dices! He... mines? Tag along with this crazy ninja on a treasure-filled adventure.

title: Hana to Otome ni Shukufuku wo
description:
The protagonist Tsukioka Akira is a normal guy living his usual life, except for one thing. His twin sister is sickly and is in the hospital and can’t go to school. Problem is that she’s been sick for too long and she may have to repeat the year, or worse drop out of school.

So their parents being the most clever people in the world, decided to send him, the splitting image of his sister, over to the all-girls prestigious school to go undercover as his sister, and live her life for a while so that when she comes back, she can take his place without dropping out of school or repeating. Of course it’s a stupid idea and he resisted, but him, being someone who is easily swept away, gave in.

So thereon starts his incredible life in an all girls school.

title: My Hero One's Justice 2: Villainous Wear Set
description: Players will be able to use Villainous Wear outfits for the following 9 characters: Tomura Shigaraki Before Style, Tomura Shigaraki, Dabi, Himiko Toga, Twice, Mr. Compress, Muscular, Kai Chisaki, and Kendo Rappa. This pack also includes 10 color variations for each outfit.

title: WRC Generations: Fully Loaded Edition
description: Get the most complete WRC Generations experience with the Fully Loaded Edition!

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Slitherlink
description: In this - one of Nikoli's most awesome original puzzles - you connect the dots to make a single ring. "Slitherlink" is a puzzle in which you connect dots with a line according to the rules. The greatest attraction is the fact that there exist an unlimited number of set sequences known as "theorems". With this puzzle, you can actually feel your own skill level rising with each theorem you learn.

title: Madorica Real Estate 2
description: The sequel to Madorica Real Estate released in 2018.

title: Halo Infinite: Winter Update
description: This is the largest feature update to Halo Infinite yet, bringing with it a number of highly anticipated experiences such as Campaign Network Co-Op, Mission Replay, the Forge Beta, and a plethora of new, free content for all players.

title: Sea Fable
description: When a young girl takes an offer to swap places with a mermaid, she’s suddenly introduced to a new world of friendship, magic, and palace intrigue.

title: Touhou Puppet Dance Performance: Shard of Dreams - Extended
description:
Touhou Puppet Dance Performance: Shard of Dreams -Extended- is a mod adds 25 new Puppets to the base Shard of Dreams expansion. Every new character from Touhou 15.5, 16, 17, 17.5, 18 and Lotus Eaters has been added, with the game being rebalanced and the campaign being tweaked to make these additions seamless.

This mod also features new areas, costumes, music tracks, moves, abilities and items rounding out the changes.

title: A day in the life of a sea witch
description: Rhere is a lack of bitsy mermaid games... so of course i had to make a game about a cecaelia that featured mermaids

title: Shoalroot
description: Play as a merperson and farm underwater featuring water animals and plants!

title: The Seaside Inn
description:
You arrive in the small town of Cauwick Bay to help your Aunt Jody run her bed & breakfast, The Seaside Inn. It’s a place steeped in memories from your childhood, and your summer awaits.

The two people at the centre of your time in Cauwick Bay are Melani, a mermaid curious about life on land, and Taylor, a young man on the brink of deciding his future.

Both have individual romance routes, and can also be romanced together in a polyamorous route. Romance is not required, and you can befriend the characters instead.

title: Travelers and Tales
description:
You play as Journey (Name Customizable), a bard with the most important skill in the party—the ability to make decisions.

You and your party are wandering adventurers in search of coin. Luckily, a villager offers you a quest, but it pulls you into something more than you bargained for.

title: Neogeo Pocket Color Selection Vol.2
description: Neogeo Pocket Color Selection Vol.2 The second wave of the dream collection is here! Ten new Neogeo Pocket Color masterpieces are included!

title: Daisenryaku SSB
description: "Daisenryaku SSB" is a simulation game in which you command and fight troops such as tanks and fighters on a battlefield separated by hexes. Since the birth of the "Daisenryaku" series, AI has been tough, and it has been evaluated as a simple game but deep game.

title: Shapez 2: Factory
description: Dive into a factory-building game where the focus is on just that — building huge factories! Construct sprawling multi-level factories and min-max your layouts without limits. Shapez 2 is tailor-made for enthusiasts who crave the thrill of optimizing production lines and perfecting automation.

title: It's A Promise
description:
Erin has gotten used to the monotony of her life. But she still feels like something is missing. One day she is approached by a young woman named Ori who seems to know who she is. Erin doesn't remember her at all... Ori asks her out on a date and Erin finds herself saying yes.

How will the date go? Will Erin remember who Ori is? Will Ori find out that Erin doesn't remember her? Read to find out!

title: Bittersweet Starlight
description: Sorrel has a conversation with his good friend Aster at the place they always meet. What will they talk about?

title: Convergence
description:
It is the present. World War III has been averted.
Claire, a time traveler, only has to live out the rest of her days as an ordinary citizen.

title: Drinking Tea (with the Trans Boy You Secretly Have a Crush On)
description:
You are Milo Poppydash, student at the prestigious Halfmoon Academy for Witches. Your best friend is Atlas Galecrown, fellow student at the Academy. You have a crush on him.

Atlas finally asked you out! Only problem is you immediately embarrassed yourself and now you can never face him again or die of shame.

Your only option? Steal the Time Acorn, go back in time, and relive the day until Atlas asks you out again!

title: Hype Prototype
description:
Hype Prototype is a 3D arena third-person shooter in the prototype style. Endless bullets make the game as dynamic as possible. Each level consists of a separate arena, you need to pass it and get into the portal. The game is great for training your aim.

Each level consists of a separate arena, you need to pass it and get into the portal. Along the way you will meet various enemies, power-ups, coins, first aid kits.

Three types of weapons are available to you at any time: revolver, shotgun and rifle. Each weapon has its own characteristics. Endless bullets make the game as dynamic as possible. You just need to aim and press the button.

The quality of passing the level affects the final grade. Your score is entered into the global leaderboard

title: Thomas and the Magic Railroad Print Studio
description: Thomas and the Magic Railroad Print Studio is a PC CD-ROM game based on the movie Thomas and the Magic Railroad. It was released by Hasbro Interactive in the UK only and features narration by Michael Angelis.

title: Rental
description: Rental is a short and spooky adventure game about the dangers of renting a house in an unknown place.

title: SugarStellar
description: Alice bakes the best cupcakes around, but can she steer through the dangers of the outer space sweets business?

title: Vergilius
description: Hot searing pain gives way to intense flashes of red and black. Falling through a sea of blood surrounded by the howling voices of the past, you begin to panic. Then suddenly you hit something, hard but painless, and your vision blurs and fades. Hours, or days pass until you awaken somewhere strange…

title: Fledge
description: Fledge is a 2D adventure-exploration game in which the player takes on the role of a young pigeon who leaves his village in search of a bird paradise. His adventure promises to be a thorny one, especially as he has a peculiarity: he can't fly.

title: MineColonies
description: MineColonies is an interactive building mod that allows you to create your own thriving town within Minecraft. It lets your leadership skills soar by providing you with everything you need to build your kingdom. MineColonies gives you the flexibility to create a colony as unique as every player. With so many options, you’ll create a different colony every time, adapt to any biome, and build inside a mountain, on top of one, under the ocean, or in the sky.

title: Perfect Ball
description:
You go on a long journey as a ball. All you have to do is get to the top.

You can't move alone. Because you're a ball without arms or legs. However, even if you can't move on your own, it's possible to move the ground you're standing on. Rotate and tilt the ground so that you can climb up!

Of course, it will not be an easy journey. You can't stop or jump up wherever you want. Also, all kinds of obstacles will interfere with you.

However, don't give up and go up. It doesn't matter how many times you fail. Even if it takes a lot of time, put all your strength into it, tilt the ground, and reach the top along with the tilted land.

The top of the lonely world will wait for you forever.

title: Undertoad: Mission Luigi
description: Explore the town of Sherborough and chat with the townsfolks. To leave town, you must conquer Luigi's gauntlet, a set of trials that will push even the most prestigious jumpers to their limit. Make sure to prepare yourself because there is no going back. Now get Movin', Butterball!

title: Witch Hat & Ears of Cat
description: Lianna was a young Dark Magician who, after leaving her home village, moved to the city of Eastwall, capital of the frontier beween the world known to humans and the unexplored lands to the east, region known as the World's Edge. There, she would begin a new life with a new identity while following the instructions given by her Master.

title: Luna and the Stars
description: In the game players control the level headed and kind Luna as she rescues her friends from Soleil. Soleil is tired of humans writing more poetry and songs about the night sky than the sun- so she's stolen the stars brought about eternal daylight! It's up to Luna to restore the beauty of the night sky and save her starry friends. You must avoid Soleil's fiery wrath while collecting stars in order to regain your magic and take her down.

title: Dream Quest: Knight and Princess
description:
Everything was wonderful- Gwyn the knight and Isela the princess were living out their lives in peace and harmony. However, things went wrong, as they often do. The Dark Lord Leirwrex appeared and took Princess Isela away to his castle in the world of dreams.

Gwyn follows them into this strange world, intent on finding Leirwrex's Nightmare Castle and rescuing her one true love!

title: Mind Donor
description: You take the role of Victoria Frankenstein as she ventures her lab, collecting the pieces to finish her creation. As you do so, you'll soon find out the motive for her research.

title: Nightmare of Weakest Creature
description: Eika Ebisu wakes up in hell, convinced that she is in a nightmare. Explore the desolate area, meeting interesting characters and learning more about the world you have been thrust into, solving puzzles along the way. Discover Eika's past, and her potential future in "Nightmare of Weakest Creature".

title: Mansion Tour
description: A short RPG Maker Game about a girl trying to deal with her problem - by going into an abandoned house.

title: Spirit Night
description: Every year, on Spirit Night, the spirits go out to help the locals and collect treats. How many people can you help? How many pieces of candy can you collect?? How spooky will it truly get??? There are many people in Rootsberg in need of help and who knows, maybe you'll even make a friend along the way...

title: A Guardian's Wish
description: Many witches exist nowadays, each of them unique in their own way. But what they all have in common is that they have a guardian angel, who visits them in their dreams and guides them throughout their life, trying to lead them to the right way as much as possible. Many angels have a passionate wish to protect their witches, as if they were their children (even though they technically kinda are).

title: Elation for the Wonder Box 6000
description: Elation For The Wonder Box 6000 is a first-person, claymation adventure game about going into the city to try and find a game from your youth that no one else remembers.

title: Untitled Runeterra MMO
description: An upcoming MMORPG set within the world of Runeterra, developed by Riot Games. It was announced on December 17th, 2020 by Executive Producer Greg 'Ghostcrawler' Street. The game is currently in early development and is expected to launch in the distant future. The lore and story of the MMO will be considered canon to the League of Legends universe.

title: The Curse of Tencond
description: The Curse of Tencond is a short adventure game, where your player character is afflicted by a terrible curse, making them die every 10 seconds and start their journey all over again.

title: Control Resonant
description: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

title: Masters & Heroes
description:
Masters & Heroes is a new mobile strategy RPG. Lead your town to prosperity, build a strong squad, follow the captivating story, and fight other players.
To win, you’ll need to be smart about growing your army and choose where to put your resources and time carefully — instead of looking for your wallet. Your battles will be automatic, but the outcome will depend on your tactical decisions: choose the right gear, find the best position for your warriors, and use your items and buffs on time.

title: Your Only Move is Hustle
description: Your Only Move Is Hustle is an online, turn-based fighting game and superpowered fight scene simulator. Using a unique and accessible control scheme, harness the power of precognition to land the perfect blow. Master your technique, execute flashy combos, and outsmart opponents across the world, frame-by-frame.

title: Akka Arrh
description:
A cascade of words, colors, shapes, and sounds flows around your turret as you desperately fight off swarms of incoming attackers. If enemies penetrate your perimeter, you must approach the combat at close range and defeat them, adjusting to a completely different perspective in the blink of an eye. Welcome to Akka Arrh by Jeff Minter.

This modern take from the excellent developers at Llamasoft combines the intrigue of an incredibly rare Atari arcade prototype with a unique creative vision that delivers incredibly addictive shooter gameplay. Akka Arrh is dripping with Minter's sense of humor, love of psychedelic color, and the ability to create games that are a joy to play.

title: Neo Breakout
description: This 2022 re-imagining of the Atari classic Breakout for the Atari 50 collection features progression from black and white to colorful and progressively more difficult multi-ball stages, as well as a 2-player Battle Breakout mode reminiscent of Pong.

title: Quadratank
description: One of Digital Eclipse's Atari Reimagined games released as part of the Atari 50 collection, Quadratank expands on the original Combat with four-player versus tank battles across different terrain types and new modes, like Capture the Flag.

title: VCTR-SCTR
description:
VCTR-SCTR is a new game developed by Digital Eclipse that combines elements of several vector based games to celebrate vector games. Featuring different gameplay aspects of iconic vector and space games like: Asteroids, Lunar Lander, Solaris, Major Havoc, and Tempest.
It has been released as part of "Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration"

title: Withering Rush
description: Withering Rush is a 2d platform game made for ElRichMC for his 10 years on youtube

title: Emi: New Beginning
description: A short adult visual novel about Emi, a beautiful young woman who is back from college to stay with you while she figures out her next move in life. The game features 260+ 4K pre-rendered stills and 10+ 4K animated scenes, which vary depending on your choices.

title: Legend of Zero
description: This game is based on Fire Emblem, a typical tactical RPG with 5 playable characters and 11 chapters in total.

title: Score Gun
description: SCORE GUN! This game made by 11-year-old!

title: Endacopia
description: Endacopia is a nontraditional point-and-click adventure game. Guide a lost child named Mellow through a world governed by unfamiliar rules. Relying on his strong gut instinct and your guidance as his guardian angel, Mellow must overcome obstacles in search of a place to call home.

title: Lawnmower Game: Space Race
description: Lawnmowers are back, now at space race. Drive these super fast hovering lawnmowers race at different space tracks. 16 different tracks, with different skilled ai lawnmower racers.

title: Fuck Hitler
description: You go back in time 80 years. In front of you lies a half-conscious Adolf Hitler. You know he can't move, can't defend himself. To your right lies a brand-new MP44 and a set of grenades, to your left a large sawblade and a gallows. You know what to do.

title: Of Frost and Flowers
description: An otome-fantasy visual novel. Play as Alto, a fearless knight, and enter a world of magic and myths with secrets waiting for you to unveil.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong Victoria Ash
description: Victoria Ash, played by Jessica Chobot, guest star in L.A. by Night, is the highest-profile Toreador in the Camarilla, and Emem's mawla. She is passing through Boston and has a favour to ask of you.

title: Shadows Over Loathing
description: A slapstick-figure comedy adventure-RPG full of mobsters, monsters, and mysteries.

title: R-Beta
description: A combination of the action and difficulty of the Classic Mega Man with the exploration of an interconnected map in the best Metroidvania style.

title: Fredbear's Fright
description: Spend 4 nights working as the attraction operator at the all new Fredbear's Fright horror attraction!

title: KIPP: Untouched
description: KIPP: Untouched is a fan game based on the Five Night's at Freddy's franchise.

title: Refinery
description: Nineteen-year-old artist Kouro Tomomi is bored and restless. She's tired of life in her small, slow-moving Hokkaido hometown. But her plans to study at a prestigious art college and break into the architectural and landscape design field were sidelined by a rude shock that impacted her on both a mental and physical level. Treading the worn path of routine at her parents' house and her part-time job at a local home and gardening store, she feels frozen in place, trapped—that it's still too early for anyone to buy her services landscaping is not helping.

title: The Sullen Boku Girls Alliance
description: An incredibly facetious and silly short RPG in which the protagonists of six separate original projects go on an errand in attempt to make their creator get to work on their stories. Hopefully their strong personalities won't be too much of an obstacle to their quest...!

title: Cumming Hotel: A Gay Furry Slice of Life
description: A Slice of Life game mixed with JRPG elements.

title: Villain Project
description: Each image is like a chapter of a book. To understand the whole story, complete all levels and check Leopold and his adventure, his practice session, and his final test.

title: Boyfriend's Rescue
description: Boyfriend's Rescue is an adult platform gay game about a boy trying to save his boyfriend who is trapped in a magical book, the Gay Sutra.

title: Perfect Memento of Touhou Question: More 50 Questions Part 1
description: More 50 questions for Perfect Memento of Touhou Question, this is the part 1 of all the DLCs.

title: Perfect Memento of Touhou Question: More 50 Questions Part 2
description: More 50 questions for Perfect Memento of Touhou Question, this is the part 2 of all the DLCs.

title: Kapsyljakt med Anki & Pytte
description: A point-and-click game based on the Swedish children's program: Anki & Pytte. As the title of the game suggests, the game is about collecting bottlecaps by playing different minigames, with "kapsyljakt" meaning cap hunting.

title: Rojiura Satsuki: Chapter Heroine Sanctuary
description: Rojiura Satsuki: Chapter Heroine Sanctuary is a visual novel game that features Bronze Heroines Satsuki, Riesbyfe, Sion, Ciel, and the enigmatic Heroine X (Saber) as they endeavor to ascend the twelve palaces of the Gold Heroines, inspired by the Chinese Zodiac and offering a parody of Saint Seiya. The game becomes accessible throughout the day, revealing each chapter within a stone circle that lights up with flames corresponding to each zodiac symbol. Certain chapters introduce unique mechanics, including battles reminiscent of Pokémon, which may result in a game over.

title: Planisphere
description: You're traveling home by train, but suddenly there's a crash and the train stops. You look through the window and see ugly monsters everywhere.

title: Conquer Humanity
description: Become the super villain in this brutal, isometric, fast paced bullet hell by a solo developer. Master your unlimited powers in combat, dismember civilians, cause mass destruction, defeat armed enemies and unique bosses. Be ready to Conquer Humanity!

title: The Ballz are Lava!
description: Nobody knows why - it's just always been this way. Our chance of survival is to absorb all the Green Orbs floating around, while avoiding certain death by touching the Lava - all before the time runs out!

title: Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise
description: Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise is a creative sandbox painting game where the entire game world can be painted, and a sequel to Bombing!!: A Graffiti Sandbox. In the game the player explores hidden secrets, talks to characters, and unlocks painting tools to paint all over the world. It features a bright and vibrant art style with bold colours and graphics.

title: The Water is Wide
description:
You suddenly wake up in a little fishing boat, right in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. To make things worse, you have lost all your memories! How unfortunate...

However, it's not all that bad. You will now work along with your new friend Comi at her family business, the Mauri Oceanografic Team!

Explore the seven seas, look for your lost memories, meet new friends, be a little bit rude, and much more!

title: FeralHeart Unleashed
description: FeralHeart Unleashed is a free-to-play roleplaying MMO game where you can explore a vast online universe as several types of animal species! Express your endless creativity with creating your own stories and worlds, make new friends in a welcoming community, and show off your true colors!

title: Poker Now
description: Poker Now is free no download poker app. Just share the room link to play online private poker with your friends with play chips. Once you accept them, you are ready to play!

title: Elder Kings II
description: Total conversion mod to Crusader Kings 3 that transforms medieval Afro-Eurasia into the Elder Scrolls' Tamriel. A followup to the Elder Kings mod of Crusader Kings 2 which adapts Crusader Kings 3's engine and granular religion/culture mechanics to represent well known and obscure groups struggling for safety or supremacy in the Tamriel of the 2nd Era.

title: Operation K.A.T.B.
description: On an unknown planet somewhere in the universe, one brave Social Justice Space Pirate must find and rescue their fearless crew the only way they know how...

title: Atop the Witch's Tower
description: A ZZT game about opening up.

title: Tiredspace
description: Tiredspace is a game made in RPG Maker VX Ace that follows the story of Cola, a girl from Earth who deals with agoraphobia, her therapy robot Bocks, and Mocha, a girl from The Moon whose job is to replace the stars in the sky.

title: Saturn's Rising Temperature
description:
Follow the life of Saturn, a warehouse worker living on the man-made planet of SD-1409-V2, in a universe where space travel is a fad that has long since came and went.
Recently, she's been having strange dreams about the moon that orbits this planet... But, it's probably nothing, right?

title: Trying
description: Trying is a game about feeling. You play as... You. Trying to find the girl who cursed you 5 years ago, and took away your ability to be happy. Along the way you help some people, and make some friends. Made with rpg maker 2003!

title: Niplob Adventure
description: This game pays tribute to the best jump and runs ever made whilst adding its own flaire.

title: What a Ball
description: What a Ball - A different kind of ball racing game. Follow Blue's adventure running against more than 600 Balls racing together. Be the Ball: Crash, jump, bounce and run up to 300 Km per hour. It's very challenging and hardcore game, if don't believe us, just try it.

title: Kemono Labyrinth
description:
Secondary roguelike of the popular anime "Kemono Friends"!
It is a game that anyone can easily enjoy with various Kemono Friends unique systems.

title: Will There Bee Another?
description: You are Bee, a girl that it's on an online date with Mel. The date is almost over, but Bee doesn't wanna end it... Can you find the correct words to delay this date a little more, or even get a second date?

title: The Potion Shop
description: You are Ryo, a guy that has a potion shop with his boyfriend, Aimer. Ryo is a great alchemist so he has to create some potions, but he is really anxious. Can you help him do those potions?

title: Those Infernal Girls!
description: After a strange light is seen in the deserts outside the town of Offal newbie herders Agatha and her girlfriend Margot embark on their first solo herding assignment to round up the infernals attracted by the light, but strange characters and even stranger creatures await them.

title: RadiAngel
description: Waking up from stasis alone with no memories years ago Em has made peace with living a calm quiet life in her bunker, until one day while watching the cameras she spots a woman who needs help. Letting her into her life and bunker Em changes both of their lives forever...

title: Hyacinth
description: Hyacinth is a psychological horror game that centers on Neo(they/them) after they find themselves alone on a strange train. Follow them as they navigate through surreal train car after surreal train car... and try to find their way home.

title: Steelrising: Cagliostro's Secrets
description: Uncover the darkest secrets of the King's agent, the Comte de Cagliostro, and seek out the revolutionary Jacques Pierre Brissot.

title: Asmodeus's Hell: Devil in the Sunshine State
description: A horror, mystery visual novel where you choose your own story.

title: The Wishing Flower
description: In The Wishing Flower you play as Thomas, a bunny boy who wants to collect moonflowers. Moonflowers are said to call the Star Prince who can grant you anything you desire.

title: Seaglass
description:
The player controls Eliot, a young adult who has never met their closest friend, Loren, in person before. The two have conversed exclusively through messages in bottles tossed back and forth at sea. After seven years, Loren is coming to visit Eliot, and they want to commemorate the occasion with a special and suitable gift.

They decide on a seaglass necklace, and it's up to the player to obtain it!

title: Inn Need
description:
There was once a marvelous hotel in the town of Queen's Horizon. Each room had a different theme, every stay was an adventure. But as the Silver Willow Inn passed from owner to owner, it fell into disrepair more and more.

The new owner, Hestia Kindlee, is determined to rejuvenate the inn that she remembers from her childhood! And no leaky pipes, cobwebby cellars, or haunted hotel rooms are going to stop her! Explore the old inn, fix what you can, find help for what you can't, and restore the inn to its former glory.

title: Football Life 2023
description: Football Life 2023 game is an attempt to continue the offline modes of the retired PES series, football life is a standalone football game based on pes21, built for offline career modes only. SP Football Life is how we like to play a football game.

title: Potty Quest
description: You play as an enby mage kid in search of a bathroom in the spooky basement of a community college while making friends with the local monsters and collecting magic rocks along the way.

title: The Lost Girl
description:
The walls have been gouged open. Strange noises come from below. Apparitions bar your progress. Death has visited here.

This is the building where your girlfriend went missing. If you want to find her and save your relationship, you have only one option.

title: Raiden III x Mikado Maniax
description: This is an enhanced version of the original Raiden III, which came out in 2005 for arcades and consoles. There will be some new game modes, online features, and customization options.

title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Steelbook Launch Edition
description:
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a historical fantasy action role-playing video game developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo.

Set during a fictionalised version of the fall of the Han Dynasty, the plot follows an unnamed protagonist who battles historical characters and Chinese mythological creatures corrupted by demonic qi.

The Steelbook Launch Edition includes:
- Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty game
- Exclusive Steelbook collectable case
- Bonus DLC items “Crown of Zhurong” and “Crown of Gonggong”

title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Season One
description: Season One (2019 - 2022) is the first season of The Dark Pictures Anthology. This season includes the first four installments of the anthology.

title: R-Type Tactics I & II Cosmos
description:
Outsmart and outgun your opponent in R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos, the ultimate turn-based sci-fi strategy collection!

This two-game combination of the classic R-Type Tactics titles arrives on modern consoles for the first time, equipped with an armada of unique units to deploy across dozens of levels.

Multiple campaigns allow you to take on the Bydo Empire or even play as them yourself, while competitive online play lets you square off against others.

title: Post-Shift 2
description: Post-Shift 2 is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame project set in an alternate universe from the original FNAF games by Scott Cawthon. Acting as a continuation of the previous fangame, Post-Shift.

title: Chop Goblins
description: Pursue the malevolent Chop Goblins through time, and foil them with devastating weapons, in this bite-sized FPS from the creator of Dusk, Iron Lung, and Squirrel Stapler

title: Hibernaculum
description:
A survival horror RPG by Wormwood Studios

Old School Dungeon Crawl/Survival Horror experience meets speculative fiction inspired modern take on the genre.

title: Thera 1
description: This entry of Thera follows the slapdash pilot broadcast of a TV program hosted by two remarkably stable and self-aware fragments named Hera and Despera.

title: Lift Your Spirits
description:
You are a desperate college student rushing to meet the deadline of your last assignment before semester break. With no choice but to stay late, you find yourself alone at campus in the dead of night.

You never believed the rumors spread around the student body. Ghost stories were simply stories, right?

...Right?

title: Melissa
description: A short retro tech horror visual novel, with a bit of comedy that taps into the general time period of the Apple II, and other examples of old computer tech.

title: Fate of the Damned
description: Fate of the Damned is a meticulously crafted custom campaign for BLOOD which aims to speculate and explore another shadowed path that Caleb might've undertaken. While taking care to never stray far from the gameplay formula that made BLOOD so gripping, the campaign will see Caleb journey through new environments that he has not seen before. Gruesome new discoveries await as he tears through hordes of the undead and nothing is left unscathed in his quest for vengeance.

title: Raguna and the Crystal of Miracles
description: Raguna and The Crystal of Miracles is a RPG Maker horror/comedy game featuring 2+ hours of content, several endings, and many ways to die.

title: Resident Evil 2: Kendo's Cut
description: From the creator of Mortal Night and director of the upcoming During the Storm, comes an increasingly maddenning and hilarious adventure for Resident Evil 2 that answers the following question: What would have happened if Robert Kendo had survived the gunshop attack and then followed Leon in his descent into darkness?

title: Bohemian Symphony
