description: Follow the nonsensical adventures of Zalmora Greenhand and friends as they attempt to solve murders, fend off curses, and survive zombie apocalypses.

title: Aren't You Overcompensating for Something?
description:
I can't stop my mind from coming up with new ideas.

Constantly, be it during work or while trying to sleep, I have to stop what I'm doing and note down the new ideas that came to me out of nowhere.

Restless creativity. Never-ending tension for not creating more. The feeling of 'I could be writing right now' follows me at all times.

So why is it that I can't write?

title: My GF Doesn't Know What I'm Into
description: A visual novel about my cute new girlfriend, who doesn't know what i'm into!

title: VillageRhapsody
description: The player will play an aspiring young man who participates in the construction of a new rural area. He will use his life skills to help complete the requests of the villagers, meet the needs of the girls, improve the girls' goodwill towards you, and strive for the honor of a strong man who dares to carry water for the widow.

title: Rainbow Dawn
description: One day, you find yourself trapped in a dream state. You can't remember anything about yourself, where you came from, and why you've been asleep for so long. Once you wake up, you realize that the entire world has been cleansed of all human souls..! At least, so you are told by your fairy companion, Hope. You need to find other signs of human life if you wish to survive, if there are any left. However... people may have still had regrets before they passed, and it's up to you to fulfill them.. or not.

title: Toontown Rewritten: Sellbot Task Force
description:
Sellbot Task Force adds over 50 new ToonTasks, a new area to explore, a fully remastered battle system, dozens of new Toon customization options, and the long-awaited Sellbot Field Offices: the most challenging Boss Cog that Toontown has ever faced.

This expansion marks a major milestone for Toontown Rewritten, being the first major content update for endgame players since before the original game's closure in 2013. It was developed entirely as a volunteer effort, and is being released for free without any form of subscriptions, advertisements, micro-transactions, donations, or other forms of revenue.

title: Radiant Devotion
description: Radiant Devotion is a Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance fangame centered on Ike/Soren during the day of devotion festival.

title: Hangaroo
description: Play the classic Hangaroo game and figure out the words and phrases by guessing the letters! Try to guess the phrase without failing four times! Or else the friendly kangaroo will be hanged mercilessly!

title: Tale of Memories
description: As the descendent of the Hero of Tarwen, your duty to your kingdom is to find and defeat its greatest villain, released after centuries of imprisonment: the Carmine Witch. On your journey, as you befriend fellow knights and civilians alike, your mission grows in complexity as you encounter the enigmatic Masked Mage, the secrets of neighboring kingdoms, and rumors of other looming threats with ties to the Carmine Witch. In the realm of Dryadales, legends, myths, and fables often prove to be true—but not always in the ways you imagined!

title: Darling of the Sea
description: Darling of the Sea is a short romance thriller game about the protagonist, Ivy Blue, who wished on a shooting star on her lover's death anniversary; and her resurrected lover. There are slight horror elements and 4 endings in this game.

title: Your Voice in the Autumn Leaves
description: After his girlfriend Kaori broke up with him, 17 year old student Kure isolated himself from the world, spending his time home, heartbroken, listening to sad indie songs and playing videogames. Then, one day, outside the Hospital where his mother works, Kure met someone very special: a girl named Autumn, who has been diagnosed with cancer and is trying to assimilate her situation. That day would change their lives forever...

title: The Toy Factory Across the Street
description:
Francesca, a brilliant young transgender journalist, goes back to the house where she grew up to celebrate the birthday of her father. Unfortunately for Francesca, there's an abandoned toy factory across the street where many people have died or have been reported missing, and strange phenomena can be witnessed at night. She has always dreaded that place, and now what was supposed to be a nice celebration will turn out to be a night full of horrors beyond human comprehension...
The horrors of...The Toy Factory Across the Street...

title: Drom
description: Described by the developer: "A short, pointless game about a dream I once had."

title: Alloy Soldier Xenia
description: Alloy Soldier Xenia is an open world action adventure platformer where you control a battle android in search of her memories and her purpose.

title: Dream Team
description:
Do you ever hear different voices in your head when you're half-asleep?

Help Triangle, Circle and Square navigate through your dreams. Where will they go? What will they become? Will it be a pleasant dream or a dreadful one?

title: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing Version 15
description: With Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing 15, you'll perform better whenever you're sitting in front of a keyboard! Track your accomplishments and stay motivated with tests, progress reports, and special certificates. Develop the essential typing skills you need for school and career success, with a little help from Mavis Beacon!

title: Gashi Shachi no Sachi
description:
This game is browsing the internet for pages that don't exist, starting with the mysterious homepage "GashiShachiNoSachi".

When you start the game, you will see a screen that looks like an operating system with sound effects. First, try logging in and launching your browser.
Browsers come with back, forward, refresh, and home buttons that are useful for browsing.
You can jump directly to a page by entering the URL in the address field and clicking the Go button.

On some pages, objects can be got by clicking on them.
The object you get will be displayed in the eyedropper field of the browser.
The object can be attached to a some object, and if the content of the attachment is correct, an event will occur.
When the event occurs, you can go to another link.

Enjoy surfing the net.

title: Cyball
description:
Cyball CyBall is a futuristic football-themed (US: soccer), NFT-based game where users can collect and form a team of CyBlocs and face off against other teams online, or trade and mentor new CyBlocs within the CyBall's ecosystem. Initially, the game will launch on BNB Chain with immediate plans to launch on Solana as soon as it is ready to create a multi-chain gaming environment.
The CyBall game engine combines different elements of strategy, simulation and chance into the form of an exciting and competitive turn-based football card game, where players compete to see who can score the most goals. Players train up their CyBlocs to compete in various game modes with varying levels of rewards. Existing CyBlocs can also mentor young CyBlocs, creating the next generation of unique NFTs. In future expansions, we aim to give players more ways to spend accrued rewards, both in CyBall and in the wider CyBloc universe.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Whisper the Wolf
description:
A character addon for Sonic Robo Blast 2.

Whisper the Wolf, sneaking in from the Sonic IDW comics, with her Variable Wispon in tow makes it to SRB2!

Whisper is a very versatile character, with many tools for a variety of situations, perfecting each of her tool allows you to traverse maps with relative ease!

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - New Adventure Volume 3: Linking Light's Successor 1-3
description: Description: A new adventure in the Shadowlands, featuring three brand new quests! Euclase and Lapis take center stage as main characters! What is the truth behind the new threat that looms over the entire continent?!

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - Vol.3 Bonus Unit: Euclase
description: Description: Adds Euclase, a main character from the storyline, into the game as a playable character.

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - Vol.3 Bonus Unit: Lapis
description: Description: Adds Lapis, a main character from the storyline, into the game as a playable character.

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - Vol.3 Challenge Quest: Linking Light's Successor EX
description: Description: Adds a bonus challenge quest featuring an enhanced version of the boss encounter from Linking Light's Successor. This quest does not include any story content.

title: Sands of Slumber: The RPG
description: A 2D Old-school RPG based on the Dungeons and Dragons Custom World Campaign of the same name. Players play as the 4 main heroes of the story as they adventure around Tanaviak, leveling up, gaining new skills and exploring the land.

title: Blockpost Mobile
description: Blockpost Mobile is a new tactical shooter from the cubic game universe by Skullcap Studios. Keeping the hurricane character of the classic online FPS, the game sets a new level of gameplay, at the junction of the most popular and relevant genres.

title: NeverSynth
description: NeverSynth is a 3rd person game that is a rhythm driving simulator. This game is a dynamic action game in which you have to drive a car to rhythmic music and collect beats. The more beats you collect, the more game points you earn.

title: MopGarden's Veggie Cart
description:
MopGarden’s Veggie Cart is a fast-paced, simulation game where you feed hungry bunnies lots of healthy vegetables! Can you feed them all in time?

MopGarden, a variety Twitch streamer, has decided to feed all the local bunnies in her town. As business begins to boom, she moves her veggie cart to other surrounding areas, where the vegetable orders get faster, and faster, and faster.

title: KnifeBoy: Rebooted
description: Things are going to start getting weird.

title: Cleopatra Fortune: S-Tribute
description: Surround falling stones and treasures to fill up and wipe out lines! Score points with "all clears" and "chains." Cleopatra Fortune, a puzzle game set in Egypt, has been revived with new modes that make it easier to play. Two players can face off in versus mode.

title: Swoon! Earth Escape
description: The planet is flooded with a mysterious green acid. Help Swoon and the rest of the crew escape the Earth. Collect all the mechanical parts of your spaceship and face the most daring bosses in this epic retro-style journey!

title: Dead or Alive 6: Energy Up! Training Wear Set
description: A set with all 16 Energy Up! Training Wear outfits.

title: Dead or Alive 5 Last Round: Core Fighters - Samurai Warriors Mashup Set
description: This set contains all the Samurai Warriors Mashup costumes. This set contains costumes for the following characters: All characters except Akira, Jacky, Pai, Sarah, and Naotora Ii. *The Azuchi stage shown in the screenshots cannot be used in this version of the game. *You must have the latest update installed in order to use this content.

title: Mighty Gunvolt Burst: Character Set - Rivals
description: This set of DLC characters contains the rival characters from "Mighty No. 9," "Azure Striker Gunvolt," and "Gal*Gun 2." This content adds "RAY," "Copen," and "Kurona" to the roster of playable characters.

title: Dynasty Warriors 9: Zhou Yu Additional Hypothetical Scenarios Set
description: Allows you to play a hypothetical story for Zhou Yu that differs from that found in the main story of "Dynasty Warriors 9".

title: The Settlers 7: Paths to a Kingdom - The Two Kings
description: Venture into new territories and conquer challenging objectives with The Settlers 7: Paths to a Kingdom – The Two Kings DLC! This expansion pack delivers a wealth of fresh content, including a thrilling co-op mode, challenging new maps for strategic city-building and resource management, a cunning new AI opponent, a unique event location, and exciting new victory points to achieve.

title: Dynasty Warriors 9: Guo Jia Additional Hypothetical Scenarios Set
description: Allows you to play a hypothetical story for Guo Jia that differs from that found in the main story of "Dynasty Warriors 9".

title: Kandagawa Jet Girls: Ikaruga & Yomi Character Set
description:
Adds Ikaruga and Yomi from the SENRAN KAGURA series to Kandagawa Jet Girls as playable characters.

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIII: Hero Mode Additional Stage Set 3
description: Six stages will be added to Hero Mode: "Wargod under Siege," "Fall of the Imperial Han," "Rise of Shu-Han," "Yiling in Flames," "Beyond the Peach Garden," and "Southern Campaign.

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIII: Hero Mode Additional Stage Set 2
description: Four stages will be added to Hero Mode: "Enmity of the Triumphant Ma," "Talent Above All," "Entering Shu," and "Liao at Hefei." "Enmity of the Triumphant Ma," "Talent Above All," and "Liao at Hefei" are story/movie only stages.

title: Fairy Tail: Levy
description: A set that includes the playable character "Levy", an additional story, and costumes.

title: Totally Reliable Delivery Service: Stunt Sets
description: Stunt Sets Island is a giant private island being used as the primary location of all upcoming motion pictures.

title: Fairy Fencer F: Weapon Change Accessory Set
description: Fairy Fencer F: Weapon Change Accessory Set includes Weapon Change Accessory Sets Little Black, Green, Icons, Little Purple, Purple, Reaper, Little White, and Yellow.

title: Mighty Gunvolt Burst: Character Set - Heroines
description: This set of DLC characters contains heroines from "Mighty No. 9," "Azure Striker Gunvolt," and "Gal*Gun" This content adds "Call", "Joule," and "Tenzou" to the roster of playable characters.

description: Additional items for use in Character Creation (48 in total).

description: Additional items for use in Character Creation (42 in total).

title: Embers of the Zombie Battlemage: Halloween - Real Werewolves of Massachusetts
description: Adds a new guest to the base game, as well as new story content for Leo!

title: Senran Kagura Reflexions: 30 Accessory Set
description: 30-Accessory Set is for use with Senran Kagura Reflexions.

title: SoulCalibur VI: Character Creation Set C
description: Celebrate 20 years of SoulCalibur with an all new Character Creation set!

title: Train Simulator: Settle Carlisle Specials Add-On
description: Settle-Carlisle Specials puts you in the cab of fabulous preserved steam locomotives as they haul trains full of rail fans along the Settle-Carlisle line.

title: SoulCalibur VI: Character Creation Set A
description: Celebrate 20 years of SoulCalibur with an all new Character Creation set!

title: Keep the Lights On
description: Keep the Lights On is an atmospheric horror game where you step in the shoes of Edmund Rosental, a private detective, who is tasked with investigating an old abbey and the mystery surrounding it. Will he be able to keep the lights on or will he succumb to the darkness

title: Crossroads: Escaping the Dark - Collector's Edition
description: A visit to Crossroads becomes a digital nightmare for a gamer struggling with a host of trauma-induced phobias!

title: Project Survivor
description: A retro style game that can be played in 2D platformer mode and top-down mode. Hunt monsters, collect coins, and buy weapons to become stronger. Play with 3-classes and a variety of weapons. Enjoy cute retro style pixel art that you see on a nostalgic CRT monitor filter.

title: Tiny Detour
description: Tiny Detour is a little relaxing story about a Broken Bridge on your way home. Head to the nearby forest village and discover very weird locals. Experience the adventure & explore the beautiful parts of the valleys while completing unique quests!

title: Bright Sudoku
description: Bright Sudoku is a unique Sudoku game, which includes traditional Sudoku games and original three-dimensional Sudoku games. The new 3D Sudoku experience brings more difficult Sudoku problems. The newly added dimensions make Sudoku solving more difficult. Come and experience!

title: Prince Ajapanadam x Princess
description: Prince Anihonhiko, the prince from modern kingdom Ajapanadam alongside with his wife, princess Akorea-Aca from modern kingdom Akoreaeve got isekaid into medieval isekai world from their modern world. This isekai world got attacked by demon queen, Prince and Princess decided to save all princesses.

title: Liberation Special Forces
description: This is tactical first person shooter that you lead a small squad with different weapons to eliminate opressors to avoid them from terrorising free people.

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2
description: Dust off your torch and hammer - it's time to get back to work, you have a new job to do. Visit the new beach coast with the largest, biggest ship graveyard in the world, dismantle huge ship parts and collect tons of precious steel. Roll up your sleeves, it's time to get back to the business.

title: Crumb Circuit Simulator
description: Powerful Realtime 3D Electronic Circuit Simulator

title: Begone Beast
description: Begone Beast is a spooky top-down action game for 1-4 players. HACK & SLASH & SCREAM through hordes of demons, endlessly changing levels, and ancient terrifying BEASTS. Harness the power of SNACKS, FLASHLIGHTS, and FRIENDSHIP in this scary (but also cute) race for survival!

title: Myasoid
description: Myasoid - This is an arena shooter about a huge worm that protects this planet from the invasion of dangerous alien ships.

title: Snoot Game
description:
You play as Anon, a lonely, faceless, nobody, reject who finds himself in the dinosaur themed acid trip of a school named Volcano High. Here Anon meets the qt ptero known as Fang and their clown-vomit colored posse of reject friends and other associated thorns-in-the-side. All of whom, you can read about here.

This game is a parody of Goodbye Volcano High.

title: Farm in the Horizon
description: You've woken up at Horizon-Valley, with one tool and a few coins you are about to start an epic adventure of creating the farm of your dreams. Are you ready to live off the land and turn the overgrown fields into a thriving home?

title: Cuppy's
description: You work the closing shift for a new ice cream parlor, Cuppy’s, that has been having strange occurrences recently. Quickly assemble every customer’s favorite ice cream flavors and toppings before these… strange occurrences… get even worse!

title: Demolition Pro Online
description: Start up the demolition excavator and use realistic tools to take down the buildings! Work in a team of up to 4 players and master the challenges in different jobs. This 3D demolition simulation is based on destruction, cleanup and recycling.

title: Christmas Blaster
description: Christmas Blaster: Christmas Blaster is an Arcade-type action video game. Santa needs to save Christmas and face creatures with a lot of explosion in this action-packed game.

title: Gray
description: This story is about a man that somehow wakes in the body of a little robot. Gray is a platform-puzzle game combined with an erotic visual novel.

title: ServiceIT
description: If you love DIY and the world of technology isn't scary to you, don't wait and get at the helm of a recently acquired IT service! Repair equipment, configure it and develop the company. It's up to you to decide which jobs to do, who to hire and what you want your office to look like!

title: Shrieking Darkness
description: Close your eyes. Step into a world filled with nothing but darkness and terror, where everything wants to destroy you. Your time has come to fight the shrieking darkness, be brave and don't look back or you won't make it.

title: Sky Base Venus
description: Sky Base Venus is a colony simulator set in the upper atmosphere of Venus. Harvest resources from Venus and its atmosphere, build up your colony, grapple with disasters and system failures, and pursue self-sufficiency as your support from Earth dwindles.

title: Neon Noir
description: Neon Noir is an episode-based cyberpunk visual novel with interactive mechanics. It is set in the megalopolis of New Devon in the year 2169, where large private corporations have more power than the government. The player follows the crimes investigated by Colden, a Snatcher.

title: Tempo Trigger
description: Tempo Trigger is a rhythm and aiming skill game. Players can compete in the leaderboard or create something truly memorable with stream chat.

title: Iron Mandate
description: Master the piloting of giant mechanical worms, lay waste to all that stand in your way and reclaim your rightful place on the throne.

title: Miami Hotel Sim
description: Transform and manage your dream hotel in vibrant Miami! Renovate your property, delight your guests, and boost your income. Expand your offerings with vending machines and food services to become the ultimate hospitality tycoon!

title: Delivery Man
description: A small town food delivery man receives an order to deliver food to a strange house. When he arrived, he discovered that the house contained a terrifying secret that one who knew it would not be able to escape to tell others.

title: Siren Head: The Horror Experience
description:
While working the late shift at the Police Department, you receive a report about some teenagers that went missing in Windermere Woods. Old folk tales mention these woods, and of a monster that is said to lurk there, but those are just stories... right?

It is your job to find these teens, but you did not imagine the horrors you would face.
The old folks tale states that the mythical monster surrounds its habitat with siren noises of all kinds, luring unsuspecting victims.

title: For the Crown
description: For the crown is a Puzzle/Supply-chain game where the player obeys the crown's orders to build and develop a production chain to create items and charakters. The demands of the crown will increase according to the level, making the game and the tasks more and more complex.

title: New Cycle

You've finally awakened and are on the search for your creator, or anyone for that matter. Explore a simplistic world using the only remnants of a civilization: their technology.

Cmd Error is a puzzle game where you interact with the world through terminals. Each area that you explore tells a piece of the story of who you are. With a single command you can open a door, turn on a laser, or even start an old spaceship! Use the in-game map editor to create your own maps that can be shared and downloaded from the Steam workshop!

title: Park
description: The original Vector Park

They worked together to perform several duties on the space station. During their journey back earth, unexpected things happen to them.

description: In the second expansion to Wingspan, we discover the awe-inspiring birds of Oceania! Wingspan: Oceania Expansion includes new gameplay features, an additional resource - nectar, 95 extraordinary bird cards, and more!

Trapped in the jaws of hell, four souls are given the chance of freedom by a mysterious voodoo priest who distils their essence into voodoo dolls. Take up their offer and begin your break for freedom!

Begin your journey to the heart of the capital before the time runs out.

description: Science has never been more dangerous! Death is in the air... Sounds pretty ominous, doesn't it? Help the twin detectives solve a new case!

description: Introducing the latest generation of ATC simulator, that provides a level of immersion like no other. With advanced voice recognition, custom modelled and detailed airports and state-of-the-art lighting, geometry and textures. Tower! Sim 3 is the gold standard for air traffic control simulation.

title: Train Operator 377
description: Enjoy the charm of one of the UK’s oldest and most enchanting railways from the best available viewpoint – the driver’s seat! Hammer through urban sprawl, rolling fields and famous tunnels at 90 MPH in all weathers and at any time of your choosing.

description: Play as Mr. Colourfool, a father looking for his son that is lost in the castle that recently appeared out of thin air. The colours are all gone, and there is a voice beckoning you towards the castle. Perhaps it is fate, or just your imagination...There is nowhere else to go anyways.

description: After a plane crash, you are the only survivor. You will quickly find out that you are in a remote place, surrounded by unknown creatures.

description: Take on the role of a warrior of an elite royal squad and defeat the bloodthirsty Barganian Empire in King's Blade - classic beat 'em up game set in a heroic fantasy setting.

title: KinnikuNeko: Super Muscle Cat
description: A cat with the body of a bodybuilder fights against aliens in this 2D platformer with anime aesthetics.

title: Loot List
description: Loot List is a thief simulator and action game about robbery. There's one difference though — here, every heist has to have a list.

title: Lumba: Hangover
description: Experience the thrilling aftermath of Lumba's destruction in LUMbA: HANGOVER! The substance has spread to four new victims, led once again by Pal. Together, they will engage in a doomed crusade across their world in this fast-paced, top-down shooter.

title: To the Earth
description: Driving car in the space game. go to from mars to earth. drive safe!

title: Strain
description: Strain is a 32-level partial conversion for Doom II released in 1997 by the Alpha Dog Alliance. It features nine new or modified monsters through the use of DeHackEd, modified weapons, and a soundtrack written by David "Tolwyn" Shaw, Mark Klem, and Jon Landis. The project had a sporadic development history, exceeding a year due to cyclical interest and disinterest[1].

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Joyous Japan
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Feudal Japan themed tables with controllable bumpers!

title: Rocket Escape
description: You're trapped in a strange facility with only one tool at your disposal - a Rocket Launcher. You must use this launcher to rocket jump your way to the goal across many unique new environments, dealing with the hazards in your way.

title: Rift Rangers
description: Rift Rangers is a sentai themed casual rogue-lite where you defend against an endless horde of dimensional creatures. Construct and upgrade your defensive turrets while dodging enemies! Find the right combination of turrets and upgrades to become an impenetrable fortress!

title: Recoil vs. The World
description: Use the recoil of your guns to make it to get to the end of these saw blade-filled labyrinths! Turn lasers off, switch guns mid-level, and much more throughout 3 different biomes, each with their own new obstacles and levels to make a fun but rage-inducing experience!

title: Rampage Ball 2048
description: "Rampage Ball 2048" is a classic Arkanoid game with RPG elements. Upgrade the ball and crush blocks.

title: Rat Cage
description: On a freezing blizzard night, a lone mouse wandered into a suspicious building. Solve the mystery and escape from the terrifying building as quickly as possible.

title: Rayless Blade
description: Venture into an unforgiving, open world and struggle alongside your team to one day, possibly, escape your terrible destiny.

title: Quinidiom
description: Endlessly bounce from tile to tile as you orbit around Quinidiom’s Core gathering letters to submit words. Rise to the challenge of the Core as accelerating gameplay tests your fortitude and offers maximum bonus potential.

title: Projekt: Passion - Season 1
description: A futuristic adult visual novel filled with comedy, drama, violence, and romance. Features animated and voice acted cutscenes.

title: Primitive Hearts
description: A classic-style turn-based RPG. On a nearby planet, the situation grows grim as the Titania Empire continues its conquest to take over the world. Unable to sit idly by, a lone adventurer sets out to stop them.

title: Polaris Outpost
description: A space station map of the same quality as the original E2 maps

title: My Heart Your Soul
description: Relive Javi's memories as she embarks on a journey through the Inbetween, in this RPG Story-Driven adventure.

title: Morendo
description: Let Morendo pull you into a dark vortex of lies, betrayal, lust and gluttony. Join a concert guitarist on his journey into the abyss.

title: Mistwinter Bay
description: Rule a town in this story heavy, visual novel-like fantasy RPG! Interact with townsfolk and foreign leaders, build and expand, and tackle randomized events that affect the town and its people.

title: Missing Pictures: Catherine Hardwicke
description: For every movie made, dozens of pictures remain missing forever. In the VR documentary experience Missing Pictures: Catherine Hardwicke, the American filmmaker tells how she unsuccessfully tried to adapt the cult book "The Monkey Wrench Gang", a precursor to eco-activism.

title: MeMoMi
description: MeMoMi Remake is a 2D emotional adventure RPG in which players enter a body in a state of emergency, moving through a world shaped by bodily and psychological metaphor as they search for the legendary Blue Bird to heal it.

title: Kemomi-chan's Journey: Enlightened Girl and the Innocent Doll
description: A 2D action game in which an amnesiac girl with animal ears sets out on a journey in search of her father.

title: Kaiser
description: Go on a campaign to dethrone the kaiser! Build an army, strengthen yourself with powerful artefacts and defeat the forces he sends to stop you. Kaiser is a casual roguelike game where you fight thousands of enemies in an attempt to become the new kaiser.

title: Inner Abyss
description: The world is riddled with monsters beyond our understanding, from horrors unknown. It is now your task to find out why they are here, and how to get rid of them before it is too late.

title: Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals
description: Strap in, all-new content skids onto Inertial Drift! Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Pack comes bursting with new story content, a pulse-racing original Eurobeats soundtrack mixed by renown producer 'Turbo', new cars and tracks!

title: Illegal Plantation
description: It’s time to leave it all behind and do a dance with the law. Build your own illegal plantation, plant your weed, water them, maintain good air temperature and good lighting. Deliver your goods or hire local dealers for it. Get rid of the competition and build your own monopoly.

title: Homerun Miko
description: Restore balance to the Spirit Realm as you solve 2d-isometric physics-based puzzles with Hanami the baseball loving shrine maiden.

title: Hot and Lovely: Charm
description: You can check the numbers by clicking on the cards in the game. When two cards with the same number are opened at the same time, the cards will disappear, and when all the cards are eliminated, the level is successfully passed.

title: House of Ghosts
description: House of ghosts is a single-player horror survival game. Stop the demon and find out the name of his victim before he drags you to hell. Run and hide. Just don't get caught.

title: Super Mario in Sonic 3 AIR
description:
A character mod for Sonic 3 AIR

Have you ever wondered what it'd be like to play as Mario in Sonic 3?

Whatever your answer is, this mod is here to show you anyway! This mod pulls from Mario's 2d and 3d games, and gives him sprites to match the Sonic 3 Artstyle, (mostly) by Kaching720!

title: 3D Pool Ball: Infinity
description: Welcome to the 3D Pool Ball game! How about a nice little game of pool? Precise the cue steering, set the angle and hit the ball. Hone your skills and play on beautiful billiard tables as you travel around the world in 3D Pool Ball now!

title: Age of Empires: 25th Anniversary Collection
description:
The following games are included in the 25th Anniversary Collection:

- Age of Empires: Definitive Edition
- Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
- Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Lords of the West
- Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Dawn of the Dukes
- Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Dynasties of India
- Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition
- Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition - United States Civilization
- Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition - Mexico Civilization
- Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition - The African Royals
- Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition - Knights of the Mediterranean
- Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition

title: Pearls of Atlantis: The Cove
description: Play 600+ match-3 puzzles! Challenge yourself with unique physics gameplay and rebuild Atlantis.

title: Clawstar Wrestling
description: Clawstar Wrestling follows the story of Elijah, a small-time wrestler with a big problem by the name of Tremor. His weekly routine of losing to the antagonistic heel is starting to put a strain on his life outside of the ring. Eli must navigate his complicated relationship with his profession, as well as dealing with a 500 pound thorn in his side.

title: Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man
description: This is a story about the fall of a man. Told in the form of an interactive comic book with sounds and animations, Saint Kotar: The Crawling Man follows the appalling life of Mojse, his fall from a beloved teacher to a bitter and vengeful leader of a sinister cult.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: USA Route - Forest Industry
description: A fictional route representing a US shortline or branchline, located among Pine forests, with a small logging industry. The map is highly detailed, with TurfFX grass and PBR textures. Includes 2 freight train sessions.

title: Trainz Plus: USA Route - Far Northern Mountains
description: Set in the northern regions of the USA, this fictional railroad through a steep mountain valley in a cold summer climate, and spruce forests. With steep gradients, you will be working your locomotives hard to travel this route, which includes 2 sessions.

title: Train Sim World 3: New Journeys - CSX SD40
description: Bring back the origins of CSX, take on new challenges and explore more on Sand Patch Grade with Train Sim World 2: New Journeys - CSX SD40.

title: Train Simulator: Flying Scotsman Centenary Steam Loco
description: Celebrate 100 years of the most famous steam locomotive in the world! As a period of festivities begin, commemorating a century-old legend, kick things off in Gresley’s almighty LNER A3 Pacific, taking a spin once more on British Railtours in our Flying Scotsman Centenary Steam Loco Add-On.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: USA Route - Far Northern Mountains
description: Set in the northern regions of the USA, this fictional railroad through a steep mountain valley in a cold summer climate, and spruce forests. With steep gradients, you will be working your locomotives hard to travel this route, which includes 2 sessions.

title: Delivering Letters
description: Just deliver 10 letters that's easy, right?

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: USA Route - Forest Industry
description: A fictional route representing a US shortline or branchline, located among Pine forests, with a small logging industry. The map is highly detailed, with TurfFX grass and PBR textures. Includes 2 freight train sessions.

title: Dictator-chan island
description: A military man who, drunk, signed up for an impossible task. So skillfully avoids dirty and hard work that he did not even learn how to shoot for all the time he served in the army. A lover of parties and girls seems to have gotten into trouble this time. But he's a good guy, help him get out.

title: Deducto 2
description: A fun sus-like game where you backstab your co-workers and get mad at your co-workers for backstabbing you. (up to 10 players)

title: Train Simulator Classic: Drautalbahn - Klagenfurt: Spittal Millstättersee Route
description: Return to Austria and embark on challenging passenger and freight services with the scenic Drautalbahn from RSSLO!

title: Doraemon Story of Season: Friends of the Great Kingdom - Winter Tales
description: Unwrap a winter themed pack stuffed with cozy outfits, furniture, and a mini-story.

title: The Tale of Bistun: Digital Collector's Edition
description:
The Tale of Bistun Digital Collector's Edition contains:
- Digital version of The Tale of Bistun
- Digital Artbook containing sketches and fully-fledged art works
- The Tale of Bistun original soundtrack by Hamidreza Ansari

title: The Caligula Effect 2: Complete Edition
description:
Complete Edition includes:
- Caligula 2 base game
- Set of 3 Battle Tracks A
- Set of 3 Battle Tracks B
- Complete Stigma Pack

title: Elite Dangerous: Odyssey - Deluxe Edition
description: Disembark, Commander, and leave your mark on the galaxy in Elite Dangerous: Odyssey. Explore distant worlds on foot and expand the frontier of known space. Includes the official Elite Dangerous: Odyssey Soundtrack.

title: Train Sim World 3: New Journeys - S-Bahn Köln BR 423
description: Get to work on the bustling Köln S-Bahn, take on new challenges and explore more on Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen with Train Sim World 2: New Journeys – S-Bahn Köln BR 423.

title: Denizen
description: Make a living for yourself in a city full of opportunity while you meet a variety of locals, explore unique locations, and work your way to the top in this open-world life simulator.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Chuo Line Rapid Service - Takao to Tokyo E233-0 Series
description: The Chuo Line Rapid Transit is one of the major commuter lines in the Tokyo metropolitan area, connecting the Tama area, a bedroom community spreading in the western part of Tokyo, with Shinjuku, the world's largest terminal station, and the office areas of central Tokyo.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Tokaido Line - Tokyo to Atami E233-3000 Series
description: The Tokaido Line was Japan's first railroad line, including the line between Shimbashi and Yokohama, which opened in 1872. It is known as one of Japan's most famous lines.

title: The Isle Tide Hotel
description: A live-action mystery FMV game, where you make decisions for a father that must rescue his teenage daughter from an eclectic cult before their final night at the Isle Tide Hotel. Save Eleanor Malone by making decisions, collecting clues, solving puzzles and unlocking hidden scenes and endings.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. G.A.M.M.A.
description:
G.A.M.M.A. stands for Grok's Automated Modular Modpack for Anomaly.

G.A.M.M.A. aims at providing a balanced survival, scavenging, cooking, crafting and repairing focused experience with a long progression and smooth gameplay.

The main motivation behind this project is to provide an easy to install, automatically updated and modular modding platform for Stalker Anomaly, with base parameters and gameplay mechanics setup to create a meaningful and enjoyable sense of progression.

title: Gundham's Calamitous Quest for Coochie
description: Gundham Tanaka, the Supreme Overlord of Ice, awakens one morning to embark on a quest. A truly calamitous quest for one of the greatest treasures known to the nine realms - coochie.

title: Paper Lily: Chapter 1
description:
Something terrible has happened. You can’t bear to think about it - but you can’t live like this anymore. You stopped attending school, you haven’t left your house in months, you have no reason to get out of bed anymore. There are no choices left.

No choice except... that strange golden letter.

It’s time to get your life back together.

One last try.

title: Almanaque Recreio
description: Almanaque Recreio is an educational CD-ROM game in which you answer general knowledge questions in order to complete a virtual sticker album. You can consult an in-game encyclopedia with articles, maps, and flags to help you with this task.

title: Lose95
description: Lose95 yourself to the depths of your folders and try to make space for the downloads!

title: The Long Dark: Tales from the Far Territory
description: The first paid Expansion for the award-winning survival experience, THE LONG DARK. Explore the vast and mysterious Far Territory, deep in the heart of Great Bear. Extract its dark secrets. Navigate its treacherous Regions. And most of all: strive to survive.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Blood for the Blood God III
description: Blood for The Blood God brings a number of gory, mature-rated effects to Total War: Warhammer III

title: 20XX: Hawk Character
description: This DLC introduces Hawk, a powerful playable Contractor capable of using 20XX's awesome Powers to the fullest.

title: Cave Heroes
description: Lead a party of Cave Heroes to explore dungeons, battle monsters and defeat tough archdemons. Build your village, collect loot, rescue pets and much more in this idle RPG.

title: Kiss My Camera
description: Dominate Hollywood by snapping NSFW ads and win the hearts of all the famous girls

title: Idle Cave Miner
description: Idle Cave Miner is an idle game about crafting items, mining gems, and building your team of miners. Prestige, craft, and travel to other mines to increase your strength to dig deeper, and find what lurks below.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Pro Train - DB Class 44
description: These powerful three cylinder heavy goods steam locomotives were built for the Deutsche Reichsbahn for use on the mountain regions of Germany. They were numbered 44 001-44 1989. This steam locomotive and tender features PBR materials, and a realistic cab view.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: Pro Train - DB Class 44
description: These powerful three cylinder heavy goods steam locomotives were built for the Deutsche Reichsbahn for use on the mountain regions of Germany. They were numbered 44 001-44 1989. This steam locomotive and tender features PBR materials, and a realistic cab view.

title: Truck World: Australia
description: Travel across Australia behind the wheel of the mighty Road Train! Haul extreme cargo thousands of miles and explore the Outback's wilderness in some of the most intense conditions on earth!

title: Train Sim World 2: Northern Trans-Pennine: Manchester - Leeds
description: Towering moors, challenging grades and tight curves are yours to conquer in Train Sim World 2: Northern Trans-Pennine, bringing a bygone era of British Rail roaring back to life.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - New England Mountains
description:
Welcome to New England Mountains!

Grab your gear and get ready to explore the majestic Appalachian Mountains! Pit your wits against a new Great One, discover three remastered animals, and check in with an old friend in this beautiful location.

title: For Honor: Medjay Hero
description: Free Heathmoor from the curse unleashed by Bolthorn with the help of the first Egyptian hero in For Honor, the Medjay.

title: For Honor: Pirate Hero
description: Bold, passionate, and the captain, the Pirate hero is coming to Heathmoor this season seeking lost treasures and relics.

title: Deliver us the Moon: Digital Deluxe
description:
Deliver Us the Moon is a sci-fi adventure game developed by KeokeN Interactive and released in 2019. Set in a near future where Earth's resources are nearly depleted, the game follows a lone astronaut on a mission to the Moon to restore energy to the planet. Players explore abandoned lunar bases and use tools to solve environmental puzzles while uncovering the fate of the people who once lived there. The game combines narrative-driven exploration with light puzzle-solving elements and offers a mix of first-person and third-person perspectives.

Deliver Us the Moon: Digital Deluxe is a special edition of Deliver Us the Moon. It includes the base game along with the official soundtrack.

title: Aven Colony: The Cerulean Vale
description: Explore the treacherous badlands of Cerulean Vale. This additional sandbox map features the harshest environment yet, and the greatest rewards. Push yourself to the limit of extrasolar survival!

title: Mutant Football League: New Yuck Threats
description: The Threats have done a great job of building around QB Stack Killson and infusing talent on both sides of the ball. With three #1 picks in this year’s draft, they added speed on the offense and nastiness on the D-Line. The secondary covers like a blanket and stings like a bee with the additions of D.J. Bleed Jr. and Saucy Charredner. This is a hungry young team ready to take off.

title: Dead Space: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: The Dead Space Digital Deluxe Edition includes the base game and five exclusive cosmetics (three Unique Suits and two Suit Textures). It's everything you need to look your best while surviving the horrors aboard the USG Ishimura.

title: Cities: Skylines - African Vibes
description: Influenced by traditional African music, this Radio Station will inspire every city planner with 16 tracks and more than one hour of music.

title: City of Gangsters: Bourbon Bootlegging
description: Cincinnati - On the Ohio River just across from Kentucky with its long history of distilling whiskey and bourbon. A new challenge presented by the city's singular geography with hills, distinct neighborhoods, and the Ohio River cutting off valuable resources in Kentucky.

title: Dead by Daylight: The 80's Suitcase
description:
Our five dear victi… friends, have decided that if they were to be savagely murdered, they might as well do it with style!

Dress your favourite survivor with iconic pieces of fashion from the 80’s!
The 80’s Suitcase includes:
- The Tartan Special Top, The Skull Print Top, the Siberian Tiger Legs, the Stripes of Power and the Ripped Leggings, for Nea
- The Patches Denim Jacket, the Ripped Jeans and the Leather Pants, for Jake
- The College Letterman, the Hooded Training Top, the Sports Leggings and the Mauve Presentation Pants, for Meg
- The Two-tone Coat, the Electric Jacket, the Pale Jeans and the Red Flash Boots, for Claudette
- The Surf Tones and Dwight Cubed t-shirts, the Brown Slacks and the Watermelon Pants, for Dwight

These cosmetics were included in the base game for console releases.

title: Dead by Daylight: The Bloodstained Sack
description:
A shapeless thing, soaked in blood, holding unholy gifts for the creatures of nightmares. The Bloodstained Sack will allow you to pick up your favourite killing outfit before you start your next chase.
This pack includes 8 new outfits for the Killers:
- The "Iron Man" and "Rogi" masks for the Trapper
- The "Swift Strikes" and "OWl" head paints with cloaks for the Wraith
- The “Scarecrow” outfit and the “Rancher’s” vest and hat for the Hillbilly
- The "Sand Bag" mask and "WW2 Nurse Uniform" outfit for the Nurse, added a month after release.

These cosmetics were included in the base game for console releases.

title: Dead by Daylight: Charity Case
description: The Charity Case is a collection of 26 cosmetic items for many of the Dead by Daylight survivors and killers. It contains 20 brand new customization options based on your favorite broadcasters and 6 previously exclusive items from old friends.

title: Blasphemous: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: A foul curse has fallen upon the land of Cvstodia and all its inhabitants - it is simply known as The Miracle. Do you wish to cleanse the land and help the people of Cvstodia? Then the Blasphemous Digital Deluxe Edition is what you seek.

title: Cities: Skylines - Airports
description: The Airports expansion allows you to build your own airport areas, set up gates and connect them via concourse networks. Design your dream airports, from small airfields to large international hubs.

title: Farmer's Dynasty: Potatoes & Beets
description: Farmer's Dynasty: Potatoes & Beets DLC expands your extensive vegetable assortment. With new machines it ensures the promising cultivation and harvesting of your new products!

title: Super Psycho Baseball
description: Welcome to Super Psycho Baseball, a sadistic home-run hitting roguelike in which you try to conquer a gang of pitch-slinging bosses, each more psychotic than the last. Come face five fully-realized pitchers, rack up powerups, and reach the top!

title: Doukoku Soshite...
description: Remastered version of the 1998 Sega Saturn game, featuring high resolution art, previously unused CG's, additional writing by the original scenario writer and implementation of new features like a "hint mode".

title: Black Squad Royal Road
description: Black Squad Royal Road is Newest version of Black Squad Classic, first-person-shooter game.

title: Apt. Map
description: Wondrous floating eye game.

title: Furry Glory
description: Furry Glory is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely FURRY Girls. The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: X Invader
description: 'X Invader' is a roguelite game where you play a hacker infiltrating corporation servers. Join the 'Rinascita' group to uncover hidden secrets. Use colleagues' add-ons to defeat security codes.

title: Star Survivor
description: The last ship against the endless. Exterminate as many as you can, and gather points to upgrade your ship from a crafted deck of equipment and power-ups. Will your choices be enough to overcome the thousands hunting you? Survive the swarm in this rogue-lite + survivors + asteroids mashup.

title: Need for Russia 4: Moscow Nights
description: Need for Russia 4: White Nights is the fourth part of a series of arcade racing games with cars from across the eastern border in leading roles. Once again, players have the opportunity to sit behind the wheel of Soviet products and Russian automotive thought.

title: Falsepine
description: Join a long lineage of Hunters as you run and gun through the wild west in this action rogue-like. Take on Bounties, Unlock powerful weapons and come face-to-face with a gallery of terrifying monsters.

title: Jump the Gun
description: Think you can make it out? Many have tried… All have failed. Traverse the unforgiving cave and do impossible jumps with your rocket launcher and shotgun.

title: Inheritance: Ladeina's Path
description: An adult action adventure with exploration and a rich story.

title: MultiVersus: Season 2
description: Season 2 contains a new battle pass, along with new cosmetics, maps, and characters including Marvin the Martian.

title: Fall Guys: Season 3 - Sunken Secrets
description:
Deep breath, Beans - we’re heading underwater. Sunken Secrets await in Fall Guys: Season 3!

This season, explore a lost city under the sea! These crumbling courses are in need of repair, so get ready to dodge the dangers of the deep, including wonky obstacles and the tentacles of a mighty kraken! The city's former inhabitants also built colossal slime slides, so take a leap for a quick but perilous slip to the finish line!

title: The Deadly Cursed Enjmin Steamroller in: The Bloody Killing on Wheel in the Atrium
description: You're playing a cursed steamroller that must kill cultists to summon the demon that cursed you.

title: The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden
description: Modeled after the anime. The Eminence in Shadow RPG is a continues action style RPG With combo skills and ultimate's to change the tide of battle. The units are reskinned as A/S/SS/SS+ and can be different elements depending on there rarity. It is highly recommended to start building a single element team as soon as you can to truly dominate the battlefield!

title: Sexy Waifu
description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

title: Dark Riddle
description: Find out the scary secrets of the neighbor.

title: Sqube Darkness
description: A unique endless running game. Only 1% of the racers reached 5000 meters!

title: Kiro the Kosmonaut
description: Kiro the Kosmonaut is a casual space-themed platformer game. Embark on a journey through the solar system and prove that you have what it takes to reach Pluto in one piece! You'll visit planets, pass the asteroid belt, evade obstacles while managing your fuel and health!

title: Midnight Maid Night
description:
The Midnight Maids are a small, local cleaning service.

After their 2 o'clock appointment abruptly cancels on them, they suddenly find themselves short of funds.

To make up the difference, they accept a side job moving items out of a client's newly purchased mansion.

However, the job proves to be more difficult than expected when the estate's unresolved history begins to resurface.

title: Carbon Steel
description: "Carbon Steel" is an experimental puzzle horror game, where you conduct unethical research in a hastily rebuilt laboratory. Work out how to operate miscellaneous machines, cross-check data tables and procure general anaesthesia. The difference between life and death can be any overlooked detail.

title: ToontownRonpa: Citizens of Distrust
description: Toontown, home of the silly and fun toons of kinds, what could possibly disturb such a way of life? The answer is quite simple, a game that will threaten the livelihood of Toontown's most well-known figures, including Toontown's current Leader Flippy. Who will make it out of this killing game? That is for you to find out...

title: Yume Kart
description: A cancelled Yume Nikki kart racer fan game. A few early versions were released, but were taken offline.

title: Deserted Island
description: stranded on a island with friends, what will be your adventure?

title: Space Adventure
description: Space Adventure delivers an exciting endless-run experience set deep in the cosmos. Steer your spacecraft left and right to avoid asteroids, collect valuable coins, and chase new high scores. Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and endless challenges make every run a thrilling journey through space.

title: Lala Hentai
description: Great relaxing hentai style puzzle game. Cute and beautiful anime girls for every taste. Great musical accompaniment and juicy drawings ‍♀️

title: Kamaria
description: Ahoyy!!, Let’s fight em all. It's time to find a way back to the future from this mysterious island!! But wait? what kind of stones on the island is this, there is some kind of power in it. May that be the way back home? Let's find out!! Action, Adventure and RPG game (Single Player)

title: Mindworks: The Great Division
description: A choice-based visual novel game about science, division, and the false ideology of knowledge. Each and every one of your choices will determine whether the disciplines will end in unity or complete division. The key to eternal knowledge is in your hands.

title: The Spectator
description: The world is on the verge of collapse. The once fertile lands have become barren. The sun, once a beacon of life, has become a sign of terror. The temperature is unbearable. Living things live in constant fear and seek shelter from the scorching light.

title: L30-P4RD
description: L30-P4RD is Sci-Fi Top-down shooter. You explore planets as a member of the L30-P4RD, a special force that pioneered planets for civilization.

You wake up to some radiating emotions floating from the other room... It's a busted memory machine, radiating the world and splitting it in two. It's up to you to find the missing parts of the machine and piece it back together again!

title: Nasu Plus
description: This is a shmup Yume Nikki fangame using the character from Yume Nikki's NASU minigame.

title: Miss Kawaii 3
description: Surrounded by many beautiful girls, a mind-blowing, sexy journey has started. Relax, clear your mind and enjoy.

title: Native Problems
description: "Native Problems" is a 2D top down game about an Indian who beats the souls in the form of skulls towards the evil spirits that are chasing the player. With every new level, evil spirits become stronger and angrier, and you need to have time to save ladies and stay alive.

title: Outdoor Adventures With Marisa Kirisame: Fishing
description: Marisa invites you for a fun little activity with her! It's none other than fishing! Capture fish in a cute little mini game and enjoy the dialogue with Marisa in this campy, feel-good expansion to the game!

title: A Slime In Time
description: Dive into a world where a simple slime must help a 100 year old sentient blender, Sir Blendsworth, retrieve chocolate covered ice cream for his 100th birthday! Jump from platform to platform, moving through time to find a clear path, but beware. The higher you climb, the farther you fall.

title: Primal Age
description: "Primal Age" is a 2D top-down battle royale game. The player must dodge enemy attacks, collect meat from enemies and be able to collect more food before the end of each round. The level is constantly getting smaller, so only one will survive!

title: The Asher Asylum
description: Explore the abandoned Asher Asylum in an effort to find a missing cop. Learn about the horrors plaguing the old asylum, and try to find a way to stop its cursed residents from leaving. This indie horror FPS is designed as a throw-back to the late 2000s indie horror scene.

title: Furry Immersion
description: Furry Immersion is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely FURRY Girls. The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Festive Finds: Happy Holidays Calendar
description: Open a door a day to find a festive ‘spot the difference’ puzzle or ‘sleigh’ them all in one short, sweet spotting session. The choice is yours!

title: Nightmare Inside
description: Join Finn on his adventure through the most beautiful periods of his adolescence! Finn, a 16 year old boy, lives in a cute town with his mother and friends. So, what will happen in his life? Put on your coats to find out, because Norway is cold! This game is not suitable for all audiences.

title: Tropico 6: New Frontiers

title: Dead by Daylight: Forged in Fog Chapter

title: Friday Night Funkin' B-Side Remixes
description:

Welcome to the new and improved version of B-Side Remixes:
B-Side Redux

description:
Help this stupid girl earn some extra cash by playing a simple game!

Seiko: High! Low! is a relatively simple card game in which you help Seiko, a girl who, although optimistic, isn't especially clever, earn some extra cash.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Bardock: Alone Against Fate
description: Experience the story of Goku's father, Bardock, who fought alone against his fate in this New Story. This is the story of one who stood alone against the scum of the universe. Bardock, warrior of Saiyan race, spent his days invading planets with his fellow soldiers. description:

The Different Future DLC includes new scenario chapters and side episodes that present alternate story beats and character interactions not in the base release. It adds fresh missions and challenge-focused stages, expanded boss encounters, endgame modifiers, plus extra gear and progression options that deepen replayability and provide tougher post‑story content.

description: River of Blood will feature a new story campaign with an enthralling five map mission that has players traveling upriver, stopping at different points along the way to collect supplies and take on new enemy threats. There will a new Cleaner that joins the roster with this new expansion. She is called Tala, a former cultist outcast, who has now turned Cleaner and is accompanied by a Ridden companion called Jeff, a friendly Tallboy that can be summoned to assist the team. Tala can summon Jeff with a whistle or other Cleaners on her team. Rivers of Blood will feature eight exclusive character skins and 12 exclusive weapon skins. It also has new weapons, accessories, and cards.

title: Apotris
description: A homebrew Tetris-like block stacking game for GameBoy Advance. Apotris features 11 game modes and the ability to edit the appearance of pieces in-game.

title: Reksio i Kretes: Odkop
description: This is a retro-style fan game, the events of which take place in an indefinite time after canonical adventures. There will be quite a strong theme of nostalgia - we will meet many familiar characters, go through similar mini-games and visit places we know. The game uses the formula of Reksio's Adventures (adventure game interspersed with mini-games) adapted to pixel art; the best comparison I can find in the gaming industry is Oneshot.

title: Awaken
description: Awaken brings Lovecraftian horror to the beloved 2D side scroller genre. Make your way through the strange forest while encountering inexcplicable forces and try to keep your sanity as you piece together the mystery of your sister's disappearance.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Megami Tensei Gaiden - Shinyaku Last Bible III - Mugen no Eiyuu
description:
Gather round, demons. Awaken, heroes. A tale of strange evil passed down from generation to generation on the frontier planet of Damir.

In addition to the series' customary "Nakama System" in which players negotiate with demonic beasts that stand in their way as enemies and, if successful, are lent power, this title also features the "Obedience Attack," in which defeated demonic beasts recognize your power and become your befrienders, enabling you to collect befrienders more efficiently. Together with your unique friends and fellow travelers, you will unravel the truth of the history passed down to you on the planet Damir.

title: Dark Siren
description: Be careful not to be captured by the Dark Siren, find the note left by the sailors, uncover the truth, and escape.

title: Reflex King of Elements
description: Reflex King of Elements is a one player game also 2D-platformer game with 10 of the hardest levels! It has 6 strong enemies you have to fight throughout the game with traps in different variations! This game come with its own health bar, stamina bar, fire blast count and money count with no time!

title: The Game of Life 2: Under the Sea
description: Swim through a new life adventure in Under the Sea world! Flash your fins in the Mermaid outfit and become one with marine life in the Seahorse Onesie. Face your first crossroads in the Seaweed Forest and make a splash in the Bustling Reef. In this watery world, every choice turns the tide!

title: An Average Day at the Cat Cafe
description:
All manners of creatures line down the block to get your signature drinks!
but how long can you keep the cafe open, when strange customers arise in the night?

title: Zombie Shooting Star: Arcade
description: You become a beautiful combatant Rudy. On the planet XX full of mutants and zombies. Defeat zombies and mutants, find and destroy Mutant Core before it regains power!

title: Satisfactory: Update 7
description:
Blueprints
The Blueprint Designer
In this brand-new building you will be able to design, adjust, and save Blueprints for use in your factory. Anything that fits inside the confines of the Designer (4 by 4 Foundations and 8 Walls in height) you will be able to build with a single click as a Blueprint.

Building Blueprints
Any Blueprint you save in the designer is added to the Blueprints Build Menu Tab, which you can organise as you see fit. From there you can select it like any other building or add it to your Hotbar. Blueprints have some unique build modes of their own, one focused on detailed control and the other on snapping with other Blueprints.

Creature Game Modes
Passive and Retaliating
These are the two new modes we added for Creature hostility which allow you to adjust how to interact with the combat aspect of Satisfactory. If you do want to fight, but want more control over the when and how, the Retaliating mode is for you. Creatures will only attack you if you attack them first, and this works per single creature. So, if you want to fight a group of Hogs or other creatures one after the other, you can do that now.

Passive mode is exactly what it says: All creatures will remain passive, no matter if you attack them or not. If you want to enjoy Satisfactory without the action aspects, Passive mode gets the job done.

You can set your preferred Creature hostility in the Escape Menu under ‘Advanced Gameplay Settings’.

In the future
This is mostly what we have in mind for allowing you to customise your experience with Creatures. In the future we are planning to implement more game modes that allow you to adjust how you play Satisfactory. But that is for after Update 7.

title: Valheim: Mistlands
description: At long last it’s finally here – the voyage to the Mistlands!

title: Lilith.pk3
description:
The most avant-garde Doom will ever get. Obviously not a WAD for everyone, the core target for such a mod is mainly people who are in video game glitches, corruptions and to some extent, creepypastas (whether that love is ironic or not). Nothing works as it is supposed to. You can hardly understand most of the things that are happening to you. Some of the custom monsters (like the hitscanning corrupted pinky) will put you on edge and keep you paranoid about the ruleset of the game.

The aesthetic of lilith.pk3 is one of a kind, horribly mangling the rendering engine of old ZDoom beyond belief to disform sprites, textures, text and even sound effects. The end result makes close to no sense, your Doom marine sprite is heavily dislocated and looks more like one of those creatures from Alien than a human being and the list goes on and on. The confused looks obviously doesn't always make for clean or concise gameplay, especially in later levels which crank the confusion up to eleven and manipulate the level geometry to do things you thought weren't possible in the game. Even basic things like crushers, slime pits or a turnstile look horribly out of shape and makes the player uncomfortable.

This is essentially what lilith boils down to: an unfamilarity to something we thought we knew by heart, a rising sense of uncomfort as the level design makes less and less sense and offering the player a new perspective on what Doom is. Don't play lilith expecting top-notch Doom gameplay, but play it for the one of a kind experience it offers you. For the better and for the worse, there are no WADs like lilith anywhere and there will never be.

title: Divinity Fatum
description: The protagonist wakes up in a cold rainy city not remembering anything. The city seemingly goes on forever, and the protagonist takes up searching for other beings. In her quest to find another person, she comes along many clues concerning a mysterious girl named Sophia, who is apparently also trapped in the endless city, and her own identity.

description: Maurice: In The Predator's Nest is a first-person horror, survival game where players take on the role of a survivor, or a predator. You and four other survivors will do everything possible to escape and survive while a predator tracks you down and hunt you.

title: One Wheel Guy
description: One Wheel Guy is a fun and challenging platforming game where you control a guy on a unicycle and try to guide him to the goal at the end of each level.

title: WordSpiral
description: Find words on the WordSpiral to eliminate them from the game board.

description: Project: Playtime is a Free-to-Play multiplayer horror game where six players attempt to create one giant toy while surviving a terrifying monster that roams the toy factory. A seventh player controls the monster and is given only one goal: Kill Everyone In Sight The Flesh Demands Invitation

title: Sonic Advance Revamped Lite
description: Sonic Advance Revamped is a remake and slight reimagining of the original Sonic Advance on the GBA, made from the ground up; a passion project designed to be the definitive way to play Sonic Advance! it's a passion project designed to be the definitive way to play Sonic Advance, with better hazard placement, a 16:9 aspect ratio, patched-up levels and bosses, completely redesigned Special Stages, the smoothest sprites from each GBA Sonic title (with some special cases and custom sprites here and there), re-implemented unused/beta elements, and true classic Sonic controls to make the game feel even better.

It takes on an 8-bit Sega Master System style and is designed to look as authentic to the system as possible (I think).

description:
Sonic Advance X is a 3D Action Platformer fangame for the Sonic the Hedgehog series. Dr. Eggman has returned with yet another scheme to take over the world. However, this time he aims to conquer the world across every dimension. It’s up to Sonic, Blaze, and their friends to put an end to the doctors most dangerous plan yet.

The X represents two key things, the roman numeral for 10; aka the number of playable characters, and the X-Dimension, an area that will play a major role in this games story.

title: Sonic Calamity
description: A 3D Sonic fan game developed by Possqueen and a few friends.

title: Mob Control
description:
Launch people onto multiplier gates to increase your crowd and capture all the bases!
Avoid the red gates and push back the red crowd, trying to ruin your fun!

How many people can you gather?

title: There Was a Mixup at the Factory!
description:
One of Funny Jester's duties as president of the Fiscal Jesters is quality control of the group's officially licensed fruit snacks, Juicy Jesters. However, there was a mixup at the factory and the Peachy Platinum gummies were replaced with actual platinum coins!

To preserve the financial solvency of the Fiscal Jesters, you simply must match as many rows or columns of snacks as possible, and fish out as many coins as you can before your forklift breaks down! But be careful, there have been other mixups at this factory before, and there will be more mixups at the factory.

description: Play as Elma and Harper, two tweens who may or may not have inadvertently summoned the evil Pumpking, who has swiped the whole neighborhood's Halloween candy and hidden it inside his army of tiny, adorable decorative gourds. Smash the pumpkins to find candy, then chow down. Once you're turbo-charged with sugar, transform into a costume-clad avenger and bash the Pumpking until he explodes! Master four unique levels and go for a high score in one- and two-player modes.

title: Terror of Sea
description: 2D Multiplayer MMORPG Pirate Game

description: Atomic Cannon is a fun arcade game that is easy to learn but difficult to master. In this strategic tank artillery duel you battle against computers or friends on 25 different landscapes. Players take turns aiming and firing at each other with over 100 weapons of mass destruction including nuclear bombs.

title: Diamonds on the forest
description: A short platformer game with an increasing difficult and some cool graphics.

title: Metamon
description: Free-To-Play PvX Monster Hunter game and universe.

title: Night in the Unpleasant House
description:
A twisted tale of loss, revenge, local politics, and pseudoscience (among other things), Night in the Unpleasant House is a branching work of interactive fiction.
It's been ten years since your father vanished while investigating strange happenings surrounding his boss—The Mayor.
Now you follow in your father's footsteps. Can you find out what happened to him and uncover the Mayor's dark secrets?
After working your way into the Mayor’s good graces, you’ve at last discovered the location of his oft whispered-of house—a place where his enemies vanish, only to return gibbering, mindless lumps… if they return at all.
Search the house, uncover the clues, and make decisions that will ultimately determine how—and if—you survive the night.
During your night exploring the house, you'll try to uncover the secrets the Mayor has striven to bury and find out what happened to your father. Or maybe you won't! Other paths lay before you, and with thirteen different endings the choices you make will determine your ultimate fate.

description: Ruler of the Waves 1916 is a naval combat game and turret-based shooter. The game follows, in a fictional sense, the major battlecruiser engagements in WWI. The player must utilize multiple turrets on multiple ships to maximize their firepower.

title: Robolifter
description: Robolifter is a sci-fi sokibanish puzzle game where you level by level repair the spaceship. You are the last working Lifter bot and the last hope of your companion - Repair AI. Help her to fix the damage and investigate what caused the critical shutdown.

title: Brave Soldier: Invasion of Cyborgs
description: Brave Soldier: Invasion Of Cyborgs is a pixel art platform game with a lot of action. Help the soldier save the world from the Cyborg Invasion! Good Luck!

title: Springblades
description: Springblades is an action RPG where you battle your way through a fantasy island filled with funny characters. Time your attacks and dodge enemy blows in exhilarating battles. Fight beehives, dragons and ordinary peasants on your epic quest to find 3 mysterious gems . . .

description:
Command legendary heroes to reshape a land fractured by broken oaths, reckless war, and a secret search for arcane power. The ancient artifacts and powerful weapons you discover will empower your cast of 30 playable characters as they form bonds and battle their way into legend.

Dark Deity: Complete Edition includes:
• Dark Deity - The Game
• Dark Deity - Suns Out, Swords Out
• Dark Deity - Digital Artbook
• Dark Deity - Soundtrack

title: Boat Train
description: A chess-inspired roguelike with flash-inspired graphics. As King, accumulate and command your army across a series of procedurally generated train carts. Outsmart a variety of unique enemies, capture them, and add them to your army... but one wrong step, and you lose them forever!

description: The cutest puzzle action game ever! Hamsters are so cute!

title: Pair of Stamps
description: This fun find-a-pair puzzle game will help improve your attention and memory, making you smile and sometimes think, both the kid and the bearded guy.

In your case, one of them has escaped and it's up to you to continue your research or escape the facility.

title: Laruaville 4 Christmas Match 3 Puzzle

title: Thunderbolt Poker

title: Where is a Toilet!?
description: 'Where is a Toilet!?' is a simple running-platformer game using only move and jump key. Player is reach to the Goal avoiding obstacles. Player also can get a combo bonus through stomping villains. Two or more combo bonus get player faster and invincible, it is a important key to the victory.

title: Cuana
description: You don't have to be born a superhero. Play and see how the ordinary beans from the grocery changed the life of a typical youngster.

title: Bacchanalia
description: As an extra actress, you are chosen by Mysterious Theatre, which will change your life. This is not only a huge gift from Gods, but also a great challenge to human nature. Will the rising star be devoured by temptation, or stand with the Mr.Right to fight against the Gods?

title: Sonic Gather Battle
description:
Sonic Gather Battle is a fan game based on the Sonic the Hedgehog series, featuring characters from Super Mario Bros, Mega Man X, and Bleach. It uses the Little Fighter MD-2 game engine and is a mix of arcade beat-em-up and multiplayer game.

The game is best known for it's inclusion of a trojan. Not all of its effects are currently known, but it contains DRM that performs malicious actions to afflicted computers and makes the game itself unplayable. The game's creator apparently put the malicious code into the game to prevent people from ripping sprites from it, despite his attempts, these sprites were ripped and sent to the internet.

title: Best Friends Forever
description: Help unite Petey and Patty in our brand new game, Best Friends! It's amazingly addictive, with wonderful physics, whimsical graphics, and charming speech sounds!

title: Myara Story 1: Hurricane of the Ancient One
description: A vertical scrolling danmaku-style somewhat story-heavy game.

title: Magicus
description:
Increase your damage by matching 3 in a row.
At first, the battles are simple.
Gradually, depending on the color, matching will activate various effects for a more exhilarating time.
In addition, you can save colors to perform magical attacks, or change a disadvantageous situation by shuffling.
These puzzles are speed battles with no waiting time.

The player takes the role of Marisa Kirisame who shoots through available stages using both primary weapon, secondary weapon and an unlimited supply of gravity bombs. The player can use focus which slows down the player's movement, makes the collision box visible, and focuses the player's attack to secondary weapon. To activate gravity bomb, the gravity gauge must reach 100% and player must hold the bomb button until the gauge is emptied. When activated, an explosion damages all on-screen enemies and destroys all on-screen enemy bullets. Each level ends with a boss fight and the game begins with three lives, but the option to continue is not given when all lives are lost.

title: De Tres al Cuarto
description: A deckbuilding comedy game about a couple of small-time comedians.

title: Coldline
description:
A 50 megaton nuclear warhead will strike New York City in 10 minutes.

I think it's time to.... call the president.

description: Trigaea is an epic 272,000-word piece of interactive fiction. It's a combination of a sci-fi novel and an RPG adventure game, where you are in control of the story.

description: The “Pretty Girls" series now includes "2048" slide puzzle! This is a strategic "2048" number game where you combine number blocks to create larger number blocks and defeat your enemies by hitting them with those blocks.

title: Gentleman Dress Up
description:

title: Christmas Wonderland 13: Collector's Edition
description:
Santa’s Magical Christmas Wonderland Adventure for All the Family to Enjoy! Enjoy magnificent Holiday Festivities in Springfield. Help Santa at the North Pole.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Check out spectacular bonus locations for more holiday fun!
- Enjoy exclusive wallpapers and seasonal soundtrack
- Explore the mega collection of bonus puzzles
- Earn special Extreme Mode rewards

The game offers a single-player roguelike mode and 2 online PVP modes. You will fight with others by playing various types of cards you draw from a shared deck.

title: Sonic Colors: Ultimate - Day One Edition
Star Wars Jedi: Survivor - Deluxe Edition
description:

This narratively driven, single-player title picks up five years after the events of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order and follows Cal’s increasingly desperate fight as the galaxy descends further into darkness. Pushed to the edges of the galaxy by the Empire, Cal will find himself surrounded by threats new and familiar. As one of the last surviving Jedi Knights, Cal is driven to make a stand during the galaxy’s darkest times — but how far is he willing to go to protect himself, his crew, and the legacy of the Jedi Order?

The Deluxe Edition includes exclusive cosmetic items for Cal, inspired by Han Solo and Luke Skywalker, as seen in Star Wars: A New Hope.

title: Spire of Glory
description: Indie Roguelike Autobattler Poolbuilder

title: CarX Street
description: Conquer mountain roads, highways, and city streets. Build your dream car with detailed tuning that unleashes the potential of “CarX Technology” physics. Take part in thrilling races, enjoying realistic gameplay and dynamic driving.

title: DogeRift
description: Dogerift is a game, where you control cute dogs (so called Doge) and have fun with your friends while playing football or other minigames similiar to Fall Guys. Also you can earn a cryptocurrency called Dogef, which is used to power up your Doge.

title: Mongol
description: Just a weird game.

title: Face Down
description: Play an unfair card game against a cruel monster.

title: Click to Ten
description: Click to ten is an interactive clicking game where you click it and you get it to go up there.

title: Akai Ito & Aoi Shiro HD Remaster
