description:
Akai Ito is set in the present age, the game unfolds from the point of view of Kei Hato, a girl who has a special blood called "Nieno Chi". A special system called the blood sucking system is used.

Aoi Shiro is an adventure game that sets stage in both the modern real world and a mythical world. Aoi Shiro takes place in the same universe as its predecessor, Akai Ito.

title: Mike's Arcade
description: New 3D games inspired by classic arcade favorites, complete with game cabinets. Blast foes, navigate mazes, rotate blocks, race at high speed, deflect balls, avoid asteroids, match colors, and jump across platforms.

title: Yanvania 2022
description: Yanvania 2022 is a Halloween themed game based on Yandere Simulator created by YandereDev for Halloween 2022. The game is a parody of Castlevania, and a re-imagining of the game parody of Yanvania: Senpai of the Night that YandereDev made in 2015.

title: Bad animals: Rabbit
description: Adventure Platformer Mix Supraland Blend, Bear Simulator, Grounded Explore, find secret improvements, solve puzzles, fight monsters, find new abilities that will help you reach new secret places. Travel time: 3-10 hours

title: I Will Never Forget You Because You Have Made Me the Happiest Dog on Earth
description: Fancy dog mom simulator.

title: Bit Hotel
description: Bit Hotel is a social-first pixel-art gaming metaverse, in which users can hang out, compete for leaderboard rewards and earn income. All in-game items (NFTs), such as characters, rooms and furniture, have been integrated on a blockchain and all have their own unique perks.

title: Pragma Arbiter
description: Pragma Arbiter is a match-based multiplayer game with a series of different game modes where you can play as a mage, rogue, or knight. The game modes include Adventure, Casual Team Battle, Ranked 3v3 Team Battle, 1v1 Duel, and Arena.

title: Sonic: Project Hero
description: Sonic - Project Hero is a 3D Sonic fangame & custom, closed source framework, made for the Unity game engine and developed by Hero. It aims to launch Sonic, Tails & Knuckles into, simply, a fun 3D adventure through various locales, to stop Dr. Eggman's new scheme. The game aims to introduce new and unique mechanics and mix-n'-match existing ones from the Sonic series, in order to create a fresh experience.

title: CanVerse
description:
Play hyper-realistic backgammon, checkers & chess with more board games coming soon.

Choose to take on your friends or computer competitors, with different levels of difficulty.

Local & online gameplay, with online support for 2 players & 62 spectators, with voice chat.

Welcome to CanVerse, the future of shared hyper-realistic tabletop gaming.

title: Picross Love
description: Picross, also known as hanjie or nonogram, is a puzzle loved around the world that consists of filling the right boxes that together form a hidden drawing. Additionally in "Picross Love", you will be accompanied by lovely women. It may not improve your concentration, but it will surely make your time more enjoyable. Do you think it's difficult? No worries! Our teacher, Pico-chan, will teach you, step by step, how to become a Picross champion!

title: Wild Tribe
description: A group of creatures called Wobblies have lived peacefully for thousands of years. But now, a dark cloud has formed over their happy village: the food and water supplies are diminishing and Hyenas are stealing resources. Can you help these simple creatures evolve into a tribe of foragers, doctors, builders and guards before it's too late? Unlock the mysteries of Tribesville by solving challenging puzzles, and defend your tribe against invaders.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 2 - Greek Mythology
description:
Overwatch 2’s first tempo tank Ramattra joins the fray, taking down enemies with his dynamic and lethal ability kit.

Battle with or against Ramattra on a brand new Escort map set high in the Himalayan peaks that takes Overwatch gameplay to frigid new heights.

An all-new Battle Pass offers more ways to play and earn mighty rewards, including epic, legendary, and mythic skins fit for the Greek Gods.

Drop into in-season events to experience fresh new and festive gameplay with limited time modes and free rewards.

title: Kuro
description: after a terrible incident, Kuro suffers from amnesia. A shrine appears in her head every night. Will she find the answer she seeks there?

title: Medusa
description: A Metroidvania about Medusa searching for a foregone creature called the Ancient Sludge. Explore eight unique regions, face hordes of menacing enemies and acquire items to help you on your adventure.

title: Deep in the Void
description:
Deep in the Void plays in a Sci-fi Universe where you, the Player, were part of a Space Expedition with others from your home World. On your way from Platina X-27 to Frek Z-Y your expedition fleet was mysteriously pulled out of your Warp drive, destroying most of the fleet and heavily damaging your ship.

Fortunately for you, during the incident you were doing an Inspection on a mining Vessel. After a couple of hours, you wake up and start to realize your situation. The mining ship's Artificial Intelligence “Cora” has started an emergency procedure and activated an emergency Station.

The Ai gives you control over the mining vessel and gives you first Instructions. She tries to scan the surroundings and tells you to start mining the asteroids close to the Station.

The goal of the Player is to construct infrastructure to help save survivors that are still alive and lost in the void. Defend yourself and your colony from enemies. The end goal of the Game is to construct a Warp Drive Device to rescue you and your people.

title: Rosetta
description: In this game, you can turn the foreign vocabulary you know (and that you didn't know until five minutes ago) into your power. Defeat the powerful enemies coming like a tide and survive tenaciously.

title: RPG Developer Bakin
description: RPG Developer Bakin (the correct pronunciation is "BAH-keen") is a game development tool that allows anyone to enjoy creating RPGs with intuitive operation and advanced features without programming. It includes a map editor, camera tool, and other tools to help you create your game, as well as graphics and sound assets that you can make your game from the day you purchase it. Games created can be distributed royalty-free with or without compensation. Now, bring “your vision of the world” to life with Bakin!

title: Emma: In the Library
description: You find yourself in a rundown public library where you meet an interesting woman with sexual appetites!

title: H2H-Xmas
description: H2H-Xmas is a Christmas-themed megawad for Doom II that was released in December 1995. The PWAD includes new music track which are based on Christmas songs, as well as many new graphics which have Christmas themes, and a new HUD. H2H-Xmas was included in the list of the top ten 1995 WADs in Doomworld's Top 100 WADs of All Time feature. It is the sequel to Xmas Doom, a small 1994 Christmas-themed minisode.

title: Startron
description: Startron is an ASCII-based space colony sim where you can mine, harvest, build and automate your way across a procedurally generated cosmos. Lead a crew of sentient cats (or dogs) as they take their first steps out and discover the mysteries of the cosmos.

title: Realm of Khaos
description: The Khaos Realm Laboratory has been taken over by the creatures from the Realm of Khaos. Shoot the enemies and kill as many as you can! Find the boss at the end... if you are willing to fight him.

title: Liftopia: One more!
description: The big adventure of a square creature!It is a somewhat nostalgic action game drawn with dots.

title: Ariokan
description: Ariokan is the online collectible card game where you can create new (and balanced) official cards to invent new combos and break the "Meta". No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns, no pay-to-win. Generated cards can be unlocked by other players, contributing to an ever-growing library of cards!

title: Two Point Campus: Space Academy
description:
Welcome aboard space cadets, as we boldly go to Two Point County’s Space Academy!

The Two Point space program is far, far away from its golden years, when rockets lit up the news and astronauts were semi-famous, like B-list actors you don't even recognise. And now the County has opened the doors to its fledgling Space Academy, Two Point needs your help on the front-lines of galactic defence, inter-dimensional diplomacy, promoting the space industry and preparing the County for foreign life. The aliens are coming; look busy.

We’ve also discovered a cluster of those cheesy space rocks caught in the County's orbit. So we need you to set up Two Point's first out-of-County campus, source alien students from all around the galaxy, and teach them everything we know about us. Conditions may be harsh out here, but we're sitting on a gold mine.

So dust off your moon boots, set phasers to fun, and get your students to reach for the stars… and their wallets.

title: Jewel Match: Winter Wonderland 2 - Collector's Edition
description: ’Tis the season for chestnuts, mistletoe, and Match-3. Travel snow-clad lands across more than 200 huge levels and rebuild a cozy village. Then start decorating the houses for the festive season. Grab a hot chocolate while you play bonus games with jigsaw puzzles, clutter, or spot the difference.

title: American Truck Simulator: Oklahoma
description:
From the grand American highways running through the hills of dusk-red rock to leading cities bustling with culture, landmarks, and businesses. Oklahoma is a diverse state shaped by its history and industries.

Located in the south of the country, "The Sooner State" generally tends to have a reputation of being a rather arid place, however, it’s much better to avoid judging this book by its cover. The state is home to wonderful national parks, several natural marvels, and historical places full of mysteries and legends. But those who are looking for something more practical instead will find their purpose as well since the local road network and a strong economy driven by natural gas and oil production will keep every trucker properly busy.

title: Sudden Market
description: The supermarket has just closed, hurry up to find and collect all the products on your list without getting caught by the security guard! A fast paced stressful action game with 2 maps and 18 levels with increasing difficulty, made for speedrunning.

title: Birdie Bartender
description: Help Birdie the bartender work her shifts so she can take a nice vacation!

title: TypeOut
description: This isn't your typical typing test. Unlock Powerups, create a loadout, and battle your way through prompts as fast and accurately as you can to allocate powerups and strategically attack your opponents in an effort to slow them down.

title: Jumpwad
description:
Jumpwad is a set of 7 monsterless platforming maps for mbf-compatible
source ports (complevel 11). Explore strange worlds! Collect gems!
Seek out the Eternal Golden Flame!

title: Upheaval
description: Master the secrets of a changing world in Upheaval, a text-based open world fantasy adventure roguelike. Explore the wilds around a remote village as you track down magic treasures, aid or disrupt factions, and match wits with an enigmatic Magician. Be ready: Upheaval is coming!

title: YAGS: Falling For You
description:
YAGS: Falling For You is a YAGS-universe game created for BaraJam 2021.

It consists of two distinct portions: A traditional visual novel and a puzzle-y minigame. The two portions are completely separate, and are enjoyable independently.

title: Zako Slayer
description: You are a female super soldier trying to escape from the invaded base by unknown intruders.

title: Wufo
description: Navigate your ship and recover Wi-Fi while dodging obstacles and fighting space enemies in the 4 worlds and 8 available bosses. You can also play together with a friend in 2D cooperative multiplayer!

title: Witch's
description: An evil witch has taken over the kingdom and you're the only one who hasn't been hit by the curse! Be yourself the savior of Farheim!

title: Strix STG
description: "Strix STG" is a "Communication-Synchronized Bullet-Hell Casual Vertical-Scrolling Shooting-Game". Let's aim to capture all 5 stages. The best feature of this game is the ability to play two-player co-op online. A simple chat using two types of fixed phrases is prepared for role sharing.

title: The Ugly Ducling
description: The Ugly Ducling is a minimalist block-based exploration and horror game, using the children's story "The Ugly Duckling" as a theme, where the player will need to find the lost pages of the protagonist's story in different biomes, while surviving.

title: Hopeless.
description: Since her parents passed away, she was forced to live by herself. Now her normal life is taken away, and she has to find her own food and bed. Her adventure starts in this crisis.

title: Àrengard: Invasion
description: Àrengard-Invasion is a beat-`em-up online-coop game. Swing your sword, shoot a ballista or cast spells to survive the Goblins siege and keep your beloved gold.

title: Dead Man's Fault
description:
A short psychological horror game about descending into a cave.
This is a short (~30 minutes) first-person psychological horror game set in a deep, dark cave.
Cave exploring is a common practice. But what happens when you overstep your boundaries? The suffocating jaws of a tight cave don't let go as easily as they grab hold of you. Deployed as part of a rescue effort, you must explore the depths of Deep Den Cave and discover what happened to the last explorer that ventured down its path. Don't get lost.

title: Hentai DevilGirl
description: Hentai DevilGirl is a relaxing puzzle game. With the theme of devil girl and 24 unique sexy girls Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

title: I Commissioned Some Bees Advent
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy Christmas/winter world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 25 art pieces to choose from, and 2500+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Keepers of the Forest
description: The Forest is in Danger. Evil forces are absorbing what magic remains and destroying all in their path. Gain ancient knowledge from powerful spell books long forgotten and create alliances with magical creatures and Gods. Build your strength and defeat the invading forces.

title: Late Photographer 6
description: A short love story

title: Lost in Memory
description: You play as a girl who has shut herself in her home and refuses to leave. she must explore and find her memories if she ever wants to escape her past. This game is inspired by Yume nikki and various classic RPG Maker horror games.

title: Metal March
description: Metal March is a newly fashioned turn-based strategy simulation game that combines chess strategy with CCG. Create a force that fits your strategy & inclinations and generate synergies by using cards and relics in order to complete your expedition successfully. March your metals to the end!

title: Palladise Island: Legendary Space
description: Palladise Island: Legendary Space It tells the story of the game master in the real world, who is transmitted to another world called Palladise because of his superb game technology, and then starts the journey to save the Palladise.

title: Nonogram: Girl's Sweets II
description: This is a puzzle game called Nonogram. Please enjoy cute and sweet anime-like illustrations by solving simple puzzles.

title: 13 Candles
description: 13 Candles is an atmospheric horror game where you play as Sara, 13 year old girl who wakes up in an abandoned hospital. Find your way to the light switch and wake up from your nightmare.

title: We Dream Standing Up
description: A short narrative game about two women dealing with life and death in a post-apocalyptic, dying world.

title: Pocket City 2
description: Build and explore your own city in this 3D sequel to the original Pocket City! Create using roads, zones, landmarks, and special buildings. Drop your avatar into the world and roam freely. Buy your own house, host events, survive disasters, and live the life of a successful mayor!

title: Nostalgic Nights at Freddy's
description: NNAF is a classic and nostalgic experience, this fangame takes the original fnaf and puts new ones hoaxes animatronics from that time, like sparky or endo, also this game has new easter eggs and mechanics

title: Tales from the Burning Sea
description: In cities sculpted from the slag of dead worlds, love, crime and fields of farmed meat await in this digital anthology of mystery and horror; a window onto a post-apocalyptic world like no other, one thousand years beyond the fall of Earth...

title: Basement of Hellish
description: Basement of Hellish is a survival horror game with zombies in 1st person. Survive and struggle to find a way out in this horror game with tense and dark atmosphere.

title: 1 Day Later: Escape Zombie Hospital
description: Escape the hospital full of zombies in a single player stealth action puzzle game. Cool story included ;) Windows version of mobile game rated 4.5 on Google Play with improvements and new features.

title: Absolution's Apple
description: A thousand years beyond the fall of Earth, a team of adventurers seeks ancient treasure and the cure to a deadly disease, in this 600 page tale of love, crime, hope and despair, in a post-apocalyptic world like no other...

title: ToHeart PSE
description: ToHeart PSE is a port of the 1999 remake of the game for Windows.

title: SuperBolt
description:
The little robot Bolt is on an adventure to save the princess Wrench from an evil bot!
Win against challanging enemies and levels!

Use the PowerUps to blast your way through walls and bots alike and Unleash the Power of the 4 bumpers to defeat the evil 404!

title: Starship Troopers: Extermination
description: Starship Troopers: Extermination drops up to 16 players right into the fight against the Bug menace in this co-op first person shooter. Suit up and ship out to a far-off front as a Trooper in the Deep Space Vanguard, an elite Special Forces group within the Mobile Infantry. It’s up to squads like yours to battle against hundreds of bloodthirsty insectoid aliens and take back fallen colonies for the Federation. The only good Bug is a dead Bug!

title: Ell's Kitchen
description:
Ever wanted to be the host of an online cooking show?

Here's your chance to experience the joys of cooking for an audience.

Play as Elliot, our chef and host of the not-yet-popular youtube series: Ell's Kitchen, as she cooks her friend's favourite foods in her girlfriend's kitchen.

title: Elevenses
description: A visual novel game that claims to be a mystery/romance genre.

title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Rise of Rasalhague
description: In a conflict that pre-dates the formation of the Star League, Join Colonel Månsdottir and the people of Rasalhague in a fight for freedom and independence from the Great Houses, and discover the Crusader 'Mech, in a new 12-mission quest line.

title: Raiders of Ruin
description: Raiders of Ruin takes the thrill of battling a mighty MMO raid boss and distils it down into a single-player experience. Study your enemies, assemble your party, and execute your strategy as you face off against dozens of challenging foes in this turn-based fantasy RPG.

title: Crazy City Driving
description: Crazy City Driving is a car driving game around the city. Get behind the wheel of one of the cars and get to the finish line, but remember your time is limited!

title: Sex and Zombies
description: Sex and Zombies - arena shooter with roguelike elements in which you have to survive by exterminating hordes of zombies. Choose from 12 different weapons, collect items and bonuses and try to last a little longer.

title: Poly Shooter
description: It as local multiplayer or single player mode fighting game where you try to survive waves of killers on several original maps. Defend yourself with many weapons and have fun with your friends : 1 vs 1, 1 vs computer, 2 vs 2, 4 vs computer... Poly shooter is your next favorite arcade game !

title: Touhou: Fading Illusion
description: A visual novel based on Touhou Project, made by fans for fans and others! Embark on the investigation of the greatest incident in Gensokyo's history and discover the terrifying truth of the youkai world with Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi and other heroines!

title: Beach Invasion 1944
description: Beach Invasion 1944 is a WWII FPS game where you defend the fortified beach against invading forces who will attack with you troops, tanks, planes and more! Use the iconic WWII weapons such as MG42, Flak88 and Panzers, prepare your defenses with mines, explosives and bonuses!

title: ArenaMania
description: Can you survive the challenges of the Arena? The progressively difficult levels and their hundreds of enemies are just looking for a way to hunt you down. Your only help is your experience and your spells leveling up after each level. If you can pick them up…

title: DFL 2
description: Endless runner inspired by American Football and the NFL. Embody a Running Back and dodge all the defenders on your way to the Endzone thanks to your skill moves!

title: Collab Ball
description: Collab Ball is an amazingly beautiful splitscreen platformer!

title: Shadow Lens
description: Monsters lurk in the dark. Use your camera to navigate unlit spaces. Find your missing daughter and discover what happened to her. Find tools to help unlock new areas to explore. Don't Die.

title: Unstable Portal
description: "Unstable Teleport" is a 2D platformer shooter where the player, jumping on platforms, shoots back from waves of enemies, exploding barrels and collecting bullets in order to reach the end and close the portals.

title: List
description: “List” is a single player first-person horror game that takes your character back to grandma’s house. As a requirement of your inheritance you must survive five nights in her home. She’s left you with a set of instructions to aid in your survival.

title: Fate Seeker: Journey
description: Fate Seeker: Journey is an action role-playing game that combines random elements of Roguelite. In this game, you will be the hero to choose talents, obtain items and combine skills to defeat enemies in every stage.

title: Pien & Paon Plus
description: Run away from the mysterious monsters "Pien" and "Pien"! A pop and cute 3D horror game!

title: Mushroom Musume
description:
Once upon a time, a lonesome Recluse wished for a daughter. A wandering witch overheard their wish, and instead granted them a pot of dirt with a strange, fungal, creature growing within. Play the role of the Recluse as you grow your adoptive child, and discover what kind of person (er, mushroom?) she will become.

Mushroom Musume is a text based life simulation game inspired by titles such as Princess Maker 2 and Alter Ego.

title: Jump Dash Soar
description: Jump Dash Soar is a frenetic, fast, and fun movement-based FPS. Build incredible speed with a powerful dash mechanic combined with rocket jumping, strafe running, slope jumps, and bounce pads!

title: Fear for Sale: Sunnyvale Story - Collector’s Edition
Harrowed Halls: Hell’s Thistle - Collector’s Edition
Haunted Train: Clashing Worlds - Collector’s Edition
Maze: The Broken Tower - Collector’s Edition
Nightfall Mysteries: Black Heart - Collector’s Edition
Nightfall Mysteries: Haunted by the Past - Collector's Edition
Phantasmat: Behind the Mask - Collector’s Edition
description: Welcome to the Ward family reunion! The Ward estate is in disrepair and its inhabitants are just as damaged. But they are your family, aren’t they? You’ll soon discover that being a member of this family isn’t just challenging – it could be deadly! Search through level after level of hidden objects and mini-games to unlock the secrets of the Ward Estate. Will you survive? Or will this family reunion be your last?

title: Phantasmat: Town of Lost Hope - Collector’s Edition
description: Phantasmat: Town of Lost Hope is the sixth installment of the Phantasmat series.

title: Phantasmat: Reign of Shadows - Collector’s Edition
Phantasmat: Curse of the Mist - Collector's Edition
description: Phantasmat: Curse of the Mist is the tenth installment of the Phantasmat series.

title: Sable Maze: Sinister Knowledge - Collector’s Edition
Sable Maze: Nightmare Shadows - Collector's Edition
Shadowplay: Whispers of the Past - Collector's Edition
Shadowplay: The Forsaken Island - Collector’s Edition
Nightmares from the Deep: The Siren’s Call - Collector’s Edition
Vampire Legends: The Untold Story of Elizabeth Bathory - Collector's Edition
Vampire Legends: The Count of New Orleans - Collector's Edition
Halloween Stories: Defying Death - Collector’s Edition
Punished Talents: Dark Knowledge - Collector's Edition
Death at Cape Porto: A Dana Knightstone Novel - Collector's Edition
Beyond: The Fading Signal - Collector’s Edition
Amnesia: The Bunker
description: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game set in a desolate WW1 Bunker. Face the oppressing terrors stalking the dark corridors. Search for and use the tools and weapons at your disposal, while keeping the lights on at all costs. Overcome fear, persevere, and make your way out alive.

title: Feng Se Lv Ren
description: Wind Traveler is a 3D adventure game in another world. It uses open scenes, exquisite character modeling, and cool skills to build a wonderful and fun adventure. Here, you will come to the chaotic star continent as a brave man, contract with the stars, unlock the exclusive star spirit, walk with cute pets, and write your own fantasy adventure story.

title: Better Call Saul Kart
description: Join Saul Goodman and his friends in this high speed wacky kart racing game. Big Trash Games promises that this is indeed a video game that can be played by humans.

title: Gyaku Shaun Sai Hanri
description: Gyaku Shaun Sai Hanri is a furry Ace Attorney fangame that was released in 2003, but was promptly taken down by CAPCOM. It was only available through CD download which would be purchased a Doujinshi events such as Comic Market. It was made by Cheshire

title: Plants vs. Zombies: Back to the Roots
description: Plants vs Zombies: Back To The Roots is a free, independently made fangame in the style of classic PVZ.

title: Danganronpa: Resort Killing
description: A new killing game begins as you and 15 other participants enter... A resort? You play as Yu Narukami from the persona series. Things seem off right from the start but things only continue to get stranger in this crossover fan game based off of the Danganronpa series by Spike Chunsoft. Featuring characters from Persona, Re:Zero, Yugioh, Super Mario, Touhou, Konosuba, River City, YiiK, Katawa Shoujo, Danganronpa, as well as Gordon Ramsey. Try to survive and uncover the truth inside this deadly resort.

title: Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant
description:
Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant is a third-person 3D Action RPG with Dungeon Crawler sections. Revive your enemies once again and make them fight alongside you!

With a completely renewed battle and companion system, travel the continent, restore the sacred city of Euda to its former glory and defeat the ominous threat that looms over the world.

Gather the powers of the Revenants, forgotten heroes of old times, create a little army of dead and defeat the Necromancer once and for all.

title: Bat Enchanter Witch
description: Take control of the witch Evelyn and escape the evil queen's castle by running, jumping and using magic to turn the bats into helpful allies.

title: Electrokinetic
description: Electrokinetic is a roguelike 3D platformer where you build your own moveset as you play. Traverse a variety of tight platforming levels with abilities new and old, trying to find secrets long missing in a randomly generated cyberscape.

title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona
description: Skelethrone is a challenging 2D action platformer with RPG elements inspired by games like Castlevania, Blasphemous and Dark Souls.

title: David Get Keen
description: Get Keen for fast-paced 3D platforming built around momentum. Run, dash, and spin through abstract levels, smash up robots, and improve your best times.

title: Mary's Arcade
description:
Mary's Arcade is a FNaF fan game that does not rely on luck or randomness. Instead, you must plan ahead in order to effectively defend yourself.

Be careful though, as sometimes fending off one mascot may bring another closer to you.

title: Vargverse
description: Vargverse is a fighting game made in M.U.G.E.N based on streamer Vinesauce Joel.

title: Bullet Heaven
description: Bullet Heaven (full title: Epic Battle Fantasy 3.3: Bullet Heaven) is a scrolling top-down shooter game created by Matt Roszak in 2011. It is a spin-off of the Epic Battle Fantasy series, to which it owes many elements of its design, including the medals, shops, and characters. Most of the foes' designs originated from Epic Battle Fantasy 3 while some of them were previews of new foes to be introduced in Epic Battle Fantasy 4.

title: Rock Life: The Rock Simulator
description: Built from the ground up, Rock Life is the next generation of immersion and simulations. Live, do, and experience what it is like to truly become one with nature... as a rock!

title: Shark! Shark!
description: Shark! Shark! is an upcoming action video game developed by NeoBird and Bonus Level Entertainment. It is an updated version of Shark! Shark!, scheduled to be released for the Intellivision Amico.

title: Super Vadimka VII: The Nightmares of The Current Continue
description: Super Vadimka VII: The Nightmares of The Current Continue is an exhilarating platformer action game that pushes the boundaries of gameplay while infusing elements of survival horror. Released on February 25, 2023, for Windows, the title is crafted by the talented duo at Kulevx and HyperTheLoopa420, featuring the iconic character, Super Vadimka, in his most challenging adventure yet. This final installment in the Super Vadimka series elevates the gaming experience with its high-quality graphics and intricately designed levels that demand precision and skill from players.

title: Trans'2: Boku to Atashi to Koibito to
description: Trans'2: Boku to Atashi to Koibito to is a cross-gender feminine-expression themed eroge developed by Catear. Protagonist Shinobu is introduced to the world of cross-gender expression by childhood friend Mizuki. The game includes both ADV-style visual novel sections and "dress-up" sections where players are able to choose how Shinobu goes out into the city.

title: The Tale of Galariel
description: You play as an orc wishing to conquer the land and make it your own, you may make allies such as Goblins, Kobolds, Dragonkin, and More. Be warned Humans and Heroes are on their way. Are you ready to conquer the land?

title: YIIK: I.V
description: YIIK I.V (1.5) is a free update which is serves as the definitive edition of YIIK: A Postmodern RPG, originally released in 2019. An unusual error manifests on April 4th, a day that echoes the enigmatic code 404. In a desperate act of innocence, a child relinquishes her name for an invitation to a birthday party, her hope tethered to the faint possibility of finding her brother. Meanwhile, Alex, a recent college graduate, returns home, only to find his reality unspooling like a threadbare tapestry. Guided by a cat which slips through the very fabric of his mind, Alex descends into the depths of his consciousness where he witnesses the impossible: a woman, locked away in an iron maiden, vanishing into thin air. A vision which ignites an undying obsession and threatens to unravel the boundaries of his world.

title: Save Scummer
description:
Save Scummer is a Seven Day Roguelike written by Jeff Lait.

It is a unique twist on roguelikes where you do not control the character directly. Instead, all you do is save/restore or perform undos, (both types of save scumming) in an attempt to reach victory.

title: MrBeast: TeamSeas
description:
It's simple, swim through the infinite ocean and pick up trash!
But be careful, along the way you may come across TNT, electric jellyfish, or aggressive sharks!

title: Marito Arcade
description: Game Developed by the youtube channel "Marito Kids", where we will be several characters, Nataria - Marito - Julian, in this scenario where we will have to kill all the "people" that come out

title: Night Stop
description: Late night stop at a gas station turns into a nightmare.

title: Midgard
description: A 3D Japanese RPG created in 1998 for PC, much in the style of the 'Diablo'. Heavy focus on dungeon-crawling with an NPC village to return to.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Halloween Hack
description: Feel the wrath of Dr. Andonuts' Rage and fight in a rap battle to the death!

title: Sonic the Hedgehog Transitions
description: A Sonic fan game set in the SatAM universe.

title: Idle Breakout
description:
Click on a brick to break it and score points. Use points to purchase new balls with different abilities and upgrade them. Balls will automatically bounce and break bricks to score more points.

For maximum brick-busting, determine which upgrades are most efficient. What is the best way to spend your money: more balls, more speed, more power? It gets complicated fast!

title: Fortnite: Chapter 4
description:
A new beginning awaits.

In the fourth Chapter of Fortnite’s Battle Royale, go forth in a new realm and get around in new ways — ride a dirt bike, roll in a snowball, launch yourself with the Shockwave Hammer, and hurdle over obstacles. Power yourself up with Reality Augments and claim territory for your squad, leaving behind Banners to declare what’s yours. And of course, venture with newly-forged weapons.

title: Tsurugihime
description: Tsurugihime is a side-scrolling action RPG. The last battle is in 100 days. It is up to the player to decide how to live until the day. Battle, ikusei, exploration, story, and even sister. "Craft" everything. An RPG that "crafts" fate.

title: Triage
description: Step into the role of a doctor in the town of Stagmarch, where an otherworldly illness is mutating residents. Get to know your patients, diagnose their illnesses, and treat them. However, you have limited medicine, and every day your patients get worse. How far will you go to save others?

title: Causality Effect
description: What if everything that went wrong on “A Red Letter Day” was not caused by what you thought? What if your teleport ripped a hole in space and time? Now you must travel through time to correct the events and set right your past.

title: Lost Industry 2
description:
Lost Industry 2 takes place in a Combine weapon factory.

Rebels in City17 are running low on usable weapons, ammo and supplies.

They decide to get the help of Gordon Freeman. The resistance members came up with a plan.

They want Doctor Freeman to sneak inside the factory silently, weaken it's defense systems and give signal for the rebels waiting outside to begin their assault.

title: Falling From the Rabbit Hole
description: Falling From The Rabbit Hole tells a tale of Alice’s sisters, as it follows the scenario of “what if Alice never discovered the rabbit hole?” As a result, her two sisters fall into Wonderland instead and are forced to fulfill Alice’s destiny to wander the land and tell the untold story of its people.

title: Infinity Nikki
description: Infinity Nikki, the fifth installment in the Nikki series by Infold Games. Step into a UE5-powered open-world styling fantasy filled with exploration, platforming, puzzles, and more. Travel across Miraland with Nikki and Momo, uncover hidden secrets, and use outfit abilities to overcome challenges and shape your style.

title: Rin ga Utau, Mirai no Neiro
description: “Rin ga Utau, Mirai no Neiro” which means “Rin’s Song, The Colorful Sound of Future” or “The Bells Sing The Future’s Timbre” is the sequel of “Mirai no Kimi to, Subete no Uta ni”.

title: Mirai no Uta to, Tsunagaru Hitomi
description: Another Vocaloid visual novel from Supplement Time. This one was released at Comiket 76.

title: Mr. Saitou
description: A short game set in the Rakuen universe about an average white-collar worker who struggles to find meaning in a life full of constant overtime and isolation. After an accident lands him in the hospital, Mr. Saitou is spirited away to a strange fantasy world where an unexpected friend takes him on a life-changing adventure.

title: Another Princess is in Our Castle
description: You play as Mario, the hero of the Mushroom Kingdom. You decide to come back to Peach's castle a few years after the princess' death, but something isn't quite right...

title: The Hypno Shop
description: You have just started your own online business, where you will be commissioned to create the perfect hypnotic spiral to help your clients get off. You'll be rated on how well you fulfill their kinks and other preferences.

title: Firefighting Simulator: The Squad
description:
With Firefighting Simulator: The Squad, you can become part of a major US city's firefighting team and experience how it feels to fight fires.

Start the siren of your fire truck, grab your hose, and fight realistic fires to save lives. Discover over 40 diverse deployment locations spread across the city inspired by the North American West Coast. Equip yourself with authentic firefighting gear such as helmets, firefighter boots, and a breathing apparatus model by well-known North American firefighting equipment manufacturers.

title: SCP: The Endurance
description: You play as a Class-D tasked with supervising 3 floors full of SCP entities through a series of nights. Will you endure til the end?

title: Farming Simulator 22: Volvo LM 845
description:
Being the very first articulated loader produced by Volvo, the BM-Volvo LM 845 brought unmatched versatility to the table. Even today, the heavy all-rounder impresses with extra-large wheels and generous ground clearance, combined with long outreach and high lift. The result is a capable and versatile wheel loader powered by a Volvo Diesel engine, introduced and produced between 1970 and 1972.

Use the BM-Volvo LM 845 to load and transport large and heavy quantities of material: Logs from harvested trees, iron ore from the mine in Silverrun Forest, or crops, bales, and big bags as well as other resources you need to transport in your daily agricultural business. With a diverse set of attachable tools, Volvo's wheel-loader is strong and versatile enough for every task of your farming operation.

title: Magic & Legend: Time Knights
description:
In Magic and Legend: Time Knights, players will follow the tale of the titular heroes as they travel through time to fight off malevolent invaders.

Both Magic and Legend feature their own unique set of abilities, letting players experiment with the right tactics and get a feel of the playstyle that suits them best. Of course, in case they can't make up their minds (because both are equally fun to use), they can always switch between the two characters at any time on the fly.

The game features 5 large sprawling levels over the time periods:
- Level 1: The Journey Begins... (Present Day)
- Level 2: Medieval Times
- Level 3: Sengoku Period
- Level 4: Ancient Rome
- Level 5: The Crown Jewel Heist (60's London)

For each level Magic and Legend have their own costumes and weapons and just for fun there are also 4 bonus levels.

Lastly, to ensure the world is safe, the boys go up against a final boss who is hell bent on taking on taking out Magic & Legend so they can take the planet for themselves.

title: 101 Card & Board Games
description: 101 Card & Board Games is a collection of board and card games for PC that was released by Eureka in 2000 in Australia.

title: Over 1000 Jigsaw Puzzles
description:
Over 1000 Jigsaw Puzzles is a fully featured jigsaw program.

Unlike some games in this genre which come with a dozen or so pictures that can be played with multiple numbers of pieces, this game comes with 1,029 pictures that of varying degrees of difficulty. It also allows the player to create their own jigsaws using half a dozen or so different styles of puzzle piece and up to six thousand pieces.

Other features include optional piece rotation, sound effects, music, an optional 'ghost' image of the completed picture, a save/load feature and an option to download additional pictures from the internet.

title: Ultimate Mah-Jongg
description: Ultimate Mah-Jongg which allows the player to play of the 1001 tile layouts, using any of seven tile images, in either 2D or 3D. This is the mode where the player has access to the editors that create new tile layouts and tile sets. This game mode plays in a window only.

title: Bitmates
description: Welcome to the world of Bitmates. A massively multiplayer online role-playing game where monkeys rule the lands. Explore, gather resources, and interact with other players in this vastly diverse world.

title: Hope Left Me
description:
You wake up in a mysterious place, alone and freezing to death, the only person around seems to be a weird girl with a long sleeve soviet jersey.

Hope Left Me is a post-noir visual novel released as a tie-in to the album of the same name by Astrophysics.

title: Le Avventure di Blue
description: A reimagining of the classic 2D RPG. - Explore the world around you to discover hidden secrets and meet "special" characters - Take on turn-based battles by breaking through enemies with powerful weapons and magic - Discover an adventure, full of surprises, cool jokes and "political incorrectness"

title: Rêves: Lettres et Ciel
description: A French rpg maker game about a postman in a world filled with magic. feature voice acting and art made by several French artists. It is a fantasy adventure game with a focus on the story and turn based battles.

title: Your Channel
description: It's a Twitch Chat integrated Bullet Hell Game, where the Streamer Plays against the Chat. Periodically the Game will Request Patterns from the Chat to be Queued up in the Next waves of Patterns thrown against the Streamer. 2 Hits, and you're out!

title: StickMUD
description: StickMUD is a free, medieval fantasy game with a graphical user interface and a depth of features. You are welcomed into the game world with maps and dashboards to complement your imagination. Join a guild and learn the ways of a Bard, Fighter, Mage, Necromancer, Ninja, Thief, Healer or Priest. Train skills in both craft and combat aligned with your guild. Participate in frequent game-wide events to earn points exchanged for gold, experience or skill training. Heroes and villains alike are invited!

title: Culto a los dioses
description:
A deck-building game in which your goal is to turn the villagers into your entourage.

Will they be loyal to you? Find out by playing cards and get them to worship you. Steal villages from other gods, sacrifice your own, and reach 100 minions. Become the most loved or feared god of all.

Turn-based game for 2 to 4 players.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Missions in Uncharted Space
description: Shrink down to toy-size and meet its iconic heroes, Buzz Lightyear and Woody. Help Woody learn the magic of childhood memories and assist Buzz as he enlists the support of Dreamlight Valley's residents to establish its first Star Command outpost. Embark on a secret Valley mission that just might see the Village gain a new resident that is truly out of this world. Get your Valley into the spirit of the season with new and exclusive items included in the Festive Star Path!

title: No T!me No Space
description: Capture the dark antimatter particles to unlock secret portals into different dimensions. A 3D FPS responsive ZEN shooter for Smartphone, Tablet, Laptop and PC. Let's play!

title: Battle Night
description:
The most unique cyber fantasy mobile game, a completely new hardcore gameplay, which will immerse you in a modern 21st century underworld

It is the year 2098, the end of the century is near, the great alliances of the world are in a great cold war with each other, while neon lights flash around the borders city under the thick fog, but the people of the city are still unaware of the situation. This city is one that lives outside the law, and is far from all countries, and has gradually become a battleground for all camps. Conflict between advanced technology and the decadent civilizations has become irreversible, and Cyberpunk has finally opened his curtains after long nights.

It was around this time on one of the street corners in a little humble detective agency, a sharp and keen detective sensed a change in the air, he quickly needed to round up a team to go and search out the hidden scheme that was in the making...

title: Destiny 2: The Witch Queen - Season of the Seraph
description: The Hive God of War moves to seize control of Rasputin’s network of weaponized satellites. In her hands, she would turn its devastating power on the Last City. To stop her, the Vanguard has authorized special covert operations armed with the Warmind’s most advanced weaponry. Agents conducting these operations are known as Seraphs.

title: Dog of Dracula 2: Cyber Monogatari
description: Dog of Dracula 2 is the conclusion of The Groomer Duology, a two-part visual novel odyssey examining the fragility of both the human and canine conditions.

title: Legends of Illarion
description:
Legends of Illarion is an RM2K3 game based on old stories from Illarion, an old online fantasy roleplaying game.

It features approximately 25+ hours of gameplay time, an epic scale story, a touch encounter system, tons of puzzles/skip puzzle functions, and a simple crafting system that allows you to create weapons/armour/items based on resources obtained after battle.

title: 150 Floors
description: 150 Floors of Magic or 150 Floors for short, is a tile-based, real-time strategy RPG where you play as a mage with either a Fire, Ice or Electric element, with more to come. Each mage has a wish they want granted or goal they want to meet. The only similarities they share is each mage wants to reach and conquer the 150th floor, granting them any wish they desire... Or so the saying goes. Beware, the floors made of tiles have a durability limit. If you attack a monster, you're also attacking the tile as well and it may break, sending the monster one floor down. The same logic also applies to you. If you fall through, you drop to the previous floor. Defeat all monsters on a floor, and ascend to the next floor. How will you fare against the 150 Floors? Will you get your wish granted?

title: Disney Classics: Master Mouse - Show Time Quiz
description: Disney Trivia Challenge, Disney's Master Mouse: Show Time Quiz is a quiz game where all the questions are based on Disney films, characters, songs etc. This is a game for one to four players, there are no computer opponents here, with three levels of difficulty. Each player selects a character, there are just four to choose from, enters their name and then the game begins. It takes place on a screen that represents a film studio, players take turns to click on a spinner which tells them how many squares they can move. Apart from the first move the players can move in any direction and the game highlights all possible moves for them. Each space on the game board is a different colour corresponding to the question category, Animation, Film, Song, Personalities and Mousellaneous, and all questions are multiple choice. If a player gets the question right they spin again and attempt another, if they get it wrong the next player takes their turn and so on. If a player lands on a space that is already occupied then there is a challenge question, all players on that square can take part ans tokens can be both won and lost. There is also a trivia vault where the player(s) can gamble one of their tokens for the vault's entire contents. Each time the player answers a question correctly they are awarded a token in that category, or in some cases a wild card token, and when five tokens have been logged for a category the player wins a medallion in that category. The object of the game is to collect a medallion in every category and at which point they will be allowed to attempt the champion question to win the game.

title: Hellpit
description:
A 3d Platformer where you evade many obstacles and traps lay in front of you.
The game is simple, just jump and move out of your way from danger. No single traps and obstacles layout are the same, use precise timing to cross safely.

title: Fisher-Price Dream Dollhouse
description: Educational children's adventure/strategy PC game developed and published by Davidson & Associates, Inc. in 1995.

title: DIG: Deep In Galaxies
description: DIG is an Action Roguelike for going solo or joining forces with up to 4 players. Get overpowered and blast your way through ever-changing scenarios to defeat The Overlord and restore freedom. Give'em hell in this galactic revolution!

title: Ravage Road
description: Ravage Road is an indie tower defense game with deckbuilding and roguelike elements that allows the players to control and build out the road they must defend using placed tiles in addition to building towers from cards in their deck.

title: When Tails Gets Bored
description:
When Tails gets Bored is a fangame that was created in the website Sonic Vegemite.

The player controls just as Sonic plays in the Mega Drive titles. Sonic must find the Special Stages to gain knowledge about why tails is bored. Beat 4 special stages to get the true ending. Besides that, the player must traverse through 9 zones (2 secret) and complete whatever hoax Estel has in store for him.

title: Western Press: TF2 Heavy
description: Gaming's favourite Heavy Weapons Guy has found himself 2Far west of 2Fort. Armed with only a minigun and a (never ending) Sandvich, his only way back to the war on BLU is through the cowfolk he's surrounded by.

title: We Love Katamari Reroll + Royal Reverie
description:
We Love Katamari Reroll + Royal Reverie is a remaster of the PS2 game We Love Katamari.

The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version! This new reroll comes with improved graphics and gameplay enhancements. In Royal Reverie, roll up katamari as the King of All Cosmos in his boyhood!

title: Graffiti Groovin'
description: Boyfriend is on his way to meet up with Girlfriend for a date they've planned for weeks, when out of nowhere a "bunny-like" girl approached him and challenged him to a rap battle, "Whoever wins gets all the money of the other!", she said. Boyfriend accepts the challenge and bets the money he had for the date.

title: Stuff'd
description:
Today is Grandma’s funeral. Your brother David stopped by her house after work to pick up Grandpa but no one has heard from them. That’s when you come in..

Welcome to Stuff'd.

title: Dissolved: Chapter One
description:
If there are feel-good games, well Dissolved is a feel-bad game. You play as a girl whose weird psychosis is to turn every ordeal in her life into a video game. It's a mix of completely new gameplays, fun and very challenging, parodying old arcade games.

Each control scheme is very simple, often one or two buttons, but unsettling at first. How to fight space gopniks shooting from the sky if you can't shoot back? Well, simply strike through their projectiles until your reach them. And if you find yourself unarmed against armies of cops, you can always use their own dead bodies as projectiles.

title: Vigilancer 2099
description: Vigilancer 2099 is a third-person open-world cyberpunk bounty-hunting game set in a gated, privatized, and isolated Megabuilding. Enter the skin, soul, and mind of your Vigilancer as you fight to stay alive long enough to pay off your bounty.

title: The Unofficial Squaresoft MUD
description:
The Unofficial Squaresoft MUD is a free online text-based fan-game, which is based on the worlds and combat systems of various Squaresoft games. UOSSMUD includes a class system based primarily on Final Fantasy Tactics, and worlds based on Chrono Trigger, Secret of Mana, and Final Fantasy 5, 6, and 7. It has a focus on accurately recreating these worlds from the original games and mirroring their storylines in missions.

In addition to the above, UOSSMUD also has smaller amounts of content from a wide variety of Squaresoft and Square Enix games. There are classes based on the combat system from SaGa Frontier, bosses from Xenogears, and a roguelike mode based on Chocobo's Mysterious Dungeon. This is a MUD with fast-paced combat, and a multiclassing system that allows for a wide variety of strategies.

UOSSMUD has a blind user mode available to improve the experience for those who use a screen reader to play.

title: Marathon: Eternal X
description: Eternal is a free scenario for Aleph One, the multi-platform, open-source, first-person-shooter engine derived from Bungie's Marathon engine. It continues the story of the Marathon trilogy, and is a nearly total conversion.

title: Crysmalia: Dawn of Darkness
description:
Something sinister is going on behind closed doors in the Kingdom of Lestyr, and it would have remained unbeknownst to its citizens and to the rest of the world... If it weren't for Siena, a nonchalant bandit, who stumbled upon the kingdom's hidden secret and lived to tell the tale.

Along with a runaway princess, a sharp-tongued knight, and a mysterious mage with a questionable past, Siena must now fight for his freedom and for the freedom of others, without knowing that this quest would also lead him to a long-lost legacy he never knew he shouldered.

title: Luminous of Stellar
description: Luminous of Stellar – is a s a top-down shooter sci-fi game with colorful ships and endless levels. Choose your own flight in space with two game modes endless and classic!

title: For Your Tranquility
description: It's a mystery game that reveals the truth through an autopsy. Be a forensic doctor and find out why the dead died.

title: Dance Assembly
description:
A 3D sandbox game in which the player can create their own characters using simple shapes, and then make them dance.
It's a game focused on creativity, and having fun, with zero stakes whatsoever. There are endless possibilities, with the game allowing the player to create literally anything they want. And there's nothing more fun than seeing your epic creation (or monstrosity) dance like there's no tomorrow!

title: Project Astra Dominium
description:
Project Astra Dominium is a Tower Defense game with Basebuilding and Automation elements.
Build up your base to become a supply hub for Earth's desperately needed materials, gather resources while defending against an unknown alien threat and improve your tower's and AI capabilities.

title: Dango Dash
description: Dango Dash is a platformer adventure game that combines fast-paced action with an engaging story about growing up and fighting for what you believe in. Help Dango in his quest to save his village and defeat the evil Hanami ninja clan threatening their peace.

title: Rocket League: Season 9
description: Long held in place by an ancient seal, the dragons of Forbidden Temple Arena have finally awoken from their slumber. As the two resume their eternal battle, these legendary beasts have left a treasure trove of elemental Items in their wake.

title: Monotonia: EXP_01
description: Monotonia: EXP_01 is the first game from Game Design Hub Studio, created for the One Button Game Jam in 7 days, played with just one button, taking on gamification on Fordism work model. Tired? Catch an ad in exchange of some of your work hours and get PAID FOR IT!

title: Tiny Glade
description: Tiny Glade is a small relaxing game about doodling castles. Explore gridless building chemistry, and watch the game carefully assemble every brick, pebble and plank. There's no management, combat, or wrong answers - just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

title: Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania
description: The inspiration behind it all returns to its 2D action roots! Castlevania’s unforgettable characters & gothic setting meet the fast-paced combat of the award-winning roguelite Dead Cells in this unprecedented collaboration.

title: Valiant Hearts: Coming Home
description: 1917, as World War I rages on, two brothers will fight to survive the trenches and find each other again. Their paths will cross with new Valiant Hearts who will share the joy of reuniting and the horror of the Western Front – all desperate to find their way home.

title: Hellboy: Web of Wyrd
description: Hellboy Web of Wyrd is a roguelite action adventure with an original story created in partnership with Dark Horse Comics and creator Mike Mignola. When an agent goes missing, Hellboy investigates. Prepare for monstrous toe-to-toe brawling

title: After Us
description: Explore the corners of a surrealistic post-human world to give life on Earth a second chance in this touching story about sacrifice and hope.

title: Hades II
description: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

title: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
description: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach is a third-person action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by otherworldly creatures. Players control Sam Porter Bridges, a retired porter, as he traverses the open worlds of Mexico and Australia to connect isolated survivors to a wireless communication network called the Chiral Network. The core gameplay revolves around delivering packages across hazardous terrain, managing cargo weight, building infrastructure like roads and monorails, and navigating natural disasters. Combat has a greater focus than its predecessor, offering lethal and non-lethal options alongside stealth approaches. The game features asynchronous online elements where players can build structures visible to others.

title: Immortals of Aveum
description: From the creative director of Dead Space and multiple Call of Duty campaigns comes Immortals of Aveum, a single-player first-person magic shooter set in an original fantasy universe engulfed in magic, rife with conflict, and on the verge of oblivion.

title: Wayfinder
description: Become a Wayfinder, and unlock their powers as you choose your path and playstyle while pushing back a hostile force that has overtaken your world. Control the Chaos as you directly shape and customize the endless adventures you go on with friends, because Wayfinders are stronger together.

title: Horizon Forbidden West: Burning Shores
description:
Travel beyond the Forbidden West as Aloy’s story continues. Encounter new machines and a compelling new story.

South of the Tenakth Clan Lands, millennia of volcanic eruptions and violent seismic activity have carved the ruins of Los Angeles into a treacherous archipelago. Experience the next chapter of Horizon Forbidden West as Aloy pursues a sinister new threat to the planet, hidden among these dangerous, untamed wilds.

title: Remnant II
description: Remnant II is the sequel to the best-selling game Remnant: From the Ashes that pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself. To succeed, players will need to rely on their own skills and those of their team to overcome the toughest challenges and to stave off humanity’s extinction.

title: Transformers: Reactivate
description: Transformers: Reactivate is a 1-4 player online action game, developed by Splash Damage, coming to PC & consoles. With the Closed Beta planned for 2023, players, press, and content creators can sign up at the links below for future updates.

title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
description: Hunt ghosts as two memorable characters in a story-driven Action-RPG where your decisions carry dramatic consequences. Torn between honoring your oath to the living and saving your departed partner, how far will you go for love?

title: Crime Boss: Rockay City
description: Crime Boss: Rockay City is an organized crime game combining first-person shooter action and turf wars, playable solo or with friends. Take on the role of Travis Baker – a man with his sights set on becoming the new King of Rockay City, one crime at a time…

title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
description: By combining FromSoftware’s longstanding expertise in mech games and their signature robust gameplay, Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon will be a new action experience.

title: Polarize
description:
Polarize is an experimental first-person psychological horror game where a simple job turns into a horrific nightmare.

Tasked with the dull job of printing out pictures and placing them into a container, you must perform your duties whilst being paranoid about the nightmarish creatures that await you outside your office. The lights occasionally turn off, and you must venture out of your comfort zone to restore it via a lever right outside.

Outside of your office (and sometimes in), there are nightmarish shadow people that will attempt to kill you. Equip your instant camera and use it to survive, you have no choice.

You need to plan your way to the lever to end the nightmare temporarily.

Or end it entirely...

title: Sonic Fan Remix
description: Sonic Fan Remix is a fan game currently being developed by pelikan13 and Damizean. It is a re-imagining of classic Sonic levels from Sonic 1, 2, and 3 in 2.5D detailed graphics.

title: Far Cry 6: Lost Between Worlds
description: Conquer life-or-death trials in this all-new Dani Rojas story. Lost Between Worlds is a rich, action-packed gauntlet with deadly crystal enemies, multiple player paths, all-new lore, and a wide variety of unique gameplay challenges.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog: Time Attacked
description:
Sonic The Hedgehog: Time Attacked is a 2003 fan game made by Jamie Bailey.
Time Attacked has been compared to commercial games released by Sega because of the game's detailed original graphics and the author's vast knowledge of Clickteam based programming.

Dr. Eggman has invented a time machine and uses it to go back in time to defeat Sonic following a failed attempt. Eggman succeeds and begins to create a paradox, causing the present-time Sonic to fade. Once he realizes what's going on with him, he sets off to stop Eggman before he completes the paradox and changes made in time are permanent.

title: Path of Exile: Forbidden Sanctum
description:
In Path of Exile: The Forbidden Sanctum, you will test your resolve as you make your way through the Sanctum's dangerous halls. In the Sanctum, each decision you make can cost you greatly.

Our December expansion introduces the Sanctum challenge league and improvements to Path of Exile's endgame, alongside two new Skill Gems, seven new Vaal Skill Gems, over 15 new Unique Items, significant balance changes to jewels, hexes, monster modifiers, unique weapons and more. We are also proud to introduce Ruthless, an optional new way to play Path of Exile with extreme item scarcity.

title: Friday Night Funkin': In the Galaxy
description:
Now BF and GF have a trip in the galaxy. In the ship, a child who is working here just felt bored came across and challenge BF, can you handle it?
What's special about the mod?

Here, you have a trip in the galaxy. During your trip, there are lots of fun thing to discover! Not really far from the earth, you met a genius engineer girl names Kastimagina. You will have a music battle with her. What will happen next? Let's see.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Vs Tree
description: Friday Night Funkin': Vs Tree is a mod with 3 new songs, a new enemy, more phases, effects and cutscenes!

title: Spirit Slider
description:
Spirit Slider features five sliding puzzle games.
Each puzzle game consist of 27 game pieces that have the ability to slide anywhere within a 3 x 3 x 3 grid.

title: Pantheon
description: Souls-Like, Turn-Based, RPG.

title: Kit's Quest
description: Kit’s Quest is a challenging, fun-filled 3D platformer featuring a brave fox on a journey to rescue his sister from a menacing dragon! Explore a huge, interconnected world, collect magical dragon teeth, and learn cool abilities as Kit treks toward Skyreach Summit to save the day!

title: The Lake of the Blind Mannequin
description: You're an old fisherman, who lives by catching fish all his life. One day his lake was closed, because people kept missing there and rumours say that the Blind Mannequin is behind all of this. But the fisherman is old and has nothing to lose, so he sneaks in...

title: Spin Time
description: Learn what it truly means to spin in this indie clicker game by Dumb Video Game Stuff. Spin Time is a short relaxed comedic experience where all you do is press a button. Your mission? To help the world's greatest spinner, Horst, in his quest to achieve maximum spin.

title: Chuzzle: Christmas Edition
description:
Nuzzle up to some Chuzzly puzzle fun this holiday! The Chuzzles are all dressed up for Christmas and ready for some Yuletide fun! Match Chuzzles to clear them from the board and keep the fun going through all 4 chuzzly puzzly holiday games. The full version of Chuzzle Christmas Edition features:

4 ways to play
Cool trophies and power-ups
2 difficulty settings
Have a Chuzzly puzzly Christmas and a fuzzy new year! Play today!

title: Trader Life Simulator 2
description: Start your business going from an empty shop to the biggest Trader in town! buy and sell over 150 products, purchase and drive vehicles, customize your shop with over 120 Equipment, Furniture and walls.

title: Starlight: Defence Command
description: Starlight: Defence Command is a Tower Defence game designed for the PC that is tough and more in-depth than those gone before. With the ability to configure towers in billions of possible combinations, unlockable perks and fine tuning through target priorities, players are given powerful tools to complete the galaxy-spanning, story-driven campaign.

title: AQ2: Expanse
description:
Start your adventure in the Aquila system, a vast expanse of space filled with opportunities.
AQ2 is being developed by a solo developer, sign up to the news email to get updates on the development.

title: Roboleon
description:
Roboleon is a story-driven humorous and subtle-dystopian Platformer Puzzle Adventure game. It focuses on a playful movement system, a physics-based character design, and puzzle-solving.

You play as Roboleon, a fallback maintenance robot aboard an alien spaceship, who is trying to help save its creators after the ship is struck by an asteroid.

title: The Cooking Class
description:
Come Cook With Us

Welcome in the Dupont Family. A nice, quiet household in the Nova Scotia province of Atlantic Canada. Let's learn together how to cook delicious meals for you and your family. Because remember, can't live with an empty belly!

Find the right VHS scattered around the house through a randomic system of placement in order to find the code to escape the house.
Good Luck!

The Cooking Class is an horror escape room, there are no hints, no clues, you are completely alone.
Or, are you?

The first of a scheduled trilogy of games involving the Dupont Family, The Cooking Class is an homage to VHS found footage horror, 80's and 90's slasher movies, and the story of a family and its legacy.

A first person atmospheric game, where the player will have to find its way out.

title: Five Nights at Pinkie's
description: Five Nights at Pinkie's is a horror game where you are the night watcher at Pinkie's Cupcakes Corner. Your job is to watch ponies animatronics (kind of robots) during the night from 12am to 6am. But the ponies are moving and they don't have good intentions. Your weapons? Security cameras & doors with limited power. Will you survive 5 nights?

title: Dogs Can Speak English
description: Love in the digital age.

title: Luna Game
description: Luna Game is a horror My Little Pony fan game created by an anonymous creator.

title: Super Lesbian Horse RPG
description: Super Lesbian Horse RPG is an RPG Maker game that was released by Ponett, and has been cited by Equestria Gaming as "the strangest RPG released yet.

title: Disney Hotshots: Disney's 101 Dalmatians
description: Disney Hotshots: Disney's 101 Dalmatians is a video game in the Disney Hotshots series.

title: Supercan
description: Supercan is a third person Action-adventure game. The game was developed by Sobee and published by TRT Çocuk on May, 2011. Süpercan was first announced in November 2009.

title: The Little Mermaid Pinball
description: The Little Mermaid Pinball is video game developed for Windows by Disney Interactive and published by Disney Online. It was released on July 11, 2005.

title: Avalanche
description: Avalanche is a free Final Fantasy VII fan-game created by Rich Whitehouse in late 2007. It features third-person action with RPG-like stat/inventory mechanics.

title: Super Magic Elemage
description: Super Magic Elemage is a previously lost and unfinished Gameboy game, now restored and playable on PC.

title: Lawn of Time: Unicorn Snow
description: When a bad boy unicorn comes to town, it's up to Tamina to stop him from completely ruining the Lawn of Time!

title: Luci RPG
description: Luci RPG is an adventure game in which LuciDin must journey to find some more, encountering strange characters, funny memes and gags, and a suspicious lil' cat who watches his every move!

title: Boyfriend Dungeon: Secret Weapons
description: The Secret Weapons DLC comes with a brand-new dunj, three new weapons-slash-love interests, and more.

title: Aardwolf MUD
description:
Aardwolf RPG is a unique and free text based roleplaying game. Aardwolf is based in the fantasy world of Andolor where magic is common and there are hundreds of exotic realms to explore, puzzles to solve and quests to complete. Aardwolf features a realistic game world with multiple continents and real geography. Each area includes a real time line-of-sight overhead map to see other characters and points of interest around you.

Create your character from any one of 28 classes including fighter classes such as Soldiers, Knights, Hunters, Barbarians, Rangers, Archers, Assassins and Paladins or select a magic based class including Elementalists, Necromancers, Healers, Priests, Witches and Enchanters. Once you have choosen your race, your guild and your profession then the rest is up to you. You have absolute control over your character's actions and there are many ways to play Aardwolf.

title: Hot Dog Stand: The Works
description: This simulation game presents students with the challenge of running their own small business, using a variety of mathematics, problem-solving, and communication skills.

title: Pastoral
description: Midway through the 19th century the world's civilizations had all been destroyed by a global cataclysmic event. You step into the shoes of one of the survivors – a shepherd. Can you guide your herd through a perilous land and into the safety of the enclosure?

title: Club Vanentine
description: Serve up drinks and lapdances to thirsty clubgoers as Carol, the star waitress of Club Valentine!

title: Carrion Fields
description:
Carrion Fields is a text based adventure mud with 20,000+ rooms. Find the 150+ automated quests. When you finally reach hero there will still be many challenges for you to face from fighting the Ancient Dragons to challenging Tiamat herself!

Roleplaying, Player Killing.

title: Armageddon
description: In this simple riff on an arcade classic, released in 1983 for the ZX Spectrum and Commodore 64 by famed game developer/publisher Ocean Software, protect cities from waves of nuclear attack by using powerful missile batteries.

title: Arx, After the Reckoning
description:
Arx is a game set in a low to mid-fantasy world, where magic is more legend and superstition than daily reality. The game itself is set in the capital city of the Compact, an alliance of the five Great Houses who hold sway over the continent of Arvum. The lands of Arvum are wild and sparsely settled, and away from the walls and settlements of the House-ruled fortifications there is great danger and mystery. Tribes of unaligned Abandoned (or shav'arvani) roam and raid the great forests and wildlands between the settled cities, and beyond the borders of the known lands even greater mysteries lie.

RP focused.

title: Geas
description:
Welcome to Geas, an exciting and challenging multiplayer online roleplaying game or MUD (Multi User Dungeon) of unmatched complexity and realism.
Geas’ class- and level-less system allows your character to improve and advance the skills and abilities he or she uses most, thereby giving you maximum freedom and unlimited possibilities to develop your alter ego into the kind of character you imagine.

The features of Geas are too extensive to list, but they include an unmatched combat system, a dynamic economy, multiple languages, a player enforced legal system, hundreds of skills, an unbelievably detailed world, and roleplay which is both mandatory and strictly enforced.

title: Cybersphere
description: CyberSphere is a Role-Playing MOO set in a dark American future. Your virtual journey begins in New Carthage, the denizens of which range from the benign eccentric to the malicious psychotic. Shadowed alleys conceal dark secrets, and gleaming towers of urban wealth hide fantastic conspiracies.

title: Legends of the Jedi
description:
Legends of the Jedi is a text-based roleplaying experience that immerses players in a multiplayer world where they can rewrite classic Star Wars stories with their own heroes, villains, battles, and endings. Over the course of each two-year timeline, the game explores all the key eras of the Star Wars Expanded Universe.

Take and hold planets as an Imperial Stormtrooper, command the Rebel navy and liberate the galaxy, pursue targets as a bounty hunter, or shape things on a larger scale as a member of the Galactic Senate. Maybe you’ll even be one of the few born with force sensitivity, destined to be trained by Jedi or Sith.

The game offers an extensive crafting system for engineers to supply weapons, armor, and ships to the galaxy. Develop new, cutting-edge armaments to give your side an edge, or open a shop in a bustling commercial district and become wealthy as part of a powerful engineering conglomerate.

LOTJ offers full PVP in both ground and space combat, governed by a set of rules to minimize griefing and ensure that all kills have sufficient in-character cause.

What role will you play? The legend awaits!

title: AwakeMUD
description:
AwakeMUD is a MUD set in the year is 2064, and the world has been reforged in the fires of magic, technology, and greed. Orks, Trolls, Elves, and other races straight out of fantasy roam the streets, along with new and unfamiliar mutations inflicted on the populace in a traumatic event known as the SURGE. Cybernetic implants and arcane workings grant incredible power to those who can afford to wield them, and information - the most valuable resource in 2064– is stolen and traded by expert hackers with homemade VR rigs. Dominating this landscape are the mega-corporations, wielding nigh-limitless political clout and conducting shadow wars while an unsuspecting populace happily consumes their products.

As a Shadowrunner, you are one of the freelance agents hired to do various organizations' dirty work (and turn a healthy profit in the process). There are many paths you can take on your road to success, and many ways you can grow in power and influence in the Seattle community.

title: Toril
description: Toril is a Forgotten Realms MUD.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: River Raids
description:
River Raids is a free update for Assassin's Creed: Valhalla. Released as part of Title Update 1.1.2, the update adds the replayable river raiding mode based on the existing raiding feature in the base game and introduces three distinct maps of rivers for players to explore; namely the River Exe, the River Severn and the River Dee. The update also added new quests and a set of armor and weapon to obtain through the new map.

An additional update in conjunction with the Ostara Season content added a second armor set to be obtained.

A third update introducing the River Erriff, the River Berbha and the River Rhine was released on 7 September 2021, featuring new questlines to obtain Lugh's Spear and the Ulfberht Sword.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: A Fated Encounter
description: A Fated Encounter was a virtual representation of one of Eivor Varinsdottir's genetic memories, relived by Layla Hassan in 2020 through the Portable Animus HR-8.5. It was added via Title Update 1.4.1.

title: Up
description:
Experience Disney•Pixar Up originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Based on the Disney•Pixar animated feature of the same name, Up The Video Game takes players on an exotic adventure with Carl Fredricksen and his young sidekick, Wilderness Explorer Russell, as they set off on a wild journey through the undiscovered jungles of South America.

title: Resident Evil 2: The Ghost Survivors
description: The Ghost Survivors is one of the updates for 2019's Resident Evil 2. It was released for free on February 15, 2019, acting as a series of "what-if" side-stories for the characters of gunstore owner Robert Kendo, the mayor's estranged daughter Katherine Warren, a U.S.S. member codenamed Ghost, and Sheriff Daniel Cortini, exploring the various scenarios in which they survived the events of the main game.

title: Hundred Furious Fist Momoko: Wonderful Pink 2
description: Play as Momoko, the superheroine Wonderful Pink, and fight off an invasion of Earth in this 18+ beat-em-up sequel.

title: Bombing Wonderful
description: Play as Momoko, the super heroine Wonderful Pink, and defeat the aliens in this 18+ shoot-em-up.

title: Unheard: The Lethal Script
description:
Unheard: The Lethal Script is a dlc for Unheard which takes place in The Peak Hotel.
Join the investigators as they enter The Peak Hotel and see how this deadly scenario plays out!

title: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Moonspell
description: Legacy of the Moonspell is the first DLC for Vampire Survivors, and introduces a brand new stage, new characters, new monsters, and new weapons to slaughter them with. There might even be some hidden mysteries for those of an inquiring mindset, but we can neither confirm nor deny the presence of vampire.

title: The Feast
description:
The Feast is a short and intensely dramatic experience designed to be completed in one sitting (20-30 minutes).

This dark and peculiar spectacle grants you the lead role. In a theatrical setting, survive the utterly confusing and twisted dinner. You will be observed and judged, so face reality, weigh every action, consider possible outcomes, make choices - and define the conclusion of this life-changing celebration.

After all, what happens here is not your problem…
… or is it?

title: TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
description: The Isle of Man Tourist Trophy is the most epic, most dangerous and most spectacular race in the world.
