It is a course of over 60km on the roads of the Isle of Man, includes 264 bends, and requires high-powered bikes specially prepared for the race. The riders who compete in it train their whole lives for the chance to win the ultimate accolade: being crowned champion of the Isle of Man TT.

title: Teeth Brushing Simulator
description:
Are you afraid to brush your teeth in real life, is there a certain threshold through which you cannot cross? With this game you can simulate a situation and it is possible to understand that there is nothing terrible in it, get used to a toothpick. There are no guarantees, of course, that this will help, but why not try?
What are you, weakly what? Scared, yes?

title: Wild Hearts: Karakuri Edition
description: Wild Hearts is a twist on the hunting genre where technology gives you a fighting chance against giant nature-infused beasts.

title: Enter/Exit the Gungeon
description:
Enter the Gungeon is a bullet hell dungeon crawler following a band of misfits seeking to shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip their way to personal absolution by reaching the legendary Gungeon’s ultimate treasure: the gun that can kill the past.

Exit the Gungeon is a small, spin-off 'dungeon climber' immediately following the adventures of the misfit Gungeoneers.

title: Street Fighter 6: Deluxe Edition
description:
Content
・Full Game
・Year 1 Character Pass

title: Beholgar: Collector's Edition
description:
An evil sorcerer reads the ancient book and invites an evil god to earth. It is necessary to eliminate this evil threat. And the fate of the earth is in the hands of a barbarian.

Beholgar is a classically styled 2D Metroidvania adventure. Explore caverns, ancient woods, and deadly castles; battle creatures and solve ancient mysteries in the kingdom.

title: DC's Justice League: Cosmic Chaos
description: Suit up as Batman, Wonder Woman and Superman and take on some of the most powerful Super-Villains in the DC universe with DC’s Justice League: Cosmic Chaos.

title: Tatusino
description:
Tatusino is a visual novel about an arranged marriage and the revelations that come forth through the journey back home

Won 1st place in vncup, a contest for short yuri visual novels

title: Redemption Reapers
description: Descending suddenly on the world, the macabre Mort armies destroy nation after nation, leaving humanity decimated in their wake. Among the forces resisting the Mort is a small band of mercenaries known as the Ashen Hawk Brigade.

title: Alter Aeon
description: Alter Aeon is a fantasy world of adventure and untold possibilities. Ours is an enormous, fantastic world to explore! We have thousands of quest to complete and tens of thousands of enemies to defeat!

title: Duel Revolution
description: A new monster taming MMORPG with a strategic real-time Duel system, Open World Exploration, Messaging System, Day and Night Cycles and continuous Storyline. Take on this ever changing adventure and more in the world of Bitacora.

title: Jurassic World Evolution 2: Dominion Malta Expansion
description: In Jurassic Evolution 2: Dominion Malta Expansion, you'll get to experience a brand new campaign, which will see you leading a new enterprise in Malta, set before the events of Jurassic World: Dominion. You'll be working alongside Cabot Finch and key figures from the film, including Kayla Watts, Soyona Santos, Barry Sembène, and Lewis Dodgson. You'll set up parks across three new Mediterranean locations, acquiring new species, eggs, and genome data via the Dinosaur Exchange in the place of Expeditions and Fossil Extractions.

title: For Goodness Sake
description: In a final attempt to guarantee your place on the nice list, you decide to try and do some chores before midnight. Will Krampus take you? Take the test and find out.

title: Winfray
description: A very epic and goofy winter-themed snowball fight game. Combat other players in a fast-paced first person arena shooter, play minigames to earn rewards, or endlessly fight against hordes of enemies!

title: The Mold Exorcist
description: You are a mold remediator, just doing their job.

title: Let Chat Guess
description: Let Chat Guess is a Twitch.tv interactive game where viewers must guess how far the catapulted character will travel! Put your Twitch chat or friends to the test and let them try to guess the correct distance! Solo player? No worries! Try to climb the rankings and get on top of the leaderboards!

title: Wonderful Pink
description: Play as Momoko, the superheroine known as Wonderful Pink, and fight to save Earth from an evil invasion in this exploration-based 18+ action game.

title: Touhou Artificial Dream in Arcadia
description: Inspired by Megami Tensei and Etrian Odyssey, Artificial Dream in Arcadia is an old-school dungeon crawler featuring Sumireko Usami in her quest to solve an incident which she seems to be personally responsible for...

title: Blood Wizard Odyssey
description: An absurd comedy turn-based RPG about wizards in a blood world.

title: Rootless: Memories of Green
description: Rootless: Memories of Green is a classic 2D adventure game set in a futuristic cyberpunk world.

title: Ok I Pull Up
description: Ok I Pull Up is a rage platformer, in which you, a capybara, ascend a tree tower only by jumping. This punishing, yet fair game requires extreme patience to complete.

title: Crossword World Puzzle
description: English crossword games with words puzzle! Improve vocabulary by word search!

title: Who Knocks
description: Who Knocks is a first person psychological horror game that will make your nightmares come true. You have just moved into a new home. Welcome the presences that will knock at your door. Solve puzzles, explore the environment and fight your nightmares.

title: Arvoesine
description: Arvoesine is a short platformer action game. As the protagonist you will face numerous challenges and defeat enemies until you claim the victory.

title: Quilts and Cats of Calico
description: Quilts & Cats of Calico is a wholesome, award-winning complex puzzle game for 1 to 4 players. Meet adorable cats and sew the coziest quilts. Compete with other players in multiplayer mode, play solo, or delve into the story of a quilter sewing their way through the city of cats.

title: Walk in the Sun
description:
Claire's got one goal - to spend time with her friend Jamie after school.

Nothing's going to get in the way of that.

Made in two weeks for VN Cup.

title: 3Scapes
description:
3Scapes is a text-based multi-user dungeon. Communication across the dimensions is easily handled, as is the ability to retain your character identity (i.e. name) across all existence, but beyond that, everything else is unique.

Since opening in 2009, 3Scapes has grown to become a virtual community of over 800 characters with new guilds, new areas, new quests, and new functionality. With its own cast of players, administrators, and its own unique feel, 3Scapes is a vibrant virtual world ready for you to visit, explore, and enjoy!

title: Toilet Chronicles: Staff Only
description: Extended version of the "Toilet Chronicles"

title: The Cleft of Dimensions
description:
The Cleft of Dimensions is a text adventure MMO (aka, a MUD) with content inspired by classic video games.
Do you want to jump on goombas? Maybe you'd rather immolate them with lava or bombard them with meteors. You could always confuse them into hitting themselves. Then again, why fight goombas when you could enslave them into your army? If that doesn't work out, you've got this motorcycle you could crash into them. The Cleft has 16 character classes, each with a different play style.
Gameplay in the Cleft is as much about exploring as it is about killing things. Secret treasure is hidden everywhere, waiting to be claimed by those willing to endeavour. Quests are prominent, with activities ranging from committing industrial espionage for a paranoid innkeeper to seeking the blessings of the mana spirits. To top it all off, we have an active roleplaying community to make your own story part of the Cleft.

title: Joy of Programming: Software Engineering Simulator
description: JOY OF PROGRAMMING - Software Engineering Simulator is an immersive 3D programming puzzle game about automating and controlling realistic machines, robots, drones and more using real Python code. Build actual coding skills while playing, solve exciting bite-sized programming challenges and progress to unlock new programming features and improved machinery. Prior programming knowledge recommended.

title: Wyoming Winter
description: "Wyoming Winter" is a multiplayer horror game where players must survive against a powerful, fast-moving creature called the Blight. Players can find weapons through completing a checklist to prevent the Blight from escaping the facility. The game is best played with 3-8 players, and servers are available in Europe, America, and Asia.

title: No Time For Caution
description: No Time For Caution is a 3d parkour game. Sit back and enjoy the parkours with different difficulty levels. Don't forget! No time for caution.

title: HeavenSlinger
description:
Hailing from Fifth of Hells, a devilish gunslinger seeks vengeance on angelkind for destroying her home.

Heavenslinger is a fast paced shooter where you ambush your enemies, and follow up with devastating combos with 5 guns to switch between.

title: Friday Night Funkin' Indie Cross
description:
You shall cross through indie worlds

Think you have the balls to survive?

Indie Cross is a mod for Friday Night Funkin that features three weeks against popular indie characters, Cuphead, Sans from Undertale, and Bendy. It also contains multiple bonus songs, a custom achievements system, Game Jolt integration, and fully animated cutscenes for each individual song in the mod.

title: Okui
description: Ōkui: Beat em up and Eat em up is a 2D action-platformer game where you play as a ninja frog, and your sole mission is to defeat the forces of evil with the power of good and everything righteous, and well… your appetite…

title: V or B
description: You have to pick one: An assassin imp or a succubus?

title: Helluva Boss Flaming Fashion
description: Hazbin Hotel is finally filling up with demons, but Charlie is too sick to work! It's up to Octavia to dress up Loona, Millie, Moxxie, and Blitzo alongside more surprise characters from Helluva Boss and Hazbin Hotel!

title: Rental Chan
description: Racheal works for an app called Rent-A-Friend. She gets paid for being friends with people for a limited time. She needs money to pay for her little sister's hospital bills who is being treated for a rare disease. When a rare opportunity comes up, a family is worried about their daughter and is willing to pay Rachael a large sum of money to transfer schools and befriend with until the end of the school year.

title: TermoVerse Chronicles
description: A fan-made game dedicated to I Termosifoni.

title: The Adventures of Catto Boi
description:
Are you sick of the same old thing over and over again? Generic non-stimulating platforming, little to no plot development, and overall boring gameplay?
Well... unfortunately, you're out of luck.
The Adventures of Catto Boi is the first of many adventures featuring an angry cat who has to find lost cat biscuits scattered all over some random, poorly designed levels.
Doesn't sound fun... But how would you know if you haven't played it?

title: Stomp Plonk
description: Created by Marek Kapolka. Stomp Plonk is a walking simulator where you walk around a fantasy continent with a lute and hang out with musical NPCs.

title: Lost Cartridge: Cold Read
description: Lost Cartridge: Cold Read is the first in a series of horror anthology games by Pure Ice Blue, creator of Lily's Well and I Cannot Drown. Explore the library, hide from those who want Mitch's life to end, and solve puzzles in order to possibly find a way to escape.

title: His Name is Diamond
description:
In the beginning of 21th century, technology has evolved in unprecedented ways. But so did crime. Huge corporations, which were in fact criminal organizations, came to control the world. Finally, a mega-corporation known as Connection has taken the power in its hands. Everything was sponsored with its money; the governments and the law were silent. Only vigilante groups called "Connection-Killers" still tried to resist. In 2015, in Detroit, one of those people, nicknamed DD, witnessed the death of his comrades...

A year has passed. DD moves to Brain City - a highly developed, modern city, the center of scientific research. It was built on an island in the Atlantic Ocean, which appeared after a volcano eruption. It is controlled by Connection. DD opens an investigation office in the city, trying to get to the heart of Connection and defeat his old nemesis, despite the hostile atmosphere and the grave dangers that await him there...

His Name is Diamond is a RPG with top-down navigation and first-person turn-based combat. The player controls DD as he moves through the urban environments of the game. The enemies appear randomly and are mostly grotesquely exaggerated everyday people (workers, journalists, etc.), with a large amount of sexy women. DD deals with the enemies through various menu commands. Instead of a simple "attack" option, there are various techniques and extensive item usage, so that many of the fights feel almost like mini-puzzles. DD gains experience and levels up, increasing his parameters, after defeating enemies.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Nurikabe
description: In this super popular puzzle, black spaces and white spaces slowly come together to show their true form. "Nurikabe" is a puzzle in which you refer to the arranged numbers to fill in all of the spaces. It's popular with a wide range of players, from beginners to experts. It feels great watching the black spaces stretch out like a soft-bodied animal.

title: Minecraft: Deluxe Collection
description:
Experience all the different ways to explore, survive, and build in Minecraft with Minecraft: Deluxe Collection!

Browse endless community created content in the Minecraft Marketplace, discover new play styles through different maps, and express yourself with Character Creator items and emotes. Gather your friends or gear up for a solo mission, you’re ready for all the many ways to play Minecraft!

title: Simulyator Odinochestva V Russkoy Derevne
description: An old Russian hut, endless forests, and not a single person for hundreds of miles around.

title: Obake no Koushinkyoku
description: Obake no Koushinkyoku is a 2D jump action game featuring a system that allows you to possess enemy characters and manipulate their bodies

title: Harvest Moon: The Winds of Anthos
description:
In celebration of the 25th Anniversary of the Harvest Moon franchise, Harvest Moon: The Winds of Anthos will offer new functions while keeping the core fundamentals that has made the series so popular. The land players will explore is known as Anthos, and is home to the Harvest Sprites, spirits that protect people and nature, as well as the goddess of nature known as the Harvest Goddess.

However, about 20 years ago, an unprecedented eruption in Anthos's volcanic region forced the Harvest Goddess and her Harvest Sprites to use all of their powers to protect the people. The people were saved, but the eruption left the villages cut off from each other... Believing that the separated villages and people would one day be reconnected, the Harvest Goddess sent a bottle into the ocean with a letter and a magic key, then fell into a deep sleep...

title: VideoHeroeS
description: VHS is a tribute to video rentals and great movies from the 90s. We want to convey what it is like to explore a collection of forgotten gems. You are the clerk of a video rental store during the amazing 90s. Over the course of the day, many customers will enter the store and ask for that one movie, and it is your job to make them happy. VHS video covers included under fair use.

title: Neo Utopia Project
description:
Neo Utopia Project is an indie videogame being developed for Windows. It is an hybrid between an RPG and a puzzle-adventure game.

The graphical aspect of the game will be focused in 2D-art mixed with pixel-art, while the story and gameplay will have dark undertones and a clear objective: To unravel the mysteries hidden in the living prison "Neo-Babylon" while the protagonists fight not only for their lives, but also to uncover the mysteries that this place holds.

The game is planned to be released in two languages: English and Spanish.

title: Obake no Koushinkyoku 10th
description: "Obake no Koushinkyoku 10th" is a 2D jump action game released on March 26, 2015 as a sequel to "Obake no Koushinkyoku". It is a work set in "Ghost Empire" 10 years after the previous work.

title: Monster Energy Supercross 6: The Official Videogame
description: Mud, sweat, adrenaline, and fun: all the best the motocross and dirt bike world has to offer awaits you in the new Monster Energy Supercross 6!

title: Boinkgame
description:
Boinkgame is a precision platformer where the only enemy is yourself.

And the walls... The walls are a bigger enemy actually.

title: From the Rain
description: From The Rain is a single player survival horror game. Reboot the generator, lock all entrances, and defend yourself from the entities that lurk in the rain. Survive each hour and wait for help to arrive!

title: 3Kingdoms
description: 3Kingdoms is a text-based adventure. In 3K, you "read" the world as you play and interact with it, using thousands of intuitive verb commands. Want to wield that sword you just found? You would enter "wield sword". Want to take a closer look at that desk in the secret room you just found? You would enter "examine desk" and then maybe follow up with "search desk" for a closer look. To help you out in the game, all you need to do is type "help" to give you access to 3K's expansive help files. Beyond that, the same files are available online right here if you ever need them.

title: Ankabar
description:
Akanbar is a text-based online Role Playing Game, a land of magic, mystery and fantasy where you the player help to weave the ever changing storyline.

Akanbar is an online fantasy role playing game created by a team of developers who have spent much of their lives both playing and creating role playing worlds. What we have aimed to create is the best of the best. A land that is constantly evolving and cared for by its creators.

title: Harshlands
description:
The Harshlands MUD is, above all else, a role-playing game world. The game should be viewed in most ways as a traditional sit-down, pencil and paper, role-playing game, and not as a video game where the object is to tally the most kills.
You can become better at your chosen trade, buy/sell, travel, fight, get a job and the scope is pretty much endless.

title: Dune MUD
description:
Dune Mud is a classic multiplayer online text adventure game (MUD) based in Frank Herbert's DUNE Universe. Since 1992 Dune has been the LP MUD of choice for several generations of amazing players. Create a character, join one of ten guilds, and explore the 30,000+ game rooms. Enjoy opt-in PK and numerous in-game quests.

Friendly players! Social atmosphere! Passionate playerbase! Discord integration! Active coding staff!

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Gods Revel, Lands Tremble
description: Patch 6.3 introduces the next alliance raid dungeon Myths of the Realm, Part 2: Euphrosyne, a challenging new trial, the dungeon Lapis Manalis and a new arena in Crystalline Conflict.

title: The Game of Life 2: Ultimate Life Collection
description: Open up even more life paths across 10 incredible new worlds with The Game of Life 2: Ultimate Life Collection!

title: The Knight of the Crimson Tower
description: Laura is a daughter of the lord of the Crimson Tower. To impress her friends she steals a certain thing from an old witch, so the witch curses her: now, when the full moon rises, Laura turns into a beast and is put in a cage of her tower. But would it be enough to hold her?

title: Hamster Survival
description: Hamster Survival is a post-apocalyptic survival game in which the player takes on the role of a hamster and must survive in harsh conditions. In the game you will have to fight monsters, build bases and craft items.

title: BlackMUD
description:
The world of Entia is again at war. The forces of chaos once again seek to destroy the world itself. It is a time of fear and darkness. It is a time for those with courage, to step forward and defend their beliefs, and their very existence.

BlackMUD is a Diku/Silly based MUD, although it has become something far more than either. The world of Entia is a wonderous and challenging place. It boasts over 90 original areas, made up of 35000 crafted rooms (and growing), all designed around a comprehensive world theme and history.

Good role-playing is encouraged and rewarded, although not required. With a wide array of races, cities, classes and sub-classes, BlackMUD offers the player a wide world of adventure and excitement.

title: Newt
description: A mapset inspired by Magnolia and other rbks stuff, mostly combat puzzles.

title: Atomic Picnic
description:
Atomic Picnic is a Co-Op Shooter Roguelite based on the new Swarm Survivors genre! Get together with up to 4 friends to fight frenzied monsters and gain experience to upgrade your weapons in an anime-style post-apocalyptic world.

Fight your way together through The Zone, an everchanging labyrinth created after the "Harvest Festival" happened. Unlock an incredible variety of upgrades that can radically change the way you play every time.

title: New Eden
description: New Eden is an Online Action Role-Playing Game with focus on involved lore, roleplay, and souls-like combat re-emagined in a 2D, retor style.

title: Space Mercenary Defense Force
description: Defend against the alien invasion and take down the mother ship! Utilise branching upgrade trees, unlock new ships, and equip permanent upgrades to create your own unique build and defeat the growing hordes of invaders in this sci-fi action roguelike!

title: Carols in July
description: Carols in July is a Friday Night Funkin' mod based on hhgregg.

title: SWmud
description:
Star Wars MUD, or SWmud, is a telnet text-based game set in the Star Wars universe, mostly during A New Hope to the Thrawn (Legends) campaign. Player killing is optional. Great space combat and newbie help!
Star Wars mud is a heavily modified LPmud based on the Star Wars Universe. SWmud is not a role-playing MUD, though role-playing is not forbidden as long as it is within the rules.

title: Cygnus Enterprises
description:
Cygnus Enterprises combines action RPG and base management elements and is set on the alien frontier world of Mytilus.
Currently in Early Access, Cygnus Enterprises offers approximately 12 hours of content which will be expanded upon further in future updates.

title: The Inquisition: Legacy
description:
A free, multiplayer Multi-Used Dungeon (MUD) revolving around medieval religious oppression and the fight against magic in a fantasy world. The Holy Order is the dominant faith of the Kingdom of Lithmore and guides its followers with an iron grip.

Experience a vast city filled with secrets. Craft and personalize hundreds of items. Engage in storylines, relationships and conflict with other players and staff-run plots. Cast fantastic spells in five different magical elements, or oppose magic through organised religion. Explore a setting 25 years in the making!

title: Sunday Night Suicide
description: One night on the town you're spending some time with your hot girlfriend when a certain rodent bumps into you. You're excited to see it's the one and only Mickey Mouse! But he seems more... down than usual. Eh, everyone has their off days. You offer him a song to cheer him up. Little do you know how much of a mistake that truly is...

title: 3D Hentai Blackjack
description: Check your luck in the blackjack card game, in order to win, you need to score more points than your opponent, but less than 21. The reward will be - nude images.

title: Freakout
description: Freakout is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game.

title: Fargone
description: Fargone is an RPG-based survival game with a strong focus on creating a living, breathing world through dynamic events, and NPC interactions. Set in a fictional land known only as The Barrens, you must survive by any means, whether that be alone or by allying yourself with a faction.

title: Bengan Yes
description: Bengan Yes is an action-packed arena fighting game designed for livestreaming. Choose to either let your viewers brawl it out or simulate a clash between thousands of bots. Everyone has an equal chance of winning with both the arena and stats of players being randomized.

title: Haram
description: A short narrative walking simulator inspired by the photography of Andres Serrano.

title: MineSweeper Tetris
description: MineSweeper tetris a brand new casual 2D puzzle game that combines elements of minesweeper and tetris, find and mark the mines in a row to remove it. But be careful lines keep getting added over time.

title: Portobello Beat
description: Portobello Beat is an indie rhythm boxing game where you play as Shiitake, a young mushroom boxer that must dodge and punch to the rhythm of the song in order to beat Deathcap, the reigning mushroom boxing champion.

title: Lucid Lucy
description: This ambient game explores the world of Lucy, a mysterious hospital patient that you are now responsible for. It uses pixel art, photo manipulation and other mixed media to create a surreal, immersive environment.

title: Galah Galah
description:
A series of spacey experiences !

Sound is important!

title: Minitroid
description: Minitroid is a fan-made game based on the Metroid series.

title: Duck Turnip
description: a thing use arrows

title: The Strange and Somewhat Sinister Tale of the House at Desert Bridge
description: When the inventor/magician known as Old Man Bill suddenly disappears from his house in the middle of the desert, his friends, companions and pets start worrying: what could have happened? To solve this sinister mystery, they call upon their old acquaintance, pretentious game designer Jonas Kyratzes, who builds a magical portal into the Lands of Dream. Using this portal, YOU can now interact with the wondrous and colourful world of the house at Desert Bridge, and help Harold the Talking Picture Frame and his friends locate their master, Old Man Bill.

title: Zonnebloem
description:
Zonnebloem is a short 18+ visual novel made by soulsoft (cappy and insects) for the vn cup.

It's a story set at the peak of summer, all about meeting an old friend again after a long time, and realizing you're in love.

title: Temporian
description: If you were sent back 10,000 years into the past, could you not only survive, but give ancient Earth a technological leap forward? Based on real techniques and technology, (re)invent everything from an apple pie to electricity.

title: EndGame
description: The ultimate action sci-fi RPG adventure, travel across time and explore places humans cannot go. Powerful monsters blocking your path and dangerous dungeons await you.

title: Power Dolls 3
description: The third entry in Kogado Studio's all-female mech tactical RPG series, Power Dolls.

title: Power Dolls 4
description: The fourth entry in Kogado Studio's all-female mech tactical RPG series, Power Dolls.

title: Power Dolls 5
description: The fifth entry in Kogado Studio's all-female mech tactical RPG series, Power Dolls.

title: Power Dolls 5X
description: A direct sequel to Power Dolls 5 featuring new scenarios and units.

title: Power Dolls 6
description: Power Dolls 6 changes the dynamic up by being the series first real-time action game.

title: Power Dolls 1
description: Power Dolls 1 is a remake of the original 1994 game Power Dolls which kicked off Kogado Studio's all-female mech franchise.

title: The Symbiant
description: The Symbiant is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about two men, both from vastly different worlds, embracing their sexuality and their newfound romance. It is also a tale of interstellar friendship and being gay in space!

title: The Stars Here Below
description: John is a young man with a secret he wishes to tell his friends. Confessing to the stars one night John find himself and his friend transported to a mysterious world where wishes can be granted.

title: Harold and the Gameover
description: Harold wakes up in a dark place devoid of normal life, but filled with evil Reids who wish him harm! Can he find his way through!? Part of the Enter the Haroldverse game jam.

title: Jacob's Room
description: Your friend has invited you to hang out, but there isn't actually much to do at his place. Interact with items and talk to Jacob to learn more about him!

title: It's Not You, It's Your Trauma
description: The world's most prosaic isekai. Stuck in an unfamiliar world inside a library that records the entirety of its history through mysteriously magical means, Sammy Baxa must... dust the shelves? Well, at least she's got a friend to accompany her while she waits for a way back home.

title: That time I was about to do something important but a god zipped me to another world full of people with masks and I needed to make them fall in love with me to go back
True Colors
description: True colors is a Narrative game where you incarnate a young lad lost in his dreams.

title: A Cyberpunk's Dream of 2077
description:
Passed out after a night of New Year’s Eve partying, you are awoken from your drunken stupor by a RetailBot.

This robot informs you that it had a dream, and would like your help in determining its meaning.

You are free to help or hinder this robot.

Just remember: words and actions can have consequences…

A (very short) cyberpunk visual novel
Dialogue system inspired by RPG classics
Four distinct endings based off your choices throughout the game
Pixel graphics!
Featuring photography from Unsplash.com and music by Alexander Nakarada

title: A Night at Sea
description:
Old playstation 1 / vhs style low-poly horror/survival game designed to keep you at the edge of your seat at all times and not just a wild goose chase for keys to open doors!

A few days ago, some of the workers at the oil rig found a cave, a few miles from the rig, thinking there might be something of interest, a search team was sent to investigate, along with went the superiors, leaving only three men behind.

"A night at Sea" puts you in the shoes of those three simple oil workers, going about their daily routine, named "Freddy", "John" and "Henry", alone at the oil rig. Trying to survive, an old legend about some Mystical creatures that lurk the sea at night, Feeding of the flesh of any who confronts them.

title: We Have a Frog Problem
description: A circular toy with frogs, physics, and jokes

title: A Small Journey
description:
Explore a small world with Avis, a travelling ghost, as she helps the valley's guardian, Willow, find his keys to unlock the passage to a hidden world.

A SMALL JOURNEY is a visual novel/point and click adventure created in Ren'Py. Relax and explore the map locations as you help Avis and Willow find keys to unlock the doors to the Moonlight's Core.

title: Legacies of Dondoran
description: A 40-50 hour epic, featuring an extensive original musical score, and a dynamic skill tree progression system.

title: Amanita
description: Amanita is an introspective journey into your mind where the path seems to be only one, and it does not seem to be easy. Let yourself be guided by surreal characters in your thoughts, clash with your memories with sword blows, wander in your memory, play cards with your fears.

title: Lucy's World
description: Lucy's World is a cute 2D Jump & Run game where your task is to search the worlds and free little dragons.

title: Transience
description: Become an Accountant - a hired mercenary who keeps the books balanced by any means necessary. This time though, you are the intended target. Take a journey through New Houston in the year 2056 and follow one man's tale of redemption as he escapes Transience.

title: Dream Team Basketball
description: Dream Team Basketball combines traditional CCG gameplay with innovative mechanics inspired from the game of basketball.

title: Outpath
description:
An experimental clicker base building game.
Craft, gather & manage resources, base building, islands buy, exploit and expand!

title: Mimi and animals
description:
This game is the adventure of a girl, Mimi. Little girl Mimi has an adventure with the help of animals.

I think you can clear the game in one to two hours. To use for the gameplay video is OK. It's made with RPG Maker MZ.

This is a Wholesome game. You can play on both Windows and Mac.

title: Love & Sex: Second Base
description:
Love & Sex: Second Base is a dating sim where a geeky guy or girl gets to be be roommates with two very hot people and meet plenty of others in their daily life. The player has the choice of taking on the role of either a guy or a girl and meet a whole cast of unique and memorable characters along the way.

Mike is a young code monkey in a big company, even surrounded with beautiful girls his love life is in disarray. His high school sweetheart cheated on him and his latest flame is dating on of his friends. Will you be able to help him find love and avoid the pitfalls of dating life or will he end up alone and unhappy?

Bree is a college freshman, penniless and a bit socially awkward. Help her find a job and succeed in her studies to become a successful woman or lead her down a dark path of drugs and debauchery.

Basically, their lives (and love lives) are yours to control!

title: Commando Hero
description:
Hero wants to be a commando. Of course, there are difficult exams to pass for this. Will you help him through these exams? Commando Hero is a very difficult platform game. You need to finish the platform without "SAVE" and "CHECKPOINT".

Commando Hero is a third-person platform game. Finish the track in the fastest time and enter the Leaderboard. In the early access version, you will now race on the track with a single character.

Through the Leaderboard, other players will be able to see your rank on the track and you will compete with them for the "BEST TIME SCORE".

title: Isolated Room
description: What to do when your days are not going well? What to do when you need to wake up and manage a troubled life, in which you need to work, eat well, and still have time for yourself? Isolated Room is about that, and maybe a little more.

title: Holstin
description: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

title: Advendows Calendar OS 2022
description:
This is an escape room type game, disguised as an advent calendar, made in a couple of gruesome nights for my wife.

You have to click through 24 different "apps" on a virtual desktop, play some games and solve some puzzles to escape the Desktop Dimension and celebrate a peaceful christmas.

title: Mecha Ritz: Steel Rondo 2.0
description: An expanded version of Doujin shooting game Mecha Ritz, featuring new ships, adjusted game balance, new story content and various other adjustments.

title: Pokémon Battle Woods
description: Inspired by games like Slay the Spire or Banners of Ruin, this game was developed to deliver a similar experience but with Pokémon. Decision making, team building and having to make sacrifices are key components of the game.

title: Ascape
description: An exploration game with ASCII art

title: Humanity Lost
description: Will you save humanity? You are on a mission to find a new planet for humans to inhabit. In this story driven FPS space opera you will explore open world planets, find weapons, upgrade your character, and befriend alien species.

title: Otteretto
description: A game about palindromes (and otters).

title: Hat Tricks: Hare in Box
description: Put magic hats atop objects to change their behaviors, and get the rabbits to the carrots!

title: The Haunted Song
description:
What is it about a home that makes it feel so warm and cozy - Is it the fireplace cracking in the dim light, the placement of your favorite mug in a cabinet, or the people living within its corridors?
Moving into a new home can be exciting, but for little Song Li it was scary…
Explore a wholesome horror point and click adventure where you discover the secrets of Song Li’s new family home.

title: Little Frog Game
description:
Jump around through 3 varied stages to collect flies and beetles, while avoiding enemies and hazards along the way!

And don't forget to stay hydrated - froggy will slowly lose hydration and can refresh in small pools of freshwater throughout. But watch out for pits and dark saltwater - saltwater is no good for frogs!

Use the froggy tongue to grab hard to reach collectibles, or activate tongue flingers that will send froggy flying onwards and upwards! Collecting all 5 beetles before finishing each stage will let froggy go to a special bonus stage. There, froggy will find a big delicious dragonfly waiting at the end!

title: Roman Sands RE:Build
description: Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

title: Living Books: Stellaluna
description: Stellaluna is a Living Book adaptation based on Jannell Cannon’s original picture book. The story is about a bat named Stellaluna, who lost her mother due to an owl crashing into her. Stellaluna has to find her mother, but she meets new friends throughout the story. There is also a Bat Quiz in which children test their knowledge of Bats. In Let Me Play, every page can be clicked to uncover a surprise or two.

title: Blue's Birthday
description: Steve, Tickety, Slippery, and all of Blue's Friends need help preparing for Blue's birthday party! There's so much to do. Create a personalized card for Blue, select a special present play lots of multi-level learning games, explore in and around Blue's house and yard...and of course, find and solve NEW Blue's Clues. Help Steve figure out what party favor Blue wants to give to her guests, what she wants to eat, and more. With so much to explore, create, play and solve, every day can be a birthday celebration in this original adventure.

title: Frog Affirmations
description: An entry for #bitsyjam July2020

title: The Travelling Salesfrog Problem
description: A gift for the Bitsy Secret Santa 2019

title: Mario Kart 64 HD
description: A mod for Mario Kart 64 incorporating new HD renders of the characters designed to match the originals. Includes widescreen support.

title: Super Beast Hunt
description: Super Beast Hunt is a platformer game featuring a hungry demon who must save the town from their diminishing supply of meat.

title: Gardens of Vextro
description: A chain game anthology by eight members of the Vextro community. Developed sequentially, with each game responding to all previous entries.

title: Rabbit & Steel
description: Rabbit & Steel is a co-op roguelike where rabbits must team up together in raids to investigate strange happenings in the Moonlit Kingdom.

title: Tone's froggy adventure!
description: hang out in a pond and meet some frogs!

title: Pokémon Jade
description:
The Ario Region is inhabited only by Pokemon native to its land, based off the beautiful Australia. In this tropical region you'll find tons of new faces to bond with! The number is subject to change, could be more or less.
8 Gyms, Elite Four and a Champion - This game follows the traditional system, but don't fret, each gym leader will come with interesting puzzles and challenges galore!
Completely Original Region - Ario is like no other region in the original Pokemon games. It features multiple climates and atmospheres that'll keep gameplay feeling fresh.

title: Walk Around this Place
description: I think I see a tree!

title: Frog 'n Friends
description: A little adventure game about a frog and his friends.

title: Before Dawn
description:
You've arrived for your apprenticeship at a island where you will live and work for a old lighthouse keeper and experienced sailor.

He says most men don't make it before dawn comes and they've all quit due to the isolation here and atmosphere driving most people insane.

title: Black Eyes
description:
Black Eyes is a atmospheric VHS aesthetic styled horror title inspired by the urban legend of black eyed kids and inspired by the title Among The Sleep.

A short horror game for the Halloween season made in a few days!

One late evening you awake from a nightmare about a girl with black eyes, suddenly reality shifts and contorts and you feel something sinister trying to get in your room. You must now prevent whatever it is from trying to get in, while also finding a way out of your room and help get to your sisters room before it's too late.

title: Blut Club
description: On that cold and early morning of 2003, you stumble upon a lost mobile phone... Piece together elements of that tragic night in this short horror experience.

title: Grand Emprise: Time Travel Survival
description: Time travel through history to become god. Ride dinosaurs, forge tools, sail dunes, build a colony, siege castles, and automate & fly in the industrial revolution. An insane unforgettable and revolutionary survival crafting base building open world adventure.

title: Wheel of Time MUD
description:
The Wheel of Time MUD is a time-honored multi-user dungeon. It’s an interactive text-based game that has been enjoyed for free by web users since 1993. It is the oldest and most popular online game set in the Wheel of Time world.

Game mechanics can involve strategy, teamwork, puzzle-solving, timing, and knowledge gathering; but what you choose to do is up to you. There are a wide variety of players that you may encounter in your travels, but nobody is putting you into a box. Fancy being a Channeler from the White Tower? Ta’veren from Emond’s Field? A bloodthirsty trolloc from Thakan’dar? You can be as many, or as few, as you wish.

title: Abandoned Realms
description: The Abandoned Realms MUD is a fully-featured multiplayer experience with roleplaying and playerkilling. As you play the game, you will make both great friends, and vicious enemies - all real people who are playing alongside you!

title: Mordor
description:
Mordor is a MUD based on the works of J. R. R. Tolkien, especially The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit. While playing the game, you can explore over 75 unique areas including: Isengard, Edoras, Midgewater, Fangorn, Shelob's Lair, Lothlorien, Rivendell, Lonely Mountain, Helms Deep, Minas Morgul, and many more. New areas are added regularly.

Mordor's unique multi-class system, along with its remort classes, allows you to completely customize your character. Role-play as good or evil and engage in player vs. player combat by joining an alliance, such as the Eye of Sauron, the Hand of Saruman, the Haradrims, the Last Alliance, the Northern Rangers, and the White Council. Solo and mercenary classes are also available, along with an alliance dedicated to helping out new players -- the Guardians of Mordor.

All alliances are ever evolving through the expansion of their halls and the addition of new alliance-specific equipment. We have a full time Quest Master and often offer Immortal quests.

title: ManServant: Gay Visual Novel
description: In Ancient Rome, demons rule and mortals are slaves. Follow the ambitious slave Silvan as he schemes his way into the emperor's court to accomplish his mission of becoming a demon.

title: Tanuki's Spring Walk
description:
You get a letter from your fox friend, Kitsune, on a pleasant spring morning.

It's time to go on a walk!

A novel game stroll which you play by making choices. Pick up ingredients on the way to Kitsune's house.

title: Tinykin Challenge Update
description: The world of Tinykin just got a lil’ bigger with new Time Attack Challenges! Find your new hornet friends Mach & Dash using your AR glasses to join the tiny racing buzz, & win medals to collect sweet prizes!

title: Peppa Pig: World Adventures
description: Play in the bigger, wider world of Peppa Pig, and bring your family into the story! Make pizza in Italy, walk on Hollywood Boulevard, climb the Eiffel Tower and more on your world tour. Create your own unique and dazzling family home, and discover more characters, quests and fun than ever before!

title: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Ch 2: Retribution - Payback Edition
description: It's time to get some Payback! Get this upgrade and receive two weapon recipes, 10 collectable postcards, and a unique "Demon" storage shelf!

title: Smoke Attack 2
description: Smoke Attack 2 is a video game published in 2004 on Windows. It is an action and educational game, set in an arcade, with themes of health nutrition, shooter and western.

title: All Day Dying: Redux Edition
description: A single player score attack game for quick sessions of focused adrenaline where you complete various goals and beat difficult score challenges. Only pure combat where precision and technique is rewarded

title: SmugForce
description: Slide and Dive through enemy bullets inside underground rave parties. Gun down the Neon Raver Gang, LSD and save Smugtopia, in this physics based third-person movement shooter.

title: Fantavision 202X
description: Fantavision 202x is a firework puzzle game.

title: Without Escape
description:
Can you escape the nightmare and find the answers you're looking for?

Without Escape is a tribute to first-person graphic adventures of the early '90s with an interactive story told through pre-rendered background and full-motion video. Explore the confines of your own home as you flip between a mundane existence and a terrifying otherworld. Are you prepared to endure the horrors that await you?

title: Shattered Kingdoms
description:
Shattered Kingdoms (SK) is a text-based sword and sorcery fantasy role playing game, played online by many people at the same time who each assume the identity of a different character.

Our players are readers and gamers – those compelled by adventure, role play and being a part of an ongoing saga story line. The world of Pyrathia is filled with turmoil and conflict. The political and physical landscapes can change over time. Some of these changes are the direct efforts of players through their mortal characters. Other changes are beyond their control as the gods and other powerful forces have real influence on the realm.

title: Disaster Band
description:
Let's get the party started! Play solo or connect with your friends, pick a track, choose your instrument and start playing. The fun never stops: Import your own tracks and prove that you and your buddies are not going down in history as the ultimate Disaster Band.

With the creative freedom to play any note at any time, you can practice and improvise in absolutely every song while you explore the music. Don't forget: Practice makes Perfect. And of course, perfection leads to higher scores. But where is the fun in that? With Disaster Band's dynamic sound engine even playing the wrong notes leads to neverending fun and entertainment.

title: Aabahran: The Forsaken Lands
description:
Aabahran is a multi-user dungeon, or MUD. A MUD is a multi-player computer game that combines elements of role-playing games, hack and slash style computer games and social chat rooms. MUDs are text-driven, where players read descriptions of rooms, objects, events, other characters, and computer-controlled creatures or non-player characters (NPCs) in a virtual world.

Aabahran has been in existence since June of 2000, ranking it in line with many of the long-standing MUDs still in existence. Its world is rich, dynamic and exciting. It is also a roleplaying-enforced, playerkilling MUD. What this means is that in Aabahran, you are required to play a character to its full extent. Additionally, you may kill other players (after a certain rank and within our highly balanced playerkilling ranges). In fact, because Aabahran has a balanced rare & unique item system, you may need to kill other players in order to get that special sword or shield you’ve been looking for! The world is massive, with over 10,000 unique rooms for you to explore. Because of the variety of races and classes, the game remains fresh and exciting, and endlessly replayable.

title: Lunatic Dawn: Passage of the Book
description:
Small tales add up to create a history that is all your own. Your mission is to seize the key of fate and build the history of this land.

Lunatic Dawn - Passage of the Book is a non-linear RPG in which you can create your own character anywhere in the world and travel freely as you desire. Take on jobs, deliver items, explore various dungeons & buildings, hunt down criminals, assassinate people, start fights in towns, steal, buy a house, raise a family & get married, be a good person or a murderous cutthroat, or save the world from ultimate evil! The choices are limitless in this game! The only thing you are bound to is can you survive the decisions that you choose to follow?

title: Broken Through
description:
7 years ago, your best friend Leo Williams mysteriously disappeared, and no one had the slightest clue where he went.

Seven years after this incident, Leo was declared dead since no one could find him.

And now you are in possession of his belongings.

But something about his stuff seems off...

Something says he's still out there.

And many more too.

Broken Through is a full length psychological story rich horror game experience that blends terrifying scenarios with dreamish visuals combined with a nostalgic retro theme.

Wander through this world with caution at all time.

There’s more than what meets the eye.

title: Countdown 1: The Body
description:
Countdown 1 - The Body is the first of a trilogy of text adventure games released as a prequel, of sorts, to 6 Days a Sacrifice. Many of the events depicted expand on events in Trilby's Notes or 6 Days a Sacrifice.

You are Jack Frehorn. It has been one year since you shot what you thought was a demon but was, instead, your friend Wilbur. You then pledged yourself to the Prince. You must complete his instructions. The prophecy must get written.

title: Countdown 2: The Soul
description:
Countdown 2 - The Soul is the second of a trilogy of text adventure games released as a prequel, of sorts, to 6 Days a Sacrifice. Many of the events depicted expand on events in Trilby's Notes or 6 Days a Sacrifice.

You are a new acolyte in the Order of Blessed Agonies. You have already purged your body and mind. Now you must purge your soul by killing your boyfriend Jason.

The nightmares from that day still haunt you. You wander out of the women's dormitory and end up in the courtyard, where you meet a stranger in a tattered red robe. He has a task for you.

title: Countdown 3: The Mind
description:
Countdown 3 - The Mind is the third of a trilogy of text adventure games released as a prequel, of sorts, to 6 Days a Sacrifice. Many of the events depicted expand on events in Trilby's Notes or 6 Days a Sacrifice.

The year is 2386. You are an unnamed delivery man. You were given a parcel and a wad of cash as thick as your thumb by a bald man in tattered red robes. All you need to do is deliver the parcel to the occupant in cell 105 of the New Delhi Mental Hospital. Don't let the guards see you.

title: Earthling Priorities
description:
Earthling Priorities is a subtle mini-adventure game, partly homaging those good ol' times when Space Quest happened and Big Brother was still considered a bad thing.

It is trying very hard to be pithy, but is mostly rather silly.

You'll point, click, solve at least one puzzle, and get to ponder the reality of your sci-fi existence; also, the importance of doors.

title: Kairos
description: Kairos is a basic Asteroids-like game, where your objective is to kill enemies to collect more ammo and stay alive. Getting hit decreases Kairo's time, shortening your run!

title: Crelabeth: Unholy Lands
description: Explore, fight, survive and unravel mysteries in this unique and unforgiving 2D isometric RPG set in an original dark, high fantasy world. Crelabeth's exceptional attention to detail and realistic simulation of all things aim to provide a deeply immersive and dynamic gameplay experience.

title: Cut Me Deeply
description: A vampire wakes up miles from his lair. He doesn't remember what happened or why he is in the middle of the forest. All he wants to do is go home. Now if only that clingy, beeping robot would leave him alone!

title: Cubic Light
description: Cubic Light is minimalistic puzzle game where you need to put blocks to activate the entire image. Grab the block, define the color if necessary, and put it into the correct place. You need to activate all the cells to complete the level.

title: I Frog-ot
description: A short horror- I mean, cute game :) Help a normal, innocent frog get back to his super awesome wizard self!! :O

title: Ys X: Nordics
description: Ys X: Nordics is a brand-new adventure set in the northern sea Obelia Bay, featuring young adventurer Adol Christin as the protagonist. Please look forward to this latest title in the Ys series, from the development team that brought you Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of Dana and Ys IX: Monstrum Nox.

title: Portal Versus
description: Portal Versus introduces live time trials so you can race a friend in real-time in Portal 2s standard maps. Your goal is to complete the test chamber before the other tester.

title: Hat World: New Testament
description: An indie RPG developed primarily by a solo developer using RPG Maker VX. The player can select one of six main characters in a multiverse of mysterious worlds created through the power of hats. The game lets you explore beautiful side-scrolling maps and take part in fast-paced turn-based battles, with non-linear progression, sidequests, and lots of customization. Oh, and there are also cute girls in big hats.

title: Telos Legacy
description: Telos is a fast paced, multiplayer Arena Shooter with advanced movement, slow TTK and a varied arsenal.

title: Whisker Squadron: Survivor
description: Wreak vengeance with your elite craft on waves of Swarm bugs, who are hellbent on killing you and everyone you love. Harvest their guts for scrap and earn a deliciously varied array of upgrades. Beat the last wave if you have the skill, then strap in and try again in this survival roguelite shooter.

title: 5 Nights At Grek's Hotel
description: 5 Nights At Grek's Hotel is a game where you rent a room for a few days, only to realize something is terribly wrong. It only lasts about half an hour, but it depends on how well you survive the monster chasing you at the end. Shrek is fired due to copyright.

title: Hell Runner
description: Fast Paced first person platformer game where you try to beat each level as fast as possible.

title: Rush Legends
description: Rush Legends is an online multiplayer First Person Shooter game with parkour mechanics where players can select a hero and utilize their unique abilities to be the last one standing.

title: Dawn of Dark Blood
description:
Dawn of Dark Blood is a psychological Thriller puzzle game inspired from old ps1 games like Silent Hill and Resident Evil, with a pinch of VHS for effect.

Michael, son of a poor maid, gets a letter from his mother asking him to visit, as the person for whom she works, has a job for him. But when he arrives troubling and horrifying secrets about the Mansion are uncovered.

title: Decrypt
description:
When a freight ship goes missing and is later found abandoned, you are sent to investigate it to solve the mystery of its missing crew.

The ISS Travan is found at a fringe system thousands of klicks off its original course.

The GiS Trade Federation believes that its crew has abandoned the ship to evade crippling trade fines in a brutal interstellar economy. You are a Data Forensics officer assigned to investigate the vessel.

What you will uncover on the Travan is a far more insidious and horrifying truth.

Features:

First-person sci-fi survival-horror adventure
Story rich gameplay - piece together a compelling narrative to discover the fate of the Travan's crew
Deep Exploration - traverse the ship to locate Terminals to progress
All original soundtrack
Bite-sized thrill - 45 mins - 1 hour playtime!
Intense scares

title: Battle of the Youstrass
description:
Battle of the Youstrass is a shareware Japanese-style tactical role-playing game.

The game takes place on the world of Youstrass where two countries share a single continent and where technology and magic co-exist. One of the countries, Kradion, is largely frozen. Its people are famous for their mercenary soldiers and mechanical fighters. The other country, Welfrad, is prosperous and fertile. Kradion depends on imported food. When the great famine struck there was no food available and times were hard, so Kradion attacked Welfrad, all but destroying Welfrad's royal knight units. Just a few ace units survived because they were not in the capital when the attack came.

Among these is Ryuke, aka Blue Wing, chief knight of the royal army, who pilots the elemental fighter Huben Drake. The game starts with Ryuke separated from surviving units. He must survive and join his comrades to wage guerrilla war on the enemy.

The game consists of large-scale tactical battles, which are played on an isometrically viewed map, only part of which can be seen at once. There is a mini map in the lower left of the screen which shows the whole game area and the location of any other units, both friends and foe. During actual battles between units the game switches to a different view which displays the combat. As combat progresses the character collects experience points, special items, and additional special abilities.

title: Cultivating Happiness
description: As you watch TV, an odd commercial comes on, and it really speaks to you. Like, directly. This game was made for O2A2VNJam 2022!

title: Discover the Ocean
description:
The ocean: A world of mystery and secrets. But what lies beneath the surface?

Discover the Ocean - brought to you by the Ocean Exploration Program

title: Cold Ice Remastered
description: This project is a modern open-sourced rebuild of Cold Ice 1.75, a popular Half-Life mod back in 1999. Set in a winter scene, its philosophy is to deliver a deathmatch that doesn't take itself seriously. Only in this mod will you find voiceover cameos from Samuel L. Jackson, Hans Gruber, and "Leeroy Jenkins" by Ben Schulz. Its ethos delivers an explosively frantic fast-paced gameplay that was and always will be Cold Ice.

title: Dragoon's Journey
description:
The Evil Knight is attacking Fluffyton!

The only help to these poor blighted souls comes from the seriously under equipped Sir Tain the Dragoon, who must explore the nearby dungeon for the items needed to defeat the Evil Knight, but his journey will have him deal with giant toads, drunken gnomes and much more!

title: Vampire Slayer
description: Other vampire hunters would just slay vampires and get the reward. But this crazy huntress, she was different. She would fight a vampire until it was helpless and weak, and then she would completely subdue it and use for her very own and very dirty purposes...

title: Boobs vs Aliens
description: Discover your real divine heritage in our funtastic Tower Defense game! Join the fast-paced, action-packed, cosmically entertaining world of Boobs vs. Aliens and see your powers grow with each battle! Dig deep inside the human psyche, and learn about the very essence of libido as you take part in unforgettable and kinky sexual adventures filled with legendary tales of heroism, tantra, neuroscience, occult, virtual reality and out of this world hi-tech weaponry! So what are you waiting for? Give a fuck! Save the world!

title: Dweller
description: Dive deep into the mountain to seek your revenge and slay the evil Goblin King. Explore randomly created dungeons and caves. Play three different character classes. Fight many kinds of monsters. Discover ancient artifacts. Dweller is a fantasy roguelike/rpg made specifically for handheld devices. The game is available for Android and Java (J2ME) enabled devices and as a standalone desktop application.

title: Batty Zabella
description: A horror point-and-click game made with 30% nostalgia, and 70% sass.

title: Moment to Midnight
description:
A promise. A prophecy. And a lost, little stranger.

Moment to Midnight is a small story game made in a week, inspired by Ludum Dare 45, with a lot of optional dialogue and a couple secrets.

title: Factory Town: Idle
description: Factory Town: Idle is an incremental-style Town Builder. Manage a bustling village so it will produce and sell a huge range of items - even when you are away. Then spend your exponentially growing pile of resources to unlock new tech and supercharge your production to unlimited speeds.

title: Attack of the Mutant Artificial Trees
description: A free online video game developed as part of a marketing campaign by the National Christmas Tree Association in 2004. The game was meant to support the natural Christmas tree industry and received criticism from artificial tree producers. It has been described as similar to Whac-A-Mole.

title: Ranata the Frog and the Broken Forest
description: You have been summoned! help the Witch find the ingredients she needs in thiis arcade platformer.

title: Frogs
description: Frogs is a clicker game where you tap to collect a variety of frogs. You can obtain them every 2 hours or unlock unique ones from chests that you can obtain by clicking. Equip frogs to boost your score, trade them in the marketplace, and just collect them all. Dive into this adventure with us!

title: Squid! Escape! Fight!
description: Swim under the sea with this hungry cephalopod and meet the other marine dwellers in this straight forward arcade adventure.

title: Frog Daddy's Dash
description:
Frog Daddy Dash is a game about the time crunch of being a single, working parent. Try to scrape together some money selling mushrooms during the day, and spend your limited time as a currency at night to take care of yourself and your family.

Sometimes you will have to make hard choices as to what you'll spend your hours on. When your a single, working parent, there's never enough hours in the day.

title: You&Me
description:
You&Me is a Yume Nikki fangame. This game focuses on the connection and mechanics of the dreams, both shared and not shared, between Yarn and Nyla, and how these two sisters influence one-another.

This game was created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam, in celebration of Yume Nikki's 13th anniversary. This is a game that follows a similar structure to Yume Nikki, as you explore through dreams and collect Stuff, but is otherwise a self-contained, original project.

title: Froggy's Battle
description: Froggy's Battle is an action roguelike game set in a loop. Help Froggy the steezy magician skater frog defeat all the baddies squatting her favorite riding spot. Choose your upgrades carefully, become more and more powerful and kickflip yourself through waves of enemies and ferocious bosses!

title: Trade Effluent
description: Trade Effluent is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. Your main goal is to find effects and progress to the next area. Each area has at least one effect in it.

title: The Dream Diary
description: The Dream Diary is an English fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It is also a fangame of Cinderella Girls, a title from the Idolmaster series. You play as Uzuki Shimamura, one of the characters from Cinderella Girls, as she explores her dreams.

title: Madotsuki's Story
description: Madotsuki's Story is a sidescrolling platformer-esque Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. The goal is to explore the dream world and collect effects.

title: Frog Gift
description: A short game made for the NDJ7!

title: Mado Paf!
description:
Mado Paf! is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It is based on the video game Super Paf! by Amaka Soft, and was developed in Gemix Studio.

Mado Paf! is an arcade-style shooter game. The goal is to kill the enemies bouncing around the screen and get as high of a score as possible. The player has five lives, which are lost if an enemy touches the player character. The game ends when all lives are lost.

title: Vocaless
description: Vocaless is a unique platformer game with rhythm elements, you must perform all of your actions to the beat! Not only that, but everything in the game, from enemies to obstacles, follows the beat of the music.

title: InSomnus
description: InSomnus is an English Yume Nikki Fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It stars Fiona. You are stuck in a dream and cannot wake up. Explore various dream worlds from the central hub and find a way to wake up.

title: Lunchtime at Lilly's
description: Join Lilly for lunch!

title: Hentekorin
description: Hentekorin is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. Hentekorin is a 3D traditional fangame where your main goal is to explore.

title: Wizard Recurse
description: Save a wizard from a timeloop using their magic hat.

title: Dream Arena
description: Dream Arena is non-traditional Yume Nikki fangame in the arena fighter genre created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam.

title: Do You Think This is a Game?
description: Do You Think This is a Game? is a Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It is a parody fangame regarding the leader of the Dream Diary Jam, Doc Saturn, jokingly threatening to ban Pyromantic from the Discord server unless they made a fangame in the next 4 hours under certain specifications (number of nexus doors, effects, and events).

title: MidCreati
description: MidCreati is a platformer game where a girl must escape by creating platforms, as she is captured by an evil organization who wishes to research her mysterious powers.

title: Long and Steady Departure
description: Long and Steady Departure is a platformer game about a mysterious girl named Aya who must traverse her own mysterious world by flipping the gravity.

title: Funkbot 02
description: Funkbot 02 is a rhythm game about a robot who must save Jet City's plants by navigating and watering plants to the beat of the music.

title: Frog 'n' Roll
description: Roll around as a cute little frog, shoot waves of bugs and upgrade your weapons in this arcade shooter, Frog 'n' Roll!

title: Ninja Froggies
description:
Ninja Froggies is a tower defense game in which you help the little Froggies to defend their pond against the Fishies that try to evade it and snacc their Tadpoles!

With a variety of brave warriors you can build up a strong army of Froggies to fight the waves of enemies approaching. Each Froggy has their own unique power or effect that either serve to fight head on or help others by increasing certain stats.

title: Frog Stack
description: Move frogs, stack frogs, build frog stacks and get to the flags.

title: Kiyeko and the Lost Night
description: This well-thought-out title is an interactive story beautifully narrated by Academy-Award winning actor Ben Kingsley. Kingsley, in the role of the Story Teller, offers a pleasant, pleasurable stroll through an Amazon village and its surroundings. The story follows jungle-boy Kiyeko's effort to retrieve the Night, stolen by a couple of snakes reminiscent of Disney's bad-guy animal characters, through 11 different animated scenes - from Kiyeko's village in the Amazon jungle, through the forest, to the snakes' lair, and back again. The well-drawn graphics, which integrate 3D backgrounds with 3D animations, and movie-style quality of the title are lovely to look at, regardless of your age.

title: Box World
description: Box World is a single player puzzle video game for Windows 3.1, created and published by Jeng-Long Jiang in 1992.

title: Starl Metaverse Project
description:
A grassroots space-themed metaverse and gaming project, the STARL Metaverse Project was built from the ground up by a team of community-sourced and AAA game developers and designers. It contains rich and sometimes outlandish designs, themes, environments, and characters that go beyond the mainstream and standard metaverse projects.

Starting out as a crypto token, it has evolved into a full-fledged game and environment built in Unreal Engine 5 and utilizing both on-chain and offchain assets so users can choose their level of involvement with blockchain technology. As the project's theme indicates, "Be Yourself" is the goal, and deep customization extends beyond characters to ships and environments.

There are portals within the STARL environment connecting to many aspects of the environment, such as the MMO Space flight, battle, and trading game Warp Nexus, live events arenas, living modules to conquer solar systems, meditation rooms, themed lounges, and the goal of integrating education into the environment.

title: Kaiju Princess
description: Living with a mysterious invader from outer space... who controls horrifying kaijus! (but she's pretty lazy).

title: Eerie Mountain
description: You are playing as a forest ranger that is going to investigate a sudden missing family on the Eerie Mountain.

title: Eight Corners: A Maguntsche Story
description:
An Insight Into The Past...

Taking place right before the events of Maguntsche: Chapter Two, you are a factory employee at the Pallen Organs Company who has awaken in a mysterious room with no memory of what happened before you were put here. The room has no windows or doors. Your goal is to find a way out. If there is one. But what is this? A hidden world is revealed with every blink. The air is cold and the space lacks light. Perhaps this darkness might shed some light on the unfortunate circumstances you have found yourself.

A Gift to Maguntsche Fans...

Releasing on the anniversary of Maguntsche: Chapter One, Eight Corners will give players the insight they need to be immersed in the growing universe when Chapter Two launches later this year.

How To Play...

Every 15 seconds, you will find yourself in one of two places. Our world or the realm. Our world acts as a "safe zone" where the player can charge their flashlight by accessing one of the terminals. If you enter the right sequence at the terminal, you gain +25% of your flashlights charge. When in the realm, there are two location you can be attacked from, using your flashlight you can flash an enemy using 25% of the charge to push them back away. There is a five second cool down for every time you use the flash ability. Your task is to survive as long as possible.

Increasing Difficulty...

The longer you survive, the more difficult the game becomes. The recharge sequences will gradually grow longer in length, and the enemies will approach more quickly.

title: Empty Head
description: In the small hamlet of Elkedor lives the Baker family, isolated and almost ''inexistent'' for the townsfolk. Arold, family man and lawyer with no fame, enters in a difficult time of his life between alcoholism and a falling apart marriage. His days began getting filled by drinking more and more, while his wife and their two children, Sarah and Thomas, started to get detached and cold. One night the two went missing. Desperate at the thought of losing them he decided to investigate until, thanks to clues found in the house, succeeds in finding a hidden passage. Lies, compulsions, and hatred are the summary of what underlies in the ambitious Baker family.

title: Experiment: Groceries
description: You go to the local supermarket every day, but you notice that something changes. You should figure out the truth about this place.

title: Space Pirate Dernshous
description:
Dernshous was basically what I liked from Escape Velocity, which was seeing little spaceships flying around and shooting and docking at space stations, and the idea of going aboard other ships. So that's pretty much what Dernshous is, but I feel like it's still too much of a conventional game that it doesn't work how I'd like. I think I would've preferred it narrowed down more with a stronger focus rather than being half a normal space game.

Dernshous was almost meant to be a much simpler version of Slumos, my other space flying game, but it got out of hand as well. I included an old version of the game because I kind of like the looser under-done feel of it, I often feel like I lose something as I try and refine my games, so the older version could remind me of what I was going for / ideas I had earlier, as I was getting a bit lost with what to focus on.

title: FeedVid
description:
Introducing FeedVid, a revolutionary new video-sharing website and social network. Our platform integrates an advanced neural-network based algorithm that automatically determines your viewing preferences. We serve you the content that you want to watch!

Update from FeedVid Inc. CEO August Williams

We are aware of an issue affecting a small number of users in which our algorithm will recommend disturbing or highly unusual videos. We appreciate the support from the community and ask that you flag any such videos that you find in your feed.

title: Get Home Safe
description: A tired man was on his way back to the river. However, he had to go home alone in a desolate atmosphere.

title: Ghost Study
description: You are participating in a study that aims to determine the effects of low-frequency sounds on the human body. Previous studies have shown that these frequencies can cause odd sensations that people attribute to Paranormal Encounters. What will you experience?

title: Good Boy 2
description:
Happy birthday...again! Sadly before you have any cake mommy said you have to go see the doctor! What is she thinking? It's your birthday it should be time for cake, time to play with the cats! But don't worry, I'm sure nothing bad will happen..

Good Boy 2 is the sequel to Good Boy 1 and takes place a couple of years after the events of the first game. Featuring a new story and hand drawn graphics.

title: Agent Roy: Secure the Temple
description: Agent Roy: Secure the temple is a thrilling 3rd person action shooter. Roy is fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. 5 minutes. Deadly mercenaries. Can he hold the fort until the backup arrives? Prepare for the worst.

title: Brick Odyssey
description:
Brick Odyssey is a roguelike game built around block-breaker mechanics.
Upgrade your bricks to become stronger and fight unique enemies with special abilities.

title: Tricky Tracks
description: Tricky Tracks is a fun and exciting multiplayer hide & seek game with a twist: As a Runner, you leave footprints! Handle them cleverly and confuse your chasers while you're running and hiding. Or as a Seeker: Don't let them fool you!

title: A Maiden Astrologer Divines the Future
description: This work is an adventure game that you can enjoy about an astrologer named Izumi who feels happy and rewarded when "making someone happy" or "being able to support someone".

title: Undertone
description: A stylized first-person game that makes use of a lens gun to mix colors to effectively fight monsters.

title: Crossfire: Sierra Squad
description: Crossfire: Sierra Squad is a virtual reality first-person shooter video game developed and published by Smilegate.

title: The Floor is Breathing
description: The Floor is Breathing is a short liminal space horror game. Play through multiple perspectives as you try to understand the deaths of four innocent people.

title: Fight the Dracula!
description:
Fight the Dracula is a 2D Action Game where you fight Dracula. The gameplay itself is inspired by "I wanna be the Boshy" and or Mega Man.

You enter the stairway to Draculas' throne room where encouraging horses will tell you words of encouragement and sometimes gameplay hints. The fight itself is a high focus combat where you have to swiftly react to Draculas moves and hit him in the head (like in Castlevania) until he falls and dies!

The fight requires high focus and concentration as the smallest slip up can and will cause a untimely demise to the player character.

title: Grainwind Incident 77
description: Grainwind Incident 77 is a realistic urban exploration VHS Found Footage horror title.

title: Gravity Angels Part 2: The Betrayal
description:
Gravity Angels Part 2: The Betrayal is the second installment in Brilliant Digital Entertainment's Gravity Angels saga. Just like the first part, this Multipath Movie uses the in-game engine to render a real-time, three-dimensional, digitally animated story. At certain predetermined points in the storyline the player gets to choose one of multiple plot alternatives or paths that, while influencing the story, never change the actual outcome. Each Multipath Movie episode - they were originally available as Webisodes as well - runs approximately 30 minutes.

We rejoin the team of rogue employees, introduced in the first episode, on Jupiter's moon Ganymede just as the Miller Western Corporate Conglomerate is moving to turn the mining base into a death trap. It soon becomes clear that the company will stop at nothing to secure its interests in the alien artefact discovered deep below the surface. Green, the facility sheriff and company henchman, receives orders to terminate any witnesses. All transmissions are jammed, company backup is on the way and that means there's only two options left to our heroes: death or a desperate fight for survival.

title: Gravity Angels Part 3: Payback
description:
Gravity Angels Part 3: Payback is the third part in the epic Gravity Angels saga of Multipath Movies. These are not 'games' in the strict sense of the word, but digitally animated stories, rendered in real-time by the graphic engine, which can be influenced by the viewer at certain points in the story line.

After the events in the previous episode, the alien ship has started moving slowly towards the surface, gradually destroying the Ganymede colony in the process. The team has no choice but to go into the alien vessel and find a way to stop this.

To add to the predicament, Green, the base sheriff, who is now alone but still at large, is moving to make sure that if he doesn't make it out alive no- one else will either.

Our heroes split up into small teams to foil Green's sabotage plan and save the base. Many dangers await along the way and not everyone might live to see another day, but if they do, they'll make sure to get some... payback!

title: Gravity Angels Part 4: Death Force
description:
This is the fourth and final chapter in Brilliant Digital Entertainment's Gravity Angels series of Multipath Movies. Each one of these interactive movies uses a proprietary video engine that renders animated scenes in real-time. In the course of the movie, players can make a number of 'decisions' that will lead the story down different plot branches.
