After the events of the first, second and third chapters, the enigmatic alien ship breaches the surface of Ganymede. Our heroes decide to pay another visit and stumble upon the ship's control room, where they will make a startling discovery.
Time is running out for the team as they find out that Miller Western, the most powerful company in human history, knew all along what was going on on Ganymede. Company reinforcements arrive in strength and they have no intention of taking prisoners. The only thing left to do for Ty, Felice, Jazz, Reece, Bennett and the others, is to start making preparations for their last stand against this Death Force...

title: Gregory's Epic Adventure
description: Visual-novel-epic-adventure-puzzle-parody-thing, baby! Give it a go for your pal Gregory!

title: Hamelin
description: Discover this reinterpretation of an old tail, "Pied piper of Hamelin".

title: Hell Awaits
description: You pour the Cereal into your bowl and a Game Cartridge falls with a clink into your bowl. You pick up the Jet black cartridge and inspect it. Across the Cover in blood red font it reads "Hell Awaits". Guess you're skipping breakfast today.

title: Hesperian Wars
description:
After the death of its emperor the Hesperian Empire breaks down and four races fight for the leadership. Each faction - Giants, Mages, Druids and Pygmies - can be played in their campaigns consisting of 20 missions. The missions goals are usually to destroy or protect something.

The units have special abilities and an inventory to store items like potions, money or spells which are left behind from defeated enemies. They also can be upgraded by moving them in the appropriate building (e.g. a blacksmith) and spending money. There is no classical base building.

title: I Did a Bad Thing
description:
I Did a Bad Thing a narrative mystery puzzle game. IDABT slowly unravels a layerd mystery through puzzles, story, items and world building. The overarching story of IDABT is a fictionalized account of true events - a heinous murder/suicide in New England in 2007. This is the prologue demo. More episodes to be released upon continuing interest.

IDABT features original art, music and puzzles that may stretch beyond the boundaries of your device. The demo should provide about an hour or two of gameplay depending on your interest in ultra challenging puzzles. Think of it as Professor Layton, but in hell...and also you have no shoes.

title: Hituzibuster
description:
This is an invader mini-game.
Throw sheep to annihilate your enemies.
You have to collect the sheep you threw.
The game ends when you complete Round 30.

title: Elsewhere in the Night
description: Elsewhere in the Night is a 2D psychic noir point and click adventure game. Play as private detective Lady Tick Tock as she investigates the latest in a string of unsolved murders.

title: Madvent Calendar 3 Necrosis
description:
It's becoming too powerful...
Lost in an ocean of dark isolation, her voice beckons to you once more.
The comforting black ink dissolves, and you bathe in the blinding glow of unnatural lights.
Your sight returns, and you are drifting in the bay of bustling city.
Many towers scrape the sky, but one pierces right through it.
The glass ball atop its point resonates with the same energy that religious symbol held.
In New Spook City a sickness shall spread.
Collect 24 dreams before they're all dead.

title: The Land Before Time: Activity Center
description: The Land Before Time: Activity Center is the first educational title based on the The Land Before Time movie series. This game features a selection activities featuring trivia quizzes about dinosaurs, mazes, memory games, and building their own dinosaurs and printing them out to share with friends and family. Tree stars can be earned to unlock movies to be played in the Movie Theater.

title: Akashi
description: Akashi is a Japanese Yume Nikki Fangame. It follows Yugano, a girl who explores her dreams to collect Stoicheios (effects).

title: Bonetale
description:
Bonetale is a fan game based on Undertale on the Genocide path. In this game you, in the role of Sans, need to defeat an evil kid named Frisk.
The game features a well-developed combat system with multiple characters, you can fight as different Undertale characters in different levels and maps.

title: ColourS
description:
ColourS is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The primary goal of the game is to explore Midoritsuki's dream world and collect effects.

One interesting element of this game is that the majority of the dream world is initially in grayscale. There are several colored orbs hidden in the dream world for the player to find that will change the appearance of certain areas once obtained, also granting the player access to new areas/effects.

title: Dream Kombat
description: Dream Kombat is a Japanese 2D fighting game, featuring characters from Yume Nikki and its fangames. The concept (and some visuals) are based off the Mortal Kombat fighting game series.

title: Eret Link
description: Eret Link is a short Yume Nikki fangame. This game stars a character from DreaMarbleng - a red haired girl named Borotsuki.

title: Kataribesou: Ensouki
description: Kataribesou: Ensouki is a game inspired by Yume Nikki, starring a featureless figure named Shidonoko, traveling into weird worlds from a building. The game contains RPG elements (combat, an item shop, etc.). It additionally lets one choose a difficulty level at the start of the game.

title: Kou
description: Kou is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It's a traditional fangame with two playable characters: Okutsuki and Nawatsuki. The overall goal of the game is to explore and collect effects.

title: Wonderland Adventures: Planet of the Z-Bots
description: Planet of the Z-Bots is the epic conclusion to the Wonderland Adventures trilogy, and the largest Wonderland Adventures game yet. Travel to distant planets, meet new characters, solve new puzzles, and save Wonderland from the menace of the Z-Bots.

title: Ls
description: ls is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame madeby an unknown creator. The game stars lca (with a lowercase L).

title: Made in Nightmare
description: Made in Nightmare is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The goal of the game is to explore Nemu's dream world and collect effects.

title: Maimu
description: Maimu is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Kiratsuki, a girl who refuses to leave the place she's staying at. The goal is to explore and obtain effects.

title: Mind Color
description: Mind Color is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Kitotsuki and explore a strange set of worlds outside your bedroom. The objective of this game is to explore and collect all of the Colors scattered throughout each world to unlock the ending.

title: Mortalis
description:
Mortalis is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. Shimotsuki refuses to leave her room, instead exploring a dream world seeking to collect effects. Additionally, there is a game console resembling a GameCube in the room that can be used to play a minigame called Tomato.

Uniquely, music tracks are not given by merely entering areas. Instead, tracks are collected through finding floating orange music notes in dream world locations.

title: Negaigoto
description: Negaigoto is a Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Ken, a person living in an old-styled Japanese house with a small garden as opposed to a balcony. Unable to leave his house, he explores a dream world through sleeping in his bed. In the dream world, the nexus contains a single door with 4 possible locations, chosen randomly when the player sleeps.

title: On Border
description: On Border is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The goal of the game is to explore Jaretsuki's dream world and collect effects.

title: Onasu
description:
Onasu is a Yume Nikki fangame. It is based on the console game in Yume Nikki, Nasu.

Your goal is to catch the falling eggplants before they destroy all of the floor tiles beneath you and achieve the highest score possible.

title: Psyder
description: psyder is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Kataochi. You can also play minigame called Sushi Survivor.

title: Remegeton
description: Remegeton is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Harutsuki, a young girl who has locked herself in. Remegeton focuses on collecting effects and exploration, like most traditional Yume Nikki fangames.

title: Tamashii Yume
description: Tamashii Yume is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The goal is to beat the game as fast as you can. Along the way you face off with various characters from the original Yume Nikki, including doppelgängers of Madotsuki herself.

title: Trial
description: Trial is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You take the role of Suzutsuki, a girl who cannot leave her room, thus forcing her to explore her own dreams instead of reality. Trial has an unusually large number of effects compared to most fangames, containing 28 effects.

title: Unable
description: Unable is a Chinese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Bility, a girl whose right eye is bandaged up. The objective of the game is to collect effects and explore the dream world.

title: Apple
description: How do you like them apples? Because we have them all! Have time in the game or click the apple to get your favorite apple.

title: Yume Nikki Nijisousaku STG
description: Yume Nikki Nijisousaku STG is a vertical-scrolling shooter/bullet-hell style Yume Nikki fangame. You control Madotsuki from the original game as she fights her way through the White Desert.

title: Yume Memochou
description:
Yume Memochou is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame, starring Shiranaishi. The objective of the game is to collect "Charas" (effects) and "Treasures".

Every time Shiranaishi dreams, the type of day cycles through. There are 4 types of "special days". The type of day can be chosen in the options menu using the object in the left side of the bedroom. Depending on what special day it is, important collectible objects may or may not appear.

title: Astronomical Club for Queers
description:
You are a transgender civet named Louie. After the flood, at your friend's family home, you stayed at the family home of your friend, a gay fox named Oliver.

Listen carefully to the podcast with your buddies - pansexual alligator Miles and lesbian dog Kylie and learn more about the approaching Halley's comet. Admire the night sky with the help of a telescope together with asexual cat Darwin.

title: Invite Me In
description: Walking home alone one night, you meet an injured stranger in need of help. So you do what you'd hope anyone else would do for you in that situation... You invite him in...

title: Grave of Träumerei
description: Tsutsuji and Sumire meet at an unpopular subway station. For some reason, the train never seems to stop. Together, they search for clues to escape.

title: Wolf Girl With You: Full Moon Edition
description: Guess who's back? Back again. Liru is back! Tell a friend!! The DLC for that flirtalicious cohabitation simulation title "Wolf girl with you" is finally here! So what are you waiting for? Get ready to start a new life with Liru! Doggo!!

title: Sawnic
description: Sawnic is a special Sonic with all sorts of new abilities, gameplay changes, quality of life tweaks, and even more!

title: Merry Christmas, Alfred Robbins
description: Merry Christmas, Alfred Robbins is a point-and-click adventure game made in roughly two weeks about an ordinary man who works hard to support his wife and son. Although it seems like it will be a very bleak Christmas in their household, Alfred does his best to make the situation better.

title: Nightmare Castle
description:
Nightmare Castle is an extended technical demonstration and a surreal adventure game, built as a platform to test reduction and refinement of RPG Maker's VFX to PC-88 or early PC-98 standards. As such, the game uses 3-bit graphics at a resolution of 640x400.

A re-imagining of Amiha's Nightmare Castle, the game uses an 8-color palette and minimalist audio with Yume Nikki-style gameplay.

title: Cosmic Dream
description: Fantasy Adventure Across Space and Time.

title: Luar
description: Luar is a Yume Nikki and an AN EARTH2 fangame. At the start of the game, the player is given the choice of two characters to play as: Corey or Doberman. The goal of the game is to explore and collect Valuables (Precioso) that change the protagonist's appearance and/or give them new abilities as well as items known as Dream Pieces.

title: Tonari ni Kanojo no Iru Shiawase: In First Snow With Her
description:
Summer vacation is over, and September approaches autumn.
Literary club on the verge of abolishment. I, who is the manager of the club, and my junior member Tomoya Serizawa.

title: Do What They Say
description:
This is a Public Service Announcement, the world is experiencing a Class G Global Event.

All agents are required by Global Catastrophe Protocol 56-EE to complete their alloted redaction paperwork before extermination can be allowed to take place.

Management would like to remind you that any extermination that takes place before Global Catastrophe Protocol 56-EE may incur penalties, such as but not limited to, loss of fleet vehicle access, reduction of holiday hours, sudden psychic expungement and eviction from allocated staff accomodation.

DO WHAT WE SAY

title: Don't Enter the Forest
description:
Don’t enter the Forest is a short sci-fi exploration game about getting lost in a forest.
Your car breaks down in the forest and you get lost. Very quickly you discover that there is more going on than in an ordinary forest.
You decide in which direction you walk. But your decisions could lead you to various places and endings!

Discover a sci-fi short story!
Get lost in the forest!
Discover 3 different endings!
18 achievements!
Playtime 30min - 2h!

title: Dungeons of Moscow
description:
Dungeons of Moscow is a throwback classic first person shooter game.

Your main quest is to kill the necromancer Ivan the Terrible who revives evil spirits.
Beware of traps and harmful items what can kill you more quickly than enemies. Explore the different locations of dungeons and find all weapons to use them in final boss fight. This is your way to become a hero who defeated evil and save the civilians.

title: Forgotten School
description:
Forgotten School / 忘れられた学校 is a short atmospheric Japanese VHS aesthetic horror game with a deeper meaning.

Japanese school girl Akiyo shows up at her school in the morning, but it would seem that everyone is gone. Through her video camera she always keeps on her, she discovers a hidden dimension unseen to the naked eye.

title: Don't Give Up the Cat
description:
Tonight, you are out in the woods. As a cat.

A short game intended to be played at night, using headphones. In this first-person game you use your mouse to look around and scratch things, and WASD keys for walking, shift to run, and you use Esc to show the menu.

After you run you may sit around to breathe a bit and listen to the forest. Don't forget to explore around. But you may not be alone...

title: Highland Spirit
description:
Becky Speed is an aspiring novelist who is seeking to break her writer's block with a relaxing solo trip to the Scottish Highlands.

However, Becky is about to discover that in her idyllic cottage, she is not alone at all...

title: Gaplus
description: A port of Gaplus developed by M2 for the NES capabilities, released in Namco Museum Archives (Namcot Collection).

title: I Have A Fear
description:
Be my first tester of the project, I've been working on recently..

If you have some time on your hand, take a look at my works as you wonder through some of my games I made in the past.
This is my first time making something public, the levels you are about to see really needs some feedback. If you are ready, we can start right away..

title: I Rented a Boat
description: A first person walking simulator where you need to get out of an island, but you are not alone, and this is a good thing!

title: Stargazer: Dreams of the Star
description: Miku has just transferred schools due to her parents work. She wanders into the infirmary, where she meets a mysterious girl named Hoshimi. Will that encounter change the fate of the two girls?

title: Into the Crops
description:
Into the Crops is a horror game inspired by the early 2000s horror games for the PS1 such as Silent Hill and the PS1 Haunted Demodisks. Created by 5 students of the University of Alicante as part of their Project Based Learning with only C++ and OpenGL.

Grab your trustworthy oil lantern and explore an eldritch cornfield that is trying to corrupt you, protecting yourself with the light.

title: Witch Effect
description: Witch Effects is a horizontal side-scrolling shooter. Your main objective is to defeat all the enemies as well as the boss at the end of the stage. You play as Madotsuki, with her Witch effect equipped.

title: Let's Get Happy Ending Project Chapter 1 Yume Nikki Time to Wake Up
description: Let's Get Happy Ending Project Chapter 1 Yume Nikki Time to Wake Up is a non-traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Madotsuki as she tries to avoid her canonical end by gathering NPCs in the dream world.

title: Mafurako: Jiyou Jikan
description: Mafurako: Jiyou Jikan is a space shooter with Yume Nikki elements. You play as Mafurako who is being attacked by Jellyfish, Toriningen, and other antagonistic NPCs from Yume Nikki. The goal is to avoid enemies and their projectiles.

title: Pastel x Pastels
description: A short and colorful experience designed for whose familiar with games like LSD Dream Emulator, Yume Nikki and etc., as well just people enjoying surreal and dreamy themes.

title: Hansel and Gretel DS
description:
Your destiny will change depending on the path you choose.
Is it a beast that attacks the two? A witch? Or...
Please guide them to the ultimate "hunt" ending.

title: Repugnant Bounty
description: Rosemarie, an alien princess from the planet Nimola seeks genocide on the evil monsters who killed her mother and people.

title: Firearms
description: Firearms is a first-person shooter mod for Half-Life which originated from a Quake modification. Initially developed in 1998, Firearms was created as a quasi-realistic team-based FPS. The mod's main feature is the large amount of usable weapons in the game.

title: Zandronum
description: Zandronum is a multiplayer oriented port, based off Skulltag, for Doom and Doom II by id Software. Zandronum brings classic Doom into the 21st century, maintaining the essence of what has made Doom great for so many years and, at the same time, adding new features to modernize it, creating a fresh, fun new experience.

title: Zero Visibility
description: A chilling cosmic horror game about four friends that get lost in a blizzard.

title: Selkö
description:
You have come to dive here for the silence... but also because something amazing lies in the depths - or so says the rumor.

As you calmly descend into the abyss, use your flashlight to discover the aquatic life surrounding you and solve the puzzles protecting the secrets of the sea.

title: Lilith's Hunger
description: Three witches go to the house of the newcomer in town. She serves them tea with a gentle smile bit as one of them takes a sip Bera hears a loud noise and sees one of her friends fall onto the ground.

title: Love in Login
description: Met the girl who is my game buddy in real life.

title: Invaseave
description:
The oceans have been invaded by a strange type of fish. These fish are rapidly reproducing, destroying all native forms in the area. We have deployed Tethys, a robotic drone to capture and study these fish.

Where did they come from? Why are they decimating our oceans?

How do we stop them? How do we prevent this from happening again?

title: Journey Home
description:
A sharp clap of thunder jolts you awake.
You find yourself cold and alone in a dark forest clearing.
You have no memory of who you are or what you're doing here.
You just know that you need to make it to the distant light that you recognize as home.

But the forest is not going to make it easy...

And you might just find that there's more to this strange pilgrimage than meets the eye...

Journey Home is an old-school point and click adventure game with a modern twist. The game features multiple endings, death sequences, secrets, optional puzzle strands and much more. It will take most players around 1 hour to complete.

title: Starship Iwamachi
description:
You are on a starship under attack by a vicious enemy and are the only one left behind to save your lover.
The maze-like interior of the ship is automatically generated, so it changes every time you play.
Walls and other surfaces can be destroyed with guns. The ship's interior will erode into a mass of blood and flesh as time goes by!

title: Bewilder House
description:
Bewilder House is a first-person puzzle game where you have to overcome a feeling of loss of bearings.

Trapped in strange mazes where the walls open and close when you're not looking, you'll have to use your mind and first person controls in unusual ways to escape a deceptive funhouse that plays with both your perception, and your life.

title: Dead Dimension
description:
Dead Dimension is a short graphic adventure, designed to be played in one session.

In the year 2169, humanity has conquered the galaxies. Manned space travel has gone beyond what is humanly conceivable. Unfortunately, it has been proven with horror that there is no extraterrestrial life. The space race no longer makes sense.

However, the sights have turned to a new unexplored universe: the hidden dimensions.

Peter Travers, a prisoner enrolled in NASA's Interdimensional Exploration program with the intention of receiving prison benefits, must carry out a simple mission: go through the first dimensional portal and repair it from the other side.

title: Far Cry 3: Monkey Business
description: The DLC adds 4 additional missions in the story mode, which involves Hurk to be recognized as a Rakyat warrior.

title: 3 Billion Dreams for a Forgiveness Machine
description: A featureless doll is locked in an apartment, and must write stories that will always be rejected, and must eat feces out of instant-noodle containers despite having no mouth, all for the Forgiveness Machine.

title: Anomiac.
description:
“Anomiac.” is an exploration game about a little girl whose ability to communicate has been impaired due to having a stoke. Through dreaming, she experiences a vibrant, colorful, crazy world where she feels uninhibited and is able to experience the things she can’t while awake.

“Anomiac.” was developed for the Dream Diary Jam 2 by Kip Icon Games using RPG Maker MV.

title: Curtained Moon
description:
A Yume Nikki fangame inspired by noir aesthetics. Made for Dream Diary Jam 2.

Travel through dreams of Veda, uncover secrets of her past and find the moon. By touching any object, you can travel to another dream.

title: Asphodelus
description: Asphodelus is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame created by Chalk Flower for Dream Diary Jam 2. The protagonist is a girl named Tsuneko. Your goal is to explore and find effects.

title: Q73
description: Q73 is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2. A traditional fangame, where the goal is to explore and collect effects as well as items.

title: A Quiet Air
description: A Quiet Air is a Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 2. The game follows a nameless young woman who inherits a large and strange house from her great-aunt. Here, she finds her dreams taking her to mysterious places.

title: Stitch.
description:
Stitch. is a casual puzzle game with embroidery on a numbered grid. The main objective is to fill in the levels' areas with no gaps to complete Hoops.

Stitch. lets you create beautiful embroidery patterns, by solving levels and Hoops of various difficulties and sizes. It's easy to learn, but hard to master!

Stitch up all the beautiful landscapes, plants, animals, objects, and more.

title: The Crash: Storm Clouds of the Mind
description: The Crash: Storm Clouds of the Mind is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2. The game uses Alice in Wonderland as its theme mixed with 1960's aesthetic. You play as Elizabeth, a young 1960's college student who is having weird dreams. The goal is to explore and collect effects. The player can collect items hidden in the dream world as well.

title: Yqriel
description:
yqriel is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2.

yqriel is a traditional fangame, focusing on exploration and item collection. Instead of a Nexus, the player starts in one specific area and can explore the world from there.

title: Yume Nikki: Date Poniko!
description: You play as Madotsuki who gets invited to visit Poniko's house for a date. The main goal of the game is to get Poniko to like you by selecting the right dialogue choices.

title: Press Play
description: A person finds himself stuck in a loop of his regular life cycle. In order to break it, he'll have to take a few wrong turns and explore the world around him a bit deeper than usual. A Yume Nikki fangame.

title: Die Känguru-Verschwörung
description: Achtung, Achtung! This retro platforming movie tie-in for "Die Känguru-Verschwörung" is only playable in German! Zis is not a drill!

title: Divine
description:
di^ine is a Yume Nikki fangame made in RPGMaker 2003 for the 2019 Dream Diary Jam.

Fall asleep to see through Astrum's eyes and wander through her vision.

title: Ep3
description: Ep3 is a Yume Nikki fangame which retains roughly the same gameplay formula but with a own twist on it. Ep3 was originally made for the Dream Diary Jam 3.

title: Calling of my Nightingales
description: A Yume Nikki fangame for Dream Diary Jam 3. Tristan is stuck in his room for unknown reasons. In his dream world he can meet individuals known as Nightingales.

title: Caution
description:
A small project for the Dream Diary Jam #3. You play as Chui, who's trying to complete an essay while sleep deprived. The main goal is to explore and collect effects and items. There is also a collectible currency called Muns, which can be used to purchase items in the dream world.

There are two bars displayed on the top-left corner of the screen: ZZZ's; which act as a life bar for the player character that depletes when the player runs into a hazard in the dream world, and PRG which represents how much of the essays been written and increases each time the player works at the table.

title: June 30th
description:
Welcome to Hotel Paradise! The view may be average, but the beds are so comfy, you'll never want to leave. What's more, there's a rumor: some say if you collect a lot of souvenirs, your wish will be granted. Are you up to the challenge?

Created for the 3rd Dream Diary Jam.

title: Milk
description: DROP WORKING NOW Milk is a clicker type game in which you just have to click milk. Simple as that! Milks drops every 1, 3 and 5 hours. Milks also can be made by community on discord. Enjoy and expand your collection of milks!

title: Sunlit
description:
Sunlit is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 3.

Play as a young woman named Clover, explore her dream world, and find effects.

title: Is This Undertale
description: A short Yume Nikki/Undertale fan-game made for Dream Diary Jam.

title: This Emptiness
description: A Yume Nikki fan game set during the 1960s. Play as a Soviet spy deep inside the United States government who has bad dreams.

title: Dream RPG
description: Dream RPG is a unique Yume Nikki fangame, containing dialogue and RPG-style battles. The game is divided into routes accessed through the Nexus that branch out into paths to Nightmares, the boss battles for the game.

title: Yume Nikki Rythm
description: A Yume Nikki themed rhythm game.

title: The Chicken Game
description:
This is not your parents' chicken farming simulator. Granted, they probably didn't have a chicken farming simulator, but still!

Starting your journey as a humble farmer, you will improve and expand, unlocking and rediscovering the long lost secrets to the chicken genome. What secrets might you ask? Polka dots. And rainbow stripes. And super speed. Design your own farm, collect your crops, and create new and unique chickens in this indie pixel-art game.

title: MuseSwipr
description: A rhythm game where you swipe between two lanes to the beat. Form your own flow and unleash your greatest swiping performance.

title: Knorrig the Gifted Troublemaker
description: Who said having a pet piggie is a bad idea? Well, you did. Just now. It's 10 minutes before the festive dinner and you find yourself in a pickle thanks to your pet. Or should we say 'pigle'. The lovely gift for your sister is gone. Will you manage to get it back in time?

title: Last Stop: Station 66
description:
You fell asleep during a train ride after visiting your friend. Upon awakening you realize you've arrived at the last stop, except this line shouldn't have more than 25 stops, but you've now arrived at Station 66. Uncover the mystery behind what is actually going on, and go in depth with the multiple outcomes to your story and ultimately your demise.

Features 2 different endings depending on player actions through non-linear gameplay routes and exploration taking the player to different locations and providing different outcomes. To fully understand the story you must complete both.

Last Stop: Station 66 is a 90s VHS Found Footage Psychological Thriller Horror experience that plays on realistic situations and claustrophobic environments with a deep atmosphere.

title: Legends of Tzonac: The Great Dungeon Escape
description: Kalzrak and Clash fall into a long-lost dungeon. Kalzrak is severely injured in the fall, and all that is left of him that works is his head. Now he and Clash must work together to find or build him a new body, and escape! But a dark presence sleeps within this dungeon, and their fall has caused it to stir...

title: Legends of Tzonac 2: Friendship & Automata
description: Robots from all over Tzonac have been detecting strange readings. Five misfit machines join together in a ragtag team to hunt down the dangerous artifact that has surfaced. Little do they know that their very existence may be on the line, and that Tzonac will forever be changed by their actions...

title: Like Veins Beneath the Town
description:
People already have a habit of going missing in the night near that Forest, but this case is a bit... different than the others. 21 women missing. The only evidence washed away in the rain. The village is divided between a select few that desperately want your help and a majority that will make sure you stay out of their affairs, even if you have to be the next one to disappear. Was it kidnapping, murder, or something much more dreadful? Who can you trust? Why was the railway project really abandoned? And what are those strange noises coming from the subway grates? This game will ask many more questions than it will answer-but that never stopped you before, did it now?

Features a dismal story, lots of custom art, one ending and a handful of ways to die with unique scenes!

This game focuses less on puzzles and gameplay, instead having a heavy emphasis on exploration/investigation and storytelling. It's roughly a half hour long depending on your playing speed. There are save points, but it is recommended that you play the entire game in one sitting. This game is set in the same universe as the other two. The order you play them in doesn't matter, but for those of you who are wondering, this is the third game in the series.

title: Soulcreek
description: Soulcreek is a sci-fi/romance FVN intended to be released in instalments. It features a human male protagonist with a changeable name and a single m/m love interest. Choices may alter dialogue or relationship dynamics, but are mostly used for roleplaying purposes and have no major consequential effects on the story. There will be a single ending.

title: Rayman Arena Definitive Edition
description: Rayman Arena Definitive Edition is simply Rayman Arena PC in its best form possible! Patched by the fans to fully work on Windows 7/10/11 and bundled with essential improvements: HD aI upscaled Textures, controller support, vibration fix, LAN patch, widescreen resolution support, custom player skins...

title: Cosmic Commute
description: Cosmic Commute is a surreal space comedy set in a world stranger than fiction: the public transport system. Playing as everyone's least favourite discount cop - a ticket inspector - discover that even unfathomable creatures have relatable problems.

title: NOX: Chapter 1
description: NOX: Chapter 1 is a first-person puzzle game, where the player has to make use of gravity changes, gravity shifts and portals to explore the dreams and nightmares of a child. All this, in a world inspired by the work of Escher.

title: Lizard Quest!
description: Crawl into the ultimate co-op RPG lizard simulator, set in a variety of lush environments ranging from beautiful jungle rainforests to harsh dry savannahs. Grow your lizard to incredible sizes while honing your platforming skills to become the ultimate lizard!

title: And Yet It Hurt
description:
And Yet It Hurt is a game about a kid who lived a peaceful and happy life with two lovely parents. All was well, until that fateful day when the tower bell rang.

Since that day, this kid had only one purpose in life: Revenge.

Go on an adventure, solve puzzles, fight enemies, all in Notepad!

title: Last Game of the Decade 2019
description: Hidden object game originally made for Glorious Trainwrecks, and a sequel to "Last GOTY 2018"

title: Babbdi
description: Find your way out of Babbdi. A short, first person exploration experience.

title: D.S.A
description: D.S.A is a surreal action/adventure game that follows D.S.A, an ameteur girl group, as they get lost on their school campus one night after the worst gig of their lives. And to make matters worse, they're all split up, and tripping out.

title: Flamingo Quest
description: A game about a girl raised by flamingos, called Flamingo.

title: Idra and the Little Fish
description: Co-op puzzle exploration game

title: Electra
description: Play as an AI that can move around a space by jumping into any other camera that you can see from your current camera.

title: Alien Flowers
description:
Mushrooms are just Alien Flowers.
Surreal world full of artstyle clashing and moods, with a tragic story behind it.

A Yume Nikki fangame created made for Dream Diary Jam 4.

title: Burden 2: Remnants
description:
"In dreaming I can see them again."

This game began as a submission to the Yume Nikki Dream Diary Jam 4 and a sequel to Burden RPG. As a Yume Nikki fangame this game is based off of exploration and discovery directed by the player.

After the events of the horror game Burden, Mila returns to the surface world and tries to live a normal life. But, in her dreams she gets to see her loved ones again.

title: Dream Data
description:
Today you start your new job doing data entry for Data Portal Inc. It's not the most exciting job, but it pays the bills. Each night, you go home, go to sleep, and have vivid dreams that let you escape your mundane life. However, sometimes the line between dreams and real life start to get a bit blurred. Will you work hard and keep your job, or will you get out of touch with reality?

The game was heavily inspired by Yume Nikki, and it was created for Dream Diary Jam 4. So like Yume Nikki, the game is mostly just about walking around and exploring dreams. However, there are a few significant changes in how this plays compared to Yume Nikki and most fan games.

title: Fractured Dreams
description:
"You can't ignore them forever."

Fractured Dreams is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4. You explore the dreams of James, and collect effects and tapes in his subconscious.

title: Higurashiki
description:
Play as Higurashiki, an insect-like girl who lives in a strange facility. There's one room she's not allowed to go into until she collects all the effects. When she finally enters, the truth will be revealed.

A Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4.

title: Kaizo Nikki
description:
Kaizo Nikki is a fangame of the classic indie hit, Yume Nikki. A poor fool by the name of "Hitmetsuki" is stuck in a strange place where he is tasked to go through several worlds and obtain "Pillars". It would appear that surviving those worlds might be harder than expected, however.

Kaizo Nikki is a more difficulty-based take on the Yume Nikki formula, featuring more enemies, more puzzles and more tricky terrain to navigate than usual.

title: Memorial Playground
description: Memorial Playground is an English fangame developed for Dream Diary Jam 4. You play as August and explore his dreams. These dreams contains elements related to his past.

title: None
description: Play as None as they explore their dreams. This is a game made for Dream Diary Jam 4. The concept and mechanics are based on the 2004 indie game Yume Nikki.

title: Planet Ennea
description: Planet Ennea is a short game made for the fourth Dream Diary Jam using the RPG Maker VX Ace engine. It focuses around a newly built robot and their desire to understand the lives and emotions of those around them. It features way more text than your standard Yume Nikki fangame, but that's fine, isn't it? You won't talk much, but you'll have the chance to listen.

title: Send You a Link
description:
A mysterious link; a weird program that you can't rid of.

Send You a Link is a small, nostalgia themed Yume Nikki fangame made for the Dream Diary Jam 4. The game is heavily inspired in the internet days of 2000-2010ish, including old memes, old teenage obsessions and aesthetics.

title: Super Mado Paf!!
description:
Super Mado Paf!! is a Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4.

It is a shooter game where the player must defeat the enemies moving around the screen. The goal is to get as high a score as possible. You play as Madotsuki and fight against enemies.

title: Talentless.
description: talentless, a Yume Nikki fan game created for the Dream Diary 4 game jam, which follows a protagonist that goes by Lumi.

title: Twin Unconscious
description: Twin Unconscious is an English fangame developed for Dream Diary Jam 4.

title: Unduhagge
description: Unduhagge is a dream exploration game in the spirit of Yume Nikki. Join Mina Mori as she navigates a dreamscape full of absurdities, distressing personal memories and other experiences that push her beyond the veil and into the unknown.

title: Ungus
description: Ungus is a Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Pine, who wakes up in a strange forest, and explore the surrounding world. A submission for the 4th Yume Nikki Fangame jam.

title: Dream Vacation
description:
Dream Vacation is a short Yume Nikki parody fangame.

You play as a young man named Sheru, who refuses to leave his apartment for reasons unknown. You must explore his dreamscape and find 3 effects and 3 []s in order to escape.

title: Dreaming Bad
description: A Breaking Good inspired parody Yume Nikki fangame thats actually about Walt losing his steam account.

title: Yume Smashi
description: Yume Smashi is a story about Smashotsuki, and how with the power of his nearly limitless imagination he will save the world of his own hellish creation in order to reach UBER Tier. A Yume Nikki parody fangame.

title: Nyan Nikki
description: Nyan Nikki is a fangame of both Yume Nikki and Nyan~ Neko Sugar Girls. You play as Raku-chan, one of the characters from the series.

title: Wakana Nikki
description: Wakana Nikki is a Yume Nikki parody fangame. It stars Mimotsuki, Madotsuki’s classmate before Madotsuki died.

title: Emo Neccky
description: Emo Neccky is a short Yume Nikki joke fangame created by an anonymous Uboachan member. It stars Kanashimito.

title: Deep Fried Nikki
description: Deep Fried Nikki is an English Yume Nikki fangame. It was made as a late April Fool's joke, satirizing fangames that are essential re-skins of Yume Nikki. It plays just like Yume Nikki, but with different graphics and music, and with an additional ending located in the White Desert.

title: Scary Nikki
description: Scary Nikki is a parody Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Sanpurutsuki and explore her strange, terrible and have lots of MEMEs dream world.

title: The Jhonson Parable
description: The Jhonson Parable is a Yume Nikki fangame that centers around a man named Jhonson, who is also known as Worker #069.

title: Soto Nemuri
description: Soto Nemuri is a Yume Nikki/Touhou fangame, made for Touhou Fan Game Jam 8. You play as Sumireko from the Touhou series and explore her dreams.

title: Bittersweet Dream
description: A Yume Nikki-inspired fangame. You play as Lizzie and explore their dream world.

title: Botaniki
description: A 3D Yume Nikki fangame. Explore Ouiki's dreams, and uncover the dark world she lives in, and has created for herself.

title: Growth
description: Growth is a fast-paced one-button game.

title: Insulted
description: INSULTED is a Yume Nikki fangame. Play as Cathy and collect "Objects" that will help her find even more useful Objects. Avoid the stalker of Cathy's dreams that appears to hunt her down.

title: Wishful Thinking
description: Wishful Thinking is a small Yume Nikki Fangame that stars a 13 year old boy named Joshua, who is a curious and peaceful person that uses their dreams to comfort themselves about a past event.

title: Yume Inu
description:
A Yume Nikki fangame. Traverse the strange dreams of Hamigaki.

Unlike most fangames, there are two types of dreams the player can have: Lucid and Normal. The Normal dream option takes the player to a random world, while the Lucid dream takes the player to a Nexus-like area. This area starts out empty, with access to other worlds unlocked through having Normal dreams.

The goal of the game is to find all of the effects hidden inside the dream world.

title: Yume Nikki: Atari 2600
description:
Yume Nikki Atari 2600, is an adaptation of Kikiyama's original Yume Nikki replicating style of the Atari console "Atari 2600" a popular console from the 70s - 80s.

The game is to get "Tojos" to get effects without being caught by the toriningens, in a variety of popular maps by original Yume Nikki.

title: Yume Nikki: Mod(ified) Project
description: The Yume Nikki : Mod(ified) Project is a mod that adds new features to the current Yume Nikki build. Much like the original game, it stars Madotsuki. It plays like the original Yume Nikki, with some added areas and NPCs. Unlike the original, Madotsuki can talk to certain NPCs.

title: Yume Metsuki
description: Yume Metsuki is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Karasu, a young girl interested in nature and flight.

title: Plastic Model
description: A very short, free to play game about assembling a plastic model kit. Made by Mike Inel.

title: Yume Nikki GB
description: A demake of Yume Nikki for the Game Boy. The goals are to walk around and collect "Effects" by interacting with objects and other characters.

title: Yume Wheeky
description:
Hey, you know the game Yume Nikki? What if it starred a little animal and didn't feature all that blood and stuff?

You are a guinea pig. Your cage is pretty boss: it's got pellets, hay, water, and a buddy. It's also got a comfy place for naps. You like napping.

Take naps, wander the world of dreams, and be a small animal in a confusing world. Encounter strange landscapes, take on new forms and powers, and discover what probably doesn't actually happen when a little animal goes to sleep!

This is a chill exploration game with 100% original graphics, a pretty boss soundtrack, and some very cute li'l piggies.

title: Álom
description: Álom is a Yume Nikki fangame. Explore Alek's dreams, collect memories and effects to discover his backstory, and unlock different endings.

title: Hikensha
description:
Hikensha (or 10 Hikensha) is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The main goal is to explore the dream world and collect effects.

The story takes place years after the events seen in Awaits;10H. You play as Yarishi, a boy who lost some of his memories after a mysterious incident from the past. Yarishi started having recurrent dreams and sightings like he used to have in the past, so this time he decides to go deeper into his dreams and put an end to everything, learning that maybe the world inside his mind might be bigger than he ever imagined.

title: Jigoku Nagashi
description: Jigoku Nagashi is a Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a girl named Shinoko, waiting at a train station.

title: Mind Reader
description: Mind Reader is a Yume Nikki fangame. Mind Reader's protagonist is Appuru, a boy unable to leave his room, instead exploring a dream world through sleeping. Appuru's dreams are colorful and sometimes vague, despite the general lack of sound.

title: Mizu
description:
Mizu is a Yume Nikki Fangame that's (quite loosely) based on ancient and almost biblical times. Play as a middle-aged man named Isaac as he finds effects (called Tides here) and explores the world hidden in the statue while trapped in a hut on a deserted island.

Initially made for the 1st 1-week Yume Nikki Fangame Jam.

title: Nightmare Diary
description: Nightmare Diary is a Yume Nikki fangame. The main character is KNF, who has bloodstains all over him in the real world. In the dream world he is known as Ketsueki (血液, lit. Blood Liquid), and the bloodstains are removed. Your main goal is to explore the dream world and obtain effects. There is plenty of dialogue in the game as well.

title: REM-9: The Yume Nikki Randomizer
description:
REM-9: The Yume Nikki Randomizer is a randomizer created by vgperson for Kikiyama's Yume Nikki. It is generally recommended for those who have played the original Yume Nikki and know how to get around the dream world.

You can randomize the effects locations or lock nexus door but also you can set the ending to require any number of Effects, as well as any number of Essences (new bonus items given by notable "optional" side events).

title: Rooftop
description: Get away! Muscular zombies are too powerful! [Rooftop] is a third-person action game with horror feel in where you escape from an abandoned building to the rooftop.

title: The Better Place
description: The Better Place is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, where you have to collect an effect, but also orbs that are located in the dream worlds.

title: Balls of Steel Community Project
description: Map design philosophies in the main maps include: kind to blind players, balance for players who don't find secrets, balance between routes, mappers are competent at beating their own maps. Lots and lots of playtesting...

title: You May
description: You May is a Yume Nikki fangame. The game follows a young girl called Yarn as she explores her dreams to rediscover her past and find the items most important to her.

title: Yume-san
description:
Yume-san is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Shiiko, a girl who has forced her way into the dream worlds in order to take a certain someone back with her, collecting effects and parts of a plushie along the way.
Unlike other traditional fangames, this game includes dialogue with certain NPCs.

title: Mortal Shell: Rotten Autumn
description: Something sinister has arrived in Fallgrim. Possess the Rotten Autumn update and access 10 new shell shades, a brand new photo mode, a new mini quest and an alternative boss OST by Rotting Christ.

title: Alien Dead
description:
Alien Dead is a game about escaping your dreams and awakening to an unknown overworld.
It seems you must reach the deepest part of your dreams first.

But how deep of a sleep do you have to be in?

title: Dawn of Dreams
description: Dawn of Dreams is a 3D fangame of the classic indie hit, Yume Nikki. A woman by the name of Doakeru is our protagonist, a lone being living in the middle of a desert. Nevertheless, she manages to reach other people through her dreams, exploring theirs instead.

title: Dream of Life
description:
You play as a boy named Enil.

Enil always fantasized about being able to lucid dream, unfortunately, he has no experience on it, so you will have to make him improve.

Play in a half accurate simulation of lucid dreaming, released for the Yume Nikki Dream Diary Jam 5.

title: Immersit
description: A YNFG Fangame made initially for Dream Diary Jam 5. You play as Josephine, who has been locked in her bedroom.

title: Kooky Sphere
description: Kooky Sphere is a game made for the Dream Diary Jam 5 you explore the dreams of Rose.

title: L8R
description: A traditional Yume NIkki fangame, starring a girl named Muratsuki who lives in her room. Made for Dream Diary Jam 5.

title: Nightmares and Other True Stories
description: Nightmares and Other True Stories is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, the goal being to explore and interact with the world. A game made for the Dream Diary Jam 5.

title: Sweet Sleep
description:
With unending amounts of free time, Madotsuki finds herself with a lack of things to do. More often than not, she sleeps. While her dreams were surreal before, they were at least consistent. When her dreams begin to change she finds new turmoil in herself.

Sweet Sleep is a visual novel with branching paths. Features original artwork and music based on the original RPG Maker walking sim.

title: Yuki Nime
description: A Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 5. Explore a dreamlike and restless world, discoverer all its secrets...

title: Hermeticism
description: Hermeticism is a 9-Map wad for Heretic that replaces Episode 1.

title: Traumruf
description:
Traumruf is a Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 5.

Traumruf plays like a traditional fangame, focusing on exploration. Unlike most fangames, the player character starts out asleep. Exiting the bedroom will take the player into the dream world. Interacting with the closet changes the main character's appearance.

title: Deteriation Game
description:
Deteriation Game which is a misspelling of deterioration, is a game about exploring your dreams and figuring out who you are. Travel through surreal recreations of your memory, or is it all just real?

Made for Dream Diary Jam 6.

title: Dream Records
description: Dream Records is a game where you explore Hizashi's dreams and you can collect hairstyles. A YNFG for DDJ6.

title: Fracture: The Dream
description:
A sudden and seamless realization of consciousness...

Play as Monoe and explore a Labyrinth of interconnected worlds, wherein you discover secrets and come to shocking conclusions.

A 3D Yume Nikki fangame developed for Dream Diary Jam 6.

title: Internal Plexus
description:
A Cayote named Fletcher wakes up one night when his computer updates on it's own. He finds a mysterious fuse box that wasn't there before attached, and a mass of wires leading to a strange mechanical door in his basement...

It was developed as an entry for Dream Diary Jam 6.

title: R5Reloaded
description: Apex Legends R5 Reloaded is a community-run mod that lets you play an older version of Apex Legends offline with custom mods.

title: Severed Ties
description: Severed Ties is a Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 6. The goal is to explore the dreamworld and find all 9 effects to unlock the ending.

title: Skwampt
description: Skwampt is a Yume Nikki-like game about exploring the memories of an alien flying through space. Made for Dream Diary Jam 6.

title: The Foxglove Catcher
description:
A young man falls down a cavern, into a different world.

The Foxglove Catcher is a Yume Nikki Fangame made for Dream Diary Jam.

title: Federation 2: Community Edition
description: Federation 2, the space trading game, is a massively multi-player game set within an exciting world of interstellar commerce and intrigue, in which you interact and collaborate with lots of other players in real-time, and compete against them to climb the ranks. The aim of the game is to amass a larger fortune (in Imperial Groats) than any other player, and to climb the ranks by forging alliances and making friends with the right people. Cooperation is the name of the game in Federation.

title: Poom: Miasma Massacre
description: Poom is a mod for The Ultimate Doom that parodies the band Black Veil Brides' lead singer, Andy Sixx.

title: They are Confined
description: An entry for the Dream Diary Jam 6. You explore the protagonist's troubled past through their dreams. This game has no "Effects" to collect. Your goal is to find / view particular "Events" that will lead you to the end.

title: World in a Moment
description:
*click* makes the stopwatch as you press its button. The last sound you hear before the world becomes silent and motionless. Wind no longer blows, rain no longer falls. The world has become free of humans, animals and everything else that attests to the flow of time. Without a material body you traverse trough this new realm frozen in time. Days, weeks or perhaps even years go by as you lose yourself on this new adventure before even a moment in you old world passes.

Welcome to World in a Moment, a photo collage exploration game.

title: Lost Direction
description:
Explore an truly infinite space of pure discovery and full of secrets, find things not meant for your eyes, discover places no one else has, and truly lose direction, all whilst being completely and utterly alone...

Or are you?

title: Midnight Shift Remake
description: Step back into the shoes of an unfortunate security guard who encounters strange things while simply leaving for the night. Expect 10 to 15 minutes of game play across both modes, each with a unique ending, and even more play time if you're looking to uncover the secret ending (Extended Scenario).

title: Maggot Face
description: Your sister and a lot of other people are missing, solve the mystery and find your sister Kirsty!

title: Moonlight Moggy
description:
Ah, cats - nature's hot water bottles. But the outside world is teeming with things that can frighten our feline companions and prevent them from getting home for a cosy evening...

Paul, an especially timid ginger tom, has vanished. It falls to his buddy Blixa to track him down. To do so, he'll have to help out the garden's various resident creatures and overcome his own phobia of plastic bags rustling in the wind.

title: Mornings with Java
description:
After recently moving in, Chronos receives much needed help from his neighbour Java. As thanks, he starts spending the mornings with him. Together they learn more about each other and end up falling in love.

MORNINGS WITH JAVA is a visual novel/point and click game created in Ren'Py. Help Chronos make drinks for Java as they spend the mornings with each other.

title: Moth Manor
description: Moth Manor is a short spooky text adventure about an abandoned manor, cryptid encounters, and discovering yourself.

title: Murder 38: Episode One - A Small World
description:
Join our detectives as they solve a grizzly murder on tonight's episode of Murder 38!
Point and click your way through this humorous tale of mystery and coincidence. Use the police computer, look for clues and interview people! All presented in a state of the art cinematic style that blurs the line between games and big budget tv dramas.

title: Core MUD
description:
Welcome to Core Mud, an interactive text MUD set on the planet formal star-charts refer to as Hermes 571-G, but that everyone in the know refers to simply as "Core". Core is one of the most distant settlements known to mankind, most famous for its lucrative yet oppressive mines. But more than mankind can be found here; Core is a diverse group of 9 races in total, all vying for recognition or profits, or both, working for The Company, the megalithic entity running the colony itself. To The Company, everything is secondary to profits. It is up to you to determine how best to survive in this environment, whether that be through combat training, superior mining skills, or technical prowess.

Core MUD is always free to play and features a fun and supportive atmosphere. Roleplaying is encouraged but not mandatory. Mining is your primary source of income, but there are multiple ways to scrape together a few credits... or a few million. Core Mud also features an economy which is player-driven; players own merchandise shops featuring energy weaponry or useful tools, pubs featuring assorted alcoholic (of course) and non-alcoholic beverages, and clinics for healing, to name a few. Come join us today!

title: My Happy Place
description: The player watches old recordings from their (strangely familiar?) dreams, starting from what seems to be a normal day in the streets of your home town...

title: Avalon
description:
A fantasy game world of magnificent proportions unfolds before you: it is the heavy sea-town air of Mercinae, the sound of waves crashing against Parrius, great dark spires piercing the sky of Thakria. This roleplaying world, which existed before the Internet and was the first online RPG game ever, thrives because of its unique world. Great sorcerers, war that can tumble years of real life history in a day, magic that can see beyond time, rituals and vast events that raise mortals to become gods! Avalon's scope is nearly infinite and anything within its walls is possible. As a text-based RPG, it will exceed all expectations: adventurers, merchants, politicians, fighters, forest-loving druids, all cohabitate in this rich, vibrant and brutal world.

Avalon is an online RPG game that has always been ahead of its time. It innovates in the most remarkable ways, inventing new mechanics that you will not see anywhere else for years. Above all else, Avalon is a fair meritocracy. You may quicken your pace but you cannot achieve excellence without deserving it and excellence in any area takes time. It is an environment unlike any other, where players decide the course of history. Find any online roleplaying game today that can match Zaphod of Avalon, who 25 years ago and still sometimes today, will be in Meeting Place sharpening his axe and preparing for battle. Players today do the same as he, building on an epic saga to write their own names into this legendary world.

title: My Uncle's Garden
description: You travel to a small hut in the woods because you received a mysterious letter telling you about a uncle you never heard of. What can possibly go wrong...?

title: Negative One
description:
Negative One is a first-person retro horror game where you take the role of Lisa.

Lisa discovers a secret abandoned lab beneath her apartment, learning some things are left best not found...

title: Not All There
description:
After working overtime one evening, you go to the underground parking lot to search for your car, you notice it's nowhere to be found. The parking lot is completely empty except for one car driving around in circles. A sinister feeling that something bad is going to happen overwhelms you as you continue to search for your car.
Will you make it out alive or should you have stayed at work?

title: Not Involved
description:
Not Involved is a dark fantasy/horror visual novel about Doctor who balances between helping others and taking care of himself.

If you want to save someone, you will have to make sacrifices. How far are you willing to go: being beaten, ostracized, having your limbs chopped off?..

You will find that this world doesn't always reward selflessness and kind heart...

title: Of Ice & Snow
description:
When her younger sister, Veni, leaves for the mainland, Lalao can't help but be hurt.

Leaving for the mainland means abandoning her.
Leaving for the mainland means disrespecting their family's legacy on the Isles.
Leaving for the mainland means she'd never return.

Unable to forgive Veni, Lalao finds herself pulled into an equally unforgiving world of snow, ruled by a Prince with a frozen heart...

Will she let herself be consumed by her pain, even if it means never returning to the island herself?

title: On Leaving the Building
description: In this point and click adventure you play as The King. You have a list of things to do. After that freedom awaits.

title: Please read me
description: "Please, read me." is a short clickteractive novel where everything is the opposite of what it appears to be.

title: Prepper
description: The storm to end all storms approaches. Prepare for the onslaught of nature without, and the darkness residing within...

title: Pretty Visitors
description:
A group of drug addicts calling themselves "Children of Lucifer" decide to "Cleanse" humankind by "Setting them free".

You play as Jacob and Jessica, a married couple who find themselves helpless in this satanic ritual and try to escape to save their lives.

title: Primrose
description:
Primrose is a rather short psychological survival horror experience, Filled with disturbing and cruel creatures that appear to be thirsty for your blood.

No one will survive except you,
for you, shall be the harbinger of the wrath.
With or without knowledge, You will take part.
You will follow the chosen one on a path,
Filled with yellow roses,
that takes you to the end

title: Risk of Rain Returns
description:
Carefully designed, beautifully remastered, and loaded with new ways to play—Risk of Rain is back and better than ever! This remake of the classic Risk of Rain packs enhanced visuals, an updated codebase, and tons of new content.

No two runs in the iconic roguelike are the same, and that has never been truer. Risk of Rain Returns bring new and enhanced Survivors, customizable Survivor abilities, fresh items, monsters, and a brand-new game mode. The game’s difficulty increases the longer you play, so prepare to fight through hordes of enemies that threaten your continued existence, collect and combine items to enhance your abilities, and scale your power to godlike levels.

Many Survivors fled the mysterious attack on your ship. Forge new paths to explore with 15 unique Survivors, each with new abilities to master. Two entirely new Survivors are making their debut in Risk of Rain Returns.

title: Gasnator
description: You are hero super soldier Gasnator. Kill and destroy different enemies and find magic crystal in different areas.

title: Wet Dreams
description: Wet Dreams is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Hello Emoji: Drawing to Solve Puzzles
description: “Hello Emoji: Drawing to Solve Puzzles” is an exciting mini game which will give you a smooth drawing experience. Draw a simple line to make the different balls scroll towards their own destinations. Levels with different difficulty challenge your logically and imagination.

title: Creature Discomfort
description: Adventure game with an inventory and puzzles that are not very hard.

title: EllrLand
description: EllrLand is a new generation of adventure card games. With randomly generated levels, nearly a hundred powerful cards, artifacts for your use, and three unique pets to play with you.

title: Argol: Kronoss' Castle
description:
Platformer action game, mixing gothic and mythological atmospheres.

Argol: Kronoss' Castle is a platformer action game largely inspired by 90s hits. Between gothic universe and mythological legends, it is decorated as it deserves with a rich and epic soundtrack to make you live an adventure in the purest arcade style.

title: Holy Ghost Story
description: A visual novel about helping the ghost of a schoolgirl move on by completing her unfinished business: some maths homework.

title: Don't Blame You
description: Henry a young adult, for the first time receives his girlfriend at his house, after a night of movies and conversations Kimberly his girlfriend disappears, he looks for her around the house and when he finds her he has bad news.

title: Telusfax
description:
Telusfax is a archaeo-game set in the teletext system of a British television station one day in a half-remembered 2003.

Browse the system to locate the names of the presenters of five different tv shows.

Explore over 50 pages of pseudo-2003 content.
Track down forgotten celebrities.
Get the most up-to-date news regarding the foot and mouth pandemic.
Get the latest football scores.
Read about the music of the day.

title: Sphinx Lowering
description: A Doom II mod.

title: Capybara
description: "Capybara" is the perfect game for anyone who loves relaxing yet captivating clicker games. With its adorable mascot and endless opportunities for growth, this game will entertain you for hours. Download "Capybara" now and start your adventure!

title: Pay 4 It
description: A Doom II mod.

title: Elsp
description: A Doom II mod.

title: Ball-e
description:
Ball-e is a singleplayer platformer with roguelike elements.
The player has to beat challenges and bosses to reach the top and become the ultimate Ninja Ball Warrior.

Many characters can be unlocked and various abilities and upgrades can be found during a run.

Additionally the player can compete in smaller challenges and become the fastest on the leaderboard.

title: Poop Killer II
description:
"Poop Killer 2" is a comedy game mixed with trash horror from the 80's and 90's. Inspired by old movies involving marijuana and a lot of shit. It's a short game with the objective to amuse the player, it contains 2 simple endings.

Billy is a marijuana dealer and lives with his friend Jamal in an apartment. They sell and smoke a lot of weed... After your friend takes a shit in your toilet... the poop killer comes to visit you.

title: Poop KIller III
description:
"Poop Killer 3" is the poop killer kill sequel. Increasingly bizarre with an acid comedy typical of 80's and 90's horror/comedy movies.

A game where we mix tension and extremely exaggerated comedy, bullshit in the form of a game. Contains 4 possible endings. Two of them might be good.

Robert owns a nightclub, the year is 1985. After a customer shits and doesn't flush... the Poop Killer will show up to bring you a big piece of shit.

title: That's a lot of pixels!
description: That's a lot of pixels! is a fast-paced retro mini-games compilation, it features a wide variety of genres: rogue-like, platformer, puzzle, shooters, beat'em up, ….

title: Poop Killer 4
description:
"Poop Killer 4" is a game inspired by trashy horror movies from the 80's. With an over-the-top comedy and weird horror.

The game contains 3 possible endings.

title: Poop Killer 5
description:
"Poop Killer 5" is the sequel to the stinkiest and deadliest killer... The Poop Killer Returns...

With a different construction from the previous ones, Leaving the gameplay more dynamic.

title: Poop Killer Origins
description: Did you think "Poop Killer" was over? We're back with the latest game in the franchise, in "Poop Killer Origins" you'll find out how this killer who uses a toilet over his head came to be.

title: The Gods Fabled: Soil Frontier
description: Sow life back into the land in an open-world fantasy farming experience like no other in The Gods Fabled: Soil Frontier!

title: 24-ji, Kimi no Heart wa Nusumareru: Kaitou Jade
Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy: Stormy Ascent
description: Experience the notorious Stormy Ascent level from the original Crash Bandicoot game. Previously unfinished and unreleased, this level will challenge even the most hardened of Crash fans! Do you have what it takes to tackle the fast retracting steps, vial throwing lab assistants, flying birds, moving platforms and iron spikes? Download and play the Stormy Ascent Level!

title: Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy: Future Tense
description: Play the first-ever new level built for the original trilogy’s gameplay in almost 20 years. Drawing inspiration from the cut “Waterfall Level” from the first Crash Bandicoot game, Future Tense features several puzzles from the original level set in the futuristic setting from Crash Bandicoot 3: Warped. Discover a whole new level of difficulty for Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy as you dodge rockets, destroy robots and leaps lasers while ascending a massive futuristic skyscraper.

title: Black Mesa: Xen
description: Black Mesa: Xen is an update to the game Black Mesa that completely reimagined and refined the Xen levels in the single player campaign.

title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided - Desperate Measures
description:
Desperate Measures is a single mission DLC for Deus Ex: Mankind Divided. Originally, it was available only as a pre-order bonus or through purchase of the day-one edition, Collector's Edition, or Digital Deluxe Edition of Mankind Divided. Desperate Measures was later released as a free download. Like other story DLCs, Desperate Measures is accessed through the "Jensen Stories" section of the main menu.

Desperate Measures focuses on exposing the mastermind behind the train bombing in Růžička Station. Adam Jensen must travel to the Prague office of Tarvos Security Services to learn the truth about the bombing.

title: Blasphemous: Strife & Ruin
description: Join forces with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night as you seek to solve the mystery of her summoning to the nightmarish lands of Cvstodia.

title: We Are Not Alone
description: We Are Not Alone is a new twist on horror that combines first person exploration and third person point and click adventure. As a member of a "safe" isolation experiment you'll explore an underground facility, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of an unknown creature. Just don't make eye contact.

title: Chicken Killer
description: "Chicken Killer" is a horror/comedy game based on the trashy horror movies of the 80's. Inspired by the low-budget chinese horror films.

title: Dick Killer
description: "Dick Killer" is a trash horror game! A mix of horror and comedy... style old horror movies like "Scary Movie", Totally over the top.

title: The Telwynium: Book Two
description:
The Telwynium Book Two continues directly from Book One. Don't worry, there's an in game re-cap if you haven't played it!

You've been betrayed! The magic wielding Aldor that rescued you from the hands of the shadowfell is dead. Your home town burns, and your only remaining childhood friend is held captive by those monsters, on the way to Targoth, south of the Burning Swamp.

But you are not alone. By your side is Drissa and Alethi, the two-headed Raakmiri rogue. The axe-wielding Uplander, Otarr. And of course, your army of skeletons.

The Telwynium: Book Two is an early 90s style point and click, with Sierra SCI0 style graphics, but with a fancy new-fangled point 'n click interface.

title: Bridge Race
description: Join the adventure with more than 1000 levels that contain mechanisms such as sliders, trampolines, zip-lines, ladders, and elevators! Collect blocks of your own color and build bridges with them.

title: Chimera Online
description:
Chimera Online is an MMORPG with a high focus on the ever lasting war between the 2 Nations "Rain" and "Millena".
Rain is living in the mountains and uses magical power for combat, while Millena is living in the forests and uses a mainly physical combat style by using Swords and Bows.

The game is designed for an easy entrance, after just a few hours of Gameplay you can already participate in fights with your nation against the other nation.
While there are many dungeons and raids that can be done with the help of other player in your nation, you can also progress alone and enjoy 1v1 combat or solo farming.

If you are unsure which nation or class to pick, you also test out any class you want to at any point in time. All you have to do is login a free test account. These Test-Accounts have limited access ingame and are designed for pvp tests and special war events.

The battle system is designed so that fights last for a moderate time. Infinite chain of control effects, aswell as 1hit KOs are banished from Chimera Online.

The game is 100% free to play. Everything you want to access ingame you can access without the need of any payment. The Cash Shop mainly offers Special Skins and quality of life items that have no direct impact in the gameplay.

title: The True Ingredients
description:
The True Ingredients is a horror game that is a goofy twist on SpongeBob SquarePants, trapping an unsuspecting customer in the disturbing bowels of the restaurant being hunted by the titular fry cook.

In the game, the player visits the (legally distinct) Krunchy Kans restaurant to try one of their famed human patty burgers. Unfortunately, the visitor is unable to pay for their $87.99 meal and is hauled down to the depths of the Krunchy Kans to be imprisoned with others that have incurred the wrath of the owner.

title: The Professional
description: The Professional is a physics-based heist game made by Torfi Asgeirsson.

title: Miss Clue: Peril In Pemberley!
description: As Jane Darcy, the daughter of Mr. Darcy and Elizabeth Bennet, you must explore the richly decorated halls and elegant grounds of the great Pemberley estate and unravel the strange happenings that threaten Pemberley!

title: You Can Kana
description: Learn and master the japanese phonetic alphabets at your own pace with this meditative language learning tool.

title: Doggo Dentist
description:
Welcome to Yarrow. You are our newest Doggo Dentist! During your totally rad career and stay with us, you will meet so many gnarly furry friends, promote your professional career and figure out what makes Yarrow the leading market competitor. So what are you waiting for? Lets begin!

Doggo Dentist is my newest free and short indie point-and click game made in six weeks, on the engine Clickteam fusion. This is the beta version- so it may be buggy!

Doggo Dentist is an awesome and totally tubular, 80's inspired point and click management game, that you should like most definitely give a try. Play as a newly hired dentist who must figure out how to perform his job in a not so radical dental firm called Yarrow. Manage cleanings, extractions, veterinary services and many more tasks on 3 unique canines, as you take the advice and heated conversation from another fellow employee named Chanice. All in all, you must figure out what to make of your new career and decide if Yarrow is the right fit for you!

title: Boreal Tenebrae Appendix I
description:
The figments of the forest swirled within this crucible of immense heat.

At the fulcrum between the exterior expanse,

and the encroaching frustration of the denizens…

Bulsifer came to exist.

Once the spirits of the forest, now a phantasm of the town.

Drift back through dreams of the town by speaking to your fellow phantoms in this small companion to Boreal Tenebrae Act I.

title: While I'm Still Your Eyes
description:
A game about emotional abuse.

You are back at the waterfront. They are spilling everything out onto you. Drink up bitch. Good girl. For now, I am still your eyes.

title: Protocol: 47
description:
Overpopulation! We're running out of space! We need to enact Protocol: 47!

Protocol: 47 - In the event of an humanitarian disaster Protocol 47 is used to select a celebrity to release an appeal/charity single or host a celebrity filled live concert in order to raise awareness of chosen disaster.

Play as a Superstar Producer and pen a new hit record that brings the overpopulation issue to the minds of many.

title: Quiet Manor
description: Made for the Haunted PS1 Wretched Weekend jam.

title: Perilous Wilde
description: Perilous Wilde follows the valiant Amelya Conner and her forest band of exiles as they plot a town's rescue against villainous invaders.

title: Hoofield
description: Powerhoof just released their latest masterpiece, and now Dave wants to celebrate by taking a day off to relax! Alas, life isn't always that simple, especially in Hoofield...

title: Random Chat
description: Based on the weekly Naver Webtoon 'Random Chat,' this new visual novel breathes life into the story by re-forming it into a love simulation game!

title: Citroën C4 Robot
description: An online racing game featuring a robot-to-car transforming Citroën's C4 car. There is only one track in the game.

title: A Red Boat
description: A Red Boat is a short story told through boating and lost letters.

title: Fate/Samurai Remnant
description:
Throughout the Fate franchise, pairs of masters and heroic spirits —also known as servants— have been fighting across history in a series of Holy Grail Wars, with the winning duo receiving an ancient artifact that grants wishes.

Fate/Samurai Remnant continues the series’ epic Holy Grail War in the fourth year of the Keian Era, Edo Period Japan. It has been several decades since the end of a turbulent, blood-soaked era, and while the people are finally enjoying peace and tranquility, a battle between seven pairs of masters and servants is about to begin as the “Waxing Moon Ritual” unfolds in the shadows. This is where the game’s hero, Miyamoto Iori, a young man in Asakusa, finds himself caught in the violence alongside his servant Saber, as they fight to be the last pair remaining in order to receive the granter of wishes, the “Waxing Moon Vessel”.

title: Lay a Beauty to Rest: The Darkness Peach Blossom Spring
description: Love-suspense AVG with the theme of "The Peach Blossom Spring". The equinox flowers, bloom for one thousand years and wither for one thousand years. Eternal paradise. Do you choose to stay here, escape here, or bury everything here?

title: Rights of Progression
description:
You are the Arbiter.

As planets apply to join your alliance of planets, it is up to you to approve or deny each request. It is your judgement, and their future lies in your hands.

title: Full Gear
description: Engineer your way through a steampunk traditional roguelike. Create drones, use Cogwheels and Tokens, and dismantle many robotic enemies along your way to get all the way to the darkest secret of the dungeon.

title: Monster Heart
description:
Have you ever met a nice, cute monster in an rpg and just did not want to fight, but instead give it a big hug? Maybe take it home, bandage up its wounds, and then care for it like a pet? Welcome to Riddle Fox's next big game, Monster Heart!

Here you will wander the Candlebook Island Monster Sanctuary and care for all the wonderful beasts and monsters, and then relax after a hard days work with your coworkers.

title: Symbol
description: Weird things on the side of the road.

title: MiG-29 Fulcrum
description: The Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-29 Fulcrum is one of the world's most maneuverable and toughest fighter jets and has often been compared to its closest Western counterpart, the F-16. Innovations unique to the aircraft allow MiG pilots to perform remarkable moves like the Tailslide and Cobra maneuvers.

title: Christmas Stories: Taxi of Miracles
description: A tough year has put a damper on your town's holiday cheer, and your spirits are low this Christmas Eve. That is until a jolly cab driver named Nick comes on the scene with an idea to turn things around! The two of you are off on an adventure to help townspeople in need and discover the true meaning of Christmas!

title: Christmas Stories: Taxi of Miracles - Collector's Edition
description:
This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Save Christmas for some friendly felines in the bonus chapter!
- Bring some holiday spirit to the neighborhood with the strategy guide!
- Downloadable wallpapers and music bring the holidays home!
- Lots of extra hidden objects to find!

title: The Last Craftsman
