description: Get settled into the town of Gear Springs! Craft items for the townsfolk, gather materials, go fishing, and fight in card battles in the facility below the ruins.

title: GothicDM 2
description: GothicDM II is the sequel to GothicDM, released on May 2, 1998. It uses the same gothic architectural themes, and was followed by Gothic 99.

title: Jumplight Odyssey
description: Keep hope alive on your adventure to the mythical Forever Star! Gather survivors, repair and build out your starship, brave black holes, and fend off attacks, all while managing the daily soap opera of your colorful crew.

title: Lost Egg 3: The Final
description: The egg's great adventure, the final chapter. That fragile but brave egg has returned with even more new powers, but this time its adventure is over. A hard action adventure game about the fragility, bravery, and sometimes friendship of raw eggs. Aim for the frying pan at the end of rolling through various stages with sad and touching melody.

title: Khatyrka: Prelude
description: Khatyrka: Prelude is a narrative third-person shooter that follows the story of Gadzhi, a military defector who must cross the vast and hostile Khatyrka Steppe in escape of his former comrades. Explore the vast, arid steppe on horseback and survive intense combat encounters.

title: A Mall Near You
description: Explore the still-intact wings of a mostly-abandoned mall, soak in the atmosphere and holiday vibes, and discover love again in this festive feast for your fearful, frosty fingers.

title: Black Mesa: Definitive Edition
description: Black Mesa: Definitive Edition includes performance improvements with a higher frame rate in some levels and visual upgrades, as well as all new and expanded Xen levels.

title: Dolce
description: A visual novel about being stuck in a time loop and talking to friends.

title: RaphaelGer's Plane
description: Its about a plane which wants to reach his goal and escape from the earth to save RaphaelGer's life and the life from his crew.

title: Dead Space: Collector's Edition
description: Dead Space puts players in the boots of Isaac Clarke, an everyman engineer on a routine mission to fix a gigantic mining starship, the USG Ishimura. But aboard the Ishimura, a living nightmare awaits. The ship’s crew has been slaughtered and infected, and Isaac’s girlfriend, Nicole, is missing somewhere on board. Alone and trapped, with only his engineering tools and skills, Isaac faces a battle for survival—not only against terrifying monsters called Necromorphs, but his own crumbling sanity.

title: Jerma's Big Adventure 2
description: Become Jerma. In this genre-jumping absurdist adventure, scramble to appease a restless livestream audience by hopping between in-universe video games. Enter the Jermaverse...

title: Fallout 2 Remake
description: An enthusiast with the nickname ConstructVOD released an early version of his own remake of the iconic Fallout 2 on a different engine. Anyone can download it for free. In addition, you can evaluate the project directly in the browser.

title: Sandy at the Telephone Company
description: Sandy just got his first job at the telephone company... make sure he keeps it!!!!!

title: Kotonoha Maichiru Natsu no Koe
description:
Osamu was on his way to attend the opening ceremony at Sakuranomiya Gakuen when he heard a familiar voice. It was the super-popular voice actress Kokoro, who never shows her face, but he was able to tell due to his ability to identify anyone by their voice. Her real name was Kotoha and she was repeating her first year, just like him. Since he was her top fan, he was excited to spend his time at school with her while keeping her identity a secret between the two of them.

Then he was invited by Yuu, a first-year student who aspires to be a voice actress but gets nervous easily, to join the voice acting club. Together with the older Aoko and wheelchair-bound Kanade, a youthful love comedy where everyone is a first-year student (although three are repeaters) begins!

title: Inochi no Spare
description:
Shukugawa Meguri is afflicted with an illness called the “Oumon” disease. At this point in time, nobody knows its cause, and there’s no real treatment for it yet. The only option with a slight chance of success, is to undergo a heart transplant. But finding a compatible heart is something that can be compared with a miracle. For that purpose Meguri’s sister, Ria, was actually born as a designer baby. So that her heart could be used “like a spare”.

This is the story about two sisters, the youngest born for the sake of the eldest. Other than their family, only Meguri's best friend Ryuuji knows about their secret. Her resolve wavers during the little time they have left. What will be the conclusion at the end of these emotional moments?

title: Konko to no Nichijou ~Bocchi de Kawaikute Hottokenai Youko~
description:
One day, you meet with a trainee foxgirl, who's in charge of the school club you're assigned to. The girl, Konko, has no human friends. By hanging out, playing, drinking tea together, and sharing in her hobbies, the nervous Konko will gradually open up, allowing you to grow close through your ongoing communication. Over the days you spend together, you'll develop feelings of friendship and, eventually, love.

The limitless days go on for forever, so you can enjoy your lovey-dovey life with Konko to your heart's content. Go on dates, eat at the school cafeteria, give presents, and choose from over 200 clothing options. Plus, as boyfriend and girlfriend, you can hug, kiss, and enjoy bathing together.

title: Verwandlung
description:
A short horror game loosely inspired by Kafka's "The Metamorphosis"
Made as part of the Haunted PS1 Halloween Jam 2022

title: Kinda Knirpsi
description: Take on the role of Knirpsi the turtle and face a variety of enemies. Experience retro cartoon-style shooter action and hand-drawn boss battles. You will die. Many Times.

title: Poker Tower Defense
description: This is a tower defense game played with playing cards, where defensive cards are used to eliminate attacking cards and receive score rewards.

title: Anime Girl Slide Puzzle
description: A chill slide puzzle game featuring anime girls, with 50 different levels and 5 tiers of difficulty.

title: Funny Walk
description: After Deity Driving and Beautycopter, the final entry of a trilogy you've likely never heard of is here! You've been invited to a talk show because of your special interests (collecting roadside treasure, having free time), but the world isn't quite ready for you yet ...

title: Aa! Megami-sama!
description: Based on the anime series Ah! My Goddess, the game follows the story of a Japanese high-school student named Keiichi, who has accidentally summoned the powerful, yet very lovely Norse goddess Verdandi (mercilessly misspelled Belldandy in the game) and pronounced a wish to stay with her forever. Now the gorgeous goddess has become a part of his life, and the two find themselves involved in constant misunderstandings and comical situations, yet also develop feelings for each other...

title: Funkscop
description:
According to content found in a copy of the lost game, the companies Garalina and Nifteam made a game whose latest version (as far as is known) dates back to 1997.

We assembled a research team to restore the gameplay and content of the game, and successfully shared a compilation of our findings so far.

Be aware that all is not what it seems, and there is more going on than meets the eye. As the game itself suggests, "It's a growing organism".

Funkscop is a mod based on the internet horror series, Petscop. It contains multiple secrets and hidden songs and sequences tied to the game's ARG and horror-esque overworld and story.

title: Antipathy: Friday Night Funkin'
description:
Friday Night Funkin': Antipathy is finally here!
After a year of development, the mod is finished. Get ready for one of the most ambitious and finger breaking madness mods out there!!

MOD CONTAINS:

- 2 PLAYABLE SKINS
- 5 NEW SONGS AND AN OVERDRIVE REMAKE, MAKING 7 SONGS
- FIGHTING MECHANICS
- 3D CUTSCENES
- 3 DIFFICULTIES (HARD, MAD AND FUCKED)
- AND MORE!!

title: Conspiratio
description: Conspiratio is a free fanmade open source game project, inspired by "Fugger 2". It's a turn-based economic simulator of the modern age (17th century).

title: The Legend of the Spirit Orbs
description: The Legend of the Spirit Orbs is a fan-made game based on the Zelda series.

title: Ossuarium
description: In medieval Bohemia, Marie and Jakub struggle to escape a terrible curse - but their futures have already been written.

title: Our Lady of the Drowned Lake, Zero Reporter
description: An amateur reporter encounters strange occurrences while trying to film a night fishing trip.

title: Pact
description: Pact is a turn-based strategy roguelike. Make a pact with a demon for world changing powers and survive the consequences.

title: Private Detective
description: Private Detective is a procedurally generated murder mystery game, where you must solve randomly generated crimes by finding leads, questioning suspects, and gathering evidence from the crime scene to compare with samples found in the homes of the suspects. It plays a lot like an adventure game, but with a lot more deduction and a lot less inventory object puzzles.

title: Project Fog: The Wounded
description: Play the character of Cheryl who got trapped in a mysterious foggy city. Wounded, she barely managed to enter an establishment to escape from the monster. She was then greeted by a man named Norman who rushed and killed the monster chasing after her. Norman tended Cheryl's wound after and left her some supplies to survive. The clock is ticking for Norman as someone dear to him is missing, and soon he'll have to leave Cheryl alone.

title: Ratman
description: Ratman is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. A creature called “Ratman” is terrorizing local dwarfs. You and your fellow brave dwarf knights decide to sneak into his lair in order to burn his supplies. Find matches and burn his cheese stock, but don't get caught by the murderous Ratman!

title: Boba Simulator
description: Boba Tea shop simulator with cats. Manage recipe, stock and customer satisfaction.

title: Chop Chop Guys
description: Join the madness in Chop Chop Guys, a wild competition of dim-witted characters racing through a world of zany traps. Lose your head? No problem! You don't need it to reach the finish line!

title: Kekcroc Forever
description: Kekcroc Forever is a MegaDrive-style game based on a fictional character Kekcroc.

title: Among Us: Submerged
description: Submerged is a mod in Among Us that adds an underwater-themed map.

title: Neko Loop
description: A cat girl facing a multitude of enemies, bosses, secrets and challenges creates the cutest roguelike game you've ever seen.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Free Next-Gen Update
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Free Next-Gen Update was released on December 14, 2022, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. This update introduced graphical enhancements such as ray tracing, improved textures, and faster loading times, along with quality-of-life features like a new camera angle, revised UI, and integrated mods. It also added new content inspired by the Netflix series, including armor sets and a themed quest.

title: Call of Dragons
description: Call of Dragons is an MMO fantasy conquest game from the creators of Rise of Kingdoms, offering an incredible strategic combat experience.

title: Bus Simulator: Ultimate
description: Bus Simulator: Ultimate is a game that challenges you to manage all aspects of a bus company, from creating the company's logo to planning the best routes in order to transport as many customers as possible.

title: Lights
description: Lights is an endless runner in which you need to dodge various obstacles and earn points.

title: Test Your Knowledge: Cats
description: Test Your Knowledge: Cats is a test game that will test your knowledge of different cat breeds. Do you know how to look like a variety of cat breeds? Havana, Somalia, Oriental, Peterbald, Maine Coon, Pixibob and many others. Test yourself with our interesting test

title: Amaze Valentine
description: Amaze Valentine is a straightforward and surprisingly - difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with romantic art and calm soundtrack.

title: Hyper Mum Ft Adult Gaming
description: Have you got the skills to overcome the problem that has plagued you all this time? It's time to find out! Play as yourself, complete the game and don't let your mum catch you!

title: Senpai Teaches Me Japanese
description: Do you know any Japanese? Based on textbook learning methods, at the end of this game you will know how to read Japanese characters, sentence structure, and 100+ words.

title: Topless Hentai Mosaic
description: Find the way to each of the fifteen girls and help them take off their clothes.

title: Amazing Online
description: Massive online role-playing game in the open world on the map of the alternative Nizhny Novgorod region of Russia, where up to a thousand players on one map can complete interesting quests, play the role of their character, participate in events, create their own criminal group or family, work as a truck driver, farmer, fisherman or join a state organization - edit news in the media, protect order in the police, legislate in the Administration, treat other players in the hospital, help in an ambulance, protect a military unit and perform administrative functions in the army, counteract corruption in the FSB (or become a corrupt official yourself - everything is possible here) or follow the correction of the guilty in the Federal Penitentiary Service, or simply create your own business and lead a peaceful life in wealth and luxury.

title: Elon Must: Road to Respect
description: Help Elon Must make his way from Earth to Mars to pay respects to the deceased robot Opportunity.

title: Trump Vs Rocketman
description: Be an USA leader and fight again the Korean enemy leader in this top down strategy game.

title: Hentai Petting Simulator
description: A simulator that will lift your mood! And in fact, not only the mood. In this game control will take only one hands!

title: Cyber Furry Girl
description: A logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and open the pictures with furry girls in cyber style.

title: Whack A Hoe
description: In this fun shooter game you aren't shooting bullets, NO! You're shooting Dildo's of all shapes, sizes and from the character that you choose! The object of the game is to be the leader with the highest score. Perfect your angle, wait for the power meter to get to the top (full) and WHACK AWAY.

title: Girls of Hentai Mosaic
description: Erotic puzzle game that will help you relax and have fun at any time.

title: Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals - Poppy Playtime Panic
description: The Poppy Playtime Panic DLC is a limited time new level for Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals. In this content you can explore and try to survive in the Playtime Co. toy factory based on the original Poppy Playtime game. Characters in this DLC include Huggy Wuggy and Kissy Missy based on the original Poppy Playtime game.

title: Warp Nexus
description: With a deep, dynamic, player-controlled economy built on Unreal Engine 5, Warp Nexus is a community-driven spaceship MMO and trading game accessible through the STARL Metaverse. Start with 16 sectors and species, customize your ships and characters, battle, trade, make alliances or choose piracy to conquer galaxies. Trade or battle for assets that can be either gameside or blockchain side depending on the user's preference. With zero pay to win advantages, this game is all about a player's skill and knowledge gained through the game economy and battling.

title: Pitch Silent
description: The Earth has withered away. Guided by an angel in the dark. You must brave the underground of Eden to find the all forms of creation to rekindle the light.

title: Stellinavra
description: An erotic sci-fi rpg set aboard a derelict space station. Its retro aesthetic is styled after the Amiga.

title: Vroom Racing
description:
Drive a Formula 1 car upon 18 worldwide tracks. Reach 380 Km/h and beat the ghost!
Tracks include: Argentina, Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, China, Egypt, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Portugal, Russia, Spain, UK, USA

title: MILF Conditioning
description: You happened to save a MILF who happened to be the wife of your landlord, yet she had a weak character that didn't match her status – she couldn't refuse others. Having learnt that, would you take advantage and sleep with the beautiful landlady?

title: I Die a Lovely Life
description: Long distance girlfriends Uni and Nuña are aching to meet, but neither of them can afford the plane tickets. Willing to do anything for money, Uni participates in a research study to have her brain uploaded into a computer... irreversibly?! Oops. But we can still hook up though, right?

title: Sidrial
description:
In a star system far from Earth, there is intelligent life. Driven by conquest, a race more advanced than Humans - and far more brutal - has waged a war against all sentient beings. They will destroy anything in their path, as they have done for thousands of years. The OVERLORDS, a bloodthirsty race bent on power and destruction, have annihilated every inhabited planet in their wake. Sidrial, one of the last planets standing, is the last outpost between Earth and the Overlords. With most of Sidrial destroyed, a new breed has risen to fight back against the tyrants. As the Sidrilian Rebel Forces fight back and struggle to join with others against the OVERLORDS, new alliances will be forged and the future of entire galaxies will depend on their success.

In Sidrial, you make your escape from some sort of prison that seems to be devoid of life.

title: Dream of a Sunflower
description: Touhou meets Dark Souls. Also Yuuka wanders into someone's dream and decides to cause trouble. What could go wrong?

title: Touhou: Phantom Assembler
description: A certain brown-haired Touhou university student ventures into a dream world.

title: Reprobate
description: Reprobate is a surreal hidden object game focused on free exploration, where players uncover symbolic objects and engage with abstract puzzles and creative mini games in dreamlike environments.

title: Robot Rumpus Royale
description: The year is 2082. Robot battles are all the rage. Fans flock from all four corners of the globe to watch robots duke it out. Competitors rent a bot and send it against a series of other bots. If their bot falls, they lose. But if their bot wins, then the competitors will gain fame and glory (and maybe even a sponsorship) beyond their wildest dreams! You are the latest competitor to challenge the arena. You are randomly assigned a rental bot. Maybe you’ll become the newest champion of the arena. Maybe you’ll fail miserably. Maybe you’re just here to listen to the goofy robot voices. And maybe you’ll get a new friend out of the deal. Who knows!

title: Do Robots Dream of Ice Cream?
description: Bobby the robot's AI has progressed more than his creator, Robert, knows. With his newfound curiosity to experience new things, Bobby decides he wants to try ice cream and see what the big deal is!

title: Sanctified
description: Your Wife and Child are missing. You are alone in a hotel. They've been expecting you. They've always been expecting you.

title: Baba Files Taxes
description: Baba needs help filing taxes, and the deadline is tonight! Help Baba in order to make it in time.

title: Rennsport
description: A racing simulation developed in Unreal Engine 5, making use of feedback from professional real world drivers to simulate car physics and behavior in a realistic way.

title: R'lyeh Assault
description: Experience hot blinking action, in a brand new LOVECRAFTIAN TALE of uncanny terror! Destroy the All-Mighty CTHULHU, using the powers of the LEGENDARY NECRONOMICON , and free the fishing town of R'LYEH of his power and his DAGON minions. Will you save R'LYEH from CTHULU'S betentacled grasp, or will you lose your sanity in the process?

title: Coin Pusher Casino
description: Coinpusher Casino is a game that brings the excitement of classic coin pusher machines to your computer. With realistic physics and colorful graphics, you'll feel like you're playing the real thing.

title: The Chiral Night: Rhythm Carnival
description: A Nitro+Chiral rhythm game featuring, characters and songs from Nitro+CHiRAL games! as well as a original story.

title: Spellborne
description: Spellborne is an open-ended monster catching MMORPG! Start as one of three hunters, looking to achieve their own goals, and experience a unique adventure in every play-through. Capture monsters, farm crops and craft items in this ever expanding world where each decision you take affects your journey.

title: Vampire Tourist
description:
Vampire Tourist is a new type of immersive experience taking place in Central Europe.
You are a "Vampire in Vacation" that finds himself without powers while in this new land so when the opportunity arises to get them back things get complicated.
Experience the European streets and atmosphere during the night (as well as day) and capture the best shots while finding our more about the city, it's mysteries and maybe about yourself.

title: Duck Nukem: Four Feathers
description: After starring in the successful Fly Hard action movie trilogy, you retired to a small cabin in the woods. You grew comfortable in the quiet life you had created. Soon, you also grew too fat to fly anywhere. Then, one day without warning, the outside world came crashing back into your life. It was not a good time to be a duck. Play as Howard the Duck across 20 levels of intense action. Your mission? Take him to Heaven!

title: Grave Spirit
description: Within an ancient land, undisturbed for ages, evil resides in a towering fortress... A young wanderer, without a name and past, has been forced to travel to this fortress by a shadowy spirit who controls his every move. Setting out on an uncertain journey, the nameless wanderer has no choice but to succeed in pleasing the spirit's wishes or die trying...

title: Fengse Huanxiang 6
description: **This game is playable in Chinese only**

title: Desynced
description: Desynced is a sci-fi strategy game with fully customizable units and behaviors. Gather, build, research, and explore the unknown. Alone or with friends, unveil the mystery of an AI on the edge of self-awareness and uncover the hidden truth in this blend of strategy, automation, and exploration.

title: Akogare no Onna Joushi ga Shin'ya no Office de Onatteru Tokoro o Mite kara Hajimaru Himitsu no Kankei.
Hiversaires
description: Hiversaires is a point-and-click adventure game. Venture down entangled corridors, enter the dark world.

title: MareQuest
description: MareQuest! A profound experience including Mare customization, procedurally generated mares, rng mare dialogue, and accurate mare friendship simulation! What more could you possibly want?

title: Entasy Online
description:
Entasy Online is a 2D multiplayer action role-playing game. It is available on Steam and Play Store.

Entasy is a fantastic world that has been attacked by creatures. Your goal is saving Entasy World from these creatures and become a hero! Natives of Entasy World needs you.

It is a multiplayer game that you may get quests from the characters to accomplish. You will get stronger equipment by defeating creatures in time. You can also buy and sell items on market to get gold or spend. Add friends to your friend list and enjoy playing with them. Entasy Online is being developed by just 1 developer and it is currently in early access version.

title: Open Surge
description:
Open Surge is a fun 2D retro platformer inspired by Sonic games and a game creation system that lets you unleash your creativity!

Open Surge is two projects in one: a game and a game creation system (game engine). It is released as free and open source software.

title: Cov Shooter
description:
Try to survive as many waves as possible.
Upgrade your weapons and stats to be able to coop with the new mutations.

title: Driving Home
description: Driving Home is a short indie horror game, where you drive home after working late and you realize you forgot to refuel your car.

title: Burden of 80 Proof
description:
Somewhere out in the suburbs, an cubicle full of nonsense sits unnoticed, unmolested. Rich has taken the day off.

At a different office, somewhere else, Peter Kent is embroiled in an over-caffeinated, lightning-paced, perfectly normal day at work.

It's good then, that Rich has arranged for "the house." A relaxing, semi-permanent party headquarters to be used all summer by the two of them, their boozy crew of half-wit friends, and anyone who follows the trail of noise to their doorstep. Unfortunately, a bit of confusion has left the boys with all house and no supplies.

So is it possible to have a good time, the kind of good time to which Rich and Peter are accustomed, without any preparation at all?

The answer, as it turns out, is no. We'll still need beer. Definitely. Right? And some other stuff.

And so with no money, no patience, and a lunch hour long since spent, can Peter secure the supplies necessary to fend off the fearsome hurricane of boredom which threatens this warm, warm weekend?

title: Deus Ex: Zodiac
description: ZODIAC is a set of six single player missions for Deus Ex.

title: Atlantis no Puzzle
description: A short exploration puzzle-platformer where you search for items and decide which one to bring over to your next life every time you die.

title: Tree Simulator 2021
description: Wood you like marginally improved graphics? Do you like leafing it all behind and taking root in some random field? If so, you are a tree, be the best tree you can be. Prepare for a deeper and more detailed understanding of what it is to be a tree. A true work of art.

title: Road to Scrubville: A Bijuu Mike Fangame
description: Road to Scrubville is a Bijuu Mike inspired fangame. Clarence decides to take revenge on Bijuu Mike once again, will it end well this time?

title: Art of Fighting: Trouble in South Town
description: Art of Fighting Trouble in South Town contains several levels like fighting / bonus stages / interactive levels.

title: Sionan
description: You've been sent to collect logs relating to a facility's mysterious destruction. Guided only by a voice and hounded by a robot, you must uncover what happened to the researchers.

title: Keke in the Caves of Peril
description: Help Keke, the brave explorer, delve into the Caves of Peril to amass amazing treasure! Collect every diamond and head for the exit in each level to beat them. But be wary of structurally unsound mineshafts and other dangers!

title: Sleepthrough
description:
Another sleepless night.
I just lay here, in my bed, with my mind stuck by a fear I can't define. I've tried everything... from pills to hypnosis. All I can get are brief moments of unconsciousness. I think there's something wrong with my brain. It all began when I started to play this game...

title: Schmaragon
description: Schmaragon MOBA is an exciting fusion of Eve Online, Dota 2, and Epic's Paragon. It incorporates innovative and hardcore concepts, such as permadeath, variable-powered heroes, no mandatory match completion requirements, and a toxicity-free environment.

title: Smart Technology
description:
It’s almost Halloween. You’ve been hired to house-sit for the reclusive widow who lives on the outskirts of town. Her home is outfitted with the latest tech, and an impressive artificial intelligence named Agatha controls it all. But something has gone wrong. The AI considers you an intruder and will neutralize you at the first sign of perceived hostility.

Tread carefully. Survive the evening. Outsmart the AI.

Agatha is watching.

title: Smart Technology 2
description:
It's the Christmas season. You have returned to Agatha's realm. You believe you've recovered from all the trauma of your first stay there. Things suddenly spiral out of control when Agatha is hit with a strange frequency and considers you an intruder all over again. You have to survive one more evening against Agatha while trying to return her to normal and decipher why she changed. Things may never be the same.

Return home.

Agatha is being watched.

title: Terminus Machina
description: Terminus Machina is a Deus Ex total convertion mod set in a dystopian cyberpunk future where you take on the role of an operative in the Hex Gen network, a decentralized movement of hacktivists resisting the economic pillaging conducted by the unholy alliances of Big Tech, Big Military, and Big Finance.

title: Trying to Sing in Static
description:
Ferry stranded silhouettes across a dead sea

A small atmospheric game that takes around 25 minutes to complete

title: Skincrawlers
description: A tiny game made for the Haunted Hunting Jam

title: Into the Woods
description: A short, five-minute experience visually inspired by the aesthetics of PS1 survival horror games

title: Towering
description: Towering is a platform game that is inspired by Red Light, Green Light. When the background is red you are frozen in place. When the background is green you can move but most platforms and objects become invisible. The challenge is to study the placement of objects during red and navigate the tower during green by relying on your memory. Watch out for dangerous obstacles and enemies which will cause you to fall down! Can you reach the treasure at the top of the tower?

title: World of Football
description: World of Football offers an authentic team-based football physics experience. Dive into straightforward gameplay that's challenging to master, ensuring a competitive edge. Experience true control with intuitive mechanics, devoid of randomness or luck!

title: Transport-inators of Doooom!
description: Rescue Phineas from the Transport-inators of Doom!

title: Floppy Knights: Version 2.0
description: Adds new playable characters, new story and challenge levels, as well as new cards and some assist mode options.

title: Rollercoaster World 2
description: If you're an adrenaline junkie and crave the rush of high-speed thrills, start building! Construct wooden, steel, inverted, stand-up and even flying coasters that push the boundaries of design with gravity-defying loops, stomach-wrenching corkscrews and knee-weakening speeds!

title: Squirrel Launcher
description: Launch squirrels into the atmosphere and explore the clouds. Dodge and shoot down obstacles – upgrade your vehicle to make it further and further until you get to the moon!

title: WarLeague
description: We combined a self-moving chess game with an RTS game to create a multiplayer strategy game with legion battles. Match and combine the cards of your choice, build your army from nothing to the cool feeling of thousands of troops, then crush your opponent, and finally eat chicken to win.

title: You are the Weapon
description: Welcome to 'You are the Weapon!' In this game you are the weapon, enabled with powers that you unleash on your foes! The game is in development and graphics will be updated and improved!

title: Wild River Run
description: Twitch integrated game that involves racing in rivers.

title: Nightmare Breaker
description:
A top-down action RPG with a beat 'em up combat style.
The gameplay loop is similar to DFO with dungeons consisting of multiple fights in separate arenas before a boss room ending with a gameplay score, up to SSS rank, for an extra reward.

title: Saikoro Saiko Sebunsu Hebun
description: "All the heroines are psychopaths!" Can you capture the dangerous psychopathic girls who will try to harm you at any chance?

title: As Long As It's Not Illegal: Act I
description: It's Friday night, you and the other Senior Elites devise a plan to throw a party at the rival campus. Carpool across Suncity limits, down into the lawless land of the Undercity. It's Illegal for these two cities to mingle. But is it illegal if... you're never caught?

title: Tenuous:City
description: An interactive music album using samples from and inspired by the PS1 game GERMS: Nerawareta Machi.

title: Gakuen Handsome
description: A classic boy's love parody visual novel, the first in the Gakuen Handsome series which would even have its own anime in 2016. Originally released as a demo on August 29, 2010 during COMITIA 93, a Tokyo doujinshi convention.

title: Catrophy Trail
description: Catrophy Trail is a light-hearted physics adventure game where you use teamwork and wits to solve physics-based puzzles, gather valuable loot, and collect gear for future expeditions.

title: Lucky Goal
description: Lucky goal offers an experience of a soccer game through a third-person view. Create or participate in an online match and show who is a better soccer player. A singleplayer adventure is waiting for you to improve your gaming skills.

title: Project Ozone 3
description: Project Ozone 3: A New Way Forward is a pack filled to the brim of mods ranging from tech to magic to even exploration. A Better Questing pack filled with "currently 1197" quests (if you include the reward system). Project Ozone 3 also supports pack modes as they become available (Normal, Titan and Kappa). Normal mode in PO3 will be "slightly" more difficult than Project Ozone 2's due to mod progression. There are still "simple" achievements after the main quests we just use Better Questing entirely.

title: Milton the Alien Guy
description:
Milton The Alien Guy is an adventure game set in a flying saucer where aliens have abducted Milton to study his strange eating habits.
Explore the saucer, cook some god-awful food, and escape the endless void of space!

title: SuperTotalCarnage!
description:
SuperTotalCarnage! is a fast-paced time survival game where you face endless enemies!
It is our brand new take on the new and popular auto-shooter genre. Inspired by great classics like Vampire Survivors and Binding Of Isaac, STC! will surprise you with thousand of enemies, destructible environments and huge bosses! Slay never-ending legions of monsters while running in circles!

title: Friday Night Funkin' VS Shaggy
description:
Shaggy, the most powerful being in the universe, has come to Friday Night Funkin'!

Using 0.001% of his power, he sings against you to test your strength.

title: Bombe
description: Minesweeper, but you only solve each situation once.

title: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
description: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

title: Truss
description: Developed for Haunted PS1's Madvent Calendar 3: Necrosis.

title: Sparkle Milla: Eight Genetic Abnormalities and a Blood Ghost
description: This game is a deduction game where you collect evidence from a murder scene to find the murderer. Eight boys and girls are admitted to the school. At the school, there is a crazy ghost named "Milla" who haunts and kills people.

title: Car Factory Tycoon
description: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

title: A Rum Tale
description: In this platform game you will embody a drunken pirate in search of a lost cargo of rum. But will you be able to face the challenges that will arise before you?

title: Fast Burger Simulator
description: Fast Food Shop Simulator Game. Make the best burger in the world.

title: Virtua Park the Fish 2: Sodatete Puku-puku
Coralina
description: An investigation through space and time in a retro RPG that blends different art styles.

title: Nothing_Matters
description: A short narrative 'point and click' adventure inspired by the real life experience of a struggling solo indie game developer. A story about everything and hence nothing at all. Discover what truly matters to you.

title: Mona and the Witch's Hat Deluxe
description: Mona and the Witch's Hat Deluxe is a homebrew game made for the Game Boy Color, and is a remake of the original Mona and the Witch's Hat from 2018. This "Deluxe" or "DX" version of Mona and the Witch's Hat features a brand new soundtrack, full color graphics, and new animations. It features the same four levels as the original version, and can be completed in about 20 minutes.

title: The Curse of The Wise Tree
description: Your task is to collect mushrooms that grow along the forest path. It would seem that everything is simple, but there are rumors that evil spirits in the form of MEMES are found in the forest. Therefore, you should look at both. Good luck!

title: Niveil: Red Riding Hood story
description: Old style fantasy platformer game.

title: Garten of Banban
description: Enter Banban's Kindergarten, and you're sure to make some friends. Explore the mysterious establishment and don't lose your life and sanity. Uncover the horrifying truth behind the place, but be careful, as you are far from alone

title: Stay Still
description: Stay Still is a first-person horror adventure based on Vietnamese culture. The gameplay is focused on storytelling, puzzles and avoiding dangerous threats & spirits hunting you. Solve various puzzles, watch your surroundings, and of course survive.

title: Legacy of Flan 4: Flan Rising
description: Don't be jelly! Be a brave hero, made from jelly, but still strong enough to defeat bad forces conquering something that doesn't belong them. You won't be fighting alone. For death and glory!

title: Five Nights at Konto's
description: Fnaf inspired fan game for the Streamer kontoletzplay made in RPG Maker2003 by Florx

title: Neon Invasion Earth
description:
A Space Invaders Clone with a Twist...

Following his escape from the Neon Space, Captain Rick Sims must now defend Earth from the evil forces of the Neon Galactic Empire...

Collect power-ups to help you defeat the enemy faster. with 35 levels of increasing difficulty... Featuring a cross-platform, Online Highscores system so you can challenge anyone in the world to beat your best score... Do you have what it takes to be Number 1?

title: Atlas Gate
description: Stranded on an island of paper, find your way off or stay and see it decay.

title: I.K.E.M.E.N Go
description: I.K.E.M.E.N Go is a remake of the I.K.E.M.E.N in Google’s Programming Language “Go”. It is an open source fighting game and game engine that supports M.U.G.E.N resources.

title: Evacuation
description: Evacuation is an unofficial story-driven add-on for Half-life 2, telling the story of an rebel who crashes on a helicopter in the woods. Having miraculously survived, the hero picks up a walkie-talkie and decides to escape from the forest, which was attacked by the Combine.

title: Bottle Cracks
description: Bottle Cracks is a party game where everyone is a bottle. Jump through chaotic levels without breaking! Play solo, online with up to 12 players, or with unlimited local players.

title: Assassin's Creed: Unity - Bastille Edition
description:
Paris, 1789. The French Revolution turns a once-magnificent city into a place of terror and chaos. Its cobblestoned streets run red with the blood of commoners who dare to rise up against an oppressive aristocracy. Yet as the nation tears itself apart, a young man named Arno will embark upon an extraordinary journey to expose the true powers behind the Revolution. His pursuit will throw him into the middle of a ruthless struggle for the fate of a nation, and transform him into a true Master Assassin.

The Bastille Edition contains a steelbook case, an artbook, an envelope with two lithographs, soundtrack cd and bonus missions "The Chemical Revolution" and "The American Prisoner"

title: Assassin's Creed: Syndicate - Rooks Edition
description:
London, 1868. The Industrial Revolution unleashes an incredible age of invention, transforming the lives of millions with technologies once thought impossible. Opportunities created during this period have people rushing to London to engage in this new world, a world no longer controlled by kings, emperors, politicians, or religion, but by a new common denominator: money.

Not everyone is able to enjoy the benefits of this boom, however. Despite fueling the engine of the British Empire, workers’ lives are little more than legalized slavery while the top few percent profit from their labor. Living poor and dying young, the lower class unite in protest as a new kind of family, gangs, who turn to a life in the underworld in their struggle to survive. A struggle, until watchful Assassins come to their side and re-ignite an age-old conflict involving London’s leaders that will echo throughout modern history, from the underground up.

Introducing Jacob Frye, who with the help of his twin sister Evie, will change the fate of millions in Assassin’s Creed Syndicate. Rise to rally and lead the underworld to break the corrupt stranglehold on London in a visceral adventure filled with action, intrigue, and brutal combat.

title: Pacman Cube
description: Play pac man, complete levels to complete the cube.

title: Sylvie Lime
description: Sylvie Lime is an exploration adventure platformer with absurd game mechanics, a funny and cute world, and a girls' love story told in secret rooms.

title: Reggie's Adventures: Part 1 - Escape From Paradise
description:
You play the part of 'Reggie Rich', an aristocratic playboy who crashes his helicopter and gets marooned on a tropical island. Local fisherman 'Randy Muffin' offers to take Reggie back to his yacht but only after completing a challenge, which luckily enough for Reggie is to seduce all the gorgeous Island girls!

However, it's not an easy task to charm the girls, so Reggie's travels will include gambling, playing the slot machines, solving cryptic puzzles, and lots, lots more......All set within spectacular locations including hot tubs, lap dancing club, casino, and you can even go to the movies! Can you help Reggie seduce all the sexy girls? If so, the rewards will be a treat for both Reggie and you!

title: King's Quest IV: The Perils of Rosella Retold
description:
"King's Quest IV Retold" is a point-and-click remake of the fourth chapter in Sierra's classic King's Quest series.

The game's story picks up immediately where "King's Quest III: To Heir Is Human" left off. As King Graham tosses his adventurer's cap to his children, he suffers a massive heart attack and is left on his death bed. It is up to his daughter, Princess Rosella, to retrieve a rare magic fruit that can heal her father, as well as save the land of Tamir from the evil fairy Lolotte along the way.

This remake introduces numerous improvements to the original game while staying faithful to its story and graphics, thus offering a new way to experience this classic adventure and making it more approachable for new players.

title: Scoot Hard DX: Daytime Drama Zero
description: From the minds behind Daytime Drama, the high-octane Scoot Hard DX: Daytime Drama Zero is the prequel to the 2018 cult classic. Very loosely based on Rainbow Factory by AuroraDawn, you play as Scootaloo, who must escape the Cloudsdale Weather Corporation and get her friends back – by kicking flank! With tons of humor, an array of equine enemies, huge levels, powerful weapons, a look and feel like something off mid-2000s Newgrounds, and full voice acting, it is a unique take on the retro shooter genre that could only come from Waffle Iron Studios!

title: Dormitabis
description: A horror fan game that could be much more scary than original five nights at freddy's

title: The Fantastic Game
description: An exploration game where you wander a grassy, eggy landscape.

title: Cat Life
description: Cat Life is an adventure and survival solo game, allowing you to explore a vast open world as a cat. A series of quests will lead you to solve the mysteries of this island, if you manage to face all its dangers!

title: Tiny Atolls
description: Tiny Atolls is a minimalist building strategy game. Build bridges across colorful islands, unlock new tiles, and complete quests to expand your world!

title: Matricon: Monopoly
description:
Part of the Matrikon city franchise. The story and action takes place in a local casino, buying out all the local gangs, companies and businesses, thereby creating a madness in their hands!

Actions take place in an era of crisis and the collapse of the Matrikon economy!

title: Evilmun Family: Season 5 water renewal Part 1
description: The flood has begun. Solve new puzzles with water!

title: Banana Bugs
description: Banana-eating bugs are ravaging the village food supply and you're the only monkey brave enough to take them on! Shoot ropes to wall off bugs and stop them in their tracks. Earn bananas to build up Monkeytown, play mini-games, and get valuable power-ups, like Coco Bombs and Hurricanes, to help fend off the hungry hordes.

title: Reditus: Ashes of Heremus
description: Condemned by the Reditus remnant to a vast desert prison, a father and son journey into the corrupted Heremus. Recruit robots, harness their cores, upgrade your gear, and fight to survive against relentless Reditus drones and twisted beasts in this story-driven 2.5D JRPG.

title: Which Naruto Character Are You?
description: A desktop simulator game about taking a Naruto character personality quiz.

title: Forge of Freedom: The American Civil War 1861-1865
description:
Forge of Freedom: The American Civil War 1861-1865 provides something for every strategy gamer. Control economic development, political development with governors and foreign nations, and use your military to win the bloodiest war in US history.
Forge of Freedom: The American Civil War 1861-1865 combines grand strategy with battlefield tactics in one game, putting you in command at every level of the Civil War, from the mobilization of your nation’s resources to the control of individual brigades during the fury of battle.

title: The Weight of a Soul
description:
In a world of arcane mysteries, a young doctor's apprentice unravels a conspiracy most grim.

The Weight of a Soul is a mystery-horror interactive novel inspired by IF classics like Blue Lacuna and Anchorhead.

title: Grooverland
description:
"Magic comes with a price. But on your birthday, all your expenses are paid. Welcome to Grooverland."

Grooverland is a large parser game that takes over two hours to complete. It is based on the works of author and programmer Chandler Groover, although it does not require previous knowledge of his games to play.

title: Belle-de-Nuit: Point-du-Jour
description: Return to the Belle-de-Nuit in this sequel to the 2021 swashbuckling hit!

title: Aska
description:
Lay claim to unspoiled lands and pave the way for a fierce Viking tribe. Craft the ultimate settlement solo or together with up to x3 friends. Trust in the Gods and the power of the Eye of Odin and summon intelligent NPC villagers to provide camaraderie and relief from the toils of survival.

In ASKA, strive to build a self-sustaining Viking tribe, working, crafting, hunting and fighting together. Command and organize intelligent NPC villagers, working and fighting alongside them.

title: Revue Starlight El Dorado
description: The first console game of the stage-themed multi-media franchise "Revue Starlight" is on its way!

title: Cubic Crush: Streamer Showdown
description: Come and show your skills in Cubic Crush Streamer Showdown! This 4D Tetris-style game is played in the rooms of your favorite Youtubers and offers different difficulty levels and missions to complete - use powerful powerups during the game to gain an advantage and advance even faster! Plus, in our interactive Twitch mode, your viewers can send you commands and help you succeed - unlock more rooms as you progress and become the king of Cubic Crush in this exciting challenge!

title: Hugo: Scylla's Revenge
description: Hugo: Scylla's Revenge (international title) is a PC-only video game originally developed by Krogh Mortensen Animation and published by ITE Media in 1999. It is the third of Hugo Christmas special games ("Wintergames"), the other ones being Winter Games and Hugo Saves Christmas.

title: Jianghu Survivor
description: This is a light casual game of roguelite with Chinese style. Fight your way out of the monsters, either alone or with a group of three or four friends. Play as different characters, form a unique Build game, defeat the final monster, enjoy killing monsters!

title: Haunted Houses
description:
Digital Eclipse re-imaged the Atari adventure classic in 3D and with 2-player co-operative play. This is a reimagined/sequel to Atari's Haunted House, being inspired by more modern takes of horror games, while retaining classic aspects of the original Haunted house featuring 4 new locations to explore.

Released as part of "Atari 50 Anniversary Collection" in 2022.

title: Yars' Revenge Enhanced
description: Yar's Revenge Enhanced is a remake of the original Yar's Revenge for the Atari 50 collection, adding a new coat of pain to the classic Atari 2600 shooter. Players can switch to the old-style presentation and gameplay at the touch of a button.

title: FNaF World: Update 2
description: Update 2, also known as Update 1.20, is a free expansion update and sequel of the main story for FNaF World, adding 8 new animatronics, 2 new areas, 4 minigames, 6 new hard-hitting enemies, and 9 new special attacks.

title: Streets of Rage 2: New Era
description: A fan-made port of Streets of Rage 2 to modern platforms. SOR2 was ported manually via reverse engineering to create the best version of the game ever!

title: Trophy Chaser
description: Help the Hero to collect all the trophys to be the master of the achievements! Trophy Chaser is a Rêtro platformer game where you have to collect the trophys to get the achievements, are you able to collect them all? Prove it in the gamer way!

title: FNaF World Simulator
description:
Welcome back to Animatronica!

Freddy has completed "the game", and gained an unfair amount of power. With his new powers, he'll take over Animatronica and destroy any enemies left in it.

It is now up to the so called "enemies" to stop Freddy before it's too late!

title: The Passenger
description:
When your eldritch existence is threatened by another unthinkable creature, you find yourself jumping dimensions to escape your ghastly fate. Safe for now, your moment of respite is short-lived as you realize you're stuck on Earth, trapped inside a dumb human larva, and with no clue of how much energy you'll need to leave this horrible place behind.

Twenty-six years later you're still stranded on an absurd planet, you have a mom and a sister, and a job delivering baked goods. Not only that, but the creature that almost ate you all those years ago never really stopped looking for you. However, there’s no way it will pinpoint your actual location… right?

Will you break free from your prison of flesh?

title: Goblin Slayer Another Adventurer: Nightmare Feast
description: Goblin Slayer Another Adventurer: Nightmare Feast is an upcoming tactical RPG game based on the dark fantasy light novel series Goblin Slayer, developed by Apollosoft and Mebius and published by Bushiroad Games.

title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation - Quest of Memories
description: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation - Quest of Memories is an upcoming RPG based on the fantasy light novel series Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation, developed by Lancarse and published by Bushiroad Games.

title: Macross: Shooting Insight
description: Macross Shooting Insight is an upcoming scrolling shoot'em up based on the mecha multimedia franchise Macross, developed by Kaminari Games and published by Bushiroad Games.

title: Elrentaros Wanderings
description: The dual life where Fantasy meets Reality begins! A brand-new action RPG, Elrentaros Wanderings!

title: Ginka
description: "Return to that summer with you..." Ryusei returns to the small island of his younger years, where time flows by gently, to spend a fairy-tale summer vacation with his childhood friend who was spirited away.

title: What in Hell is Bad?
description: What in Hell is Bad? is an adult defense otome game for mobile devices.

title: Fantasy Westward Journey
description:
Turn based MMORPG in China from 2003, based on a classic novel: journey to the west.
Had its peak concurrent player number of 2.71 million around its 10th birthday.

title: Ao Oni 3D
description: Unreal Engine 5 Remake of the "Ao Oni" RPG maker game.

title: Sessions
description: Sessions blends horror, action, and atmospheric exploration. The player takes on the role of a synthetic human in a dystopian world overrun by mysterious creatures. In this dark sci-fi story, you must face existential horrors and frightening creatures. It's a lonely and evocative game about exploring the unknown and discovering the horrors of the human condition.

title: University Tycoon
description:
University is awaiting you!

Start out your student career in the time-honoured England, meet friends and visit foreign countries as an exchange student in order to achieve your task to pass the famous master degree with "suma cum laude".

Choose between five characters, e.g. the nerd Jason, the pretty Lindsey or the ace Bobby and try to survive the hard student life.

title: Harvest Festival 64
description: Welcome to the town! Luckily for you just in time for the HARVEST FESTIVAL! Help your new friends with their preparations and enjoy your potentially cursed life!

title: Tiny Civilization
description: This is a historical simulation game that promotes the development of civilization based on the match-3 Game. You'll need to gather resources, use skills, discover new technology, and lead humanbeing through a 10,000-year journey to the cosmos.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location - Custom Night
description: Custom Night is a free content update to Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location.

title: Monopoly Madness: Dino City
description: Become the most famous real estate mogul of Dino City in the new Monopoly Madness DLC!

title: Waternet
description: Vircon32 port of Waternet, which is a multiplatform water pipe puzzle game written for old consoles and handhelds.

title: Formula 1 Game & Watch: Playdate Version
description: A Small Fictive Formula 1 Game & Watch style game with high score keeping.

title: Internet Reversi
description: Internet Reversi is a game pre-installed on Windows ME and Windows XP systems that features online play.

title: Chess is Stupid!
description: Shoot the Juicers.

title: Paradise Rescue
description: Your girlfriend has become ill, and you decide to help her by shrinking yourself down to microscopic size and entering her body. When you wake up, you find yourself on a colorful island populated by strange creatures who you play mini-games with to progress.

title: Fuji Golf
description: Fuji Golf is a golf sports video game released with Microsoft Entertainment Pack 3 for Windows in 1991. The object of the game is to play the round (18 holes) in as few strokes as possible. Factors such as wind are automatically generated, and the player plays against various computer-generated scores.

title: Sister Location: MA
description: Sister Location: MA is a troll game of Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location created by Scott Cawthon, claiming that Sister Location has a very dark story line and might not be suitable for children. Because of this, he said that he might work on the game for several more months to make the game and its story more appropriate for younger players. When the "mature" version was released, however, it turned out to be a hoax.

title: SuperTux: Octo's Levels
description: Octo's Levels is an addon pack for SuperTux. The pack includes original levels created by Florian octo Forster, alongside a few remakes of levels from Super Mario World and Super Mario Land.

title: The Karters 2: Turbo Charged
description: Get ready for the ultimate kart racing experience on Steam & Steam Deck! Inspired by Crash Team Racing, built with its own identity, advanced gameplay systems, tons of new features, and massive modding support for endless replayability!

title: You Are Being Watched
description:
It was just another ordinary day on the country road leading you back home. Who would have thought how a small coincidence can turn your life on the path of unnatural events…

Look for supplies, store them in your inventory, explore all the rooms, solve puzzles, unlock areas of the map, interact, and try to collect everything you find.

Experience survival horror like never before and remember - You are being watched.

title: You Have 293 Keys
description: You Have 293 Keys was made over the course of 24 hours. It features:

title: September 7th
description:
Do you believe in the existence of Christmas elves that appear on New Year's Eve and Christmas? If so, then most likely you have heard of the good elves. But imagine that there are still evil elves. They create madness and can come to you at any time if they get bored. They are watching you and testing you. Or maybe they just want to have fun. Will you play by their rules?

Dima is a graduate student. His family is planning a move. Finally, this day came on the seventh of September, Dima and his parents move into a new apartment. A few weeks pass and Dima receives a funny Christmas Elf doll as a gift. With her appearance, strange things begin to happen in the house.

title: Lichtreich: Willa
description: Lichtreich: Willa is a 2D horror game with strong story focus. As a detective which dealt the most with infamous "Viper", Alex is the best choice to check his mansion. You have to find out if there any people alive? There is no time to waste, you have to check it!

title: Hentai Room
description: Relaxing puzzles with beautiful girls. The perfect choice to calm down and improve your mood.

title: DongBeiZhiXia
description: DongBeiZhiXia (a summer in the northeast of China) is a free visual novel, which tells the story that the protagonist followed parents' wishes to make one's living in Shenyang, met two online anchors Huniu and Daojiang by chance, and experience affairs one after another with Shamate.

title: Bugscraper
description: Bugscraper is a solo or co-op roguelike shooter. As you climb toward your tyrannical boss's office, you'll battle floor after floor of enemies. Using a wide arsenal of weapons and upgrades, mow them down and aim for the top!

title: Arcade Paradise: Kung Fury - Street Rage
description: Kung Fury: Street Rage is the very first licensed game available as an in-game cabinet alongside the 35+ other games within Arcade Paradise

title: Those Who Crawl
description:
As you progressed through the cave tunnels, they slowly tightened until you could not even stand. Now, as you crawl, you wonder if you are not alone in the darkness.

Those Who Crawl is a short but tense horror game about crawling and climbing through tunnels.

Each hand is controlled individually with a unique crawling and climbing system. Use the mouse buttons or Q / E to move around, and Hold space to interact or use items.

The game is about a half-hour long and features AI monsters, environmental hazards, climbing, and crawling.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Heyawake
description: This is a progressive puzzle which you can comfortably enjoy working out using logic. "Heyawake" is a puzzle in which you fill in the spaces according to the rules. It's called "heyawake" ("split rooms") because the face of the board is divided into rooms. This puzzle first appeared in 1992, but a plethora of solutions have been developed, allowing for a very progressive puzzle. Each time you discover a new strategic move, your skills of solution will improve.

The Soul of War is an adventure role playing module inspired by the fantasy role-playing game Dungeons & Dragons.

title: Final Fight LNS Ultimate
description:
Final Fight LNS is a beat'em up that mixes concepts and movements from both this genre and the fighting genre. It has a revolutionary and new combo system based on "cancelling", which allows us to link special movements within others, thus being able to perform a very high number of hits. The game is also designed so that its difficulty decreases considerably as we learn and run this system, so the learning curve is steep. In other words, the game will reward us as we learn to deal maximum damage to enemies.

The roster of playable characters consists of 120 (114 + 4 hidden + 2 super hidden) characters, combining fighters from several of Capcom's most successful sagas such as: Final Fight, Street Fighter II, Street Fighter III, Street Fighter IV, Street Fighter Alpha, Cadillacs and Dinosaurs, Captain Commando, Alien vs Predator, Battle Circuit, Punisher, Knights of the Round, Warriors of Fate, Marvel vs Capcom and Capcom vs SNK. Despite the wide repertoire, each character is balanced and arranged so that the playable experience is optimal, we choose the character we choose and we have chances to finish the game without continuing with any of the 120 characters and in any of the game modes.

If its simplicity is reminding you of time-waster games, think again. Touch the Color is an arcade reaction time game that’ll work your mouse aim and take it to new heights. Build fortifications on different buildings or build your own base from scratch. There are plenty of build parts available for you to craft!

title: Snake Robot
description: Times are changing.

title: Starless Hotel
description: Find a way out in a weird 5-star hotel that loses a star every night

description: Lead one of four factions of your choice and defeat all your opponents in fierce card battles with real players from all around the world. Destroy your enemies, reinforce the power of your empire, and comprehend “The Art of War”!

title: Our Casual Battlefield

description: Do you like to search and find? Solve logical problems and at the same time participate in active actions? Then this game is just for you!

title: Poly Puzzle: Butterflies

title: Pixel Slayer
description: Idle RPG game with infinite fun and endless possibilities

title: Pip X
description: Pip X is a cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes.

title: Pinhi!
description: Endure your senses into a synth-like, hyper-casual, level-based oasis!

description: Play as the Phase Ninja and help him use his special abilities to defend nearby residential areas from an onslaught of enemies. Try to find the origin of this invading force and put a stop to it.

description: You are Idas, a woodcutter's son thrust into a medieval world of power and impotence, of beauty and corruption. Enter the world of Ringborn and immerse yourself in a captivating story realised through deep combat, beautiful graphics and impactful player choice.

title: Rogue Ship
description: Blast aliens, collect upgrades, and survive long enough to make it out in this sci-fi mashup of "Asteroid" and "Vampire Survivors".

title: Iaijutsu
description: In this retro action game, the player controls a mysterious ronin, navigating the rooftops and alleys of a rainy city as they are hunted by a team of elite assassins.

title: Image
description: Image is a first-person horror game. Explore haunted, ever-changing environments in an atmospheric, confused world and enjoy a truly terrifying gaming experience.

title: Indies's Lies: Alrayan Undertow
description: Once a united race of the Alrayan descent, Grayrock, Fireeyes and Irondust are now in constant conflict. Grayrock is home to the oldest knight army. Fireeyes has the most cutting-edge technologies. Irondust demonstrates a resolve of steel. Clashes are inevitable - Which nation will victory favor?

description: King's Hand is a turn-based, roguelike battler that fuses the strategy of chess with deckbuilding and a dash of chaos. Face increasingly challenging waves of tactical chess gameplay with a twist!

title: Kanji Drive
description: Supplement your Japanese practice with this arcade driving game. Learn common kanji, hiragana, words, and verbs while having fun. Go through flashcards effortlessly.

description: The devil arrives on earth on the night of the Day of the Dead and kidnaps the beloved princess Fifi, and it's up to the cowardly peasant Juan to save the princess and put an end to the Devil's evil. Overcome 7 levels full of monsters, obstacles, and traps that will try to stop Juan in his tracks!

title: I Won't Forget Hue
description: Disorganized and alone, a woman finds herself crafting new glasses in order to look at her own home with different shaded views. I won't forget Hue is a psychedelic thriller experience. You'll go searching for new lenses, try to figure out what is happening to her home and why she is all alone.

title: It Lurks
description: It Lurks is a survival horror game set in an infested sewer. Hunted by a relentless presence, you must recover scattered data tapes and piece together a way to transmit them topside. Every step brings you closer to escape… or into its grasp.

description: Guess the random sequence of glyphs with optional hints and alternate symbol sets.

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Cyber Pizzeria Set

description: A Twin Stick, Hack and Slash, Survive Enemy Waves game! Choose from different heroes, fight climactic enemy waves, level up, collect coins, fight against the endboss in three different levels and have fun.

description: Take your brain for a walk in Handshakes, a simple yet tricksy sokoban puzzle game. Guide two hands through puzzles designed to stump, not frustate, so that they may achieve their dream of a warm, firm handshake.

description: Your memory is fading. Things around your home keep changing; they are not what they appear to be. Find what is wrong, take pictures to restore your memory. Try to remember. Learn what you have forgotten, learn what has happened. It is not what it seems to be.

title: Defcon: Xenos

description: A fractured family, a lonely little girl, a mystery beyond the walls of dreams... Something is happening, and it doesn't seem to be good. Explore Molly Eleonor's nightmares, find the truth and, more importantly, do not die. Enjoy this new and scary adventure, you won't sleep again.

You will not see the dawn, but will you be able to sell your life more dearly?

This Game Is About Riddles and Mind Trick Questions .
Challenging Question that will trick your brain to get wrong answer.

24 wins, 3 manufacturers' titles, 2 drivers' titles… the Peugeot 206 left a big mark in its era and was driven by top drivers such as Marcus Grönholm and Gilles Panizzi.
With WRC Generations, you can get behind the wheel of this iconic car and experience the extreme sensations it was famous for.

With the addition of just one extra person you may set off an incredible chain reaction that helps you create a show that no other circus will be able to surpass. Will you battle with your current members? Or will you wait it out and try to recruit different ones? You will feel amazing when you make the right choices in this speedy card game!

title: Shieldmaiden: Remix Edition

Season 11 is included in the Year 3 Pass for SnowRunner.

Action! Support the production of an exciting action movie deep in the valleys of Scandinavia and help a ski resort prepare for the next winter season with 2 new trucks across 2 new winter maps.

Death, Destruction, Survival, Scavenge, Nature, Thrive, Conquer, Hunt. The Cenozoic Era

Highway Pursuit is a modern game taking its inspiration from a number of classic arcade games.

It's an action-packed 3d blast along roads filled with enemy agents -- but also with innocent civilians that you should protect at all costs.

Featuring diverse landscapes and scenery, a variety of enemy vehicles, multiple weapons, weather effects, radio communications from your HQ, 3d sound effects, configurable support for keyboard, joysticks and steering wheels, Highway Pursuit is a road trip you shouldn't miss!

description: Head to a hike to the old mysterious valley and explore the hidden beauty of untouched nature. Explore many unique locations and buildings set to rot by humanity a long time ago.

You just finished from your smoke break and ready to go back to your works.. And suddenly someone knocking on your apartment door.

You feels like this is a thousands time you met her. But, you can't tell why. Enjoy the cozy conversations with aroma of coffee and friendship between two souls in a weird little town where 'The Snow is Red'

title: Project Sail
description: Project Sail is an open world naval combat game set in a fantastical pirate world. Project Sail is a top down third-person arcade shooter with RPG and rouge-like elements. Discover unique locations, find hidden treasure, and battle against the pirate and royal navy factions.

title: Chestnut Grove
description: How do you go about your life when self-isolation has become the new normal? Chestnut Grove is based on my personal experience of quarantine and features 100% real documents and notices.

title: Cycle Chaser H-5
description:
Mysterious Aliens have occupied a scorched Earth. A lone pilot seizes the skies. What is it they're after?

Cycle Chaser H-5 is a horizontal arcade-style shoot-em-up. Burn through waves of impenetrable foes with a sleek arsenal of weapons. Defeat foes to harvest their energy, then activate the powerful 'Super Tatsujin' system for maximum power and defense!

title: The Tarkiff Transfer Incident
description: Most realities don't mix. Explore what remains of Tarkiff, the city you once called home and uncover what happened.

title: The Orchid's Edge
description: 'The Orchid's Edge' is a third-person Combat Action platformer where you play as Willow, a Dryad Spirit Reaper who defends the souls of the forest from being harvested by a kind of mechanical invader known as the Clunkers. Using her scythe The Wild Orchid, she protects the cycle of life and death in the forest.

title: Time Hoppers: The Silk Road
description: Time Hoppers: The Silk Road is a time-traveling, mind-expanding, action-adventure RPG for all ages! Embark on an epic journey through the Golden Age of the Silk Road and save real scientists who changed the world. The enigmatic evil Dr. Fasid has sinister schemes up his sleeve, though.

title: Kame Paradise
description: Kame Paradise, made by Yamamoto Doujin, is a Dragon Ball Hentai Game released on March 07,2018. It is part of a series of games made by Yamamoto. It is a R+18 Adult Hentai game featuring Dragon Ball Characters from Dragon Ball: Original, Z, GT, and Super.

title: Sands of Sodis
description: A dark fantasy ATB-combat JRPG, centered on open exploration, deep character interactions, intricate map movement and experimental combat mechanics. A fusion of the classic JRPG with nihilism and psychological, Lovecraftian horror.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Super Idol
description:
Boyfriend and Girlfriend are walking past the street to find a man advertising a liquid product.

They challenge him to a rap battle and the mod commences.

title: Spider-Man 4
description: Spider-Man 4 is an unreleased game for the Xbox 360, PlayStation 3 and PC that was based on the movie of the same name. It was meant to tie in with the cancelled fourth Spider-Man movie.

title: Kame Paradise 2
description: Kame Paradise 2, made by Yamamoto Doujin, is a sequel to Kame Paradise, being a Dragon Ball Hentai Game released on November 23rd, 2021. It is part of a series of games made by Yamamoto. It is a R+18 Adult Hentai game featuring Dragon Ball Characters from Dragon Ball: Original, Z, GT, and Super. This entry has character from Original, Z, GT, and Super, as opposed to the first game which mostly just focuses on characters from Original Dragon Ball.

title: Kame Paradise 3 Multiversex
description: Kame Paradise 3 Multiversex, made by Yamamoto Doujin, is the 3rd entry to Kame Paradise series, being a Dragon Ball Hentai Game released on January 13th, 2023. It is part of a series of games made by Yamamoto. It is a R+18 Adult Hentai game featuring Dragon Ball Characters from Dragon Ball: Original, Z, GT, and Super. This entry has character from Z, GT, and Super, as well as including Vomi/Android 21 from Dragon Ball FighterZ/Dragon Ball Super.

title: Dawn Apart
description: Mine resources, maintain a growing settlement of fortune hunters and defend it against the fierce native population. Or flip the script - and start a rebellion against the greedy corporation exploiting your new home…

title: Good Morning Is A Social Construct
description: Follow 15 year old Miya Nakamina's daily life in high school, where she finds herself increasingly lost and alien. Her only friend is growing up past her own pace, where does that leave Miya in the world? Completely alone forever, probably...

title: The Siege of Brimir
description: Play as an alien with super powers in frenetic battles against the army, destroy building, smash, fly and improve your character in order to annihilate humanity. They will try to stop you with their soldiers, F15, Giant mechas, warships or tanks, but it is going to be useless against your power.

title: World Racing 2: Champion Edition
description: World Racing 2 is back - revamped with a new look! The highly acclaimed racing spectacle makes the streets on your screen glow like never before! The new Champion Edition offers modding and Steam Workshop support. Are you ready to start the race of your life? The roads are waiting for you!

title: The Unfound Soul
description: Unlock the ultimate power in this turn-based roguelike adventure game, where you'll combine artifacts to create even more powerful ones. Collect over 1000 weapons, armor pieces, and artifacts as you vanquish your foes and rise to the top as the ultimate soul. Test your skills and strategic planning in intricate and deep turn-based combat as you navigate through challenging levels, discovering powerful artifacts and building your ultimate arsenal. With over 1000 items to find, the possibilities are endless.

title: The Palace of Unrest
description: Use poems to solve puzzles and escape the mansion with your life in this horror themed escape room game.

title: Metal Black: S-Tribute
description: Metal Black S-Tribute is port of Metal Black, a 2D a side-scrolling shooter arcade game by TAITO in 1991. This game is a reproduction of the home console version released by Ving in 1996. Play with improved controls and new features.

title: Elements Cubed
description:
Elements Cubed is a fast-paced bullet hell game where you REK Computer Viruses!

Run, Dive, and Dodge through perilous enemy fire and retaliate using an assortment of digital skills & abilities!

Go it alone, or play it with a friend in couch CO-OP Mayhem!

title: Drawing From Memory
description: Drawing from Memory is an online party game where you and 2-4 friends try to figure out what your most and least favorite characters look like by Drawing them from Memory.

title: Bustafellows: Season 2
description:
Bustafellows Season 2 is an otome visual novel developed and published by eXtend.

Everyone wants answers. Who is to blame? What went wrong? And what must the punishment be? To preserve the state of the world, everything is either black or white. Those who focus on the in-between will only continue to suffer.

title: Jackie
description: Play as Jackie, a lost rabbit, as she descends deeper into a strange world with even stranger sights. Uncover your dark past and traverse a land of endless joys and sorrows. When the time comes to accept your fate, you need to be ready for anything.

title: Oblitus Casa
description: Oblitus Casa is the culmination of Treasure Island's legacy and is the official final chapter in the FNaTI story. With new gameplay, better graphics, and atmospheric sound design, we promise to bring FNaTI to its ultimate conclusion. Welcome back to the island.

title: Grizzly's
description: This is a fan game of Five Nights at Freddy's that is a remake of the game named "Devious Minds" which was released in 2019.

title: Bondee's Barnyard: Safety Violation
description:
The year is 2004, from inside the cow animatronic, Kou, you must defend yourself from a barrage of haywired animatronic characters.

And if that wasn't enough, you must avoid the camera systems sightline to not awake any suspicion with the security guard. If you're seen moving around, shuting doors, the guard will give Kou a remote electric shock, killing the child in the process...

The game is split into "hours" instead of the regular "nights" becasue why would you wanna stay?

With hand drawn minigames and 2 unlockable modes, you wont be starving for content at Bondee's barnyard!

title: Donkey Kong City
description: Donkey Kong takes a nice stroll through the city.

title: Garten of Banban 2
description: Continue the story of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve deeper into the bizarre establishment where the place was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents, all while uncovering the truth behind the place…

title: NFT Museum
description: You are the proud owner of NFT, but there is nowhere to display them in a nice environment? Get N.F.T Museum, load a copy of your NFT, and place them in a museum! You can also import files from your computer.

title: The Legend of Doom
description: The Legend of Doom is a total conversion for DOOM that seeks to faithfully recreate the original NES world of Hyrule!

title: Ever17: CrossOver Impression
description:
The action takes place two months after the events of "Ever17 ~the out of Infinity~".
Takeshi's returned to it's normal, peaceful course. In a quiet and measured life burst hot summer, however, is not bringing anything new in it.
However, this daily routine collapsed after a strange incident. It all started with the fact that in a nearby street, was found dead of a woman with signs of violent death. The air at the scene soaked unusual smell of rot ... from the decaying corpse. In the chest - a huge hole, and internal organs turned out. Strange murder suddenly roused harmonious life of the city. This event has attracted the attention of Sara, and she decided to conduct their own investigation. "Why do not we organize a duet !?." This is the phrase Sara identified developments. So, the duo Ninja-Detective got its birth. In the process of searching for them will be new facts of this mysterious case, and then the secret will be revealed. What unites this event from the past and present heroes? ... It was a period of time, slightly changed the course of the boring summer vacation.

title: Something Nefarious Below
description: This is a FNAF styled game where you need to clean a ritual that took place, all while you feel someone is there with you. Do your job, pick everything up, and leave.

title: Spellzone
description:
Spellzone is an RPG where the player controls a team of heroes who explore Tulneau Island. While this game uses a standard turn-based battle system, some tactical approaches may be required in order to defeat enemies.

Most in-game action takes place in the forest areas of Tulneau island, but you will also travel through deep underground passages, mines, rural areas, and cities.

title: The Branch
description:
