The Branch is a ‘slice of life’ documentary looking at the staff who work at the local high street bank.

In tonight’s first episode we meet branch manager - Clinton Meeks. Clinton’s obsession with currency is preventing him from ever loaning the bank’s money to anybody! In charge of the Bureau de Change is xenophobe - Mildred Pew. An elderly woman who’s only interested in the GBP and wants to get rid of all other currency. Then finally there’s body builder, branch security and delivery driver - Derek Armageddon, who’s suffered a severe spinal injury since using the vault as his personal gym. For these 3 people - currency is their life.

Tune in now!

The Branch is a simple narrative driven experience. Meet the characters and play out their day to day activities. There is no winning or losing, just doing. Have fun!

title: The Fickle Hands of Fate
description:
The Fickle Hands of Fate is a short point and click adventure game

Fate is finalizing her last recording in the steeple of an abandoned church in a village she is about to leave. Then, off to another city and another recording: her search is not over yet.

title: The Field Trip Murders
description:
"The Field Trip Murders" is a "serial killer-themed" survival horror.
A simple school trip turns into a nightmare when a stranger decides to join in!"

You play as "Mia", a high school girl, on a trip with her friends and teachers. Mia's group arrives at the cabin later than the rest, but when they reach their destination, something seems off? do you care to find out what happened?

title: The Frozen Shore
description: Harry lives a simple life. Every morning he wakes up and takes his little boat out fishing. This morning however, he awakens to find that the whole coastline has been covered in snow! Will he still be able to take his boat out of the harbour for his daily fishing trip?

title: The Garden of Hades
description:
The Garden of Hades is a surreal first-person adventure in which you have to save the soul of a woman held by Hades, the ancient god of the dead, by navigating five very different settings: a little girl's dream, a young woman's psychedelic trip, a comic book journey into space, a pack of Tarot cards in a puppet theatre, and a detective story concerning a China
plate.

There are many challenges that you must overcome before the final confrontation with Hades himself. If you dare, step into The Garden of Hades!

title: Undertale: Kindred Spirits
description:
Undertale: Kindred Spirits is an Undertale fangame that tells the story of Batty and Mel, who possess the purple and blue souls respectively!

Hiding from the Underground's Royal Guard, their journey takes many twists and turns, ultimately challenging their partnership along with whether the food is actually good - down here in the underground.

title: Friday Night Trepidation
description: Enter Friday Night Trepidation where you rap battle your way through infamous creepypasta's...

title: Bad Pixels
description:
8-Bit first person shooter set in the old west! Have you ever wondered what a FPS game would look like in 8-bit? It's gotta look bad, right?

Bad Pixels is a gritty, hoodlum-shooting, gristle-chewing, law-avoiding retro style FPS. As Sheriff in this reckless retro environment, you must round up a team of deputies to help you flush out wrong doers, cash-in on wanted contracts and restore the peace.

title: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
description: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a Monster Collector RPG set in the wonderful land of Talea. Trey, who has mysteriously lost his memories, decides to set on a journey after a particular event. His only guiding light will be a mysterious desire... but will that be true?

title: Heist Kitty: Cats Go a Stray
description: Work for the Meowfia or work for the Purrlice, it’s your choice. Drive cars, scale buildings, steal, get into back-alley fights, or rob banks. Bring your friends to have a crew!
The fate of a lost wallet is in your hands. He is all alone in this cruel world of wealth. Embark on an unforgettable journey, to fulfill the dream of all wallet in the world - be full again.

title: Retro Space
description:
In this space shooter game your goal is to destroy all the invaders and get the best score.
Inspired by a famous game (Space Impact), Retro Space has 8 levels and 8 bosses.
With a more colorful and modern look, you will remember what it was like to play on an old cell phone.

title: Graceward: Complete Edition
description: On the run for her life, expelled from a dying city into haunted country, Renee has no choice but to befriend whomever she can- and kill everyone else. In Graceward, all things finish packed down in dark earth.

title: RAM: Random Access Mayhem
description: RAM: a top-down roguelike shooter with no player character. Seize control of diverse robotic enemies, turn them against each other in frantically paced combat, and fluidly swap to fresh hosts as old ones collapse into smoldering rubble.

title: Biters
description: A pixel side-scrolling shooter against zombies.

title: Xanniban
description: Evil has been unleashed. Don the Trespasser's suit as you dash across facilities, manage resources, and confine hostile machines to change the fate of humanity. Lure your foes into containment as a grim epidemic festers beneath the surface...

title: JR's: Enter the Flipside
description: JR's: Enter The Flipside is an upcoming official full 3D remaster and expansion to the all-around investigation type FNaF fan-game JR’s. Each night, a select bunch of animatronics becomes haunted, and it's your job to weed out which ones are haunted, and which ones aren't. Search for clues and hints throughout the nights, in order to lead you to who is possessed. In your downtime, explore The Barrens, a limbo between life and death to gain more insight into the story and world.

title: The Banshee
description: It's a dark dreary night, being driven away from sleep by the sound of thunder and slashing rain, until you are compelled out of bed due to some mysterious sounds...

title: The Crypt Terror
description: The town of Sherdone is cursed and you are sent down to rid them of the evil.

title: The Curse of Rabenstein
description: "We should try to find a place to stay for the night. The horses need a rest." Those were the coachman's last words before he disappeared without a trace. Lost deep in the Black Forest, you soon find out that some things should remain buried forever.

title: The Descent
description: The Descent, a horror walking sim in Rockwell Mine, immerses players in miners' harsh life and unsettling mine encounters. Play as an investigator uncovering hometown mysteries

title: Tristia: Legacy
description: 20 years after its initial release on PC in July 2002, Kogado Studio’s simulation game makes its debut on Switch. While the graphics have been overhauled for the modern era, Eeji Komatsu’s cute and sexy illustrations live on. Experience the origin story and roots of the long-running Tristia series.

title: The Hole in the Cabin
description: After running out of gas, you take refuge in a cabin in the middle of the forest.

title: Scout
description:
Scout is the ambitious son of a well known adventurer. His father explored lost places and donated any treasures he found to let the world see it. However, there had been one treasure he never managed to locate and retrieve: The golden hazelnut of an ancient squirrel temple. Everything he found out about it had been written down in his diary which Scout years later recovered and further researched and eventually located the temple. Now he needs your help to explore the it's secrets and show the world his father's life's work!

'Scout' is a short and compact, atmospheric adventure game, mainly focusing on creating a harmonic environment and nice, simple graphics rather than complex gameplay and features. The goal is to encourage the player to take their time while playing, stop occasionally and just have a look around instead of rushing through it, while still enjoying this ride!

title: The Hospital
description: Embark on a horrific journey of discovery; unearth a buried past.

title: Shrine of the Spirits
description: The demon army is invading and the Goddess is in danger! At the most critical moment, you lead many heroes, equipped with artifacts, to fight for the Goddess in a dark fantasy world! Together with your friends, fight against the demon army and become a legend of the Pantheon!

title: Let's School
description: This is a casual school-building game, you are entrusted by your old headmaster with the glorious task of reviving your alma mater. As the new principal, you will not only need to build a stylized school, but also train teachers, recruit students, run clubs, create your ideal personalized academy.

title: Stewart the Fox
description: Join Stewart the Fox on an epic adventure through four challenging levels filled with obstacles, enemies, and two boss battles. As you collect hidden items to help Stewart emerge victorious in this action-packed platformer game.

title: Maximum
description: You control an athlete whose task is to do flips back and forth. The game will be over if you land on your head. More flips in a jump - more final points.

title: White Water
description: Defeat the enemy as quickly as possible

title: Rougle
description: Rougle is the classic game of Wordle with a mix of rogue-like elements, that increases in difficulty as you succeed. As you play, you will gain abilities that will increase your chances of finding the word while the difficulty increases and you challenge enemies that will attempt to stop you.

title: Sua
description: Sua is a rather dark adventure game. This game was made by RPG Maker MV. The game was created by referring to the history of South Korea. I think there will be difficulties in encountering neutral or hostile characters. Everyone, try to escape with the girl.

title: Far Far Away
description: Fast Paced Arena Combat with stylized Graphics. With Two game mode -Battle Mode -Puzzle Mode

title: MidnightKing
description: Strengthen, Fight, Explore. Use spells, weapons, and enhancements to create your unique playstyle. Explore to fights bosses/enemies from elemental origins and uncover secrets of the world of Vathenic.

title: Shiitake Showdown
description: The showdown between Snakes and Shrooms rages on in this high action first person arena shooter. Use your control over the elements and your experience with a gun to show up your friends and slay your enemy's.

title: Dyestributor
description: Dyestributor is an indie puzzler with both simple and complicated mechanics that combine to make fun levels! You can perfect your gameplay to earn trophies or make and play custom levels in this relaxing (but admittedly difficult) puzzle game!

title: The Hunt for the Red Cthulhu
description: Underwater Exploration shooter (You know, That sub level in Super Mario Land), made to GBJAM 4.

title: NSFW Solitaire
description: Solitaire collection with XXX card sets. You can play it with one hand...

title: Remember U
description: Even if it is a short moment, please remember me!

title: You're Fired! Revenge!
description: Office Destruction Simulation Game "You're Fired! Revenge!" Fired from your job, you destroy the Office into a mess to get revenge.

title: Zombie World Pixel
description: Zombie World Pixel is a top-down survival shooter. The goal of the game is to survive in a small town and find all the necessary parts in order to fix the car.

title: Backrooms: The Game
description: Backrooms is a creepypasta that contains randomly generated office rooms that seem endless. The walls are mono yellow in color. It is also an eternal paradox.

title: Demon Invasion: Endless
description: Demon Invasion: Endless is a tower defense game with endless challenges and tons of talent to explore. You will need to plan your tactics and build defensive towers to repel endless demons. Keep challenging and gaining resources to build your unique talent tree.

title: Korea Dynasty
description: This game is a 3D open world survival exploration game that survives in the Korea Dynasty. Players Begin with slaves, change their status in Joseon, survive, and escape. Once free, travel around the country, explore hundreds of ruins, hunt, and collect what you need to survive.

title: SpaceDog
description: "SpaceDog" is a 2D arcade game about open space, where the player controls a spaceship and collects scattered astronauts, refueling along the way and continuing his flight, and most importantly - do not forget to properly land the ship on the surface of the earth at the end!

title: Elemental Raiders
description: Assemble your team of Heroes, choose from hundreds of skills, and unleash them to defeat your opponents! Elemental Raiders is a fast-paced, strategic hero battler that will challenge your tactical prowess. Join the fight & save Runaria!

title: 100 Keys to Your Heart
description: Figure out a way to get the correct key for every door in this sweet Puzzle Platformer game.

title: Gemstones
description: Casual Arcade-Puzzle game, where you move gems around to pair them together! Relax and get the highest score possible, earning cosmetics along the way.

title: Overrun Survivors
description: Overrun Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelite game that throws players into the middle of hordes of aliens and asks them to fight tooth and nail in order to survive. Play through different alien planets and feel powerful knowing that you're the only one who can save the day!

title: Grand Theft Auto: Alien City
description:
Replaced almost all models of pedestrians and vehicles. More than 60 missions, more than 60 race tracks and much more await you.

The modification is positioned as a trash frenzy. Therefore, do not be surprised by the stupid walks of pedestrians, new animations, the appearance of maniacs with shotguns on the streets, the opportunity to play basketball in a car, play the guitar, get high and many other gaming gadgets.

title: Mousey
description: Retro style 3D-platformer about collecting cheese.

title: Endless Space: Definitive Edition
description: Endless Space - Definitive Edition includes all the expansions and updates released for the game (including Endless Space Disharmony).

title: Hoglands
description: Hoglands is a dynamic strategy game with RPG elements and beautiful hand-drawn graphics set in a gloomy medieval setting. You will plunge into the adventure of a noble boar trying to protect his kingdom from the hordes of the undead and find the cause of the spreading plague. You have to build defenses to repel night attacks and collect resources during the day. Also don't forget about sorties to destroy the sources of the plague that turns your subjects into flesh-hungry monsters. Do you have the skill and courage to face Count Porkula himself?

title: The Mansion of Evil
description: The Mansion of Evil is a short funny game inspired by the old classic survival horror games.

title: Bargain Invaders
description: Fight your way through space and avoid beeing blown to bits.

title: Eastern Europe Train Sim
description: The best way to visit a country is to go where cars don't go.

title: WWE 2K22 SuperCharger
description: WWE 2K22 SuperCharger puts the biggest Legends in the WWE universe in your hands. Unlock ALL WWE Legends available at launch, including The Ultimate Warrior & "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. Access arenas so real you'll be saying “ohhh yeahh” like Macho Man Randy Savage.

title: Postmouse
description: Join Postmouse on their very first journey to deliver mail in a treacherous world unfit for a tiny mouse. Explore the ruins, meet charming characters and solve puzzles on your way through an abandoned mansion in this free, student-made adventure - all in one small mouse-sized package!

title: Disgusting Puzzle
description: Disgusting Puzzle is a puzzle game designed for people over 18 years old. The game is very simple, you have to collect a picture, which consists of 20 elements. With successful assembly a button will appear with the transition to the next level.

title: Fullybroken: Way Home
description: A roguelike shooter set in a post apocalyptic world, with dynamic narrative happening along your journey. Your goal is to go back home to your wife and kids. But the journey back home is perilous and full of danger. Be careful, your actions and choices along the way could leave you dead.

title: Love Quest
description: Embark on a quest to find your sweetheart. Talk to girls, avoid those pesky trolls and play videogames. A dark comedy with a blend of environmental storytelling, stealth and 2d platforming.

title: Adventure's Pixel World
description: Face goblins, trolls, bats, giant golems, spiders, angry chickens, dangerous traps and much more to complete levels that get more and more challenging. Collect as many candies as you can to unlock stronger characters. Attention: Only legends will succeed!

title: Menhera Girls Ensemble: Needy Girlfriends
description: Too much heavy love at all costs. Life with mental girls If you want to be loved to death by someone. Or if you want to experience this at least once, your wish will come true.

title: Suzy and freedom
description:
Suzy and freedom is a short adventure game made for RMN’s 2013 All Hallows’ Eve Event. Theme: Non-fiction horror. It is inspired by a real life crime that happened in Brazil.

On October 31st 2002, a couple was found dead in their bed. What first appeared to be a burglary followed by murder left too many unusual traces, and the police soon figured that whoever did it was probably someone familiar with that house. Less than a week of investigation revealed that the murder was planned by the couple’s own daughter, with the help of her boyfriend and his brother.

The game tries to reenact this story from the perspective of various characters involved. Each scene is focused on a different character, and uses a different style of gameplay to represent his motivations and goals.

Suzy and freedom is NOT, however, an attempt to recreate the original story in a completely faithful and exact fashion.

title: Zoo Animals
description: Zoo Animals is a 2001 edutainment game released by Wise Owl.

title: Apploid: Ballfare
description: A casual multiplayer sports game that features a combination of rugby and dodgeball elements with a grappling hook mechanic.

title: Rei
description: A free supernatural high school romance visual novel by sonnet009.

title: Dagon Ball Super: Lost Episode
description:
Dagon Ball Super: Lost Episode is part of a series of Dragon ball Hentai games made by Yamamoto. It is a R+18 Adult Hentai game featuring Dragon Ball Characters in this specific case, focusing on Broly and Cheelai, and their adventures.
Let's just say that, Saiyans love strong women, and Cheelai loves strong saiyans especially one who's constantly with her without his shirt.

title: Let's Pet Pets
description: Pet pets to gain Pet Points. Pet Points purchase Helping Hands. Helping Hands give you Pet Points every second. Each Helping Hand can be upgraded to give you more Pet Points. Pet Points buy Items. Items are unlocked by completing Quests. Items give you effects. Quests let you buy more pets.

title: Gunslinger Nova
description: A top-down, 2d space-shooter that pits the user against swarms of alien ships from other dimensions. Destroy all enemies and portals as fast as possible. Battle increasingly tougher enemies through 40 Campaign levels and Endless Mode!

title: Super Kids Racing: Mini Edition
description: Super Kids Racing: Mini Edition offers wide variety of challenges which involves 5 different seasons with many different types of vehicles to choose from. Players will love to complete these challenges with their friends in split-screen multiplayer mode.

title: Forest of Relics
description: Use the Run / Jump / Hanging / Paragliding to pass through various obstacles and obtain treasures. Spinel, the guardian of the ruins, is testing you.

title: Black White Bear
description: An interacting story about the life journey of a strange colored bear.

title: Our Little Chase
description: Become the Executioner and hunt down the traitor. Build up your army, manage your inventory and engage in real-time combat to defeat your enemy.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Character - Shingo Yabuki
Kitten Kingdom
description: Join adorable kittens in Kitten Kingdom, a 2D platformer game with engaging gameplay, cute graphics, and an amazing soundtrack. Explore a vast and colorful world, collect money, and navigate challenging obstacles. Escape the monotony of everyday life with this charming game for all ages.

title: Necrodemic
description: Necrodemic, is a Free to Play survival-based thriller. Defeat zombie bears to earn essence. Essence can be used to purchase more powerful weapons, ammo, and perks that increase players' chances of survival. Rank in daily competitions and win loot box prizes and a daily leaderboard that rewards players!

title: Angkara: The Horde
description: Enter the world of Angkara: The Horde, a horde-mode wave survival game set in a mystical mythological realm inspired by Southeast Asian culture and mythology. Survive as long as possible on the Arena - or earn a heroic death in battle!

title: PK Girls
description: Your face is my strength to defeat other girls.

title: What is Snowman Made of?
description: An atmospheric mini game that let's you explore a snowcapped yard in which you build your very own snowman.

title: Hidden Post-Apocalyptic 4 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: I Wanna Lockpick
description: I Wanna Lockpick tells the strange story of a girl's trip to an abstract world made of keys and doors. Or, well, I'd like it to, but really the keys and doors are the main focus here. It's a puzzle game! Assume the role of the reserved protagonist, Lily, and traverse many different abstract (and maybe beautiful?) landscapes, solving puzzles along the way. The main concept of the game is to bring colored keys to doors of the matching color, however new mechanics are introduced in each new world, with each getting progressively more unhinged and terrifying than the last.

title: Friend or Foe
description: Stranded on an island all alone. As you try to find a way home, you come across a peaceful wildlife. Build, explore, befriend the animals or tear it apart and suffer the consequences of your actions.

title: Beventlaed
description: Beventlaed is a singleplayer Touhou puzzle fangame in which you have to connect strings of three identically colored UFOs. Red colored UFOs extend your life meter, blue UFOs increase you score multiplie and the green ones intrease your Bomb meter, which helps you get rid of glass UFOs (which normally can only be gotten rid of by connecting adjacent UFOs).

title: Dyztopia: Post-Human RPG
description: It's a game about quitting your job

title: Endless Stars
description: The story takes place in the distant future. You will play a captain of a star ship and go into deep space. You need to manage your resources carefully. In the game, you can investigate the outliers of various planets, discover the wonders of the universe or learn the stories of lost civilizations.

title: Epic Race: The Stadium
description: Let's challenge winding tracks in a stadium.

title: String Along
description: Fun and relaxing arcade game, you control two dots connected by a piece of string. Dodge and capture enemies for as long as you can. Each level is slightly more challenging than the last, how far can you make it?

title: Love's Crescendo
description: On a cold winter day, Valerie and Cadence are brought together through their shared love of music. Determined to hear more of the talented pianist’s tunes, Valerie seeks Cadence out in hopes of making something beautiful. Little did they know that their composition would blossom into something more…

title: Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods
description: A group of thieves have found their next gig: a museum holding the "Amulet of the Gods," a mysterious artifact said to contain godlike power inside of it. It's sitting there, just asking to be stolen. With law enforcement on the prowl, will the crew's leader, Orlando, lead them to riches or ruin?

title: Silence Falls
description:
Shateiel, angel of silence has come to lay the world to rest~

Made in 3 days for Mini Jam 119: Heaven².

title: Old Tunnel
description: Old Tunnel — combines tough real-time battles with an automatic runner and platformer. Each of your skills has a cooldown, so you will have to fight in difficult conditions using ingenuity. And all these underground monsters are trying to tear your adventurer to pieces!

title: Bus Simulator: Car Driving
description: You have to be a great public bus driver in this bus game simulator.

title: Temple and Secrets
description: Temple and Secrets - 3D, a game in which you, being a treasure hunter, will look for precious items

title: Stories From the Cores
description: In this entertaining and educational game, players analyze evidence from under the ocean floor to unlock dramatic stories.

title: ASU
description: The beginning of an exciting MMORPG.

title: Rattenkönig
description: Rattenkönig is a Brazilian folklore inspired cosmic horror adventure where you take a boat trip through the mangroves of Brazil in search of a fabled rat temple.

title: Re: Rem Plus
description: Emilia, Roswaal, and Ram all left the Roswaal's Mansion, and now only you and Rem are left to look after it. What will happen when two lovers are given so much time to spend alone together?

title: Waste Eater
description:
After a global revolution dealt a final death blow to the world's crumbling industries, researchers and activists were left to pick up the pieces of their planet's ruined ecosystems. Their solution was simple: they turned themselves into pollution-eating mutants.

Now, over half a century later, the rivers are blue again and the birds have learned new songs. A beautiful world is stepping out of the husk of the old.

And the last waste-eater is waiting to die.

title: Red Amazon
description: Red Amazon is a four-minute narrative game seeped in atmosphere. The player controls someone shacked up in a forest cottage when danger approaches.

title: Oblivion Eagle
description: A light-gun game where you shoot and destroy enemies that launch colored attacks. Shoot their blue attacks before they hit the screen's edge, while dodging their red attacks before they hit your crosshair. Shoot blue, dodge red. That's the name of the game.

title: Retail Wars
description: Retail Wars is a friendship-ruining 4 player couch competitive party game. Pickup and throw anything in the store to serve customers and knock out your friends in the fight to become the coveted employee of the month!

title: Chasmal
description: Chasmal is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Descend into a ruined machine using powerful items to overcome foes and reach the bottom of the depths.

title: UnrealGundy
description: Welcome to UnrealGundy, a 3D platformer made by drevil1200. You play as "Gundy", a fictional character whose mission is to locate a gun, and fight any enemies along the way until you get to the boss. Be prepared for a fight at the end where only the most talented gamers will win!

title: The Catacombs
description: The "Catacombs" is a found footage game that plays through the perspective of a VHS camera showing a person venturing deep into the Catacombs of Paris. After exploring far into the maze that lives under Paris the player begins to feel they're being followed.

title: The House the Dead Built
description:
Set after a breakdown of your car, you decide to go find help which leads you to a nearby house. Inside, you discover that experiments are being completed on people transforming them into horrible creatures.

Trapped & with seemingly no way out, you must descend further into the house, uncover the truth & escape with your life.

title: The Legacy of Castle Terroretra
description:
A point and click/puzzle adventure game.

The third and final game in the Castle Terroretra trilogy by Reldni's Troy Scott, this game laid the groundwork for Vinnie's Tomb.

title: The Man, the Alien, and the AI
description:
This is the story of a young woman who comes across an extraterrestrial AI. The AI's entire function is to slowly rewrite the mind of whoever it has bonded to. The only ones who could separate them are on a distant planet called Valley 7. Now this woman must get to Valley 7 and separate the AI from her mind. But the AI seems to have become quite intrigued with her. And there's that dashing alien rogue hunting her down. And their childhood friend who keeps following her everywhere.

What a mess she's gotten herself in to!

title: The Museum
description: A content creator enters the cursed Museum for views, but finds something watching. Solve twisted puzzles, survive a ghost’s wrath, and choose your ending in this survival horror tale.

title: Scary Turnaround
description: While walking in the mountains, you fall into a cave. There is practically no light in it, you will have to find your way out of it by exploring the abandoned rooms of what was once a laboratory. As you explore, you'll need to find the key that will open the door to your freedom.

title: Mystery Solitaire: Grimm's Tales 7
description: Magic or reality? Adventure or everyday life? The world of the Brothers Grimm fairy tales gives an unambiguous answer!

title: Dreamland coffee
description: Du Qing, the heroine, opened a cafe in a foreign country alone after the adventure of Wonderland Lovers. A new story began when she took in a little boy who lingered outside her door on opening day...

title: Signal Maze
description: This story is about a corporation named RavenTech, set in the near future. R.O.O.T.

title: Vradark's Revenge
description: “Vradark's Revenge” is a fantasy game in the Action RPG genre.

title: Agni Fighter
description: Agni Fighter is a vertical scroll flight shooting game with future technology pictures. In the game, the player will control a fighter to fight over the city.

title: Kong Hero
description: ‘Kong Hero' is a 2D platform jumping game with cartoon style. The player controls a cute little monkey through many difficulties and finally reaches the destination.

title: Aeolus Fighter 2
description: 'Aeolus Fighter 2' is a vertical scroll flight shooting game. The player controls the main character's fighter to fight with the enemy in the universe.

title: The Legend of Herobrine
description: The Legend of Herobrine is a mod designed for modern versions of Minecraft that aims to add Herobrine to the game with many new gameplay features while also fitting in with vanilla gameplay and keeping the scary theme surrounding Herobrine.

title: Avoid the Rain 2
description: This is an agile parkour game. You can dodge quickly to avoid raindrops falling from the sky and go to the designated place.

title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 14 - Collector's Edition
description: Help run Pinecreek Hills and Puerto Rico's Tropical Rainforest Parks

title: Sakura Trick
description: The story follows Haruka Takayama and her relationship with her highschool friends, especially Yuu Sonoda. What will happen to them now that they are second year students, and will they be able to continue to hide the relationship they share?

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: Mercedes-Benz Remastered DLC
description: Mercedes-Benz Remastered includes 5 licensed Mercedes-Benz cars: Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Gullwing (W198), Mercedes-Benz 560 SEC (W126), Mercedes-Benz 500E (W124), Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG (C197), Mercedes-Benz 280 SL Pagoda (W113).

title: Not Born to be King
description: Not born to be King is a simulation game where you embody a medieval king and try to lead your kingdom to success. Face a large variety of events, build a strong economy, and make the right decisions to prosper in this ruthless world.

title: Eternal Fidelity
description: Evil people set a bee on the king's daughters. The princesses, enlisting the support of the court knight, will be saved. The knight's vow will not allow him to retreat and he will save them all.

title: Air Attack VR
description: Arcade avia/auto simulator. Complete various missions, controlling a fighter in the sky and an armored vehicle on the ground. Win air and ground battles, capture enemy bases, improve available vehicles, and thrive in this action-packed game.

title: Stellaris: First Contact
description: You are not alone! The galaxy is vast and full of wonders, but it’s also full of alien empires you’re going to encounter, whether you’re ready or not. First Contact offers a set of new origins and mechanics that give players the chance to tell stories about their civilizations’ early encounters with visitors from the stars — ones that may not have come in peace!

title: Mad Miner
description: Mad Miner is a mining game where you try to survive in a new order where world life is trapped underground.

title: Toyland Racer
description:
Razer, Spacer, Humpty Dumpty, Tubby and Freddy Banana are five friends organizing a tournament on 10 wacky tracks placed in 5 different worlds, in order to determine who is the fastest inhabitant of their charming world.

The player slips into the role of one of these merry friends. Every driver has a different, fantasy vehicle, which differs in acceleration, traction and weight from the other drivers' cars. Race through lovely hills, villages, and ghostly woods. Collect bonus weapons and options like bombs, rockets, jump, and turbo boost. The physics engine is enabled for crazy stunts and wild crashes.

title: Mr. Tiny Adventures
description: Mr Tiny is a single worker to whom the spell of a witch has caused him to become the size of an insect. Drag your 30 grams of weight through various scenarios, where any single and common object can be a deadly enemy. You need to finish 9 levels of the game to get all the talismans to help you break the spell of the witch and restore your normal size. Mr Tiny, the great lover of beer, is depending on you. Drive through large areas of the kitchen, the pipes, the garden, the street... till the witch house ( your neighbor) Avoid the enemies that come your way, You can kill them as well as jump over them like in other games. Move objects to access to different higher places, which before he had to crouch down to get to. See how you can change the life of a single person in an extreme situation.

title: Crawlspace 2
description: You saw an ad about someone needing help fixing their ventilation system. it sounded easy, but this job was much different then then usual work that you were used to.

title: Elven City Simulator
description: Revive civilization and save it from mysterious darkness. Story-oriented colony simulator with elvish flavor and indirect control.

title: Immortal Tales of Rebirth
description: Immortal tales of rebirth is a rogue-like strategy game based on a fantasy world. you will lead your students and female partners for growing to become a legendary master, conquer the giant beasts in the epic but also dangerous world. make your every choice carefully to survive.

title: Disney Hot Shots: Disney's Tarzan Jungle Tumble
description: A rip-roaring romp through the jungle. Use speed, skill and strategy to help Tarzan navigate three devious obstacle courses while avoiding his enemies.

title: Digital Exorcist
description:
While everyone is celebrating the coming of the new year 1999, retired Digital Exorcist Sawyer and his computerized partner Tomodachi run into a grisly scene that will make this jaded investigator remember all the old techniques he learned at the agency.

Travel into a world where cyberdemons live all around us in this Adventure Game/Visual Novel inspired by Snatcher and The Silver Case. Do you have what it takes to become a Digital Exorcist?

title: Disney Hot Shots: Disney's Terk & Tantor Power Lunch
description: Feast on fun in this fast-paced feeding frenzy. Terk and Tantor are hungry and have invited all of their animal friends over for a jungle feast. Devour all the food before Kerchak and Sabor spoil the party.

title: Learning Land
description: Learning Land is a series of educational titles aimed at children. It was published as a part-work series with a new title appearing every two weeks. Each CD was accompanied by a magazine.

title: Nitro: Stream Racing
description: Nitro is a high-speed, streamer-led, chat-plays racing game played live on stream! Earn rewards to build out your garage of customizable cars and characters. Climb the leaderboard with your community to earn trophies and qualify for the end-of-season Streamer Grand Prix!

title: I Commissioned Some Bunnies
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bunnies and carrots as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1440+ bunnies and carrots, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Strategic Command: American Civil War - Wars in the Americas
description: Lead your armies during five epic 19th century conflicts in this expansion for Strategic Command: American Civil War.

title: Regular Home Renovation Simulator Prototype
description: Regular Home Renovation Simulator is a simple simulation game about fixing a house. Replace floors, clean up dirt, fix walls! Who needs an electrician when you've got a perfectly fine screwdriver?

title: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzles: Magic
description: Those with great power are often rejected by their societies, who regard them as dangerous. These talented outcasts often search for others, to exchange mystical knowledge.

title: Baker Street Breakouts: A Sherlockian Escape Adventure
description: "Baker Street Breakouts" combines the thrill of an Escape Room with the storytelling of an Adventure. Use your superior deduction skills in this story-driven mystery to help Sherlock deducing his way through an old film studio to finally face his arch nemesis Moriarty. Become a Master of Deduction!

title: Elette
description: After the events of the Reaper Wars, Lotte had become a shattered nation. Under the rule of Mathias, the citizens managed to rebuild some of their once proud nation. After years of reconstruction, the island nation of Lotte is soon threatened by a darker, more vile threat; one that had been sleeping since the Reaper Wars. Take control of Mathias as he fights for his life against the invading horde in this haunted tower defense game!

title: CRSED: Cuisine Royale
description: CRSED: Cuisine Royale – is a brutal MMO last-man-standing shooter with realistic weaponry, elements of lethal mystic forces and incredible superpowers!

title: Buffet Boss
description: Cook your way to the top and rule the restaurant scene!

title: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzles
description: A selection of fantasy jigsaw puzzles. Customize your puzzle experience and expand the game with DLC.

title: Abelardo: Steakhouse Musician
description: Play as Abelardo, a guitar-wielding dinosaur entertaining diners in a bustling steakhouse. Navigate between tables, match each customer’s requested music style, and perform rhythm sequences to earn “meat” while avoiding collisions that can end your run. Built in Unity and originally released as part of the Indies vs PewDiePie jam, it’s a single-player music/arcade experience presented from a top-down perspective.

title: Let's Play Jigsaw Puzzles: Butterflies & Moths
description: Unveiling the Mysterious World of Moths and Butterflies!

title: Deathtide
description: A Roguelite where you are the Boss Fight! Defeat endless tides of the undead, complete tough challenges and dethrone powerful bosses. A Horde-Survival Roguelite where you unlock ancient powers and create overpowered character builds to become an unstoppable army-destroyer.

title: Unusual Ghost
description: When there is no one in the house, a ghost wakes up. He is looking for all the candles in the house to leave the owners without light. After all, when he scares them, they light candles and he has to hide again. Collect them all.

title: Unloop
description: Unloop is an elegant, relaxing puzzle game about using clever mechanics to connect and remove portals.

title: Four Color Puzzle
description: A chill puzzle experience. Set the colors of the pieces so that no two adjacent pieces have the same color. Complete 30 handmade levels, or explore infinite randomly generated 3D puzzles.

title: Afterplace
description:
Afterplace is an adventurous indie game for mobile devices. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. You'll run around the woods, fight monsters, and talk to ostensibly shady characters! All from your pocket! Be warned though - you never know what the forest might be hiding, and not all trails are paved. Labyrinths and dungeons are tucked away in the most concealed nooks. There are no waypoints in Afterplace. You'll have to forge your own path.

Afterplace has been designed from the ground up to be a fast, fluid, beautiful experience for mobile. There are no virtual buttons. You can move and attack by touching anywhere. You can tap objects directly to interact or attack, or use two thumbs like a traditional controller. The game will adapt dynamically to your play style. Pick up and set down the game at your own pace, it will always save your progress. Afterplace is made to feel like a full-fledged indie adventure game that fits in your pocket.

title: Pipe Dreams
description: This one goes out to the lovers, the believers and the pipe dreamers. All we want is a place that we can be free and live up to our full potential; be something better than ourselves. ‘Pipe Dreams’ is the game where you can power up to the rank of believer and reminisce in the past that never was. Perform space flips in the imagined world of self belief, hang around for a second in the Joy Shop of life, in times that never were. It’s the way of life in a made up fantasy, that we all wanted, but never got.

title: Icewind Dale II: Collector's Edition
description:
This Collector's Edition of Icewind Dale II, in addition to the game, includes:

- A cloth map of the Spine of the World
- Dice
- A poster with a creature list
- Trading cards with characters and creatures from the game
- A bonus CD with in-game extras and soundtrack
- Spiral-bound manual
- Black Isle Studios stickers
- Writing tablet

title: No More Money
description: A visual novel in which you play as a 20 year old man forced to move to a new city after his family lost all of their money.

title: Wilbler Park
description: Surreal walking simulator, where you traverse an alien mixed-media landscape. Journey through barren wildlife, bustling cities and peculiar architecture. Also, you have binoculars.

title: Vivid Relapse
description: ViViD Relapse is a mind-bending platformer that follows the plight of Burt; a troubled man who tries his best to live and cope with disease, both mental and physical. While many similar games have a tendency to focus on external evils, with ViViD, we hope to explore something much more personal; a certain kind of powerlessness that couldn't ever really come from anywhere but within.

title: BoxLoop 2
description: The Time Looping Evil Boxes Are Back! Solve The Riddles and Help Save Our Hero Aous From The Time Looping Evil Boxes In This Roguelike Adventure.

title: Time Survivors
description: The Most Historically Inaccurate Roguelike Ever Made. Slay hordes of minions as Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra and other historic heroes with new unique abilities! Fight through various historical eras, collect resources, unlock and enhance gameplay through our skill-tree metaprogression.

title: Hentai Casual Slider
description: Enjoy this casual slider puzzle with dozens of nice illustrations for you to enjoy and relax.

title: Subtransit Drive
description:
Realistic subway simulator

Feel what it’s like to drive a real train anytime and anywhere. Operate a vehicle with fully simulated internal systems in a highly realistic environment following a strict driving schedule and learning operating procedures on your own or with your friends in multiplayer.

title: A Slight Chance of Sawblades
description: Dodge, jump and somersault over razor-sharp sawblades in an attempt to survive the deadly storm! Compete in the global leaderboard for the spot of the best blade-jumper. Unlock quirky and outlandish characters to join in the blade jumping mayhem!

title: Kardomance
description:
A competitive card game set in the fantasy world of Ama Luria.
Developed and published by Armored Frog Games.

title: Legend of the Moon 2
description:
You can play the game combining with other
devices Find the key to save the earth
by destroying entities posing a threat.

title: Gherbert Groundhog in Save the Date
description:
Gherbert had just got his burrow laid out perfectly for his upcoming date with his sweetheart. Unfortunately his jealous crazy critter neighbours broke in and stole his belongings. With only hours to go until his big date Gherbert must venture outside to find his stuff and get back to tidy up before his date arrives at 8pm.

A traditional retro pixel art platform game. Collect the objects while avoiding the critters before the time runs out!

title: A Noite dos Patriotas
description: A Noite dos Patriotas is an indie game where you deal with patriots that want a federal intervention.

title: Cobalt Core
description: A sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder with a deep new single-axis spin on tactics games! Dodge missiles, line up your cannons, and blast 'em out of the sky... Then get to the bottom of these time loops, before it's too late!

title: Rocket Science
description: Take part in a space program. Design spacecrafts and send them off to explore the vast expanses of space. Experience the real scale of the Solar system and the size of its celestial bodies.

title: AbyssalCraft
description: AbyssalCraft is an eldritch horror mod for Minecraft centered around exploration, with growing magic and Lovecraftian influences.

title: Actually Additions
description: Actually Additions is a mod for Minecraft that adds various new additions, including utilities, Crystal Flux machines, and foods.

title: Green Sans
description: The first UNDERTALE fangame TO BE GOOD.

title: Marvel's Midnight Suns: The Good, The Bad, and The Undead
description:
Marvel's Midnight Suns: The Good, The Bad, and The Undead is the first DLC expansion for Marvel's Midnight Suns, released in January 2023. This expansion introduces Deadpool as a fully playable hero, bringing his trademark humour, unpredictability, and unique combat abilities to the game.

The DLC adds new story missions focused on Deadpool's involvement in the battle against Lilith and her demonic forces. These missions are designed to showcase Deadpool's quirky personality and chaotic fighting style, which includes regenerative healing and a mix of melee and ranged attacks.

title: A Passive Boy at the Huntress Clinic
description: The protagonist is unable to move due to a car accident and is now being approached by the heroines. And so begins a hospital stay surrounded by prank-loving female doctors and nurses!!

title: Meseugaki Yeong-ae-nim!
description: "Twenty questions party with Young-ae!"

title: The Sims 4: Simtimates Collection Kit
description: Set the mood with fun and flirty loungewear from The Sims 4 Simtimates Collection Kit.

title: The Sims 4: Bathroom Clutter Kit
description: Embrace the mess of daily life or create an organized oasis with The Sims 4 Bathroom Clutter Kit.

title: Train Sim World 3: ScotRail Express: Edinburgh - Glasgow Route
description: Rapid inter-city action in state-of-the-art traction awaits! Discover Scotland's two biggest cities and take charge of dense commuter services on ScotRail's principal rail line. The modern Class 385 is ready for service in Train Sim World 3: ScotRail Express: Edinburgh - Glasgow.

title: Way of the Wizard
description: Way of the Wizard is a first-person adventure game. Take on the role of a traveler who wants to become a wizard.

title: The Green Room Experiment: Episode 1
description: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. This game is designed on an escape game structure, you must solve a puzzle to move on to the next table. You will be transported to a dreamlike, strange universe, mixing exploration, mystery and poetry.

title: The Duduk Master
description: The Duduk Master, is a 2D platform game, with RPG elements that tells the story of a hero who was transformed into a monster, beside him are essential elemental skills to defeat his enemies and of course a powerful magic Duduk that can perform enchantments while playing some melodies.

title: Stack Machines
description: Push and pop your way through Stack Machines - an open-ended puzzle programming game. Use a variety of modules to read, transform and output different input sequences. Optimize your solutions for size, module count, speed and cost-effectiveness.

title: Rogue Blaster
description: Rogue Blaster is a shooting game that adds a twist to the FPS genre by adapting some rogue-lite aspects. The planet you crash-landed on is teeming with monsters! Use different equipment and items to survive the attacks until your ship is ready to leave.

title: Ozymandias: Mesoamerica
description:
Great cities have stood in these jungles and highlands since time immemorial. Upstart tribes threaten the old balance. Will the peoples of the Jaguar enjoy one last pre-columbian golden age?

Including a new map: Mesoamerica!

title: Sapiens League
description: Play for free and compare your skills with friends in this exciting competitive multiplayer game.

title: Old Shadow
description: A game based on J.R.R. Tolkien's novel The Lord of the Rings. A variant "Metroidvania" with elements of survival and crafting.

title: Martial Fire
description: Martial Fire is a classic 2D adventure game. Explore dungeons, ancient forests and deadly wastelands; fight enemies and solve riddles!

title: Light the Backrooms
description: You will be hounded by ghosts in the Backrooms of a ghost hunting company from midnight to 6 am. New kinds of crazy ghosts will be introduced daily, but you will also be notified how to deal with them. Take advantage of the two types of lights and survive five days of crazy business.

title: Kori's Fable Visual Novel
description: In a world of twisted magic and broken spirits be a girl with a mission.

title: Hyper Shapes
description: Hyper Shapes is a frenetic minimalist Boss Rush where understanding the enemies attack patterns and weaknesses is key.

title: Hike Trip
description: Take a step away from citylife and head on a rural Hike Trip in the middle of barely visited old forest.

title: Hentai Hanako
description: Hentai Hanako is a relaxing puzzle game. With the theme of hanako and 24 unique sexy girls. Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

title: Hell Slayer
description: Clear your way down to hell and bring punishment to the one responsible, Lucifer, fallen angel and king of sins. Face unending hordes of demons, optimize and perfect your build.

title: Castle Capture Topkapi
description: Multiplayer, medieval archery. Numerous characters, and classes to choose from. Use a bow or crossbow to snipe at your enemies or throw an axe for high damage. Use a sword, axe, hammer, mace, or fists for close combat. Exact copies of real-world castles, including Topkapi Palace.

title: Car Parking 2
description: Car Parking 2- Meet the continuation of the first part! Get behind the wheel of the same cars and get to the finish line in the shortest possible time!

title: Agent Roy: Zombie Hunt
description: Agent Roy: Zombie Hunt is an engaging 3rd person action shooter game. The horror is back. 300 Zombies. 15 houses. 1 village. Can Agent Roy face his worst nightmares and bring the nation to peace?

title: 8 Ball 3
description: Where to jump? Which way to go? Should I go on or fall? Which balloon to choose? Take your intuition to the extreme.

title: Cookie Match: Enhanced Edition
description: Cookie Match is a game that everyone can enjoy. To match cookies and cookie cutters or icings, you will face different tricks in each room, that gives you a unique experience and entertainment. Clear all the stages and reveal cookies' true stories!

title: Duelyst GG
description: Duelyst is a unique hybrid 1v1 card game where you play your units and spells onto a 9x5 board where you can position them to your advantage. You can pick from different generals with unique Bloodbound spells. All 800+ cards are unlocked so you can play anything you want from the start.

title: Desktopia: End of the Road
description: 'End of the Road' is a new game mode featuring a HUGE new level, five times longer than anything you've seen so far. Grow your village to an a massive 195 buildings, while dealing with multiple strongholds, new enemies, and new challenges.

title: Eastern Europe Bus Sim
description: Welcome in this bus simulator which brings you to Eastern Europe. Here, almost everything is different compared to the west, even the profession of a simple bus driver.

title: Enigma do Labirinto
description: Help the Abominable Cyclops of the snow solve the Enigma of the Labyrinth, so that he can be reunited with his beloved, who is waiting for him on the other side.

title: Frido
description: Robot time traveler got into the past. To get out, he needs to get to the time machine, passing more than 10 exciting levels.

title: GeoJelly
description: Born within unknown you instinctively seek for freedom as an experiment defect. In GeoJelly you have to find your way out of dystopian laboratory through platforming while avoiding traps and collecting keys necessary to push forward. Are you gonna find a way out?

title: Hank: Straightjacket
description: Hank: Straightjacket is a narrative bite-sized game combining traditional point-and-click gameplay with a time manipulation mechanic.

title: Gunwatch: Conflict Survival
description: 1-16 Player combat zone & 1-4 Player coop Zombie Wave Survival in Comic style. Singleplayer and Multiplayer Playthrough. Get ready for Gunwatch: Conflict Survival!

title: God Busters: Who watches the Watchers?
description: Episode 1: When fresh bodies start appearing from an explosion that happened weeks ago it's up to the "God Busters" to crack the mystery behind this case.

title: Otok
description: This is a very chill Sandbox "City Builder", No Goals, just build your island as beautifully as you can with the given buildings.

title: Morphman
description:
Morphman is an interactive video game, running via Microsoft Video, where the player plays as Morphman who has the power to change into different creatures. He is on a mission to rescue Professor Roberts, a physicist from performing military experiments. Morphman must take his jet to a mysterious castle on a mysterious island to rescue the Professor.

Morphman plays on a single screen where a video file plays in the top-left corner. He reacts to different circumstances by picking the correct ability when a challenge appears on the screen. The player has a short time to select the correct button press at pre-determined points in the video adventure. During the adventure Morphman is able to absorb the forms of various creatures to help him which are then shown on the interface.

title: Undertale 2: Overtale
description: Step into the shoes of John Undertale as he attempts to rewrite history to save the ones he loves from an avian catastrophe.

title: Break Everything: Park
description: The game is a fun shooter made on Unreal 5. You need to use a toy rifle to shoot balls to break all the objects in the park.

title: Animal Shelter Simulator: Horse Shelter DLC
description: In Animal Shelter - Horse Shelter DLC, we take care of much bigger animals that also deserve a good home. This DLC not only includes horses but also new fresh mechanics that will allow you to experience the world of Animal Shelter all over again!

title: Cyber West: Hidden Object Games - Western
description: A unique cyberpunk western! Conduct an investigation like a real detective in the world of Cyber Wild West! The newest hidden object game with a storyline. Сarve out your own legend!

title: Panspermia: Horror Myson Mansion
description: After the disappearance of his sister Maria, Marcelo decides to start his search on his own since the police cancel the search for her, Marcelo goes alone to the Myson mansion, which was the last place she visited. A bizarre mystery awaits you at the Myson mansion.

title: Grip on Reality
description: Follow adventures of a crazy wizard casting spells. The spells tend to be quite chaotic and unpredictable. The wizard finds himself embarking on a long quest across the world to uncover the mysterious cult worshipping a crystal, the same crystal powering the wizards staff.

title: Friendly Facade
description: In this visual novel, Maggie Crane and 15 others are invited to partake in the Isolated Society Study, where they must forge a peaceful society while attempting to outsmart each other in complex challenges. Just as the study is about to conclude, the Golding Foundation introduces a sinister twist.

title: Grip on Reality: The Jaguar
description: A pious blood-thirsty warrior with an insatiable need to sacrifice the blood of his enemies to his gods. He wields his blood-letting macuahuitl and calls upon blood magic to bleed his foes. Blood.

title: The Pale Man
description:
You wake up in a park, in the middle of the night.

Has someone trapped you?

Escape without getting caught!

title: The Petrified King
description: Your brother has been missing for a few days now. Last you heard, he went camping in the Old Forest. There have been rumors of a long forgotten race of people that dwell among the trees of that old forest. Are they only rumors?

title: The Potion Master
description: Markus, the young apprentice of a local potion master, has barely started his apprenticeship when trouble began - his master, Zabella, was found lifeless (but not quite dead) on the floor of her own underground lab. The local doctor can only do so much, leaving it up to Markus to investigate his master's mysterious collapse and -hopefully- find a way to cure her.

title: Corrupted Kingdoms
description:
You are the hero - or possibly villain - of this tale, originally on a journey to discover why your family was driven out of your home town, but quickly thrust into events beyond anything you could ever have imagined. As tensions rise between the humans and the mythical creatures that lurk just outside of sight, will you stand as a beacon of hope... or use your newfound power to bring the world under your control?
Meet dozens of fully-realised characters, purchase property and upgrade it, seek allies in your quest for justice or revenge and build relationships or tear them down to reveal fully animated and uncensored erotic scenes. With over 590 animations, more than 4000 images, unique music and sound effects and whole lot more in store!

title: Buzz
description: Buzz is a challenging momentum-based platformer.

title: The Shaft
description: Sgt. Reed has been tasked with descending into an abandoned underground facility, activating the power generator and opening the main entrance. But things did not exactly work as planned, leaving Reed stranded underground with no means of communication, most of the gear lost and very little idea of what went wrong in the first place and, most importantly, what lies at the bottom of the shaft...

title: The Surprisingly Short Adventure of Leopold Kettle
description: Join Leopold on his incredibly short adventure on the lovely island of Peanut Wharf.

title: Devil's 5 Days: Mischief Game
description: A Role-Playing Game as play as an adventurer who travels with the pact demon, who is also his girlfriend, Ria, attend to a business contest with a powerful adventurer that lasts for five days to decide who will be the next pact holder.

title: Chronicles of Albian: The Magic Convention
description: Gathering of wizards and sorcerers of the world is about to happen in Albian Castle. They have no idea what secret the castle holds!

title: Age of Wonders 4
description:
Rule a fantasy realm of your own design in Age of Wonders 4! Explore new magical realms in Age of Wonders’ signature blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat. Control a faction that grows and changes as you expand your empire with each turn.

Triumph Studios’ award-winning strategy series has emerged into a new age, evolving the game’s iconic empire building, role-playing, and warfare to the next level. A new storytelling event system and hugely customizable empires provide an endlessly replayable experience, where each game adds a new chapter to your ever-growing saga.

Powerful Wizard Kings have returned to the realms to reign as gods among mortals. Claim and master the Tomes of Magic to evolve your people, and prepare for an epic battle that will determine the ages to come.

title: Advent of Ascension
description: Advent of Ascension is a massive adventure and exploration mod for Minecraft designed to flesh out every area of the game as much as possible. It adds 21 new dimensions, each with its own items, ores, blocks, mobs, dungeons, and bosses. In addition to new tools and armor, players can access a set of special skills that offer perks at higher levels.

title: Applied Energistics
description: Applied Energistics is a Minecraft Mod which contains some basic tools, some electric tools and an advanced storage system called ME that lets you store items compactly and in the way you want.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Cute Cats 3
description: Cute and clumsy cats on guard of your good mood! ""1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats 3"" are ready to help you gain positive emotions!

title: My Neighbor Neko
description: Once a lonely girl came across a lonely cat. She decided to shelter him. So she found a neighbor... A neighbor with a secret...

title: Ars Nouveau
description: Ars Nouveau is a magic mod for Minecraft inspired by Ars Magicka that allows players to craft their own spells, create magical artifacts, perform rituals, and much more.

title: Avaritia
description: Avaritia is a mod for Minecraft that adds various extremely powerful items with very expensive recipes to create them, it was initially developed as a parody mod because of the power creep problem (mods add content that is significantly better and/or cheaper than content from another mod or the content counters content from other mods because they can).

title: EA Sports PGA Tour: Deluxe Edition
description: The exclusive home of the Majors, EA Sports PGA Tour features Pure Strike for superior golf gameplay powered by ShotLink, and unrivaled access to the world's most exclusive golf courses.

title: Cubematrix
description: Dive into a world of blocks that will introduce several fast-paced obstacle courses with 10 levels of gameplay and different atmospheric worlds!

title: Tactical Command
description: Assemble armies of soldiers, lead them into battle, conquer your enemies and move one step closer to galactic domination!

title: Tristia: Restore
description: Happening in parallel to Tristia:legacy, the story of Tristia:restore follows the genius inventor girl Nanoca Flanka, granddaughter of the legendary inventor and crafter Prospero Flanka, as she is working to revitalize the floundering marine city of Tristia alongside her trusty companions! But this game focuses more on the day to day of running the shop: She has some major crafting projects to complete, but all the while, new orders for smaller objects are coming in for her to complete!

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - The Last Sarkorians
description: The nation of Sarkoris was destroyed by the demons, yet the last of its people are ready to fight back. Meet Ulbrig Olesk, a Sarkorian shifter capable of turning into a mighty griffon. Explore a new region, fight new enemies... And maybe even find new love!

title: Hentai Leaked!? Only for Fans
description: Naked photos of girls prepared for their fans have been stolen to another dimension, fight against opponents, upgrade your character, give photos back to girls and get your reward...

title: Tet
description: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises.

title: Hexagon Puzzle Blocks
description: Get ready to challenge your skills with this isometric puzzle game! Each level presents a new hexagon grid and selection of colored shapes to fit together. With a relaxing yet challenging gameplay experience, this game is perfect for puzzle fans of all levels. Exercise your brain and have fun today!

title: The Betweenlands
description: The Betweenlands is a mod developed by the Angry Pixel modding group, which adds a whole new dimension along with tons of its own blocks, mobs, items, game mechanics, and even music.

title: Biomes O' Plenty
description: Biomes O' Plenty is an expansive biome mod for Minecraft that adds a slew of new, unique biomes to the Overworld and Nether! To go along with the new biomes, it adds new plants, flowers, trees, building blocks, and much more!

title: Hugo: The Secrets of The Forest
description: This Hugo franchise game is an edutainment game - its theme is about biology. Its gameplay is varied between stages. In one stage, you might be guiding a near-sighted swallow to eat some insects, while on another stage you'll be tasked to memorize all the shown animals in a correct order. Essentially, the stages are minigames with puzzle or puzzle-like elements included. The stages are presented in a non-linear format, so you can enter in these stages anyway you like. There are 3 difficulty settings to choose from when beginning a new game.

title: Botania
description: Botania is an innovative natural magic-themed tech mod for Minecraft, centered around generating and harnessing the magical energy produced by mystical flowers.

title: Milky Quest II
description: You find yourself in a world full of cute monster girls! The only problem is you lost your memories and all the monster girls want to eat you for nourishment! How will you survive!?

title: BuildCraft
description: BuildCraft is a mod that uses machines to mine resources, craft items, and sort resources. It also has machines that can automatically build structures based on blueprints. The mod also includes pipes to transport items, liquids, and power.

title: Chaos Awakens
description: Chaos Awakens is a re-imagination of the OreSpawn mod for Minecraft, it adds more bosses, armors, weapons, tools, dimensions, dungeons and so much more!

title: Nu pogodi! Vypusk 3: Pesnya dlya zajca
description: "Nu pogodi! Vypusk 3: Pesnya dlya zajca" - a computer game created based on the famous animated series "Well, you wait!". The artists of the original cartoon participated in the creation of 29 levels and 17 animations.

title: ComputerCraft
description: ComputerCraft is a mod for Minecraft that’s all about computer programming. It allows you to build in-game Computers and Turtle Robots, and write programs for them using the Lua programming language.

title: Cyclic
description: Cyclic is a mod for Minecraft that adds helpful items, blocks, inventory features, world generation, simple machines, gameplay tweaks, new villagers, and more changes that do not follow any particular theme.

title: Kikokugai
description: Kikokugai (also known as Kikokugai: Reichin Rinrinshan) is a remake of Kikokugai: The Cyber Slayer. It features full voice acting, redrawn art, improved animations, and vertical text boxes.

title: Dalek Mod
description: Dalek Mod is a mod that brings the world of Doctor Who into your Minecraft! With this mod, you can travel the universe using a fully functional TARDIS, travel to Minecraft's past, battle Daleks, Cybermen, and more!

title: Chef Wanted
description: The chef at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza has gone missing, so Freddy has to give up the microphone and take control of the pizza-making for a whole week!

title: DimensionalDoors
description: DimensionalDoors is a mod about manipulating dimensions and exploration. You can use its doors to connect and travel between any two locations instantly, even across dimensions, or to create your own pocket dimensions, isolated from the rest of the world. There are also doorways to seemingly endless dungeons, waiting for anyone to happen upon them.

title: Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room
description: Negative Atmosphere: Emergency Room is a first person, cinematic medical horror experience dedicated to precision, tension and trauma. As the Chief Medical Officer on the TRH Rusanov, Samuel Edwards must triage, examine and operate on his crew-mates, as disaster builds and shady figures set the events in motion that will eventually lead to Negative Atmosphere.

title: Draconic Evolution
description: Draconic Evolution is a mod for Minecraft that introduces high-powered and efficient weapons, tools, armor, machinery, storage units, rituals, research, and more.

title: Ender IO
description: Ender IO is a full-featured tech mod. It has armor, tools, weapons, machines, conduits, inventory management, mobs, etc.

title: EvilCraft
description: EvilCraft is a magic/technical mod for Minecraft that is based on somewhat evil things. Throughout the game, you will discover an ancient source of evil. These powers can be used in various technological advancements to initiate a second age of evilness.

title: Farmer's Delight
description: Farmer's Delight is a mod that gently expands upon farming and cooking in Minecraft.

title: Flan's Mod
description: Flan's Mod is a huge mod for Minecraft which adds planes, cars, tanks, guns, grenades, and more in a customizable content pack system. Enjoy peacefully flying through the Minecraftian skies and driving through your worlds or get some more destructive content packs and stab, shoot and detonate mobs, blocks, and even other players.

title: Galacticraft
description: Galacticraft is a mod that lets you travel to new planets with your own spaceship, explore dungeons, and build space stations with friends.

title: Pam's HarvestCraft
description: Pam's HarvestCraft is a mod for Minecraft that adds different seeds, plants, and new food items that can be found in the world, eaten by players, and crafted using specific recipes. It also changes the farming functionality of many of the vanilla crops, changing both farming mechanics and global game goals.

title: The Herobrine Mod
description: The Herobrine Mod is a mod for Minecraft that adds the infamous Herobrine and scary gameplay features.

title: Pokémon Altar
description: Pokémon Altar is a classic game created for the most conservative within the world of Pokémon. The difficulty is a little higher than that of the official games and it has a hard mode for the most daring.

title: EmoteGuesser
description: EmoteGuesser is a very simple game about guessing 7TV Emotes from a specified Twitch channel! It's more challenging than it sounds, but you'll have to check it out yourself!

title: Fallout 76: Season 11 - Nuka-World
description: Nothing beats the irradiated Appalachian heat like an ice-cold Nuka-Cola! (Just don’t forget to save that bottlecap for later.) Whether you prefer the classic taste of our original formula or one of Nuka-Cola's many other flavors like Cherry or Quantum, we welcome all comers to join us on the road for Nuka World on Tour.

title: Pokémon Gadir
description: Embark on a new adventure to face the challenge of the gyms in the Gadir region!

title: Rift Breach
description: A sci-fi dungeon crawler where you choose the next room. Your options are rarely beneficial, with random traps, puzzles and enemies lying in wait. Act quickly, for failure to manage your situation will cause a rapidly-spreading, merciless threat to the entire facility itself - a Rift Breach.

title: Chase: Animatronics
description:
Chase: Animatronics is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame developed by Team EKS, the people behind the Five Nights at Candy's and Popgoes series, as well as the now cancelled Chef Wanted, the game that originally spawned this project!
This is a "maze chase" game that takes mechanics and characters from the Five Nights at Freddy's games and puts them in a fast-paced arcade scenario. Try your best to collect all of the coins and survive against Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy with clever takes on the door mechanic from FNAF1, the flashlight mechanic from FNAF2, and more!

title: Sperma
description: Experience a roguelite in a fashion you never asked for. Command a fleet of brave spermoids, upgrade your load, and save the world by getting fertilized!

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising
description:
Dare to rumble with the best like never before with all-new characters, mechanics, and modes in the sequel to the revolutionary fighting game praised by both newcomers and fighting game veterans alike.

Experience even smoother and more responsive online play with rollback netcode and engage in battle cross-platform against players on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Steam!

title: Shalnor Legends 2: Trials of Thunder
description: A Story-Rich RPG/Action-Adventure Game. Step into the shoes of the young Orc Mogren, and explore all of Thunder Island. Venture into dangerous dungeons, explore caves and solve puzzles and help the residents of the island with their quests.

title: Majorelle Mystery
description: Point & click adventure game set in the Villa Majorelle in Nancy, France - a Art Nouveau house with growing plants on the doors blocking you from leaving it.

title: TXXX
description:
You're running out of time.
It was just a stop on your way, why'd you have to complicate things?
You shouldn't have stayed in the first place…

A bittersweet one-shot set in the world of Quaint.
One sprite, one background image, less than 1000 words.
Made in six days for the O2A2 2022 Visual Novel Jam.

title: RPG Workshop Max
description: This is a video game creation program that specializes in using custom made 3D images. It's not bigwig hollywood software, but it's well worth the price and extremely easy to learn and use. You can use any 3D clipart, including the images in the clipart package included, or you can even use digital photos of family and friends. So if you've always wanted to make a game but don't want to learn computer code, this is a great way to get started. You can save an unlimited number of games, and there is no limit to how big each game can be! I not only helped create the program, I use it all the time! It also comes with a great instruction manual in .rtf format. Check it out!

title: The Fifth Paradox
description:
During a time of myths, monsters and fantastic technology, an ancient tablet is discovered that makes a society re-think their place in the universe.

When it is discovered that the purpose of their existence is to create the being that will someday create their world, a secret team of genetic scientists start creating super powerful beings, in an attempt to create an omnipotent being capable of creating the world.

If they do not complete this task in time, existence will dissapear.

But problems start to arise, the paradox project produces genetically flawed monsters capable of terrible destruction, and a group of friends must try to solve the mystery and save the planet that is being torn apart by myths and geneticly bred Gods.

title: Spelp
description: The Spelp program needs you to annihilate thousands of aliens with a variety of weapons, members and unique capacities. Unlock characters and make up your own team to fit your playstyle.

title: Immersive Engineering
description: Immersive Engineering is a retro-futuristic tech mod for Minecraft featuring many multiblock machines, with energy components that look and feel like an AC electrical network.

title: Buy the Game, I Have a Gun: Sheesh-Man
description: This game is an interactive movie telling the story of how I went on earth and became a super-hero or whatever, it's pretty sick if you ask me! Not sick in the sense that you will throw up, but in the sense that it's cool. This my friend was a word play, you can expect this level of humour in the game, may I say it even gets better than this, not a lot, but at least a little bit.

title: IndustrialCraft
description: IndustrialCraft is a mod for Minecraft which adds many electrical machines, blocks, and items. It revolves around automation and modernization of many aspects of the game. The mod's electricity is measured in Energy Units.

title: Mekanism
description: 12 maps of orange and purple.

title: Mo' Creatures
description: Mo' Creatures is a mod for Minecraft that adds over 58 new mobs to your game, it provides many new animal and monster mobs, as well as the ability to tame and ride some.

title: NetherEx
description: NetherEx is a mod for Minecraft which largely reworks the Nether, adding four new biomes, each designed to fill a specific purpose with a unique approach within the dimension. The biomes are populated with new mobs, decorated with new blocks, and filled with over a dozen new items.

title: NuclearCraft
description: NuclearCraft is a tech mod for Minecraft focused on using nuclear power to provide energy.

title: Oh the Biomes You'll Go
description: Oh the Biomes You'll Go is an exploration and adventure mod designed to take you on a road trip across Minecraft like no other! Explore over 80 magical, realistic, and breathtaking biomes.

title: OpenBlocks
description: OpenBlocks is a mod for Minecraft that adds various helpful and unique blocks and items.

title: OreSpawn
description: OreSpawn is a mod for Minecraft that expands the game with various new dimensions, swords, tools, mobs, and bosses.

title: Pixelmon
description: Pixelmon adds many aspects of the Pokémon into Minecraft, including the Pokémon themselves, battling, trading, and breeding. Pixelmon also includes an assortment of new items, including prominent items like Poké Balls and TMs, new resources like bauxite ore and Apricorns, and new decorative blocks like chairs and clocks.

title: Project Red
description: Fight in the Blood Arena for your life. Earn, bet money and prove to your team your skills in a fair fight. (3v3, 2v2, 1v1) Blood Arena, poker and many more activities on Project Red will allow you to earn $EGLD while showing your skills to the whole mafia.

title: Psi
description: Psi is a magical tech spell programming mod inspired by the light novel The Irregular at Magic High School.

title: Quark
description: Quark is a fully modular Minecraft mod, named after the subatomic particle. In simpler terms, it's a large mod with lots of small features, aimed at improving the vanilla game.

title: Mythrel
description: A multiplayer online trading card game! Build your collection and decks, battle your friends, trade cards, and dominate the Seasonal Leagues!

title: Monsters Mess
description:
Trash horror game with underworld monsters that were unleashed when three friends broke the spell protecting their neighborhood.
The mess changed the reality of the world of the 3 young people who will now have the mission to defeat the creatures, to imprison them again.

Search every corner of the map in search of the crystals that are keys to other dimensions and face guardians possessed by the spell of the underworld who guard pieces of the relic capable of fixing the mess.
