description:
Fall back in love with a fuzzy, non-stop explosion of adorable Chuzzle matching action!
Slide and match colorful chuzzles, and watch them sneeze, shiver and explode with delight! But watch out for locks and other dangers as you take on dozens of Chuzzle challenges in your quest to funkify the universe!
Your pet Chuzzles are waiting for you to find them! Unlock them all to fill your very own Chuzzarium! Take a break to watch your Chuzzles swing, run, dance, eat, and play! Raptisoft's ADO (artificial digital organism) technology makes your pet Chuzzles feel real!
So cuddle up with Puzzle fun -- once you start popping Chuzzles, you won't be able to stop!

title: Meatly's Storage World
description: Oh, the horror! Another "terrifying" first person mascot horror game where you do stuff and not get caught. Over several minutes of gameplay! Lore! Discover the secrets, I guess.

title: Search
description: The existence of all mankind is under threat. You are the only hope!

title: Alien Slayers
description: Alien Slayers is a roguelite time survival game where you hunt down hostile alien creatures on various planets. Grab your weapon and survive to the end to become the strongest alien.

title: Wizard Hentai Survivors
description: Roguelite Hentai combat with Wizards! Explore the world, find beautiful women, grow stronger with each encounter! Over 100+ beautiful anime girls need to be saved in this bullet hell!

title: Chinese Expeditionary Force: Assault Team
description: Chinese Expeditionary Force - Assault Team is a tactical stealth game set in the expedition of the Chinese Expeditionary Force to Burma during World War II. The assault team consists of five characters, each with their own special skills. You can use different strategies to complete the mission.

title: Third
description: An experimental serious meta game.

title: Souls of Chronos
description: Classic JRPG + Action Combat System

title: Maze / Break
description: Gather your team, arm them with some gear and try to find the way out through the hordes of monsters in a procedurally generated maze!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CFR Calatori B 26-26 064
description: Manufactured at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, this versatile doubledecker car was used on regional passenger transport by the Romanian operator CFR and then by CFR Calatori, being repainted into various paintschemes through the years, mainly different types of blue paint.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: CFR Calatori B 26-26 186
description: Manufactured at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, this versatile doubledecker car was used on regional passenger transport by the Romanian operator CFR and then by CFR Calatori, being repainted into various paintschemes through the years, mainly different types of blue paint.

title: Zombocity
description: ZomboCity is a fast-paced, score-based FPS where you fight endless waves of zombies in a neon-lit city. Test your reflexes, stack up points, and see how long you can survive.

title: Equal People
description: Welcome to the City of Neapolis. You are here to solve a Mystery. Talk to People and Get Clues.

title: Omega Survivors
description: Omega Survivor is a sci-fi bullet hell, part of the new "Survivor" genre with loot, crafting and lots of alien blasting to be done. The perfect game for those that just want to relax and turn off their brain.

title: Madshot: Road to Madness
description:
Road to Madness is a stand-alone spin-off of Madshot, which introduce a new vertical-style survivor gameplay!
Slaughter endless abominations while moving stylishly through a lovecraftian nightmare. Combine a multitude of unlockable weapons, abilities and upgrades in order to survive as long as possible, and reach the top of the leaderboards.

title: Outlaw Heart
description:
Outlaw Heart is a Fast Paced Character Action/Rail Shooter that is playable on Flatscreen or VR!

Help Remy and her band shred their way through the city they love!

title: Minecraft: N7 Mash-up
description: Shape the fate of your Minecraft galaxy with this amazing mash-up, which includes thirty-six character skins, bespoke game textures, themed menus, a dedicated world filled with iconic locations, and an original soundtrack compilation to set the mood.

title: Astrobit
description: A free PvP space shooter with epic RPG mechanics. Upgrade your ship and explore new builds every match by combining different weapons, skills and abilities. Be a swift assassin, a tanky heavy-hitter, or go deep into magic to destroy your opponent and climb the ranks. The choice is yours!

title: Papyrus's Big Christmas Adventure
description: It's Christmas in the Underground, Sans and Papyrus are preparing Christmas Eve dinner, until Papyrus realizes that he forgot to hide Sans' gift. Papyrus runs out to hide him and Sans tell him that if he's not home in 10 minutes, Sans would have dinner without him.

title: The Return to Freddy's 2: Winter Wonderland
description: The Return to Freddy's 2: Winter Wonderland is a reboot of the 2015 fangame. From 12 AM to 6 AM, survive your shift at the soon-to-open pizzeria while dealing with the increasingly erratic behavior of its mascots. Following each night, you will be required to complete a maintenance task to wrap up.

title: Digimon: Digital Heroes
description: A Digimon platformer fan-game. You can play as every (partner) digimon from the original Adventure & Adventure 02! Each character is able to perform a physical attack and a ranged skill. Most of them also have abilities like flight or swimming.

title: Heaven for Death
description:
A fangame from "Bocchi the Rock!" series made in RPG Maker.
Ryou is dead and amnesiac and Nijika is her angel. Together they're in heaven.

title: The Soul's Choice
description: Play against the clock in single-player mode or play together with up to 10 people in multiplayer mode. If the evil spirit chooses you, you will have to kill everyone. If he doesn't choose you, your mission is to help destroy the soul by collecting voodoo dolls. Don't forget to strategize to win.

title: Ohka Bots
description:
Ohka Bots is a free-to-play action role-playing multiplayer online game available for PC.

A battle to save Cyberspace and become the strongest BOT you can be. Upgrade and customize your BOT as you power up and loot your way through the Virus threat that has infested Cyberspace.

title: Fat Prisoner Simulator
description: Fat Prisoner Simulator - a soccer simulator where you play the role of a prisoner. The jail managers have noticed that some prisoners, who really like to eat a lot, can hardly go through the doors, including those of their cells.

title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Shogun
description: The next iteration in the successful microstrategy franchise, Kingdom Two Crowns will allow players to venture to exotic biomes across the world through expandable content. On day 1 of release, players can journey to lands inspired by the landscape, architecture, and culture of feudal Japan. Play as the mighty Shogun or Onna-bugeisha, enlist the support of the ninja, lead your soldiers to battle atop the mythological Kirin, and form new strategies as you brave the Greed hiding in the thick bamboo forests.

title: Cats War
description: Cats War is an incredibly addictive third-person shooter. You have to play as a cat who wants to take revenge on the ducks for their bad deeds! You have deadly fists, a bat and even a pistol in your arsenal! Punish all ducks and collect all flowers.

title: Astral Sorcery
description: Astral Sorcery is a magic mod focused around harnessing the powers of starlight and the constellations. Explore and discover the world and the sky above you; focus starlight to your will, strengthening yourself or enhancing the world around you.

title: Comfy Cozy
description:
Comfy Cozy is a mod that adds multiple new decorational blocks with the goal of making your Minecraft sessions more "cozy."

That of course, is a subjective term so your results may vary, but my hope is that everyone can find something they like here.

title: Legends Mod
description: Ever wanted to build your own lightsaber while flying around in your Iron Man suit battling Godzilla in Minecraft?! Or traverse across the galaxy as a Jedi hunting down the brutal killers of society? The Legends Mod features packs such as Superheroes Unlimited, Horror, Kaiju/Godzilla, and Star Wars, allowing you to suit up as your favorite heroes and villains or become the Jedi and Sith of old to fight in the battle against good evil.

title: Dragon Ball Z: A Batalha dos Deuses
description: Official game for PC developed by brazilian studios Aiyra and Duckbill for the release on the country of the movie Dragon Ball Z: A Batalha dos Deuses.

title: Chaotic Era
description: Chaotic Era is an intense and brutal strategy game inspired by classic science fiction, following a stranded human crew on an alien planet. Scavenge for resources and fight back against mysterious alien terrors in this frantic real-time strategy nightmare.

title: Final Fantasy VII: Re-Imagined
description: Final Fantasy VII: Re-Imagined is a project made by fans of the original game as an action game in the vein of 2D Side-scrollers, such as Dragons and Dungeons: Chronicles of Mystara, Streets of Rage and so on. You get to play as Cloud or Tifa in one level based on Midgar.

title: WJMax
description: This is a fan game of streamer "woowakgood."

title: Digimon Chronicles: The Alpha Chosen
description: An action-platformer fan game based on the Digimon anime series, created by SE77E in 2019. Only the first episode was released, before he jumped into another game called Digimon: Digital Heroes.

title: Crisis Evil 2
description: Crisis Evil 2 is a sequel to the first Resident Evil themed mod by HarlemHero. It takes place at the same time as the events of the first Crisis Evil and features 2 new playable characters: Leon Kennedy and Claire Redfield.

title: Inside Jennifer
description:
As you follow the life of Jennifer, she'll bump into many different characters and end up in lots of unexpected situations. You'll have to make decisions that will make certain routes available while closing the others. The choice is yours!

In this game you play as the female protagonist Jennifer.

Inside Jennifer is an adult, corruption game, with multiple choice routes and endings. As Jennifer’s life unfolds, you’ll have to make decisions that will cause unique and distinct interactions between all characters. Stay loyal, lie, cheat or go wild, the choice is yours.

title: Three Kingdoms Story: Conussia
description: A tale of sex, power, and intrigue set in the Royal Court of a fantasy kingdom. Become the saviour of Conussia, or its doom. Extreme adult content.

title: SnowRunner: 2-Year Anniversary Edition
description:
SnowRunner’s 2-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game as well as the Year 1 and Year 2 Passes.

Get ready for the ultimate off-road experience!

SnowRunner puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful vehicles as you conquer extreme open environments with the most advanced terrain simulation ever. Drive over 60 vehicles from brands such as Ford, Chevrolet, and Freightliner as you leave your mark on an untamed open world.

title: Hi Pizza
description: A light, fairy-tale and fantastical deciphering game, with a cat being the protagonist.

title: Redfall: Bite Back Edition
description: The Bite Back Edition includes the Base Game, Redfall Hero Pass, Throwback Outfit Pack, Laser Beam multi-weapon skin and the Tactical Knife Stake attachment.

title: Xenotilt: Hostile Pinball Action
description: Lightning strikes again!! Xenotilt, the sequel to the cult hit, Demon's Tilt. Get ready for another pinball fantasy. Xenotilt shreds the envelope with face-melting gameplay & graphics.

title: How to Die: A Hope Beneath
description: A box was trapped inside a mysterious chamber. There's no way escape from there, except... death. How to Die is a dark, narrative-driven 3D platformer with lot of challenging puzzles.

title: Side Scape
description: A light-hearted, Side-Scroller/ Top-Down hybrid!

title: Backroom Warfare II
description: Fight for survival in the Backrooms. Play with friends in multiplayer or solo against AI bots. Unearth the terrifying monster scorestreak and get ready for an intense experience!

title: Moonlight Pulse
description: Teamwork matters most in this seamless, fantastical metroidvania within a living, breathing world. Realize each character's true potential to take down an invading force of overwhelmingly powerful parasites.

title: Chimeras: Blinding Love - Collector's Edition
description: When several young men are mysteriously found blind and paralyzed, you're called in to investigate! Can you uncover who, or what, is attacking them and return the Parisian streets to safety?

title: Catacombs: The Beginning
description: Catacombs: The Beginning - is an excellent 3D shooter where you have to survive in the catacombs overfull of various monsters.

title: TVs: The Revival
description: TVs The Revival is a platformer single-player game that balances exciting action with challenging puzzles. When the hero "u" awakens from a coma, he is driven through strange events living in the TVs real world to unravel the mysteries of his past and defeat evil forces plaguing the region.

title: Idlenetics
description: Exciting idle tycoon game that immerses you in a beautiful medieval world. The game features a hex-based map that is divided into different zones, each of which is unlocked as the player progresses through the game.

title: Balance Helicopter
description: Balance the helicopter with its two engines! Navigate through increasingly harder levels and different challenges!

title: IOUA
description: An endless torture game set in the distorted remnants of forgotten RPGMaker puzzles.

title: Hiden Ruin
description: A challenging platform game that will test your skill and patience.

title: Don't Get Lost
description: A procedurally-generated, open-world, first-person colony sim. Build colonies in an infinite world, alone or with friends via Steam or self-hosted multiplayer.

title: Fall and Destroy
description: Perhaps the craziest simulator of falls and destruction that you have seen! A variety of attractions, "beaters" and physics settings on the levels will definitely not let you get bored.

title: Flower Memories
description: Exercise your memory alone or with a friend in a beautiful and relaxing environment.

title: Project Nosferatu
description: A fast-paced Action RPG with a fully customizable arsenal combo battle system. Varied landscapes of an interconnected world bring unique dangers in each area, which tie together a complex story about the mystery of the nocturnal, subterranean species known as "Umbrakhs."

title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 13 - Collector's Edition
description: Help run Pinecreek Hills and New England's Minuteman Valley!

title: Ultimate Flight Simulator Pro
description: If you want to feel like a real pilot, this airplane game is for you.

title: Bloody Lonely Cold
description: Bloody Lonely Cold is a survival horror game from a first-person perspective. In a future large Japanese hospital. There is a brave beautiful girl who bravely faced monsters in order to survive. When you are with her, don't panic, don't be afraid.

title: Pusu: Uyanış
description: Pusu:Uyanış is the first 3D action game of its kind in Turkey.

title: Mercenaries Lament: Requiem of the Silver Wolf
description: Mercenaries Lament is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world.

title: Bloodborne Kart
description:
Bloodborne Kart was an unofficial fan game made by the community. Race through the streets of Yharnam and beyond with a wide array of vehicles, ranging from traditional karts to motorcycles to wheelchairs!

Days before its intended release on January 26th, 2024, Sony requested the removal of copyrighted content from the game. The game was delayed and was reworked into Nightmare Kart.

title: Poglings
description:
Poglings is a cute, pet simulation, creature collecting adventure. Play as Keeble: a young boy who's taken up the profession of becoming a Pogling Hatcher.

Each day is a new opportunity that will offer fun and unique challenges as you make friends and grow your nest of Poglings. Put in a hard days work and some of the more colorful and rare poglings could be yours! Explore your island, discover its secrets and race against other Poglings! Learn enough and you could become a master hatcher!

title: Fragment's Note+ AfterStory
description: Following the story of "Fragment's Note+"...

title: Life After End
description: Life After End is a harsh and cruel representative of the Survival Horror genre, where you have to survive in post-apocalyptic Siberia. Be prepared for harsh climatic conditions and realistic gameplay.

title: Just Wak and Beats
description:
Fangame for "Woowakgood", based on "Just Shapes and Beats"

Are you ready to embark on a rhythmic and colorful adventure? Introducing Just Wak and Beats, the electrifying fangame inspired by the mesmerizing world of “Woowakgood” and the adrenaline-pumping gameplay of “Just Shapes and Beats”. Get ready to groove your way through an epic journey in search of lost colors and ancient artifacts!

Prepare yourself for a gameplay experience like no other. Just Wak and Beats seamlessly combines the high-octane action of bullet hell games with the addictive allure of rhythm-based mechanics. As Wak navigates through the beat-infused landscapes, deadly obstacles will come at him in sync with the pulsating soundtrack. Dive, dodge, and dance your way past walls of sound, explosive boss battles, and heart-pounding crescendos.

title: Minecraft: Dragonborn Mash-up
description: The Dragonborn meets Minecraft in a clash of epic proportions. Build your own worlds in the land of Tamriel and experience adventure with many of its most iconic characters. Fus Ro Dah!

title: Fazbear Entertainment: Storage
description: Fazbear Entertaintment: Storage is a total revamp of Fazbear's Fright: Storage. New characters, new mechanics, a new story, and more. Taking place in the large gap between FNaF 1 and FNaF 3, FE:S seeks to merge somewhat seamlessly with the existing FNaF story, while also filling in a few gaps.

title: Nightstars
description:
Nightstars is a Five Nights at Freddy's fan-game developed by Bonzee & Co.

It's a short one night game focusing on reaction times and prioritisation skills. Expect some twists, fresh mechanics and more!

title: Fredbear and Friends: Left to Rot
description:
With the assistance of a private investigator through your handheld radio, you sneak down into the depths of Fredbear's Family Diner—seeking out clues for the whereabouts of your son and prime suspect of the case, William Afton.

However, unforeseen traps have been set within the facility. Will you be able to escape?

title: Ellie's
description: Ellie's is a more traditional fan game with elements of old and new while still being different. ELLIE'S was also built on the formula which permeated FNAF 1 through Sister Location. Investigate Ellie's, gather evidence of the past and the paranormal, and show your findings

title: Bubba's Diner
description:
You're the handyman of the brand new Bubba's Diner! Expect the unexpected!

Bubba's Diner is a FNaF-Based game with inovative mechanics and, of course, a dense backstory.

title: Sulfur
description: It looks that the latest volcano eruption was so strong that some hellspawn were ejected in addition to lava... Approximate playtime around 20 minutes. Classic map (no jumping etc.).

title: Monsters & Memories
description: Monsters and Memories is an independently created, niche Fantasy MMORPG that harkens back to the classic MMO era of the late '90s and early '00s.

title: Quest for Moomoo
description: Help Kye find her plush cow! A strange visual novel RPG hybrid experience. A plush cow is involved.

title: American Truck Simulator: Kansas
description:
Introducing Kansas! A U.S State that is home to a truly authentic cowboy culture and miles of land littered with wildflowers. Located in the Midwest of the USA, Kansas is known for its native grasslands, streams, abundant blue skies, and green grassland vistas.

Once considered to be the country’s agricultural heartland, "The Sunflower State" has managed to attract many large businesses and develop in other industrial areas due to its central location and convenient infrastructure for logistics operations. But, as the nickname suggests, nature is certainly doing very well to keep up with technological progress, as the state parks and vast prairies offer unique views with a marvelous atmosphere that will leave every trucker passing by with something to remember.

title: 1 Bit Survivor
description: 1 Bit Survivor is an easy to play but difficult to master randomly generated rogue-like with stylized pixel art and survival horror elements. Fight to survive 28 Days of the Zed-pocalypse and save your pet Cat!

title: Commander: Modern War
description: Experience the thrill of a modern conflict between two factions, as you outsmart your opponents in an epic game of strategy and cunning. Take command of your ground, air, and naval units and lead them to victory in the most immersive turn-based battle simulation. The battlefield awaits.

title: Abandoned Drive-in
description: The main character Kaori is on a date boyfriend suggests that they go on a test of courage. The destination is an abandoned drive-in. They hear a noise in the ruins and stops. Is there already someone there?

title: Forest Life
description: Players will play as five different characters and experience five environmental theme scenes relating to sustainable palm oil, orangutan conservation, rainforest protection, etc. Players need to make a variety of choices through their own understanding, and reach different story endings.

title: Silent Hill 2: Streets of Rage
description: Streets of Rage: Silent Hill is a 2015 fan game developed by BoggyTheWorm using the OpenBoR engine. It's a beat 'em up that mixes Sega's Streets of Rage fighting game and Konami's Silent Hill horror game into one. This crossover uses several well-known characters such as James (Axel), Maria (Lisa), Angela (Blaze), Travis (Adam), Eddie (Bongo), Heather (Lucia from Final Fight 3), Pyramid Head, and Scarlet.

title: Connection Error
description: Amber, an employee at GlobalNet Solutions, does her every-day night shift job in the IT Department, most of it being in the server room. Though somebody is stalking inside the darkness...

title: Pirate Fighting Simulator
description: PFS is first person shooter game where you fight pirates with guns. There are also different game modes such as capture the flag and team death match.

title: Concrete Tremor
description: "Concrete Tremor" is a short experimental horror game about plastic explosives and soviet apartments, where the story is told from multiple perspectives.

title: Super Botte & Bamba II Turbo
description: Super Botte & Bamba II Turbo is a MUGEN based fighting game created by Giochi Penosi, a team known for creating controversial games. The game uses average Italian humor and features various characters from TV shows and politics.

title: Price for Freedom: Avarice
description:
A CRPG turn based tactical game with novel take on damage systems and limb based targeting. A deep engaging character based story with four main companion characters where your decisions and actions will change their responses and how they will approach you or solving solving problems for you.

All hand-drawn massive expansive settings, cities, wilderness, coastlines. These maps feature several interactive areas and even some procedural tunnel and cavern networks that you can explore.

Enemy behaviour is handled in novel manner as well, where they draw from a pool of cards and then perform whatever action is based on that card. The player can reveal the enemy hand, re-shuffle, or even discard cards permanently to get the upper hand in a fight.

Side content includes; hunting, fishing, cooking, arm wrestling, and treasure hunting. Collectable pinups are hidden through the game world and some side quests, romantic trysts or outright romps.

title: TacticalDuty.io
description: TacticalDuty.io is a brand new 2D shooter game that contains really fun competitve gameplay!

title: Doka-chan no Onigokko
description: Doka-chan no Onigokko is a game of tag in which players collect chicks in a maze while running away to avoid being caught by Oni. The stage is cleared when all four chicks are caught within two minutes, but the game is over if you get caught by a Oni or run out of time. The gameplay is fast, although some mazes can be quite aggravating and some chicks quite elusive.

title: NeuroSquad
description: Invent your own weapons in this sci-fi Roguelike shooter! Combine any weapon with any upgrade to customize your arsenal. Form a squad of holographic soldiers, redesign their guns too, and slay hordes of cybernetic enemies!

title: Halloween in Hollywood
description: Halloween in Hollywood is a romantic comedy Yuri Visual Novel and Dating sim. Play as witty writer Martina Alvarez as she manoeuvres her way around epic events on Halloween night as she rubs shoulders with Los Angeles elite to do what she can to get her screenplay produced.

title: Fliese
description: "Fliese" is a minimal logic puzzle game

title: Efpiyes
description: Efpiyes is a multiplayer first-person shooter with a built-in map editor that anyone can use.

title: CGI: The Game
description: Step into the shoes of one of 7 real-life body scans of models from today's generation and take on robots aliens & monsters in this futuristic metaverse. Utilizing stunning computer-generated imagery plus a custom soundtrack, the CGI game offers an immersive and action-packed gaming experience.

title: Squiggle Drop
description:
Solve puzzles by drawing a single shape.

Featuring 100 levels, each with a unique objective and requiring different types of problem solving skills.

title: Secret Diaries: Manage a Manor
description: Help Jane decide what she truly wants before it's too late!

title: Kindergarten Secret
description: Kindergarten Secret - detective, horror and puzzle in one game. You will be able to play as several characters in the frame of one game, complete twenty unique quests and uncover the main secret of the story.

title: Secret Dimension
description: Secret Dimension - a mind-bending platformer that will test your skills and keep you guessing. Master illusions, beat the clock and set new high scores.

title: Guacomole
description: GUACOMOLE is a classic arcade shooter with a twist... Survive endless waves of chip enemies with only one bullet. A seamless cross between classics such as Pong and Asteroids. Enjoy a challenging and strategical experience that will leave you hungry for more!

title: Refund Me If You Can: Lexy's Story
description:
Welcome to Lexy's Story, a challenging 3D platformer set in the year 3030.

In this game, you must help Lexy's grandmother by retrieving her medication within two hours.

But be warned, this game is not for the faint of heart. With permadeath, ragdoll physics, and no save feature, you will need to rely on your skills and determination to overcome the obstacles on your path.

title: Extra Case: My Girlfriend's Secrets
description: Your girlfriend seems to be hiding something. Will you respect her privacy or pry into her secrets? Don't worry, though. This is a horror dating sim with a time loop, so you can try again...and again...and again...

title: Pop Survivor
description: Pop all balls in the level before you rush to the goal, in under 60 seconds. You need to jump, run, avoid obstacles to successfully clear each level. Make sure to efficiently pop balls or else, you won`t be able to clear levels in time!

title: Sex with Teachers
description: Sex with Teachers - is the simplest puzzle which can help you to develop your visual memory and enjoy hot pictures of sexy ladies.

title: Waifu Packer
description: Waifu Packer is puzzle game where you try to fit tiles into boxes by moving them around on a grid. Each level you unlock an image of a beautiful waifu which will be waiting for you in the gallery!

title: Living with Temptation 1: Wild Weekends & Wife Gone Wilder
description: Erotic RPG game about relationship and desire. Help Tracy with the household chores, take care of your baby, earn money and spoil her with your kindness. Rediscover the pleasure of sex and have kinky experiences with her.

title: Only Furry 18+
description: Only Furry 18+ is a casual clicker adult game that looks like a popular social media.You should help main character to earn enough money to make a post. After every reached goal you will get a beautiful 3D picture or awesome 3D animation with girl.

title: Jam Above Jam Below
description: Witz and Doobz on their adventure to make a video game through seven different mini-games and funny cartoon cutscenes!

title: Biblios Dice
description: Biblios Dice is a digital adaptation of the dice game by Dr. Finn. In it you are working as medieval monks to produce illustrations and improve the prestige of your abbey. Manipulate the value of the five different resources, buy and sell at the market, and gain the bishop's favor.

title: The Backrooms: Nightmare Dimension
description: The Backrooms: Nightmare Dimension is a Co-op online horror game with up to 4 players, where you and your friends take on the roles of soldiers who are part of the SCP Foundation with the mission to eliminate the mysterious entities found in the infamous place called "the Backrooms".

title: Cute Bully Nyanbaba
description: The super cute villain Nyanbaba is back! This time, meow bully invaded 10 new scenes, found all the strange hidden points and cracked the magic of cat ear Nyanbaba! Contains jump out shock (cute)! And super cute Chinese dubbing! More scenes, more voice, more joy!

title: Whackerball
description: Whackerball is a twin-stick shooter roguelite with Breakout inspired mechanics. Use your paddle to keep your ball airborne and dodge enemy bullets as you defeat waves of enemies.

title: EdoPro
description: A Yu-Gi-Oh multiplayer card simulation updating game available for download on Windows, Mac, Linux, and Android. A fork of the YGOPro client.

title: Apes vs Helium
description: Apes vs. Helium is a game that was made in 2020 and is a first person shooter based off of the tower defense game series Bloons TD. In the game you play as the unique monkeys that appear throughout the series, starting off as the Dart Monkey. You begin upgrading your weapons, changing classes, and buying extra support to help you along the way.

title: Striving for Light: Survival
description: Striving for Light: Survival brings the exploration of infinite expanding skill trees to the arena survival roguelite genre. Unlock new characters, weapons, skills and maps, slay hordes of monsters and take on massive boss fights.

title: Hyper Pop
description: Hyper Pop is a frantic action rogue-lite bullet heaven. Use your mouse cursor to guide and protect your character as it grows to become absurdly overpowered against hordes of cute emojis!

title: Shanghai Summer
description: Shanghai Summer is an adventure game set in the millennium. Our protagonist, Baichuan, goes through a series of "anomalies" over the length of twelve days. In his pursuit of the truth, he found that his hopes and regrets from the past finally seem to converge. Will he be able to "fix" it for good?

title: Party Maker
description: Builder. Designer. Renovator. Unleash your creativity in over a dozen unique places, get the right equipment, prepare the space, use what you find. Wanna make a crazy party?

title: Arena of the Mad King
description: Arena of the Mad King (AotMK) is a fast-paced bullet-hell boss rush game. Touhou meets Realm of the Mad God.

title: I Commissioned Some Bees: 12 Days
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy Christmas/winter world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Farming Fever
description: Farming Fever is an engaging time management game where you can become both a farmer and a chef at the same time. You'll have to manage your farm, harvest crops, cook, and complete customers' orders.

title: Sakurairo Prism
description:
The protagonist of this story, Hikaru Sakaki, is a second-year student at Kirigamine Private High School. Although he became the head of the photography club this spring, he finds that he is the only member of the club. As he struggles to save the club from disbandment, three girls appear before him.

What do they see behind the camera?
Each of their feelings gently overlap and create colors.

"Hey, in what color do you see me?"

title: Put Your Brain on 2
description: Put Your Brain On 2 is a casual-puzzle game about thinking and organizing tactics.

title: Ruina Remake
description: In a quiet corner of a small town by the river, ancient ruins have mysteriously reappeared. Within lies a sprawling labyrinth filled with cryptic prophecies that have drawn in adventurers from far and wide. But alongside the legendary monsters and treasures, many more secrets remain hidden...

title: Come Home

title: Into the Necrovale
description: Into the Necrovale is an Action RPG in which you collect powerful items that interact in unexpected ways. You must be clever with your build if you hope to pierce the mysteries and dangers of the Necrovale, where a thousand generations of miscreants and criminals have been banished.

title: FTB Oceanblock
description:
OceanBlock is a new unique modpack created by the FTB Team inspired by the countless island-based modpacks. Expect many changes to what you’re used to, encounter custom structures within the deep depths of the sea. Experience the true beauty of the obsidian boat, especially in water. With over 550 quests to guide you through this wet and wild journey, you’ll never loose things to do. Nor will you feel bored, with the addition of rafts to break. A new addiction can form, the endless hunt for treasures among the infinite oceans. An entirely new crafting system, Tempered jars. As you follow the quests, diving into new draconic technology. “Enjoy” the lack of ability to swim. Jump into the ocean with a scuba suit. Sluice gravel, sand, dirt and dust for resources.

Dive into this new drenched, world.

title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: S.O.G. Prairie Fire
description: Experience the intensity of the Vietnam War on a monumental scale. Featuring three vast terrains, a new co-op campaign, single/multiplayer scenarios, and dozens of weapons and vehicles, players can quell uprisings, run recon missions, and wage war in a historic take on Arma 3’s military sandbox.

title: Pasha Planet: Reborn
description: “Pasha Planet: Reborn” is the debut game of Scorpio Game, a Taiwanese independent game development studio. Prepare to be charmed by unique hand-painted scenes and have fun with light detective work, players will get to explore the main game plot that revolves around the characters’ daily life through an immersive and one-of-a-kind puzzle-solving gameplay.

title: Lawbringer
description: Lawbringer is a fast-paced arena fighting roguelite. Hack, slash and shoot your way through enemy hordes to appease the Autarch. The faster you slay your enemies, the greater His favor. Pick up game changing skills and a variety of weapons. Kill fast, grow strong and cheat death.

title: Glass Heart
description: A 20% chance is all you have to survive the surgery. Will love give you the strength to continue this life or will you be singing with the angels? The choice is yours in Glass Heart.

Metroidvania made as an action platform game. In Afterimage we play the role of an adventurer who travels across the fantastic land of Engardin, searching for its secrets, solving its problems and facing numerous dangers.

- Base Game
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Artbook

TankLab

Players take on the role of Nameless, and the plot of the new elements revolves around the Ancient Ones, i.e. powerful beings serving Innos. The authors have developed new locations and adventures, five additional factions and dozens of characters. In addition, it was made possible to impersonate a Magnate and take part in arena battles. All this has been superbly integrated with the basic version of the game and made in a quality that more resembles an official add-on than a fan production. In addition, there are so many novelties that you can go through the main campaign again without feeling bored, as the modifications introduced by the authors effectively refresh the overall formula.

EFZ version 2.x. Released by Twilight Frontier on August 2002, during Comic Market 62.

This version added 3 new characters from AIR (Mizusu, Kano, and Minagi), and added UNKNOWN as a hidden playable character, bringing the total number of playable characters to 16. Kanna from AIR was used as the true final boss.

Play as Mei Hashimoto, one of the colonists send to an exoplanet to prepare it for the arrival of the rest of humanity.

description: Immerse yourself in neon, smoke, and high-stakes legal gambles as a Defense Attorney with uniquely Killer insights in this diabolically stylish visual novel adventure game.

title: Only One Night
description:
When a kid is abandoned by his parents and left alone for a day, they start to go insane and start seeing creatures of their own nightmares. Driven by sleep deprivation, they must manage their energy and take quick naps while surviving against the never ending threats to survive only one night.

Only One night is a Fnaf-Like game with Rogue-Like elements such as enemy scaling and powerups. Instead of the usual night formula the game is split into many fast paced hours, and you must manage your energy by taking naps which leave you vulnerable. Every hour you can get a powerup which can be as small as a stat up or the ability to parry the nightmares.

The game is inspired by many Rogue-likes such as Binding of Isaac, Fnaf, and it's many Fan Games, such as One More Night (Roblox) and Too Many Nights. The game was made previously for a Game jam with the theme "Only One", and was originally released with a v1 demo. The game has been polished ever since, with many new features such as enhanced music, sounds, sprites, and a more refined gameplay loop.

You are looking forward to batoning-down the hatches and spending the evening beside your hearth with a warming tot of rum.

However, as a tea clipper hoves into view over the horizon, your evening is about to take a very different turn...

title: The Passage
description: "The Passage" is a first-person exploration game set in a cold forest of a post apocalyptic world. You suddenly run out of gas in a distant area and your only way out is to search for 2 gas canisters in the area to help you on your journey, but... beware of the creatures in the forest.

title: Maribato! Version 2.0
description: A second version of Maribato!, called Maribato! Version 2.0 was released in Comiket 70 in 2005, and a third one, called Maribato! Plus, was released one year later, both presented as standalone discs. Both version add new characters and stages, and rebalance the existing ones.

title: Dot Fighters
description:
Dot Fighters is a 2006 2D Fighter Maker doujin game by Takase, the guy who made Arm Joe. It only contains 4 characters drawn in an extremely retro, pixel-art style. Despite the small amount of content, it is pretty infamous for its larger filesize. It contains a full soundtrack and voice acting. The game requires that your computer's locale be set to Japanese in order to play.

Looks can be quite deceiving with Dot Fighters, as it actually contains a fairly complex gameplay system, which is arguably better designed than Arm Joe's. Unfortunately, Takase has retained the same design ethic for Dot Fighter resulting in vastly overpowered characters and moves.

title: Warm Snow: The Ash of Nightmare
description: The Ash of Nightmare DLC will introduce a new mechanic that will be at the core of the DLC, the Nightmare system, as well as five new bosses, six true and false endings, 30+ new Nightmare abilities, a hundred combos, and several new NPC skins!

title: My Meta Farm
description:
My Meta Farm is a blockchain-based decentralized virtual reality platform where users can create, own, and monetize game experiences. It has the concept of a persistent, online, 3D universe that combines multiple different virtual spaces. My Meta Farm metaverse will allow users to work, play a game, and socialize together in these 3D spaces.

The metaverse will be driven by augmented reality, with each user controlling a character or avatar. For example, you might take a mixed reality meeting with a VR headset in your virtual office, finish work and relax in a blockchain-based game, and then manage your crypto portfolio and finances inside the metaverse.

title: Old Bira's Farm

title: Bank Robber
description:
Harry, a bank robber aims to rob a government bank, so he choose the day that the bank is open to visitors, and takes the opportunity to carry out the robbery. Upon arriving at the bank, learns some routines, of how things work and then begins to put his plan into practice.

The game takes place on a bank, in the center of the city, where you can explore various areas of the bank, as long as you have the appropriate access card, thus having different levels of security. In addition to that, you must complete some objectives to complete your mission. You will only have a rifle and a pistol as work tool, and you should assemble a strategy to position it properly, as the bank has metal detectors. You will have to face an area full of security, with strategy.

You will control Harry, in first person and you will have to do some tasks to successfully complete the robbery, disguising yourself as a bank clerk and arriving at the vault at the right time, all this with a lot of action, since the bank will be full of security guards, making it possible for you to complete your objective stealthily, without drawing too much attention. Enter the bank, loot the safe and try to get out alive.
The game experience provides a mix of strategy with a little suspense and action.

You appear in a room of an empty bunker with no memories at all. However, you find a diary with some strange notes.

title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein: Time Gate
description:
Our hero is a scientist, archeologist finds himself in an ancient undergrount caverns and tonnels built hundreds years ago. once this place was discovered by nazis but their expedition failed. Fighting through the dark corridors full of zombies, our hero finds an unique artifact - the time gate. using it, he teleports to 1945. germany collapses, the panic is everywhere.

The great luck is that artifact teleported our hero into the house basement. yet, resident of this house is a nazy scientist who works under the secret project of the third reich - retribution.

It turns out that there are two such gates and they're working in a pair. but nazi scientists found only one portal and they moved it into the secret laboratory placed in the ancient castle. If scientists would activate these gates then nazis would be able to change history turn on the planet.

Met scientist, in a hope to safe himself from the soviet army attack and find refuge on an allies territory offers some help in breaking that secret lab to our hero. for him its only chance to return back to his time. but from the other side, by activating time gate he'd put the world on a verge of disaster. so, his objective is to break into the lab, mine the time gate and have time using it to return back.

title: Tales of Vogar: Lost Descendants

Discover the secrets behind the Ascension, reclaim your homeland and take revenge in this story-driven RPG with a turn-based battle system. Free the people of Vogar from tyranny!

Lead a rag-tag crew of misfits, solve problems and fight for your life on a voyage that will put you at odds with an ancient evil that lurks in the shadows.

description: Elder Trial is a Rougelike ARPG game with Customizable Abilities,each Ability has a variety of Customizable Enhancement Options,and it can also Super Evolution!The game also has a large number of Weapons,Amulets,Random Events…You can have fun every time you play the game!

title: Scree
description: Scree is a roguelike shooter in a physics sandbox. Discover creative ways to fight through swarms of hostiles and outrun the supernova.

title: Beauty from Wisdom
description: After some brainstorming, although you are a little tired, enjoying the beautiful scenery may relax you.

title: Rose
description: “The journalist who lost his daughter unveils the veil of truth with his light.”

title: OverRider
description: A beat'em up style action game, thrilling, hardcore. You can choose between exploring a cyberpunk city, takeover enemies' bodies; or perform a surgery for implants? You play as a female doctor with a mysterious past, hunting at night in Yayoi City and perform surgeries on day in her clinic.

title: The Specter Chronicles: Episode 1 - The False Prophet
description: The Specter Chronicles is a cyberpunk visual novel that combines text-based adventure with turn-based tactical combat.

title: My Grandparents' Christmas Mystery
description: Grandma never showed up and Grandpa's tragic passing 3 days later left me in anger, confusion and sadness. I couldn't just let this go like it never happened, so I decided to go and find out what happened on my own. Will you survive a first-person psychological horror game and uncover the mystery?

title: Hentai 15 Puzzle 2
description: Hentai 15 Puzzle is a casual puzzle game. Rearrange the panels to complete the illustration! Complete the puzzles and get high-quality sexy images and animations of beautiful girls! You can view the images and animations you have obtained at any time in gallery mode.

title: Mr. Mower
description: Get mowing in this challenging top-down lawn mowing simulator. Traverse lawns that need a good mow down while avoiding an array of obstacles standing in your way. Help out your creator Hane finally complete a project by pushing trough and becoming the best mower you can be fo her.

title: The Orphanage
description: Zack has a simple choice.. Run. Escape. Survive. With lots of puzzles to solve, Keys to find, Puzzle items to obtain to help progress through the game to lead to your escape. Will you live to tell the tale of JJ Randalls Orphanage?

title: Stack World
description: Stack World is a physics puzzle game. Place all the given blocks and make sure they do not fall off the screen before the countdown timer hits 0. Enjoy over 100 levels of gameplay and use the level editor to create your own levels. Compete for the fastest times on the leaderboards.

title: Escape Dream
description: Help the character trapped in a dream to escape and go to work next day!

title: Last Memories
description: Dark short story about a girl who went travel with her father. This a point & click adventure that includes a deep plot with several endings.

title: Bat Hero
description: Equipped with your favorite weapon of choice, a Bat, embark in a whole new adventure with this brand new arcade action game and defeat the great evil that lurks in the shadows gathering new powers along the way. Ready ? Swing Away !

Collect different types of hogragon egg, raise them up, let everyone in the kingdom know how adorable these mythical beings are. Build houses and workshops, design this ranch to your heart's content!

title: Cook Fest
description: Create and design your own complex maze by strategizing your festival spaces! Cook and serve dishes to satisfy your customers. Level up to unlock to new ingredients and recipes. With unexpected roguelite elements and fast-paced gameplay, you can play solo or in chaotic co-op with your fellow chef!

title: Project Planet: Earth Vs. Humanity
description: Will you save your fellow humans, or destroy them as planet Earth? Impossible dilemmas and branching narratives create countless paths through cataclysmic disasters. Work with and against your friends in this 1v5 serious party game.

title: Doug's Nightmare
description: Doug's Nightmare is a bullet hell dungeon crawler with countless opponents, weapons, skins and quests.

description: Embark on a journey to rescue an old wizard friend in bara visual novel Burning Secrets! Mixing high fantasy adventure with gay romance themes, Burning Secrets lets you choose between multiple routes as you journey through lush and inspiring landscapes. See the lighthearted narrative to its end while developing relationships and unlock steamy CG scenes along the way.

title: Neanderthallica
description: Puzzle-metroidvania game set in a prehistoric world with a twist of sci-fi. Master the ability to change the weather, altering the environment and battles. Craft unique gear and weapons, and explore hidden secrets as you journey through humor-filled stone age.

title: Durka Simulator
description: Durka Simulator is a visual novel where you are waiting for adventure and mystery.You as the main player are being sought to take away your power.You and mysterious must not let them catch you!With you will always be your friends as a lemur named Zina, Mysterious and Larry

title: Wuxian
description: This is an independent game! It has a unique way of playing. I hope you can enjoy it! It's definitely worth it!

title: ToyBox Puzzle
description: These toys are all over the place! Arrange and organize the mess by fitting everything inside the grid in this relaxing and colorful puzzle game with over 100 levels that will test your critical thinking skills.

title: Lumien
description: Lumien is a fast-paced third-person platformer in which you explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and breathe life back into it. On your way past the various defenses, you'll be helped by the Orbs, fueled by the mysterious powers of the civilization.

title: Dungeon King
description: Dungeon King is a turn-based adventure puzzle. Player should smash all enemies on tile based map avoiding traps and plan his moves ahead.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Fantasy 2
description: Fantasy images!

title: Chinese SimpleLife
description: Chinese SimpleLife is a living environment simulation.

title: Speluncaphobia
description: A retro-inspired horror game where you play through different 'stories' of cavers that went missing.

title: Towers, Turrets, Turtles
description: Build and upgrade mazes of turrets to Defend your computer tower from the Pea Horde in this bright and colourful Tower Defence!

title: Escape: Left to die
description: In the deepest and darkest place on Earth no one can hear your scream.

title: Ordinary Day
description: In this not so ordinary psychological horror you must chose which path you take, your soul bound from birth to a demonic entity that's awaiting the day it can rebirth. Will you be the puppet it wants you to be or will you defy your destiny and rid yourself of the curse?

title: Redumption
description: Redumption is an action adventure game where you explore a town consumed by the waste. Fight bosses and retrieve precious items to save your friends from the witch's curse. Can you clean up the town and achieve redumption?

title: Arms Race 2
description: Arms Race 2 is PC strategy game based on the historical conflict between the USA and the USSR taken place in 20th century.

title: Ansoku
description: Ansoku is a relaxing, fun, simple, and yet challenging puzzle game with a high replay value.

title: Star Hive: The Menace
description: When humanity arrived on Mars, another civilization had arrived first. Then everyone knew that an invasion was imminent. Despite welcome preparations (a defense fleet with a freighter packed with missiles!), can humanity survive such an advanced invading horde?

title: GourdsTown
description: In an unfamiliar world, full of gourds, you are left to discover the struggles of living in this tiny town, in the middle of nowhere, with little resources you will need to uncover how to be useful, these town-gourds will need your help. In this adventure into the odd world of GourdsTown

title: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzles: Elves
description: From glittering white cities to hidden woodland outposts, the last remnants of elfkind are ever-vigilant against the growing darkness.

title: Scout Duty
description: Scout Duty - Top Down View is a game in which you need to direct the attacks of allies behind enemy lines. Be careful not to get hit yourself. The victory of the allies depends on your work.

title: Light of Alariya
description: Light of Alariya is an open-world, third-person, exploration puzzle game in which you traverse ancient alien temples and ruins to restore the power of the stars and awaken your sleeping civilization.

title: Clausum
description: Clausum is a first person psychological horror game that delivers a terrifying and immersive experience. Solve puzzles, explore different locations and discover true horrors. You have nothing to defend yourself and the house is looking for the next victim.

title: Chaos Storm: Strategy Edition
description: Chaos Storm: Strategy Edition is a magic style tower defense strategy game. You will be the leader of a specific camp, strengthen your power through constant battle, defend your strongholds, and constantly expand your territory, eventually becoming the ruler of the whole world.

title: Cats and Sokoban: Mimi's Scratcher
description: Move boxes, jump on everything in sight, Mimi loves challenges like jumping long distances. Help her reach her scratcher!

title: Empty Shell
description: Empty Shell will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a "recovery operation" without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.

description: Battle relentless cyborg police in a grim 23rd century dystopia. Experience fast-paced, bloody combat in this retro-inspired beat-'em up, action platformer. Recruit comrades and collect upgrades as you traverse hazardous environs to reach KAPITAL and take down the oligarchs in charge!

title: The Cursed Knight
description: The Cursed Knight is an action / platform / shoot‘em up game, based on a « die and retry » style and made with love and passion to pay tribute to the games made in the 90s.

title: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin'
description: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin' is a fast-paced FPS inspired by both retro and modern FPS games. Fingerbang combines elements from each in order to create a mix of its own, with a scoring system added on top to gauge your performance through the different levels.

title: Dropoff Dealer
description: Escape the police and cause endless destruction!!

title: Oathbound: Arena
description: Turn-based tactical PvP combat with high-fantasy RPG units. Meet Oathbound: Arena. This stand-alone PvP play mode of the upcoming MMORPG Oathbound lets you experience the core combat mechanics in engaging 1v1 online battles. Rally your oath-bound units and lead them all to victory!

title: Ozymandias: The World
description: Including a new map: The World!

title: Vampiric Tower Remix
description: A puzzle game where you can fly around as a bat and try not to get zapped by pumpkins.

description: The World has been in the midst of the winds of change. As a wandering artist, you end up in a mystical valley on your journey. Do you find inspiration for your art there?

title: Trailmakers: Airborne Expansion
description: A whole new campaign focused on the skies. Face the very first Trailmakers enemies in this expansion and enjoy new blocks, mechanics and missions.

title: Factory Trashcension
description: Factory Trashcension is a first-person open-world factory creation and optimization game with unlimited possibilities. Play with your friends and design efficient factories to Trashscend without worries and explore a vaporwave inspired universe!

title: As Guilty As the Moon
description: This is a realistic + survival oriented work. The murder of a girl in a ride-hailing service two years ago, brought your 12 fates back together. You wake up in a strange room, and things are getting weird around you. In the fog, not everything you see is the truth. Is everything real or unreal?

title: Party Shift
description: Get ready to party with your friends! Party Shift is a 2-8 player online party game where you will laugh, cheer and test your skills with our collection of exciting and unique minigames. For a night of endless entertainment and plenty of absurdity, grab your friends and shift into party mode.

title: ZigZagging Ski
description: Do you remember the last time you were on vacation?

title: Don't Wake God
description: Take on the role of Tieface - a dream figment, whose goal is to prevent his dreamer from waking up - if he wakes up, you die! Acquire abilities, outsmart your enemies, and most importantly... Don't Wake God.

description: Frayspace is a fast-paced local multiplayer space shooter with destructible maps, where up to 4 players can compete in muItiple game modes. It features several space fighters with different characteristics, and lots of weapons and power-ups that the players can learn to use for their advantage.

title: Nitrous Firetruck
description: Response time from this fire department has been slacking recently, so Nitrous Oxide has been installed on the firetruck. Located directly in between two cities, this firehouse is responsible for responding to fire calls at both cities and putting out the fires.

title: Metal Ascension
description: Metal Ascension is a horde survival game with rogue-lite elements. Upgrade your mech with over 200 pieces and more than 1 000 000 combinations.

title: Girl Fantasy
description: "Girl Fantasy" is a visual novel with a theme of youth. It tells the love story of the woman who went to play with the man during the summer vacation and stayed at the man's house, then moved the man with "sincerity" step by step, and finally stayed with the man.

title: Beau & Bow
description: Beau & Bow! A game about two sweethearts going on a lighthearted adventure. Best platforming challenges and solve puzzles! This game is inspired by handheld platformers from the late '80s and early '90s. Beau & Bow! A great introduction for those new to the platforming genre.

title: In the Backrooms
description: "God save you if you hear something wandering around nearby, because it sure as hell has heard you.."

title: Drag the Dead
description: A mind virus has taken hold of the population! Assume the role of drag-queen--zombie-slayer extraordinaire Zane Dmaaj and battle your way through mobs of NPZees, Fatties, SoiBois and more in the high octane, pearl clutching shooter Drag the Dead!

title: GeraScopia
description: When lost in the Depths, the only way to go is up. You will Escape- one way or another.

title: The Hero's Journey Through Time
description: On your journey you will meet a wide variety of heroes who are as different as fire and ice. You will meet brave warriors who risk their lives for their beliefs, but also benevolent magicians who use their powers for the good of others.

title: Army Troop
description: Army Troop is an old-school PvP World War 2 online first-person shooter. Reminding you of the good old days World War games.

title: Balance 100
description: This game requires controlling your hands to cure that slight OCD, Maybe occasionally drive you crazy, But don't worry. You'll probably be able to do it.

title: Elemental Survivors: Roguelike
description: Fight off hordes of enemies, slay Bosses, choose from a variety of upgrades and combine your spells to create unique and game-breaking builds In this auto-attacking roguelite.

description: A fantasy/adventure visual novel - as Freya Fae, track down the master assassin Orick Genn before he brings ruin to your home city. Rely on faithful companions and make friends with the citizens as you encounter dangers lurking through the streets.

title: KaiJu Girls
description: Kaiju Girls is a Visual Novel full of Monster Girls. The protagonist lost his memory in an accident and became a KaijuTamer, with the Kaiju girls in the Kaiju world full of danger adventure! In the wonderful and exciting adventure journey in the protagonist will slowly recall his memories.

title: Grow Your Pets
description: You found a mysterious egg. By deciding to open it, your life has changed forever. Now you are the Pet Grower. Everyone thinks that all these creatures are extinct. But you know that there is someone, who chose exactly you. Wander through the forest, fish for food, upgrade pets. This is your world!

title: Ratopia
description: Ratopia is a new game that has combined elements of both strategic survival and city building. With plenty of content available, and more planned, enjoy a vast world to adventure and populate with citizens! Build your own economical system to sustain your ideal city of Ratopia.

title: Whispers in the Moss
description: Whispers in the Moss is a retro JRPG with some of the most beautiful and detailed text-based graphics you've ever seen. Experience an epic story, a fun turn-based battle system, and a full custom soundtrack.

title: Slipgate
description: Explore a gloomy rooms of damned sci-fi base as a doomed marine, only survivor of the portal experiment. Save humanity like in 90's with your trusty shotgun, paving a way through ominous corridors inhabited by the shadows of sinners and evil spirits.

description: Manipulate time! Let's do mischief! Helpless 10 year olds are given only one weapon: a clock. This world will soon be destroyed...

In this story-driven game set in a futuristic 1983 LA, your playground will be detective work, head-to-head combat, and the ability to DYNAMICALLY interact with full motion video characters.

Multiplayer combat racing, with no driving!

Monster Racing League is a madcap multiplayer racing game made for maximum fun.
Let your monster drive while you activate offensive and defensive abilities to foil your rivals.

description: Join the guerrilla and take down the enemies on your vehicle in this 3D third-person shooting game! Gain EXP and upgrades by defeating enemies, choose new weapons and combat skills. Use gold gained from battles to buy tactical packs and combine them into your own combo and beat the enemies!

title: Miss Lu
description: Miss Lu is a lovely girl. After the encounter in the game, she yearns for it all the time!

title: Zotenhold
description: A massive open world online survival Co-Op Pvp wave-based medieval fantasy. Start with nothing - work your way up to build fortresses against the hordes of enemies or raid other warriors to obtain more loot. Enemies grow stronger in power each night. Choose your journey wisely.

title: Ice Nosfe
description: Help the Van Helsing brothers defeat Nosfe in the lands of Transylvania. Use the freeze rifle to defeat the bosses in each dungeon. 10 dungeons await you guarded by Nosfe and his hosts. NES or Commodore style. Solo and cooperative.

title: I Love Finding Birds
description: Your new feathered friends are taking you to the sky!

description: Go through a world where every living being is a slime and take down the slime dictator in this 2D side-scrolling action game. Discover the secrets of a world no more on your journey.

description: Pair up all animals with one of their own type to beat each puzzle level. Explore and utilize the unique traits of each animal type, tile, and object to find the optimal solution and earn all 3 stars! Make and share your own puzzles using the handy in-game editor.

description: Void Blitzing is a top-down action roguelite set in space with randomized levels and a challenging movement system. Fight over 18 unique enemies, Upgrade your ship, Modify your weapons and survive.

title: Maya's Dream
description: Solve the puzzle of her memory and bring a lost chapter of her life, back to life. Immerse yourself in her story and unravel the mystery of a stranger's recollections. As you piece together her memories, you'll discover how they connect us all, in a captivating and emotional journey.

description: Naïve Riri is a match 3 game. You need to go through many interesting levels, breaking power crystals and rescuing girls from Evil! You will see fun and addictive gameplay, beautiful music and incredible anime style!

description: You spawn in a dungeon that hasn't loaded yet and for some reason the other enemies (apart from you) want to attack you and you have to escape before they reach you (there could be many bugs).

title: Crowd Medieval City War
description: Fight with medieval soldiers in a fantastic city.

description: Web Crawlies - Due to a Lab Accident at the Pesticide Factory, All of the pests on Earth have grown 100 times their normal size, and the air is toxic to humans. You and your team are the last remaining people, can you survive?

description: Final Factory blends factory building with a rich universe to explore. Build a vast network of automated space stations and command a massive fleet against the hostile local aliens. Discover new technologies and unlock the secrets of an ancient civilization as you explore an infinite cosmos.

title: Project Backrooms
description: Project Backrooms is a 1-4 player exploration game. Explore the subluminal space known as the Backrooms avoiding entitles, puzzle solving, and discovering new levels. Free content updates with new levels, entities, etc.

title: Gladiator's Arena
description: Win in the Gladiator's Arena! Dominate and conquer!

title: The Secrets of Hope
description: Lose yourself in an immersive story, as you follow a man coming to terms with terminal cancer. Explore a surreal world from a first-person perspective. Revisit both new and old memories and follow along as he discovers The Secrets of Hope.

title: Tangy TD
description: Strategic tower defense where you play a witch, place class-based towers, equip them with items that grant powerful abilities, combine them, create unique builds & deal ridiculous amounts of damage! Customize your builds with a deep stat system and giant skill tree!

title: Anubis Clicker
description: An idle game about Buying Slaves. Hurry up, collect money and buy slaves, they will protect you from being burned and cursed by Anubis!

title: Sylvio and the Mountains Giants
description: An unknow evil has come to disturb the fragile balance of the land of Yahouna. Only a clever and pure being can save them all...

title: Rolando: Deluxe Edition
description: Roll, bounce and blast your squad of Rolandos across the Rolando Kingdom in this charming and delightful puzzle platformer

title: HappySnowMan
description: The purpose of this game is to travel through various platforms to the last island. Run to the stable on the last island. Depending on which platform you step on, the speed of movement and jumping power will vary. Don't forget to save your progress by pressing the 'E' key on the island's landmark.

title: Choppie's
description: A horror game where you have to escape a restaurant from a killer rabbit that has got a really sharp arm. Will you chicken out or face your fears?

title: Soul Passage
description: The fate of the unbound souls is in your hands. Take control of Obligor with lots of different skill and weapon combinations, and fight, and explore different planets in Soul Universe. A fantastic 2D hand-drawn Metroidvania with a unique quest and story system.

title: Train Simulator Classic: E60 Electric Locomotive
description: The massive and powerful General Electric E60 electric, born during the formative years of Amtrak and employed also by NJ Transit, now comes to Train Simulator Classic through the superb creativity of developer Reppo!

title: Lhama Clicker
description: Lhama Clicker is a clicker game about reproduce an infinitly amount of lhamas, to increase your production to ridiculous numbers

title: Destiny Duel
description: Simple to learn, impossible to master. Destiny Duel is a battle of the mind: in order to win, you must predict your opponent's every move. Attack, Guard, Recover, or Dodge. The choice is yours, and every choice matters.

title: Thronefall
description: A minimalist game about building and defending a little kingdom. Thronefall is a classic strategy game without unnecessary complexity, just some healthy hack-and-slay. Build up your base during the day, and defend it ‘til your last breath at night.

title: Nature
description: Nature is a relaxing game for modern people tired of everyday life. Become a dandelion seed and soar to the sky. Enjoy nature by listening to beautiful music. Fly farther and higher by interacting with nature. Heal your weary heart by playing Nature.

title: Hell Grinder
description: An intense 2D action rogue-lite game. Fight your way level by level through masses of demons and defeat bosses to delve deeper into hell. Collect demon souls to unlock permanent skills and weapons and become even more powerful.

title: Potion Brew
description: You need this game to forget about your life cares and become the best alchemist of this fantasy world with your friends! An alchemy shop keeper game offers you to brew potions for your customers, loot the ingredients in the forest, trade with sellers and compete with rivals.

title: Eternal Dreamers Rising
description: Eternal Dreamers Rising continues the popular battle-focused RPG series! New characters, items and challenges await! However you choose to fight, that's up to you!

title: The Wings of Dawn
description: The Wings of Dawn is an open world survival game either survive as a dragon or thrive as a human. The wildlife having evolved entirely differently to anywhere on earth will pose a challenge to everyone. Do what it takes to survive the day and make sure to be in shelter at night.

title: Emil: A Hero's Journey
description: As Nazi forces take his father, equipped only with his imagination and creativity, Emil goes on a journey to find him. Emil: A Hero's Journey is a Cinematic Puzzle-Platformer, combining intense action and creative puzzle solving. inspired by actual testimonies that took place during WW2.

title: Bar Simulator
description: You made a demonic deal to open your bar. With your friends, prepare cocktails, manage the chaos, and pay off your debt as you build your own bar empire.

title: Out of Nowhere
description: Be in control of a dog in an adventure action horror game set in a full of mysteries fantasy medieval open world where aliens took over and there is no one left to help you. Explore the different areas to find out how to defeat them.

title: Burg Wimmel
description: In Burg Wimmel the player has to find black and white hand-painted objects in the setting of a medieval castle and bring them to colorful life.

title: Ultimate Chicken Path
description: Waking up in a cold office, where do you look first? You're a random kid who went missing in entertainment complex. Let's play hide and seek with scary robots. Try to escape and tell everyone the truth about this place.

title: Lost Hotel
description: "Lost's Hotel" is a 3D horror adventure puzzle game which make you explore and find the way out from this mysterious hotel.You have to find the 4 codes that are hidden in different rooms to unlock the way down to the next floor. The last exit is on the lowest floor.

title: Tanks Battle
description: Defeat the enemy tank with the help of logic and tactics.

title: Call of the Abyss
description:
Call of the Abyss is a short atmospheric exploration game about descending into a deep mysterious hole in the middle of nowhere.

Carefully navigate precarious platforms, use the tools you discover, and push deeper into the dark, while resisting the whispering pull of the abyss itself.

How far down will you get before the darkness envelops you whole?

Developed by The Hole Gang: Mathue24, starbi, Henpemaz, Dice
in 5 days for the 2025 Spelkolllektivet Halloween Game Jam

title: Mini Knight's Journey
description: Mini Knight's Journey is a linear action-adventure platformer game about two twin brothers who, with their father, go on a journey to defeat the school bullies! Play as one of the two brothers and face this incredible adventure!

title: Chillquarium
description: Chillquarium is a relaxing idle game. Buy fish and raise them in real time, then sell them to turn a profit! Customize your aquarium and fill your collection with rare exotic fish, and unlock ultra-rare color variants!

title: Twistales
description: On the day of what she believed to be her ‘Happy ending’, Cinderella witnesses the collapse of her universe and the murder of her beloved. With the help of a magic grimoire, in search of the truth, she walks into various fairy tales, through worlds that are now disturbing and enigmatic. Fighting enemies corrupted by a strange curse, the princess becomes a mighty warrior, determined to resolve this chaos.

title: Coin Trader Simulator
description: Coin Trader Simulator is a cryptocurrency trade simulation. Buy low, sell high coins, get experience to level up your skills, sense trends and pump & dump coins. HODL to the moon!

title: Death Trick: Double Blind
description: The star magician of Morgan’s Traveling Circus has vanished, but the show must go on! Death Trick: Double Blind is a non-linear detective game where an unlikely duo must gather clues, question suspects, and reveal contradictions to unravel the mystery of the missing magician!

title: Subject F-011
description: Trapped in Area 51 on planet Earth, you must solve calculated puzzles to escape this strange planet. Puzzles consist of using enemies' mechanics to your advantage, moving objects to block enemies, and using items that alter parts of the rooms. A spiritual successor to Adventures of Lolo.

title: Kiro II: The Wizards Guild
description: Kiro II: The Wizards Guild is a fantasy based multiplayer dungeon crawler in which up to six players can join online together to navigate through semi-procedurally generated dungeons using a classic text command system to slay monsters, collect loot, and defeat dungeon bosses.

title: HuaBing
description: Pictorial Pie is a large multi-person online role-playing game in the Xianxia sandbox. With the growth of martial arts, the construction of the Zongmen and the Cave, and the free PVP battle, dangers and opportunities can be seen everywhere.

title: Lords of Infinity
description: Lead an ancient and crumbling noble house in a rich gunpowder fantasy setting. Lie, bribe, and conspire to secure power and prestige – or to save a doomed kingdom from itself.

title: Boom 42
description: Experience the nostalgia of the past, reimagined for the present, Boom 42 is a party game for up to 8 players. Join the Crew-42 on a unique adventure, testing friendship and discovering new exciting planets!

title: Frosty's Cold Hard Produce!
description: Twas the Night before Christmas and all through the streets not a creature was stirring but there were some dope beats, From across the town square, covered in a neon glow the gentleman's club was open and it was time to go.

title: Dragon's Treasure
description: Dragon's Treasure is a Roguelike action game, thousands of characters in a variety of weapons to choose from, free collocation with lighter, combination relic system affect , independent equipment upgrades and synthesis, the dice game events system randomly generated as a result,

title: Mobspawn
description: Absorb your surroundings and repurpose them as projectiles. Ascend the floors of Mobspawn Co in this top-down roguelike shooter.

title: Last Eclipse
description: Guardians and Gods fight for earth's balance.

title: Digital Pierrot Museum
description: Digital Pierrot Museum is a free virtual museum presenting the experience of navigating through a museum of digital and multimedia art through VR and Windows platforms.

title: Conspiracy: Tower Defense
description: Tower Defense game where you build units to destroy incoming waves of monsters.

title: Scholar's Mate
description: Scholar's Mate is an immersive first-person horror experience that puts you in the shoes of Judith, a young woman who wakes up in the gloomy facilities of a psychiatric hospital.

title: Saint Ceri
description: An adult otome with three love interests and monogamous and poly routes! Play as Saintess Ceridwen, an overworked saintess pressured to get engaged in two weeks' time. Can you find love with one -or more- of your suitors? Will you marry for love or duty, or find a way to avoid marriage entirely?

title: Path of Survivors
description: Path of Survivors is a multi-class auto-battler survival game with roguelite elements. Plan your path in the 1000+ nodes passive tree and craft gear to help your battlers survive in this world. You can have up to six units on your team auto-battling their way through hundreds of mobs on the screen.

title: Her Feet
description: The male protagonist is a white-collar, he has a little secret hobby, like massaging girls' feet. But it's not an easy thing to get strange girls to accept it. The player needs to help him meet the girl and gain her trust, get her to agree and enjoy the guy massaging her feet.

title: Paleophage
description: Paleophage is a third-person dinosaur survival horror game set in an urban resort. Fight or attempt to outrun over ten varieties of prehistoric creature, solve puzzles and uncover the secrets of the Paleophage, a prehistoric biological nightmare capable of reconstituting ancient life.

title: Emblem of Valor
description: Emblem of Valor is a rougelike deck-building game combined with RPG elements. Form your party, level up your characters, collect powerful cards and equipments to overcome all threats in the Shattered Realm and prove your valor!

title: Yuma
description: Step into the shoes of Yuma, a thief girl who wields the power to take over other people's bodies. In a quest to save her people, she can use another person's secrets and weaknesses. But it isn't exactly easy to find the resolve to fight for freedom when you're haunted by inner voices.

title: Dawn of Hell
description: Explore the cursed village and discover the sinister secrets it hides. Survive a terrible night and solve challenging puzzles as you try to escape the curse that plagues the place. Experience tension and fear at every step in this horror game.

title: Wild Seas
description: Defend the jewel of evil pirates! Wild Seas is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements, where your positioning can ensure victory

title: Kaila
description: Kaila is a visceral adventure set in an unrelentless, vicious world. Take part of an unforgiving story, leading a gang of four unique outcasts on their quest for survival, or die trying.

title: The Hidden Object Guru
description: The Hidden Object Guru - Find the Hidden Plushies in some of Your favorite Steam games from Archor Games and HO Guru Games !

title: Out of the Park Baseball 24
description: The 24th release of Out of the Park Developments' award-winning sports strategy franchise. Officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc., and KBO.

title: Sex Simulator: The Yacht
description: An interactive sex simulation game, featuring realistic high definition graphics and characters. You play the role a guy having fun on a luxurious yacht anchored near warm tropical islands.
