• Ryoma Growth Support Kit
• Sword Upgrade Materials Kit
• Gun Upgrade Materials Kit
• Third Division Armament Expansion Kit
• The Dragon of Dojima Skin

title: The Light in the Darkness
description: The Light in the Darkness tells the story of a working-class family of Polish Jews in France during the Holocaust. It is the first videogame to portray the Holocaust accurately, releasing free for educational purposes.

title: Isekai Rondo
description:
Sho, a young man who spends his days in an exploitative company in modern Japan, is reincarnated into a parallel universe as Shaw, due to an accident!
While the job given in his new life is 'Unemployed' and hardships continue with a bad luck party, one day he acquires the ultimate job as a Sage, suddenly becoming the strongest with ultra rare passive skills!
Aiming for the long-awaited mellow life he finds himself in a battle to defeat the Overlord after meeting the Hero Viola.
With exceptional passive skills that for example can change the future by returning before Game Over, get rid of enemies in turn-based battles by summoning spirits or managing mana plants, or even use the skills of monsters!
Complete quests and raise the guild rank so you can challenge deeper dungeon or other adventuring parties, too! With other elements such as a battle arena and the dungeon where treasure chests are automatically generated, your adventure against the Overlord's Army will surely be an unparalleled quest to finally gain a calm, modest life!

title: GearToyGear
description: Super fast-paced 3D shooter.

title: Nothing to Lose
description: A retro horror and adventure game.

title: Little Shaker: Summer Adventures
description:
A young boy named Cliff spends his dull vacation at home in Ritztown, a village on the outskirts of Clank City. One day, though, the family receives a mail-order package that would change his life. Using this new magical shaker and recipe book to synthesize items with various powers, Cliff concocts a medicine that turns the lonely village elder's pet pig into the speaking bipedal Piggy! This gives Cliff the courage to continue helping his neighbors and exploring the wider world. It was the most exciting vacation he'd ever have.

Little Shaker is a 2001 Windows action-RPG where you play as Cliff, adventuring around Ritztown, Clank City, and various locales as his summer goes from boring to bombastic. You collect ingredients and key items to create new ones using the titular tool, then use them to solve puzzles and complete quests. The game has you exploring a world of Americana, from grassy overworlds to many "dungeons" like the Ritztown cemetery. Talking to NPCs not only advances your connections with them, but will increase your total health as you earn friendship points.

title: Redline Royale
description: Redline Royale is an online battle royale racer where players must speed their way through a wild map and take down opponents with a uniquely destructive arsenal. Watch out for obstacles and sharpen your driving skills if you want to outlast the mayhem.

title: AquaHero
description: It seems that something strange has been happening at the bottom of the ocean for some time. It would be good to check!

title: Shadow Warrior 3: Definitive Edition
description: Take an adrenaline-fueled journey through a mythical Japanese realm in the Definitive Edition of Shadow Warrior 3, packed with new features, and enjoy an ultraviolent blend of fast-paced gunplay, razor-sharp melee combat, and spectacular free-running movement.

title: Batsugun: Saturn Tribute Boosted
description: Batsugun is a vertical scrolling shooter arcade game released in 1993 by Toaplan. The game attracted attention for the large number of bullets shot by both enemies and allies. This led many games to adopt the same kind of play. Batsugun thus became the pioneer of the bullet hell genre. The “Special” version of the game was then released on home consoles. The Special version offers new features with a better sound.

title: Samurai Shodown V Perfect
description: Samurai Shodown V Perfect is the 2nd upgraded version of Samurai Shodown V (following Samurai Shodown V Special), the 13th main installment of the Samurai Shodown series and the ninth game of the official chronology (if considered the non-canonical games). It's an exclusive game released only for the Samurai Shodown NeoGeo Collection. The game was originally supposed to be the final Neo Geo game but was never previously officially released

title: Volleygon
description: Volleygon is a raucous 2-on-2 anti-gravity showdown where geometric shapes flying through space take center stage! Utilize the ceiling and floor to bounce, lob, and smash the ball into your opponent's zone! Just be careful as the ball can change gravity on a whim, but so can your opponents!

title: Clay Soldiers: The Raiders
description: Introducing the Raiders alliance! These barbarians plunder gold from every kill, start with a huge economy, and have a lot of cheap fast units at your disposal! combine their abilities and army with others of the same faction to create an unstoppable early game powerhouse!

title: Clay Soldiers: The Immortals
description: Introducing the Immortal alliance! Part of the undead faction; these creatures are hard to kill! Nearly every unit has a chance to be revived after death! Includes a collection of monsters, vampires, and lynches. Raid your opponents with undead creatures and variants of the everyday zombie!

title: Clay Soldiers: The Faithful
description: Generate extreme amounts of faith and use that faith to summon the strongest units in the game. Support you allies with powerful healers and blessers or convert your enemies to boost your faith production! Control the power archangel or wage war with an immortal chosen.

title: Noobs Want to Live
description: Noobs Want to Live is a fast-paced roguelike featuring several characters and a large pool of skills to choose from (that synergize with one another, too!) Fight, kill, grow. Each run is a new chance to create a steamrolling build!

title: Tempus Rail
description: Trapped in the temporal loop, fight your way to the front of the train and destroy the engine before the day resets. Tempus Rail is a story rich, First-Person, Roguelike Deck-Builder set in the Wild West. Play to escape or take your time to uncover the mystery behind the train and its passengers.

title: Ria
description: In this open world adventure, you'll be exploring and solving as you uncover the story of Ria, the magical capybara looking to stop the Dark soul from taking over. With your inner power along the way, and experience a journey driven by your choices to save the world.

title: Feudal Fantasy Incremental
description: Feudal Fantasy is an active incremental game in which you rebuild a town once lost to tragedy as its lord, by managing upgrades, new buildings and recruiting the wisdom of fantasy races.

title: 11 Years Ago
description: 11 Years Ago is a puzzle-solving single player adventure game made with Unreal Engine 5 and it is the final project of the Red 32 team of BigRock School.

title: Notes of the Young Lady: In Turbulent Times
When Sword Sinks Into Flowers
description: Ford Gillia Kingdom, where the ancient magicians' legend still remains. On a certain day Adelite, belonging to the kingdom's chivalric order was cast a death-promising curse by a man who identifies himself as a "magician". The feud between knights and magicians is beyond epochs...

title: Shadow of the Night
description: Build and survive inside the desolate forest.A struggle for survival in the north of Sweden.

title: Cargo Truck Simulator 2023
description: Become a master truck driver by performing cargo missions in this truck game.

title: Fiery Rivaz
description: Fiery Rivaz - Reanimate Shmups !!! It's time to revive the shmup genre. You can expect a shooter that focuses on varied and innovative level design. It is accompanied by cool 3d graphics and a great soundtrack.

title: In the Building: Hamsters
description: Is a game where you have to find all the cute hamsters. Hamsters will hide in all houses. Search every corner of the room, move the pillows, open the nightstands, check the toilet.... Hamsters can hide in the most unpredictable places.

title: GPRO: Classic Racing Manager
description: Manage your racing team, driver and a car, prepare setups and strategy for every race, plan your season and budget, analyze race telemetry.

title: Local News with Cliff Rockslide
description: Welcome to Local News, it's the small-town-celebrity Cliff Rockslide (seven subscribers, ahem) with his trustworthy cameraperson, YOU!

title: A Traveler to Unknown Thule
description: Adventure Game Traveling around Iceland.

title: Dark Night with Floppa
description: Dark Night with Floppa is an emotional horror from the first person about searching for pictures in a dark forest. The gameplay is simple – You found yourself in the wilderness and now you need to explore this place to collect 8 pictures of cats that someone hid somewhere nearby. Find all the pictures before the Big Floppa finds you. There is no complicated pumping, complicated plot or expensive special effects in this game. Only your lonely character, the night forest, a spot of dim light from a flashlight and a Big Floppa.

title: Hand2Hand Project
description: The Hand2Hand project is a fighting game... of hands! Use everyday object in everyday places out of boredom in epic battles between... yourself.

title: Parts Unknown
description: Parts Unknown is a single player fighting game aiming to recapture the spirit of old fighting platformers with a unique twist.

title: How 2 Escape
description: How 2 Escape is an escape-simulation game where two players will need to cooperate on asymmetrical gameplay and devices. "Talk together. Help each other." will be your new motto to survive in How 2 Escape.

title: Dark Paradise Nigelopia: Mini Mix
description: A 2D action game that takes place in the Dark Paradise of Nigelopia, where girls are large and in charge! The guys are pretty cool too, but the big butt is the ULTIMATE weapon! Also there’s an optional Fart Mode, which gets very noisy! Zip across the colorful Dark Domains to take on your opponents!

title: Magnetik
description: Are you a good puzzle solver? Ready to face new challenges and enjoy the puzzles? Check Magnetik!

title: My Lovely Pets
description: Discover the joy of hidden object games with "My Lovely Pets"! Explore over 100 adorable pets in stunning locations, solve mini-games, and uncover playful fuzzies hiding in unique spots. Relax, search for hidden treasures, and enjoy the cutest adventure!

title: Who Run the City
description: Who Run The City is a Third-Person Multiplayer funny game where gangsters are doing illegal stuff (stealing money, selling drugs ...) and the police have to stop them.

title: Golgotha
description: Dare to explore the most haunted vicinity in all of England? You will leave no stone unturned as you walk along the eerie grounds of the Black Waters Station and uncover the horror that lies within.

title: Unheard: Voices of Crime Edition
description: Put on your headphones and step back into the past. Use the voices you hear to return to crime scenes, tracking down each individual involved and solving the cases. But where do the voices come from? Can you trust what you hear? And what's the mysterious thread weaving all of these cases together?

title: Hiyoku no Tori
description: An occult-mystery-adventure game set in Kyoto—detectives investigate to solve bizarre and complex cases. What did Kamotan detectives finally uncover on their way to the truth of these cryptic incidents?

title: Berry People
description: Berry People is a game where you take photos of as many berries as you can find! You can find these silly creatures hiding everywhere in the forest. Explore each area fully to discover all of its secrets! Take a breath of fresh air while relaxing in a field of flowers, climb a very tall hill or take your time and try to count all of the falling -- Wait is that a berry? Quickly! Take a picture!

title: Police Car Armored: Cop Simulator
description: If you like police games, this police car driving simulator is for you.

title: Morbid: The Lords of Ire
description: Risk insanity in the gruesome slash-em-up Morbid: The Lords of Ire, with brutal combat and souls-like elements. Defeat the five Lords of Ire as you fight for your life across tortured landscapes, rending the evil Gahars of their flesh-bound forms.

title: Clicker Guardians
description: A true RPG clicker in which you need to loot, craft and refine your equipment to come out on top. Loyal guild members will help you along your mystical journey to defeat goblins, skeletons and adequately dressed frogs!

title: Aby's Playground
description: Do you want to roam in an open world, discover new things, find new weapons, kill monsters and upgrade your character?

title: Directive 8020
description: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

title: Multiplayer Cowboys
description:
The Town is being taken over by Ghosts. Can You and Your Posse Survive ?

This is a Fast Paced RPG Survival game.

The game includes a Single & Multiplayer CO-OP system via Steam.
You can Invite Your Steam Friends with the ' + ' Icon on the Main Menu and Team Up!

title: Townseek: Jam Version
description: Townseek: Jam Version is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you fly around the world. Travel far and wide, discover exotic landmarks, trade with towns, fish, mine, farm, and complete your journal's collection!

title: Vanessa
description: Vanessa is a superhero fighting simulator where you fight shadow bosses. Sexy spider ninja girls like Dragon Gwen your step sister, train you to fight crime and web like a spider rope hero using a grappling gun. Man, use the power of spider martial arts in this amazing third person hero game.

title: Race on Ice 2022 Pro
description: Race On Ice 2022 Pro is an ice racing game where you can drive 28 drivers of the year 2021-2022 of the category Pro and Lite . The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race.

title: Race on Ice 2021 Pro
description: Race On Ice 2021 Pro is an ice racing game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2021 . The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race. But be careful because depending on the driver you take, it will be more difficult to win the race.

title: Race on Ice 2020 Pro
description: Race On Ice 2020 Pro is an ice racing game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2020 . The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race. But be careful because depending on the driver you take, it will be more difficult to win the race.

title: Super Ball Mania
description: Super Ball Mania is an action-packed minigame-based party game. Compete against your friends to earn the most points by the end of the game, and become a Super Ball Maniac.

title: Wholesome Monster Girl Academia
description: A wholesome high school experience with monster girls set in a Catholic school. Befriend and try to romance with a harpy girl, dragon girl, slime girl, succubus, or a vampire. Along the way, learn and apply lessons from your faith to improve your relationship with God and the girls.

title: Upgrade 2021-22: Bionic Traveler
description: A compilation of the collaborative efforts of the University of Pennsylvania Game Research and Development Environment's programmers, artists, writers, and sound engineers over the 2021-2022 academic year. Fight our enemies, view our art, explore our scenes, and listen to our soundtrack!

title: Silent Love
description: This is a terrorist decryption adventure game that took place in 1913.

title: Another Pokémon Game
description: Another Pokémon Game is another Pokémon game.

title: Labyrinth of Galleria: The Moon Society - Quest Set
description: Delve into the depth of the Labyrinth of Galleria with this DLC Bundle which includes three quests: Special Soul Pact Quest, Great Hat Quest, and Great Boots Quest.

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Commedia Della Morte
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter, two Legendary weapons, and one Legendary consumable: Scaramuccia (Hunter), Opera Glasses (Winfield M1873C Marksman), Macchinista (Sparks Pistol), and Spaccagambe (Concertina Trip Mine).

title: Animal Academy
description: Animal Academy is a rogue-lite casual game where you survive for 10 minutes with a cute hedgehog. Defeat 4 stages using a variety of weapons and skills learned from the 8 masters at the animal school. Use the coins to strengthen the perk that can borrow the power of your masters to become stronger.

title: Dream Bright
description: Dream Bright is an unique story-driven game that blends exploration, platforming and stealth into a short journey. Dive into the imagination of Lucy while she creates her own adventure.

title: SpiderAttack
description: You are a spider who must capture insects for food, the goal of the game with your web that you weave and to bring the insects as close as possible to their respective colored web so that it is captured.

title: Gradient
description: Uncover the secrets of a mysterious world as you venture forth as a lone warrior in Gradient, the stylized single-player, open-world and arena shooter.

title: Hidden World 3 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Hidden Post-Apocalyptic 2 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzles: Forests
description: In glade and glen, copse and clearing, strange life forms live amongst the trees. The forests are home to countless flora and fauna that even the elves have yet to discover.

title: Alpen Ghoul
description:
Alpen Ghoul is an exploration/stealth game. Sliding might grant you a quick escape, but the price of safety is high. It may cost you all of your progress. There are multiple routes with varying difficulties, so if you're struggling, keep trying different paths. You will die, more than once, but with each death you will be able to explore further, hide better, and slide faster.

Can you find everything the mountain hides?

title: Insomnia's Window
description: You're an overworked receptionist that's been having a tough time at work. As a result, your sleeping habits have suffered a bit and you're unable to do much sleeping at all. Who better to escort you to dreamland than your boyfriend? <3

title: Fallout 1.5: Resurrection
description: Fallout 1.5: Resurrection is a total conversion mod for Fallout 2, featuring a new several dozen hours long campaign: set in the state of New Mexico, at a point between Fallout 1 and 2.

title: Fallout: Nevada
description: Fallout: Nevada is a total conversion mod for Fallout 2, featuring a wholly new campaign, taking place prior to the events of the first game.

title: Fallout: Sonora
description: Fallout: Sonora is a total conversion mod for Fallout 2, featuring a wholly new campaign, taking place after the events of the first game, in the area around the titular Sonoran Desert.

title: Bagdex
description: The journey begins! Collect over 160 creatures inspired by Brazilian culture, manage and customize your base, conquer challenging battles, and unravel the mystery behind this fantastic world!

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Festival of Friendship
description: The Update 3 for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings Mirabel (from Encanto) and Olaf (from Frozen) to the Valley and unravels the mysteries from the Frosted Heights biome. Some quality-of-life improvements and a Star Path inspired by Disney's 100th anniversary is also part of the update.

title: Urban Assault: Metropolis Dawn
description:
Metropolis Dawn is an official expansion pack for Urban Assault, featuring two new singleplayer campaigns, maps as well as new units. It was set to release in summer of 1999.

A fully playable build of it surfaced online in 2007.

title: SnowRunner: 1-Year Anniversary Edition
description:
The 1-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game SnowRunner and its Year 1 Pass.

Get ready for the next-generation off-road experience!

The game puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful vehicles as you conquer extreme open environments with the most advanced terrain simulation ever. Drive 40 vehicles from brands such as Ford, Chevrolet, and Freightliner as you leave your mark on an untamed open world.

Overcome mud, torrential waters, snow, and frozen lakes while taking on perilous contracts and missions. Expand and customize your fleet with many upgrades and accessories including an exhaust snorkel for heavy waters or chain tires to battle the snow.

Ride solo or with friends in 4-player co-operative multiplayer!

title: A Hat in Time: Ultimate Edition
description: A Hat in Time: Ultimate Edition contains A Hat in Time and its two DLCs, Seal the Deal and Nyakuza Metro.

title: Party Hard 2: Collector's Edition
description: Welcome back to the extended Party Hard universe! Choose from hundreds of ways of dealing with noisy partygoers, incidentally destroy a drug syndicate, and save the Earth from an alien invasion. May the chickens be with you!

title: Spellarium 9
description: Each level is designed with love, like a piece of art, in order to keep the game interesting, not just mindlessly moving tiles.

title: Sinister Squidward
description:
What would happen if Squidward finally went insane and decided to wreak havoc on the residents of Bikini Bottom?

Take control of the mean cashier as he transforms into a menacing monster armed with an AK-47, then play as Sandy to save Spongebob and Patrick from this tentacle horror!

title: SM2
description: SM2 is a modded Call of Duty client based off the MWR engine with all new features, weapons, perks, streaks, maps, QOL changes and more, all designed on top of our revamped gameplay to create a fun and balanced experience.

title: Train Sim World 3: Northeast Corridor - New York: Trenton
description: Experience the City that never sleeps. From the Big Apple to New Jersey suburbs, non-stop action awaits aboard premier electric traction. Serve the East Coast well with NJ Transit and Amtrak passenger equipment, brought to life in Train Sim World 3: Northeast Corridor: New York - Trenton.

title: Train Sim World 3: Union Pacific Heritage - Livery Collection
description: Celebrate the history of US rail with this stunning mix of Fallen Flag schemes, haul freight in colorful style with the UP Heritage Livery Collection for Train Sim World 3, which depicts 6 liveries carried by a fleet of Union Pacific's SD70ACe locomotives!

title: Train Sim World 3: Amtrak's Acela
description: America's Fastest Train! Race along Northeast Corridor rails in iconic style, reaching incredible speeds through multiple states and suburbs. “Train approaching, please remain behind yellow line”, Amtrak's Acela blasts into Train Sim World 3!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: Pro Train DB/DR Auxiliary Train
description: The standard DR auxiliary train developed and built by the Deutsche Reichsbahn (DR) between 1973 and 1979, is mainly referred to as the Einheitshilfszug (EHZ). The train is set of locomotive-hauled rail vehicles for technical assistance in the event of operational disruptions or railroad accidents.

title: Trainz Plus: Pro Train DB/DR Auxiliary Train
description: The standard DR auxiliary train developed and built by the Deutsche Reichsbahn (DR) between 1973 and 1979, is mainly referred to as the Einheitshilfszug (EHZ). The train is set of locomotive-hauled rail vehicles for technical assistance in the event of operational disruptions or railroad accidents.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Pro Train DB/DR Auxiliary Train
description: The standard DR auxiliary train developed and built by the Deutsche Reichsbahn (DR) between 1973 and 1979, is mainly referred to as the Einheitshilfszug (EHZ). The train is set of locomotive-hauled rail vehicles for technical assistance in the event of operational disruptions or railroad accidents.

title: I'm on Merrymaking Watch
description: A short, Christmas themed game where you scan through security camera feeds for anything Christmas related. If you see anything festivous, be they Christmas ornaments, gifts, or perhaps even Santa himself, report them immediately!

title: The Orc Invasion
description: Game is a narrative driven 2,5D platformer shooter. It's based on collecting gold and resources from battlefield, learning new recipes, crafting everything necessary for yourself, your army and your mobile castle from basic to advanced.

title: HellFurnace
description: Go to save the world from HellFurnace. HellFurnace is a 2D boss rush game in which the protagonist, who has fallen into another world, defeats the boss. Avoid enemy attacks to collect beads and create weapons to defeat the boss.

title: Finding Hannah
description: Hannah’s got it all: a well-paying job, a fancy coffee machine, and a comfortable life – so why isn’t she happy? Explore beautiful scenes and find hidden objects to learn more about the characters and their journey of self-discovery. The story of a family: experience a light-hearted drama featuring three generations of women - their loves, their struggles, and their joys. Hannah is a woman searching for answers. She turns to her grandmother, Eva, and her mother, Sigrid, to find that each of them has her own unique story to tell. How are their hopes and dreams passed down through the generations?

title: Vaccine Case
description:
Store, mix, and pour the vaccine out to eradicate the virus.
Your brains’ll be pouring out too with the soaring difficulty of this “gusher” puzzle game. That’s what Vaccine Case’s all about.

title: Zaccaria Pinball: Pinball Champ 2018 Table
description: A modernized version of the original Pinball Champ table from 1982.

title: Rekt!: The Forge
description: Crazy jumps, stunts, and a brand new car on your disposal - forge the best tricks and discover a brand new map, full of ramps, new challenges and much more!

title: Island Saver: Dinosaur Island
description: Dust off your trusty Trash Blaster and get ready for a new super-sized adventure! Another Savvy Island needs your help! And this one's filled with fearsome dinosaur bankimals!

title: Omega Labyrinth Life: Additional Dungeon - Mystic Omega Spot
description: Adds the additional dungeon 'Mystic Omega Spot'.

title: Crazy Guy
description: Crazy Guy is the story of a space tramp who travels across worlds with the simple goal of clearing out enemies. You joined a war nomad as he explored a small cluster of enemies on a secret planet.

title: SkyIsland
description: "SkyIsland" is made by a group of students in a college, quarter-view action-adventure game. Enjoy the wonderful world and beautiful environments as you help the protagonist, Pino, fix his broken plane and defeat monsters to return home safely.

title: Cubosphere
description: Cubosphere is a 3D remake of a classic game Kula World on PSX. The game concerns controlling a ball in order to collect all keys and reach the exit of the level.

title: The Backrooms: Liminal Reality
description: Explore the backrooms and liminal spaces while trying to find your way out while you fight with the feeling like you are in a dream, or if you have just entered one of your own.

title: Champ's Nightmare
description: Champ's Nightmare is a horror immersive audio game for the visually impaired which prioritizes ears over eyes.

title: Splat Death Salad
description: A multiplayer FPS game with several modes to choose from & customize. Made for 7DFPS in June 2012.

title: Anime vs. Evil: Apocalypse
description: In Anime vs. Evil you will fight the monsters that take over the whole world by mystical polygonal magic. Find the survivors, look for the supplies, beat the story mode and finally finish with this mess!

title: Flame of Rebellion
description:
Flame of Rebellion is a freeware RPG-Maker 2000 game by the creator Lil_Lucy.
The leading global powers are threatened by an unknown force, that calls themselves by the name of "The Empire". No one knows how, but they possess technology that is way beyond what should be capable by modern human standards and seem to be unstoppable.
Even though these scary events happen all around the globe, some are yet mentally unaffected by all of this and live their lives like every other day, which includes the protagonist Roland. His day starts off as a normal school day, but since a lot of bus drivers called in sick, out of fear of a possible war, he is about to arrive late. When he arrived at the school, even his town is falling under attack by this mysterious force.
Being one of the few survivors of the attack, he and the others form a local rebellion group, in their attempt to stop the enemy.

title: StarSim
description:
Starsim is a sci-fi multi-genre (pausable real-time, text quest, Turn-based tactic) computer game where you can become anyone.

Players explore a partly-randomly generated galaxy, with each sector featuring multiple stars and planets. This leads to a universe with hundreds of planets, each with their own economy, government, and opinion of the player.

The game is not limited by borders and allows players an opportunity to influence the branching storyline. At the same time, the larger and more expansive game world lives and develops by itself. In Starsim players will have an opportunity to test their skills not only in outer space, but in turn-based tactics as well.

title: Tea for the King
description: Make a cup of tea on a rainy day. You must make a Tea for King.

title: Live Factory
description:
Action-adventure platformer. Great graphics. Explore the underground factory!

Explore an underground factory hidden from eyes, filled with dangers, secrets and spatial puzzles. Use your wits and reaction to reveal all the secrets!

Excellent 3D graphics and music will immerse you in the atmosphere at their best. Responsive controls will help you to run away from trouble and make accurate jumps to the intended goal.

Features:
• Interesting gameplay
• Unusual visual style and beautiful 3D graphics
• New game mechanics and situations during your passing through
• Game made with a soul

title: Sushi Bar Express
description:
Experience the dizzying life of a top sushi chef as you prepare sushi dishes in this exciting time-management cooking adventure.

Serve hordes of demanding patrons and build-up your menu by purchasing more recipes, to take with you to bigger and better restaurants.

Start a career as a sushi chef and absorb all of the wise teachings of your master. Slice, dice, roll and hammer sushi, and then serve it to customers as quickly as you can. Make sashimi, roll uramaki, pour sake, and feed the hungry hordes to collect cash. Catch coins as they fly by, and use the money you make to upgrade your equipment and purchase more recipes.

The characters and tone of Sushi Bar Express are presented in a light-hearted and comical style, designed to appeal to all types of players – ranging from children to adults, and all genders. Whimsical humour offers a counterpoint to the manic plate-juggling gameplay and helps players to feel comfortable and entertained throughout the game.

title: Poly Jigsaw: Cats
description: Poly Jigsaw: Cats is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game, with a cute kitties.

title: Pogo Girlfriend
description: A foddy-like pogo game with a lot of heart! Play with your friends!

title: Offroad Jeep 4x4: Car Driving Simulator
description: In this offroad game, become a great 4x4 car driver in a big town.

title: Grip on Reality: Endless Night
description: Play as the Nightmare Stalker, a void realm assassin focusing on speed and precision to kill its enemies and unleash its power of the endless night.

title: Grip on Reality: Bound and Forgotten
description: Play as the Bound God, a giant creature who wreaks havoc on the enemy through terrifying swipes of his claws and great bursts of fire.

title: Drone Delivery
description: Are you tired of waiting for your order for hours? It is said that if you want to change the world, it starts with you!

title: Castle Destroyers
description: Gather resources, build, power up and battle. Choose between two different teams in Castle Destroyers, build your castle with your teammates and attack the enemy. No stopping until you destroy the other side!

title: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings - New Quest: Piles of Coll Quest
description: A quest that will help to obtain large amounts of Coll will appear on the Notice Board at the Castle Plaza: - Revitalizing Poultice

title: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings - New Quest: Loads of Exp Quest
description: A quest that will help to obtain large amounts of Exp will appear on the Notice Board at the Castle Plaza: - Legendary Puni

title: Ark: Ragnarok
description: Journey through an expansive 144 sq. kilometer environment where elements from The Island, Scorched Earth, and all new biomes are combined to bring the ultimate survivor experience. Whether tackling the extreme cold atop the highest mountains, harvesting resources from an active volcano, or just searching for that perfect base location, Ragnarok plays host to explorers and base builders alike. But survivors beware, Ragnarok houses such creatures as Polar Bears, Ice Wyverns, and a mystical creature many have yet to tame in the ARK universe. Ragnarok boasts many unique features such as: custom explorer notes, challenging dungeons, dungeon bosses, active hot springs, unique pickup-able/harvestable resources, new biomes, an active volcano, unique tree platform locations, environmental traps, unique ruins, and so much more combined with a beautiful world to explore.

title: Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince - Toby's Dream
description: This is a DLC level in which the three heroes help Toby the Dog reunite with the prince. The level appears on the map after completing the Prince's Dream level in the main game.

title: Phantom Rose 2 Sapphire
description: Phantom Rose 2 is a roguelike deckbuilding game by solo developer & artist makaroll. Fight and collect powerful cards as Aria, lost in her cherished school that’s now corrupted by evil creatures.

title: Rootman: Bodycam Horror Footage
description: Realistic first person bodycam horror. On October 26, 2005, a policeman from the 46th department disappeared in the forest. The found footage from his body camera showed how evil it is in the forests.

title: EarthBound 64 Experience
description: EarthBound 64 Recreation is a PC fangame created by Team Pollysoft. It aims to recreate the Spaceworld '99 demo of the unreleased Nintendo 64 version of Mother 3.

title: The Collector
description: Multi story collection, experience many different nightmares, integrate physics, plot, battle and other rich content, and provide horror games with continuous content updates.

title: UC Love
description: A humorous and wholesome anime-style dating simulator based on personified University of California schools + more! Romance 2D-girls (or guys) with 3D personalities in a cute and funny visual novel format! There are various locations to visit, minigames to play, and secrets to find!

title: CoronaFighter
description: A coronavirus-themed shoot-em-up in the classic arcade tradition.

title: Coronavirus Evolution
description: Choose a character and fight online to get maximum antidote and cure as many coronavirus people as possible!

title: Pocket Mini Golf: Fairway
description: Spend even more time with Pocket Mini Golf. Old rules, new holes - all here in Fairway DLC!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Amtrak P40DC Loco
description: Through the craftsmanship of accomplished developer DTM, the original version of the stylish Genesis diesel - the P40DC (also often called the Dash 8-40BP) comes to Train Simulator Classic along with an all-new complete Amtrak Superliner consist!

title: The Forgotten Concluder
description: “The Forgotten Concluder” is a third person perspective 3D Role-playing game base on the ancient Chinese fantasy wu-xia world. Being a young teenager Shen Zi-Jun that grew in a isolated valley, taking on a adventure to discover a great secret and his true dentity.

title: Inky & Blinky
description: Join Inky & Blinky and all their friends in this addictive little puzzle game where your goal is to get Blinky back to Inky.

title: MiniBob
description: MiniBob is a 2D side view puzzle game, focused on exploring the enviroment, and getting to know the characters. Almost every object has something to tell, some times nothing important, but other times…

title: Kanji Islands
description: Come to Kanji Islands and learn all the Kanjis and vocabulary necessary to become a proficient Japanese reader!

title: Puzzle Pieces 4: Farewell Dear Winter
description: With this Jigsaw gameplay and dazzling collection of puzzles, the beauty never stops. The pictures are a mix of beautiful winter and spring scenes. There are a lot of options to choose, from puzzle shape and number of pieces. You will love to use your own images and create puzzles from them.

title: The Smile Alchemist
description: Follow the growth of a young alchemist aiming to become the best in the world!

title: Green Soldiers Heroes
description: Become a Super Soldier and defeat the terrorists.

title: The Pale Beyond: Collectors Edition
description: The Pale Beyond Collector's Edition includes the base game and the Original Soundtrack, featuring a curated selection of 19 tracks from the game.

title: The Pale Beyond: Deluxe Edition
description: The Pale Beyond Deluxe Edition includes the base game, the Digital Artbook and the Deluxe Soundtrack, which collects all 51 tracks from the game.

title: Gal*Gun 2: Complete Edition
description: Gal*Gun 2, the notoriously lewd rail-shooter is back with the Complete Edition, which brings together all the existing DLC in one tidy package! As you bring girls euphoria and hoover off their skirts, you can now get all of their outfits in one go, as well as enjoy the game in VR for a more immersive experience!

title: Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne - HD Remaster Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Shin Megami Tensei III Nocturne HD Remaster Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Maniax Pack
• Mercy and Expectation Map Pack
• Shin Megami Tensei BGM Pack
• Merciful Difficulty

title: THZ
description: THZ is an arcade style top-down shooter with an emphasis on the greatest substance known to man. It's pretty dope.

title: Farming Tractor Simulator: Big Farm
description: In the farm game, you can drive a 3d tractor and farm.

title: Papa's Freezeria Deluxe
description: After starting a relaxing job at the oceanfront ice cream shop on Calypso Island, things get hectic when all of Papa Louie's crazy customers arrive on the island! Now it's up to you to single-handedly craft and serve tasty sundae treats throughout the year. You'll whip up delicious Freezer sundaes by pouring ice cream, adding mixables and syrups, blending sundaes, and finally adding whipped cream and toppings for that perfect summertime treat. You'll need to multitask between each area of the restaurant, where each station is a unique hands-on experience.

title: Ball Animals
description: Animal Ball is a local party game, where 2 to 4 animal balls fight against each other...Use your bouncy belly to bounce others away!

title: Wak Attak
description: A retro-arcade adventure. It's Pacman, with weapons. Take our hero through 29 devious mazes fighting ghosts, dragons, vampires, and more. Cast powerful spells, find fun treasures, and try to rescue the rest of the Waka Waka's. Wak Attak is classic, retro goodness.

title: Gomorrah
description: Gomorrah ﻿is a GZDoom mapset consisting of 6 brand-new maps, powered by ukiro's amazing OTEX texture set. In Gomorrah, you'll be traversing three different locations - an abandoned mine/techbase, a medieval castle and a fortress in Hell - in search of three skull keys. Each skull key is going to be locked behind a puzzle which you'll have to solve. Once you have all three of them, you must use them to open a gate beyond which lies your final challenge.

title: Pong Ping
description: A Pong Ping type game. A Single Player Arcade Physics based Tennis Like Game!

title: Pyramid Runner
description: This arcade puzzle game challenges you to collect treasures from ancient pyramids, dark dungeons, and even Mars. You'll have to outsmart cruel mummies and dangerous gorillas, as well as solve many of clever puzzles.

title: Final Nights
description:
Something is here and it wants revenge

Years after the incident that caused our favourite restuarant to be shut down, it's reborn and not as good as it used to be. However it's rapid decline in visitors due to supposed hauntings has doomed the restuarant once again, as a nightguard the ghosts have now followed you home, yet this one is different.

Is it trying to take your soul? Or is it trying to tell you something?

Defend yourself, and try to get rid of this curse in Final Nights!

title: Final Nights 2: Sins of the Father
description:
That which you have created is now tormenting you.
The animatronics are burnt and beaten but they're alive, and they know what you did!

In the sequel to the FNaF fangame Final Nights it is your duty to fix these abominations during the day, and survive their torment during the night.

After setting up your make-shift security system and other precautions you are ready to take on the terror and end this nightmare once and for all!

Or are you?

title: Final Nights 3: Nightmares Awaken
description:
Sleep tight.

Doctor, we've got some news about the patient that was taken into intensive care recently. He seems to walk around his room at night, as if he is seeing things.

Pretending to use a flashlight and screaming. We're not sure if the loss of his frontal lobe has any influence on this behaviour.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Stonehenge
description:
A special prehistoric location with friends from the future.
This DLC includes:
- Roller coaster map: Stonehenge.
- One roller coaster cart.

title: War on the Street
description: War on the Street is a top-down shooter game in which you have to fight a group of terrorists occupying the streets of Zamir city. Take them out, run or die.

title: ToHeart2 XRated
description: ToHeart2 XRated is an expanded game of the original To Heart 2, which adds new scenes.

title: Corpse Disaster: Survivors
description: In another failed invasion plan you were caught in a storm Cut off contact with friends who have worked together for many years The city was thrown into a mess by the explosion of the laboratory and the spread of the virus You are blocked by many virus-infected creatures and enemies.

title: Final Nights 4: Fates Entwined
description:
The untold stories of Final Nights

In Final Nights 4 you will explore the original Fredbear's Family Diner and much more from 2 different perspectives.

title: Final Nights Redux and Knuckles
description:
The gameplay and graphical marvel that was the totally fully completed Final Nights Redux comes back better than ever! Now with Knuckles the Echidna from the Sonic The Hedgehog franchise!
Knuckles is a friend by your side! An ally in combat! Wanted in 34 States!

title: SynthCave
description: Defend your upgrade station and light your path using your gun while blasting away at enemies in this Synthwave inspired arcade wave shooter! Buy upgrades like Light Poles to illuminate areas and turrets to mow down the incoming waves. Can you take on the horde or will they take your station from you with sheer numbers? Find out now!

title: Castle Warriors
description: Castle Warriors is a rogue lite auto battler with a strategy twist. Build your army one card at a time from over fifty units!

title: Dino V. Xeno
description: Dino V. Xeno is a casual, simple, yet deeply crafted tower defense game, in which you can enlist 10 upgradable dinosaurs, plus 14 additional special towers, to battle alien invader hordes. With randomized elements, 51 levels and 12-16 hours of gameplay, DVX is a tailor made for tower defense lovers.

title: Polyturned
description: Your goal is to survive in a city overrun by zombies, team up with friends to mine resources, build forts and explore the abandoned city.

title: The King of Cats
description: Navigate the claustrophobic corridors of a cargo ship and try to survive a night with man-eating tigers on the loose. Your choices will determine who lives and who dies.

title: Fisher Online: China
description: The prototype for this lake was the Lake Xihu 29 species of inhabitants, of which 12 are found only at this locatio AI-map generation, 8 kilometers of coastline, 2.4 sq. km of water area, three game zones: channels, shallow waters, deep water.

title: Doraemon: Nobita's Resident Evil 2
description: Doraemon: Nobita's Resident Evil 2 (also known as Nobihaza 2) is the sequel to Doraemon: Nobita's Resident Evil, an RPG-Maker game that is set in the Resident Evil universe with characters from the Doraemon anime.

title: Metro PD: Close to You
description: Included in the "Love 365: Find Your Story" app.

title: Five Nights at Treasure Island: Old Builds
description: Five Nights at Treasure Island is a FNaF inspired fan game that was originally made by Anart1996 the owner of Five Nights at Treasure Island and Purity Sinners. This version of the title consists of Demo 1, Demo 2, Remastered Demo, AI Demo, Demo 3, and Alpha Test.

title: Blue Oddities: The Final Chapter
description:
Blue Oddities is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame, a point and click horror game in the Oddities series, and is a sequel to Green Oddities.
It is created by the Radiance Team and was mentioned to be the final chapter of the game.

title: Dragon Survivors
description: Valkathien has returned! Choose a mighty warrior to play as, and fight through hordes of enemies in a pulse pounding action game. Gather power ups, increase your strength, and see if you have the skill to last long enough to challenge the Dragon. Battle against fate. Prove yourself a Dragon Survivor!

title: Five Nights at Treasure Island
description:
This is an official reboot of the infamous FNaF fangame "Five Nights At Treasure Island."
This reboot will complete what Anart1996 started with a whole new story included. This game will feature new and updated gameplay, as well as an interesting and terrifying atmosphere. Welcome to the island.

title: Five Nights at Treasure Island: Anniversary Edition
description:
For 6 years, Photo-Negative Mickey and his friends have terrified audiences across the internet. For one last time, you can experience that terror.

On December 1, 2014, Anart1996 would announce his FNaF fangame... "Five Nights at Treasure Island."

FNaTI would go on to pioneer the fangame scene and change the way we see Mickey Mouse and the Disney Corporation.

For the game's (late) birthday, the Radiance Team has decided to release a special version of FNaTI to commemorate the game. Enjoy.

title: Five Nights at Chuck E. Cheese's: Rebooted
description: This is an official complete reboot of the popular 2015 FNaF fangame "Five Nights at Chuck E. Cheese's." Featuring new mechanics, graphics, and more while still keeping the spirit of the original game.

title: Hentai Military
description: Hentai Military is a relaxing puzzle game. With the theme of military and 24 unique sexy girls. Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

title: The Voice from the Well: The Velessar Saga
description: Stranded in a foreign world, Jay must fight to reclaim his stolen memories as mysterious forces conspire!

title: Black Lily's Tale
description: A Switch port of Black Lily's Tale that includes all previously released additional scenarios, as well as the additional scenario “The Day We First Crossed the Boundary,” which follows Hana Sasamori and Itsuki Omiya after the main story.

title: Forbidden Trip
description: A Total Conversion for Amnesia: TDD. A parallel space & time, your story. No memories of last night. Strange. Being a little paranoid, you junkie? Reconsider your bad habits someday… for now, recover crucial documents before leaving the country tomorrow. Be quick, don't think. Easy.

title: Mail Mole + 'Xpress Deliveries
description: Mail Mole is a charming 3D platformer featuring Molty, the fastest delivery mole, in his quest to save Carrotland from disaster! Explore magical worlds, make new friends, race against Mecha-Moles, find collectibles, solve puzzles and deliver awesomeness to the end of the world!

title: CalmLine
description: Overcome levels with the help of various tools and your mind. Are you sure it's easy?

title: The Curse of Kubel + Expansion DLC
description: Return to Asserya, and visit your favorite characters again with all-new character art and voiced dialogue! Gather information and venture into the chasm to investigate the source of the curse. Defeat dangerous monsters and lay claim to valuable items as you make your way through the underground dungeon.

title: Modo Defence
description: Modo Defense is a strategy tower defense game. Spin yut, similar to dice, to obtain various resources and summon or strengthen towers. You can customize your tower however you like. Specialize in multi-attack or strong one-by-one! And we have to stop the demons coming in. How far can you stop it?

title: Dead Age: Survivors
description: Dead Age: Survivors is an Indie Survival RPG with a touch of strategy. Complex quests and real-time pauseable party combat. Loot resources, build camps, and conquer new areas in battles against 7 greedy factions. Farm animals, cook, and brew beer! Pay close attention to hunger, stress, and morale.

title: Manacle
description: Menacle is set in an impoverished town where players take on the role of a desperate father who becomes a black-market doctor. Players will face chilling as they uncover the secrets behind the town's decline and the source of its evil. Get ready for a thrilling and intense gaming experience.

title: Plot Hole
description:
After months of careful renovations, the Pleasure Temple finally opens its doors to the public. The last sanctuary for queer fat lust, enormous strangers arrive from all over, feral for the pleasures of fat filth. It's the perfect time for the high priestess to try out the Temple’s latest addition…

Plot Hole is an episodic CYOA-style erotic game where players switch between the POVs of sleazy fat strangers at a bathhouse glory hole — to learn more about them or simply craft the steamiest encounter! It’s my love letter to fat kink, bathhouses, and cruising. Our next episode is slated to drop Summer 2023.

title: Glass Wings
description: Glass Wings is a fast paced third-person parkour platformer. Explore a stunning minimalist world in a series of linear courses in which your only objective is to complete the level. No combat, no story - just run.

title: Special Courier
description: Special things require special attitude!

title: Backroom
description: Based on Alice in Borderland, SCP-096 and The Backrooms Saga. Explore, think, interact, fight, but be careful, SCP-096 could be hidden anywhere...

title: Songs of Silence
description: Songs of Silence is an Art Nouveau-inspired fantasy strategy game with a unique mix of turn-based kingdom management, hero development and real-time combat.

title: Once a Tale
description: You are invited to step into the enchanting world of fairy tales like never before. Play as Hansel and Gretel in this unique stop-motion-style single-player 3rd-person narrative adventure where you'll uncover mysteries, solve puzzles, and meet a reimagined cast of beloved fairytale characters.

title: Restaurant Builder
description: Equipped with a high-pressure washer, jackhammer, and a highly addictive spray gun, you face the construction of a restaurant the world has never seen. Tear down walls, build, destroy, paint, and decorate, utilizing real physics, and dynamic lighting to bring empty space to life.

title: Autumn-Time Trade-Up
description: A game about speed, optimization, and exploration! Meet loads of unique characters on your way to the top of the spire! You are given four minutes to save Thanksgiving through various wacky means. Can you get everyone to the top of the Spire for the perfect Thanksgiving feast?

title: Gunlocked: The 2nd Gunning
description: A sci-fi action roguelike in space. Gunlocked is a twin stick shooter without the twin stick. Choose from multiple unique characters, dodge enemies, equip powerful upgrades, fight huge bosses, and drink your morning coffee with your free hand. Then do it all again for a brand new experience.

title: Fool's Curse
description: Fight your way through 13 retro inspired stages. Utilize the powers of your enemies to create over 70 magic spells and explore multiple routes on your way to the mysterious castle!

title: Nonotown
description: Play classic and colored nonograms or picross.

title: Touhou Fractured Transience
description: Touhou Fractured Transience is a 2D Platform Fighter game with elements of the Shoot'em up genre. Play as one of the many legendary figures of Gensokyo and wield their powers and abilities in combat. Hit your opponent as hard as possible and send them flying in a beautiful yet unhinged Battle of Bullets!

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - Tromsø XP
description: With Tromsø XP, Jo Erlend Sund and Stairport Sceneries have created another beautiful Norwegian airport scenery for XPlane 11. This scenery depicts an extremely detailed recreation of Tromsø Airport on the island Tromsøya as well as its surroundings.

title: You are the Judge!
description: As a judge of the Kobardde court, solve complex cases inspired by actual events. Your decisions will directly affect people's (and perhaps yours) lives. You may have to make difficult decisions for your family, country, and life. What kind of judge will you be?

title: Echo Storm
description: Echo Storm is a 2D action with roguelite elements. Survive enemies attack as long as possible. Death resets the progress, but the longer you survive, the more abilities your character gets. Onslaught of enemies is growing too, so - find best abilities combination and destroy 'em all!

title: Walkies
description: Happy-go-lucky dog helps save a local rescue centre, with help from furry (and not so furry) friends! Wag those tails and bound and bounce your way through this whimsical adventure!

title: Engine Roar
description: Engine Roar is a hardcore race for survival on rusty post-apocalyptic wastelands, under the noisy roar of engines in pixel 3D styling.

title: Moving Through Life
description: Together with the main heroine of the game, go through important stages of her life. Help her set up homes and feel her experience through her belongings. The game has simple rules and control: move items to where you think they should be. The game has no scores, time limits, or complex tasks.

title: Obsta-Loop
description: The Spiritual Successor to our NES classic, Exit-Loop. Its the new most Fun-Zaniest, Insaneist, Death-Loopiest, Crypt-Pillageist experience ever! Now with power-ups, masks, Multiplayer on PC.

title: My First Horse: Adventures on Seahorse Island
description: Adventure awaits with Olivia and her trusty horse on a stunning island full of excitement and mystery. Join them on thrilling quests and explore beautiful landscapes. This horse game has something for everyone. Don't miss out on this immersive experience. Saddle up and join the adventure!

title: Flirting with Yasmine
description: Relationship simulation with free roaming in key locations, interactive dialogs and mild stat building.

title: Immortal Realms: Vampire Wars - Fangs and Bones
description: The Fangs&Bones DLC includes two unique Lords, the Winter Wolf and the Skeleton King, ready to lead your armys of the night to victory. They both come with unique abilities and character models and are available as Lords for your armies.

title: Crash and Run
description: Race. Compete. Run. Clash head to head with your friends, ducking and weaving obstacle to obstacle until you prove yourself to be the best once and for all.

title: Crash-San
description: Crash-San destroys the spirit. Use jumps and guns to get the treasure before the spirit is destroyed.Action game.Aim for the goal with limited life.Three different stages await you.Each stage has traps to make you suffer.

title: Mock 2: The Speed of Stupid
description: Mock 2: The Speed of Stupid is a comedic level pack for DOOM II and a spiritual successor to Mockery. Described by many as "so stupid that it's funny", the mod relies on ridiculous enemy placement, gratuitous abuse of ZDoom features, and intentionally displeasing map design – mocking the most common map design tropes of its time.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Soldier Summit Route
description: The stunning plains and valley passes of Utah make Soldier Summit one of the best loved mountain passes of the western United States.

title: Tavern Talk
description:
A cozy visual novel about running a tavern in a D&D-inspired fantasy! Gather rumors, serve magical drinks, and meet adventurers on a life-changing quest.

Befriend a colourful cast of adventurers as they brag about their latest triumph – or commiserate an utter failure. Whether it’s relaxation or a fresh thrill, you’re on hand to give each patron what they need.

Beyond the walls of this cosy tavern, a world-threatening danger is brewing. Every quest, rumor and conversation is intertwined with the ultimate fate of the land.

The Wayfarer's Inn is a safe haven to a colourful cast of characters inspired by TTRPGs. Get to know their unique personalities, and help them find a place that feels like home.

Serve an ever-growing menu of magical drinks to your patrons, but choose carefully, as your choice will alter their fates. Gather rumors from the tavern-goers and use them to create quests for your adventurous guests.

Piece together the fragments in your little study and uncover the secrets of an ancient evil threatening the land. As adventurers return from their mighty quests, they’ll bring back trinkets you can use to decorate your tavern. Your choices shape the snug interior of the Wayfarer’s Inn!

title: MicroCrawl
description: Microcrawl is a bite sized point and click 2D adventure text hybrid presented from the first person in which you'll have to navigate your way back through a dark fantasy world to get back home.

title: Castle Kingdom Wars
description: Make your own strategy to beat your enemies. Characters have different skills so you can defeat your enemy with different tactics. Knight, swordsman, archer, skeleton, mage, catapult and much more hero are ready to fight for you.

title: Great North Shelter 2
description: Great North Shelter 2 is an atmospheric adventure with a deep story, detailed world and horror elements.

title: Fantasy Shop
description: Manage a shop set in the medieval world!

title: Trauma: Broken Paradise
description: Awaken in the fragmented mind of a woman, lost in the shadowy corridors of a sinister mansion. Unravel the mysteries of memory in this gripping psychological thriller, echoing the beloved classics of Survival Horror from the 90s/2000s. Dare to delve deeper.

title: Celestial Force: Magical Mayhem
description: Celestial Force: Magical Mayhem is a beat'em up where you are in control of a Magical Girl preventing an alien invasion. Choose your favorite combatent and defeat the invaders with your elemental-adjacent powers and a lot of glitter!

title: Ruslicstan Invades
description: Save Europe from shortage of crappers! The swamp horde of ruslic savages is gushing out, again! Stop the "russian world" leakage from the crapper-state, in the meaty first-person shooter game!

title: Striker of Sky
description: It is a drone sports game that implements the actual drone soccer game system based on VR and multiplayer.

title: Pandora
description: Pandora brings a mix of the moba genre with soul mechanics, destroy towers and fight different enemies with an innovative playstyle, use mounts and pets to help you during your gameplay.

title: Fort Valen
description: A desert fantasy murder-mystery following young involuntary shut-in Vishara Vakricustos as she attempts to solve a murder plot to prove herself to her overprotective mother.

title: Journey Express
description: A hybrid 2D/3D adventure game pitting the player against countless dangers on a cross-country journey. Manage your resources and keep your party alive!

title: Blood Rite
description: A gruesome human resources game. Mine gems to spawn new minions. Sacrifice these minions to keep ahead of the fire. Then use their blood for special powers like shields, power-ups, and daggers to defeat incoming foes. Towers will turn minions into archers, electrocutioners or human crossbow bolts.

title: The Final Bastion
description: The Final Bastion is a Multiplayer PvP & PvE Tower-defense with a classic Medieval-Fantasy theme. Compete against players in head to head online in a PvP, sending waves against the enemy and growing your economy. Play side by side with your friends in PvE and see who survives the longest.

title: Quest for the Pinnacle
description: In this unique turn-based RPG, your group's escape begins with deciding who stays behind and continues as you seek help from Pinnacle for your homeland! Ask locals about recent events and new places, use your new knowledge in battle, and reach for new heights.

title: Twerk it Girl!
description: You have no idea what to do? Simply, twerk it!

title: ReverseRoom
description: ReverseRoom is a "play mode" where you move your character, and a "puzzle mode" where you rotate the stage and change the terrain. This is a new type of action puzzle game that uses two modes skillfully to conquer stages.

title: Labyrinthian: Lost 'til Dawn
description: 'Labyrinthian: Lost 'til Dawn' is a horror maze/puzzle game where the player advances deeper into the maze-like forest to maintain survival, trying to last until day. This game uses mouse and keyboard controls (WASD), with other keys gaining functionality as the game progresses.

title: My Summer Jobs: Dialing for Dreams!
description: My Summer Job: Dialing for Dreams! is a puzzle game where you guide a young girl Molly through the world of telemarketing. Test your skills in cold calling, product knowledge and time management to match the right product to each customer's desire and save enough money to make dreams come true!

title: Mimics the Bots
description: Fun game between friends where one embodies a killer and the other the finder. The killer will have to kill bots and impersonate them while the finder will have to unmask the killer.

title: Risen 3: Fog Island
description: A stranded Inquisition raiding party is searching for new territory in a world where madness seems to spread. Help them unveil the deadly secret found on this island.

title: Tiger Tank 59 I: A-Gun MP041
description: This DLC contains the Map No.221-225

title: An Adventurer's Gallantry
description: Disgraced knight-in-training Oren gets a second chance at life as an adventurer in this fantasy visual novel.

title: Hope's End
description: Hope's End is a post-apocalyptic tower defense roguelite with an emphasis on active ability use to succeed. Play as the Supreme Psion and use unique ability sets to rain destruction down upon the monsters that threaten humanity's final bastion!

title: Stacks: Space!
description: Stacks: Space is a space-themed base builder card game with rogue-like elements. Buy booster packs to get new cards, discover craft recipes by stacking cards together, create structures, manufacture drones and droids, defend your base from enemies, visit distant planets, and more!

title: Crimson Connect Origin
description: Survive, collector's heroes!! game is a fusion genre of real-time strategy and roguelike. Survive to the end through defense-style battles

title: Larry's New Wheelchair
description: Larry decided to buy a new wheelchair online and with it he will be settling some scores...

title: Tank Kingdoms
description: Medieval world RPG, large scale tank warfare.

title: The Dragon Queen
description: Enola has lived her own life on a small village secluded from the rest of the world. But soon this will change!

title: Q.u.q.
description: Q.u.q. is a surreal visual novel about a somewhat crude girl that wanders a desert.

title: The Lost Sheep
description: A beautiful, 3rd-person exploration game centered around two parallel stories: a lost sheep trying to find the way home, and a man restoring his life from his dark mistakes. Uncover artifacts from the man's life as he becomes intertwined in The Lost Sheep's journey to his home.

title: Carnage Offering Tower Defense
description: The replicator robots are back! It's 2528. The machines are increasingly infecting the planets with genetically modified monsters. Challenge them and try to stop the onslaught. Upgrade buildings and heroes, mine resources, discover technology and fight to save humanity!

title: The Great Divide
description: The One Being, the Goddess who ruled it all, one day grew tormented by the actions of its own creations. That frustration led to what is known as The Great Divide. Now the world faces unbalance as those spirits fight each other for full control.

title: Blackout Hospital
description: When the power goes out while working night shift in the hospital, the emergency lights come on with an eerie glow...

title: Lana and the Milking Table
description: You’ve won a free all day massage! You head to the parlor to find out if it’s legit or not and you meet your beautiful masseuse Lana. You’re about to get the most memorable massage of your life!​

title: Terranny
description: Design and program drones, then send them into battle.

title: Tiny Fight
description: Tiny Knights is an arcade fighting game in medieval fantasy, with elements of management, trade and pumping up the fighter.

title: House of Jigsaw: Masters of Art
description: Imagine yourself being in the greatest musea by solving the Jigsaw Puzzles of master artists like Monet, Haring, Kadinsky, Hokusai, Rousseau and Rembrandt. All major art style are represented in more dan 100 high quality puzzles. Enjoy the modern UI and 4 difficulty levels (30/120/300/600 pieces).

title: X-Plane 11: Aerosoft - Airport Berlin-Brandenburg
description: With the brand-new add-on “Airport Berlin-Brandenburg” we bring what is probably Europe’s largest airport construction site to XPlane 11.

title: Warp Tango
description: Warp Tango is a casual multiplayer shooter where you eradicate waves of space jungle vermin with your friends. You can play alone or host/join a game with up to 6 friends.
