Their mission is to repel the invaders under the guise of a local paramilitary unit such that all actions can be disavowed should things go wrong.

title: Come Home: Premium Edition
description: Come Home is a free game and will always be a free game, but this Premium Edition contains loads of extra content, receives updates before the free version, and is a great way to show your support for the game and its developer.

title: Lusty God
description: Lusty God is a puzzle game where you are a God that decided to create a whole world out of boredom. Explore lots of elements and make lots of interesting things to satisfy your lust! Let's start creating!

title: Better Me Tree
description: Better Me Tree is an interactive self help application that includes simple objectives that are spoken aloud by the user to promote daily positive reflection, motivation, encouragement and edification.

title: GoreBox
description: GoreBox is a chaotic physics-driven sandbox where creativity meets destruction. Use the Reality Crusher to spawn, manipulate, and obliterate anything. Customize, battle with friends, roleplay, or face devious creatures. In this world, your imagination rules—and chaos is your playground!

title: Solar Survivors
description: Build the ultimate space fighter as you uncover clever strategies and hidden synergies. Overcome weakness and slay hoards of rebels in order to defend your gods. Solar Survivors distills the deep strategy and progression of an RPG into quick, arcade-like sessions.

title: Mega City Force
description: Retrowave Action Roguelike featuring tough agents battling crime to the electrifying music of artists like Droid Bishop, Timecop1983, and more! Choose your agent and dive into hardcore action against enemies and bosses, utilizing a vast arsenal and special abilities that will define your playstyle

title: Baking Success
description: Join Fay on her Flying Bakery and travel the world, serving delicious baked goods in this challenging Time Management game!

title: Qualification as Rogue
description: A platformer combining fun controls and puzzles to solve traps

title: Project Chaos
description: Project Chaos Is An High Octane, Manic & Chaotic, Multiplayer First Person Shooter. Set In 2098, A Team Of Rebels, Activists & Terrorists Band Together With One Goal: To Insight Change. Their Method Of Choice? Chaos!

title: Limbo Revolution
description: Limbo Revolution is a dystopian adventure game set in an alternate 1990s Eastern European country ravaged by dictatorship. In this immersive world, you must navigate the desolate streets, political landscape and unravel the truth behind the downfall of the nation. Watch out for others.

title: Core Crossing
description: First-person dungeon crawler RPG. Build your party and explore the labyrinth known as the "Core" under the Town of Melodiena. Successful adventurers shall be granted the town's coveted Revere License.

title: Raindrop Umbrella
description: Sometimes to attack, sometimes to move. Kick your enemies to the ground with umbrella actions. A devastated land. Two opposing races. What is the secret of the world where it keeps raining? ...... A short 2D action game drawn with dots.

title: Felvidek
description: Find out what unlikely events take place in this alternate history region of Slovak Highlands. This land is ravaged by Hussite pillagers and Ottoman spies while surreal horrors dwell in the dark. It's now up to Pavol, a fair knight with alcohol problems, to gather a party and stop those who oppose our kingdom.

title: Loretta's Brand New Job
description:
Loretta's husband Elio has started a promising new job at his political party's newspaper. However, a politician Elio used to work with is now coercing Elio to write positive articles about him, putting Elio's reputation at risk.

Elio must stop Fabro from realizing his diabolical plans, and it's up to you to investigate the town and uncover the truth from your fellow citizens! Experience a traditional slice-of-life RPG while you unearth the truths hidden behind Fabro's deceit. Stop Fabro and don't let him steal your position in the party!

title: Balls & Beats
description: Balls & Beats is a colorful and casual game where you automatically jump to the beat of the music.

title: Qwerty Quest
description: Type your way to the top of the leaderboard as an epic Wordslayer! Perfect for anyone serious about improving their typing speed and accuracy in a fun, educational way.

title: Ebola Village
description: A classic horror inspired by the original survival games of the 90s, Ebola Village is a modern take on a first-person adventure where the main character, Maria, investigates a series of mysterious events.

title: Sally Can't Sleep
description: Sally Summers, an average Jill living in her apartment in L.A, has trouble getting to sleep one night. As it turns out, her favourite pillow needs some new feathers! Are you a bad enough dude to collect the feathers in this First-person Dream exploration Collectathon Platformer?

title: Strawb
description: Find your way through challenging puzzles and catch your friend by clever movement and destruction of blocks.

title: Ultratoro 2
description: Drive at full speed in donut-shapped worlds while monstrous entities try to destroy you. Your car is a hacking device, capable of stealing from Megacorporations in cyberspace.

title: Turbo Racing
description: Turbo Racing is an arcade motorsport drift racing game filled with driving fun and a healthy competitive spirit. Take part in racing races and choose one of 12 different racing cars.

title: Legends of Celestite: The All Bearer
description: Fate unites a new group of heroes as an unstoppable supervillain resurrects from the dead. During his war-filled resurgence, he discovers the peculiar birth of a red-eyed boy whom he believes to be more than just a prophecy in this story-driven RPG influenced by Naruto and The Legend of Dragoon.

title: Neko-chan's Club
description: In the Neko-chan's Club, you can meet girls for any taste! Sports tennis player? Or maybe a mysterious ninja girl? Do you like an insatiable Egyptian woman..? Be careful with the last one, she hasn't seen a man for a thousand years! Become a club member with Neko-chans!

title: Mahjong: Legacy of the Toltecs
description: Become the best mahjong player in the world in the great mahjong game "Mahjong Legacy of the Toltecs"! Search for an ancient, powerful artifact that will help you find incredible treasures. Overcome obstacles, collect magical mana and become a legendary adventurer.

title: Vagrant Knight
description: Vagrant Knight is a topdown challenging action roguelike with elegant hack-n-slash combat with spell casting. Mow down and clear each room of demonic spawns to level up your character with unique melee attacks and spells. Try different combination of special attacks and spell in each level.

title: Roll Freak
description: Drag to move, hold to stop, charge to sprint. In danger, hold nearby hackable machines to make a way out.

title: The Crimping
description: A first-person horror game based on one of America's most haunted hotels. Use your wits and reflexes to escape supernatural encounters within Oregon's underground "Shanghai Tunnels."

title: Foad
description: Foad is a competitive party game featuring explosive devices with a thirst for chaos and destruction.

title: Cities in Motion 2: Metro Madness
description: Ever wanted to have a shorter metro for the night time, or a very long version for the rush hour? Well, now it's possible! The Metro Madness pack features customizable metro trains that you can put together car by car and alter the setup for different timetables.

title: CometStriker DX
description: CometStriker DX is an arcade action shooter featuring dodging, strategic power-ups and intense boss fights!

title: Wildwood: A Town Building Game
description: Build and grow your own colony in Wildwood, a thrilling town building game. Gather resources, craft tools, and expand your settlement with a robust logistics network. Start small and watch your colony thrive as you take control and guide it to greatness. Join the adventure now!

title: Murder Is Game Over: Streaming Death
description: Embark on a thrilling pixel art adventure with Detective Guy & Cleo as they solve a mysterious murder. Explore an eerie seaside village, search for clues, interview suspects, and unravel the truth in this whodunit mystery.

title: Zombie Survivals 18+
description: Zombie Survivals 18+ is a blend of top-down shooter and visual novel. The world of the game is the ruins of the city after the zombie apocalypse. The enemies are hordes of zombies who want to kill the main character.

title: Dead Island: Zombie Hunter
description: An oasis island originally rich in resources, due to the attack of the virus, everyone was infected with the mutated virus, and the whole island was full of the breath of death... How do you defeat these zombies when you are the only survivor on the dead island? Can you survive?...

title: Chernobyl: Death May Die
description: You have to plunge into the psychological horror, where you have to solve puzzles and find a way out of Chernobyl. Weird, crazy and unique horror awaits you.

title: Bottoms Up!: Part 1
description: The most intoxicating story you will ever read... Literally! Bottoms Up! - is a linear Visual Novel type of game that only aims to present compellingly an interesting fantasy world, colorful characters and the largely funny, but sometimes dark shenanigans they get into.

title: Save the Girls
description: Welcome to a world full of fun and sex! ! Protect cute girls from danger! When you successfully protect them they will dedicate their bodies! Come and find the girls' secret garden! Happiness is waiting for you ahead!

title: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham DLC - The Squad
description: A mysterious figure has infiltrated Belle Reve Penitentiary.

title: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham - Bizarro
description: To help save his planet from the evil Darkseid, Bizarro clones the Justice League and creates his own Bizarro League.

title: Erannorth Chronicles: Untold Tales and Legends
description: Experience a richer, more distinct, and dangerous world with the fourth Erannorth Chronicles expansion. "Untold Tales and Legends" will expand the world seamlessly with new Narrative Events, Challenges, Enemies, and Cards.

title: Vacuum Warrior
description: Vacuum Warrior is a Free to Play incremental idle game. Listen to the crisp crackle of dust and debris entering your vacuum as you vacuum ridiculous amounts of dust. Upgrade your vacuums, idle gains, and robot vacuums, earn achievements, and explore numerous locations in the Vacuum Warrior universe!

title: Snafu
description: Alibaba, the caretaker of the Medieval Grow your Business Game notices a Glitch or Virus of some sort called Snafu has infiltrated the game files. NPCs begin to act strangely, textures look off, and I think - I think something is trying to hunt me down?

title: Lie of Caelum: Spirit
description:
A ragtag group of specialists is tasked with resolving a crisis. As they dig deeper, the mission begins to rot from the inside. History doesn't add up, and they uncover a hidden truth that overturns everything they believed about their world. Throughout their missions, they are opposed by terrorist factions and a mysterious organization whose stated goal is to “return Caelum to its former state.”

Lie of Caelum: Spirit is a passion project heavily influenced by the PSX-era JRPG. It blends 2D sprite characters with fully 3D environments, and pairs a turn-based foundation with a real-time execution layer that rewards timing and mastery.

title: I Spy Spooky Mansion
description: Through the creaking gate, you'd best beware. A spooky mansion awaits...Enter if you dare! In I SPY: Spooky Mansion Deluxe a mischievous skeleton traps you inside her spooky mansion challenging you to find the secret way out. Explore a mysterious old house full of puzzles and mysteries!

title: Solium Infernum: Rectification
description:
Solium Infernum: Rectification is a free mini expansion pack that brings new rules, mechanics and play elements to the game that pits you as an Archfiend with the ambition of ruling Hell.

The expansion content could be enabled before game creation and it added new rules, diplomatic options, manuscripts, rituals, relics, artifacts, praetors and legions.

title: Don't Give Up on Me!
description:
Don't Give Up on Me! is a romance-comedy visual novel about a simple love confession going wrong in the most unpredictable, absurd and insane ways ever imagined. Experience five different days in which Yorokobi Akihiko tries to confess to his crush, each one with their own plot and shenanigans.

In the end, will Akihiko manage to confess?

title: Spider's Web
description: A short RPG horror game about a girl who tries to untangle a tight knot in her life.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Hazy River
description: Hazy River is a mod created by atsuover and Rageminer, and as the GameBanana page says: "2 classic FNF Mods in 1 sexy(?) package!", merging Garcello and Annie into one remake mod. It counts with: remastered songs; previously unused assets; minor updates and new bonus content.

title: Those Darn Brothers!!!
description: 'Those Darn Brothers!' is a slice of life BL about bonding with family.

title: Tokio: Tokyo-to Dai 24-ku
description: Tokio: Tokyo-to Dai 24-ku of Tokyo is a sci-fi city simulator from Artdink, the company behind the A-Train economy sim series. Playing it will require careful planning, improvisation, and correspondence with your city's constituents to fix problems and make everyone happy. You can personally telephone residents to hear their opinions, or even tune in on various TV channels to survey Tokio. Every little counts: your political party platform, the techno-industrial automation needed to power Tokio & its economy, and even space tourism via space shuttles and other programs—among others! Elements like artificial gravity, weather control, and orbital mining can also make or break your term as mayor, so manage it all to the best of your ability.

title: Parasomnia
description: What begins as a simple funeral wake spirals into something far more sinister. As the Wan Siblings, explore their childhood home and uncover a dark plot, all the while surviving the malice of the tragic denizens trapped therein.

title: Hitman 3: VR Access
description: Death Awaits. Agent 47 returns in HITMAN 3, the dramatic conclusion to the World of Assassination trilogy.

title: Hitman 3 Access Pass: Hitman - Complete First Season
description: The HITMAN 3 Access Pass system allows you to access HITMAN 1 and HITMAN 2 locations in HITMAN 3, essentially making it possible to play all locations in the World of Assassination trilogy from within HITMAN 3.

title: The Astonishing Captain Skull
description: A mysterious death on a planet full of ghosts draws the investigative powers of the amazing Captain Skull.

title: True Combat: Elite
description: TrueCombat:ELITE is a total conversion mod for Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory that turns it into a tactical FPS: with realistic firearms and firearm handling, movement and locational damage.

title: Math+Sticks: Coffee Break Club
description: Math+Sticks: Coffee Break Club is a puzzle for math lovers with matchsticks that won't burn you, but will light up your mind. Challenge your mind to move, adding and removing matchsticks until you find the correct solution. How many tries do you need to solve each level?

title: Eulogy of an Insect
description: A skullcap-wearing woman makes a woefully wrong turn, ending up in a crapsack world full of fantastical creatures. Among them she finds misery, BUGS, apathy, and a shockingly strict adherence to paying one's fair share in taxes.

title: BlackJack Math Cross Numbers
description: Tease your brain in this ambient logic game where you have to make the math match 21 as a result horizontal and vertically (because we're talking about blackjack, right?) Swap the cards, make the math, repeat. That's all you'll need in order to complete this game!

title: Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers
description:
Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers is a kart racing video game originally based on the 3D Sonic the Hedgehog fan-game "Sonic Robo Blast 2", which itself is based on a modified version of Doom Legacy. It is the sequel to Sonic Robo Blast 2 Kart.

Hang up your sneakers, because Dr. Robotnik and his ex-enemies are going go-karting! Use the untapped potential of rings to super-charge your vehicle across more than 200 crazy courses. With over 20 unique items and some of the hottest moves on this side of the Floating Island, this is Racing at the Next Level!

title: Hardwork Simulator
description:
It was a normal day at work. But your text editor started to get pretty Unstable.

Hardwork Simulator is the perfect game for you to play at work, on the university computer, or any other time you just want to have fun! Play a game while everyone around you think you are working as hard as hell.

Sounds fun, right? But not everything will be fun. Angry stickmen try to unmask you while you smash your keyboard trying to reach the end of the document.
Kill Stickmen and keep the mouse pointers away from your text by dropping letters on them. But you have to be careful not to lose too many letters or you will face the Blue Screen of Death!

title: Too Easy
description:
Dear valued customer,

We are sorry that you found this game to be "too hard".

We have made every effort to ensure that this game is too easy and we apologise for any difficulty you may have experienced.

Furthermore, our reimbursement policy does not cover the computer peripherals you damaged in a "fit of rage".

Thank you for your understanding.

title: Finally, in Love Again
description: Included in the "Love 365: Find Your Story" app.

title: Dark Souls II: Seeker of Fire
description: An overhaul mod for DS2 SOTFS that adds an entirely new experience to your next playthrough. This mod will rebalance the game mechanics and difficulty, as well as decorate and fill in objects in areas that feel a little empty, expanding upon the work of Tales of Drangleic.

title: Spring Crisis
description: This is a Touhou doujin game by 46flare.

title: The Enchanted Worlds 2
description: Enchanted Worlds 2 is a puzzle adventure game from Syntaxity studio. Find an ancient artifact, following the clues from the books. At the same time, you have to explore many locations, look for items and interact with the environment. Touch the doorway to move from one location to another. When you find items, tap them to add them to your inventory. You can always see these things in a satchel. To use an item, select it, then tap the screen where you want to use it. Some puzzles require you to find clues to solve the puzzle: explore the area to find them. You can always use a hint if something does not work out for you.

title: Kalpa: The Sign of Omen
description:
In July 1999, a strategy role-playing game developed by Dynasty International Information and published by Soft-World Technology was released along with the well-known computer magazine "Software and CD" in mainland China. This game is called "Kalpa: The Sign of Omen". Due to its low price of 25 yuan for the full version, it attracted a large number of players.

Most people were initially scared off by its difficulty, making the most common screen seen at the beginning "defeat." Then, there were a lot of game-breaking bugs, causing many players to have to start over. There was even a rumor online that the game company was treating players as free testers. As a result, the magazine "Software and CD" had to include a patch in its August issue to appease the players' anger.

In September 1999, the "enhanced version" of "Kalpa: The Sign of Omen" was released at a price of 69 yuan. In addition to a big box packaging, the game also came with a full-color manual and a fan comic. The game version was also upgraded to 1.1. This version looked like a deluxe edition, and many players who owned the standard edition were not interested in it. However, this version contained a big secret, which was the perfect ending of the game. The relevant levels were not included in the standard version.

title: Creme de la Creme: A Silver Spoon
description: Become Gallatin's top student in A Silver Spoon! Discover hard-to-reach paths, achieve the highest grades, or play on hard mode. With these hints and cheats you'll never be late for class again!

title: Rider of Justice
description: A top-down shooter where you run and gun down bad guys as the vigilante, Rider. Vastly outnumbered, quickly kill and quickly die as you sweep through multifloored buildings bringing criminals to justice.

title: Pinball FX: Wrath of the Elder Gods
description: The end is nigh! Face the horror of the Elder Gods on this table packed with the unspeakable. Try to escape with your sanity...

title: Rhapsody II: Ballad of the Little Princess
description: Join Kururu on her journey to find true love and experience the charm of Rhapsody II's storybook adventure!

title: Primarch
description: Primarch is a roguelike auto-battler centered on a single hero. After being exiled to a foreign planet, you are challenged by a fallen God and pitted against your comrades to determine who is most worthy of the title ‘Primarch’.

title: Clash: Blue Mirage
description: Save the day with Clash!

title: Fishing: Barents Sea: Line and Net Ships
description: Expand your fleet of ships with this DLC, adding five new vessels to your game of Fishing: Barents Sea. The ships are either compatible with line or net fishing and comes with its very own quota - so drive out and fish to your heart's content! There is plenty opportunity to explore the seas in search of new fishing grounds! More ships mean more quotas to fill!

title: Magical Delicacy
description: A wholesome pixel art platformer. Cook magical delicacies from a vast collection of ingredients in your own shop. Explore an unfamiliar town and deliver tasty treats to the townsfolk. Learn new ways to traverse, discover secrets, and experience a unique witchy world.

title: The Bride Horror Game
description: Investigation and horror game, where the player becomes a detective and seeks clues to unravel a mysterious case that took place years ago. Whenever the player restarts the game, the clues change position. The crime scene, weapons and culprits are also changed with each new match started.

title: Tachyon Dreams I: The Radiant Fish of the Apocalypse
description: You're Dodger, a dish washer (a person, not a machine!) onboard Space Station Penrose, where temporal experiments are being conducted. One of them is about to go very wrong... Only you can save the fate of the timeline itself! With your, you know, stellar dishwashing skills an' all that!

title: Tachyon Dreams II: The Bloated Can of Space Root Beer
description: The adventures of Dodger through space and time continue! Previously a dish washer (person, not a machine!) onboard Space Station Penrose, Dodger must travel the space-time continuum and inter-dimensional highways to save the universe from the Tgorodians, a bunch of time-travelling thugs in search of the fabled Garden World!

title: Tachyon Dreams III: The Rancid Buttermilk from Andromeda
description: Tachyon Dreams III: The Rancid Buttermilk from Andromeda is the grand finale to the sci-fi comedy Tachyon Dreams text-parser trilogy! In his third adventure, Dodger explores a barren world, travels back in time to relive past moments, and then journeys to a dark forest on the edge of the cosmos. It is time to finally discover the fabled worlds of the Margdonians, which the greedy Tgorodians have searched for all this time.

title: Popgoes: Archives
description: An official collection of all of the major previously released Popgoes content, that is now non-canon due to the current reboot. Popgoes is a game series based on Five Nights at Freddy's.

title: Cut the Head off the Snake
description: This is a race against time game, in this game, you can collect gold to restore your health and improve your combat ability, the time to defeat the boss is limited, if you don't beat the boss in the allotted time, the challenge will fail

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Best Places
description: Best Places for you to visit by playing, Jigsaw Puzzle Best Places is a minimalist game with 5 difficulty levels (64, 144, 289, 484, and 784 pieces) with over 50 beautiful landscapes.

title: Bala na Manga
description:
A mobster stole you, get back what's yours in turn-based duels!!
You must choose between to shoot, to reload or to dodge.

title: Zebra Logic Master
description: Do you belong to the only 2% of the world population that is able to solve Einstein's Puzzle? Discover here!

title: Party Demon
description: Party Demon is a tower defense, deck-building game where your main goal is to protect a Lady Demon’s birthday party from human intruders. Build your castle on a budget and defend it in real time with a deadly Trap Deck full of demonic weapons.

title: Super-Patriota Simulator
description: Heads up! In 72 hours something very important will happen, stay in the streets, do your part and wait for the armed forces! For the future of the country and for the future of your children! The Super-Patriot is coming!

title: Drop Dead: The Cabin
description:
The Cabin is an intense and challenging game. Are you among the few that will survive? Gather supplies, arm up, and fight off waves of the walking dead that have escaped from an evil lab experiment. We expect you to die - a lot, each time you fall, you will earn XP to upgrade your character and weapons, making you stronger and bringing you one step closer to beating the game. Whether you play co-op or brave the horrors of hell solo - Fight with a blade, bat or a variety of guns, power up and become a pro monster slayer.

Can you hold off the horde before they breach the Cabin? Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Saimin School Days: Hypnotic School Days
description: The protagonist has acquired an app that can hypnotize others. Is school life with hypnosis bright and fun? Or...

title: Beyond These Stars
description: Journey on the back of the space whale Kewa, building a city for your people as you travel across the galaxy seeking purpose and answers, and developing deep relationships with the universe around you.

title: Grimm Tales
description: Surviving your own fairy tale, brave knight, requires first reliving seven of the Brothers Grimm's most classic stories. Find the seven dwarfs, awaken Sleeping Beauty, protect Little Red Riding Hood, escort Cinderella, and more. My, what big jackpots you have!

title: Pinball FX: World War Z Pinball
description: Outlive the dead to climb the leaderboards! The zombie horde forced your group to hide and you are now stuck in the overrun Central Mall. Score big and roll through hordes of Zeke to help the survivors escape this forsaken place.

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball - World Cup Soccer
description: Travel the United States and work your way up to the finals to be named World Champion! Juggle and dribble your ball, take aim, and score to pave your way to victory.

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball - The Addams Family
description: They're creepy and they're kooky, mysterious and spooky! Join The Addams Family in the classic, bestselling pinball adventure of all time.

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball - Swords of Fury
description: Unleash the fury of this 1988 solid state classic! Join the legendary Lion Man and prove your might! All in a world of sword and sorcery full of heroes, villains, and mythical monsters.

title: Pinball FX: Universal Classics Pinball
description: Universal Classics Pinball combines three captivating tables based on the blockbuster films Jaws, the Back to the Future trilogy, and E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial.

title: Pinball FX: The Machine - Bride of Pin Bot️
description: Here comes the Bride! Awaken the Machine by activating her vocal circuits and eyes. Or go even further and bring her to life! A legendary table from the PIN-BOT trilogy.

title: Pinball FX: Star Wars Pinball - Thrill of the Hunt
description: Two great tables! Whether it's for bounties in The Mandalorian or for Star Wars toy nostalgia in classic collectibles, the hunt is on.

title: Pinball FX: Peanuts' Snoopy Pinball
description:
Join Snoopy, Woodstock, Charlie Brown, and the rest of the Peanuts gang on their adventures.
Shoot that jackpot, Charlie Brown. Play Peanuts' Snoopy Pinball!

title: Pinball FX: Garfield Pinball
description: Feast your way through mounds of lasagna to score big in Garfield Pinball! Dig up bones with Odie, woo Arlene, fight the alarm clock, and find Pooky the teddy bear to reach Feast Frenzy, all for a perfect feline day of eating and sleeping.

title: Tap Craft
description: Gather resources, craft new tools and build your idle empire on islands. This is an idle crafting game like you've never seen. Mine up rare metals, grow food to feed your thriving idle settlement, unlock new buildings, craft new items, and expand to new islands in Tap Craft.

title: Horror Tale 1: Kidnapper
description: Uncover the mystery behind a terrifying kidnapper in this story-driven horror adventure. Solve puzzles, explore eerie locations, and help Tom and his friends survive in 1990s America. Horror Tale is a creepy escape game full of twists and suspense.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: The Cayo Perico Heist
description: Grand Theft Auto Online: The Cayo Perico is a content update for Grand Theft Auto Online. Playable from start to finish either as a lone operator or with up to three other players, discover dozens of ways to infiltrate and heist a brand-new location for the ultimate score.

title: SparkleWand Puzzle
description: Unique Puzzle Game ! Seemingly easy casual game at first but will still challenge you. Test you skill and perception and try pulling off tricky shots. Fun for all ages !

title: Parcel Problems
description: ​​Parcel Problems​ is a fast-paced parcel packing simulator. You must cram items into boxes as fast as you can in the hopes that you're making your quota. Don't let your boss down!

title: Quacktown Smackdown
description: Play as a Rubber Ducky in this 3rd Person Arena Shooter! Utilize squirt guns and water abilities and sink your opponents to become top duck of the tub! Battle it out in the Bubble Bath Battlefield or the Stormy Sandbox. Customize your ducky to make sure the lobby knows who's the Smack Down King!

title: Retro Style: Pixel Art Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces.

title: Legends of Luisa Llama
description: Legends of Luisa Llama is a retro-modern 2D adventure game where you guide the sassy llama heroine through levels full of puzzles and exploration in a quest to stop an evil djinn bent on taking over the world.

title: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator: Bug DLC
description: A DLC that includes 11 unique bugs that you can enable at will.

title: Had
description: Darkness stole all of your stuff. let's get it back!

title: Re:Fresh
description: Restore your town as you run, jump, and dash through cozy locales while helping lovable townsfolk! Become immersed in a tight-knit community of animals and robots while becoming the town hero in this heart-warming solarpunk adventure.

title: Firestorm
description: Firestorm is an upcoming first and third-person shooter video game developed by Totem Arts, that aims to reimagine Tiberian Sun in the shooter genre. Firestorm is set in a reimagining of the Second Tiberium War, with elements taken from the eponymous Firestorm expansion pack and Tiberium Wars. Unlike the traditional C&C mode in the original Renegade and Renegade X, the main game mode of Firestorm is based on the conquest game mode found in large-scale modern military shooters such as Battlefield. Players will be able to construct buildings and expand by conquering outposts scattered throughout the map.

title: The Mute House
description: Inspired by old and classic survival horror games, The Mute House combines exploration, management, puzzles and a touch of action. As Emily investigates about her sister's vanishing, she finds herself trapped in a mysterious mansion.

title: Super Smash Asteroids
description: "Super Smash Asteroids" is a high-speed, twin-stick, top-down, rogue-like space shooter. Choose from 6 unique ships, upgrade with 70+ items & blast through epic bosses. Level up for intense, action-packed battles in a futuristic universe. Buckle up for a thrilling journey to glory!

title: 50 Days to Survive
description: Having survived a plane crash, you are the last one alive. You find yourself alone in the middle of a desert, and devoid of all hope. Quickly find what to eat, what to drink, what to shelter you, and improve your comfort of life to avoid death. Can you survive for 50 days? Let's see that.

title: Alignment
description: A challenging and engaging puzzle game that will require you to move colored objects and place them on their respective platforms to explore through a series of increasingly complex levels.

title: Ball vs. Zombie
description: A stationary strategy tower defense game. Place balls to block zombies Don't let zombies into the house Player's hand speed, strategy matching, ball matching, Protect the surviving humans, the ball warriors protect the humans

title: Manual Overcycle
description: Manual Overcycle is the evolution of bicycle gameplay. With it's unique physics-based gameplay, bicycle gamers finally have the expressive controls they have always dreamed of.

title: Knight Raider
description: Knight Raider is a wave-based game set in a dungeon aesthetic environment. Kill enemies, purchase power-ups, and don't die! How fast can you beat it?

title: Pi Fu Fighter
description: This is a game created by me. Players will operate multiple fighter planes to form a fighter formation to deal with endless and uniform enemies. Of course, players can synthesize stronger fighters by picking up fighter cards or use different attribute cards to strengthen their fighters.

title: Neebota: 99 Fails
description: Neebota: 99 Fails is a surreal 3D adventure with demanding 2D precision-platforming challenges. Explore Zeebo's recurring nightmare, master his changing forms, and uncover his story, with music by David Wise.

title: Canine
description: Canine is a PSX style horror game about a boy looking for his dog, kidnapped by an evil corporation that runs experiments with pets.

title: Ovivim
description: Ovivim is a virtual pet for streamers that lives on Twitch streams by its own free will. These little creatures come in many different forms, and how they grow depends on how you care for them.

title: Tall Tales
description: A nostalgic, turn-based RPG where you battle monsters in real-time! Collect loot! Go fishing! Mine for Power Runes! Solve puzzles! Customize your characters stats! Meet eccentric and interesting individuals! As well as accepting quests from collecting butterflies to saving the world!

title: Wonder Trips
description: Wonder Trips is designed to take you into different lands to enjoy many trips and activities. Have Lot Of Fun by riding, racing, para-sailing and more... It's time to discover different wonderlands and enjoy your own trips.

title: JR East Train Simulator: Saikyo-Kawagoe Line - Osaki to Kawagoe E233-7000 series
description: The Saikyo and Kawagoe Lines are one of the major commuter lines in the Tokyo metropolitan area, running from Osaki Station via Omiya Station to Kawagoe Station.

title: Suicide Squad: Kill The Justice League - Deluxe Edition
description:
Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League is an action-adventure shooter developed by Rocksteady Studios. Set in Metropolis, players control Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Captain Boomerang, and King Shark as they battle a brainwashed Justice League under Brainiac's control. The game features third-person combat, open-world exploration, and live-service elements. It received mixed reviews for its narrative and repetitive gameplay mechanics.

Suicide Squad: Kill The Justice League - Deluxe Edition features:

- All Standard Edition content and pre-order bonuses.
- Four Justice League Outfits, one for each Squad member.
- Three Black Mask-themed notorious weapons (pistol, sniper rifle, and heavy weapon).
- Four Squad Golds-themed weapon dolls, one for each Squad member.
- One premium battle pass token.
- Up to 72-hour early access to the game, prior to the main launch.

title: Connected Hearts: The Musketeers Saga - DLC
description: Love can help you overcome many obstacles, even if the fate of an entire kingdom is at stake! Can two heroes in love make it through? Find out in this game!

title: Null Breach
description:
Lost in a collapsing dimension. It's time runs out. Can you save it from it's demise?

A 2D Roguelike Platformer. Be fast, precise and spend your time wisely. Can you get all 10 abilities? How long will you be able to survive?

You play as Meex, the creator of this dimension. But something went wrong. Upon entering his newly created world he was horrified to discover that it has fallen apart. There was only void with some scattered landmasses.

This worlds time runs out and Meex is lost in this dimension. Collect Time Orbs and defeat Void Eater to gain more time. Unlock new abilities and save your dimension.

title: Heath Robinson Solutions
description:
The sixth entry in The Lizard King series. This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2012.

title: The Castle Burns!
description: Kill literally all of the Goblins, Orcs and other monsters with ridiculous oversized weapons and items born from pure insanity in this 2D Roguelike Arena Survival game! Do it fast, because The Castle Burns!

title: The Lizard King
description:
Tomb Raider fan game made using the Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation engine. It's a new experience using the resources that one of the oldest games in the franchise has to offer.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2005.

title: Red Oddities
description: Red Oddities is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame, a point and click horror game. Created by the Radiance Team, the game was intended to be a joke and not to be taken seriously. On January 25, 2022, the game’s application was finally found after it’s game page was deleted for a few years.

title: Mario: The Music Box Remastered
description:
Mario has heard rumours of an abandoned mansion that has been close to the Mushroom Kingdom for over a century. Any person who dares step into the mansion's rooms, never returns. Mario and Princess Peach were supposed to investigate the strange place but Mario decided to go alone. Inside the home he finds a strange music box that was playing by itself. Little did he know that a "harmless" music box would've caused the home to try to eat him alive. Find out as you comb through a dangerous mansion and find out the story of its residents and how they met their fate.

Will you be able to guide the cheery hero of the Mushroom Kingdom back home? Or will he lose himself?

title: Lis: Achados & Perdidos dos Confins do Universo
description: How sharp are your organization skills? It’s time to discover!

title: Rhythm Storm
description: Rhythm Storm is a roguelike bullet heaven with stunning vector graphics, rhythmic action, and overwhelming swarms of enemies. Your vehicle aims and fires automatically while everything else dances and moves to the beat in this spectacular audio-visual experience.

title: Siege of Osaka
description: Siege of Osaka is a retro hybrid of Beat-em-up and Brick Breaker. Send enemy ninja rolling into walls and fortifications to bring down their castles. Localized/parodied for American audiences.

title: Plink Game
description: Game with Plink where you need to beat the game and collect as many as you can coins!

title: EverQuest: Night of Shadows
description:
Norrathians have ended the conflict between Mayong Mistmoore and Luclin herself, but can they relax their vigilance? The recent attention of Luclin has emboldened the Akheva, and they continue their plans to conquer the moon!

As war rages across the surface of Luclin, disaster has befallen Shadow Haven deep below. The mysterious sealed door has been smashed open, and the great spirit trapped behind it has rampaged through the city, leaving death and destruction before retreating to the unknown caverns it escaped from. What maddened the spirits? How can the Akheva be stopped? Can Shar Vahl survive as war threatens to engulf the city? The truth lies in the shadows -- will you survive to find it?

title: Brain Damage
description: Challenge your skills and push your limits in Brain Damage, the intense 2D action roguelite shooter with wave-based gameplay. With each upgrade, brain damage increases, making the game more challenging as you progress. Push the game to its limits. Can you break the game before it breaks you?

title: Moose In Canada
description: A game that is good for speedrunning and is an adventure kind of story game.

title: Alone: Cold Winter
description: Alone - Cold Winter is reimagination of Alone - Eternal Nightmare, which is a RPG-Maker action-horror game, that was heavily inspired by cult classics like Resident Evil, Silent Hill and Project Zero.

title: Disney's Animated Storybook: Toy Story
description: Part of Disney's Animated Storybook series, this game adapts the 1995 Pixar movie Toy Story into a point-and-click adventure format.

title: Masquerade Kiss
description: Masquerade Kiss is a spy themed romance game. It is one of the first games to be part of the Love Choice. You are a spy sent to bring your target down and falling for him risks you being killed if he exposes you.

title: Romance MD: Always on Call
description: Romance MD: Always On Call is a medical-themed game and its main stories are Love Choices.

title: Stream Defense
description: This is a class-based tower defense game which challenges you and your Twitch viewers to work together. In Stream Defense, your viewers can play alongside you by typing commands into chat. Each viewer has full control over their character. Your viewers can even continue playing while you sleep!

title: Destind: Mr. Almost Right
description: Destined: Mr. Almost Right is an otome game by Voltage Inc. The game is found in Love 365: Find Your Story.

title: Minecraft: Mega Man X
description: Dash through the blockiest Mega Man X world, charged with the original Mega Man X soundtrack and 14 classic skins from the series! Use The Blue Bomber’s arsenal of 9 weapons to fight an army of Mavericks, make your way through iconic levels, and defeat epic bosses.

title: Like a Dragon: Ishin! - Shinsengumi Captain's Set
description:
The Shinsengumi Captain's Set contains the extra difficulty level "Ishin" for players looking for an additional challenge, as well as a set of 16 cosmetic items, skin and haori designs for Like a Dragon: Ishin! main character, Sakamoto Ryoma.

- Haori: Dragon Samurai

title: Like a Dragon: Ishin! - Third Division Armament Expansion Kit
description:
The Third Division Armament Expansion Kit contains a set of additional Trooper Cards to boost the player's ranks. This pack of 8 Legendary Troopers and 15 Epic Troopers includes, among others, "Yakuza: Like a Dragon" Ichiban Kasuga and Omelette.

In addition to the Trooper Cards, consumable items to level up your troops and high-value goods are included.

The Third Division Armament Expansion Kit contains:

- Legendary Trooper: Nishitani Shigeharu
