title: Cartoon Rage
description: Gather up to 8 friends in this friendship-strengthening game! Solve puzzles, think together, and beat all levels while having a lot of fun! Meet new obstacles and gameplay mechanics as you progress throughout the game until you reach the ultimate puzzles!

title: Destiny of a Wizard 3: Beyond the World
description: Before the Blue Wizard could celebrate the defeat against Zarra, our hero was whisked away into another world! What brought him here? Why is he here? And most importantly, can he get back to his original world? An all new adventure awaits in Destiny of Wizard 3: Beyond the World!

title: Pitball: Winter Waifus
description: Pinball-like arcade fun with a variety of challenging levels and cute winter-themed waifus.

title: Grim Tales: Horizon of Wishes
description: What is Richard up to? Pursue Anna's missing father through time!

title: Hentai Jigsaw Puzzle Collection: Valentine's Edition
description: Enjoy the jigsaw puzzles with high quality sexy hentai girls that our Valentine's Day theme. Move the puzzle pieces to make the complete image More then 14 different jigsaw puzzles to complete

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Keio 3000 & Asanogawa 8800 Series
description: The Keio 3000 series was a DC electric multiple unit (EMU) train type operated by Keio Corporation on the Keio Inokashira Line in Japan from 1962 until 2011. This pack features the Keio 3000 Series Narrow Body 4 car sets and Asanogawa Railway 8800 Series 2 car sets.

title: SoulCalibur VI: Deluxe Edition 2019
description: The SoulCalibur VI: Deluxe Edition includes SoulCalibur VI and all DLC characters.

title: Dongeng Bayang Kulit
description: Dongeng Bayang Kulit is a turn-based RPG that is loosely based on Southeast Asian folklore. You play as the recently ship-less, Captain N'man and his mystical guide, Putri Matami as they travel in search for answers regarding a mysterious apparition that has taken to incessantly haunting N'man.

title: No Man's Sky: Fractal
description:
The 4.1 update for No Man's Sky brings a number of Quality of Life fixes, and mainly PSV2 support.

This update includes a great number of general VR Fixes but also includes a resizing of the players Ship garage to 12, a new Style of "skimmer" ship and a new Utopia Expedition

title: Gummy Dummy Battles
description:
Gummy Dummy Battles is the craziest battle simulator in the history of video games!
Once the fight begins, you can stand and watch as a spectator or take the field and fight in the first or third person.

Although the units are quite unconventional, each has its own strategic role: to dominate the enemy, you must discover their strengths and weaknesses.

title: Green Oddities
description: Green Oddities is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame, a point and click horror game. Created by the Radiance Team, the game, and the entirety of the series, was intended to be a joke and not to be taken seriously. This fangame is followed by its direct sequel and final chapter, Blue Oddities. The game turned out to be a "troll game," as there is no real gameplay aside from being a 2d free-roam game.

title: The Purgatory and the Stolen Souls
description: Welcome to The Purgatory and The stolen souls, in this game you will experience the exciting adventure of Baby against Springtrap... in space!

title: Christmas with Freddy's
description: It's Christmas! It is exciting, isn't it? I'm so hyped for my gifts, the animatronics from Fazbear Entertainment! I'm going to play with them all day! It's a shame I won't sleep anymore.

title: Artemis: Book One
description: Artemis is a visual novel intended for the adult audience. You begin your road to recovery three years following a traumatic event, where you'll eventually find yourself shaping the technological future.

title: Milfy City
description: Milfy City is an adult Visual Novel where you play as a young student who finds himself in the school therapist office, after a humiliating moment with another teacher at school. While plotting his revenge, he'll romance other characters at the school and at home.​

title: Lucky Paradox
description: Lucky Paradox is a harem focused adult visual novel with a mysterious and puzzling Story. You will also find loads of cuteness, love, and passion.

title: Abyss of Fire
description: A peaceful kingdom is frozen by the curse of the ice witch Kione. The mysterious girl "Laila" who appeared from somewhere and the mysterious spirit "Flara" who appeared from somewhere head to the kingdom to solve the curse of the kingdom together!

title: The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story
description:
Developed by Digital Sun, creators of Moonlighter, The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story is an action RPG that takes place in the League of Legends universe. In the kingdom of Demacia, the Mageseekers hold the power to oppress magic-using citizens in the name of public order–by inducting and indoctrinating them, locking them away, or driving them into hiding.

Play as Sylas, a spell-stealing mage who has just broken free of his unjust captivity at the Mageseekers’ hands. Wielding the chains that once bound you, you must liberate your homeland from tyranny, one Mageseeker at a time.

title: Box Office Boss
description: Box Office Boss puts you in charge of your own movie studio. The studio will rise or fall on the back of your executive decisions. Everybody thinks they could make a good movie, but do you have what it takes to turn that dream into box office success?

title: Parasite Black
description: Parasite Black is a mature, dark fantasy adult RPG sandbox game, with turn-based combat and VN style sandbox exploration, set in the world of Mirnos, a world under the fierce onslaught of a dangerous, bizarre race known as the Demorai.

title: What A Legend
description: What A Legend is a hand-drawn sandbox adult visual novel with 2D animations and a large cast of female characters to seduce and romance. You play as a young man who has a special gift that might be the key to save the kingdom from its corrupt leaders.

title: Muffins on Stream
description:
"Muffins on Stream" is an engagement game based on a video game in development called"Muffin Tour Legacy" that brings the fantasy world of Flourden to life on Twitch. As a streamer, you will use assets from "Muffin Tour Legacy" to create an interactive experience for your viewers, allowing them to join in on the fun and compete against each other in real-time.

The game is designed to be a fun, in-between game that can be played during live streams or as a giveaway for your viewers. Players will need to navigate the world of Flourden, uncovering clues and secrets about the "baker dust" and its potential to unleash great power and evil. With fast-paced gameplay, an engaging story

By purchasing "Muffins on Stream" on Steam, players will not only be able to enjoy the game but also support the development of the full game "Muffin Tour Legacy". The funds generated from the sales of "Muffins on Stream" will be used to further develop the game, improve its graphics and gameplay, and add new features and content. Additionally, the success of "Muffins on Stream" on Steam will help demonstrate the potential popularity of "Muffin Tour Legacy" and attract additional funding to bring the full game to fruition.

More about the game we want to make: In Muffin Tour Legacy, players take on the role of Molly, a skilled baker who owns the popular "Muffin Legacy" shop in the fantasy world of Flourden. Known for her exceptional muffin-making skills, Molly's world is turned upside down when a mysterious old man appears in her shop and offers her a rare ingredient called "bake dust" that can make her baking taste out of this world, but with the wrong usage, it can cause great evil.

As Molly embarks on a quest to save the universe from the Evil Bearclaw King and his pastry army, players will have to navigate the dangerous world of Flourden, uncovering clues and secrets about the "baker dust" and its potential to unleash great power and evil. Along the way, players will encounter various colorful characters and challenging obstacles as they strive to become the ultimate muffin-making hero. With fast-paced gameplay, an engaging story, and a unique fantasy setting, Muffin Tour Legacy offers players an unforgettable gaming experience.

title: The Arson Betrayal
description:
The Arson Betrayal is a choice-driven and story-focused action-thriller visual novel. Players are given the opportunity to choose which girls they wish to pursue a relationship with, as they spiral down towards the center of a deadly conspiracy.
As the story goes, you'll discover the girls' different kinks and be given the chance to determine how your relationship with them progresses, romantically or otherwise.
A majority of your choices and conversations with characters throughout the story are remembered and may affect the story as you go forward.

title: Ripples
description: A short story about cats, cookies, and making a difference. Koda is a photographer who dislikes people. But a chance encounter with Kuu may get him thinking otherwise... and it all started with cookies. This is a short voiced kinetic novel made as a family gift.

title: Pale Carnations
description: Pale Carnations is an adult visual novel focusing on the life of a student who recently got a job at a gentleman's club. As you get to know its patrons and workers, you realize that this job might not have been all that it was set up to be.

title: Detuned
description: An eerie anti-rhythm hiden-object roguelike. Avoid a procedurally generated song. Look for pearls in a surreal wonderland. Experience hyperacusis from the comfort of your seat.

title: Planet Fights
description: An online MMO game in which you can have your own virtual life. You can join a nation, buy vehicles, items, properties, open a political party, fight in battlefields, participate in races, take part in agent fights, be a nation senator or president, vote on nation issues and you can do many other activities.

title: MurMur
description: MurMur is a story about love and lust in our lives, about what their absence leads to and what forms they can take. In this game, you'll be playing as a 28-year-old guy who gets involved in unexpected mystical events.

title: Jump Barrel
description:
Jump Barrel is a challenging platform game where players have to hide in barrels and escape from underground prisons. To overcome various obstacles, players need to rotate the barrel and jump from side to side, which requires a lot of skill and experience because it can slip on the move.

Jump Barrel, an easy-to-learn control, is an accessible game, but it requires delicate skills to escape. I highly recommend it to challenging platform game fans.

title: Shadow Island
description: Shadow Island is an adult visual novel/dating sim game with point-and-click and sandbox gameplay. It is set in a Victorian fantasy world inspired by the work of H.P. Lovecraft and contains strong language, some elements of horror and a lot of pornographic images and animations.

title: Furry Futa
description: There are Furry-girls with a twist here! Let's get weird.

title: Assassin's Creed Unity: Secrets of the Revolution
description: The Revolution is not over, the people of Paris still need your help.

title: Putridum Horror
description: Putridum - Psychological dark horror in which the player will have to explore a large dark hous with only a weak flashlight, look for the right things, not be caught and find a way to escape from there.

title: Dinosaurs Dominion
description: Explore and conquer in this single-player dinosaur adventure where you fight, evolve, and conquer territories to reclaim the wilds. Each conquest brings progress, but death sends you back to the start.

title: DiktaPunk: Fighting for Dominance
description:
"DiktaPunk: Fighting for Dominance" A game where you can embody your favorite character or the worst to fight against your opponent, will you be more Joe Biden, Kim Jong-un or Vladimir Putin?

In Diktapunk, Fighting for Dominance, every character is unique and has its strengths and weaknesses.
Be ready to fight with the all-time most powerful (dangerous, craziest, creepiest, Bring-Your-Own-Adjective here...) people of this world. From Kim to Biden, passing by Zelensky or Putin, discover their style and secret techniques to win. Play the piano with your member, use an AK47, make a cringey speech, or dance Gangnam Style on a giant rocket: the choice is yours and there's a lots more to discover!

title: Age of Empires III: Collector's Edition
description:
In this highly anticipated next installment in the Age of Empires franchise from Ensemble Studios, Age of Empires III places players in the time period of roughly 1500–1850, picking up where Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings left off. As players work to establish their empire, they take on the role of a European power struggling to explore, colonize, and conquer North and South America.

Age of Empires III introduces exciting new gameplay elements, including the all-new Home City and an incredible combat system. Players have new civilizations to discover, random maps to conquer, and a single-player campaign unlike any other. Players also find stunning graphics as a result of a revolutionary graphics engine that pushes the limits of PC graphics technology in an entirely new way.

title: Ghost: AC-130 Close Air Support
description: You are the gunner of the AC-130 Gunship. One of the most lethal war machines ever made. Use your skill with thermal optics and three of the biggest and most lethal guns ever produced to stop the enemy cold. This is a mindless shooter. A game to zone out with. Relax, and destroy.

title: Existence: The Outer Reach
description: Existence is a grand RTS that puts you in command of an empire that is expanding across the galaxy. Colonize planets by building bases and extracting valuable resources to build your forces. Attack enemy colonies on planets with mechs and native wildlife. Fight for space superiority with your fleets. Explore the galaxy to discover new planets that offer unique wildlife that can be trained. Monopolize rare minerals to build the devastating weapons capable of exterminating an entire planet.

title: Linkito
description: Unleash your creativity with Linkito! Connect blocks to solve unique puzzles and create your own masterpieces. A sandbox puzzle game with endless possibilities. Join the Linkito community and share your puzzles with the world.

title: Legion Saga
description: Part one of a trilogy heavily inspired by the Suikoden series, with regards to setting, theme, as well as the gameplay systems of recruiting characters into your army, governing a castle and engaging in large-scale battles.

title: Chests, City, Clicker
description: The principle is simple, the more time you spend, the richer you will be, you can do nothing and get money, but the decisions you make will allow you to get even more!

title: Marvel's Midnight Suns: Redemption
description:
Marvel's Midnight Suns: Redemption is the third DLC expansion for Marvel's Midnight Suns. This expansion introduces new story content centred around the character Venom, who becomes a playable hero. The DLC follows Venom's redemption arc after being corrupted by Lilith in the base game.

The expansion adds new missions where players can explore Venom's unique abilities and combat style, which includes powerful symbiote-based attacks. It also includes new enemies and challenges that fit into the overarching narrative of battling Lilith's demonic forces. As with other DLCs in Midnight Suns, "Redemption" further expands the roster of Marvel heroes and deepens the tactical options available to players.

title: The Foglands
description: Run into the unknown, fight monsters, scavenge loot, and try to make it back before you are swallowed by the fog. The Foglands is an atmospheric roguelike adventure where you’ll discover new paths and uncover old secrets.

title: Naruto x Boruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm Connections
description: The next exciting entry in the STORM series, celebrating the 20th anniversary of Naruto's anime debut, releases 2023! The game features new playable characters in addition to the 124 ninjas from past series! Plus, it connects key moments from the first four STORM entries into one game for the first time.

title: The Foretold: Westmark Legacy
description:
The Foretold: Westmark Legacy is Horror Deck Building game inspired by H. P. Lovecraft.

Fight to investigate another day in this gothic horror adventure card game. Equip items and relics. Buy cards and use them wisely to survive what lurks in the darkest corners of town. Take a short and mind-bending dive into the unknown with a cozy horror atmosphere.

title: A Corgi's Cozy Hike
description: Em-bark on a therapeutic adventure as a Corgi exploring a peaceful island getaway. Climb the mountain, soar the sky, and sail the seas to uncover treasures and cozy spots. No need to rush. Relax and savor this bite-sized, open-world experience while 10% of your purchase is donated to animal shelters.

title: 50 Rounds
description: A round based zombie killing experience. Each wave will be harder than the last with bosses showing up at possibly the worst of times. Good luck you will need it.

title: Mortal Kombat 1
description: It’s In Our Blood! Discover a reborn Mortal Kombat Universe created by the Fire God Liu Kang. Mortal Kombat 1 ushers in a new era of the iconic franchise with a new fighting system, game modes, and fatalities!

title: King War
description: Who can be the last king in the dogfight between the countries of the earth and aliens? A pixel-style real-time strategy game, a simple and easy experience for placing units

title: Doomsday Survivors
description: Doomsday Survivors is a doomsday survival rogue bullet hell shooting game. You can choose a variety of characters and choose different weapon combinations to pass the level. Super fast-paced game style, every game can bring you a different experience!

title: I.S.A. Calendar Photoshoot 2023
description: Good day. Today you will be playing the role of a renowned photographer. The International Space Agency has commissioned you to photograph a team of astronauts to publish a charity calendar for 2023.

title: Adventures of Helio
description: Adventures of Helio is a 2D platformer with a dark fantasy setting inspired by Central America. Fight scary enemies, overcome tough challenges, discover powers, and more through 60 levels.

title: Battle Crush
description: The beginning of an explosive action brawl! Battle Crush is an action-packed game with simple controls and intense battles. Smash your enemies with spectacular skills in this electrifying arena filled with explosive energy!

title: Arcade Paradise: Summer of Sports
description: On your marks, get set, go! Compete in the Summer of Sports to become the most decorated athlete in the arcade. Break and set new records in this button mashing and joystick waggling classic.

title: Arcade Paradise: Penguin Push
description: Waddle and hop your way around your enemies, utilising power blocks and platforms to flip the script on the invaders and stop them in their tracks, just be careful of stray birds, cold waters, and angry walruses that haven't been disposed of - there's no fury like a walrus scorned!

title: Arcade Paradise: R.O.G.E.R.
description: Strap yourself in and prepare to enter the danger zone! You are Rocket and Ordinance, Guidance and Evasion Robot 2.0 (Or R.O.G.E.R for short) - your mission? To survive waves of deadly missiles and push your aerial evasive abilities to the limit!

title: UFO Robot Grendizer: The Feast of the Wolves
description: For the first time in the video game history, climb aboard Grendizer the Legendary Robot and fight the forces of evil to defend our planet Earth!

title: Arms Evolution: Zombie Destroyer
description: "Arms Evolution: Zombie Destroyer" is a unique Roguelite tower defense game. You will slaughter thousands of zombies in the game and enhance your weapon towers through build character in the RPG way. and , the game also offers an idle mode, so you can enjoy building weapons anytime and anywhere.

title: Remembering/Not remembering Sin
description: Shunichi Sasaki, a young man who lost his past memories due to higher brain dysfunction, was criticized as a "murderer". Who was he really? Use memory notes to supplement his memories and explore his past.

title: Not Not 2
description: Enhance your Brain Skills by solving clever Puzzles based on orientation, logic and colors!

title: Way of the Hunter: Aurora Shores
description: Explore untouched Alaska nature with a rich population of wild animals like Kodiak bears, Roosevelt elk, Wood bison. Use a broad selection of firearms and equipment to get the best trophies and enjoy the open world habitats ranging from grasslands to mountains

title: Disaster Detective Saiga: An Indescribable Mystery
description: A tale of unnameable calamity by a fiercely unlucky detective! A comical occult horror adventure!

title: Dead Earth
description: A thrilling, first-person, action-survival game set in the modern post-apocalypse. As mankind's last hope, you'll traverse the hospital ravaged by a lethal plague. the fight for survival gets progressively more difficult as the story unfolds. Be ready for violence

title: Anti-Bully Adventure
description: You're a person who has been getting bullied online, then you find a comment that looks positive and decide to click the link attached. An evil virus corrupts your computer and you have to try to get rid of it. Will you be able to do it?

title: Hazard Horizon
description: Distant future. You are on a damaged space station with an unknown creature and dozens of panicked people. There are not enough resources for everyone, so you will have to work hard to survive and escape from this place.

title: Simple Increment
description: Simple but addictive idle clicker game for those who just wants to relax and have some fun.

title: Don't Byte Your Tongue
description: Don’t Byte Your Tongue is a thrilling 8-bit retrowave platformer where you have to climb up multiple levels and overcome various obstacles to reach your robo-lover at the very top. This rage game/precision platformer will test your skills and patience as one wrong move can send you back to the very bottom. You can choose from different game modes to suit your preference and style. You can also show off your best times and rank up on the cross-platform leaderboard that features players from all over the world.

title: The Good Life: Behind the Secret of Rainy Woods
description:
Elizabeth is alive, and no one remembers what happened in the Goddamn Hellhole, that is Rainy Woods. It's time to find out what’s really going on… And maybe enjoy some time in the countryside along the way.

Take on a slew of new side quests from the residents of Rainy Woods and come across some new faces along the way. Help them learn photography! Cook together! Set up secret dates! Save someone’s life...?

Well it’s time for Naomi to put that drink aside and put on her journalism hat once again!

This DLC includes 12 new side quests, with many secrets left to uncover…
Let's peek a bit further behind the curtain of Rainy Woods shall we?

title: Plunder Islands
description: A fast paced 2D platformer, Plunder Islands has you running, jumping and climbing for treasure. Are you ready for the challenges each island brings.

title: The Entity Within
description: The Entity Within is a echolocation Hardcore Stealth Horror game, each map has its story and each monster (called entities in the game) has different powers. Join this atmosphere and try your best.

title: Beetle Ju 2
description: Evil little creatures are invading Beetle Junior's world. Use your skill to defeat them in this side-scrolling adventure. To complete each level, you will need to destroy all the monsters on the level and save all the little bugs.

title: Class Reunion Chat Room
description: Amy receives an invitation to a group chat set up by some of her former classmates. Its purpose is to reconnect after all these years. But soon more and more disturbing facts about Amy's classmates are revealed, and Amy begins to fear that the people she's texting with may not be what they seem.

title: Ultra Blade
description: Defend Mankind's last city from the endless hordes of darkness! Ultra Blade is a horde survival RPG with rogue-lite progression elements. Build new heroes to take on new challenges while cutting through 1000s of foes at once. New heroes unlock new powers, making runs more dynamic the more you play.

title: Epic Assassin
description: Epic Assassin - Bad Dudes are invading the Realm. The Queen has hired an Epic Assassin to Kill Them.

title: Dance Fight
description: Dance Fight is a Beat 'em Up Brawler Game, Also with Cool Dance Moves !

title: Snakebird Complete
description: A console version of Snakebird that contains both Snakebird and Snakebird Primer and some minor adjustments.

title: Sex Advice Succubus
description: Sex Advice Succubus is a cozy mature chat simulator! You play as Qmin, a succubus who works for a company that provides advice to paying clients, with the goal of improving their sex life.

title: Number 94
description: A short experimental horror game about infra-red and the dangers beyond our perceived color spectrum.

title: Trans Goetia
description:
Trans Goetia is a 18+ gender euphoric gay little adventure of trans girl named Circe losing her brain cells from dealing with the mischief making demon Fufu.

Circe gets introduced to the world of magic in exchange of being pestered as she gains squishy softness at a rate regular hormone therapy could never provide! Surely there are no demonic downsides!

This naughty story will be an episodic release, working towards a game where the player gets to nudge Circe towards specific kinks and consequences while even getting to help her decide what her ideal body will be.

title: Demon Dash
description: Somehow the world got taken over by demons because everyone was too gay. Despite the new demon overlords being a bit dangerous, most of them are just vibing and most humans got to continue their lives unaffected. After the general consensus came out that there was a niche for those who really liked demons, a dating and delivery app called demon dash was invented where people can sign up to be a lucky candidate to be picked up by a demon girl.

title: Supplementaries
description: Supplementaries is a highly configurable Forge mod focused on adding valuable content which fills the gaps vanilla has. Its features are tailored to be functional, aesthetically viable, and complementary to preexisting content and provide many new ways to enhance your Vanilla+ experience.

title: I.R.P. Intelligent Rackety Paradise
description: This is a game where you are set out to find the items needed to reach a new paradise.

title: The Man in the Park
description: You see a man in the park on your walk home. Will you help him?

title: Shield Blast
description: Planet Earth is running low on resources and your goal is to help the cargo spaceship, named Mother Ship, reach Planet Earth. You are in hostile territory and will be attacked by all kind of alien enemies such as flowers, mushrooms and weird Lovecraftian creatures.

title: Mind Ripple
description: This is a short, experimental, psychedelic platformer made by me (Lixian), the programmer, and my friend Gabriel Holtschlag, the artist, for the Global Game Jam 2018.

title: Ricochet Gun
description: Use your gun to destroy enemies, but make sure to aim properly or things might get out of control.

title: Damien: The Game
description: Damien: The Game is a game based on Markiplier's Damien YouTube Video.

title: The Warfstache Clicker
description: Warfstache Clicker is Lixian's second fan-made clicker-adventure video game played by Markiplier. It was gifted to Mark by Lixian for his 32ed birthday.

title: Monday Night Mania
description: What are you doing this FRIDAY? At NIGHT time, we will be getting FUNKIN on the DANCE floor! Who will be the best?

title: Simple Solitaire
description: Play the most basic and simple game of solitaire. This game follows the rules of TriPeaks.

title: NagiQ 2: Treasure Hunt
description: NagiQ 2 is a family-friendly, original and challenging word game! Conquer 75 boards full of fun with words! This time Nagi has found a treasure map and is now embarked on an adventure to conquer 5 islands and 75 boards full of fun with words! He’s after all of the treasures and a lot of coins! In NagiQ 2 you’ll enjoy an original gameplay based on combining words on boards to win coins, defeat an evil pirate, win prizes, punch evil skulls, explode monsters, trim mustaches and prove that you are the ultimate wizard of word games!

title: Mold
description: Mold is a beautifully haunting exploration game. Scurry around the decaying sewers as a bug in a dying colony. Collect corpses of your kin to bring to your infected queen, as it is your only purpose.

title: Panic on Ice
description:
Jessy is away on business, but a plane crash puts him in a desperate situation. Isolated in an inhospitable Alaskan environment, he will have to face the freezing cold and fight to survive.

In addition to the horrible situation in which he finds himself, he will still have to deal with cannibal maniacs...

title: Deceit 2
description: Deceit 2 is an online social deduction horror game. Inspire fear as the Terror, play detective as the Innocent, or create mayhem as the Cursed. Trapped with friends and strangers: who can you trust to help you escape?

title: Memetric: Classic
description: It's a "side-scrolling" real-time strategy game, pixelart style, with a few small "rouge-lite" elements. You have to collect and farm creatures, various bizarre creatures, to further develop your territory and eventually defeat the evil force that has been organizing against you throughout the game.

title: I will Blow up the Earth Muahahahahahahaha!!!
description: This is a game about a girl who wants to blow up the earth because she is very evil.

title: Momo Horror Story
description:
Momo is a horror game based on the history of the message user "momo".

In the game, you will be a guy that contacts momo by message, and now he will be pursued by the monster of momo.

You will have to complete some tasks before get rescued, like turn on the generator, find some keys, close windows etc...

The objetive is to survive until the timer reachs 00:00 then, the police will arrive and you would able to escape.

There are two modes in game, Classic and Gun mode.

title: Embervale.TV
description:
Welcome to Embervale.TV, the ultimate fantasy role play game that you can play fully as an extension on Twitch! Join the adventure and immerse yourself in a world of magic and wonder where you can become the strongest player, team up with other players, and create the most powerful guild.

Embark on thrilling adventures alongside your favorite streamers and experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat!

title: Life is Pain
description: Life is Pain is a 2D platformer with elements of hardcore, dynamic gameplay and abstract graphics in which you need to pass a variety of levels, playing as an alien.

title: Feudal Friends
description: Feudal Friends is a competitive tower defense game. Each player has different tasks within the tower and they work together to produce new soldiers and determine strategies to conquer the opposing tower. Plan your strategy well because this war does not wait for anyone!

title: A.L.T.
description: A 32-map megawad for Doom II from the Russian Doom clan Clan B0S know for its surreal narrative built around traditional Doom gameplay.

title: Lycanthorn III
description:
Join Rain in a short, sweet, action packed adventure through haunted forests, decrepit villages, and cold cobbled ruins...

Collect cash to buy powerful sidearms and upgrades, gather the five orbs to unlock Dracula's Castle, retake Morvania from the Vampires!

title: GRID Legends: Valentin’s Classic Car-Nage
description: Buckle up and prepare for adrenaline-fueled chaos as Demo Derby-style game mode Classic Car-Nage smashes its way into GRID Legends to rewrite every racing rule. Join Valentin Manzi, played by Ncuti Gatwa, to cause havoc and bash bumpers with your nemesis in GRID Legends’ epic, new game mode. With the pack’s 8 new Story Experiences, 5 eclectic new Vehicles, 4 new Tracks and 3 fresh Career Events, you’ll have all you need to claim bragging rights and cause optimum carnage.

title: Super Cosmic Land
description:
In this adventure, you are "Fierce" the self-proclaimed "Bandit King" who has just pulled of a heist and is basking in his stolen treasure on a remote planet from far, far away.

As he is reveling in his spoils, he is suddenly struck from the skies by a mysterious blot of darkness who also makes off with his treasure!

Help Fierce retrieve the treasure that he rightfully stole and find out who is behind this sudden theft of a thief!

title: Clean Paper
description: Clean Paper is a horror game with comedy overtones that doesn't last more than 15 minutes. an interdimensional giraffe brought you to her strange world to help her with an important task

title: Pixel Wars
description:
Test your strategy skills in an intense real-time battle with friends. With just enough units and buildings to keep it exciting, you can jump into an online multiplayer game the moment that perfect Steam invite arrives!

Get ready to enjoy the simplicity! With only five building types and six unit types, you don’t have to worry about feeling bogged down—now it's time for some fun.

Discover an uncharted world with each map you generate! Unlock new levels of excitement as you journey through unpredictable landscapes and ever-changing challenges.

With just one click, you can challenge your Steam friends to a thrilling online match! Have fun and prove yourself the ultimate gaming champion.

Now you can make quick work of commanding your troops with our intuitive control system. Select and group units without the hassle, so that military tactics come to life right before your eyes!

Step back in time and explore the world of pixel art. With our retro graphics, you can experience a classic aesthetic while still staying clear and readable - it's fantastical fun!

title: Mystery Legends: Phantom of the Opera - Collector’s Edition
Tchia: Oléti Edition
description: The Tchia: Oléti Edition comes with the Tchia base game and the Kepler Customization Pack, which includes four costume sets for Tchia and four boat customization packs, inspired by fellow titles from the Kepler game catalogue.

title: Orb Devils
description: A short experimental deck building roguelike! Use Attack Cards on enemy intentions to weaken their attacks, Use Heal Cards on status effects to increase their effects! Play as Demon bounty hunters looking for their Target as you combine and use Card orbs.

title: B.C. Piezophile
description: B.C. Piezophile is a first-person action horror game set deep underwater. It features a foreign ocean brimming with ambivalent environments, hazardous anomalies and baroque ecosystems. Stranded in the hadal zone, the player must ascend over 6,150 AeC before they can dream of rescue.

title: Onenellemoo
description: This is an action-adventure game that requires you to use your brain. Save the world with your powers of observation and inspiration!

title: Never Forgotten
description: A uniquely stylised survival-horror adventure game. Explore a dying world, navigating through hazards and solving puzzles by deciphering riddles and combining items.

title: Gemstone Guardians
description: Gemstone Guardians is a tower defense game where selection and combinations are key. Similar to a game of poker, players are given a set of random towers each round and must make the best combinations to prevent the waves of enemies from reaching the end.

title: TerraScape
description: Build gorgeous kingdoms on floating islands by strategically placing buildings in this cozy City-Puzzler. Discover secret combinations, take on weekly challenges and explore randomly generated maps in various single- and multiplayer game modes.

title: Elven Rivers: The Forgotten Lands - Collector's Edition
description: Celene and her brave teammates have already earn a reputation for themselves: this is why they were chosen to be the first group to explore the neighbouring continent of beastmen.

title: Saccharine Pale
description: Saccharine Pale is a "Slash 'n Parry Nemesis Feud" with a DEEPLY robust, intuitive, and revolutionary combat system! Launch your rival, the Stiltfox, into the air with a well timed parry to juggle it with attacks, or slam it into a solid surface and see what happens!

title: Enemies: Gone Suburban
description: Tired of the story? The plot? The looming twists? Take a break and shoot the shit and not in a conversational manner! Like literally, shoot shit!!! Well not actual shit but like, shoot things. Shoot....Enemies!

title: Etherion Online
description: Gear up! Become a prestige master in weapons or master a skill - join thousands of other players in this massive 2D adventure!

title: The Obscura Experiment
description: Anabasis & Co. welcomes you to the family - we’re so glad to have you here! Your mandate as part of this research project will be to monitor and document a new energy form: the [Redacted]. To begin, let’s review your perso- oh? We’re detecting some anomalies near you… care to investigate?

title: Jetpac Too
description: A free frantic and fast paced reimagining of the classic Jetpac with All Vs All or Team Match with unique real-time terraforming played over the surface of a planetoid.

title: Lovelorn Sanatorium Ⅲ
description: This is a spoof plot puzzle game. Click the dialogue to advance the plot. There are many puzzle-solving levels in the game. You can find props by exploring and solve puzzles according to the game prompts

title: Digital Eclipse Arcade: Q.P.I.D.
description: Rescue cats! Collect hearts! Defy the laws of physics! Q.P.I.D. is part platformer, part physics puzzler, part race against the clock. Did we mention the cats?

title: Sweet Science: The Girls of Silversee Castle
description: A visual novel that takes you back in time – to a chapter of your youth, long forgotten – to four quirky young women – to a castle full of science, mysteries and – perhaps – romance...This is the first large AI-generated VN.

title: SlavicPunk: Oldtimer
description: The game is an isometric shooter. The story revolves around Yanus- a private investigator with a troubled past trying to solve the case of stolen data while fighting his inner demons, urban gangs and an omnipotent corporation responsible for the decay of the city he once used to call his own.

title: Railway Company Owner
description: Railroad Tycoon is a puzzle train simulator video game. build a railway city bigger and more complex than anyone could ever imagine. Build your city into the biggest railroad city in the world.

title: Finding Fern
description: Finding Fern is an Action Adventure RPG with an emphasis on story and dialog. Your party members will talk to each other as well as many people and denizens they meet along the way.

title: Loya
description: Loya is an open world, multiplayer RPG with dynamic combat, crafting and a procedurally generated world! Play alone or with your friends with private servers!

title: El Panadero: The Baker
description: Action Packed 2D Arcade Action Platformer featuring hand-drawn graphics. Armed with your fists (or a rolling pin) and a variety of bread-based boosts, fend of the the Alien Plants, and avenge the Bakery they destroyed.

title: Aleon's Nightmare 2
description: Welcome to the World of Nightmares! You play as Aleon, you woke up in an unfamiliar place. You need to understand what is going on and get help from the surrounding objects. The nightmare world includes different parts. Castle, Kingdom, Forest, and Dungeon.

title: Grey Haven
description: Grey Haven is a game where you explore Nightmare and build a village with the girls you saved. Explore the Nightmare with the help of the witch, help the girls and gather resources to build your haven.

title: Attack on Hex Island
description: A cute and approachable turn-based deck builder/card battler that combines the battle systems from Tetra Master/Triple Triad and Pokémon. Collect, upgrade, and customize your party to strategically defeat your opponents and save them from the attack on Hex Island.

title: Angrbotha Mountains
description: Angrbotha mountains is a short cinematic, story driven adventure RPG game. Regard it as a short solo RPG session with a game master. Levelling up, meet wandering creatures, putting the story together, making choices, exploring and finding items are important parts to put the events to rest.

title: Hearth's Light: Potion Shop
description: A cozy, casual potion-making and shop-managing game, that is complimented by an array of deep mechanics to keep crafting potions satisfying and interesting regardless of how many times you've done it.

title: Subtension
description: Outfit, crew and command your submarine to save what's left of humanity beneath the seas of a ruined earth. Man your sub's systems and take aim in this real-time strategy epic! Inspired by FTL, this subnautic student project serves as our first 2-semester release.

title: You Are Sick
description: Do you like feeling sick? Well, this is the perfect game for you! Feel the thrill of testing your parkour skills as you overcome simulated sickness. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Captain Meow
description: FPS RPG Action Adventure

title: The Devilry Reservation
description: A faceless PSS agent visits a "reservation" due to complaints from its residents. Deal with the problems of evil spirits and reveal their mysteries and secrets. Explore a world once hidden from people. Get to know the mythological stars and their life stories.

title: Virtual Families 3
description: The sequel to the smash hit mobile game “Virtual Families 2” is here!

title: Punt
description: In Punt, gravity is at your fingertips -- discover the abilities of the E.M.M.A. in this new and innovative first-person puzzle platformer running on the Source Engine!

title: Death Race Outer Space
description: Fast paced 3d multi-player/single-player shooter which can be played both in online as well as split-screen modes. Players race against each other through the trenches of space in a gameplay style which rewards spontaneity, shooting and athleticism in a dynamic and complex environment.

title: Water 2050
description: Take on the ultimate challenge of being mayor of the last city with clean water reserves in 2050. Manage resources, discover new technologies and tackle the global water crisis with Water 2050. An innovative blend of city building, resource management, adventure, and survival genres all in one game.

title: AInder
description: What is AI? What is love? In Ainder, you will be able to swipe “Like” or “Nope” on characters created by AI. They sometimes send photos that might excite you. Through communicating with the characters, the human and the AI will learn and adapt.

title: Bombo Rumble
description: Bombo Rumble is a 4 player local - multiplayer game where you throw bombs with physics at your foes. Battle in 12 different arenas, use a variety of weapons and power ups to blast away your friends or play against Bots

title: Bloody Horror Plant
description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

title: Reflexia: The Archetype's Room of Three Walls
description: The story in this game that's missing the fourth wall and the roof starts from pantsu jokes and ends with your depression. Play at your own risk!

title: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 3
description: Two young girls must solve puzzles, avoid traps and overcome hellish enemies to find The Six Medalions and put an end to The Entity's reign, once and for all.

title: Before Resignation
description: It is a game in which the main character, who suffered from stress after being unfairly treated at the company, takes revenge the day before leaving the company.

title: Dystopian Debugger
description: Dystopian Debugger is a puzzle game about debugging murderous robots.

title: Xheres
description: Either FPS or TPS, choose your play style and survive the apocalypse on your own or with your friends. But one must know for sure it ain't gonna be easy, there are hordes waiting for you. Not even considering tough ones... Nevertheless it's gonna be a fun experience.

title: Lorena and the Land of Ruins
description: Lorena and the Land of Ruins is a third-person 3D platform shooter in which you explore a beautiful fantasy world filled with many mysteries and ruins of the past!

title: Potio Mellow
description: Experience endless adventure in "Potio Mellow," a single-player card game. Explore, gather, craft and battle your way through a mysterious world with a radiant art style. Build your deck, overcome obstacles and discover endless possibilities.

title: Milo no Senki 3
description: In this new entry to the turn-based tactical-RPG Milo no Senki serie, Lord Milo and his group of companions will travel to the realm of the dead in order to bring back their departed friend, Prince Nelson...

title: Low Oxygen
description: A short linear puzzle platformer about an astronaut on an alien planet. Explore this strange facility by solving strange puzzles which include but not limited to pushing plants, throwing plants, growing plants, bouncing plants and last but not least bouncing plants on other plants.

title: Misaligned
description: Misaligned is a set of 11 vanilla maps for Doom 2 by @myolden and @Ludi, made specifically to feature the MIDIs created by @MtPain27. These maps are short and have low monster counts. The whole set takes about 30 minutes to play.

title: Deliverance & Reign
description: Join a gothic battle where Good confronts Evil using roguelike deckbuilding mechanics. Play as either side, invading Alaric's Castle, or as Alaric himself defending against the invading heroes!

title: The Battle of Sacred Heart
description: The Battle of Sacred Heart is a refreshing action RPG. Sacred Heart nuns challenge the elite of the four armies of Middle Earth. What the player must face is a protracted battle to the death.

title: MF-01 Aerostrike
description: A Tactical Shmuplovania. Aerostrike combines elements from Metroidvania, Bullet Hell, and Shmup genres. Take flight in the MF-01 Aerostrike, explore a large underground base, battle against squadrons of hostile ships of all shapes and sizes, and find a way to escape alive.

title: Deep Death Dungeon Darkness
description: Challenge yourself again and again to meet your dead lover in dark fantasy roguelike action The structure of the Labyrinth of Death, which leads to the underworld, changes every time you play Abundant weapons, heavy action and heavy-handed combat through magic

title: Riley in the Abyss
description: Riley In The Abyss is a stealth action shooter. You wake up as 'Riley'in an underwater facility to research the depths of the ocean. Upon waking up, something is wrong... Everyone is seemingly dead. Sink or swim in this short psychological horror game.

title: Space Pop: Bubble Shooter
description: "Blast off into the galaxy with our new bubble shooter game! Explore 200 levels set across stunning intergalactic environments and pop your way to victory. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, you'll enjoy hours of bubble-blasting fun.

title: Super Crane Bug
description: Retro match 3 with a Bug juggling at his job. Line tiles in a line to destroy them, but the way to move them changes constantly. Be a Bug, Do a Work, Match a 3

title: Paddle Flap
description: Ready, set, FLAP! Flex your paddle flapping skills in this casual but engaging arcade game. Imagine pinball, but remove all distractions and just focus on the ball action. Use the paddle to strike the falling balls and make them hit the right targets to earn points, power-ups and achievements!

title: Sharks
description:
Swim, bite and attack using a unique locomotion method that only needs the movement of your head and one controller: look where you want to go, pull the trigger to swim, squeeze the grip button to bite. You won't believe how fluid and dynamic the shark motion is.
Hunt with groups of up to 10 people online. Eat whatever you can to survive and avoid the zombie sharks: last player standing wins.

Escape from other sharks, or outmaneuver the survivors to catch them. Use powerups, hide in caves and shipwrecks, and use cannonballs and mines to evade and chase sharks down.

title: Survivor Mercs
description: Lead your squad of Mercs against M.E.G.A. Corp.'s evil robot army. Fast-paced twin-stick action, frantic horde survival, tactical squad-building & lots of loot! Exploit game-breaking synergies and beat the evil billionaire bosses in ever-changing operations. Lock, load, and loot, Commander!

title: World of Mana
description: You can play with many people with a map made with the map editor and share the created map. You can set up individual or team battles and become a team together to catch monsters, escape mazes, or fight each other. Create a map using the map editor in World of Mana and enjoy it together.

title: Night Stones
description: You awake in Mythica, a cozy island where magical stones change day to night. Explore winding paths or venture into the wilds with your trusty glider and sailboat. To return home, you must befriend quirky townsfolk, discover hidden treasures, master magic, and face enemies in clever puzzle combat.

title: Sahara Storms WWIII
description: Sahara Storms WWIII is a multiplayer tactical First Person Shooter based on modern current environment. Offering objective gameplay where every player plays their part to win. Whether if you are a Assault, a Support, a Medic or Recon Class each role is important.

title: Game Collecting Simulator
description: In "Game Collecting Simulator", play as the new collector in town, Thomas. Interact with other game enthusiasts and hunt for the games you want. This is a short visual novel featuring casual gameplay.

title: Erophone:Re
description: Erophone is returned and renewed from its original. The conflict between humans and ajin girls continues to escalate in the NORMAL city, the organizations behind the scenes are eager to move. The choice is in your hands whether to help the girls or to hunt them down.

title: Water Tank
description: A year had almost passed since my wife disappeared. It has been raining in a cloudy sky. Every day the phone rings with calls from his wife's mother inquiring about her whereabouts. Various rumors have begun to circulate in the neighborhood about his wife's sudden disappearance.

title: Pinewood Valley
description: Pinewood Valley is a Single Player, First-Person Open World Horror. Set in 2006, you play a young male who returns to his hometown and finds the whole town has vanished or being killed by a group of unknown killers. You must Run, Hide or Fight to uncover what happened in Town of Pinewood Valley.

title: MoonScavenger
description: The main character also dreams of becoming a billionaire, leaving behind a gloomy future that seems to be just an ordinary life on Earth, investing all the money he had in moon tickets and a moon cleaning company, and embarking on a long journey penniless.

title: Battle Cry of Freedom: Blood & Gore
description: Experience the brutal and gruesome reality of the 19th Century with the Blood & Gore DLC for Battle Cry of Freedom. With the Blood & Gore DLC you can expect to see new and improved death and wounded animations including decapitations, dismemberment and more.

title: HiveCorp
description: Join the HiveCorp mercenaries in their fight against an onslaught of enemies in this action rogue-lite auto-shooter. Avoid enemies, level up and combine powerful weapons and equipment to survive.

title: Chronicles of Time: Timeline Zero
description: Travel back in time and unravel the mystery of humanity's extinction in Chronicles of Time: Timeline Zero. Play as Azura, a skilled warrior with time-manipulation abilities, and defeat the rogue AI, Crimson, in an epic battle for the fate of humanity.

title: Fishjong 2
description: Fishjong is back with more colorful mahjong levels! Now play Fishjong 2! The goal is simple – clear the board by making matches. Various colors and shapes of tiles, new set and background. No storyline - just a great mahjong gameplay. Have fun playing ocean-theme levels.

title: Midnight Arrow
description: Hop on platforms and jump on walls to explore a vast immersive world. Discover different types of arrows and use them to solve puzzles and traverse this dimly lighted world.

title: New Year Break
description: New Year Break is retro arcade game with animated characters, powerups and custom music. Collect bonuses and powerups and blast your way thru the 30 Levels into the New Year. Simple controls and retro arcade action. Collect all the powerups to stack powerups.

title: Glimmer Chain
description: Glimmer Chain is a skill-based platformer in which you are an energized robot with a hook and a chain. Swing and light up the city in the shortest time possible!

title: Walk and Stroll
description: Take a brief stroll in the beautiful walking-sim, adventure game: Walk and Stroll! See the sights, find items, and interact with things around town to make the impassable passable.

title: Cats Hidden in Italy
description: Find and discover 100 cute cats hidden across Italy in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: Polar Penguin
description: Help the lost penguin find his way home to his family. Magnetize your way through obstacles along the journey and avoid possible dangers on your path. This game is a short physics based platformer using magnets to traverse yourself and your surroundings.

title: Radical Road
description: A casual, arcade, one button game about getting a car to go as far as it can on an infinitely procedually generated road, while collecting coins.

title: Psycho Fear
description: Psycho Fear is a heart-pounding co-op survival-horror experience where players must escape to survive. Solve challenging puzzles, overcome deadly obstacles, and fight deadly enemies in an intense atmosphere, nerve-wracking and dark environment will keep players on edge.

title: Super Sean 007
description: Super Sean 007 is a platform game with a great world. The world consists of various beautiful sceneries of nature: forests, caves, mountains, and abandoned ruins telling the stories of when there used to be a civilization there.

title: Forbidden Dojo
description: Embark on an erotic journey where the line between fantasy and reality is blurred. In this sensual visual novel, you are caught between two beautiful and deadly warriors, each with their own unique allure. With each choice you make, the story will unfold, revealing a tale of passion and intrigue.

description: A crime that is not proven is not a crime!

description: Life in the Twilight - this is a world of hopelessness in which the guardians are looking for you to stop your escape.

description: Shadow of Ether is a first person horror game where a man with a spiritual power goes deep into the lower astral plane to banish an archon in a secluded haunted house in a forest.

title: Delivery Kore

Become Kore, a forest girl, explore the forest of Eleusis with Poring, and deliver Poring to a new world.

description: Athenian Rhapsody: Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is a dangerously goofy RPG with fast paced, unique combat and zany secrets and adventures. Your goal is to build your own rhapsody, the story of you - the player - an experience which cannot be replicated by others.

description: Help the two dogs dig out the bones they hid in the dirt..."Dog Puzzle" is a challenging puzzle game that requires you to think carefully without worrying about time limits.

title: Operation: Polygon Storm
description: A fastpaced, military tug-of-war game with minimal micromanagement. Choose and deploy from a mix of specialized military units to overwhelm the enemy. Experiment with a huge variety of unit compositions, synergies, abilities, and upgrades to lead your army to victory!

title: Kabuto
description: In this game every move matters, kabuto and a pixel art puzzle game where you control a samurai who seeks revenge in a world where only the strong survive.

title: Frontline Survivors
description: Frontline Survivors is an intense top-down shooter that puts you in the boots of a soldier fighting for survival on the battlefield. With countless enemies coming at you from all sides, you'll need to use all your skills and strategy to stay alive.

title: Blood 'N Bullets
description: Blood 'N Bullets is a top down roguelike shooter where your ammo, health and currency are one and the same. You play as a vampire stuck in a prison and have to shoot your way out while your "friend" helps you with upgrades.

description: Are you ready to climb the ranks of the elite and become the wealthiest hedge fund in the world? In this thrilling new stock market game, you'll trade stocks, bonds, and use corruption to achieve your goals. Don't miss your chance to dominate the world of finance and amass a fortune.

description: Experience the ultimate life simulator in To Pixelia. Create your own story, choose your character's look and design your home. Climb the career ladder, compose songs, cook, fight, drive and take care of your health. Live the life you've always wanted.

title: Fight With Keys
description: A combination of action and rhythm games, players need to move characters while entering corresponding keys.

description: The Twin Hunters fell into The Segment World... Combat various monsters and bosses, and complete their segmented journey! The Segment Twins is a hack-and-slash game with simple controls and a unique character tag action feature.

title: The Editor
description:
Newspaper Editing Adventure.
"In 1996, a congressman was murdered...The prime suspect is a congressman's aide.
As the suspicious article was published the story begins"
Play the role of editor-in-chief of a newspaper.
You become the editor of a newspaper and write a front-page article every day.

description: Play through your gloomiest dreams in this challenging ragdoll platformer! Learn and survive the levels, collect dream shards to unlock extra challenges

title: Chronicles of TalDun: The Longing
description: A kinetic novel about two magi learning how to live with the burden they each carry. Explore Tal'Dun—a world of dark magick and primordial beings with unfathomable power. Follow a mysterious phenomenon as it turns the world upside down in a way not even magi would be prepared for.

title: Cosmo's Pizzarama
description: Craft fresh slices to restore order to the galaxy.

title: Crazy Designer
description: A strategy and simulation game about interior design. The player has to make the perfect arrangement of compartment, furniture and decoration to satisfy everyone's different request. 9 topics and more than 1200 items in the game.

title: Pooh Honeytime
description: Winnie the Pooh is no longer the same as before. Now he stalks these woods, and few have been lucky enough to see him and escape with their lives. It will be you, your car and your guts.

title: The Awaited ReCollection
description: A story about fatherly love and family affection. A gift for those children who have lost a father in their lives.

title: Arena Story: Rouge And Princess Knight
description: For various reasons, they come to the gladiatorial arena where they can get their wishes, and they keep fighting! The gladiatorial arena is filled with people of different races, demons, or anything else. If you lose, you lose everything, and if you win at the end, you can get everything.

description: Beat the Humans is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a squad of aliens against human invaders. Gather your squad, fight, collect artifacts and explore the star system map to survive and win.

description: Avoid or defeat dolls that move when you're not looking, take their bodies, and make your way to the 399th dimension. This is a short horror game of fear and strategy, an exploration survival horror.

title: Discounty
description: Manage your own discount supermarket! Get caught up in small-town drama, organize and plan your shop's layout, and strike lucrative trade deals as you expand your secretive aunt's business empire. Selling more frozen fries will surely heal this broken community...right?

description: You've always wanted to be a hero, and now's your time. Help Tom save his sister Lisa and prove yourself as a hero. It's up to you to rescue Lisa. Are you brave enough to accept the challenge and save her in Hero World?

After some events in her town, she will have to leave the safety of the forest behind and go explore a world full of dangers. The fate of her grove will be in her hands.

description: You have the opportunity to become the husband of the Goblin Baroness. But what are your chances if this love is a sham?

title: Emplacement
description: Emplacement is a turn-based strategy game. Build up a floating metropolis while destroying your enemies. Place your tiles across the map while strategically building up your army & economy. Come up with strategies similar to chess to become the best!

title: Sushi Warrior: Secret Plan
description: "Sushi Warrior: Secret Plan" is a 2D side-scrolling platformer game. With precise physical simulation, this game will put your skills and patience to the test. But be warned, this game is not for the faint of heart.

title: Hunting Pearl Creek
description: Hunting Pearl Creek is a 2d platform game. You make your way along the creek through 9 challenging levels. There are many obstacles and dangers along the way. The challenge is to survive and hopefully reach the cabin.

title: Dramatic Road: The Origin of Wind
description: A full-fledged simulation RPG set in modern Japan! A variety of characters unique to modern times, such as riders, magicians, and baseball players, have appeared. Command them, nurture them, and use their skills to protect the peace of the school!

title: Minos Station: Escape Room
description: You are trapped in one of minos games, an escape room creator, you have several puzzles to solve, and several clues to follow to solve those puzzles, but each time you go to the next escape room, the puzzles are more complicated.

title: Hentai Casual Swap
description: Enjoy this casual tile swap puzzle with dozens of nice illustrations for you to enjoy and relax. With an open gallery for simply relaxing!

title: Plastic Soul
description: Plastic Soul is a daily life simulation about living with an android. Play as a man who gets an android from you son to help you move on from your deceased wife. Progress through the story by interacting with your android and discover the secret behind your wife's death.

title: Travellin Cats in Paris
description: Find 100 cats hiding in Paris, France in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game.

title: Scrap Bastion
description: Scrap Bastion is a strategy tower defense game where you manage your city, equipping it to survive the waves of mutant creatures, testing your planning and decision making capacities at every turn. Watch out, as time is crucial to win!

title: Trinity Of The Fabled
description: Join Trinity Of The Fabled, a league of Warriors, Gods, and Demons who traverse the Abyss in seek of wealth and power.

title: Toleo

description: Walk on walls. Manipulate gravity. Discover secrets. In this first-person puzzle game, delve deep into an ancient labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking an imprisoned god at the centre.

description: Evil gatekeepers. Transgendered protagonist. Overdue reckoning.This is a casual sci-fi action-adventure bullet-hell dodger about transgender people re-visiting a post-apocalyptic earth and searching for a lost artefact. A wholesome trauma-healing adventure.

title: Final Dose
description: Final Dose is an immersive stealth simulator game inspired by slasher horror movies. You are being pursued by a relentless AI that can see and hear you. You will need to explore every inch of an abandoned clinic and find items and puzzle pieces to unlock doors and crawl through vents. Run or hide under beds, in bathroom stalls and cabinets, crouch to move around silently, and do whatever it takes to figure out how to escape this place!

title: Cavimilation
description: Cavimilation is a 2D shooter/platformer throwback to classic high score chasing games with the addition of modern roguelike elements. Explore an endless procedurally generated cave filled with treasure and monsters, where every mistake takes its toll and where every bullet counts.

title: Fishjong
description: Dive into the magical world of underwater Mahjong. Test your skills again and again on more than 100 levels. Customize your tiles, sets, backgrounds and tile shapes. Take a load off with the game's relaxing music and meditative gameplay.

description: Pogo Joins The Circus takes the role of the eponymous Pogo Joe, a boy on a pogo stick. Holding the joystick button lets Pogo Joe jump over a barrel or empty space the width of a barrel. Falling off is impossible.

description: When an alien boy named Enoch lands on your balcony one fateful Sunday evening, your life is changed forever. Can you keep your alien roommate a secret from the world?

description: Mortalis Institute's patented Helper Bond System provides quick and easy diagnosis for physical trauma. Place your arm in the device and follow the simple instructions to receive a diagnosis.

title: Mother Bird Horror Story Ch2

After you escaped from MOMO in your house, you lost your sanity. The asylum is you home now.
But did you really get away from IT ? Is It real or it's just in your head ?
You are about to find out in this thrilling horror adventure.
Solve the puzzles and fight scary mental patients while you trying to leave the madhouse.

Welcome to The Psychological Horror Game of Mannequins in process: Eeriest Night.

Will you discover the secrets of this place?

I lived a fun and trendy life as a working woman, but after a night of drinking, I found myself married to a coworker!?

A welcome home kiss, a ring on my finger... I shouldn't feel love for a contract marriage, but why does my heart beat so fast?

An oath and a marriage registration later, can love be born from marriage?

This game is horny for drones, robots, mind/body control, and the future.

title: Enthralled
description: "Enthralled" is a short game about a man possessed by a demon. It takes place in a desolate world where you balance between looking for a way out, stopping the demon from killing innocent people, and not being completely devoured yourself. Explore the world and find a way to deal with your curse.

title: Marble Blast Platinum
description: Marble Blast Platinum (aka MBP) is a standalone modification of Marble Blast Gold released in 2007.

title: Anchors: Blockade Zone
description: Anchors: blockaded zero is a Cthulhu style 2d shooting game. The game requires players to explore in various maps generated by the program, find and bring back equipment, and live in a base full of doomsday atmosphere. When you explore the map, you see some strange things, calm down. Maybe that's truth!

title: Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse
description: 'Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse' is the sequel to 'Bad 2 Bad: Delta' and 'Extinction', armed with a vaster world and richer content. Apocalypse follows the story of the Delta Team, led by Major Pan, saving and reconstructing the world ravaged by a virus from the Human Forces. Join the Delta Team on their journey from survival to rebuilding the world.

Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between. Customize your weapons to your liking and get ready to prove that you have what it takes to come out on top!

description: The Thaumaturge is a story-driven RPG with morally ambiguous choices, taking place in the culturally diverse world of early 20th century Warsaw. In this world, Salutors exist: esoteric beings that only Thaumaturges can truly perceive and use for their needs.

description: Cache Grabbers is a chill first-person cartography puzzle game. Navigate through 30 levels in a strange environment, using only your compass, metal detector and shovel to find and grab the cache — and maybe even a way to escape.

description:
Molehill Empire is a fun economy simulation, revolving entirely around the microcosm garden. As free browser game it runs entirely in your web browser, without any additional downloads or software!
Given the task of an industrious garden gnome, you'll be able to create your very own private Garden of Eden. Lettuce, carrots, strawberries, spinach or onions - it's up to you which plants you want to grow. Visit the friendly towns of Green Valley and Hedgerow Ville to trade with other players, purchase new plants and decorations to spice up your own garden, deliver your customer's orders and always make sure to be a good neighbour ... or you might wake up one day to find your garden infested by an army of moles...

title: Five Nights at Old Toy Factory
description: You are working as a night guard at the old toy factory. Some strange stuff is happening over night. Explore and stay alive. Find clues to what is going on here. Your shift starts at 00h ( midnight ) and ends at 06h. The only thing you need is to survive. How hard can it be ?

title: Road Trip USA 2: West - Collector's Edition
description: This time, explore beautiful locations spanning the Western states as you hunt for hidden objects. Hidden Object enthusiasts will rejoice with over 2,200 objects to locate across multiple game modes and beautiful hi-resolution scenes! For a change of pace, test your puzzle solving skills against a fun selection of 8 mini games! Don’t miss this trip of a lifetime!

title: Glass Masquerade: Origins
description:
Welcome to Glass Masquerade - an artistic puzzle game inspired by Art Deco & stained glass artisans of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to unveil clocks and themes exhibited by various cultures of the world at the 'International Times Exhibition' - an interactive electronic show.
The Origin's edition includes all the previously released DLCs

title: Southern Cross
description: The tale of a wandering swordsman seeking the Strongest, at the end of his journey.

description: FNAF Rewritten: '87 is a re-imagining of FNAF 2.

description: I made this experience after watching "My Octopus Teacher" on Netflix. I've always wanted to make a underwater environment for an exploration game but I never found a place to implement it. After watching the movie I just wanted to do it anyway without any gameplay elements at all.

title: Drift Experience Japan: Supporter Edition
description: Get the Supporter Edition of Drift Experience Japan and enhance your experience with new maps and extra content!

title: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump

Interested in boxing, fitness and bodybuilding?
Do you dream of becoming the coolest boxer and knocking out your opponents in packs?
Do you want to be the most powerful in the gym?
Download the game and let's get started!
Here is a game that can make your fingers tremble with tension, performing the next approach!

title: Pokémon Floral Tempus EX

When the time arrives, the protagonist and their two friends decide to embark on their brand new adventure, brimming with eagerness and hope. Unbeknownst to them, the evil Team Blight have been secretly planting their seeds of fate that will eventually entangle the three adventurers. Only time will reveal the real intentions of Team Blight and the shady institutions of Rialtra.

title: Pokemon Heads & Tails
description: Pokémon Heads & Tails is a Spanish, superhero-themed Pokémon Fan Game developed during the summer of 2017 and 2018. Launched originally only in Spanish, the game has been recently translated to English. The game has a superhero-themed story, with an extensive post-game after finishing the Pokémon League that serves as a second half for the overall plot.

title: Z Day Shootout
description:
Do you love old school shooters ? Z Day Shootout is just that! Lot of weapons, lot of zombies. Just search and destroy! It happend so fast! We didn't see it coming! The Virus was Spreading So quickly!... Soon everyone got infected! Well, not everyone... There is still a few of us. Fighting. Surviving! I was chosen for this mission! Best survivor, best GUNMAN! It's up to me to clean this Town of the Undead!

So What are you waiting for ? Pick up Your GUN and DO the Dirty Work! Good Luck. You're gonna need it!

title: Momo

Momo is a horror game based on the history of the whatssap user "momo", in the game, you will be a guy that contacts momo by whatsapp, and now he will be pursued by the monster of momo.

You will have to complete some tasks before get rescued, like search things, hide, close doors, etc.

The objetive is to survive until the timer reachs 00:00 then, the police will arrive and you would able to escape.
