description: The Shadow of the Erdtree is a fully-fledged expansion that features an all-new story set in the Land of Shadow. It adds a whole new map with 70 new weapons, ten new shields, 39 new Talismans, 14 new sorceries, 28 new incantations, 20 new Spirit Ashes, 25 New Ashes of War, 30 new armour sets, and new consumables and craftables.

title: Dungeons & Jewels
description:
Dungeons & Jewels is a Tile-Matching Roguelike.
Collect Relics. Learn Spells. Fight monsters and use your abilities by matching tiles, creating combos, and solving puzzles!

title: Call of Duty: Vietnam
description:
Call of Duty: Vietnam is a cancelled installment of the Call of Duty series that was under development by Sledgehammer Games. It was stated to be taking place in the 1960s and 1970s, in Cambodia, Vietnam and Laos.

The game was planned to be in the action/adventure genre and would've been the first third-person only Call of Duty game. After eight months of development, the game had up to 15 minutes playable, at which point Activision offered Sledgehammer the opportunity to help Infinity Ward in the development of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.

title: RoboCock
description: You are a Robo-Chicken that has been sent to hell for your many evil acts. Now you only have one purpose. Kill!!!

title: Three Lilies and Their Ghost Stories
description: Three different areas, three different decades, three different tales. A visual novel defined as a "kinetic story anthology".

title: It Gets So Lonely Here
description:
You are running through a forest.

It is late at night and the sky is as black as pitch.

The trees which surround you, jutting out of the earth like eerie monuments to a foreign god, are blotting out most of the moonlight.

You do not know where you are going.

You have no map; no route; no plan.

You have no desire, as you run, save to escape.

You cannot let yourself be caught.

All you can do is run, on and on and on...

But, despite all of your hard work, your best efforts will, invariably, be in vain. It’s already too late for you. After all...

You’ll never be able to escape from me.

title: Cockroach Simulator: Household Survivor
description:
Cockroach Simulator: Household Survivor Allows you to simulate being a cockroach that even you can't imagine. In its view, you too are a terrible thing.

This is not the adventure to the wonderland.
Neither not the role playing as the superhero or protagonist on the viral television programs.
If you are looking something new, such as role playing as a creature even you are scary of, we are proudly introducing you a Cockroach Simulator!
The simulator game that letting you survive in the dirty house of huntsman as a cockroach.
Enjoy your cockroach life with a lovely fatty uncle in Cockroach Simulator household survivor today!!

title: Ultimate Double Dragon
description: This is a new fan-game dedicated to Double Dragons based on Super Double Dragon on SNES. New special effects and animations, super combinations and spectacular performances. New characters and new challenges that you will have to defeat, many new weapons, and maps. So many combat combinations that you will have to learn will keep you on the keyboard for a very long time.

title: Spider Queen Cave
description: The student sister who has been secretly in love for a long time has been missing for three months. Tonight, my sister suddenly called and asked me to go to an abandoned villa in the suburbs. I have no choice but to prepare for departure. It is said that the villa is a famous and dangerous house.

title: The Night Driver
description: The Night Driver is a point and click, RPG, adult game. Set in a dark and dirty world, full of drug dealers, prostitutes, criminals, and liars.

title: Greyhill Incident: Abducted Edition
description: Greyhill Incident is a story-driven Survival-Horror game that takes place during the early 90s. As Ryan Baker, equipped with a baseball bat and a few bullets in his trusty revolver, the story takes you across the atmospheric neighbourhood of Greyhill, which is invaded by UFOs & Grey Aliens.

title: Bus Simulator 21: Next Stop
description: It's your stop! Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop offers the most comprehensive bus fleet in the history of the series with 30 officially licensed buses. Drive on two vastly different maps, alone or with friend. Career Mode combines Sandbox Mode with the campaign's economic system. Play with extended management elements or just enjoy your time on the road.

title: Bus Simulator 21: Next Stop - Gold Edition
description: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Gold Edition offers new bus fans an all-in-one package. In addition to Bus Simulator 21, it includes all previously released premium DLCs, as well as the free Next Stop update and its numerous game improvements, brand-new game mode, and official map extension.

title: Sexy New Year
description: Sexy New Year - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Endless Railway
description: Use the machine gun to kill zombies to clear the railroad

title: Aniballs
description: Aniballs is a racing game where you control small animals in balls and race. Players roll through unique 2D circuits with a side camera and can throw objects such as spears, bombs, or time stops at each other!

title: Little Garden
description: Growth plants on your island and make a delicious meal with these plants. If you have enough gold, you can expand your island! Unlock dozens of cards at each farm level and improve your income. You can make things easier by automating your farm with amazing tools.

title: Crazy Clown
description: Crazy Clown - Top Down Shooter, a game in which you need to take your own and destroy all your abusers. You have not only a machine gun in your arsenal. Use all the variety of weapons and crush your enemies. Take revenge on them, clowns can not only make fun!

title: Best Pearl
description: Best Pearl is a shooter where one of the sea inhabitants repels attacks, protecting the pearl he found. Be careful the steering wheel landing can hurt you. Don't let them get it. They must not reach her. You can handle it.

title: Deeper in the Dark
description: You like Sci-Fi games? You like FPS? You like games with secret items, collectables? You like short Indie games? Then you will love this game! The game takes place in a big mothership captured by aliens. Your mission is to kill all the aliens, and blow up the mothership.

title: The Adventures of LinShanHai: Chapter 2 - Bus Bombing
description: The bus to the suburbs suddenly exploded, the scene was a mess, the sales staff, including all 10 people on board died. Lin Shanhai led the scene investigation team to conduct a detailed investigation and visited all the families and friends of the deceased, but the case is still no clue.

title: Within
description:
When Maya gets a disturbing phone call from her estranged younger brother Nikil ("Nik"), it sets in motion a series of horrific events that stirs the past and threatens to destroy all she holds dear.

Within is a short, first-person horror adventure featuring Crux Game Studios' (The Hospital, Decrypt) unique style of narrative gameplay.

title: Conur Life
description: Survive the streets of San Hugo facing all kinds of problems in this open world located in Argentina.

title: Fabulous Field Trip
description: Fabulous Field Trip is an island excursion game full of learning and fun suitable for children aged 9-12 and adults of all ages.

title: Bridge to Another World: Cursed Clouds
description: Gather your courage for this mystical journey to a distant world!

title: Tents and Trees
description:
Place a tent next to each tree in this original nature puzzle game!

The numbers around the grid tell you how many tents must be placed in each row and column. Be careful, tents can’t touch each other.

Don't guess! Use your logic and carefully plan your every move. Each level has only one unique solution. Come up with your own strategies for solving larger grids and more-challenging levels.

title: Destiny 2: Lightfall - Season of Defiance
description: In the aftermath of the attack on the Traveler, the Vanguard calls upon its closest allies. Guardians must master the righteous powers of the Awoken to stand against the encroaching Shadow Legion and prove themselves as Queensguard.

title: Oppai Odyssey
description: Oppai Odyssey is an adult visual novel and dating sim, focusing on the crew of USF starship Agni as they traverse the galaxy in search of a new planet for humanity to colonize. Enjoy a fully explorable starship, filled with events to enjoy with your crewmates.

title: Solfege
description: Kagura is a high school student who returns to her old school after three years abroad. There, she wants to meet again her sempai Sukune, who she admired since she was little. But she has also more friends: the active Chiho and the serene Kotomi. But it seems Sukune has forgotten her! What's happening...?

title: Seven Days: Anata to Sugosu Nanokakan
description:
One day close to the beginning of summer vacation, Shuuichi was watching a ‘cursed Blu-ray’ given to him by his buddy when a spirit came out from the disc and possessed him. His childhood friend Murasaki belonged to a family that managed an ancient temple, so she tried an exorcism to rid him of the spirit. While the ritual was successful and quelled the vindictive spirit, the spirit girl’s form remained due to her inexperience. Her name was Chiyako, the name of the girl who was killed on screen, and she revealed that the spirits of six other girls dwelled within her.

According to Murasaki, spirits can only remain in this world for 49 days, which meant that there would only be seven days allotted for each of the seven girls. Shuuichi was tasked with helping them achieve happiness so they can leave this world with no regrets. However, it is a very short time to accomplish this task. Also he did not realize at this time that it meant that he would be getting to know each girl well only to bid a painful farewell seven times over.

title: Mold 2: Origin
description:
"Mold 2: Origin

" takes place before the first game in the series... explaining the origin of the mold curse. Stan lives in an isolated location with his wife Mary. He has metal detection as a hobby. After finding a strange amulet things start to get really weird.

Is it possible to break this curse? what is the origin of all this?...

title: Night of Carnage
description:
Adam is a 13-year-old teenager who lives with his mother in a quiet neighborhood... When they get the news that there's a murderer on the loose...

Adam begins to suspect that his neighbor may be the dreaded killer.

title: SMS
description: Stuck on a dark train.

title: Endless Days
description: Dylan takes a job on an isolated island looking after the lighthouse for six months. The last lighthouse keeper has mysteriously disappeared and as the days go by, Dylan discovers that he may not be alone on the island.

title: Gears
description: Adam and his friends gather for a beer in a bar... After being kidnapped by an assassin... he will have to play a dangerous and deadly game to save his life and that of his friends.

title: Race of Life
description: Race of Life is a college/street racing Adult Visual Novel. Take a peek into the underground racing scene, where suck, squeeze, bang, blow is about more than just your engine cycle. Race and upgrade your car to take control over your future. The more rubber you burn, the more money you earn.

title: Well...
description:
Welcome to "Well...", a very difficult first-person precision platformer with engaging lore and storyline! In this game, you'll find yourself in a mysterious magic well with a few strange rats. To climb your way out of this unfamiliar terrain, you must strafe platform to platform while relying on your intuition for navigation. Along the way, you'll discover and collect hidden journals; these will enlighten you on the well's history. Four levels must be beat in order to save this perplexing world. The levels progress in difficulty, making your journey continually more rewarding and rage-inducing.

With its intuitive controls and fun gameplay, "Well..." is the perfect game for anyone who loves a good platformer with a twist. So why not join us on this adventure and see what lies waiting at the bottom of the well?

title: Tank Online: War Shooting Simulator
description: Enjoy the thrilling action of tank warfare in Tank Online! Experience unique tank game with stunning visuals and realistic physics. Join the fight now!

title: The Azmodeus Project
description: A survival game in an open world of zombies.

title: Up to Clouds
description: Protect your village, don't let the monsters climb down the sky-high bean. Buy traps and upgrade them to the highest level. Wear the strongest armour and always use the right weapon to defeat the enemy.

title: Jigsaw Puzzles: Fantasy Landscapes
description: Enjoy 30 puzzles of increasing difficulty featuring original artwork of stunning fantasy landscapes!

title: Not Anyone's Business but My Own
description: Navigate a local princess through the pages of a hand-crafted fairy tale and help her solve the mystery of a golden ring in this narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game with multiple endings.

title: Sushi Drop
description:
Merge the same sushi blocks to make great sushi!
Can you merge the sushi ordered by the customer and clear the stage?
How expensive & luxury sushi can you make? Try it right now!
Sushi Drop : Merge Puzzle is a simple, classic puzzle game that can be enjoyed by everyone in the family!

title: Astra and The New Constellation
description:
Astra is the smallest star in Constellation Station. Tired of being picked on, she sets off an adventure to build a new constellation of her own!

Run, jump, slide, and float across the galaxy while collecting stardust to build your new home in this retro-inspired Pico-8 platformer.

title: Climber
description: This is a little adventure in the depths of a mysterious cave. Try on the role of a rescuer and try to save the lives of a team of missing cavers as quickly as possible. You will need concentration, discipline and strong hands, because the owners of these depths do not like uninvited guests.

title: Leta Adventure
description: Through Spring, Autumn, Winter and Summer! Leta Adventure is a relaxing role-playing game where you must travel a journey in order to deliver a letter. Featuring many different locations, minigames and characters to meet... your Adventure awaits!

title: Lattice Dancer
description: Experience the thrill of dodging lasers in this easy-to-learn, casual game. Your goal is simple. Dodge the lattice laser. Sharpen your spatial awareness and concentration skills with each round. Are you ready to dance with danger?

title: YinYang Street
description: Set in a small town on the border in the 1980s, "Street" is led by Li Minglai, an active soldier engaged in a homeland defense war. A trip back home in the usual but, Once warm and happy home is now only a mystery, everything points to a mysterious and weird legend - "Yin and Yang street".

title: Crossroad of Worlds: Mirrors to Other Worlds - Collector's Edition
description: Detective, adventure awaits! Once again amazing worlds full of puzzles and riddles await you. Test your deduction, solve cases and help people all over the multiverse!

title: Untold Love Stories
description: Untold Love Stories is a collection of visual novels in different genres and styles. Romance, meetings, dangers, adventures and even mystery are waiting for you!

title: I Was the Cat
description:
You ever have a bad day?
Well... Today you have.

Work sucks. Your partner sucks.
And you think... maybe... life isn't worth it.

Until an angel bumps into you.

And, just like that, you have a whole new purpose in life.

Follow our unlikely heroine, as she navigates her newfound zeal for life and pursues the woman of her dreams.

title: Dude Quest
description: Dude Quest is a satirical monster catcher RPG heavily inspired by Pokémon, released back in 2014 as a flash game. Features 59 Dudes to collect and use on your journey.

title: Crymachina
description: Crymachina is an action RPG where mechanical girls strive to survive in a post-apocalyptic world to become “Real Humans''. But what does it mean to be a “Real Human”?

title: Strippers
description: Strippers - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Castlevania: Seal of the Eclipse
description: A Castlevania fan-game.

title: Mega Man X: Maverick Wars
description: Mega Man X: Maverick Wars is a Mega Man X fangame developed by Pixel Box

title: Ms.Lemons
description:
"Welcome to my game, player!"

Ms.Lemons is so glad to see you! She has been waiting for a worthy student for a very long time! Feel like at home and get ready for endless f̶u̶n̶ !

title: Five Nights At Dungeon
description: This game is similar to Dungeon Nightmares but with the weapon. You must find five artifacts and survive for five nights. Only this time you have two weapons. One is melee and other is ranged. Can You Survive Five Night's At Dungeon ? Search for clues, and fight your fears. Fight for your life!

title: PlayM2M
description:
In PlayM2M, an open-world fantasy online role-playing game, players can choose from four character classes: Dorhan, Skogr, Petrun, and Wizard. Each class has two specializations that offer distinct combat styles for Player vs. Environment (PvE) and Player vs. Player (PvP) modes.

PlayM2M focuses on real-time combat, crafting, exploration, and PvE and PvP content. Currently available in 11 languages, PlayM2M continues to grow with new content and plans for future international expansion.

title: Pet
description:
Pet is a horror visual novel about being in a city after a fun day out and how sometimes you gotta get home to take care of your cat.

It's a late night on an unseasonably warm day. On your way home to feed your cat Kuma, you stumble upon a vending machine in a dark alley.

title: Sifu: Arenas
description: You can test your skills against the clock and waves of bad guys

title: Guitar Praise: Stryper
description: An expansion pack for Guitar Praise featuring 25 tracks from the band Stryper, commemorating the band's 25th anniversary.

title: Project Horror Tales
description: When Travel plans go awry, the only way out is to face the darkness and find a way to survive to make it home alive. With something Lurking in the Dark. You are not alone. You will Have to Face the Darkness to Survive. The question is - Can you Survive?

title: Mangchi the Hammer Boy
description:
Kkoma Daejang Mangchi is a 3D platforming game for children based on a comic book series by Huh Youngman. The game allows movement in three dimensions, but most of the platforming sequences in the five stages are structured like in a 2D game. A few sequences focus on walking into or out of the depth of the screen in a mostly straight progression, usually running away from enemy vehicles. Enemies have a yellow ring around them on the floor, and the hero can only whack them with his mallet as long as he is standing outside of the ring.

The official homepage saw the game scheduled for July 2002, but somehow the game didn't come out before Candy Global Media published it in 2004, when retail PC games in Korea were all but dead and gone, and even DDS itself would have been near their end, if they still existed at all. Needless to say, the Xbox version that was also planned remained a pipe dream like all other Digital Dream Studios games for the console.

title: Dredge: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: The ultimate pack for your impending voyage. The Dredge Deluxe Edition includes everything you’ll need to weather the seas and trawl the deep for sinister secrets.

title: Chippy & Noppo
description:
"Chippy and Noppo" is an action puzzle that assembles parts into a toy!
Collect the parts in the factory, process the colors and shapes, and make the same toy as the blueprint.
Even if it's a little different, you might be able to clear it...!?
Because the factory manager is a bit careless.

title: Forsake The Rake
description: You and Your friend are on a quest to find the truth about The Rake. Investigation took you to the forest where is a secret underground lab. Search the abandoned underground lab and find the truth about the Rake!

title: The Ape Painting
description:
Tomorrow is the day that you publish your debut novel. But tonight is the night in which your date’s hideous painting has fallen off the wall and killed him, leaving you trapped in an apartment of nightmares - both his and your own.

The Ape Painting blends point-and-click elements into a visual novel structure, and sets you loose in an apartment where everything hates you. So get off your date's corpse, put on some clothes, and get to work. But remember: achieving your dreams might cost more than you think.

title: Blacksmith Master
description: Manage your own medieval smithy in Blacksmith Master and supervise the entire process from mining ores and gems to designing and selling finished products. Forge everything from weapons and armor to tools and cooking utensils to fund your craft and become the Blacksmith Master.

title: City Avenger
description: City avenger is an VR 3rd person shooter game.In this game, you need to turn your VR headset and using your gamepad to control the hero to beat these mafia and other bad guys. In city avenger you can using rifle, machine gun, rocket launcher and other very cool weapons, driving car, turret, tank , helicoper, etc.You can enter bullettime to killing tons of badguys in a second, and you can roll over a tank in a single jump. You can blow up bad guys, car, house even skycraper, in another words, you can blow up everything in the game.

title: Oxide Room 208
description: Eight people trapped in an old laboratory will try to survive their last moments of life in this frenetic body-horror full of action, blood and guts. Oxide Room 208 challenges you to face your fears in a dark and twisted environment where flesh and madness merge.

title: FIFA Soccer 08
description: Old-gen port of FIFA Soccer 08.

title: Minecraft: Trails & Tales
description: Minecraft: Trails & Tales is an update for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition with its theme being "creativity and self-expression through representation and storytelling", focusing mostly on decorative blocks, customization options, and resources for player-driven in-game storytelling and roleplay. It also adds new passive mobs, an archaeology system, and the cherry grove biome.

title: Fremdganger: The Cheating Demon
description: Burnt out on the dullness of your play sessions, you voyage into the mountains to seek out a legendary Game Master. However, you quickly regret your decision after his game becomes a tad too real and involves you in an unexpected way...

title: AFL 23
description: AFL 23 is the most authentic video game football experience to date. Featuring the fully licensed 2023 AFL Premiership and AFL Women’s competitions and over 30 detailed stadiums, it’s time to play footy for real.

title: Florifer
description: Open world explorative game focused on growing the last magical seeds that can turn into flowers and bring an abandoned, silent world back to life.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Killer Night
description:
Killer Night is a fan reimagination of Five Nights at Freddy's 3, created to celebrate the game's 8th anniversary.

This is no traditional sit-&-survive game, however! Killer Night is a short point-&-click adventure game with different types of minigames and references to previous FNAF games, developed in 2 months!

title: Channel 7
description: Channel 7 is a single player game with psx era graphics. You are a camera man working for channel 7 news and you are on a journey to a mysterious town called Willowbrook.

title: Sokfest
description: Point-and-click your way through an online festival terrain, celebrating the 100th Sokpop game! Befriend the characters from all 100 Sokpop games, and explore a bustling festival with colourful characters!

title: Westgrove
description: Westgrove is a game that focuses as much as possible on emulating the ps1 era gaming experience with horror elements and follows a found footage story style with inspiration from some 90's movies.

title: Nutty Noon
description: Nutty Noon is a Celeste mod which draws heavy inspiration from Kirby's Return to Dream Land, specifically level 5: Nutty Noon. It takes on the themes from this area, as well as the difficulty of the Kirby game (beginner). It focuses more on exploration and multiple routes, but also features a full B and C-side which are more linear and low intermediate difficulty.

title: FIFA Soccer 09
description: PlayStation 2 and PC port of FIFA Soccer 09.

title: FIFA Soccer 10
description: PlayStation 2 and Windows port FIFA Soccer 10.

title: Due Date
description: Your Art assignment is due in 20 seconds... Will you see what's beyond?

title: Slapdash
description:
Slapdash is a first-person parkour game about delivering packages and free-running across rooftops in a minimalist city.

This project was made in Unity. Assets were created using Maya, Substance Designer & Painter. Other assets were used in Unity's asset store, including foliage and background buildings.

Slapdash is a simple and relaxing parkour game, which further developed into a short game to showcase at PAX 2022 for the Interactive Media class at Lake Washington Institute of Technology.

title: Roche Limit: The Death of CMK
description:
Roche Limit: The Death of CMK is a horror-surrealist style PowerPoint game made over the course of eight months. It features over 1,500 slides and 80+ unique hand drawn scenes.
The game is a follow-up to the developer's 2019 project The EdCo Incident.

2 additional endings where planned for and worked on as a possible update for the game but have been dropped in favor of a new game that continues the themes with a new story.
An OST for the cut ending scenes was released with interludes and titles, ending 2's title was The Golden Age and ending 3's title was Depi Lontan.

title: The EdCo Incident
description: A point-and-click style horror game made in Microsoft PowerPoint over the course of nearly 3 years.

title: C21: Steel Battle Chronicles
description: C21 Steel Battle Chronicles is an Action MMORPG in which you can customize your very own robot to determine how it fights in battle. Become a member of the Neo Angel Force and defeat the nefarious Demon Force to restore peace to the Cosmic Renaissance!

title: Iniquity Survivors
description: Iniquity Survivors is a Coop Arena Roguelite, where you heed into battle yourself or with up to 4 friends or strangers. Acquire new powers, create broken builds and use your spells wisely to survive and defeat hordes of enemies and the final boss at the end of each map!

title: Migrant Bird
description: Do you know about migratory birds? There are migratory birds: summer birds and winter birds. Summer migratory birds are birds that 'come north in spring and go south in autumn' and live in very warm conditions all year round, while winter migratory birds ...... are birds that fly north in spring to live far away and cold, only to return in winter. Although they may each spend half of their lives in the same place - they never get the chance to be together.

title: Garten of Banban 3
description: Embrace the horrors of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve even deeper into the depths of the establishment that was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents and continue the search for your child…

title: Severed Lands
description: Severed Lands is a community-driven Open-World Sandbox MMORPG featuring in-depth crafting, base building, a player-driven economy, full-loot, and sieges. It is set in a world divided by two societies with their own sets of ideals, views, and ways of life.

title: FIFA 15
description: FIFA 15 is a football simulation game developed by EA Canada and published by Electronic Arts. FIFA 15 is the first of the series to be developed for next generation (Xbox One and PS4) consoles and also features the new Ignite game engine.

title: Gunster: Rain of Bullets
description:
Gunster: Rain of Bullets was a 2D multiplayer action video game, created by Korean-based company NHN who in turn hosted the game using the North American portal named ijji. One other version of Gunster exists, named Gunstriker: Reloaded Bullets and is hosted at Hangame Japan.

Gunster: Rain of Bullets is a port from a Korean game of the same name and was hosted directly by Hangame, which both localizations were shut down. Minor differences exist between the two localizations, but the biggest difference is that they are managed independently of one another.

title: Champions Ascension
description: Ready your Champions for battle! Collect, train, equip and manage your own stable of brave and brutal gladiators. Define your own story, and influence the world of Massina. Who will you become? A battle master, an ingenious alchemist, a rich Imperial business magnate? Enter a player-driven fantasy world of arena-based combat where death is real— but so are the rewards.

title: Pax Dei
description: Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by the legends of the medieval era. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. Join thousands of players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. What world will you make?

title: My Computer Wants to Eat Me?
description: Explore your dreams and collect game disks for your hungry computer.

title: Panzer Campaigns: Philippines ’44
description:
In Philippines ’44, as MacArthur you will command units from both the US Sixth and Eighth Armies as well as US Army Air Force and Naval air groups. The Japanese forces, led by General Yamashita, had at his disposal, three major commands, the Shobu, Shimbu and Kembu Groups. Yamashita’s command outnumbered the Allied forces but had to defend a vast territory with limited knowledge of where the Allied forces may land. All that is lacking is for you to kick off one of the largest land campaigns of the Pacific War.

Philippines ’44 is a fascinating title, focused on a rarely covered campaign. There is both a range of operations as well as diverse forces for both sides. Actions ranged from amphibious landings, airdrops (for both sides!) to a range of land actions. The environment and terrain are much more of a hinderance to action than is the case in Europe and the juncture of weather, jungle and other challenges impacts the speed of movement and play.

Philippines '44 includes 76 Scenarios – covering all sizes and situations, including a solo tutorial scenario plus specialized versions for both head to head play and vs. the computer AI.

Philippines '44 provides multiple play options including play against the computer AI, Play by E-mail (PBEM), LAN & Internet "live" play as well as two player hot seat.

title: Adachi Dating Simulator
description: This is just a meme dating game.

title: Line 88
description: Line 88 is a short kinetic novel with walking elements. It takes about 20 minutes to complete and has elements of horror.

title: The Die Is Cast
description: The Die is Cast. Now, all you need to do is trust your companions and penetrate the enemy's weaknesses.

title: Katakoi Contrast: Way of Parting Vol.2
description: Part of "triAngle PROJECT," a collaboration project between Otomate and Frontier Works.

title: Battle Tanks: Arena
description: Capture cities and destroy enemy tanks in breathtaking firefights. Protect your comrades from attacking enemies. To defeat a dangerous enemy, come up with a plan of action in advance to destroy as many enemies as possible with less loss...

title: Katakoi Contrast: Way of Parting Vol.3
description: Part of "triAngle PROJECT," a collaboration project between Otomate and Frontier Works.

title: The Lacerator
description: A mix of classic survival horror and trash movies, play as an 80's porn actor and beware of every corner because you can get Lacerator and lose a limb in real time... But you can still adapt and survive.

title: Slobbish Dragon Princess 3
description: Peace has more or less returned as humankind and dragonkind learn to coexist with each other. With the town summer festival approaching soon, Takeru would prefer that things stay the way they are. As expected, a new threat approaches in the form of Mei, the dragon princess of the Nether!

title: My Girlfriend's Special Place
description: One day, our hero is headed home from Akihabara when he's mistaken for a molester. The person accusing him is his childhood friend, Fuyuka Akiyoshi. "If you want me to forgive you, then become my butler!" Recently reunited, these two end up in an unusual relationship as their story begins...

title: Fap Nights At Frenni's Night Club
description: Fap Nights At Frenni's NightClub is a 3D freeroam FNAF parody NSFW game focused on a traditional harem story mode, similar to a graphic adventure or visual novel, as well as unlocking erotic scenes and collectibles, also the game have an arcade mode.

title: Five Nights at FuzzBoob's: Definitive Edition
description:
Congratulations! You're Hired as a Night Guard!
We are delighted to inform you that you have been selected for the position of Summer Night Guard (00:00 - 06:00) has been successful!

Your responsibilities will include maintaining the security of our premises from 00:00 to 06:00, ensuring the safety of our property during the night shift.

At Freddy FuzzBoob's Pizza Party Pussy Palace, we strive to ensure adults can have some delicious pizza, drinks, and pleasure.

Our main attraction is Freddy FuzzBoob and her two partners: Bonnie FuzzBoob and Chica FuzzBoob. They are animatronic fursluts, programmed to drain balls and ruin your innocence along the way.

If you have any questions or require further information, please feel free to reach out. Once again, congratulations on your successful application, and welcome to the FuzzBoob's family. We look forward to having you on board!

title: Galactic Empire
description: Galactic Empire is a 2D turn-based strategy game where you, as the Commander, decide the fate of the entire universe. Expand your planet, explore solar systems, play cards in cantinas, modify your ships and conquer more planets.

title: Pineapple on Pizza
description: Pineapple on Pizza is a short game about exploring an island full of dancing people, finding a way to ruin the party, and unexpectedly enjoying it.

title: Alien Frontier
description: Alien Frontier is an open world, third-person shooter roguelite. Explore, search, and mine resources in the deadly alien wilderness... assuming you can survive combat with hordes of bloodthirsty aliens. Collect loot and upgrades to become the most dangerous (and wealthy) prospector in the galaxy!

title: Haunted Lands: Burial Grounds
description: Dark and bloody retro inspired action platformer. Slay the grim cultists, the infernal minions and twisted nightmarish creatures that roam the Haunted Lands.

title: Call of Duty: Warchest
description: A bundle that contains Call of Duty, its expansion Call of Duty: United Offensive, and Call of Duty 2.

title: Call of Duty: Ghosts - Digital Hardened Edition
description:
Buy the Call of Duty: Ghosts Digital Hardened Edition and enhance your multiplayer experience with a digital download of Call of Duty: Ghosts and an assortment of bonus digital content, including:

• Call of Duty: Ghosts Season Pass: Get four epic DLC Map Packs*, each delivering a collection of fresh Call of Duty: Ghosts multiplayer content. title: Liquisity
description:
Liquisity is a problem-solving action game where players must get a ball past obstacles into a goal. Each level is set underwater. The player is given a cannon which can be used to fire a ball with varying force. Once a ball is launched, the player can control it to a limited degree with the left and right arrow keys. The player can launch another if a ball is destroyed or offscreen.

The levels contain obstacles and elements such as fans which block the way, sharp fans which destroy the ball, bubble jets which propel the ball in a specific direction, and others. Solving the level often involves carefully hitting switches to deactivate inconvenient obstacles. There are several different types of balls, in addition to the basic one: the metal ball is heavy and hard to control, but it can shatter glass barriers; the seltzer ball slowly dissolves in water and thus has a limited lifetime, but it can fit in tight spaces and avoid obstacles when shrunk, and it can be made to float upwards at any time. There is also a helicopter ball, which can move freely in any direction but cannot exit the level.

The game includes a built-in level editor and some unlockable bonus content.

title: Ore no Ryomi 2
description:
Ore no Ryomi 2: The Restaurant is a restaurant management game. Similarly to its predecessor, it's an action-strategy game where the player must manage his funds and personally prepare all the dishes for the customers.

Before the start of each day, the player can spend money to purchase expansions for his restaurant, including new food menu items and proper equipment. Once the day starts, the player must manage his time carefully to cater to all the customers and the restaurant's needs from morning till closing hours.

Throughout the day, new customers keep coming in and ordering food, and events (such as the need to wash dishes or a fire in the kitchen) require the manager's attention. Each customer and event is represented by a gradually vanishing bar. Preparing food and caring for problems is usually done through a simple, action minigame. The player can only take on one of these at a time, but it is possible to serve prepared meals to customers in the middle of something else.

Each customer expects his food to be prepared strictly according to order. If the player messes something up by adding the wrong ingredients or by under- or overcooking the food, the customer will pay less. And if a customer waits too long without their order being attended to, they get furious and leave, causing a minor monetary penalty. Things get even more hectic during the "Rush Hour" that comes twice daily, during which large crowds of customers keep coming in.

Ore no Ryomi 2 also contains several "Challenges": the player, invited to the Iron Chef TV show, tries to complete a specific difficult task, such as preparing many perfect dishes in a limited time. Throughout the game, the player receives trophies and awards, which he can proudly view in his Trophy Room if he has purchased them.

description: Together with your friends, defeat the swarming monsters! Collect gems, and unlock more runes through accumulated honor to enhance the fighting power of heroes! The level boss will appear in 15 minutes, hurry up to let the hero grow up and defeat it!

title: CrashOut Xtreme
description: Crashout Xtreme is a casual arcade game with a unique combination of Pong and Brickout gameplay. Break the blocks using the bat and ball with a new and fresh design. Various gameplay experiences await with power-ups, and so the challenging enemies.

title: Battle of Hořice 1423
description: Relax alone or with friends while experiencing the 15th-century battle and all that came with it - explained simply and casually in a popular way.

title: Goblin Keep
description: Voxel World Survival and Town Building game with building tools, combat, and destruction

title: Bent Oak Island
description: Bent Oak Island is a 1990's point and click adventure set on a mysterious island! Join twins Archer and Sam as they delve into the mysteries of both the island and their own heritage, and maybe save the world!

title: BRoS: Battle Royale of Survival
description: Fight against other survivors and watch the time to escape from the island. Jump into the battle royale experience and try to survive. To increase your chance of survival, arm yourself and show no mercy. Chaos reigns on the island and only one survives or no one. Be a survivor!

title: Pip: Battle for the Arctic
description: A cute, fun platformer for all ages. Travel though the arctic, caves and ocean. Eat fish along the way, and make your way to the factory. Play as Pip, or Owl, and take back the arctic from the evil oil drilling company's CEO!!

title: Survive Now
description: In this thrilling top-down roguelite survival game, you'll face off against hordes of creatures in a desperate battle for survival. You'll need to collect energy to unlock new skills and upgrade existing ones, and every moment counts as you fight your way through waves of monsters.

title: Adrenaline Dungeon
description: Adrenaline Dungeon is a top-down dungeon crawler game, play as an unknown man stuck in a time-looped dungeon. Uncover clues to discover a new order trying to rewrite history. Use different weapons and abilities to escape the dungeon and prevent history from being rewritten.

title: Cantirium: God Slayer
description: A colorful metroidvania made in pixel art, where we have to help a cat girl save the whole world from inevitable death, and at the same time challenge the gods themselves!

title: Tap Sword
description: Be the best blacksmith!

title: Kakuriyo Village: Moratorium of Adolescence
description: Ao & Hinori were both childhood sweethearts and accidentally went to a strange world called Kakuriyo Village. Because of her boyish appearance, the villagers mistakenly thought Hinori was a boy... Can they successfully hide Hinori's genders and escape from the village!?

title: The Witch's Cauldron
description: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.

title: Alice in Dreamland
description: "Alice Minase" was just a regular office worker. One evening when she came home from work... A book about a "Wonderland" falls off from the shelf. Then, she stumbled into the "Wonderland".

title: Dunjunguy
description: Dunjunguy is a randomly generated action RPG dungeon-crawler with Rogue-like elements. Following brave adventurers on their journey into the DUNJUN players will find bizarre unique items, epic loot, and pets that buff the player's abilities and enable them to fight off the endless hordes of creatures.

title: Hot Pussy College 2
description: Hot Pussy College 2 is a short adult Visual Novel focusing on the fun parts of college life. The game is packed with humor, romance, and lots of sex. Play as a young male attending college at B&R and guide him through the experience.

title: Ballistic: The story of Marble and the Energy Core
description: Ballistic is a top-down roguelike casual game divided by level, with a completely new take on the gameplay invented by Breakout in 1976, and enhance later by other games like Arkanoid.

title: Milkshake
description: MILKSHAKE is the greatest piece of interactive software to ever be created by womankind. It is a looking around simulator inspired by the SOUP-like movement, containing ~31 rooms.

title: Celestiais & Dragões
description: The new 2D Hack and slash based on fantasy medieval times using mechanics inspired by old Beat 'em ups phases games from the Arcade era. It has a lot of adventure, action, magic, mystery, sensational environments and diverse creatures. Try to beat the game and decipher this story.

title: Go There
description: A short action game that the girl go "There" with a dragon.

title: Running Riot
description: Pick a class and blast your way through rooms of cyber enemies in this roguelite twin-stick shooter! Choose your abilities and your path wisely, because you've only got one life to make it through the gauntlet. Rack up those points and spend them on even more ways to RIOT!

title: Glory to the Heroes
description: No glory without sacrifice.

title: Cryspace
description: Cryspace is a fresh social media simulator/visual novel with a heavy focus on relationships, dating, and multiple branching paths. Create your profile, connect with friends, and find your way to success, or stumble into despair.

title: Pop Some Eyes
description: Pop Some Eyes is a FPS game where you control Mr. Pineapple Bundy, in a space jail where he must fight aliens to survive. The game features fast-paced action, unique sci-fi/comedy storyline, and 3 different weapons. Help Mr. Pineapple navigate the dangers of the space jail and defeat alien forces.

title: AgrChamp
description: Are you ready for the hardest exam of your life? If yes, let me welcome you to the game AgrChamp. It is a game based on elements of the famous game Jump King and it’s motivated into environment of the famous czech streamer Agraelus.

title: Let's Play Jigsaw Puzzles: France
description: Discover the sights of France while playing fun jigsaw puzzles!

title: Astro Pig
description: A 90-s inspired lo-fi adventure puzzle platformer about a piglet astronaut and his intelligent ship.

title: Pino the Elemental
description: Adventure game in hack slash style, with different spells and pets, enemies with different difficulties, high difficulty level against bosses.

title: Ringlorn Saga Gaiden
description: Ringlorn Saga Gaiden is an adventure RPG inspired by the Japanese PC classics. After dying in a decisive battle, your spirit is separated from your body, and you must exact your revenge on the Dark Lord by possessing his minions.

title: Reclusive
description: Robert Livingston sails to a remote northern island to spend the last days of his life on it and encounters unexplained phenomena and creatures.

title: Changer Seven
description: Fast-Paced Lane-Based Action Brawler. The legendary Changers 7 heroes must fight a new threat that changes the citizens of Sunny Point into terrifying beings! But as they investigate and defeat "villain of the week" like enemies, they suspect that someone from their own group may be behind it all.

title: Secrets of the Witch House
description: Secrets of the Witch House is a challenging, procedurally generated, permadeath, action roguelike. Encounter fierce monsters, dark secrets, devastating weapons and pachinko as you wage war against an ancient evil.

title: The Druid
description: We embody the spirit of The Dagda, king of the Celtic gods, with the objective of liberating his territory from the corruption of the goddess Morrigan in a 2D roguelike platformer full of intensity.

title: Fish Simulator: Agonik Lake
description: In this simulation game, play the role of a proud northern pike (Esox lucius) living in a North American lake. Your goal: Surviving and becoming the King of Agonik Lake! To achieve this feat, feed yourself; get stronger, taller, faster; and avoid various hazards along the way.

title: Which Way Up: Galaxy Games
description:
Which Way Up: Galaxy Games is a family friendly party game that gives unique freedom of movement by allowing you to run on walls and ceilings, orbit around planets, or fall across entire levels by manoeuvring through gravity fields.

Before The Universe existed, the Space Sprites banded together one-by-one to see a dream come to fruition: the dream of life itself. As The Universe began to take shape, so too did space. But space is unpredictable, and creating life is tiresome work. So, the Sprites took it upon themselves to create a pastime. The Galaxy Games.

Each event features its own unique bite-sized challenge where up to 4 players can compete. Eject your friends into space as you race across gravity fields, score a goal with an entire moon, leap across planets to escape a black hole, and capture and hold zodiacal constellations.

title: Uootoy 3671
description: The legendary comic action puzzle "Uootoy" from 1984 is now available in its ultimate version with all the elements enhanced! The combination of various simple tricks is easy for anyone to understand, and the various stages that stimulate your creativity will keep you hooked!

title: Grey Area
description: A tough platformer following an 8-year-old diving over, under, and around the terrifying creatures living in a strange, mysterious world that's so much bigger than her: the "world between all worlds".

title: Let's Play Jigsaw Puzzles: Flowers
description: Escape to stunning floral landscapes

title: Royal Romances: Forbidden Magic - Collector's Edition
description: Is it possible to overcome obstacles through hope or faith in love? Lead your valiant heroes through the thorny path to their most cherished desires and find out!

title: Dysmantle: Doomsday
description: Board a mysterious flying cargo drone and enter a hidden archipelago holding a deadly secret. Discover scientific experiments gone awry and utilize new technologies to stave off doomsday.

title: Nusantara
description: The hackable indie turn-based strategy game. The game is feature-rich, with single (PvE) and multiplayer (PvP) content. Different maps, factions, heroes, upgrade trees and randomized map interaction allow for lots of exploration, while rulesets allow for endless replayability. Minigame included!

title: Let's Play Jigsaw Puzzles: Birds
description: Get ready to spread your wings and soar through a world of stunning avian beauty.

title: Plateman
description: Explore the steampunk world in Plateman. Fly over the world of machines full of gimmicks and monsters. Uncover the secrets of Shaman and the difference engine. Try to change this decaying world by Shaman Drum and the special lightning power.

title: Forbidden City Journey
description: This is a VR tour game based on the real picture, which can not only allows players to immerse themselves in the majesty of the Forbidden City, but also to understand the culture and history of the Forbidden City through a mini-game.

title: Hold-Up
description: Prepare the perfect heist. Do record the plan progress, rewind, replan, proceed quietly, lockpick, hide in the dark, take the loot and then run away!

title: Rabbi-T
description: Save Wilson Toys Inc. from the villainous robot ACTO and be a hero. Rabbi-T is a 2D running action game that pursues destruction and speed. Destroy obstacles to run faster. Reach the boss's weakness as fast as possible.

title: Medchess
description: Build and manage your own medieval village while maintaining the balance between gold, army, technology, and faith. Will you survive the bandits and pollution in Medchess?

title: Girls Tennis League
description: The Steam version of the popular 3D independent tennis game "Girls Tennis League" is now online! Real tennis action, supports up to 4 players local doubles and online match, fully supports controller operation, permanent update, and many functions waiting for you to experience.

title: Lamia's Bambina
description: Lamia's Bambina is a unique game centered around the trials of the Lamia tribe. Reclaim stolen territory from the rival Harpy tribe by training, forming formidable parties, and facing off in battle. The fate of the Lamias lies with you. Unite, Lamia's Bambina!

title: Weggye's Adventures
description: Weggye's Adventures is a 2D platformer game. Which focuses on skill. The player explores a magical world full of challenges with Weggye.

title: Red Crucible: Phoenix Rising
description: No prisoners! No mercy! Smash and destroy your way to victory!

title: Silent Nights
description: Silent Nights - A short horror game with realistic graphics, touching storyline and scary moments.

title: Merchant In Dungeon
description: This game is about managing shops.Hercules enters Dark Gate Town solo, aiming to repay his father's debt with his friends' help.

title: Tranquil Isle
description: Tranquil Isle is a rogue-lite city-builder in which the player must build up their town by progressing through a research tree while balancing 4 resources, Population, Science, Industry, and Happiness.

title: Hullbreakers
description: Hullbreakers is a space arcade game with fast paced combat, quick maneuvering, and strategy. Use an ever-evolving spacecraft to wipe out endless hordes of enemies and relentless bosses in order to make your mark on the leaderboard.

title: Extreme Tag!
description: Extreme Tag! is a casual party game for all! Run from tagged players to stay alive. Last one standing wins!

title: The Little Witch Shop: New in Town
description: In this shop management game, acquire new familiars to help cultivate your greenhouse, hunt fantastical creatures, and craft potions or runes to fulfill customer orders. Earn gold to upgrade your magic shop and impress the Witches’ Council.

title: Smells Like a Mushroom
description: The Milky Way has become infested with creatures called Magic Mushrooms. To prevent a catastrophe, the brave Carrotado goes into space! Third-person sci-fi shooter with a bizarre story for a single-player and co-op.

title: Beacon's Bluff
description: Solve unearthly puzzles and become engrossed in this discerning horror mystery story. The Lighthouse is the first in the Story Machine Horror series.

title: Dying Breed
description: Dying Breed is a classic base building RTS game, set in a past alternative timeline, featuring 2 unique faction with a common enemy.

title: Lost Dream: Darkness
description: Once the Darkness rises above all, It's your time to take the reins and hit the ground running on a mission to discover the light once again.

title: The Hellchemist
description: The Hellchemist is an intense pve arena shooter where you will fight waves of monsters while random events will alter the way you have to play the game and makes every run unique. The game is heavily inspired by Doom and Quake. Bunny hops, shooting and a whole lot of explosions!

title: Spell Disk
description: Build unique synergy spell combos to destroy the hordes of monsters and bosses in this rogue-lite action game.

title: Aqua Marbles: Ocean
description: Deep in the abyss of the ocean lies an underwater kingdom. Dive into a submarine atmosphere complete with colorful graphics and exciting music, but keep an eye out! In the deepest darkest corners lie sunken ships and castles full of danger. Check out match-3 from a fresh perspective!

title: Ettrian: The Elf Prince
description: Unravel the truth behind betrayal and reclaim your rightful place in Ettrian - The Elf Prince, an epic adventure of survival and redemption!

title: Access Denied: Escape
description: Access Denied: Escape is a puzzle game where you have to hack data vaults and interact with various devices to escape.

title: ArrowMongers
description: ArrowMongers is a top-down, pixel art, 2D shooter roguelite!... Or actually more than that!? Fight through the procedural dungeon, clear the floors of the colosseum, solve the puzzles in the puzzles dungeon, and become a legendary archer in the ArrowMongers village!

title: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life - Day 1
description: A strange incident turns the life of an ordinary young man upside down when, having fallen asleep on a regular train commute, he wakes up in another country... in a body of a Japanese student! An unforgettable summer adventure awaits, promising many fateful meetings and momentous occasions.

title: Let's Play Jigsaw Puzzles: On the Farm
description: Join us on a journey to the countryside and indulge in the joyful and peaceful world of farming

title: Goospace
description: Goospace is a side-scroller jump game. discover universe, jump through physics from planets to planets, find various birds and fresh turnips.

title: Dungeon Slave
description: This is a Dungeon themed Hack and Slash, adventure through the dungeon and defeat all enemies and bosses, level up characters and create a variety of combos

title: Xanthiom Zero
description: Play as Captain Grisham, as he uncovers the secrets of Planet Zord in this thrilling prequel to Side Scape!

title: Super Cakeboy
description: When a group of unsanitary chefs threaten all that is good and just in Cakeland, it's up to Cakeboy to serve up punishment. Fight your foes with pastry-themed items in this bite-sized 2D platforming adventure!

title: Rugby Sevens 23
description: Get ready to experience the intensity and excitement of rugby 7s like never before with our new game! In this retro-inspired 2D action game, you'll take on the role of a rugby player and lead your team to victory in a full career mode, complete with team building, trading of players, and more.

title: Tamayura Mirai
description: There is a girl, searching for something she lost... Tamayura Mirai is a midsummer fantasy visual novel of humans, spirits, and sorcerers that's won several industry awards in Japan.

title: Alpacalypse
description: Alpacalypse is a 2.5D action platformer where you control Pancake The Llama, fighting to rescue your wife, The Mrs. Kick and spit your way through hordes of alpacas, collecting coins, and platforming your way to victory.

title: Adventure Apple Robots
description: Help the hero to find out why his brother is always running away, explore this fantastic world and unlock new skills as he ventures.

title: Crazy Cars
description: Crazy Cars is an action-packed racing game that combines fast-paced gameplay with vehicular combat. Players race in custom vehicles, use power-ups & special abilities, and enjoy endless hours of excitement. Multiple game modes, customizations, & suitable for all ages.

title: Galactic Getaway
description: Explore a cozy, uncharted planet and make it your own in this wholesome multiplayer life-sim! Befriend creatures to gather rare resources and build your dream home. Play fun minigames, farm crops, and craft decorations as you shape your perfect slice of galactic paradise!

title: Dinobot and Tiara Present: ApplePop
description: Apple Pop is a super relaxing, super satisfying Puzzle Popper with powerups, beautiful scenery and major combo's for literally anyone to play to pass the time or to let off some stress.

title: TileDeck TD
description: TileDeck TD is a Deckbuilding Tower Defense with roguelike elements set in a tabletop environment. Expand your kingdom, play powerful cards and build your perfect defensive setup.

title: Fantasy Boy
description: Fantasy Boy: a roguelike, following the adventure of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, fight many enemies, and have FUN!

title: The Aching
description: In a dark world somewhere between dream and nightmare you find yourself alone, cold, and without memory of who you are or where you came from. Guided by little more than a silver locket and questions, you must find your way off an isolated island in pursuit of answers.

title: Beecarbonize
description: Research cutting-edge technologies, enact policies, protect ecosystems, and modernize industry to cut down carbon emissions. Manage your resources well and you might survive.

title: Winning Post 10
description: The latest in the horse racing simulation series Winning Post, celebrating its 30th anniversary!

title: Lust Theory 2
description: Lust Theory 2 is an adult Visual Novel filled with lust, passion, sex, humor, mystery and on top of that the day is repeating until it doesn't.

title: QQTang
description:
QQtang is the best known game in China and across Asia. Not many of you heard of the game "bomberman", which is rarely known in the world . If you heard of bomberman you may think it is so-called "twin" base on the fundamental gameplay by strategically placing bombs in order to kill enemies and destroy obstacles, destroy powerups. However the comparision differs alot especially the clear view of preciseness of the game, designs, qualities, features, events, courses, characters, advantures, cool custom items, designs, and much more.

This game allure to alot of people, It is easy to understand even if the language is foreign to you. You will develop and learn techniques for your goal is to defeat your opponent(s). Additionally, playing with alliance, or if you are comfortable without having team you can play sole, it is optional, doesn't mean they wont get teams.Rank up and you will see amazing unique badges as you continue to go higher(changes in every rank) . Show off your character(s) design (some require money), and many other more.

To start of, choose a server, pick an event,boss..Join the room that you like (platform/arena) or create a your own room to be the leader to pick whatever platform/arena you want to choose and you can mange players (8,7,6,5,4,3, or 2 players), pick varies colors for different team players(you can play with a team or without a team),you can kickout players, whatever you like before you start the game. it is like democracy

title: SoulCast
description: SoulCast is an online action RPG set in a dark and gritty fantasy world where players compete or cooperate with each other to defeat bosses, enemy factions and other players in intense multiplayer clashes.

title: Europa Universalis IV: Domination
description: Revisit some of the most powerful and popular nations in EUIV Domination. This Expansion Pack offers new mission trees, new government reforms, new estate management and new events for several of the major powers in the game.

title: The Lamplighters League
description: Sneak, steal, and shoot your way through a world of pulp adventure in The Lamplighters League! Globetrot across a variety of exciting locales around the world and outwit your enemies in strategic turn-based combat - and, if you play your cards right, you might just save the world.

title: Crusader Kings III: Tours and Tournaments
description:
Life is a journey of chivalric adventure, so why don’t you embrace yours, ruler? Create your very own epic story with the major expansion, Crusader Kings III: Tours & Tournaments. Be awed by the sights and events that await you, from bold, mock combat in the jousting area to adventuring perilous wilds with your royal entourage.

Let wanderlust overtake your ruler’s desires during a monumental Tour, and seek out your subjects in a realm that can be both dangerous and richly entertaining. Prove yourself in one of the many forms of gallant Tournaments, either abroad or at home, or use the festivities to murder a quarrelsome rival. Be the host of new Grand Activities, be it grand weddings or stirring falconry hunts. But beware! Many celebrations are the perfect cover for the perfect scheme against foes… or family.

Be the host of new Grand Activities, be it grand weddings or stirring falconry hunts. But beware! Many celebrations are the perfect cover for the perfect scheme against foes… or family.

title: Across the Obelisk: The Wolf Wars
description: Travel back ten years and live the tale of the legendary Wolf Wars seen through the eyes of Magnus and Yogger with this new Story Pack, and unlock a new character, pet and new skins along the way.

title: Mechabellum
description: Command massive armies in this epic mech auto-battler. Draft your troops, customize your units, master your formations, and crush enemies in spectacular 3D battles. All strategy, no clickfest. Outsmart opponents in 1v1, 2v2, free-for-all, or Survival Mode.

title: Knights of Pen & Paper 3
description: Enter the new and improved world of chivalry, class warfare and off-beat pop references. Knights of Pen & Paper 3 is a true sequel to the turn-based, retro style, pixel-art adventure full of danger and saving throws you hold so dear!

title: Life by You
description: Designed to be one of the most moddable and open life-simulation games, we look forward to the humans, stories, and creations that you’ll make with Life by You.

title: Victoria 3: Update 1.2
description:
Update 1.2 comes with the following updates:

- New Features
- Improvements and bug fixes
- Interface

title: Surviving the Aftermath: Rebirth
description: For the longest time, you strived to survive the aftermath on planet Earth. Now, thanks to your knowledge, skills, and leadership, you can finally look forward to a new chapter for humankind. “Rebirth” is your mantra, your goal, the dream that will make you overcome old and new challenges, for your survivors and all humanity.

title: Cities: Skylines II
description: Create and manage your own city without restrictions. Offering a deep simulation and a living economy, Cities: Skylines II will challenge your decision-making skills and allow you to build the cities of your dreams. Get ready for a new epic scale in the most realistic city builder - ever.

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 9
description: Chests of Fortune, Skulls of Destiny, World Events better scaling to crew size, more regular Meg and Kraken encounters, fresh cosmetics, a wave of quality-of-life tweaks and much more will breathe new life into your Voyages in Sea of Thieves Season Nine!

title: Payday: The Heist - No Mercy
description: No Mercy is a heist that takes place in Mercy Hospital, a location from the Left 4 Dead game series.

title: Grand Strokers
description: Comedic Horror RPG / JRPG that will leave you breathless with a sticky keyboard --- or offended! No holds barred, no filters. Pure unadulterated sexiness monster orgy goodness!! Features color tiers gear, a ton of monsters and enemies, multiple dungeons and even bosses you can recruit as characters!!

title: Clockwork Manor
description:
Venture into the clockwork manor, a mysterious place that seems to know your deepest desires. Do daily tasks as the manor's new maid, while the manor impedes you at every step!
This is an 18+ game made for the Strawberry Jam 7 game jam. In particular, it has elements of hypnosis, reality shifting, and transformation.

title: Payday: The Heist - Undercover
description: The Crew must take an IRS employee, only known as Mr. Sturr, or simply, the Taxman, hostage in order to hack into the IRS and steal $25,000,000.

title: Payday: The Heist - Counterfeit
description: Two businessmen, named Mitchell and Wilson, have a money counterfeiting setup beneath their suburban homes, which generates millions of dollars for the two and their families. The goal of the heist is to rob the two of the money plates they use to create their counterfeit money.

title: Pokémon 3D
description:
Old school Pokémon in a 3D world! Bringing the games from the early generation of Pokémon games to the modern era.

Pokémon 3D is a video game originally created by Nilllzz. It is heavily inspired by Minecraft, and the Pokémon series. Pokémon 3D focuses on the strong points of Pokémon Gold and Silver versions and their remakes, and gives players a taste as to how the once 2D world they knew was in 3D. They could even see through the eyes of their trainer.

Pokémon 3D focuses on the strong points of Pokémon Gold and Silver versions and their remakes, and gives players a taste as to how the once 2D world they knew was in 3D. They could even see through the eyes of their trainer.

title: Disney Infinity 4.0
description:
Disney Infinity 4.0 was to be an action-adventure sandbox game developed by Avalanche Software and published by Disney Interactive.

It was the planned sequel to Disney Infinity 3.0, and was initially slated for release in 2017, before it was announced in May 2016 that Disney was ending production of the Disney Infinity series, and the game was cancelled.

title: Noroi E: The Origin of Nightmares
description: You will have to make important decisions that will affect the outcome of the game and the fate of the main character. Will you be able to find a way to stop the curse and save yourself from the darkness, or will you fall victim to the darkness and join the ranks of the dead?

title: I Wanna Be The SuperTux
description: I Wanna Be The SuperTux is a level mod for SuperTux that is inspired by I Wanna Be The Guy.

title: I Wanna Be The SuperTux 2
description: I Wanna Be The SuperTux 2 is the sequel to I Wanna Be The SuperTux, a SuperTux mod themed around I Wanna Be The Guy.

title: Fortnite: Marvel - Royalty & Warriors
description: Warriors can be formed for any reason, whether it be a king's responsibility, a soldier's duty or a hired gun's price.

title: Forspoken: In Tanta We Trust
description: Continuing her search for a way to eradicate the Break from Athia once and for all, Frey finds herself following a mysterious voice that leads her to a place that somehow transports her to the Purge of the Rheddig, the legendary battle that devastated Athia and eventually drove the Tantas to madness.

title: Virtues
description: Virtues is an adult visual novel and harem simulator. You, as a young capable college rich kid, versus 7 gorgeous girls with different backgrounds and personalities. Try to immerse yourself in the plots, discover more of the girls, and enjoy the feeling of developing your harem.​

title: Deviant Anomalies
description: Deviant Anomalies is an adult visual novel and investigator simulator. It features High quality renders with fully animated lewd scenes and immersive gameplay. Solve baffling cases, recruit Supernatural Anomalies into your team and help them control their newfound powers. The more uninhibited their minds are, the more their powers grow.

title: Payday 2: Hostile Takeover Heist
description: Hostile Takeover Heist is available on its own or as part of the Hostile Takeover Bundle.

title: Payday 2: Lost in Transit Heist
description: The Lost in Transit Heist is available on its own or as part of the Lost in Transit Bundle.

title: The Awakening
description: The Awakening is a choice-driven adult visual novel with sandbox elements. You as the player are in recovery for amnesia and must navigate your new world with the help of your otherworldly sidekick.

title: Weird Shit is Going to Happen
description: Weird Shit Is Going to Happen is an adult visual novel where weird shit is going to happen. The game is built around a lot of little side stories. As you are exploring these unusual stories, you will try to build a Harem with girls you meet in these side stories.

title: Baking with Lizzie
description: a sweet story

title: Payday 2: Midland Ranch Heist
description: The Payday Gang head to Texas to complete a job for Gemma McShay.

title: Moth House
description: Moth House is a collectible horror game that is an adventure game in an old house where many varieties of moths dine, which you will catch. The house is very dark and all you find in your pockets is a box of matches, with which you can light your way a little.

title: Kingdom of Explorers
description: Kingdom of Explorers is an adventure RPG game for up to 2 players. Each player needs to explore, collect, manage shared resources to unlock new terrains, upgrade weapons to defeat the enemies, Bosses and save the Dwarves Hidden Island!

title: Ezamur
description: Ezamur is a challenging platformer that consists of 4 stages each with it's own set of gimmicks and unique boss fights.

title: Indiepocalypse #1
description: Issue #1 of a monthly indie game anthology collecting games from 10 developers.

title: Payday 2: Black Cat Heist
description: The Payday Gang goes out to sea to strike a blow at the Golden Dagger Triad where it’ll hurt them the most, their floating casino fortress.

title: The Last Grape
description: The Last Grape is a game about fruits, vegetables and vengeance. Slice through your enemies with speed and precision in this action, fast paced platform where you control a tiny grape in seek for revenge.

title: Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened - The Whispered Dreams
description: Unlock exciting side cases that expand the world of The Awakened beyond the main adventure. Enjoy new stories, mysteries, and investigations, sure to satisfy your hunger for more detective work. You will need all of your investigative skills to unravel these baffling mysteries, and uncover the extraordinary truths behind them.

title: Tamarak Trail
description: In this deck-building roguelike, you'll use a customizable dice set as you battle through randomly generated trails - full of loot, mysteries, and danger to protect inhabitants from the evil that has corrupted the trail.

title: Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition Includes:
- Sherlock Holmes The Awakened
- Exclusive Pre-Launch DLC - The Sleuth's Attire (3 costumes)
- Set of digital wallpapers

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Adventure Sonic
description:
Features:
- Easy to digest physics and moveset taking the best from Sonic Adventure 1 and 2!
- Outstanding support for controllers and simple mode. Give it a try on SA-Sonic and be surprised! (NOTE: Bind "Center Camera" to a comfortable button, you might prefer it over manual camera turning!)
- A fleshed out super form, custom NiGHTS moveset, many easter eggs, and deep-rooted mechanics hardcore fans will instantly recognize!
- A custom Adventure menu for cosmetical and accessibility options!
After around a year of work, Adventure Sonic (AKA SA-Sonic!) is complete! SA-Sonic heavily alters the game's physics to resemble Adventure 1 and 2's, whilst scaling everything to still feel good within an SRB2 context.

Sonic has more turning control and air resistance like in Adventure, and much stronger interactions with slopes! SRB2 normally encourages you to stay airborne to keep your speed and zoom over obstacles, but SA Sonic is instead at his fastest on the ground!

Adventure Sonic supports all control styles! (strafe, standard, & simple) Normally SRB2 prioritizes keyboard+mouse, with controllers being a massive self-induced handicap. But SA-Sonic was designed with a controller-play in mind, as that's what comes to mind for us when we think "3D Sonic platformer". The primary goal was to make Adventure Sonic control naturally for both casual players and SRB2 physics loyalists both. Here's hoping we achieved that goal!

title: Panzer Battles: Battles of Normandy
description:
The Battle of Normandy evokes so many emotions. It was the beginning of the 'Great Crusade' in Northern Europe by the Western Allies, yet was viewed as long overdue by the bloodied Soviets. Few realize that the casualties suffered in the three months of the summer of 1944 in Normandy rivaled the worst of the Eastern Front. The air and seaborne landings in Northern France were the largest the world has ever seen, with meticulous planning for D-Day, yet marked by a surfeit of clear goals once ashore. Both the bocage terrain and the dogged defense by the Germans resulted in the need for unexpected improvisation. Both sides had significant constraints; the British were nearing manpower exhaustion and would have to rely excessively on their armor arm, the United States had boundless resources but many of their divisions had never been in combat, while the Germans were short of everything and it was only through their ability to organize disparate troops into flexible kampfgruppen that they held the Allies for as long as they did. Ultimately, the Battle of Normandy resulted in the utter defeat of the Germans at Falaise with France and Belgium quickly liberated thereafter. The Allied advance would last till late September 1944, ending in the streets of Arnhem with Operation Market Garden. This second release in the Panzer Battles franchise is focused on many of the battles that occurred across the Calvados & Cotentin regions of Northern France. Fought across nearly three months from June 6th 1944 to August 20th 1944, actions from the D-Day landings, through the bocage fighting to the pursuit and destruction of the German forces at Falaise are included.

Battles of Normandy includes 93 Scenarios – covering all sizes and situations, including specialized versions for both head to head play and vs. the computer AI.

title: Sonic Origins Plus
description:
Sonic Origins Plus is an updated version of Sonic Origins that includes the Plus Expansion Pack. Unlike Sonic Mania Plus, Sonic Origins Plus can be bought digitally on PC as a single purchase like the console versions, while the base game continues to be available on it's own. Digital versions of Sonic Origins on all platforms can be upgraded to Plus by purchasing the Plus Expansion Pack separately.

Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in the newly remastered Sonic Origins Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles including 12 game gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind the scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!

Sonic Origins Plus will be available as an all-in-one bundle in both digital and premium physical editions that include the Sonic Origins base game and the Plus Expansion Pack, featuring 12 Sonic Game Gear titles, playable Knuckles in Sonic CD, and for the first time ever, Amy Rose as a playable character in Sonic the Hedgehog 1, 2, Sonic 3 & Knuckles, and Sonic CD! This pack also includes previously released add-on content: Extreme Missions, Mirror Mode, new character animations, and additional backgrounds and music.

The premium physical release marks the first time any version of Sonic Origins was available on physical media. Released for Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Switch, in addition to including the complete version of Sonic Origins Plus on a disc/cartridge it also comes packaged with a reversible cover with alternate box art, an art book and an outer sleeve.
