title: Juurru
description: Travel through the roots of ancient flora. 24 tiny caves to solve and many many roots to grow!

title: Baldo: The Elemental Temples
description: Baldo's free update, The Elemental Temples includes enemies you'll encounter and more, featuring four new dungeons and more. The update is a new standalone adventure for lovers of complex dungeons, and the story follows the events after the Three Fairies DLC and before the Guardian Owls.

title: Tickling Girls
description: This is a casual puzzle class game. The story takes place between a pair of sexy and beautiful sisters. Sisters often play jigsaw puzzles together, and as punishment, the one who completes the puzzle gets to tickle the other.

title: The Most Lecherous
description: The first erotic game for young people, why pay when you can play for free?

title: The Last of The Core
description: The Last Of The Core is a third person survival horror shooter for one player where you are a soldier member of the "Two Six" team. You must recover samples in an area where there was an incident at the research facility and dinosaurs are on the loose everywhere.

title: Story of the Olivia
description: Welcome to the Wild West.Meet Olivia Carter.Fulfill missions.Earn money and uphold the law against thugs.

title: Heartbite: Dating by Daylight
description: Get to know a unique cast of characters in Heartbite: Dating in Daylight! Escape from a dire situation, collect candy and witness a decisive battle as you get closer to them. Behold stunning locations, uncover secrets and get a taste of different genre minigames in this dating sim!

title: Enter the Cyberjungle
description: Enter the Cyberjungle is a single-player, deckbuilding card game inspired by the rules of ----. Face a desperate struggle of skill and luck as you attempt to turn your pile of worthless digital cardboard heroes into a team that can defy the card game gods and win the Cyberjungle tournament.

title: Dirty Room
description: First person shooter horror adventure game. As detective C, you arrived at an old friend's home and try to find out what's going on.

title: Dawn of Mages
description:
Dawn of Mages is a new PvP Battle Arena that lays down the classical guns and the sword&board in favor of reality shaping spells.

Start a match and fight against other players (or AI) and show your skills in this fast-paced magical 3rd person shooter.

Skills and reaction time combined with strategy and fast-thinking in a fascinating and spectacular setting.

title: Retro Golden Age: Goody
description: Goody, the original spectrum action, platform and puzzle game from the eighties, puts you in the shoes of an expert bank robber in an updated version for Steam with improvements such as saving, filters and screen settings and achievements with the best Spanish hits.

title: Penny Larceny: Gig Economy Supervillain
description: Join Penny in planning and executing daring heists across the city, and navigate the intricate web of alliances and betrayals that makes up the criminal underworld. With snappy comic book artwork, a swinging soundtrack of electro-jazz and a multiverse-spanning storyline of victories and disasters, Penny Larceny is a must-play for visual novel fans. Are you ready to embark on the heist of a lifetime?

title: Hentai Puzzle Quest
description: Hentai Puzzle Quest is a game that aims to relax through art and lofi music.

title: Magic Research
description: Magic Research is a text-based incremental game about Magic. You are the headmaster of a newly-created institution of Magic. Will you be able to lead your school to win the prestigious Tournament of Magic?

title: Goose Ronnie
description: "Goose Ronnie" is an exciting and amusing platformer game that takes you on a journey with the beloved character, Ronnie the Goose. In this game, Ronnie must navigate through various landscapes, all while avoiding dangers and collecting points.

title: Fox4Elite
description: Fox4Elite is a dynamic female FPS and TPS strategic shooter - fast paced and challenging. Lead a team of highly skilled Agents in order to defeat a murderous female clone army. Deploy your Agent fire teams for strategic advantage against the enemy and survive to complete the mission objectives

title: Black Reliquary
description: Black Reliquary is a total conversion mod for Darkest Dungeon, one which makes sweeping overhauls to gameplay, adds a new story, a new setting, new narration, new music, new enemies, and so very much more. Embark into the distant east and uncover the ancient secrets of the Black Reliquary!

title: Crop Rotation
description: Crop Rotation is a farming-theme card drafting game. Cards are played automatically so you can focus on the deck building and building synergies.

title: Mystery Solitaire: The Black Raven 4
description: Gothic sequel to "Mystery Solitaire. The Black Raven". Breathtaking architecture and mysterious atmosphere.

title: Panda's Village
description: Panda's Village is a real-time strategy and survival game, where you build and upgrade houses, defenses, and stores, fight fierce monkeys, purchase and upgrade weapons and magic and customize your panda. Your goal is to save the village's Capitol at all costs! If you die, you start over.

title: Tangram Collection
description: Tangram Collection offers a fresh spin on a classic tangram game

title: Sandoria
description: This is a 2D platformer with a conditionally infinite procedurally generated world. A very deep and varied world full of interesting and dangerous things to explore.

title: Sonic Mania Atmosphere
description: Welcome to Sonic Mania Atmosphere! A complete modpack of new, reimagined and returning zones along with a completely new soundtrack to create a fresh Mania experience unlike any before. The mods and music included are compliled from the best of the gamebanana modding community and Sonic Youtube community musicians to create a fluid and polished 2D Sonic experience from start to finish rivaling that of a sequel game.

title: ​Sonic Robo Blast 2: Official Level Design Collab 2022 - Round 2
description:
The Official Level Design Collab (formally Official Level Design Contest) is a collection of levels from the SRB2 community.

Contributions:
- Auburn Heights Zone, Act 1 - Cool Cat
- Seaside Coast Zone - M/C Industries
- Speed Highway Zone - LucasLixoso

title: Ducky's Delivery Service
description: Propeller-powered duck delivery action! In Ducky's Delivery Service, you are a duck who uses a propeller backpack to fly around and deliver mail. Master the flight physics, grow your delivery business, fulfill special delivery requests from other ducks, and earn time attack ranks and high scores.

title: Sonic Adventure Genisys
description: Rumors of a Sonic Adventure remake are floating around in the Sega offices and Tails created a Knuckles Terminator robot to be send back in time and investigate what's going on. And things are going to go a lot more Meta and insane from there on.

title: Deep Space Scoundrel
description: Deep Space Scoundrel is a rouge-like space adventure where you use a variety of classic arcade mechanics to explore the universe, customize your ship, land at spaceports, and fraternize with other aliens and low-lives.

title: Sex Simulator: Girl on Girl
description: An interactive sex simulation game, featuring high definition graphics and videos with realistic looking characters, set in a beautiful decor. You play the role of a sexy brunette, inviting three girls over at her glamorous apartment, for some wild same-sex experiences.

title: Not the Hero
description: Not the Hero - Yes, you are not the hero in this story, neither are you the right guy. but you will be doing it anyway!

title: Apewar
description: Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. By playing in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. Monkeys are strong together!

title: Bullet Runner: The First Slaughter
description: Big fucking guns + twin-stick action = Bullet Runner! Combine crazy movement and combat mechanics to dodge, slide, swing and shoot your way to victory! Brutal attacks, adrenaline, speed, power; you get them all. Free to play 4-hour single player campaign and an endless arena mode.

title: Ainmora: The Impending Disaster
description: A captivating RPG with interesting mechanics and unique challenges that will make you think strategically as you admire the immersive history of Ainmora. Think about each choice. Explore carefully. Aziron, Kiarah, Roberit and many others await you in Ainmora.

title: Lethal Dose
description: Fast Paced, Violent Top-Down Shooter. Magic Abilities. Difficult Levels. Twitchy Enemies. Level Editor.

title: Dream Fire
description: Dream Fire offers a unique and captivating experience, which will keep you in suspense and delight you both with its unique story and graphics, as well as with the fact that you will always have something to do to develop yourself more and more!

title: Dark Traveller
description: Dark Traveller is an action-packed puzzle game with multiple storylines and open endings. The game tells the story of a world on the brink of apocalypse in the distant future. In the world, you travel through quantum space-time to rescue your homeland on the rocks with the help of your partner!

title: Twinsen's Little Big Adventure Remastered 2
description: Built from the ground up, enjoy new breathtaking visuals, enhanced music and improved, deeper gameplay as Twinsen's Little Big Adventure 2 - Remastered reignites the original LBA2/Twinsen's Odyssey game using the latest next-generation technology.

title: Little Big Adventure: Twinsen's Quest
description:
Step into Twinsun's fantastical world in this action-adventure remake! Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest brings brand new visuals, new music by the original composer, and smoother gameplay to the iconic classic released back in 1994.

Embark on a Timeless Adventure, Reimagined

Twinsen is back in this remake featuring a new stylish makeover and modernized gameplay. Faithful to the original game, Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest takes you on an epic journey on a small planet harboring both magic and technology.

title: Vallen
description: Space combat on a massive scale. Defend your allies, destroy the Xeris and claim victory for the Vallen! Your people need you, fly your ship in an intense battle in an asteroid field to secure the sector.

title: Mafia Clicker
description: Run a Mafia Crew and Build up your City! Try to turn your entire City into a Mafia Empire!

title: Silver Box Classics
description: This collection brings back a gathering of adaptations of the events in the first four Dragonlance role-playing modules, at the beginning of the War of the Lance. These are the first video games adaptations of D&D that started it all.

title: Shame Legacy
description: Shame Legacy is a first-person survival-horror, set in a forsaken cultist village. You attempt to survive using stealth and escape. By solving puzzles, you unravel the mystery that's h(a)unting you.

title: Primal Carnage: Extinction - Prehistoric Legacy
description: Deck out your dinosaurs with over 200 unique looks!

title: Mineshaft
description: Use falling blocks to craft shovels, pickaxes, bombs and other tools to dig deeper into the mine and uncover gems to complete your quest! Craft coins to buy upgrades to tools and special abilities! Join a friend for classic PVP puzzle battles, where combos drop trash onto your opponent's playfield!

title: The Wagadu Chronicles
description: The Wagadu Chronicles is a Role-Play-First Afrofantasy MMORPG featuring multiplayer synchronous turn-based combat, communal settlement building and capture, and a cinematic dialogue mode.

title: Data Delivery Agents
description: An edutainment puzzle game about the principles of ubiquitous connectivity. Help Ebi deliver packets across the world wide web; build paths using directional tiles across over 30 different levels.

title: Welcome Kokuri-san
description: Welcome Kokuri-san is a visual novel starring the VTuber Kurune Kokuri. The story is fully voiced, and will include scenes with realistic ASMR voices, so you can enjoy the scenario “as if you were there.”

title: Paper Snow
description:
Paper Snow is a yuri kinetic novel about the pain and joy of knowing someone you love is happy without you.

At some point in life, your path might diverge from the people you least expect to say goodbye to. There is no set when and where for this momentous event. No red circled reminder on a calendar, no ear-marked page on a journal. There is no indicator for the last time you’ll ever meet someone. Only the memory of it, after it’s all over.

title: Mini Doom
description: Mini DOOM is very short tribute game based on Doom 1. It transforms the classic FPS into a 2D action platformer. Collect keys and battle your way through 5 stages with the classic Doom weapons, powerups and enemies.

title: Are We Thawing
description:
An ex-detective stumbles upon a crime he wasn't supposed to know about and is now complicit in the death of a God.

You play as Noelle Blanche, an ex-detective belonging to the Kingdom of Winter. As times begin to change, the seasons find themselves at war. The Winter Kingdom's biggest enemy the Summer Kingdom is advancing. And Noelle never thought he himself would be at the center of this conflict...

title: Trashmorfers
description: In the future, the unrecycled trash takes a monstrous form, known as Trashmorfers & dominates the world. Save the earth from destructive pollution before it's late for the human kind 3rd& 1stPerson Destroy PVCs, Trashmen & WEEEs Multiplayer soon

title: A Day Out with Ube
description: "It's another grey morning here in the Matamis' mansion, you pry your eyes open to the bright grey clouds with your consciousness finally creeping in to get you awake. Though, this day doesn't really seem to be like any other day you've had. In fact, you might just be in for a day out for one of the missus' kids." -some lunatic trying to narrate this

title: Metal War
description: This is a fast-paced top-down shooting and tower defense game. You need to customize and upgrade your chariot, build defensive structures to protect your base, explore the world and destroy all enemies! Don't forget to come back and defend when the enemy attacks! Can you make it to the end?

title: The Banished Vault
description: A strategy game of exploration, endurance, and space travel on an interstellar gothic monastery. Explore solar systems, harvest resources, construct outposts, and face hazards in the challenging universe of The Banished Vault.

title: Sinister Turmoil: Sewers
description: Below the abandoned Fredbear and Friends Funland, horrors lurk in the shadows. Mangle has been unleashed into the sewers and you have been locked down there with it. While navigating a series of tunnels and rooms you must find a way out, as well as avoiding the monsters that only have one agenda, to kill you.

title: Ultimate Anime Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Kawaii girls are broken into pieces. Can you reunite them by completing these jigsaw puzzles?

title: SCP-087-B Extended Edition
description: This mod expands SCP-087-B by giving it new content, such as new floors, events, monsters, and also introduces some new features

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Cacee "Kiwi" Cactus
description:
A character addon for Sonic Robo Blast 2.

Cacee "Kiwi" Cactus is here from Mirage Saloon Zone! She used to be a bandito, but she's given up her days of crime... mostly.

title: Sonic R Characters: Metal Knuckles & Tails Doll
description:
A character pack for Sonic Robo Blast 2.

After being disowned by their creator after their failure to acquire the Chaos Emeralds in Sonic R, Metal Knuckles and Tails Doll join Sonic and Co. to take down Dr. Eggman! This duo of doppelgangers have returned from their previous outing with some new tricks that players can utilize to explore stages in brand new ways, similar to that of their original organic counterparts.

title: Chi Ninja
description: In a world full of ninjas chi ninja will fight his way to freedom a fast pace speed runner platformer with sharp ninja moves grappling hock and ninja stars aswell as a katana will our hero survive the ninja army.

title: Touhou: New World
description: Delve back into the world of Touhou in this bullet hell action-RPG adventure! The boundary between Gensokyo and the outside world has been breached, and it falls to Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame to discover why. Level up skills, forge new equipment, and explore Gensokyo to uncover the truth!

title: Captain Dodger: The Hidden Cargo
description: After clearing the port and killing his enemies, Captain Dodger enters the pirate ship. Avoid their traps and try to unlock all the doors. Be careful though. The pirates have made it pretty tough to navigate their ship hull. Who knows what kind of cargo they might hide in there. Time to unravel the mystery.

title: Deathchron
description: Deathchron is an action side scroller where you play as a kid that finds an amazing mech to save the world.

title: Shinobi Harisenbo
description:
Otome game by Spice+.
Set during the Sengoku era, a short story about a princess and her shinobi guard.

title: Distant Worlds 2: Factions - Ikkuro and Dhayut
description: The Galaxy Expands! For the first time since the release of Distant Worlds 2, two new playable factions are joining the game – the peaceful Ikkuro and the devious Dhayut!

title: Escape From the Depth
description: Escape From the Depth is a cosmic horror game that takes place in a submarine under the dark, cold, and desolate oceans of Europa. The player must survive while trying to collect the necessary items to safely evacuate the sinking submarine.

title: Tuya
description: The protagonist returns to his parents' house in a hurry after hearing the news of his grandfather's death, and there he meets a terrifying sight!

title: Life of Slime
description: Life of Slime is a cute story game in which you have to play as a slime named Slami.

title: Flea the Cat
description: Flea the Cat is an endless runner, in which you play a ninja, known as Squeek. Slice and chomp your way through crowds as you attempt to escape the clutches of the demonic cat that hunts you in this living nightmare.

title: Pangya: United
description: Anime-style golfing MMO.

title: Uniform Girl
description: This is a search for beautiful girls. Through the wiping of the gentlemen, the girls and girls interact to trigger the unlocking of all CG.

title: Mekakare
description: In development otome game.

title: Key La Box
description: In development otome game.

title: Qualia/Delta
description: A in-development PC otome game.

title: Yami-iro no Maju
description: Otome game by Daisy2.

title: Junsei Yasaotoko
description: A shoujo manga style romcom otome game.

title: Junsei Yasaotoko Sweet & Bitter
description: TyranoScript remake with 3 new heroes.

title: Wandering
description: Wandering (Liúlàng Huāngdǎo) is a pixel-style sandbox action-adventure where you play as a drifting desert island adventurer trying to survive on a pristine desert island. You can explore unknown islands on a raft and get unique resources and treasures.

title: Half-Life: MMod
description: Half-Life 1: MMod is a free, fan made modification for Half-Life aiming to refine player's arsenal and further expand player's combat options. Featuring AI tweaks, VFX and SFX overhaul in spirit of original, additional weapon functionality and bug fixes, while keeping most changes optional.

title: Taxi of the Asteroids
description: Asteroids game made for the Game Jam FR 8

title: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine
description: Help Dr. Fetus create the perfect Meat Boy clone in a unique new twist on the tile-matching puzzle genre. In classic Meat Boy fashion, an endless cavalcade of devious and deadly traps stand between you and victory in this hardcore puzzle game that will push your skills to the limit.

title: Doki Doki! RainClouds
description: Doki Doki! RainClouds is a fan game that makes you play through DDLC’s original Act I with Sayori’s point of view.

title: Shatter Bot
description: Shatter the shackles of corporate tyranny in this action-packed shooter-platformer. Upgrade your ShatterBot, unlock new weapons, and blast all around you to smithereens! Features fully destructible, procedurally generated levels, guaranteed to challenge even the most experienced robo pilot.

title: Nico Yazawa is Dreaming
description:
When Nico-chan woke up one day, she found herself inside a mysterious dream world!!
Joined by the rest of μ's, she embarks on a great adventure!
Beset by many strange and cute creatures, she must bring a smile to all of them!
Aim to become the number one idol in the universe!

title: Let's! Revolution!
description: In Let's Revolution, embark on a deadly game of hide and seek as you decipher numbered clues to uncover the path to your goals. Chase down the cowardly King through the realms of Beebom while facing off against a host of enemies. Gear up along the way with powerful items and abilities for a final showdown in Beebom City.

title: Closer the Distance
description: Closer the Distance is a slice-of-life sim that tells a deeply emotional story about the connections between family and friends in the face of tragedy. Unearth long kept secrets, repair strained relationships, and help your loved ones move on.

title: Golden Memory 2
description: Golden Memory 2 is a re-imagining of the universe of Five Nights at Freddy's

title: Greed of Man
description: Greed of Man is an open world multiplayer game where you live in a town built and ran by real players. Players can buy and own their own Houses that they can decorate as they wish. There is an in game economy also influenced by players. Players can choose to start their own jobs and run their own legal businesses like shops and factories, but they can also get a little more spicy with their money by constructing underground black market business like drug and weapons cratering. And not only can players purchase properties but they can also build one, or hire a construction company to build one. You can also rob other peoples business, but be aware of players playing as cops as they can always stop you in your conquest of crime.

title: Ra Ra Boom
description: Ra Ra Boom is a 2D, co-op beat ’em up driven by a coming-of-age narrative about a group of ninja cheerleaders from space in a fight to save the rest of humanity on Earth.

title: The Faces of Evil Remastered Randomizer
description: A randomizer mod for The Faces of Evil Remastered.

title: The Wand of Gamelon Remastered Randomizer
description: A randomizer mod for The Wand of Gamelon Remastered.

title: Bunny Bye-Bye
description: You control bobe, the little alien as they clean their space station of dust bunnies with their handy clean0tron.

title: 1-900-Cult
description: Under the neon shadows of Miami, a mysterious cult searches for a way to bring about an end to life- and death- as we know it. Who will stop their horrific summons?

title: Kunado Chronicles
description:
You wake up from a cold sleep upside-down in a tree. Watch out—It's the future.
In a world destroyed by ineffable monsters with no hearts, but an iron will; in a society warped and shaped by the constant threat of ruin; the dragon is already dead: Help what's left of humanity learn how to live in this post-apocalyptic fantasy visual novel.

title: Hamelin's Journey
description: Inspired by Pokémon, Dragon Quest, Monster Rancher and other late 90s classics, this game tasks you to explore a mysterious world, capture and train the spirits that inhabit this realm and seek the timeless creature that lurks in the depth of the underground.

title: Pseudoregalia
description: Sybil finds herself in a distorted castle and must find her own way out. Grow strong and unlock new abilities to build up a deep movement system, fight enemies, find secrets, and uncover the mysteries of Castle Sansa.

title: Million Monster Militia
description: This time, 50 giant bosses have taken over 50 cities in the United States (including recently-annexed Montreal). It's your job to cross the country, gathering troops to free the terrified population.

title: EX: Extra
description: A vertical doujin shmup inspired by Ketsui.

title: Chucky: Wanna Play?
description: Chucky: Wanna Play? is a stealth-action video game, based on the Child's Play franchise.

title: The Curse of Kubel: Deluxe Edition
description:
An earthquake swallows up the city of Kaldesta and splits it into two. Now many adventurers travel there in search of treasure. However, a curse suddenly appears and starts infecting the adventurers. The Magician’s Guild catches wind of this, and sends the young apprentice, Magetano, to investigate.

The Curse of Kubel Deluxe Edition contains both the base game, as well as the additional content from "The Curse of Kubel+ – Expansion DLC".

title: CatSacks
description: CatSacks is a cozy hidden object game of fuzzy friends with a little twist of Rube Goldbergesque puzzle solving fun. Click, slide, & spin objects to find hidden cats & other animals in four catastical worlds. Cat finds lovingly voiced by my real life kitties & friend's floofs!

title: Milky Animals
description: Battle of cute animals and cute monsters Evolve into a cuter and more powerful animal with an evolution potion animal strategy game A game that anyone can enjoy

title: Hentai Journey
description: Hentai Journey - is a simple puzzle game with musical accompaniment where you can relax and enjoy pictures of girls on gallery after complete level

title: Little Monki
description: Little Monki is a cute and relaxing sokoban-like game, help the little cute monkey to collect all the bananas to satisfy his hungry.

title: Tsetseg's Adventure
description: Tsetseg, the little witch, is in crisis. Her friends are taken and converted to bad guys by the Mad Wizard. Explore castle, fight Bosses, rescue friends, regain special power, and defeat Mad Wizard! A classic pixel style, 2D platformer game.

title: My Life as a Cult Leader
description: After you lose your job and apartment, you're left with nothing. Forced to spend the night on a cold park bench, you curse your fate, only for a beautiful woman calling herself Shima Itsuki to appear and ask you to be a cult leader...

title: Midnight Market
description: Welcome to the seedy side of town, try to make money, while dodging knife fights, and running from the law.

title: Pale Cinder
description: Death is not the end! Slash, dash, parkour and manipulate time in this 2d action plaformer.

title: Magic and Machines
description: A retro fantasy RPG with turn-based battles, puzzles, and six unique characters. It's perfect for players who grew up with turn-based RPGs and are looking for a new adventure, and also accessible for new players as it doesn't take itself too seriously.

title: I Was Born Poor
description: Cherubino is a boy who was born poor and he lives in village where TV is provided for free by local government. His life is truely surrounded by nothingness. But Cherubino is getting his way through poverty with the spiritual help of "Brahmana" of Brahmanas.

title: Starborne: Frontiers
description: Take to the stars in an epic space adventure set in the distant future. Discover the dark secrets of the 10 warring factions, from the immortal Children of the Everliving to the lawless Marauders; they all have one goal: to dominate the galaxy. As a commander, you will face threats from all across the galaxy. Is your fleet ready for the challenge? Find out in this stellar tactical gacha game, where you'll test your strategy skills in exhilarating starship battles.

title: Earthtia Saga: Larthur's Legend
description: Action point-and-click adventure, related to the Lord of Lords: Ryu Knight series.

title: Brave the Dungeon
description: Brave the Dungeon is a thrilling and immersive multiplayer open-world game that takes you on an epic journey to fight against the daemonic invasion threatening the archipelago.

title: Spooky Shelter
description: A girl named Sarah stood in front of the old abandoned orphanage where she had spent her childhood. The building had been empty for years and looked decrepit and troubled. As she approached the entrance, she heard a faint whispering voice that seemed to be calling her name.

title: The Moroccan Castle 3: Behind The Secrets
description: Dive into the adventures inside The Moroccan Old Castle, solve the mystery, prepare yourself for a great horror experience!

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Cute Cats 4
description: Cute cats will melt the coldest hearts! The wide range of features of the game "1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats 4" will bring your head to the ground.

title: Pumpkin Delivery
description: After carving her own pumpkin, Murphy decides to give it to her grandmother and goes out on Halloween night without her parents for the first time. Thus begins her fight against the Halloween evil that has come to life in the city.

title: Pencil Plus: The Wrath of The Spankster
description: Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster is an interactive novel style choose your own adventure game in which players take the role of Conner, a normal high school kid that gains a very unique super power: the ability to pull limitless pencils out of his pockets.

title: Second Wave
description: Second Wave is an online multiplayer team-based shooter set in the world of Armantia. Over the years, wars have been fought over a unique resource that has helped the continent advance in both Science and Technology: The Arcane Stone.

title: Squeen's Adventure 3: Across The Cosmos
description:
The "threequal" (Is that a word?) to one of the best games known to man! (Don't look that up)

​After finally completing his adventure, Squeen's spaceship is fully working without any problems! That is until a rouge asteroid knocks into his ship and his Light-Jump Reactor breaks off and plunges into a nearby black hole. With no way to get back home, Squeen must travel across the universe in search of the parts of the reactor, fix it, and finally go home and charge his phone!

title: Labyrinthe
description: Third game from the Horror Tour series.

title: Link Devicer 2074
description: Mecha strategy game, developed by G.A.M Corporation

title: GachaHell
description:
In this breakneck, arcade-style, game, you'll take control of Flow, Macho, and Jade - three idols who were fired from their dream gig for being too... different. But don't count them out just yet - with your help, they'll fight to climb the ranks and become the ultimate 5-star idols!

Choose from three thrilling game modes as you strive to reach the top. But be warned: the competition is fierce and the stakes are high. You'll need to quickly feed weaker idol units to your own to level up and reach a coveted 5-star rating. But if you're not careful, you could end up as level fodder yourself!

The world of this fictional mobile gacha game is not for the faint of heart. It's a cutthroat place where only the highest star idols will survive. Do you have what it takes to lead Flow, Macho, and Jade to their dream in this GachaHell?

title: Learning English With Takako
description: Set before the prologue of the visual novel we have Sachiko and Takako practicing their English in anticipation for their upcoming trip to the southern islands of Australia. A peek into the lives of Sachiko and Takako in this fan visual novel.

title: NHL 97
description: PC port of NHL 97.

title: Rhythmole
description: Rhythmole is a musical rhythm whack-a-mole game. Play through hand-made levels or create and share your own with friends!

title: Pinkatana
description:
Slash and dash as Pink, the cherry blossom samurai, to save your love from a fate worse than death!

A platformer where your attack, dash and jump are all the same mechanic.

Advance through perilous obstacles and defeat elemental spirits at the risk of losing all of your progress at the slightest misstep.

You may be brave, but you're still just a cherry blossom

title: Mousebusters
description: The player character just wanted to move into their new apartment, but when they end up transformed into a mouse they find themselves having to join the Mousebusters to take out the ghosts haunting every resident of the building.

title: Nightmare Before Disney
description: Nightmare Before Disney is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame, a point and click horror game. Created by the SubwooferX3 with motivation from Blackout1912, Nightmare Before Disney is a official remake of Sub's 2015 NBD.

title: Monster Factory
description: Play as an unknown organism with different abilities bent on devouring everything in its path. Start as a small blob, rolling around absorbing objects, eating bigger and bigger objects as you go.

title: Gutterbrawlers
description: Gutterbrawlers is a snappy 2D fighting game with a combat system inspired by early Klassics. Featuring online mode with rollback netcode implemented using GGPO open-source code.

title: Poly Jigsaw: Animals
description: Poly Jigsaw: Animals is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game, with a cute animals.

title: The Wingless Bee
description: The Wingless Bee is a brand new Frogger-inspired game where a bee named Bella is abruptly thrown far away from the hive she lives and works at. With her wings destroyed, she can only hop to get back home.

title: Turbo Racing: New Cars
description: Take control of new racing cars! Feel the new atmosphere with the first expansion Turbo Racing: New Cars!

title: Words of Wisdom
description: Poetic, philosophical and challenging platformer experience? That's all about Words of Wisdow — innovative mix of hardcore platformer with text riddles and word puzzles.

title: Donut Adventure
description: A kids friendly platform game. Collect coins and jump to the destination.

title: Crossroads: Escaping the Dark
description: Can you guide a tormented gamer through a trio of terrifying challenges?

title: PeopleWillMoney
description: People generate money if they are working, but it costs money if they are not working. It is important to build facilities as quickly as and keep people around. Keep building facilities silently, or use policy to other players. The player with the most assets at the end of the game wins.

title: Unsolved Case: Murderous Script - Collector's Edition
description: The life of a detective is unpredictable and very dangerous. You never know what awaits you around the next corner and what secrets you need to unravel. But you knew what you were getting into, there's no turning back!

title: Touchstarved
description: You were born cursed, with hands that twist the mind of any human you touch. Desperation leads you to the shadowy city of Eridia, where your fate intertwines with 5 monstrous strangers. Each can offer you salvation or damnation. Find a cure for your curse in Touchstarved, a gothic horror romance visual novel.

title: Coding Robo
description: Learn programming in a fun way! An educational game that teaches the basics of programming and algorithmic logic. No prior knowledge of programming is required to play.

title: WorldWide Warfare League of Cities
description: World Wide Warfare (WWW) is the final battle between the good and evil forces of the ancient and modern world. Join the fray.

title: Running Guys
description: A police officer, a thief, and a bag full of cash, with a hole in it. This is the story of a wild pursuit on this 2D platformer.

title: Heart vs HP
description: Avoid all incoming obstacles while managing your HP! There are only 2 ways to die. One, is be hit by an obstacle, and two, when your HP is 0. Try to get as many points as possible to renew your high score!

title: 0xFF
description: Work your way across endless terrain and toxic water in search for a way to stop the energy outburst that will end all life.

title: Clockmaker
description: Rescue the town from the evil curse of the Old Clockmaker! Enjoy an addicting story, solve the mystery and save the city from the villain. Thousands of levels of adventure match three are waiting for you right now!

title: Point of Mew
description: A first pawson puzzle adventure! Play as a cat helping your sad human to build a toy boat out of trash and get through the day.

title: Persona5: The Phantom X
description: Persona 5: The Phantom X is a spin-off of Persona 5, and is officially authorized by SEGA with deep involvement by Atlus.

title: Frogun Encore
description: Frogun Encore is a dashing standalone expansion/sequel to indie hit Frogun! Join now older Renata and Jake in a trek around the whole world to prevent the return of Beelzebub. Encore builds on Frogun's retro PS1/N64 formula. Plus, enjoy the whole adventure in true couch co-op.

title: Criminals Within
description: Embark on an epic journey through a medieval fantasy land inhabited by powerful, de-evolved dragons. Join forces with a friend in this asymmetric co-op multiplayer adventure. Engage in skill-based combat, take on epic boss battles, solve cooperative puzzles and enjoy lighthearted comedy.

title: Zaccaria Pinball: Space Shuttle Deluxe Pinball Table
description: A space shuttle themed pinball table.

title: Robo Frenzy
description: Build and battle in Robo Frenzy! Create dozens of weapons and construct inventions to crush gigantic gadgets in a sandbox action game that blends crafting with combat.

title: Surviving the Aftermath: Forgotten Tracks
description: Here is what’s left of Music: old tapes, cassettes, forgotten tunes that re-emerged from the ruins of society as we know it. With different styles and origins, Forgotten Tracks is the perfect soundtrack for surviving the Aftermath.

title: Run On Home
description: A short horror/comedy themed 2.5D platformer with puzzles, hostile enemies, and multiple endings. After reaching the end the first time you'll unlock the demon killing gun.

title: Dune of the Desert
description: A vehicular-combat focused game set in a post apocalyptic desert, the player takes the role of a bounty hunter tasked with taking down some of the most feared creatures in the desert. Collect artefacts, crystals, and other highly sort after items to upgrade your vehicle for high intensity combat.

title: Henry Halfhead
description: Meet Henry, merely half a head, but with the peculiar ability to possess and control any object within their reach. Discover every object's unique properties and abilities and cleverly combine them to progress through Henry’s not-so-ordinary everyday life.

title: Forge of the Fae
description: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

title: Demon Speakeasy
description: Mix drinks and mingle with monster girls! Manage a bar staffed by cute waitresses and work hard to earn their affection! Take orders, make sophisticated small-talk and get lucky in the wildest ways possible...

title: Avian Knights
description: Battle it out with your friends or compete for the title of Grand World Champion in Avian Knights, the crazy game of mounted mayhem combat! Featuring an 8-player competitive arena mode, a classic arcade co-op mode, and tons of weapons and power-ups, there’s plenty of ways to play!

title: FT Adventures
description: FT Adventures is a game about a robot who goes through various different types of platforms and environment levels and tries to complete those levels.

title: Marvel's Midnight Suns: The Hunger
description:
Marvel's Midnight Suns: The Hunger is the second DLC expansion for Marvel's Midnight Suns, released in January 2023. This DLC introduces the character Morbius, the Living Vampire, as a fully playable hero. Morbius brings a unique set of vampire-themed abilities to the game, focusing on life-stealing attacks, supernatural speed, and other vampiric powers.

The expansion includes new story missions that delve into Morbius's battle against Lilith's forces and his struggles with his vampiric nature.

title: Revival Quest
description: To save their hometown from being shutdown, Ravilla and Tyris must do everything in their power to revive the town's once thriving mine and revive Elsinki to its former glory. Another classic RPG from developer ShiroKuroSoft!

title: Train Sim World 3: BNSF SD70ACe
description: Tackle the harsh and mountainous grades of California in a modern masterpiece; experience heavy freight hauling aboard electro-motive power with an orange twist, battle the summit with Train Sim World 3: BNSF SD70ACe!

title: Train Sim World 3: DB BR 403 ICE 3 Railbow
description: Add a splash of colour and ride in high-speed pride on iconic ICE services; from the 10-year anniversary of DB's pride initiative, to the many parades and celebrations throughout Germany. Embrace love and diversity with Train Sim World 3: ICE 3 Railbow!

title: Train Sim World 3: Rail Operations Group BR Class 37/7
description: Take charge of the hardest working locomotives in Britain today; experience unique Unit Drag services, hauling EMUs to and from refurbishment, thrashing throughout the Medway Towns and beyond with Train Sim World 3: Rail Operations Group BR Class 37/7!

title: Tax Heaven 3000
description: Tax Heaven 3000 is a visual novel dating game that actually prepares your 2022 US federal tax return! Romance Iris, a cheerful and easygoing girl who is oddly interested in your personal finances. Maximize your deductions, and charm your way into her heart!

title: Against Great Darkness
description: Against Great Darkness is a brick breaker roguelike. You are a paragon of pagan mythology trying to escape the clutches of Lucifer. Fight through waves of demonic entities and acquire great relics which aid you on your escape. Stumble upon unique events which can either reward or hinder your ascent. Gather shards on each run to unlock upgrades that will better your chances.

title: Unprompted
description: A.I. is here. Type to guess the words used to create A.I. artworks, while slowly uncovering A.I.'s reflections on its own work. Come investigate more than 1,500 artworks made by A.I. across 7 carefully curated galleries.

title: Park Beyond: Impossified Edition
description:
The Impossified Edition includes:
- The GameDesk Figurine
- Collector’s Box
- Artbook
- Poster
- Lanyard & Badge
- Exclusive SteelBook
- Physical & Digital Soundtrack
- Exclusive Postcards
- Stickers
- Collector’s Bonus Content: Features the BEYOND SEAS Set including 10 decorative items such as pirate flag, cannon, and pirates animatronics so that you can bring that Ahoy pirate atmosphere into your park!
- Deluxe Bonus Pack: Features the Park Beyond: ZOMBEYOND Impossification Set including: One flat ride and its impossified version.
- Season Pass: The Park Beyond: Annual Pass will allow you to receive 3 upcoming DLCs.

title: Chinese Chess Party
description: Chinese Chess(Xiangqi) is no longer just a 1v1 game, Chinese Chess Party can support up to 4 players. You can play against the computer on a 1v1 game or even play a 2v2 team game with a computer teammate.

title: Phantom Integration
description: An expanded version of "Phantom of Inferno", containing a new ending.

title: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno
description: Remake of Phantom of Inferno with completely redrawn art in the style of the 2009's anime. The voice cast was also replaced by the one used in the anime.

title: Glory Room
description: Glory Room is a Roguelike game that can be played quickly and lightly. It proceeds with stories of the characters who have no choice but to come to the hellish arena. Various items, monsters and traps give you trials. Overcome it and create your own show to defeat the demons and reclaim your glory!

title: Sokoboxes Duo
description: A new game based on Sokoban.

title: The Illusion: Curse
description: The Illusion: Curse Is a horror game made by professional crew In the art of horror. You will have the opportunity to experience one of the most powerful types of psychological horror Based on an environment designed in every detail to be a real hell that makes you terrified.

title: Xiaomei and the Flame Dragon's Fist
description: Save your sister from the darkness in this authentic 16-bit kung fu action game, releasing outside Japan for the first time!

title: The Hero with a Thousand Arms
description: The Hero with a Thousand Arms has created a challenging game where multiple mini-games are running simultaneously on the screen, and the player needs to switch between them to operate. Meanwhile, the other games enter bullet time mode.

title: Backrooms: Exploration
description: Backrooms: Exploration is a single-player horror game, which takes place in 2020. Two friends have lost their jobs due to COVID-19, but they still have to bring food to the table. After a failed heist, one of them ends up in the Backrooms. Now your only mission is to survive.

title: Counter-Strike 2
description: Counter-Strike 2 is a free-to-play multiplayer tactical first-person shooter developed and published by Valve. Released in September 2023, it is the fifth main entry in the Counter-Strike series and serves as a direct replacement for Counter-Strike: Global Offensive on Steam. Two teams, Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists, compete in objective-based rounds across modes such as bomb defusal and hostage rescue. Built on the Source 2 engine, the game introduced volumetric smoke physics, revised weapon handling, and a new sub-tick server architecture. It inherited all cosmetic items from its predecessor and features both a map-specific Competitive mode and a numerically ranked Premier mode.

title: IguaRPG
description: Be an iguana and save the world from evil.

title: The Territory of Egg
description: This is a variant tower defense indie game. Use the Egg Warriors to form a defense line, observe the type and distribution of the enemy, use the terrain structure, build a reasonable formation, explore different skill combinations, and protect the Holy Egg.

title: Exit: The Game - Trial of the Griffin
description: An exciting Escape Room experience awaits you! Can you uncover the secrets of Greifenstein Castle and escape?

title: Road Accident With Dangerous Goods VR Training
description: Train your professional skills in Road Accident With Dangerous Goods VR Training safely and in full correspondence with international standards!

title: Atomic Blast
description: Atomic Blast is a tricky platformer with a plethora of dangers to keep your eye on. The protagonist may have a gun, but that won’t help much if he can’t dodge the enemy soldiers and death lasers that will cut him up with a single shot.

title: Koi de wa Naku: It's Not Love, but So where Near
description: This is the debut and the only title by Syangrila Smart. It tells the story from several perspectives but there are two main protagonists: Norifumi, a guy who has been taking pictures since he was small, and Yumi has been working as a model but suddenly shows interest in photography. Instead of a typical to a visual novel cast of heroines, this game rather follows a story told from both of their perspectives. Even though the title suggests that it isn’t about love, it tells a drama of adolescence describing a type of 'love' which is not quite romantic but close.

title: Tribefort
description: In this multiplayer survival and base-building game, you fight for survival on a vast island. Explore, mine, craft and gather resources to battle against other players for the strongest tribe.

title: It Comes in Waves
description: A minimalist, experimental open-world adventure about guilt and grief. Explore, shoot, scavenge and bring a specimen to The Sanctuary.

title: Snowball Christmas Festival
description: Snowball Christmas festival is a puzzle game, the ultimate goal of which is to swap the blocks to collect the image. But remember, the purpose of this game is to let you relax and enjoy the process. To do this, we added a minimalistic interface and relaxing music.

title: Horny Hotel Maids
description: Horny Hotel Maids is a puzzle game, the ultimate goal of which is to swap the blocks to collect the image. But remember, the purpose of this game is to let you relax and enjoy the process. To do this, we added a minimalistic interface and relaxing music.

title: Inize Warrior
description: The "Beat it, then break it" pixel art RPG featuring two storylines and a unique battle system with platforming elements.

title: GunFu Deadlands
description: GunFu Deadlands is a super hard retro styled indie game. You play a wild west guy, and have to kill all the bad guys on each of 10 levels.

title: Chibi Ninja Shino-kun: Treasure of Demon Tower
description: Inspired by Japanese ninja games from the 80s and 90s, Chibi Ninja Shino-kun: Treasure of Demon Tower is a fast and smooth retro platformer in which you climb a giant tower while dodging enemies, traps and other obstacles. Use your wall jump, hookshot and ceiling running abilities to make it past the various enemies and discover the legendary treasure of Demon Tower!

title: CubeRun 2
description: You are a cube. Fight with other enemy cubes in a procedurally generated map. Earn rewards and customize yourself and your surroundings in this action shooter with a top view

title: Hitstun
description: Hitstun is a turn based fighting game with online matchmaking. Challenge your friends to an exciting battle with diverse characters and movesets.

title: The Riddler
description: Think you're clever? Prove it with an enigmatic AI, the ultimate master of riddles beyond imagination.

title: Nightmares Before Disney
description: In a land where all your dreams come true, does the same apply to nightmares?

title: The Underside
description:
The Underside is an exploration based action platformer in the vein of games like Castlevania, Metroid, and Cave Story.

The game is seemingly not complete with the last major update occurring in 2009.

title: Skullpogo
description:
The hordes of Undead are invading!

Zombies, bloodthirsty bats, and... vampire PIGS? It's time to deal with these vile cretins using your secret weapon: a POGO stick!

description: ToHeart2: AnotherDays is a spin-off from ToHeart2, taking place sometime after the events of the original game, its main storyline allows the player to pursue seven heroines consisting of both supporting female characters from To Heart 2 and new characters. In addition, it also contains two additional scenarios that extend storylines from the original game.

title: Rocket Control
description: This game is an extremely simple 2D action game where you launch, control, and land rockets. The rules are simple: ascend to an altitude of 1000 meters, start the descent, and then land back at the original launchpad.

title: Project Liminal Redux
description: Project Liminal Redux is a first-person horror made in realistic 3D graphics. The gameplay consists of collecting notes, solving riddles and escaping from various entities. The main goal is to survive and escape.

title: New Super Abandoned: Discovery Island
description: New Super A:DI VI.0 DX: Director's Cut DELUXE: Five Nights at Treasure Island: Found 2021 Revision 3 feat. Dante from the Devil May Cry series Final Mix Redux with New Funky Mode - A Fragmentary Passage and Knuckles Remastered (otherwise simply known as New Super Abandoned: Discovery Island) is a semi-serious self-parodying April Fools' update to Abandoned: Discovery Island. Taking place in a separate continuity, the game features a mixture of improvements and additions, as well as joke additions and changes. This version is planned to receive updates as well as the DLC feature that were intended to be added to R1 and the original game, though it is not planned to entirely replace it at the moment nor will it be the game's last iteration.

title: The Penguin Game: Antarctic Savior
description: Collect air conditioners, save Antarctica! Only you can save penguins. Antarctic savior! This is an open world adventure game with various contents such as sports mini-games, FPS, boss battles, item farming, quests, platformers, and puzzles.

title: Ultimate Ball
description: Completely simulate the physical laws of the real world, by building different structures, let the ball as fast as possible to the end! Try as many solutions as you can, and see who can get to the finish line in less time than your friends!

title: Do You See Sparky?
description: Do You See Sparky? is a first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players with a social deduction elements. Collect clues, solve puzzles, cheat to catch a monster that you can't see, but your friends can.

title: Souseishi, Arui wa Doukoku no Mokushiroku: Incarnation Erased from History
description: Touhou-style independent shooting game featuring original characters and world.

title: The House of E.
description: The House of E. is a story-driven puzzle game with horror elements and a creepy atmosphere.

title: Dungeon Legend
description: This is a casual breakout game. The pace of the game is very tight. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible. .

title: Ballsvoid
description: Difficult game of skill and reflexes where you have to help the character to escape. Take your controller and prepare to die many times.

title: LEGO 2K Drive
description:
Welcome to Bricklandia, home of a massive open-world LEGO driving adventure. Race anywhere, play with anyone, build your dream rides, and defeat a cast of wild racing rivals for the coveted Sky Trophy!

In LEGO 2K Drive, your awesome transforming vehicle gives you the freedom to speed seamlessly across riveting racetracks, off-road terrain, and open waters. Explore the vast world of Bricklandia, show off your driving skills, and build vehicles brick-by-brick!

LEGO 2K Drive Awesome Edition includes:

# Aquadirt Racer Pack

# 550 Coins
# Awesome Bonus Pack: Includes Wheelie Stunt Driver Minifigure, Machio Beast Vehicle and a Vehicle Flair.

description:

title: Childhood Dreams: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces.

title: Dinosaurily
description: a queer dinosaur game about found family and affection !! with hugging and planting flowers and stickers

description: Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is a multiplayer sandbox adventure game. Create your own character, select classes, and take on quests to earn rewards and level up. description: Experience the best of both worlds with our monster taming game - relive the nostalgia of classic role-play games, while enjoying fresh and immersive gameplay. Capture and train unique monsters in stunning environments, and put your skills to the test in challenging 3v3 battles.

description: Although the heroes of Caer Cyflen managed to prevent the Soraks' attempt at reopening the Rift to unleash their foul god upon Solasta, the threat is far from over. Kingdom of Gallivan has suddenly declared war on their neighbours, and the Snow Alliance is calling for your help!

title: Kay's Destiny
description:
A retro style indie JRPG with pixel art graphics and a live piano soundtrack.
Created by youtuber "KayThePianist".

description: Shota Kare! is a visual novel game.

description: Wizardry: Prisoners of the Battles is a DLC scenario for The Five Ordeals in which the adventurers face relentless challenges in their attempt to aid the local royal guard.

description: Romantic Shooter is an erotic shmup game where you'll be able to destroy the girls clothes!

description: An educational game focused on reading and math for 5-6 year old children.

title: Adibou: Je lis, je calcule 6-7 ans

description: An educational game about human anatomy aimed at children ages 4-8.

title: Adibou Nature et Sciences
description: An educational game about Nature and Science targeted at children ages 4-8.

I believe that most people are struggling to achieve financial freedom and strive to become the boss of the richest party; When the penniless you come to a strange city, please use your wisdom, arrange your time reasonably, and strive to live

Now the world is run by literal clowns, and you must overthrow the overthrowee, and take back the honor of the king.

description: Slay enemies using clicks, spells and get stronger by leveling up in endless dungeons !

title: Infected
description: First Person Survival

title: Lucky Slots
description: Lucky Slot is a single player quick-play game that is fun for all the family - keeping Vegas-style slots in a fun and safe way for all.

title: Tasty Slot Machine
description:
You start with 1,000 coins - the aim of the game is to wager your coins to try and increase your coins as high as you can. Pick the number of pay lines and then how much the bet per line will be. Then cross your fingers and press spin.
If you win on a spin, you can either Take Win or choose to Double of Nothing in a simple game of Red or Black. Keep playing until you run out of coins or want to Cash Out and register your rank in the Leaderboards!

title: Yello Adventures
description: Overcome challenging and dangerous platforms with a variety of different and challenging enemies and make sure you are prepared for the boss at the end of the level where you will show your experience and expertise! Spend the money you get from enemies in the in-game store, upgrade your weapon and become more effective in your fight against your enemies!
