description: Ashes of the Phoenix is a survivor style, Roguelite ARPG experience set in a dark high fantasy world. The story follows Nix, a mysterious heroine (or is she?), as she battles her way through hordes of enemies to uncover the mystery that is the world around her.

title: PhaigeX: Hyperspace Survivors
description: PhaigeX is a fast-paced "survivor-style" space shooter that tasks the player to contain a growing incursion of rogue AI-controlled units. Pilot a variety of ships, use a myriad of upgrades and lay down heavy firepower against the growing menace.

title: Jump Jump Cyberpunk
description: A strategy game where driving a ball you will have to overcome countless obstacles to reach the exit and move to the next level. You will find led levels full of jumps, free falls, spins,teleports, obstacles and music that will immerse you in the game. A perfect combination to enjoy, are you ready?

title: Darksy's Adventure
description: Darksy's Adventure is a 3D platformer with furry characters and abstract 3D worlds. Tail whip and pounce your way to victory!

title: Core-Blast
description: Find core of the same type that are close to each other and click on them to blast.

title: Raptor Rush
description: The game features a dynamic day and night system that adds a new level of challenge and excitement to the game. You'll be able to see the stunning visuals change as you progress through each level, keeping you engaged and immersed in the game.

title: FNAF in Psych Engine
description: FNAF 1, but remade in Friday Night Funkin' Psych Engine LUA

title: Abandoned: Discovery Island - Jeff The Killer
description: Abandoned: Discovery Island - Jeff The Killer is a Minigame version of Abandoned: Discovery Island, created by Photo Negative Mickey. Minigame later ported to Abandoned: Discovery Island in the next update.

title: Combat Mission: Battle for Normandy - Commonwealth Forces
description: CMBN Commonwealth Forces Module is an add-on Module for Combat Mission Battle for Normandy that brings British, Canadian, and Polish Allied forces to fight in France.

title: Combat Mission: Battle for Normandy - Market Garden
description: CMBN Market Garden Module is an add-on Module for Combat Mission Battle for Normandy that portrays the famous battles for the bridges over the Rhine.

title: Choo Choo Survivor
description: Drive your train and get to safety while shooting down endless hordes of zombies that are blocking your way. Upgrade your weapons and abilities and become absurdly powerful!

title: Wars Across the World: Zulu 1879
description: Zulu 1879 recreates the British military campaign leading up to the destruction of the belligerent Zulu kingdom in South Africa in 1879. The British and their allies must quickly seize the enemy capital Ulundi or capture the Zulu king.

title: Hentai Ariel
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Tofu'Drift
description:
In this challenging arcade driving game, you have to collect all the red cubes with your car. Sounds easy enough, right? But you only have 10 seconds to complete each level.
Can you manage all 15 levels?

title: RedCat: De Europese Stedentocht
description: RedCat searches Europe for pieces of a crashed UFO.

title: RedCat: De Reusachtige Letterraket
description: A game to expand vocabulary in a playful way.

title: Battery Check
description:
Battery Check is an action game with strategic elements. So it comes down to dexterity, but you will have to think regularly. It's all about batteries and the mechanisms they power. When those batteries are empty, everything comes to a standstill, and you can't get any further. So you have to make sure you keep things running...

Battery Check was given away for free by Stibat when returning 15 empty batteries between May 9 and June 20, 1998. The goal was to give away 50,000 units, but due to its popularity, it ended up being 220,000.

title: A Case for Cap & Co
description:
Karen Lucre is in a fix! Zak, her little dog has been kidnapped!

The kidnappers are asking for a huge ransom. Zak is in a great danger. Time is running out and Karen's parents are on holiday... it's obviously A Case for Cap and Co! Together with Cap, Billy, Karen and Toby you must comb the town of Roseborough for clues. Who are the kidnappers? Where is poor Zak being held? Can you help free him in time?

title: Een Wonderlijk Avontuur met Pardoes de Tovernar
description: A Wonderful Adventure with Pardoes the Tovernar is a computer game on CD-ROM in which Pardoes has to defeat Pantagor through a journey through the Efteling. It was published in 2000 by ReDi Entertainment B.V.

title: Spelen met Bassie & Adriaan Deel 1
description: Playing with Bassie & Adriaan Part 1 contains the Crooks game, karaoke, a memory game and (digital) coloring pages.

title: Spelen met Bassie & Adriaan Deel 2
description: Playing with Bassie & Adriaan Part 2 contains (digital) jigsaw puzzles, a music game, a memory game and an exciting catch game.

title: We Want You
description: We Want You is a procedural war platformer with a satirical flavor. Try and fight your way through enemy territory back to your allied camp.

title: Being Struck By Lightning is Probably the Best Way That You Could Die On Account of All of Its Awesomeness
description: The game is tricky, with tough jumps to make and numerous dangerous spike pits.

title: Takishawa is Dead
description:
A dangerous criminal called Takishawa is on the loose, and a reward has
been offered for his capture. In an odd world full of characters who have
televisions for heads, you set out to find Takishawa, dodging traps and navigating difficult platforming sections along the way.

title: Voice of Cards Trilogy
description:
Voice of Cards is a quirky series of RPGs where the whole world is depicted through the medium of cards.

The Voice of Cards Trilogy bundles together all three titles from the series; Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars, Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden and Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden.

title: Night of Spirits
description: Night of Spirits is an individual or online horror game for up to 4 players, where the main objective is to hunt down the ghosts that haunt the city.

title: T.D.Z. 3: Dark Way of Stalker
description: Atmospheric Stalker adventure in the post-Apocalypse world!

title: Dream Ploy Will
description: This is a 1V1 game, including round system, war chess, and strategy play. You can freely match your deck, command heroes, summon monsters, and release spells! Compete with game friends or strangers!

title: PowerShift
description: Speed across the shadownet desert at speed in the minimalist, 2.5D retro racer POWERSHIFT

title: Trash Horror Collection 3
description: We bring you 10 short horror/comedy games in this collection. Inspired by the "Tales From the Crypt" series and cult horror movies from the 80's/90's.

title: ForbiddenWord
description: Let the other person say the forbidden word! A psychological chat game that takes care of your own forbidden word and draws out the other player's forbidden words!

title: Armed Air Forces
description: Armed Air Forces offers all-embracing combat flight simulation experience on mobile devices. Finally you can play PC quality combat game anywhere and anytime you wish.

title: DevilutionX
description: DevilutionX is a port of Diablo and Diablo: Hellfire that strives to make it simple to run the game while providing engine improvements, bugfixes, and some optional quality of life features.

title: Queens
description: Queens is a very short but difficult platformer about a ruthless king who throws his many wives into a dangerous gauntlet whenever he tires of them. You lead each queen through the obstacles in the run and try to stay alive.

title: Din
description: Din puts you in the shoes of Billy, a popular guy who everybody wants to talk to. Unfortunately, everyone wants to talk to him at the same time and will get upset if he doesn’t respond appropriately.

title: FallOver
description: In Fallover! You control an elderly british gentleman, who has lost his stability and keeps falling over.

title: Dungeon
description:
Dungeon is a game made by Scott Cawthon in 2003.

The only image of the game shows the sprites of some enemies and objects, among which a zombie, a stone cross and a skeleton of what looks like a dragon or a dinosaur stand out.

title: Paul Moose in Space World
description: Meet amazing alien species and visit deadly planets as Paul Moose in Paul Moose In Space World.

title: Pathways
description: Pathways explores the idea of interactive storytelling through abstract decisions and literal pathways. The hero walks through the same town each day, taking different routes and encountering separate stories that, when all brought together, make up his life story.

title: Cobblemon
description: Cobblemon is an open-source Pokémon mod for Minecraft, with the goal of being the mod for everyone.

title: Alternate Watch
description: A Mandela Catalogue themed spot the difference horror game. Report Alternate Anomaly encounters until 6 AM in order to survive the night.

title: Dice Fantasy
description: Dice Fantasy is a turn-based RPG grid fantasy action game from the Shock Price Advanced Series.

title: SDS Star Divers
description: Action mech game developed by Cybelle.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Seaside Hill Zone
description:
Seaside Hill from Sonic Heroes comes to SRB2 as a single player map!
This map features multiple pathways, emblems, and custom enemies.

title: Dark Fiber
description: Adventure science-fiction game developed by SolidState, Inc and NEC Interchannel.

title: Aquamorphosis
description: It's a horror game that tells a story about a fisherman who loses his way into another world during fishing.

title: Beeknighted
description:
On a stormy evening a marauding troll absconds with a beehive while being pursued by hunters. While the hunter's plans go awry, the troll stumbles into their pitfall trap, dragging the unfortunate bee with him. Separated from the broken fragments of her hive and stranded during a storm, the bee must find temporary refuge in the caves below the Bugbear Antfort and escape to safety.

Meet friends and foes, discover treasures and traps, and traverse the dangerous caverns in this adventure inspired by Nintendo 64-era classics.

title: Jables's Adventure
description: Jables's Adventure is a casual platforming adventure game staring a young boy named Jables. One day an odd squid appears on his head an claims that Jables is the hero. The boy accepts his new title and sets out on an adventure filled with wild lumberjacks, burrowing cacti, and random facts about fruit.

title: UFO on Tape
description: The truth is out there! UFO on Tape puts you in the role of one lucky guy who has managed to spot a UFO. Fortunately, he’s got his trusty (and very shaky) camcorder on hand to film the evidence.

title: Deliver Us From Evil: Masquerade
description: Deliver Us From Evil: Masquerade is a short and sweet BL visual novel. Keldran and Ace are two centuries-long friends with benefits. What starts off as a fun haunted house trip soon turns sinister and If they cannot conquer their fears, they may find themselves wandering the halls forever.

title: Man Enough
description:
Why play one game when you can play four games at once? In Man Enough,
there are four completely different games all running at the same time and
you must use the arrow keys and the space bar to beat each simultaneously.

title: They Need To Be Fed
description: Run and jump through 11 crazy worlds to feed the monsters in this 360° gravity platformer. It doesn't matter which way you go; up or down, left or right, you can't fall off because of the 360° gravity!

title: Resident Evil 4: The Mercenaries
description: The Mercenaries is a long-running Resident Evil challenge mode that sees players attempt to defeat as many enemies as they can before the timer runs out - or you die. In the original Resident Evil 4, Mercenaries mode was unlocked upon completing the main game. This time, it will be a free DLC content post-launch.

title: Girlfriend vs. Boyfriend
description: In Girlfriend vs. Boyfriend, you play a guy who is in serious trouble with his girlfriend for eyeballing another woman. She proceeds to chase you, throwing all sorts of objects your way, including fruit, animals, and tables.

title: Go! Underground
description: Go! Underground (or Journey to the Center of the Earth) takes a player into the depths of the Earth to explore subterranean environments and collect relics. A treasure map gives hints as to the location of each relic, and your task is to unlock a variety of paths and find all 40.

title: Dungeons of Fayte
description: Dungeons of Fayte is a dungeon crawler for one to four players with enough content to keep either a single player or a group of friends going for a good while. The Bone Lord, ruler of the Underworld, is planning an attack and the heroes need to train in various dungeons before taking the Bone Lord and his cronies on.

title: And Everything Started To Fall
description: And Everything Started To Fall is a simple platformer about life and death. The protagonist starts at the bottom as a child and slowly works his way up to the top, passing through each stage of his life along the way.

title: Illuminator
description: Armed with just a flashlight, a boy sets out to save his sister from a band of nasty ghouls who have the ability to tear through the fabric of space and who travel from house to house in the dead of night.

title: Classic Night
description: The moon wants to be as bright as the sun, so it hires a skeleton called Harigol to help fulfil this dream. Classic Night is a strategy game with construction elements that follows Harigol as he goes about his assignment.

title: Your Final Days
description: A NES-Like action game where a small robot, Orb, has to venture through four locations to get stronger and fight the corruption, on a strict time limit, while paying extra attention to resource management.

title: The House of Evil Grandmother
description:
You find yourself waking up in a room. You have been locked up in an old, decrepit house by Crazy Grandmother, a crazy old woman who hunts her prey with a bloodied baseball bat.
Explore and find items and tools to open the various locks Crazy Grandmother keeps on her front door, all while outrunning her pursuit.

In Your mission to unlock the front door, you must find hammer, that is also a weapon that can knock Crazy Grandmother out for a 15 seconds, battery and main door key.

Will You be able to escape this prison or will You succumb to her unending chase and face Your doom in the walls of the house?

title: Evilmun Online
description: Evilmun Online - a separate part of your favorite online game mode for all platforms.

title: Mega Man 2: Atari De-Make
description: A fan remake of Mega Man 2 with less detailed graphics, new level design, and a save system.

title: Trail Hogs
description: The Trail Hogs is a bicycle jousting platform adventure game where you play as a cyclist with bumpers in a fight to reclaim your bicycle kingdom, Hog Haven. You cannot die in this game and it has some unique features. Difficulty is moderate to hard.

title: Eloriasha
description: Inspired by the classics, Eloriasha is a simple yet challenging action-platformer about a man who's trying to save the world.

title: Brageskålen
description: Travel to Veøya in the Viking Age and solve a dangerous mystery with cunning and song!

title: Hellgineers
description: Help the minions of the underworld across bubbling pools of lava with rickety bridges and non-regulated constructions. Will you go for the easiest route, or test your skills and aim for the coveted skulls? Return to completed challenges to perfect your builds!

title: Alpha Warrior
description: Alpha Warrior is a retro, space shooter where the player engages in flight combat with enemy terrestrials and arcade style bosses. Blast your way through 12 exciting levels while stacking power-ups to become the most feared pilot in the galaxy.

title: Adventures in Equica: Unicorn Training
description:
Master powerful magic, venture through dungeons, and explore the monster-filled forest of Equica! Clover is the unicorn apprentice of Grand Swirllock the Bearded. She needs to learn the 10 basic combat spells every mage must master to survive fights against the monsters of Equica.

Traverse deadly dungeons to unlock more spells and extend your life energy! Beat all the dungeon bosses to prove you’re tough enough to take on any dangerous quest!

title: The Reacher
description: The Reacher is a platform game with different aspects in it. Run, slide and swing for reaching the goal. It is designed for speed runs.

title: Field Clashers
description: Take your team to glory, using a keen strategy and tactical prowess to overcome your opponents!

title: NetMaze: A Funnyman Game
description:
netMaze allows you and up to 15 other players to explore different parts of Cyberspace together through the high-octane competitive Brawl mode or the creative Sandbox mode.

Take the maze by storm or build out your own virtual world using your very own Funnyman, a digital avatar that you can customize to your liking with different colors, weapons, and more!

title: The Soul of Dracula
description: The Soul of Dracula is a dark Japanese platformer heavily inspired by the classic Castlevania series. A vampire hunter journeys to the Dark Prince’s castle armed with a rather familiar whip, which he can use to cut down the skeletons, bats, and ghouls that cross his path.

title: Friendly Premonition
description: Friendly Premonition is a talking sim where you can meet every character from the original game and listen to them talk your ear off about a range of interests. Once they've run out of specific topics, they'll eagerly share whatever thought enters their head. A select number of characters even have special mechanics for you after you've talked to them enough, so make sure you check back.

title: Tux, of Math Command
description: “Tux, of Math Command” lets kids hone their arithmetic skills while they defend penguins from incoming comets, or offers them a chance to explore the asteroid belt with only their factoring abilities to bring them through safely!

title: Flood the Chamber
description: A prisoner has escaped from solitary confinement and is trying to escape from prison. As he runs off towards the exit, a guard shouts “Flood the chamber!” and water begins to rise, leaving the rogue in quite a predicament.

title: Dark Fate
description: Dark Fate is a fast paced single player level for Doom II, inspired by the style of the original Doom's third episode, "Inferno".

title: Teppoman
description: Teppoman is a simple run ‘n’ gun platformer that stars a naked hero. Terrorists have taken a number of your fellow nudists hostage and your job is to bust in, take the enemies out, and free your unclothed friends.

title: Tombed
description: If anyone can overcome the dangers hidden away in the tombs of TamaraKama and find the incredible treasures of legend, it must surely be brave explorer Danger Jane and her magnificent shovelling skills.

title: Day at the Races
description: The aim of this "light-hearted" horse racing game is to win enough money to purchase, maintain and enter your horse in the prestigious Day at the Races Cup, held on the 5th race of the final day. Good luck!

title: I Was in the War
description: I Was in the War is either a philosophical look at how war can escalate out of control or an action-packed—and rather distorted—arcade game that requires quick reactions and a steady hand. It all depends on your approach.

title: Perfect Detective Manual
description: Adventure point-and-click game. Production and planning made by Pleasuredome, Inc., and distribution was handled by Dynaware, Inc.

title: Kinnikuman Muscle Fight
description:
Muscle Fight is a free competitive fighting game released in 1999 by Matayan.
Based on the Yudetamago manga "Kinnikuman", created using Enterbrain's (formerly ASCII) software "2D Fighting Maker 95".

title: Spies Spies Spies
description: This is a pixel-style role-playing game with exploration and adventure. weapon upgrade, random state, random skill, random prop, armor upgrade, store, alien copy, spy, fog, civilian kill, escape, super magic outfit, roguelike, poisonous fog, trap, automatic aiming, infinite refresh.

title: Asteroids: Multiplayer
description: A modern version of the classic arcade game

title: Hai! Tetsuman-desu
description: In this Japanese game, you control Tetsuman, a nuclear powered humanoid robot designed to learn the Osaka dialect. As the robot learns, it absorbs your ethical values and this has consequences for good or evil.

title: Gas Station Simulator: Air Strip
description: Airstrip is a DLC for Gas Station Simulator. A story-driven dlc allowing you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.

title: Sakin II
description: Follow-up for the album Sakin (砂金), by Kazuyuki Sekiguchi.

title: Master Blaze
description: Role playing game, developed and published by Nihon Create.

title: The Linear RPG
description: The Linear RPG is a short "RPG" game that involves leveling up a character while reading a ridiculous RPG story.

title: Broken Spectre
description: Broken Spectre is a cosmic horror narrative adventure game developed in collaboration with the makers of The Blair Witch Project. A cryptic message left by her father takes Casey back to the abandoned trails of Coldblood Mountain, a remote wilderness that has haunted her family for generations. In addition to its unique, macabre visual style, Broken Spectre takes advantage of the Meta Quest 2’s immersive hand-tracking controls to bring unparalleled realism to the game’s gruesome body horror elements.

title: Artist Life Simulator: Cakes and Guns
description: Adds 200+ new events, 14 Cakes, 9 Pistols, ~100 illustrations & other new content to the base game. Fully save compatible.

title: Graamaseva
description: Graamaseva is the first top-down view, horizontal scrolling run n' gun arcade game.

title: Wizard Shrimp
description: Wizard Shrimp is a bullet-hell roguelike game where you play as a Shrimp who inexplicably is also a Wizard?! Battle your way out of three different areas whilst gaining many different upgrades and power ups to become the most powerful Shrimp this world has ever seen!

title: Space Slaughter
description: Test your skill while trying to unlock all ships by fighting on 6 unique maps full of different kind of enemies!

title: Gorufoo
description: A Golf-like sport for the new generation.

title: The Dream of Cocoon
description: This is a pixel art style open world survival adventure game. Player wake up in a strange dream world, start an unknown journey. Player need to acquire resources through foraging, hunting, mining, fighting,etc.,to build bases, to craft equipment, to cook foods, and to develop himeself/herself.

title: Cowboys & Rustlers
description: Tear-jerking story about a friendship between a man and a horse. Face life’s headwinds with the help of universal tools of communication - revolvers, lasso, emotional intelligence and dynamite. Search for the sense of spittoons (and life) on the prairies where mean words ricochet as hard as bullets.

title: Silicon Scream
description: First person point-and-click adventure game, developed by Off World Communications and published by JVC Advanced Media.

title: Ibis AM
description: All I want you to do is catch fish and search for others who seem hungry. You are only a bird.

title: Indiepocalypse #2
description: Issue #2 of a monthly indie game anthology collecting games from 10 developers.

title: Looming
description: Looming follows an unnamed protagonist as he explores the plains of a mysterious world, finds clues, and uncovers a variety of beautiful intertwining stories.

title: Pokémon Vanguard
description: Enter Ayrei, A region split into four separate quadrants, each blooming with life.

title: Lemmings & Oh No! More Lemmings
description:
This Windows port contains two complete games from DMA Design's classic 'Lemmings' puzzle series, which are all mind-boggling games of multiple skill levels, featuring fantastically animated graphics and simple yet addictive gameplay.

These Lemmings are the wackiest collection of misdirected rodents ever seen on your screen! They simply walk blindly through the world in the hope of safely reaching their home at the end of each level - unfortunately these levels include steep drops, gaps in the ground, barriers, rivers, and many other hazards.

Your task is to rescue the Lemmings across 114 levels of fast-paced puzzling.
You are not in direct control of any individual Lemming, but of a cross-hair, which can be moved over any of the Lemmings. Along the bottom are a selection of roles which can be assigned to an individual Lemming, including climbing, floating and bashing. You must click to select the appropriate function, then click on the Lemming to activate it. Each level has a different range of skills on offer, a different amount of Lemmings, and a different percentage target of Lemmings to be rescued in order to progress.

'Oh No! More Lemmings' is the follow-up to Lemmings. The game features 100 new levels, and all-new graphics and music. This port features a slightly increased quality in graphics. The UI is also larger and features more detailed information. The music is also replaced with original scores of royalty-free music in much higher quality. The intro is absent.

title: Cannelé & Nomnom: Defective Agency
description: Cannelé & Nomnom: Defective Agency is a fantasy comedy interactive fiction game. Players follow an amnesic individual who hires a duo of disastrous detectives in order to investigate three mysteries.

title: Sonic Storm
description: Sonic Storm is a Sonic fan game that takes place after Sonic CD. This game takes inspiration from Y2K and street culture, from its stylised shading and user interface to its heavy focus on grinding and maintaining combos.

title: Dangerous Dave Champion's Edition
description:
The entire Dangerous Dave collection is here! From the 1988 original to the 1990 PC classic to the final 2021 remaster, all nine of Dave's adventures are here in this Champion's Edition! Here is the treasure locked within:

1988 Dangerous Dave in the Deserted Pirate's Hideout
1990 Dangerous Dave in the Deserted Pirate's Hideout
1991 Dangerous Dave in the Haunted Mansion
1991 Double Dangerous Dave
1992 Dangerous Dave Returns
1993 Dangerous Dave's Risky Rescue
1993 Dave Goes Nutz!
1995 Dangerous Dave Goes Nutz!
2021 Dangerous Dave Remaster
Pirate's Treasure Map Hint Guide for Dangerous Dave in the Deserted Pirate's Hideout
Contains BOTH Windows and MacOS versions

title: Little Friends: Puppy Island
description: Get ready for a pawsome puppy adventure in Little Friends: Puppy Island! Discover exciting locations, dig up hidden treasures, build and expand your holiday resort, and meet plenty of lovable little friends to care for on your very own un-paw-gettable, tropical island adventure!

title: The Thrill of Combat
description: The Thrill of Combat is quite possibly one of the most disorientating experiences you’ll ever have, even though the concept sounds simple (if a little bizarre): fly your helicopter into enemy territory, kill the soldiers, cut out their vital organs—and repeat.

title: Park Beyond: Day-1 Admission Ticket Edition
Rocketbirds: Revolution!
description: Rocketbirds: Revolultion! is a 2D cinematic action-adventure puzzler game made in flash, developed by Ratloop Asia. It features rich visuals and classic 2D gameplay. Players take control of Hardboiled Chicken in a world filled with angry and often violent birds.

title: Hilm
description: Hilm is a classic 3D runner with a 3rd person view.

title: Little Crab Fisher
description: An idle-clicker crab fishing game based in a fantasy world. Collect mythical crabs, travel the high seas, and upgrade your ship. A fun-filled adventure awaits!

title: Can't Live Without Electricity
description: Can't Live Without Electricity is a 3D relaxing puzzle game in which you supply electricity by connecting houses to power plants.

title: Odyssée Numérique
description: Odyssée numérique is an educational game that will allow you to mobilize and develop skills associated with digital competence. To progress in the game, you will have to research, evaluate the reliability or credibility of the information and publish it in the vast digital world!

title: Where Is My Cat
description: "Where is My Cat" is a horror shooter game where you play as a janitor in an abandoned medical school and spend your days looking for your missing cat.

title: Project: EagleBeak
description: Project:EagleBeak is a mix of multiple modes of science fiction adventure game.You will play as a prisoner called ANN,imprisoned in an alien laboratory,find a way out of this matrix like laboratory.

title: Tower of Traceability
description: You control a magic tower floating in the sky, falling from the sky against enemies coming from all sides, choosing the right weapon mix for different enemies, using health and mana in a planned way, reducing their wear and gain more rewards.

title: Squad Game
description: Squad Game is a unique game that combines side-scrolling adventure with quarter-view turn-based strategic battles.

title: Karpov
description: "Karpov" is a visual horror novel shrouded in mysticism.Do you see THEM? Sneaking around in the shadows. Hiding their motives. You are far from the first to confront them. Are you sure you're strong enough? How presumptuous. Take your time. One false step and you won't be able to go back.

title: Finger Is 300 Bugs
description: "Finger is 300 bugs" is a wave game where you have to destroy bloodthirsty insects attacking your breakfast. Use boxes, traps, and moves to protect your belongings and survive as long as possible.

title: I Love Finding Furbabies
description: Collect cute furry creatures in this engaging hidden object game.

title: Hollow Mission
description: A game that follows a soldier in his mission to find out what has happened to a lab out in the woods.

title: Magic Guardian
description: Magic Guardian is a non-classical tower-defense game challenging you to fight against the Evil forces to protect and save the Soaring Crystals. Why is it non-classical? Because it all happens in VR and YOU are the only defender!

title: March, March! European Warfare
description: A minimalistic, turn-based wargame without randomness that puts emphasis on outmanouvering and striking the enemy with diverse unit types. Fight in the field, besiege forts or hunt down enemy king in local or streamed PvP. Illustrated with digitized, centuries-old copperplates.

title: Blondes
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Ascendant's Roguelike
description: A fantasy based roguelike. Ascend and slay endless hordes or monster while gaining the abilities of each creature you slay.

title: Blind and Schizophrenic
description: Fornicate with hookers, smoke weed, or just sit at home collecting welfare, how will you spend your life as a blind old man with schizophrenia? Can you survive even one day as this poor, decrepit wretch? Or will you show the world that it should pay attention to irate old farts with nothing to lose?

title: Chaos Coming
description: "Chaos is Coming" is a personal independent development of the Cthulhu Mythos-style card roguelike game. In the game, the player will face various mysterious and crazy creatures and events, collect powerful relics to drive away monsters, and escape the domain before their mind is corrupted.

title: DobbyxEscape: Pirate Adventure
description: Follow Tommy on the adventure of a lifetime where he meets the legendary pirate Blackbeard!

title: Fateful Mages
description: Relaxing 2d puzzle game where you unlock characters and stories through solving puzzles and decide their fate in a magical but unforgiving world.

title: Fight For Your Resurrection
description: Fight For Your Resurrection is a fighting game with dynamic A.I., Anaglyph support, gamepad support. When You loose a match the difficult level decrease! When You win consecutively two matches the difficult level increase! I dare You to finish the game never losing a match!

title: Rogue-Fp
description: A blend of old school gameplay and new school controls. Experience a classically styled roguelike in a way you never have before! In first person!

title: Robot Lawn Mower
description: Step into the exciting world of robotics with this satisfying robot grass cutting game

title: Mr Rabbit's Cambridge: Point and Click Adventure
description: Discover an imagery Cambridge in this dynamic point and click adventure game. Find Mr Rabbit before The SS P320 leaves!

title: 3D Miner
description: A casual strategy mining game The game is designed with 30% luck + 40% aiming power + 30% decision (product mix) to determine whether you can finish the game In the mine with limited resources, with props, to maximize the benefits.

title: Fishing and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Stack Masters
description: Stack irregular shaped blocks to create towers and reach the 'Goal Zone'. Unlock new levels, compete on the leaderboards, create your own levels and share them via the Steam Workshop.

title: Ghosts over the Water: Changing the Tides of Japan's Future

There is but one quest in Dust. Stay alive.

title: WeAreDreaming
description: WeAreDreaming is a Chinese Yume NIkki fangame. You play as Zakurotsuki (附石榴), who refuses to leave her room. Exploring the dream world can also unlock wallpapers, music and menu skins.

title: SIght
description: SIght is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a cyclops named Nakime and the goal of the game is to obtain the five Items (アイテム) scattered throughout each world to unlock one of two endings.

title: Illove dream
description: Illove dream (爱梦症) is a Chinese Yume Nikki fangame. You explore Aiko's dreams, who refuses to leave her room.

title: Conexus
description:
Conexus is a short Yume Nikki fangame that follows a young adventurer who mysteriously awakes in a realm of interconnected worlds named the Conexus.

Uncover the reason why you were brought to the Conexus, and learn about the realm's history along the way. Or if you don't feel like performing story errands, just treat it like a digital museum instead.

This game features 17 unique areas to explore, with lots of weird things to see and people to meet everywhere you go.

Unlike the typical Yume Nikki fangame, there aren't any "effects" to find here, instead all of the focus is placed on touring a fully open realm where every path leads to somewhere else.

title: Sharkphobia
description: Sharkphobia is a short underwater found footage survival stealth horror focused on galeophobia, thalassophobia & claustrophobic environments.

title: Cell of Empireo: Isoi Sanemitsu no Records
The Judgement Chamber
description:
You will be shown a self-proclaimed victim, and the person whom they claim is the wrongdoer.

You will listen to their conversation, and from a neutral standpoint, you will determine whether the victim should take their revenge against the wrongdoer.

But do exercise caution.

After all, revenge here means that "the wrongdoer will be sentenced to death at the victim's hands".

title: The Legend of Zelda XD2: Mercuris' Chess
description:
The Legend of Zelda XD2: Mercuris Chess is the sequel of the first XD parodic game, and was also released on April 1st, in 2017 this time. As a direct sequel, the overworld is expanded, the story is extended and the funny tone is kept, if not bettered!

The game was made in 10 weeks (!), beginning with an a discussion about how people always mispronounce Mercuris Chest (note the T at the end). Diarandor suggested that a game could be named Mercuris Chess to make fun of the title, and the same day it was decided that it would be the next big April’s fools joke.

The team worked really hard, and you can feel the improvements from the previous games. The game has 2 dungeons, and lots of side-quests and secrets everywhere, and also feature silly NPCs around the overworld. Be sure to speak to every one to not miss a joke!

title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Dream
description:
The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Dream is a fanmade remake of the Game Boy cult classic The Legend of Zelda: Link’s Awakening, first published in 1993 and enhanced with colors in 1998 with its DX version.

The Solarus-made remake uses A Link to the Past graphics, extended with lots of custom sprites and tiles, in order to represent all the game’s characters, enemies and landscapes. Even the music has been remade in SNES-like fashion, to get the perfect feeling as if the game was released on Super Nintendo.

title: Kingsvein
description: Explore and reclaim the infested castle-city of Kingsvein! Ride into its depths on your trusty wyvern, and lead your customizable party of Knights and Mystics in deep tactical combat.

title: Not Only Nine
description: A narrative turn-based RPG where the only fights are the bosses. Play as a cat and journey through the afterlife to save your human. Meet loveable characters and explore what it means to exist.

title: Moon is Not the Limit
description: Reach into orbit with Moon is not the Limit! Take to the stars as a recent recruit to the space program and learn all about the science behind space travel.

title: Day of the dead
description: A multiplayer low-poly styled zombieshooter game

title: Mike and the Zombies
description: The gas runned out and you're in the middle of nowhere! Now it's time to kick, shoot, fire and rip apart zombies and monsters in this 80's thriller platform game.

title: Simple Multipliers
description: Unique idle game with endless gameplay mechanics. Hardcore goals but fair possibilities to reach them. Create the most powerful income generator and be the best among all players!

title: The Green Room Experiment: Episode 1 VR
description: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. This game is designed on an escape game structure, you must solve a puzzle to move on to the next table. You will be transported to a dreamlike, strange universe, mixing exploration, mystery and poetry.

title: RushLane
description: Welcome to RushLane, an adrenaline-pumping, high-speed racing game set on the scenic forest roads! Take control of your car and navigate through the twists and turns while avoiding oncoming traffic and collecting points to unlock new vehicles.

title: Bold
description: Bold is a unique, quiet and elegant third person exploration game, as well as a Zen game for traveling, walking, watching picturesque landscapes. The protagonist of the game, deer (bold), finds deer herds and obtains inner peace by crossing grasslands, deep forests, wilderness, rivers, and lakes.

title: MyPopgoes
description:
Popgoes is an official Five Nights at Freddy's spinoff series, produced by Scott Cawthon and developed by fans as part of the "Fazbear Fanverse Initiative".

MyPopgoes is a short and simple resource management minigame, where you take care of an extremely needy weasel named Popgoes. Housed in an adorable plastic LCD toy, your new pixelated best friend will need pizza, fizzy drinks, and only the best entertainment provided by Freddy Fazbear himself. And if Popgoes doesn't receive what he desperately needs, he passes out. Or maybe he straight up dies. Up to your imagination.

title: Until Daybreak
description: Léon and his twin sister Anna have always been together, but five years after the deaths of their parents, a deadly illness contracted by Anna threatens to separate them. Determined to fight this fate, Léon is prepared to do anything to stop the same Angel of Death that claimed his parents from taking his sister away from him.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Candyland
description: We found an abandoned shed and turned it into the most delicious roller coaster ever! This DLC includes: - Roller coaster map: Candyland. - One roller coaster cart - 1 weapon. - 1 companion character.

title: Spellshot
description: Survive against hordes of zombies using bullets enchanted with spells purchased from a rerolling shop. Spellshot is a fast-paced, rogue-lite fps in which you create unique builds by combining and upgrading spells, activating set bonuses, and collecting rare items.

title: Ball Drop
description: Get the ball to the end zone safely. Without exploding!

title: Marins Dream Garden
description: Manage a garden by finding the seeds scattered throughout the dream islands.

title: Deltarune: Chapter Rewritten - Scampton The Great
description: Deltarune: Chapter Rewritten created by The Winterer is a roleswap AU with the spirit of a kid's cartoon, follow Asriel, Noelle and Charkis down the dreaded abyss of Kueen's dungeon and free this sad, strange little man.

title: Idol Showdown
description:
Idol Showdown is the definitive fan-made hololive fighting game experience, powered by rollback netcode. Engage in exciting duels as your favorite H=hololive talent and prove once and for all who the strongest idol is using the game’s easy-to-learn controls.

Pick up on this game’s easy-to-learn control scheme in no time to get straight into playing. Even hololive fans who are inexperienced with traditional fighting games can have fun!

Besto Games has been hard at work developing the game’s online rollback netcode to make the online experience as smooth as we can.

Explore the vast world of hololive from our roster of iconic hololive talents, with moves inspired by their most memorable moments and personality traits. Fight across the virtual world in lovingly recreated hololive locations. Jam out to remixes of your favorite hololive original songs while raising idol hell.

hololive talents are re-imagined as core fighting game archetypes with a unique twist. Bring chaos in the battlefield with flashy attacks and high-octane action.

title: Cricket 24
description: Cricket 24 is the culmination of a decade of Cricket video game development and includes teams from every corner of the globe.

title: Kits
description: Kits is an assembly game. Discover, construct and admire beautiful little works of art. Set your own complexity and challenge levels and enjoy KITS the way you like to play.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Characters - Kim Kaphwan
description: "Kim Kaphwan" can be used in THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV.

title: Mizz Survival
description: Mizz Survival is Survival game Style , Crafting Building Adventure with friend in the wide world or fight with orther team and meet the horrors at night. 2 GameMode ( 1. Survival , 2. Team Battle )

title: The King's Campaign
description: The King's Campaign is a hybrid of Grand Strategy and Real-Time Strategy gameplay set in Medieval Europe and North Africa, where you manage your cities, engage in diplomacy and direct your armies on the world map before plunging into battle and commanding your troops directly on the battlefield

title: Windy Meadow: A Roadwarden Tale
description: Windy Meadow - A Roadwarden Tale is an interactive slice-of-life visual novel about choosing your own path. Help three protagonists make the most important choices of their lives. Featuring a multitude of hand-crafted characters and a richly detailed village set in the Roadwarden story world.

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Omoide VR - Yotsuba
description:
The Quintessential Quintuplets: Omoide VR - Yotsuba is the second official VR adventure game based on the popular manga series!

Play as Futaro Uesugi and enjoy spending time with the fourth Nakano Quint, Yotsuba, in this VR adventure game.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II - Season 03
description:
Weapons hot vaqueros.
Alejandro and Valeria face off in Season 03

title: Chocotto Land Online
description: 2.5 Dimension Online MORPG from "cocone v corporation"

title: Skolios
description: Cora wakes up in the main hall of an abandoned train station. She has no memory of what happened before she woke up, and an ominous silence surrounds the area. It's foggy outside the windows, the doors are locked and something disastrous seems to overtake the building... There are others, lost and confused, like Cora. And there are also the shadows and deformed creatures lurking and crawling in the dark, waiting to draw them into the deep. Will she be able to find a way out?

title: On the Job
description: Sneak your way past guards and obstacles through as many levels as you can in this turn-based roguelite stealth game, getting top secret documents and super cool gadgets on the way!

title: Mystery Case Files: The Dalimar Legacy - Collector's Edition
description: It's the opportunity of several lifetimes when the intrepid Master Detective finds themselves in the body of their greatest rival!

title: Fireball Spam
description: A two-button, 1 shot, 1 kill fighting game! Taking all of the action of fireball wars in other fighting games and upping the stakes with instantaneous death! No d-pad. No EX-moves, No frills. Just jump, shoot and win!

title: Vico 3: Tale of the Seven Seas
description: Vico 3: Tale of the Seven Seas, is one of the most unique arcade games both graphically and mechanically. Featuring Real Time reflections and Gorgeous HD graphics!

title: Gravel Gang
description: Gravel Gang is a simple but challenging real-time strategy/tactic casual game. Make smart plans and show your strategic skills, fight and conquer the challenging maps to WIN! You will be richly rewarded for victories, you can buy epic heroes and show your skills with them.

title: Meet Your Maker: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the Scorched Necropolis Collection. Build and raid in post-apocalyptic style, or use ancient-Egyptian-inspired blocks, props, weapons, and Custodian Suits to create and infiltrate Outposts unlike any other in the wasteland.

title: Rogue Hex
description: Play your cards right to conquer the world in the Roguelite 4x. Explore mysterious lands, survive against the barbarian horde, and grow your stone age empire into the stars!

title: The Solitaire Conspiracy: The Atlantis Project
description:
The Atlantis Project is a noble force of aquatic avengers, hydrated heroes and lubricated legends. They fight for the seas, and all who treat the water with respect.

Players unlock this new crew via their own FMV campaign, hosted by Alanah Pearce. Via an intriguing story, players use their powerful Submerge skill, and take it into daily challenges, countdown and skirmish modes.

title: The Solitaire Conspiracy: Return of the Merry
Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
description: This version of Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams features an arranged soundtrack, a dedicated two-player Versus Mode and also a Training Mode allowing players to practice their techniques and combos on a non-hostile character.

title: Wade
description: A stroll along the shore of a wide river that flows into the underworld. As the player ventures deeper, the scenery starts to shift and they may encounter oddities or curiosities.

title: We Are Poems
description: A swim through the queerest region of deep space. Its inhabitants float and gravitate in bountiful joyous explosions of light, embracing the void as a place to thrive.

title: Nonno's Legend
description: A game about imagining places you’ve never seen. Nina's grandfather shows her that a globe has some magical properties—you can reshape the planet!

title: Battle Monsters
description: Battle Monsters is an early German RPG-Maker Pokémon clone by Pascal Cattarius.

title: 4 Seasons Runner
description: Avoid the obstacles by jumping over them and beat your own highscore.

title: Car Delivery Man
description: Immerse yourself in the era of the 90s, driving cars of those years. Become a driver who delivers cars to different countries.

title: Escape the Unknown: Awaken the Realm
description: Awaken the Realm is a fantasy RPG visual novel where you explore various dungeons to solve puzzles and fight enemies in a quest to uncover your identity and save the kingdom!

title: Crusader Kings III: Legacy of Persia
description: Legacy of Persia lets you relive the dramatic struggle for survival and empire in the lands between the Euphrates and the Indus. This Flavor Pack introduces new systems for Clan government rulers, and expands on the Islamic and Zoroastrian religions dominant in the region at the time.

title: The World of Pirates
description: Welcome in this simulation-action game of "The World of Pirates" where you take the role of a pirate battling to take over the sea.

title: Poly Jigsaw: Butterflies
description: Poly Jigsaw: Butterflies is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game, with a cute butterflies.

title: Cat Rescue
description: A desperate woman fights to rescue her cat from a paranoid streamer’s lair of twisted experiments, puzzles, and lurking horrors in this psychological thriller.

title: Fourteen Fiends
description: Fourteen Fiends is a single player fantasy action adventure card game!

title: Riddles And Sieges
description: Riddles & Sieges is a medieval puzzle game where you use old siege weapons to solve puzzles. Your goal is to destroy the castle and for that you are given sets of different buildings with their own quirks and timings.

title: Toon Tumble
description: "Toon Tumble" is a side-scrolling runner game with beautiful graphics. The game adopts a cartoon-style screen, and players need to jump continuously, pass through various organs and obstacles, and finally reach the end point.

title: Heroes of Loot: Gauntlet of Power
description: A randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Mow down thousands of dungeon dwelling creatures and survive as you descent deeper into the dungeon! Enhancing your Gauntlet of Power with new and upgraded weapons.

title: Hard to Make a Romantic Cartoon!
description: Yunjae possesses the body of a character in a romantic comic. Will he be able to go back to his original world? BL game 'hard to make a romantic cartoon!'

title: Text Twist 3
description: Complete dictionaries and thousands of levels for English, German, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Swedish, Spanish, Turkish, Dutch, and, French languages. You can use your touch screen or a mouse to play the game.

title: Zombie jokers 2
description: Zombie jokers 2 is an arcade game where you have to survive in different locations with zombie ! You can improve the speed of your character, as well as buy him a more powerful gun! Each time, the number of zombies increases. In the game you will have to shoot different zombies.

title: No Man's Sky: Interceptor
description: Venture to forsaken Sentinel worlds in update 4.2, INTERCEPTOR! Explore corrupted planets, fight a legion of challenging new robotic guardians, hijack their technology, steal their ships, harvest their resources, destroy their freighters, and much, much more!

title: Ascendant.com
description: Ascendant is a squad-based tactical FPS with serious balls. Each match is different, with game-changing events and adrenaline-fueled battles. Set in a dynamic BioPunk world where everything wants to kill you; fight to extract resources, and get out with more than just your dignity.

title: Bakken: Ski Jumping
description: Bakken: Ski Jumping is a winter sports simulation game. To go for gold you have to jump as high as possible, you have to fly as long as possible and you mustn't forget the telemark landing!

title: Strange Flesh
description:
Welcome to Strange Flesh: a sexy, gay, adult beat 'em up game from Greatest Bear Studios.

You play the role of The Bartender, a master of the hypnotic arts and a servant of the bar, Strange Flesh. In the game, you'll infiltrate the mind of Joe, one of the bar's many troubled patrons and help him out however you see fit. Pummel your enemies into submission, corrupt them with your hypnotic smoke, or recruit them to your side. The choice is yours.

Strange Flesh is pretty short, just about 30 minutes long, but features three endings, lavish animation, and a killer soundtrack. Strange Flesh won the Melbourne Queer Games Festival Gold Medal in 2018!

title: Rumbleverse: Season Two
description: Rumbleverse Season Two is live! The bridge is open, and the champions of Grapital City are battling it out at the all-new sunny sites of Low Key Key.

title: Lil' Guardsman
description: Imagine you're a 12 year old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

title: Chataclysm
description:
Legend has it that there is a treasure trove of great loot and riches. The fortune is said to lie at the very top of a perilous climb. However, all those that have tried have been pulled down by an evil monster. The monster known as........ chat
Welcome to the game where chat directly affects the player. And can only be WON with a chat alliance. Every chat message will try to stop your journey to the top.

title: Ninja Gaiden Sigma 2 Black
description: A mod that rebalances the difficulty in Ninja Gaiden Sigma 2 to something closer to the original 2008 version of Ninja Gaiden II

title: Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds - Deluxe Edition
description:
Includes:
- Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds
- Winds Treasure Box DLC: A collection of six previously-untold stories.
- OST: 20 tracks to immerse yourself in the battles fought and the emotions felt in Kyoto.
- Event Scene Collection: 17 pages of gorgeous event scenes.
- PC Wallpaper: Add some beauty to your screen with 4 wallpapers.
- Mobile Wallpaper: Protect your mobile device with any 12 of your favorite bachelors.
- Character Art Collection: 13 pages showing rough sketches and full-color artwork of the beautiful characters.

title: Primal Planet
description: Unveil a heartfelt story of family, dinosaurs, and UFOs! Craft, upgrade, and survive in a realm of primeval predators, savage tribes and... ancient aliens. Rise from a humble cave dweller to the planet’s last hope — alone or in local co-op. Welcome to the dinovania!

title: Kirby's Dream World
description:
Kirby's Dream World is a fan made virtual community where fans of the Kirby series can create their own character, hang out with friends, chat and discuss a verity of topics, and explore an open world in a MMORPG style. It is completely fan made, with original gameplay, areas to explore, and quests and activities to complete, and in no way reflects the games or gameplay found in Nintendo and Hal's Kirby series--this is a fan made community for fans of the series, and not a Kirby game.

In Kirby's Dream World you create your own character and enter the world of Dream World. Once you are in the game you will be able to meet fans from all over the world, and play with them. The idea of this virtual community sandbox is to make your dreams come true. By playing and being active, you will not only be able to play with other Kirby fans, but you will be able to affect the game its self and shape it into your own dreams.

title: The Farmer Was Replaced
description: Program and optimize a drone to automate a farm and watch it do the work for you. Collect resources to unlock better technology and become the most efficient farmer in the world. Improve your problem solving and coding skills.

title: Echo Point Nova
description: Satisfying first person combat meets classic adventure game. Featuring singleplayer and online co-op. By the creators of Severed Steel.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 4 - Space Opera
description:
Blossom onto the battlefield with our newest Support Hero Lifeweaver, progress through the Battle Pass to earn rewards including Mythic Galactic Emperor Sigma, and fight for your faction when The Watchers and The Infinite Empire clash in the Starwatch event!

Explore Talantis, the first-ever map made in collaboration with the community.

Enjoy major quality-of-life updates with a revamped Competitive experience.

title: Moon Minions
description: Moon Minions is a currently lost old Scott Cawthon game released in 2004. some information we know from old Daily Click reviews and articles, we know the game was about a RPG where you can take control of a moonman and his minions on a robot infested planet and must try and destroy a interstellar dark energy called the "Phantom Core".

title: Legacy of Flan
description: Legacy of Flan is the first game in the Legacy of Flan series and is one of Scott's very first games ever to be released. It's an RPG game centered around little slime creatures known as "Flan" which you can change the species of with flan flavors you find after beating monsters where you must stop whoever's giving your species such a horrible name.

title: Junkyard Apocalypse
description: Junkyard Apocalypse is a fire of action and online platforms made by Scott Cawthon in 2004.

title: The Legend of White Whale
description:
Legend of White Whale is a role-playing game that focuses on a group of three mushroom friends on a quest to find "The White Whale," the legendary ship that brought their ancestors into the world.

The village of Mushsnail is starting to dry up, and that would mean certain death for everyone who lives there. Frup-Foo (our hero) believes that if the mythical White Whale exists, he can keep the secret of a new beginning. But there is an evil afoot. Now that Mushsnail is starting to dry up, he has been left vulnerable to monsters that previously couldn't enter the magic barrier. With each passing day, the village becomes more at risk.

White Whale features turn-based rpg battles and an aerial world map. Each character has their own abilities, of course. Priss is the healer as well as the state spell caster. Frup is slower than the others, but has a powerful special attack and is the only character who can use items during battle. Chup is the fighter, and he can only ... well... fight!

The game progresses in chapters. Each chapter takes place in the same world, just with a different goal.

title: Chup's Quest
description: The sequel of the game The Legend of White Whale.

title: Bogart
description: Bogart is one of many games by Scott Cawthon. It was created in 2006 and is a action based game.

title: Evil of Demons: Algailah
description:
Evil of Demons: Algailah is a survival horror game, hiding and escaping, where the hero is kidnapped by a demon at noon the hero wakes up and finds himself somewhere underground, tries to get out of the predicament by finding keys and collecting the statues to open the exit door, you must have to hide from the devil and sneak away from him so that he can survive. Along the way there will be obstacles and places to hide.
While you try to escape from the demon home you will explore the fearsome cellar of the Demon
Reveal some facts.

title: Bogart 2: Return of Bogart
description: Bogart 2: Return of Bogart is a platform video game made by Scott Cawthon in 2006.

title: Parkour Annovation: Unreal Edition
description: Parkour Annovation is a game that shallenges you to traverse obstacles in a dynamic and realists environment using parkour skills such as running jumping climbing You san explore different locations from urban landscapes to natural settings, and face various challenges that rest your speed agility and creativity Parkour Annovation is a same that lets you experience the thrill and freedom of parkour in a virtual world

title: Software Tycoon: Der Spielemanager
description:
Software Tycoon puts you in the role of a game studio CEO. You start out in the 1980s, where you hire your first employees and develop your first games and research new technologies and genres to create even better games.
Besides a free-style mode without any goal, the game does feature various scenarios.

A spiritual successor to the game was released under the name of Mad Games Tycoon by two of the main developers of the original game: Stefan and Christian Pohl.

title: Slumberfish!
description: Slumberfish! is a Puzzle game where you need to find the right path to the finish line.

title: Days of the Divine
description:
Long ago, in a valley where a small village lay, two deities fought each other. One was imprisoned, the other vanished. Yet some time ago, an unnatural mist began lingering in the village, dissolving people's memories.

Biyu, a young shrine maiden, is now working her hardest in the shrine of one of these deities in the faint hope the mist will one day dissolve. Even though her good friend also lost his memory, not all hope is lost; she meets a stranger who seems to be recovering from his memory loss, and rather quickly as well...

- Description from the games original post on the Lemmasoft forums

title: Golden Galaxy
description:
Golden Galaxy is a game made by Scott Cawthon.
Released in 2013 for Android devices, Golden Galaxy features levels, enemies and characters from The Desolate Hope. The game can be downloaded for free on the Google Play store or App Store. The Windows version can also be purchased on Amazon.

title: Forever Quester
description: Forever Quester is your quest companion, playing the rpg that you just don't have the time to play while you're living your own life. When you turn your phone on and check the game, your hero will update you on what you've missed. Help him choose weapons, armors, mounts and professions, and check back often to see how he is progressing! Guide him as he seeks out the evil Xaxoor on a quest that could very well go on forever!

title: My Demonic Romance
description:
My Demonic Romance is a Visual Novel with a twist...
Sure you're playing a typically geeky guy with classes to attend, a job that sucks and a love life that's DOA.

But the difference is that when the cute, exciting and adventurous girl shows up, she's an actual demon, with horns, a pointed tail and a sex-drive to match!

As that guy you have to navigate your daily life while trying to keep your new demonic companion safe in a world that's completely new to her and not to mention handling the fact that she's not at all shy when it comes to her physical desires too!

You take on the role of Adam, a guy studying hard to get the grades he needs to succeed in life, working a part-time job to pay the bills, and all the time longing for some meaningful female companionship - who gets more than he bargained for when Lily, a succubus summoned from hell itself turns up in his life.

title: Fantasia: The Realm of Thanos
description:
"Please save Fantasia!" a woman asked you. She's in front of you, a lonely girl who does not have anyone, asking you to save an unknown world from an impending doom by obtaining a heart key from one of four "heart bearers"

The first one is a Demon Lord....
The second is a bloodthirsty assassin...
The third is a mysterious hooded guy...
And the fourth... has curse placed on him...

title: Kitty in the Crowd
description: Select from three difficulty settings then scan the crowd for nine kitties who could be hiding anywhere! Play again and the kitties will be in new hiding places! Fun for everyone!

title: New Super Mario Bros. Versus: Cubby's Character Mod
description: A mod of New Super Mario Bros. Versus that added a variety of new character options and stages.

title: Farm Slider
description:
Easy to play, challenging to finish and impossible to put down.

Hours and hours of puzzling fun for all ages. Challenge your ability to think ahead in our new, minimalistic puzzle game. The game contains lots of levels with pictures of farm towns and roads,
but: they’re out of place! Slide the tiles to match the example above to complete the level.

Some may seem impossible at first, but we promise: they CAN all be done!

48 brainteasing levels
No ads, no in-app purchases

title: Pokémon Bizarre
description: Pokémon Bizarre is a Spanish-language fangame created by developer MrGrossi, also author of District Dance Battle, Motor Casa Paco, Vaya Canicastañazos, Mauriçius Nativitatem, FDI, A Toda Pastilla and Louse on the Loose. You will give life to a character who has been forced to explore the quirky and amazing Pokemon region known as Quintueles. In the process you can train up to eight generations of Pokémon, visit eight different gyms, meet new stupid characters and embark on a multitude of missions that involve things such as going to a rave, fight malicious octopuses and chit-chat with the famous "Alien Fumeta".

title: New Heights
description: New Heights is a physics-based climbing and bouldering game.

title: Wynncraft
description: Wynncraft is fully-featured MMORPG Minecraft server.

title: Pokémon Sphynx
description:
Pokémon Sphynx is a Spanish-language fangame created by Angeleiro, also author of some Pokémon fangames like Vinyl: Mystery Solver or Sunny! Sunny! Fangame Parade.
You will incarnate Riley or Roy, the quiet protagonist(s), alongside the cheerful artist Hilda, the stupidest being alive Luka and the shy policeman Blu. This unusual group will enbark on a journey through Arkan to close the access to the dark world of Mirroria, meeting some wacky characters along their way.

title: The Return to Bloody Nights
description: Get ready for a spine-tingling lore focused experience with our new fnaf fan game, "Return to Bloody Nights." Inspired by FNaF Plus, the original 4 FNaF games, and the books by Scott Cawthon, this game takes its own unique twist on the timeline and crucial events of the Five Nights at Freddy's series. With a combination of old-style atmosphere and gameplay, along with new mechanics, our game brings the best elements of the official games to the table. It's a reborn version of our previous game, "Bloody Nights at Freddy's."

title: Wanna-Be a Dino Finder
description: Help Dr. Rock Hound dig for fossils and learn some fun facts about dinosaurs and prehistoric eras. You can also play dinosaur-themed mini-games with anthropomorphic animals Addie, Katie and Rufus. Part of edutainment series of games.

title: Lobby Loitering
description: Have you ever felt like, in a single step, the world around you changed, and you didn't notice until it was too late? Explore a collection of alternate realities in an attempt to get Marcel back to the reality he belongs in.

title: Roland Garros French Open 2002
description: Roland Garros French Open 2002 is a tennis game developed by Caparace. The player can choose between 10 different players to play in 4 tournaments that includes Roland Garros and the US Open.

title: Rune Coliseum
description: A deck-building roguelike game with unique semi-real-time combat system. Step into the shoes of an ancient gladiator and do your best to survive in the coliseum. Combine various skills and equipment, develop your own fighting style, and defeat all the enemies to become the next champion!

title: Devil's Dive
description: Devil's Dive is an action platformer rogue-lite. Dive deeper and deeper into the depths to regain your title as Lord of the Underworld... if you can defeat the usurpers! Death will see you spat out, returned to the surface. But you may Dive again, stronger!

title: Temporal Shore
description: A unique blend of roguelike deckbuilding and survival strategy, where you control your characters only with your cards. You not only play your actions, but also decide who to perform them. Can you break the time loop and lead your team to safety, or will you die trying?

title: Dino Dash Party
description: Dino Dash Party is a fast paced 4 player casual couch co-op/party game where you throw bombs, collect food and try to stay alive. Work together or compete against each other in a variety of minigames, add modifiers to change your game or try out our crazy wacky stages in our challenge mode

title: Hitman Party
description: Get ready to join the ultimate hitman party - a fast-paced and hilarious local multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Can you blend in with the crowd, outsmart your friends, and be the first to hunt down the target? Experience the thrill of multiple game modes with your friends!

title: Sentinels of Earth-Prime
description: Control a new team of heroes battling evil villains across dynamic environments. Play out epic comic book battles come to life in this exciting adaptation of the hit card game.

title: Project Apidom
description: Project Apidom combines MOBA and RPG gameplay in a post-apocalyptic world. Build your character, scavenge, and fight in arena battles to become an unstoppable force while breaking the norms of usual MOBA games.

title: Dynablaster
description: Having been a blockbuster, Dynablaster is a game for the strategic thinker whose smart tactics will instill fear in his competitors – playing online or local against others or against the computer. In this captivating action game, destroy your enemies with cleverly placed bombs.

title: Christmas Squirt!
description: Christmas Squirt! - is an awesome, animated, relaxing game where sexy elf girls help you have an unforgettable Christmas night. See if you can bring the lusty girls to squirt!

title: Strip'Em III
description: Strip'Em III is the latest installment in the Strip'Em series, a unique blend of poker and sexual content graphics.

title: Gym Manager
description: Gym Manager is a simulation game where you can build, expand and manage your own gym. To attract more customers, invest in new equipment and sabotage your competition. But beware: the town's shady streets provide opportunities for illegal business ventures.

title: Cult of Personality
description: Cult of Personality is an upcoming Social Deception Game that bends the rules of what players can see, do, and hear... In life, and death!

title: Grim Tides
description: A traditional RPG adventure, set in a detailed fantasy world with abundance of writen lore. Inspired by the classics of the genre, it tries to evoke both the simplicity and complexity associated with early RPG games, and can be played in short bursts of just a few minutes, or for hours at a time.

title: Techbrawlogy: Into the RoboDome
description: Techbrawlogy: Into the RoboDome is a multiplayer split-screen beat 'em up with cartoon-styled characters. Players can cooperate with their team to fight robots, charging up their super meters to perform powerful attacks while doing so.

title: Zombie Exterminator
description: Zombie exterminator is a top-down shooter roguelite where you play a soldier wielding up to 4 weapons which consist of 3 different parts stock body and core. Fight against zombies and horrendous creatures. Choose different upgrades, weapons, parts and relics. Create unique builds and weapons.

title: Cease To Breathe
description: Cease to Breathe is retro-inspired adventure heavily influenced by the Commodore Amiga games of the late 1980's / early 90's.

title: Melon Knight
description: Tiny little adventure with roguelike elements, where your next step decides everything. Fight your way through a dungeon full of monsters, bats and bugs. Find a magic book and save the Kingdom of Lei! (or destroy it). Retro style!

title: Dog's World
description: A surreal, menu driven, pseudo-immersive sim without rhyme or reason - What's the point? What am I supposed to be doing? Is it supposed to look like this? The answer to all these questions is yes.

title: Umbratica Tactics
description: Lead a squad of vampire slayers, craft a powerful deck and combine the effects of ancient relics in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Fight your way through the hordes of the undead and the unholy as you attempt to purge the evil that has taken over the once glorious land of Umbratica.

title: Chrono Rift
description: Join the Breach Hunter Guild in Chrono Rift, a multiplayer online coop game of fantasy, action and roguelike elements. Defend the world from monster invasions caused by mysterious breaches and uncover the truth behind the phenomenon. Play now!

title: Bellwright
description: Establish and expand your own settlements, liberate the land and assist its villagers, and recruit others to your cause while learning more about a life you had to leave behind. Command your forces, prove your valor through combat, and cement yourself as the hero of your people.

title: Demon Tormentor
description: Perform ancient rituals with your magical dagger and shoot your way through the darkest places of this VR fantasy horror. Avoid dangers as you look for mysteries and artefacts. Don't let demons stand in the path of your investigation!

title: Demonic Supremacy
description: Demonic Supremacy is an old school 3D shooter with a certain nostalgic flavour and few gamer-friendly features. It offers several hours of hurricane gameplay rocking through memorable levels with the explosive heavy metal soundtrack!

title: Beach Cafe II: The Escape Room
description: Grandfather is still missing, after visiting the beach cafe, and delving into his memories, it's time for the next place. Will you unravel the secrets surrounding his disappearance?

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Fever
description: Jigsaw Puzzle Fever is a single player game that is fun for all the family.

title: Molly Medusa: Queen of Spit
description:
Poor Molly! A sculptor’s apprentice cursed into a snake-haired Medusa – and so, every living thing she goes near instantly turns into a stone statue. Every living thing! Enemies and friends, bosses and shopkeepers, monsters and allies, even animals and small insects, they all turn to stone.

Molly’s quest takes her through a series of mystical temples, as she struggles with loneliness and alienation. Inside these temples gravity is “local”. Molly’s “down” is calculated from the surface she’s currently standing on, which means she can easily walk up walls, or upside down in the ceiling. This allows the level design to twist in on itself, and curl into labyrinths that are physically impossible. Petrified enemies accompany gravity puzzles and non-euclidean architecture, in M. C. Escher scavenger hunts.

title: Respark
description: A roguelite-platformer in which squirrels shoot fireworks in a cute world! Choose from about 30 different fireworks to face a mysterious course that changes with each challenge. You can even design and use your own original fireworks.

title: Lunarwardens
description: Lunar Wardens takes you to a world of creatures with elemental abilities. Capture strongest wardens, train and develop skills. Experience the beauty of the magical world as you battle against opponents in the arena. Make strategic moves and earn fame ,glory and become the best warden trainer!

title: Rainbowcore Hypernova
description: Unleash your inner fighter in Rainbowcore Hypernova, the explosively fun and free fighting game featuring vibrant characters, easy controls, and dynamic battles.

title: Exodus of Descent
description: Descend into an online third person PvE RPG dungeon looter inspired by RuneScape and Dark and Darker. Party up with your friends to solve escape-room type puzzles, collect over 150+ lootable items, level up your character, create unique classes and unlock new abilities. Escape Your Descent!

title: Auver
description: Suzanne Auver was a successful painter once, until her sister went missing. Blaming herself, she was persistent on finding her. But with frequent nightmares involving the disappearance of her sister, this wasn't an easy task.

title: I, the Forgotten One
description: To defeat the rebel knights and stabilize the crown, you must journey through the most dangerous realm in the kingdom--your own wretched past.

title: Attack From the Void
description: A top-down shooter set in a ship travelling to the solar system's edge. Make your way through the aliens attacking the ship, search for other crew members, and stay alive.

title: Cube de Grace
description: Cube de Grace is a mix of a classic RPG and CCG. In the game, instead of cards with different abilities, you define the actions of the characters by rolling dice. Each dice has various effects on its faces.

title: Eldrimar
description: Eldrimar is a blend of genres, Action/RPG and Survival horror. The game tells a grim story in a dark fantasy setting. Explore large, nonlinear locations, while eradicating the undead to progress through the fascinating storyline of the dark Kingdom of Eldrimar.

title: Pilfer: Story of Light
description: A 3D platforming journey featuring a cute raccoon that must save the forest from darkness! Master dozens of different level mechanics as you run and jump through course-based worlds, saving other animals along the way.

title: 1000 Rogues
description: You have played roguelikes before, but have you played 1000 at the same time? In 1000 Rogues, the retro RPG auto-battler you literally can! Step right in, plug in your vintage gaming systems and get ready to delve into the retro dungeon.

title: Ultimechs Spectator
description: View and stream Ultimechs matches with broadcast-quality tools so that your audience never has to miss a moment of the action! Built with streamers and esports fans in mind, Ultimechs Spectator lets PC owners keep an eye on the action in one of VR’s hottest competitive games.

title: Downtown Dealers
description: Blending city building with deck building, Downtown Dealers challenges you to build a deck worthy of the perfect city, although even in a perfect city you can be dealt a bad hand.

title: DarkSwarm
description:
DarkSwarm is a tactical co-op shooter where teams of elite operators battle against a deadly alien infestation deep within hostile, procedurally generated environments. Players can tackle the challenging campaign solo or with friends, combining strategic loadouts, powerful abilities, and teamwork to survive intense combat against the relentless DarkSwarm threat.

With dynamic missions, customizable loadouts, and a focus on cooperative tactics, DarkSwarm delivers thrilling PvE action that rewards communication, skill, and adaptability.

title: Number 217721
description: You'd been woken up by an entity which created you. It put you in a testing area and wants you to complete the puzzles and open the end gate. When you open the gate, the test is finished and you complete the task which the entity gave you.

title: I Commissioned Some Ladybugs
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many ladybugs and aphids as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 20 art pieces to choose from, and 2000+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Asuji: The Legend of You
description: You play as "You", a sperm who wants to become Human! Collect all the sperm cells, dodge the crazy sperms and maybe become long enough to inject yourself into the egg!

title: Hentai Ayumi
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Streetball the Mecca
description: A new take on streetball is here, combining streetball with street fighting. If you wanna score here you're gonna have to beat your defender one on one. Break ankles and take names as you become a streetball legend!

title: The Prowler Hell
description: Escape from the devasted land and try to survive.

title: What is Sleeping in My Room?
description: Experience the hunt for the Monster living in your room in this Visual Novel experience. Your choices will determine the fate of both you and the Monster. Will you figure out what the Monster really is?

title: Eternal Roadster
