description: Help Urgh, Urgha and Claw the Cave Bear survive the harsh winter. Hunt, collect wood and pick herbs to ensure that your cave remains nice and cozy. Make sure you don't catch a cold!

title: Tenchi Shinden
description: Jump into this platformer with a unique, dimensional, twist. Play as a ninja with the power of Tenchi.

title: Homesickened
description:
A short story about rational fears in 4-color CGA.

You can't go home again. Except that you can. But you don't really want to. And then you do, anyway.

title: Neo Berlin 2087
description: A unique, Third- and First-Person Action Role-Playing Game; a deep, cinematic Detective Thriller that takes place in a dark future vision of Berlin. Solve a far-reaching conspiracy on an emotional Cyberpunk Journey about Justice, Friendship, Love, Guilt, Sacrifice and Betrayal.

title: Neko Miko Onryou Toubatsu Emaki
description: In this side-scrolling shooter with six stages, choose three out of six different cats and utilize their unique abilities to fight back against the vengeful yokai!

title: You Will Fall
description: A brutal vertical parkour game where every fall costs real progress. No checkpoints. And now the water is rising. Master momentum, learn the map, find faster routes, and climb before everything below you disappears.

title: The Gray Wolf and The Little Lamb
description: Once upon a time there lived the grey wolf and the little lamb. One was infamously cruel while the other had a heart of gold. They both egotistically believed they could teach one another a life lesson. But maybe they could become friends in the end?

title: The Lonely League
description: The Lonely League is a comic book style superhero tactical fangame RPG with Superman, Batman, Venom and John Lennon. It alternates between comic book cutscenes and tactical battles inspired by games like Shining Force and Final Fantasy Tactics. Battles are challenging and deeply tactical, and there are always multiple paths to victory, which often include not only attacking but also interacting with map objects and recruiting temporary characters. The story develops from common errands of an ordinary guy, slowly escalating to an epic journey with psychological and political undertones.

title: Serial Experiments Lain Bootleg
description: Serial Experiments Lain Bootleg is the third and final soundtrack for the Serial Experiments Lain anime. A CD-ROM included with the soundtrack features a dress-up game, a shooting gallery game, wallpapers, and screensavers.

title: Raios Funde
description:
Raios Funde, a word guessing game that follows a scary aesthetic, its differential is having a connection to Twitch, in which the chat actively participates with its player.
The game has the mechanic for the player to guess the word in the chat or to create the word for his chat to guess.
Thus having multiple tools to entertain the gameplay such as: time, chances and word hints.

title: The Sorrowvirus
description: On the verge of death of a life unlived, Wyatt Heyll was given The Sorrowvirus by his parents, a substance that suspends the human soul in Purgatory after death; allowing Purgatory's mysterious properties to heal them. As he ebbs, Wyatt's only desire is to be free, forever.

title: Minesweeper
description: This is a minesweeper game created by ItchySkink0.

title: A Phone Found in Tall Grass
description:
a phone found in tall grass is an experimental visual novel made in one month. There are no choices and should take between ten and twenty minutes to read.

It tells the story of an apocalypse and three aimless 20-something adults stuck in the middle, via tweets. Read the latest news! Shitpost while hurtling towards oblivion! Tell your closest friends how much you love them!

title: Lost Alone Ultimate
description: Lost Alone Ultimate is a first-person psychological horror game designed to convey anxiety, distress, and terror. You will have to explore three different houses, avoid staying in the dark, and face moments of fear that will not give you respite.

title: Furious Farm: Total Reap Out
description:
Furious Farm is the world's first Combine-Harvester racing game. Battle 7 other farmers to see who can reap the biggest portion of the field in this crazy arcade game. Every round 2 farmers get eliminated, and the remaining ones get to upgrade their machine. Will you make it to the end and win the Grain Prix? Alternatively, get up to 3 other players and play against them for a fun and unique party game!

Who said farming should be relaxing?

title: Heart Fragment: Book One - Fantasy Fragments
description:
Includes Kay and Clive's routes.

A mysterious figure that appears to you and sets the events of the story into motion is a young man named Kay who always seems to have a smile plastered on his face as he reveals strange secrets to you. His friendly personality makes him easy to open up to despite the odd circumstances.

On the other hand, Clive seems to have a knack for popping up at "just the right moment". A string of coincidental encounters combined with his awkward demeanor cause you to wonder what his intentions really are.

With strong elements of fantasy present in this book, a lot of questions are raised and shocking reveals begin.

title: Falcão & a cornopopéia brasileira
description: Falcão & a Cornopopéia Brasileira is an interactive CD-ROM based around the comedian and singer Falcão, in which you can play six different games, learn about the philosophies of Falcanian ideology, ask the singer questions, learn about the Universal Declaration of the Cuckold's Rights or the Chinese horoscope by Falcão.

title: Matsuro Palette
description: This game is a horror adventure game, released on February 19, 2020 by SleepingMuseum on Googleplay and Appstore.

title: Nucleares
description: Nuclear Reactor Simulator, operable by a single person with the help of an AI Assistant.

title: War Thunder: Sky Guardians
description: The first units for the French naval tree, new and updated graphical effects and data structure optimization along with ejection seats for selected modern jets. Amongst the 43 new as well as updated vehicle models, one can't help but mention the real behemoth - the Char2, the agile AH-6M "Little Bird" helicopter or the first French light cruiser; Duguay-Trouin! In addition to all this, the winter version of the location "Seversk", a new location for fans of avionics - Pyrenees, and as always, many improvements and fixes! Let's welcome the "Sky Guardians" update!

title: Potion Path
description: The king has fallen ill, and now Matteo will have to do something he never thought he would: ask a witch for help.

title: Gotoubun: RE
description: Fangame from the acclaimed manga and anime series The Quintessential Quintuplets.

title: Dead Space Demake
description: Dead Space Demake has everything you want and more, from necromorph limb dismemberment to affine texture mapping errors. You've played Dead Space (2008) and you've played Dead Space (2023) it's time to soak in the horrid vibes of Dead Space (1998)

title: Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One - Clergyman Cassock
description:
This DLC includes the following items:

Clergyman Cassock

title: Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened - The Sleuth's Attire
description:
Get ready to immerse yourself even deeper and channel your inner detective with three new Victorian-era-inspired costumes!

With the Clergyman Cassock, you'll give the impression of a true man of the cloth, ready to absolve even the most hardened sinners.

Unleash your inner detective with the Master Sleuth costume. This sleek and sophisticated outfit will make you the talk of the town, and give your character the mystery and intrigue of a true virtuoso investigator, ready to solve even the most challenging of mysteries.

The Consulting Detective outfit adds a classic touch to your look and elevates your immersive experience.

title: Entropy: Zero - Uprising
description: Entropy: Zero - Uprising is a mod for Half-Life 2: Episode Two that lets you play as a Civil Protection Unit during the Uprising. The mod features a full campaign of 20 maps, a unique storyline, new enemies and weapons, a fully voiced cast of characters, and a soundtrack composed by various artists.

title: Rizline
description:
Presenting Pigeon Games' second enchanting music rhythm game, following the success of "Phigros"!
Dive into a mesmerizing journey where points and lines dance in harmony, weaving an extraordinary geometric tapestry set to the innermost beat of your heart!

title: Reincarnated
description: This was a fanmade project and video based on "Garten of Banban" by the Euphoric Brothers. This project was made purely for practice and fun and is not for profit. Please support the official releases of the Garten of Banban series.

title: Anno Mitsumasa Pepperon-mura no Shiki
description: Based on Mitsumasa Anno's picture books, the game takes place in an old-fashioned German village. There are some some city building simulation and management elements, throughout four seasons. Each building has its own activities and learning material such as the bakery, carpenter and clothes shop. There is also a segment in which you can custom build your own village.

title: Dennis Miller: That's Geek to Me
description: Multimedia CD-ROM glossary of computer-related terms ("ASCII", "E-mail", "Cross-platform" etc.) with both a serious explanation spoken by an animated "geek" character, and digitized video clips of Dennis Miller giving his own humorous definition of the same term.

title: Digital Bojangles Saga HD Remaster
description: Digital Bojangles Saga is a fan-made Shin Megami Tensei fangame that seeks to combine the fast-paced gameplay of mainline Megami Tensei with an unconventional story to deliver a unique experience.

title: Disco Dave
description: Say hello to neon lights and funky moves! The disco fever begins with Disco Dave on the ever changing dance floor!

title: Luckie Ball
description: Luckie Ball is a short precision platformer where nothing is fully solid. You'll float to the top of everything! Features tight controls, a custom physics engine, tons of bonus content, and a level editor.

title: Die-Rise
description: Shooter with light immersive sim elements. Fight your way to the top of a high-rise building.

title: Poop Collector: Number 2
description:
The poop gods have found out about the disaster you brought upon them in your previous mission and they are furious!

They have located you on earth and took you to a hidden cave somewhere on the planet "Pooparium" and the only way to escape and get back home is to play their game and show them why you are the best poop collector out there!

This time they are making your life harder with obstacles and more challenging rooms so go out there and show them how fast you can shame them and clear their rooms to escape back home!

Feedback is always welcome, enjoy!

title: Quadanoid
description:
A breakout clone with a twist!

There are no walls, only paddles and bricks.
The idea is to use the paddles as walls and clear the level.
Each level brick layout is randomly generated and everytime you clear a level the movement speed increases.

Let's see how far you can get :)

Enjoy!

title: Jamie
description: A secret gets uncovered. Will your journey into that secret uncover your deepest desires ? Follow Jamie, an ordinary shy college student, explore his feminine side and see how his girlfriend Sarah copes with these changes and her own explorations.

title: Rack and Slay
description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler where you're a billiard ball. Push monster balls into holes or traps in randomly generated levels. Draft stackable items with game-changing effects to build synergies.

title: Viruzzerk
description: A game based on Robotron 2084, Berzerk and Windows XP

title: Stars Shooter
description: A basic arcade video game of spaceships

title: Let’s Build a Zoo: Aquarium Odyssey
description: Escape to a brand new AQUARIUM ISLAND and discover a world of seafaring beasts. Start a brand new zoo complete with adorable water splashing and ocean dwelling creatures, brand new themed shops and a whole host of new decorations to give your guests the ultimate aquatic experience!

title: Freddy's Pizza Parlor Survival
description: Freddy's Pizza Parlor Survival, or FPPS for short, is a tower defense game based off of Scott Cawthon's Five Nights At Freddy's franchise. As you progress through the game, you must place towers, develop strategies, and face an ever-growing army of hungry children.

title: Phazer Punk
description: Phazer Punk is a mini metroidvania game where you explore mysterious alien planets full of secrets and dangers. Use your phazer gun to destroy obstacles and your jetpack to reach new heights as you discover new areas and abilities. But be careful, as you go deeper and deeper into the planets core, you will face more challenges and enemies. Can you find all the hidden resources and escape the planets... Phazer Punk?

title: Tales of Sector 1
description: In a world overtaken by a deadly virus, you are a recruit with a crucial mission: to stop the infection from spreading to the lower sectors. But your task is not as simple as it seems. You will face moral dilemmas, unexpected challenges and diverse characters along the way. Your choices will shape the story and the destiny of the town.

title: TurnKee
description:
A pixel art turn-based dungeon crawler where you choose to move one tile every turn.
You are Monkee. You're in some dungeon. There's keys in the rooms. They might be useful. There's enemies. Probably should avoid them...

title: Be A Rock
description: A unique 3rd-person exploration game set in a beautiful open world. Your spirit is born in the form of a rock as you explore canyons, deserts, and volcanic lands in order to uncover secrets of the past. The game features puzzle solving, and a distinct storytelling style. For fans of Journey.

title: Routine Checkup
description: A first-person murder mystery horror game. Explore a creepy dentist's office and try to identify a corpse by collecting the victim's missing teeth.

title: Landnama
description: Face the judgment of winter’s deadly toll as you lead the first Viking clans to settle Iceland in this non-violent, rogue-lite survival base builder.

title: Hotel Renovator: Kawaii Furniture Set
description: Invite your guests on the most adorable stay with the Kawaii Furniture set.Give your hotel that youthful glow with the Kawaii Furniture set, packed with the cutest 53 items that will make any of your customers' heart melt. With its bright colors and playful patterns, life truly is all sunshine and rainbows!

title: Playable Mockup
description: Explore an infinite loop corridor and get to 0 PM to 0 AM by building a "Time manipulation deck". You will be challenged with a life threatening test. Wander the “Dead Soul Corridor” created from a ghost photo. Find a way to get to the soul of the dead.

title: Thanks, Come Again
description: A game by Incisor Studios for the Cartomancy Anthology. A game about the day-to-day of a simple shopkeeper and their complex wares. Try not to give too much of yourself away.

title: Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy
description:
Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy will take Amadeus the Wizard, Zoya the Thief, and Pontius the Knight on their most action-packed journey yet!

Traverse breathtaking 2.5D landscapes in Trine‘s deepest and visually richest chapter to date, with an all new cast of characters – some friends, some foes, but all unforgettable.

Whether by yourself or playing with up to three friends in online and local co-op, the upgraded puzzle difficulty system keeps things fresh, adapting the challenge to the number of players.

Level up the heroes' abilities with the all-new skill quest system, growing their legend as they are once again united by… the Trine!

title: PacMania II
description:
PacMania II is the fourth game in the Alawar PacMania series based on the original Pac-Man. Like in Pac-Man, all the dots from a board need to be eaten in order to pass to the next board. If the characters bumps into a monster, he loses a life. There are special pills in every stage allowing the character to eat the monsters for a short period of time.

The game contains three game modes: Classic: this is the original style of Pac-Man*, the player is the yellow dot muncher, and the enemies are the four ghosts.

- Advanced: in this type the player's character is a pair of big lips and the enemies are skeletons.
- CarMania: in this type the player is bulldozer and the enemies are little cars. Objects turn into fuel tanks, screwdrivers and hearts. This third mode was added in an updated version.

In every game type there are also bonuses. Most of them offer points and hearts provide extra lives. For every five completed levels a password is provided to continue from there.

title: Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood
description: Slash and survive a typical workday as Dracula's overworked and underappreciated servant! You'll have a bloody good time as you rampage through New Orleans to find fresh victims for your narcissistic boss.

title: Sesame Street: Search & Learn Adventures
description: The Amazing Mumford tries to create a magic picnic basket to hold everything Elmo and friends need to go to the beach. He accidentally ends up teleporting all of the items across Sesame Street instead. The famous detective Sherlock Hemlock volunteers to track down the items along with your help. This is done by solving puzzles and playing educational minigames focused around shapes, matching, recycling, and more.

title: ExoCross
description: ExoCross is an offroad racing game introducing 4CPT vehicle physics (4-way contact patch traction technology). A soft-body tire model allows for competitive time attack and multiplayer wheel to wheel racing.

title: Small on Top
description: "Small on Top" is a full on adult furry RPG with character driven events and narrative. It follows the Adventurer as he tries to find out why he woke up in the forest.

title: Don't Eat the Mushroom
description: A short mod of Knytt Stories where a young girl is asked to deliver a package for her mother. Adds in new levels, music, and a few other surprises!

title: Axon TD: Uprising
description: From the developers of Element TD 2 comes a Mazing Tower Defense where you can expand the map layout itself. A huge arsenal of towers and a wide variety of enemies clash in a battlefield that shifts on your whims. Engage in single, cooperative, or roguelite gameplay.

title: The Vampire(?) Detective and the Case of the Lying Maid
description: Enid had a crush on her eccentric lady Olivia for as long as she can remember, but she'll rather die than admit it. One day, she's summoned to Olivia's study for an unclear reason...

title: King of the Arcade
description: Featuring over 40 Playable games, King of the Arcade lets you play as former Champ Mac McCormick, fighting to save Castle's Arcade from a hostile takeover. With epic boss battles and an open-world arcade, reclaim your title as King in this ultimate Arcade experience.

title: Snaileeyo Save Them
description:
Go with the heroic Snaileeyo and explore vibrant new worlds, solve challenging of obstacles, fight enemies and save your friends.
Slither across brilliant islands, haunting deserts, scorching volcanic mountains and crystal palaces.
Enjoy intuitive controls, smooth HD graphics and original music.
Gain special powers: fly, blast fireballs, lay decoys, and grow mega huge to topple your foes!
Find all your friends and unlock the true ending. Treat yourself to an unforgettable, fun-filled adventure! Brought to you by the indie game studio, Bezenyo!

title: Null
description: NULL is a first person psychological horror game about grief, obsession and what happens when love refuses to accept an ending. You explore a neighbourhood that stopped behaving like one. You talk to people who seem completely normal until they turn and look at you in a way that makes you wish they hadn't. You find what was left behind by someone who could not say goodbye. And slowly the picture forms — what happened here, who did it, and why they thought love was a good enough reason.

title: Buccanyar
description: The game consists of two major parts: a nautical mode in which you operate your own ship with AI cats (crew) and go on adventures, fighting other ships and sea monsters, and a port mode in which you customize your ship, replace crew, and cash in resources obtained in battle.

title: Children of Morn
description: Children of Morn is an erotic adventure and sandbox game set in a dark fantasy world full of vicious demons and alluring witches.

title: Blue Flow
description: Follow our blue hero through a challenging 2D platformer filled with precision jumps, fast-paced shooting, and clever puzzles. Each pixel-art level rewards skill, timing, and persistence. Overcome tricky obstacles and uncover new mechanics as the journey unfolds.

title: Hololive CouncilRyS RPG
description: Hololive CouncilRyS RPG is a fangame and love letter to Hololive CouncilRyS, built in RPG Maker MZ with custom art assets by me and original musical arrangements of Hololive songs by Jeremy Robson. Expect the game to be about 3 hours long.

title: One week, My room
description: A week in just five minutes. A closed off room, just eight tatami in size. A small world for you to save. This game is a puzzle adventure that takes from thirty minutes to an hour to play through.

title: Monuments to Guilt
description: Take a first-person wander through Monuments to Guilt, a short exhibition exploring exclusionary design. Acquaint yourself with the core principles of this harmful practice, re-evaluate the objects you see every day and let guilt sit with you, for just a little while.

title: Metal: Hellsinger - Dream of the Beast
description: In the Dream of the Beast DLC, make the Hells fear the beat with two new songs (Cristina Scabbia from Lacuna Coil and Will Ramos from Lorna Shore), a new weapon, and three outfits with unique gameplay bonuses.

title: Crash Bandicoot: Back In Time
description: A love letter to Crash Bandicoot in the form of a game that features 5 traditional levels, 5 flashback tape levels, time trials and the Crash Creator: an awesome level creator.

title: The Aether II
description:
The Aether II is the sequel to the highly popular dimension mod "The Aether", set in a hostile paradise miles up in the clouds, the Aether is an entirely different world from what regular players are used to, filled with fantastic creatures and mysterious structures, the Aether is a world brimming with life and history. You'll have to relearn key ideas as the Aether challenges you with twisted materials, terrifying monsters and deep lore if you want to survive and prosper in this strange new land.

As the mod comes closer to a final release, Dungeons, Biomes, NPC settlements will pepper the landscape, offering new and exciting challenges and experiences unique to this mysterious world.

title: Mr. Brocco & Co.
description: Mr. Brocco & Co is a classic 2D platform game set in a fantasy world where junk food is trying to take over! Choose one of two characters (Mr. Broccoli or Super Asparagus) to save the city!

title: Ride 5
description: Rev up your engine and get ready to hit the track with RIDE 5. An adrenaline-filled gaming experience that is so authentic it will make you feel like you're truly racing at break-neck speed. Find your favorite bikes and check out new ones in the ultimate motorcycle game! Race on over 35 tracks and collect more than 200 motorcycles from world-renowned manufacturers, each element is designed to feel like you're riding a real bike.

title: Love Challenge
description: You are a retired male whore with a villa on the hill. On this day, three beauties came out of nowhere to seek help. Taking advantage of the opportunity of the three beauties spending the night, use your expertise to make them willing to sleep with you without the other two beauties knowing.

title: Yogurt: Wet Dreams
description: Yogurt: Wet Dreams! - a clicker with a lot of beautiful girls! You must collect all the girls, for this you need to bring them to the peak with your clicks! Each girl is animated, voiced and emotional!

title: Wizard's Watch
description: You are a wizard and your village is under attack! Push back the enemy forces with powerful spells. Burn, freeze, shatter and crush the enemy soldiers with your magic powers. Gain XP as you kill your enemies and unlock upgrades for your spells.

title: Up All Night: Daybreak
description: Nick just can't let go of the people he's killed.

title: Way of the Bullet
description: Shoot, dash and slice your way to victory in this rogue-lite FPS! Discover new weapons, spells and game modes as you progress through a series of procedurally-generated levels. Face hordes of enemies and bosses as you fight solo or in a 3 player co-op.

title: Sex Room 2: 18+
description: SEX Room 2 [18+] is a steamy and seductive casual clicker game. Sex Room 2 [18+] is a game that invites you to immerse yourself in a world of passion and pleasure. You can upgrade generators and clickers, purchase new sex toys, and enjoy adult content

title: Sisyphus.12.20.03
description: In a world of no humans, a robot remains. Voiced by Kakos Xamos.

title: Slime-ing
description: In 'Sliming, players must navigate the slime through numerous obstacles to reach its destination by bouncing it. The control of avoiding obstacles such as spikes, saw blades, and moving platforms creates a thrilling experience for players.

title: Slingshell, by Muno!
description: SLINGSHELL is an arcade high-score shooter / platformer where you play as a cloud-riding, gun-slinging snail and brave the dangers of enemy-filled, randomly-generated levels. Master the unorthodox controls of a varied cast of characters, all while enjoying beautiful pixel art and a jazzy soundtrack!

title: Soulvester vs. Lil' Beezey
description: Show Lil' Beezey who the boss of Winkletown is in this addictive and fast paced 2D action roguelite! Created from scratch in only 14 days and nominated for GDWC Game Jam GOTY, Soulvester comes to Steam for the first time, now with controller support and achievements!

title: The Artist: Act One
description: Do you feel good where you are? Some people do, some don't even if they have everything in the world. Does love fix that sort of feeling, even if such feelings feel so hard to grasp and such love could be toxic to yourself? What is a loving muse to the artist who paints them?

title: Tales of Seikyu
description: "Tales of Seikyu" is a fantasy farming sim game set in a lost fae land called Seikyu, inhabited by legendary creatures. However, the town is frequently threatened by the old gods' forces. As a new arrival, can you successfully manage the old inn entrusted to you by God Inari?

title: The Witch, Wife, & the Wish
description: Once upon a time, there was a witch who lived in the middle of a forest. Rumors said that even the witch was cursed herself, but the witch had long forgotten what spell had been cast, until one day a brave young man came to ask a favor of the witch, for his ailing wife.

title: Rollerball
description: Roll the ball, collect the crystals, avoid obstacles. Don't fall.

title: PieClicker
description: PieClicker is a beautiful clicker game designed to be visually appealing. Click, Get Pies, Upgrade Pies.

title: Puppetmaster: Pose Viewer
description: The Puppetmaster Pose-Viewer is the next, new 3DX innovation from the team that brought you Sensual Adventures! This PC-only software application will let you watch and play with Brittany, Trinity, Jasmine, Marcia, Livia and Alexandra in almost any way you like.

title: Road to Salvation
description: Road To Salvation is a stylized action adventure game. This is where the world is ruined. Your daughter, who was the only thing that connects you to this difficult life, has been kidnapped. Fight to save, do you have the courage to negotiate? You may even have to die. Can you do these?

title: Run a Café
description: Run a Café is a game where you do just that, run a Café! Make drinks from regular coffee, to iced flavored coffees and even serve food! Manage your inventory and time efficiently to ensure you maximize every customer! Start from nothing and build a full scale, dine-in Café!

title: Threat Actor
description: Threat Actor is a story rich, cybercrime-themed game, where you, an infamous hacker and paranoid owner of an underground marketplace, are ready to do whatever it takes to secure the legacy of your business as one of the most luxurious trading sites on the Dark Web.

title: Model Eight
description: A shoot em' up with a manga inspired look. Destroy enemies, and use their salvage to gain more power.

title: Mirthwood
description: Embark on an enchanting journey and brave ferocious creatures in an immersive medieval fantasy world. Will you settle a new homestead to live a life of farming and trade, or pick up the sword and take up the adventurers' path?

title: Marionette Mates
description: Marionette Mates is a powerful pngtuber application with multiplayer support. Marionette Mates allows you to use the provided assets or ones you create as virtual avatars to create an online presence alone or with friends.

title: Dawnfolk
description: Minimalist and relaxing survival builder perfect for short gaming sessions. Rebuild and manage your realm, collect resources and decide the fate of your people. Explore the darkness and unveil the secrets of the black monoliths to bring back light to the world.

title: Super Pet Hero
description:
Take the control of the Ninja or one of his friends and save all the cute pets from dangerous crossroads. Join our crew of rescue heroes and take the pets to safety. Gather coins from the busy crossroad and on top of running cars to unlock all the pet rescue heroes.
The Ninja and his friends have a tough mission, to rescue fuzzy and cute animals from a busy crossroad. Cats, dogs, pandas and even pigs and unicorns await you! Climb the leaderboards and achieve a high score in this action packed pet rescue adventure.

title: Neon Survivors
description: ANNIHILATE a small army's worth of ghouls, knaves and miners, with the power of lasers, missiles and kidneys! You're alone against these hordes with nothing but INCREDIBLE WEAPONRY and MURDEROUS INTENT. Can you survive for FOUR MINUTES?

title: Nidus
description: Emerge into Nidus as a mind-bending Symbiotic Duo. Control Two Characters Simultaneously in challenging Twin-Stick Top-Down Arena gameplay. Gather power, devour the swarm, and shine brilliantly as your strive to complete the mesmerizing collective lifecycle.

title: Open Spaces SE
description: Skylar is an student with anxiety. Walter is a farmer with social anxiety and PTSD. Jessica is a programmer with anxiety and agoraphobia. Li Wei is an technologist with intense anxiety. Navigate their stories, learn how they move through the world, and about methods of treatment and recovery.

title: Pickup Artist Trouble
description: Alex is a pickup artist who scams single, lonely young men for money. Now he created a mob that is coming after him. They took his books and scattered them around different locations. Help Alex get his books back so that he can find success while scamming more men.

title: Hentai Puzzles: Attack on Tight Panties
description: Meet Jaimie and Emma in this Hentai puzzle game.

title: Hentai Casual Jigsaw: Witches
description: Enjoy our new line of puzzles with Hentai Casual Jigsaw - Witches! With a lot of gorgeous illustrations of beautiful witches and with an open gallery for you to relax and enjoy!

title: Green Squares
description: Pure Simple Physics Fun. Green Squares is A physics based time trial, where there are green squares, that need to be not green!

title: Finland Corruption Simulator
description: experience boring life in simulator game and this will just is it finland corruption simulator and then you can just play it nothing intresting so do what ever you want in game what you will can so basically nothing

title: Entogious
description: Kill an angel in a real-time-turn-based combat style thats COMPLETELY UNFAIR and take it’s heart. Die 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 times who cares? Become the richest man alive. Hmmmm COWS?!?!!.

title: Don't Beg for Help
description: A horror visual novel game with "Tales from the Crypt" style plot.

title: Land of Zombies
description: Welcome to the heart-pounding adventure of Land of Zombies, where survival is your only option in a world ravaged by the undead.

title: It Consumes
description: It Consumes is a roguelite arena-FPS in the dark. See by beating your heart and kill demons shrouded in shadows. Upgrade your abilities, unlock new weapons, and conquer what lurks in the darkness.

title: Imaginal Voyages
description: Experience the depths of emotion and the twisted psychology of the flawed human condition. Encounter futuristic technology and the cosmic horrors of space travel. Examine the differences between man and machine.

title: I Had a Plan!
