description: This is a third person action shooter game. Support for custom character size, support for costume change, use guns and bows for long-distance combat, can also use cold weapons for melee combat, with some training elements. Enemies include monsters and humans.

title: Reborn a Zombie!
description: A queer, slice-of-life visual novel about the hardships and joys of a trans girl transformed into a zombie. Follow her new life in a world filled with magic, cute demons and dragons!

title: Aurendor
description: Aurendor is an open world survival game. Players must gather resources, cook their meals and fight dangerous creatures to survive and build a home for themselves. Aurendor also offers a multiplayer game option. Players can play together by cooperating with or battling other survivors.

title: Neko Office: Nightlife Adventures
description: Neko has been working hard at her job in the office and deserves to go to the bar! As you know, it is from the bar that nightly adventures begin...

title: Doggo Garden Defense
description: Critters are on their way to eat your carrots! Recruit fearsome Doggos to shoo them away in this casual yet strategic Tower Defense game. Defend your garden across a variety of different levels, each with four difficulty modes. Can you save your crops, or will the Critters win?

title: Akari and the Abyss
description: This game is a JRPG featuring a girl exploring the demon-infested Hell Palace. During her journey, the demon-slaying girl, Akari, encounters incidents where people's souls have been stolen. In order to save everyone, Akari challenges the Hell Palace and the story begins.

title: Blade Abyss
description: "Blade Abyss: Death Raid" is a skill-driven hardcore action game, blending precise parry, dynamic movement, and tactical axe throws. Face demonic bosses and zombie hordes in fast-paced combat—no gear, no grind, only pure mastery of mechanics. Your reflexes are the ultimate weapon.

title: Hentai Casual Swap 2
description: Enjoy our newest and sexiest casual tile swap puzzle with dozens of nice illustrations for you to enjoy and relax. With a gallery for simply relaxing! Unlock all the pictures!

title: Escape from Norwood
description: Explore a city that lives without your input in this illustrated text adventure. Observe the lives of its inhabitants behind the veil of your invisibility magic. Find items and combine them to solve intricate puzzles. Set your own pace as you control time and move freely in an open fantasy world.

title: Cactus Venture
description: A platformer about the adventure of a cactus: where it goes and where it ends remains to be seen. You have to play as a cute cactus on a classic platform game. An adventure and arcade game. Also in the game are saws, thorns, doors, and elevators.

title: Words of Yendor
description: A word puzzle roguelike set in a steamgoth world of amalgamated steam-age technology and antediluvian sorcery. Collect resources, solve dangerous situations and prepare for a showdown with each Master Villain to discover the meaning behind the Word of Yendor!

title: Momo no Hana ha Senketsu ni Somaru
description: A Japanese visual novel about the adventures of Onmyoji girls.

title: Ride 5: Special Edition
description: Enjoy RIDE to the fullest with RIDE 5 - Special Edition! In addition to the full game you'll also get the Season Pass that will give you access to bikes, amazing tracks and a credit multiplier as soon as they become available.

title: Fantasy Love
description: Fantasy Love - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Varial
description: Varial is a single player skateboarding-action game where you play as the titular character fighting a giant robot called the "Y.2.K.A.I.J.U.". The game takes place in a Y2K apocalypse, where all the technology has revolted against humanity and wiped out most of the population.

title: Out of Action
description: Action heavy, multiplayer + singleplayer FPS set in a brutal cyberpunk universe.

title: Cats Hidden Around the World
description: Find 1500 cats hiding in over 15 iconic locations such as Rio de Janeiro, Istanbul or Tokyo in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game.

title: Bullet Bunny
description: Bullet Bunny is a twin-stick shooter with rogue-like elements. Fend off an onslaught of enemies, level up, and create unique builds every run while trying to survive 500 seconds!

title: Frog Island
description: Frog Island is a fully hand-drawn, cozy Frog Collection and Life-Sim game. Start your new life as a caretaker for an island of frogs in this cozy creature-collector! Build your dream island, discover magical wildlife, and uncover the island's many hidden secrets, to try and piece together the past life you've somehow forgotten.

title: Bullet Brawl
description: Endless action!

title: Emergency Parking Only
description: A physics-based parking pileup for up to four players. Smash other players' cars out of the way while placing your own cars perfectly - all without any brakes. A delightfully silly party game that'll have you rolling!

title: Cube Heroes
description: A Magic Cube Roguelike: shuffle to match monsters and abilities, traverse a randomly generated path and fight powerful enemies. Choose the right path to victory. Collect rare items to acquire powerful synergies. Can you survive this dangerous journey?

title: Military Tanks
description: Do you like tanks game? Are you ready to feel the full power of a tank games?

title: My Hero: After the Fall
description: This is a pixel tower defense game that combines light Rogue and grass cutting! Dozens of heroes for you to choose from, hundreds of blessings appear randomly, with the strongest team components to protect the crystal from monsters!

title: Battle Teams
description: Blood Strike is a free FPS game which has more than 300 million faithful players in China. Now the battle is on, there are various modes and weapons for you to explore! Call your friends and join us,get into the battle field now!

title: Them's Fightin' Herds: Stronghoof
description: The 9th character to join the TFH roster is Stronghoof the Reindeer. Conjure an arsenal of icy, magical weaponry and fight alongside his muscly winter sprite Vetr!

title: Ungate
description: The action is about a young man named Jason, who follows the steps of his friends to find them and to get them out of a mysterious cave that has its own ecosystem and is known by the locals of the West Village as the gate of hell...

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball - Twilight Zone
description: You just crossed over... into the Twilight Zone. With a pinball that isn't, and flippers that aren't, keep telling yourself it's only a game. Earn highscores that are from another dimension with this classic joining the Pinball FX library.

title: Pinball FX: Crypt of the NecroDancer Pinball
description: Challenge your skills in this pinball and rhythm fusion table, which captures the wacky atmosphere and killer soundtrack of the acclaimed rogue-like. Stop the NecroDancer once more as you use your flippers to battle bosses and acquire the Golden Lute.

title: Corpse Party 2: Dead Patient Neues;
description: Corpse Party 2: Dead Patient Neues; is a survival horror adventure game developed by Team GrisGris / GrindHouse released for the PC. Corpse Party 2: Dead Patient Neues; is the definitive version of Dead Patient with updated graphics and additional scenario.

title: Super Vadimka X2
description: Super Vadimka X2 - is a free video game made by two developers VadimBallzGame and HyperTheLoopa420 for Windows. The game was released on April 9, 2023, and in North America in 2023. This is a direct sequel to Super Vadimka X, released in the same year. The action of Super Vadimka X2 takes place in the near future, a new opponent named Chris Chan wants to take over the world and kill the main character Super Vadimka X will the hero be able to survive a second time.

title: Shikyokusei
description: Turn-based tactics game developed by Kogado Studio's Usagi Team and released for Windows PCs in March, 2001.

title: Killbug
description: Killbug is a fast-paced, first-person movement shooter set in an endless arena. Slash and shoot your way through hordes of ravenous insects, mastering fluid aerial movement mechanics as you fight for glory on the leaderboards.

title: Cherrywitched!
description: In Cherrywitched! You play as a witch detective for the Council of Witches who’s been struggling with a recent series of missing person cases. One day, you decide to take a break from work to visit your favorite cafe: Cherry Pie’s Cafe! This game takes place in the same universe as my first visual novel Berrywitched! So if you haven't played that game, please consider checking it out.

title: Toro to Typing
description: Toro to Typing is a typing-based adventure game based on the Japanese PlayStation game Doko Demo Issyo. The game series concept of communicating with and teaching a virtual pet-type character is integrated with typing prompts.

title: Onsen mo Issho
description: The follow-up to "Typing with Toro," a typing tutor game based on the Japanese PlayStation game Doko Demo Issyo. This time Toro and his friends are heading to a hot springs resort and will require your conversational typing prowess along the way. New minigames include karaoke, word games, snowman building, and others.

title: Junk Survivor
description: Junk Survivor is a zombie post-apocalypse game where you loot, craft, build and farm in a struggle to survive. With a vast map to explore, a robust skillset to unlock this customizable sandbox awaits the adventurer. How long before you die!

title: Who is the New Maid?
description: There is a rumor that the new maid is a lesbian. And a slut. You're Stephanie, the oldest of three sisters, and it is your responsibility to make sure the new maid fits in at the manor.

title: Raging Bytes
description: Raging Bytes is a story-driven zombie RPG full of drama and pixels! Survive the raging bytes! With difficulty levels for all kinds of players, dive into this post-apocalyptic world and face zombies in turn-based battles!

title: New Club Penguin
description:
New Club Penguin is a fan-made continuation of Disney's Club Penguin.

Crafted with care, built on legacy. Bringing Club Penguin's classic charm into the future! Where quality and accuracy set us apart.

New Club Penguin is a recreation and/or fan-made game and is in no way affiliated to Disney's Club Penguin, The Walt Disney Company and/or Disney Games.

title: Sonic: Project Survival
description: Sonic: Project Survival is a Sonic fan game that is Mega Drive-style Sonic platformer, with original zones based of classic games in the series.

title: Ochakai he no Shoutaijou
description:
Donna, who was raised on a family plantation in the countryside, spent the day hard at work harvesting, as usual. That day, news came of her grandmother's sudden passing, disrupting Donna's peaceful country life. She was told by her parents to head to her grandmother's residence in the city to settle her belongings.

The big city London, which she had never been to in her life.

The duty of settling her grandmother's belongings, which she reluctantly accepted.

The moment she was filled with excitement yet unease from being in the unfamiliar city, the visitor bell rang. When she opened the door, she was met with unfamiliar guests, who said they'd arrived to have tea with her grandmother.
What her socialite grandmother had left behind, was but a fun tea party...?

title: Piggy: Chapter 1
description:
Piggy kidnapped you!

Therefore, you will have to escape from the house by solving puzzles and using objects to get out of that place.

title: Bloons But You're the Bloon
description:
Bloons But You're The Bloon is a fan-made reimagining of the classic tower defence game Bloons in which players use a monkey character to pop balloons (bloons) using various weapons and tools. In this version of the game, the player takes on the role of a bloon and must evade being popped by the monkey characters.

As the bloon, the player will navigate through different levels, each with their unique challenges and obstacles. The player must avoid the monkey's attacks, such as darts, bombs, and boomerangs, and find ways to get past the monkey's defenses. To do this, the bloon has a range of abilities and upgrades that can be earned throughout the game.

The player can customize their bloon by choosing different types of bloons, each with unique abilities and weaknesses. As the player progresses through the game, the monkey characters become more challenging, and the levels become more difficult. The ultimate goal of the game is to make it through all the levels without getting popped by the monkeys.

title: Quiz Quest
description:
Quiztal Games introduces Quiz Quest: a mind-stretching, collaborative quizcapade!

Team up with friends and family, using your smartphones as your controllers, and put your heads together as you journey to achieve the rank of Master Quizards.

The fallen knight Sir Answerlot needs you to take up his failed quest to rid the kingdom of its most hated tormentor: the evil dragon Spontanius the Combustor. You will need to keep your wits about you as you encounter many allies and enemies, make many crucial decisions and answer many, many quiz questions along the way.

title: A Turtle In A Hare-Machine
description: An erotic horror game.

title: HarleQuest!
description: 3D roguelike dungeon crawler currently in development for the Sega Dreamcast and PC.

title: Therapist: Mind Manager
description: Therapist: Mind Manager is a visual novel with simulation elements set on modern times, following the life of an ordinary man working as a psychotherapist.

title: The Deep Ones
description:
In a mysterious little town, inhabited by a strange tackle shop owner, the deep waters are stirring...

Explore the foggy landscape and try to fill out your fish species logbook. Purchase items and upgrades to help you catch stronger and rarer fish. But beware, these fish won't be caught without a fight - they may just drag you down with them!

title: Pleonexia
description:
"Play as the fisherman of a quiet little sea-side town called Pleonexia. Relax as you fish and listen to the waves. As long as the townsfolk are fed, everyone will be happy and nothing will ever go wrong. Don't look under the surface." Brought to you by Portal Emulator.

A black-and-white 2D point-and-click horror game about the life of a fisherman.

title: Truth Loop 2
description:
"TRUTH LOOP 2" is a short game (approximately 5 minutes), with a scary story and bizarre moments...

It has a "LOOP" style of gameplay, you keep repeating an action while the game and the story progress.

title: LazinAround
description: LazinAround is a puzzle game that will put your laser puzzling and color theory skills to the test. Master the increasingly complex puzzles by manipulating multiple lasers into a single color. Figure out how to combine different colored lasers together to hit the matching colored targets. Use the colored filter crystals to tune the lasers to the proper color. Hitting the matching colored target is the goal. Just don't hit them with the wrong color.

title: Ghostwire Tokyo: Spider's Thread
description:
The city’s denizens have been replaced by beings from another world - yōkai, evil spirits, myths and urban legends brought to life. But now isn’t the time to fear the unknown…face it in Ghostwire: Tokyo, now featuring the all-new Spider’s Thread update!

The Spider’s Thread update, available now for all Ghostwire: Tokyo players, adds a new rogue-lite mode to the game on top of other additions to the base campaign, including new enemies, new skills, new areas to explore, new side missions, extended story cinematics, Photo Mode enhancements, new trophies/achievements and more!

title: Rhythm Rabbit
description: A fast-paced rhythm action game where you automatically move on the beat of the music, but the amount of steps changes on each move. React fast in order to progress or end up dying repeatedly.

title: Penitent Dead
description: PSX Fantasy Horror. There are whispers that the Endlyss have arisen. As a Knight of the Black Order, you have been called upon to investigate.

title: Tennis Manager 2023
description:
The new Tennis Manager arrives on May 25, 2023 just before Roland Garros. Discover in a few days the presentation of the new features by clicking on the "follow" button and adding the game to your wishlist.
This year Tennis Manager puts team spirit first. Be there !

title: Bogdan's Cross
description: Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a fallen Templar seeking to make amends for his past sins. Explore a stunning world filled with ancient mysteries, uncover hidden secrets, and battle fierce enemies in this immersive action-adventure game.

title: Precious Stones
description: This is a physics-based platform game where players control a sphere to collect diamonds while avoiding obstacles and hazards. The game requires players to use their knowledge of physics to navigate through levels filled with slopes and moving platforms.

title: Entity Room
description: Entity Room is a short indie horror game, in which you're working in an underground lab. Your job is to ensure the entity is being fed every day and the rooms are cleaned afterwards.

title: A Craft of Mine
description: Your uncle, an employee from Mojang Studios, the company that develops Minecraft; has disappeared with no seeming reason. Sad for your uncle, you go to your room to play that same game, still unknowing of the answers you would be getting.

title: Metria
description:
The starlight is our hope.
An RPG where hope and sin collide.

title: Webkinz Next
description: Build your family of pets in the home of your dreams while playing fun games and hanging out with friends.

title: Legerdemain
description: A surreal fantasy RPG inspired by roguelike games and interactive fiction. Become a magician in the world of Phenomedom! Escape from prison! Learn rituals! Collect paragraphs! Converse with conjoined twins! Do battle with wild and original enemies, including pookahs, imp-imps, and boogadah dream porridge. Altogether there are dozens of areas to explore, hundreds of original monsters to slay, and nearly two hundred citizens brimming with lies and idle gossip.

title: Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions
description:
Your next chapter takes flight! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Quidditch by playing solo or sharing the magic with friends and family.

Take to the sky as one of the classic positions—Chaser, Seeker, Keeper, or Beater—each with their own unique play style. Soar into legendary Quidditch arenas, as well as maps that showcase never-before-seen areas of the wizarding world.

title: Katana Infinity
description: Discover Zero's first mission after the war and a new mysterious character : Infinity.

title: Don't Destroy The Rocket
description:
In this small but nice action game you control a rocket and have to bring it safely to the target. Try not to collide with the environment, because that is not good for the rocket. You have the tools you need to get ahead. There is also a hidden collectible in each level.
Are you curious? What are you waiting for. Download Don't Destroy The Rocket today and become a rocket master.

title: Terralith
description: Terralith is a Minecraft datapack designed to fundamentally overhaul the overworld with new biomes and caves. It accomplishes this without adding any new blocks, making it fully compatible with vanilla clients.

title: Spiritrest
description: Short atmospheric adventure game.

title: Touhou Juuouen: Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost.
description: Touhou Juuouen: Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost is the 19th official installment of the Touhou Project. It was announced by ZUN on April 18, 2023 (JST).

title: I'm on a Watcher Duty
description: This is a fangame of "I'm on Observation Duty" which originally created by Notovia (Zaster). This fangame is made by Paulor94.

title: Incendium
description: Incendium is a Minecraft datapack designed to completely overhaul the Nether using only vanilla blocks. In addition to extending the Nether's generation height to 192, Incendium adds 8 all-new biomes and 9 new structures with new custom mobs, items, and advancements. Terrain is also overhauled, with jagged mountains, twisting caves, and much more.

title: Nullscape
description:
The End is a barren, depressing, bleak place. As it should be, and always will be.

Nullscape is a Minecraft datapack designed to overhaul the End's generation in a way that maintains this identity - a realm of utter desolation. Nullscape will make you feel tiny and alone in the vast expanse of the End. You against the void - nothing more than that.

title: Structory
description: Structory is a seasonally updated, atmospheric structure mod/datapack with light lore for Minecraft.

title: Just Kiss Her Already!
description: Just Kiss Her Already! is a fluffy girls love story about Nanala (from Just Kiss Him Already!) attempting to get a girlfriend!

title: PortaBoy+
description: Congrats on purchasing your very own PORTABOY! Are you ready, GAMER? You're about to enter a fun world filled with challenging minigames. Stay focused, and do your best! Leave the rest to us!

title: A Tiny Sticker Tale
description: A Tiny Sticker Tale is a cozy miniature adventure about changing the world, using the power of stickers!

title: Yoshi Goes to Tesco
description: Browse the aisles for the items on your grocery list, get into some trouble, and solve minor puzzles in this short (15-25 minute) shitpost about the wonders and terrors of retail, with dumb references to outdated memes, copyright infringement and jokes about British "culture."

title: Agatha Christie: Hercule Poirot - The London Case
description: Hercule Poirot is back in a brand-new adventure, set in the heart of London.

title: I'm On a Watcher Duty 2: Paranormal in Gensokyo
description: A sequel to the first "I'm on a watcher duty". This time, it takes place in Gensokyo. Enjoy.

title: I'm On a Watcher Duty 3: The Invasion
description: Another sequel of "I'm on a watcher duty" series. This one is in the theme of the hand-made maps made by Paulor94. Enjoy.

title: I'm On a Watcher Duty 4: The Community Place
description: This time, we're in the community place. The place where people that like these community will be gathered. However, these community places are being haunted by anomalies and it's your job to take a care of it. Good luck fellow watcher.

title: I'm On a Watcher Duty 5: Returning to Gensokyo
description: You got requested by Yukari to go back to Gensokyo one more time because anomalies still happening there. You accepted the request and head back there immediately. You now back to your duty again.

title: I'm On a Watcher Duty 6: Home of Anomalies
description: Story: You came back from Gensokyo but your job isn't over yet. You wanted to find out what exactly happened so you decided to continue working as a watcher duty.

title: Viking Rise
description: Explorar, construir e conquistar Midgard!

title: I'm On a Watcher Duty 7: The Familiar Places
description: Story: You are now playing as another person and you get brought to one of the company by Yukari because she wanted to make you have a skill on spotting the anomalies by using the simulation that this company provided to you. You'll be doing a watcher duty job inside the simulation in a very familiar places.

title: Dark Quest 3
description: A rogue-lite tabletop that mixes card based exploration with turn based combat. Create your party, draw adventure cards, roll dice and fight monsters to defeat the sorcerer and his magic.

title: Neon Echo
description: Neon Echo is a 3D side-scrolling action Roguelite game with an anime and tech-wear style.

title: Buddytale
description: Buddytale is exploration of our attachments to virtual pets, our responsibilities as their caretakers, and the way digital mortality effects the value we place on our relationships to computational entities. It is a series of vignettes, little snapshots into the relationship between an owner and their pet, from the day they meet until they must say goodbye.

title: Iso Racer
description: Iso Racer is a top-down multiplayer racing game with a focus on realistic driving physics combined with drifting. It features a variety of circuits, cars, and the ability to personalize and upgrade vehicles. It's a great pick-up-and-play experience for both casual and hardcore racing fans.

title: A Little to the Left: Cupboards & Drawers
description: Sort, stack, and organize household objects into particular arrangements in A Little to the Left: Cupboards & Drawers. Prepare to clean out the cabinets and secret compartments of the home with even more charming illustrations, surprising scenarios, and 25 delightful new Cupboards & Drawers themed puzzles to discover.

title: Cult of the Lamb: Relics of the Old Faith
description: This update adds new relics, fleeces, attacks, followers, buildings, crusades, minibosses, encounters, quests, harder bosses, and a photo mode with stickers.

title: Teslagrad Remastered
description: Teslagrad Remastered is an updated version of the original Teslagrad, developed by Rain Games and released in 2023. This remastered edition features enhanced graphics, improved animations, and updated sound design while retaining the core puzzle-platforming mechanics of the original game. Players continue to use magnetism and electricity to navigate puzzles and obstacles within a mysterious tower, with the remastered version providing a refined visual and auditory experience.

title: Dead or Alive 5: Last Round - Character: Naotora Ii
description:
With lightning fast leg strikes, Naotora Ii leaps into the fray! This mashup brings together the action of Samurai Warriors and the fighting entertainment of Dead or Alive 5 Last Round. Defeat the strongest fighters for the honor of the Ii clan!

Naotora Ii joins Dead or Alive 5 Last Round as a playable character!

Download this to use Naotora Ii in Dead or Alive 5 Last Round

title: Launch The Baby
description: Launch The Baby is a silly and fun game where you launch your baby out of a cannon to gain points. With these points you can customize your baby with many options to go full absurd. These points will also allow you to unlock new levels and other beneficial tools when launching.

title: Unrecord
description: Unrecord is a tactical shooter where players can expect an immersive and narrative experience. Unrecord features complex dialogues, innovative gameplay mechanics, tough moral dilemmas, and a unique shooting system. The storyline in Unrecord can be compared to a detective novel or a thriller. The player will have to investigate several criminal cases and confront a diverse cast of characters. The game's plot and presentation will be central to the gameplay experience, and players can anticipate a range of gameplay sequences as well as numerous plot twists.

title: D&D Classics
description: This ultimate collection consists of 30 iconic Dungeons & Dragons video games. These include “Gold Box Classics”, "Silver Box Classics", "Spelljammer: Pirates of Realmspace" and other adaptations of the D&D universes that bring to life many iconic locations, monsters, heroes, and villains.

title: Cards Survivors
description: Cards Survivors is a unique mix of card games, action games and roguelikes. Craft a unique deck, slay hordes of enemies, discover cards of immense power and survive as long as you can.

title: Auto Necrochess
description: After struggling to live with no job, a girl becomes a necromancer and tries to overthrow the King.

title: Hazama_Queen
description: In the year 202X, the world is "Yami"...! To save the world, go to hell and kill all the demons. Yes, just like ordering a Frappuccino at a cool cafe!

title: SUMS
description: Super unaccurate Midage Simulator (S.U.M.S.) is an open world sandbox game in which you can completely individualize yourself thanks to the complex RPG mechanics. Meet quirky characters, do jobs and build your own village.

title: KarmaZoo
description: Share the love and die trying! KarmaZoo is a joyful, altruistic, cooperative platformer where up to 10 random players help each other with the unique abilities of 50 different characters - all for the sake of good Karma.

title: Heart Fragment: Book Three - Despair Fragments
description:
Includes Natalia and Jasper's routes.

Your progress towards the truth leaves you desperate for answers in this tangled web of fear in Book Three: Despair Fragments. "Fantasy" has been torn apart, "belief" becomes increasingly twisted, and "despair" threatens to engulf it all. Book Three reveals intentions and motives that you may have begun to piece together through the previous routes, but what will you discover by examining that evidence from the viewpoint of the villain?

title: Wind Fantasy SP: The Moment of Sealing The God
description:
Two hundred years ago, the devil Medicis launched a war against humans because of the death of his beloved, the saint Lilith. ．．The leader of mankind, Arthur, the King of Light who personally executed the saint Lilith, raised his holy sword to resist for the survival of the world of light. The war caused by the love affair between Lilith, the Saint of Light, and the Demon Lord Medicis lasted for seven years. ．．

The revenge war of the Demon King Medicis against the Holy King of Light was not successful. In the last battle of the Holy Demon Palace, the Holy King of Light Arthur defeated the Demon King Medicis with a sacrificed attack. In order to prevent all disasters, human beings at that time used the power of the absolute magic circle to seal all the dark people at the end of time and space.

title: Deceive Inc.: Misery Empire
description: A ghost from Ace's past has returned to break hearts and take names in Misery Empire: Deceive Inc's first seasonal catalog update. Featuring tons of gameplay improvements and fixes, over 50 exclusive new items to unlock, and Red - the devilishly charming new Scoundrel Agent!

title: Twitch Dates Pokemon
description: Twitch Dates Pokémon is a visual novel based on the lore and story of Twitch Plays Pokémon, with a primary focus on the Red and Crystal playthroughs. The game is available for free for Windows, Mac, and Linux

title: Porkérion
description:
Porkérion is a fangame made in RPG Maker 2003 by HLMTZ.
It is a parody of mostly Pokémon, Metal Gear and hispanic internet culture of the 2000s.

title: Porkérion 2
description: The second entry in the Porkérion series by HLMTZ.

title: Yark!: A Kobold Adventure
description: Steal the priceless treasures of the local kingdom to pay back your debts to a dragon in this stealth and thievery based, old school fantasy game.

title: Porkérion 3
description: The third entry in the Porkérion series by HLMTZ.

title: I Would Rather Have Cake
description:
Created for O2A2: Queer Jam.

There's a girl, and a pastry chef. They talk about cakes. It's cold.

title: Square Enix AI Tech Preview: The Portopia Serial Murder Case
description: This software is an educational demonstration of Natural Language Processing (NLP), an AI technology, as applied to the adventure game “The Portopia Serial Murder Case” (created by Yuji Horii and first published in Japan in 1983). At the time of the game’s original release, most adventure games were played using a “command input” system, where the player was asked to type in text to decide the actions of their character. Free text input systems like these allowed players to feel a great deal of freedom. However, they did come with one common source of frustration: players knowing what action they wanted to perform but being unable to do so because they could not find the right wording. This problem was caused by the limitations of PC performance and NLP technology of the time.

title: Thriving City: Song
description: In 960 A.D., the Zhao Song Dynasty was established. As the mayor, you'll need to help the townspeople settle down, cultivate the land and expand. However, when the emperor issues a national mandate, conflicts between factions threaten city development—what strategy will you adopt?

title: Torcurus
description: Play as a turtle in this retro inspired adventure game! After you was born you found strange shrimp, that starts your adventure.

title: Traversal
description: While traversing through several islands in this action adventure game, you'll need to help the islanders, solve puzzles and survive to make your way back home.

title: Soul Cliff
description: A souls-like game about saving a trapped beloved beneath a collapsed sink-hole. The gameplay mechanics is a souls-like experience with the added ability of an ultimate ranged attack minus a riposte mechanic. It is a short-story with a potentially confusing moment.

title: The Sims 4: Greenhouse Haven Kit
description: The Sims 4 Greenhouse Haven Kit

title: The Sims 4: Basement Treasures Kit
description: Hand-me-down furniture and forgotten favorites await in The Sims 4 Basement Treasures Kit.

title: Dolphin Spirit: Ocean Mission
description: Embark on an amazing adventure on the tropical island of Maupiroa! Take to the seas and discover the secrets that surround the island! Dive into the ocean's depths, teeming with life and color, with your dolphin friend Keanu.

title: Dead or Alive 5: Last Round - Character: Mai Shiranui
description:
The super heroine of fighting games enters the fray!

The flying fan, the powerful flames, the bewitching beauty - all come to life with the hottest fighters in gaming!

Mai Shiranui puts her Shiranui style of ninja arts to the test in Dead or Alive!

Download this to use Mai Shiranui in Dead or Alive 5 Last Round.

title: Xel: Breaking Time
description: A new chapter of Reid's story awaits. Travel back in time to the Xel, meet old friends, make new ones and change the future.

title: 1428: Shadows over Silesia - Deluxe Edition
description:
The deluxe edition includes 1428: Shadows over Silesia, the soundtrack and two written stories from the world of the game.

1428: Shadows over Silesia
Medieval Europe is in the middle of religious upheaval and many a preacher predict the imminent end of the world. Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy story with true historical events in the background. You'll be facing intricate puzzles, challenging battles and cunning stealth.

Soundtrack
Listen to the soundtrack, which contains most of the in-game music from 1428: Shadows over Silesia. The tracks were composed by a trio of composers - Dark Fantasy Studio, Matyas Vonz and Jan Valta. Some of the tracks are originally composed for the game. For example, God Warriors is a variation on the medieval Hussite chant "Ye Who Are Warriors of God".

Bonus stories
This DLC contains two PDFs with unique short stories from the world of 1428: Shadows over Silesia. Read on to embark on your next adventure with Hynek and Lothar. The stories are available in two languages - Czech and English.

title: Pieces of My Heart
description: Date beautiful women and solve tricky puzzles in Pieces of my Heart, a premium animated jigsaw puzzle game. Beautiful women are looking for love, by solving their puzzles you unlock their hearts and companionship.

title: Mokoko X Deluxe
description: Mokoko X was inspired from the arcade games like Volfied, Qix and Gals Panic. A popular gaming style in the late 1980’s, Mokoko X looks to resurrect the soul of the arcade genre while adding a modern touch. There are 32 levels in Mokoko X; each level has its own unique boss and minions. The main goal is assisting the girls that need help from the weird bosses. This is sometimes passing a mobile game level, sometimes helping out with the insects in the kitchen.

title: Doki Doki Dollmaker
description: Doki Doki Dollmaker is an indie boys love visual novel. Make decisions on behalf of Lyle to steer the story in different directions and experience multiple endings.

title: Spring Catastrophe
description: Spring Catastrophe is a 2D scrolling action game where Lily White spreads spring to Gensoukyo.

title: Sequence Palladium
description:
Released in 1998, Sequence Palladium is a fantasy mecha strategy RPG for Windows PC. The game follows a three part flow: starting with story events that into selecting a scenario which you then play out on the battle map and then continue to new story events.

Mechs in Sequence Palladium (called Wizards in game) require a knight and para-sweet (spirits) to form a contract to pilot. A significant portion of character management in Sequence Palladium is nurturing the relationships between knights and para-sweets, and selecting optimal pairs.

Combat is fought from a top down perspective, with an alternating player and enemy phase. All units are moved at once.

title: Mugen no Shinzou II
description: Mugen no Shinzō II is a role-playing game very similar visually and gameplay-wise to early Ultima games. As opposed to the first game, overworld occupies the majority of the screen, and towns can be physically explored in a top-down fashion. Another change is elimination of random enemy encounters in favor of enemies visibly roaming the overworld. Characters can now join the protagonist and participate in battles. Battles are viewed from first-person perspective (with large enemy portraits) and feature simple turn-based mechanics.

title: Sorcerer's Choice: Angel or Demon? Steam Version
description:
Sorcerer’s Choice: Angel or Demon? is a dark fantasy visual novel that tells the story of a boy called Lucil, the grandson of a great magician. After his house is attacked by a mob, his grandfather teleports him to safety. Burned and battered, Lucil is aware of two beings standing over him: one of Light, and one of Darkness.

Which hand will he take? What fate awaits him when he chooses?

title: Merge Design: Mansion Makeover
description: Merge Design is a very interesting casual merge game that combines decoration design, simulated construction and elimination gameplay to provide players with novel game content and gameplay designs. Here you can experience a completely different casual gameplay and feel your own merge challenge! Free choice of reward tasks, more surprise gifts, exclusive customize the appearance of the house, merge items to create a personalized living style, let's start renovating your own mansion!

title: Topolino amico delle guardie
description: Help Mickey Mouse infame the inhabitants of the colorful city! Enforce the quarantine and join the graces of Chief Seamus O'Hara!

title: Pik's Epic Kirby Sprite Comics: Teh Game 2
Touhou Mahoujou: Book of Star Mythology
description:
Touhou Project fangame developed by Maceknight and Raichu that originated as a Touhou styled music album, but was eventually made into a game. Gameplay revolves around collecting star items dropped from enemies, where more can be obtained by attacking enemies at close range. Collecting star items increases the Magnitude gauge, which leads to higher point multipliers. Star items do many other things: they factor in gaining resource pieces, they increase the point item value, and gathering enough in a stage will trigger the stage boss's "Last word" spell card.

This game uses the chapter system of Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom, and is also divided into two modes: "Legendary Hero Mode" with infinite lives, and the regular "Legacy Mode". Legendary Hero Mode is different from Pointdevice Mode in that it ignores what chapter you're on; instead, you simply respawn where you died, either at that exact spot or at the bottom of the screen (depending on the setting in the Option menu).

title: Touhou Doumeiju: Mystical Power Plant
description: Touhou fangame by Kaisendo. The main gameplay mechanic of Mystical Power Plant is based around collecting leaf items to fill a gauge, which causes the player to 'level up' and gain various benefits as the game proceeds. The benefits vary depending on what character duo is chosen.

title: Touhou Jaseishou: The Last Comer
description: Touhou fangame developed by Ido, Yuuyu and Hatsuke. The main gimmick of The Last Comer is based around collecting stars to fill a gauge, which is similar to Ten Desires' Trance gauge.

title: Tri Focuser: Outside the Traditional World
description: A Touhou fangame developed by Shijimi Nono, Ido and Raichu, with gameplay similar to the official Touhou games Shoot the Bullet and Double Spoiler. Much like those two, this game also brings back a variety of characters, but here they are from games developed by the Kaisendo circle prior to this game's release: The Last Comer, Mystical Power Plant, Riverbed Soul Saver, and Book of Star Mythology.

title: Touhou Hakujinki: White Names Spoiled Past
description: A Touhou fangame developed by NRT. Unlike the regular Touhou games, White Names Spoiled Past incorporates mystery-solving elements in addition to danmaku. While playing the game normally, the player should pay attention to the story and the dialogue, which contain hints as to the identity of the culprit. The Extra Stage can only be unlocked by correctly answering the order of events and the true culprit. In addition, this game has 3 stages instead of the standard 6, with even more emphasis on replayability.

title: Touhou Gyakumyouran: Ephemeral Unnatural Balance
description: A Touhou fangame developed by ExPorygon of Ephemeral Entertainment. The gameplay mainly revolves around collecting Balance items to fill a gauge. The gauge has a few effects, such as lowering the Point of Collection line and adding score bonuses for point items but its main use is to activate Discord. Similar to Trance from Ten Desires, Discord drains the meter while it's active and causes a variety of effects including increased player shot power, harder enemy bullet patterns, and automatic bombing when hit.

title: Recognition Test 23
description: 3 Phases. 21 Questions. Are you ready?

title: Touhou Mukyuushi: Glory of Deep Skies
description: Touhou fangame developed by Τeam αlternative Σnding and programmed by Kirbio, Gizmo the Dragon, Aka Kyuketsuki, and Lunarethic. This game features 3 stages (and a 4th unlockable stage) instead of the standard 6. The main gameplay mechanic of Glory of Deep Skies is the Elemental Burst system. If the player collects Elemental Orbs of the same attribute as the one they chose at the beginning of the game, an Elemental Gauge is filled up. Once full, the Elemental Gauge can be emptied for a boost with various duration and effects depending on the attribute chosen, and during this time, all items become life and spell pieces.

title: Touhou Saikotan: Servants of Harvest Wish
description:
A Touhou fangame created by the group Dream Compass.
The game features a "Harvest Mode" system where grazing rewards you with harvest items. These harvest items will put you into Harvest Mode after filling up your Harvest Gauge. In Harvest Mode, all point items and faith items on screen will be auto-collected. You will gain point item value for all harvest items obtained during Harvest Mode, as well as up to three spell pieces for collecting a sufficient amount of harvest items.

title: Turma da Mônica em O Resgate
description: Turma da Mônica em O Resgate is a fan-made mod for 2017's Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap that remakes the 1993's regional port of the original game, in which Monica gets raptured by Captain Fray after entering the Dragon's Castle and now their friends must save her.

title: Plastic Tape
description:
Snapshots of a life through bandages.

You start your new life abroad with your phone and an opened box of eight bandages in your bag.

title: Touhou Danmuki: Spellbroken Dream Festival
description: A Touhou fangame created by Incandesence System. This game features scene-based gameplay, where you capture individual spells instead of 6 stages, with 64 total.

title: Touhou xià yèjì: Shining Shooting Star
description: The gameplay system is based around filling a gauge by gathering star items. When the gauge is full, a border activates, with different effects based on the color of the gauge.

title: Touhou Yuǎn Kōng Jiè: Ultimate Vitality of Imagination
description: The game's mechanics revolve around the usage of the featured Limit gauge in order to turn red items into life meter and bullets into bomb meter by deleting all bullets within the limit range, which grows as your limit level increases.

title: My Pig Princess
description:
An 18+ Visual Novel taking place in a kingdom where the pig girl Emelie is the princess!
You play as a human farmer in this lighthearted comedy adventure featuring plenty of adult content!​

title: Classic Sonic Improvement
description: The aim of this mod is to revamp Classic Sonic's game play in Generations and create an entirely new experience when replaying the game. Note that this doesn't mean he was bad in the original game. This mod simply tries to add upon the experience while also making him play a bit more in line with what you would expect from Classic Sonic game play.

title: Torte Le Magic
description: Tort Le Magic is a free doujin vertical shooting game by former Amusement Makers member Pietoro, featuring characters from the manga 10 Carat Torte! (天からトルテ!) and music composed by ZUN specifically for this game.

title: Sumorbit
description: A physics based fighting game where planets sumo wrestle. Grab with your moon and bounce with your planet to launch opponents out of the solar system.

title: Digital Seclusion
description: Isolated in a room repurposed into a personal shrine to esoteric Japanese media. Our nameless protagonist has dedicated himself to a collection of retro Japanese computer games, with a particular fondness for early visual novels. Although decaying in a slovenly existence to the untrained eye, his retreat into digital life is enriched by the scripted interactions with various charming 2D girls. His one purpose in life is to chronicle his thoughts and reflections on each of the digital worlds he immerses himself in. However, one day while pulling out the box of another visual novel to review, a girl leaps straight out of the cover art and begins interacting with him face to face. And perhaps most shocking of all to him, in a completely unscripted manner.

title: The Tail of CatPat
description: Follow CatPat and the gang on an amazing adventure!

title: Sleep the Blackbird
description: Sleep the blackbird is a hand-drawn 2d puzzle game made in a form of comics with lovely watercolour illustrations and beautiful music. Follow the heart-warming story about Sonya and the blackbird who can't fall asleep. As the story unfolds, few puzzles will be on your way.

title: Old-Fashioned Way to Die
description: A hand-drawn detective game

title: Wrench to Restore Silence
description: Hand-drawn action platformer. Don't you sometimes want to get away from noise and crowds and just watch night sky? So does this little wolf who took a wrench and build a spaceship which took him to a nice and quiet planet. But suddenly he sees other spaceships are landing on his little planet. Can't they just leave him alone?!

title: Bugs make fine snacks
description: Bugs make fine snacks is a hand-drawn endless runner game with watercolour illustrations and cool music. Help our little short-sighted owl to fly in the night forest and look for yummy bug snacks. Be careful - don't touch the thorns.

title: Dice Catcher
description: Battle your way through the dungeon and collect back all of your magic dice!

title: Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin'
description: Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin' is a unique fusion of traditional turn-based roguelikes and twin-stick shooters. A fast-paced take on strategy games where you dodge deadly bullet patterns and kill enemies for their money - all at your own pace

title: Nijuubako
description: The Nijuubako fandisc featuring 2 scenarios: "The Daily Life of Iru and Sui" and "Return to the Fort".

title: ShenSonic
description:
ShenSonic is a fan game made by SimSonic, whose real name is Simon Elo, of Magitek Soft which has also created the Sonic in Mobius games. This fan game was previously created using The Games Factory but the final version used Multimedia Fusion Express.

ShenSonic is Shenmue but with Sonic characters and makes changes to the plot to fit the Sonic universe. It features 100+ characters, 4 locations, 8 mini-games, day and night cycle, QTE's, inventory system, and much more.

title: Chaotix of Tomorrow
description: Chaotix of Tomorrow is a fan made Sonic RPG made by Magnus Andersson using RPG Maker 2000, it stars the Chaotix crew featuring the return of Mighty. The game was later updated in 2006 to add better graphics and new features. The creator originally did not plan to create a sequel to the game, but a sequel was made anyway titled Twisted Mettle.

title: Twisted Mettle
description: The sequel to Chaotix of Tomorrow

title: Forces of Mobius
description: Forces of Mobius the third game in the series of Magnus Andersson RPGs.

title: Tails and the Quest of 100 Rings
description: Tails and the Quest of 100 Rings is a fan game created by Magnus Andersson (aka mightydillo). A demo was initially released publicly with one zone in 1997. It was only the second Klik & Play Sonic-based fan game to ever hit the internet. A completed version was released in mid-1998. A demo for this game was released in the Sonic Klik & Play Collection.

title: Tails Race
description: Created by Magnus Andersson/mightydillo, who himself created one of the first Sonic Fan Games.

title: Tails Quest 2: A Tale of Love
description: The last of the handful of fangames made by Magnus Andersson aka mightydillo using Kilktopia.

title: Sonic Boom
description:
Sonic Boom was the first Klik & Play Sonic fan game to hit the internet. It was created by Martin Braid in 1995. The initial release had a virus, so it was taken down temporarily. It was re-released in 1996 by Magnus Andersson.

Due to the open-sourced nature of Klik and Play, Sonic Boom later re-appeared in saxman's Sonic Klik & Play Collection along with demos of Sonic PC and Tails and the Quest of 100 Rings. It was also re-released as Rotor Boom by Ian Klukan, the Archie character Rotor Walrus replacing Sonic.

title: Desterium
description:
Since the beginning of the game, each character has a race that determines their physical form and a class that determines what they excel at in the game. Throughout the game, each player's character learns skills that will determine how successful (or not) they will be at their trade. The first two attributes (race and class) are chosen by the player when creating his character. The skill attribute mainly depends on the experience during the game and is deeply influenced by the way of playing and the preferences of each player.

The action takes place in a fictional virtual world where you take the role of a character who interacts with other characters, whether they are controlled by other players or by non-player characters. All the interactions take place in a fantastic environment like in a traditional role-playing game. You can chat with other characters on the screen, and through interactions, trade, trade, make friends, or other activities. We are waiting for you at Desterium!

title: Summer Album
description: A doujin of "White Album" that revolves around Morikawa Yuki.

title: Eien
description: A doujin game based on Tactics' "One ~Kagayaku Kisetsu e~", with Kawana Misaki as main character.

title: SM
description: A Super Metroid decompilation for PC.

title: Sorority Rites
description:
In the year 2014, Myles finds her world crashing down as she finds herself the target of a mysterious college organization known as The Sorority. Horror reaches new heights for Myles as she is coerced into staying at an abandoned mansion, but the unexpected company from a new friend may just give her the courage she needs.

Uncover the roots of evil in Sorority Rites, a kinetic visual novel horror game that reveals the dark pasts of characters from the AppSir Games Universe.

title: Wukong Odyssey
description: Wukong Odyssey is an epic adventure game with a classic platformer-style gameplay that will keep you entertained for hours. As the fearless hero, Sun Wukong, you'll embark on an incredible journey through a magical world filled with danger and excitement.

title: Zcrew: The Void Realm
description: Survive the post-apocalyptic world and face the rise of the Void! In the "Void Realm" DLC, you can once again improve your strength and prepare for future missions. Fight alone or join forces with your friends, challenge the levels, break through the limits, and dominate the Void!

title: Shepherd's Crossing
description:
Shepherd’s Crossing is a different kind of box garden simulation game that pursues the fun of increasing what you want and creating the landscape of your choice.

You have been entrusted with a miniature garden (farm)! Use the farm to raise animals and crops. Animals and crops can be exchanged with others. While there may be a main story, the ultimate goal is up to you. There are no time limits, so enjoy creating a relaxed and carefree farm landscape!

title: Tulgey Wood

title: Life of Pi
description: This is a Survival Simulator, you having to chop down tress, collect stones to make your tools and weapon, there are many customizable thermal weapon you can choose to fight demons or other players, you can also driving through the desert, grasslands and snow mountain, you have to help Pi survive.

title: Merge & Blade: Berserker
description: 'Berserker' is a character whose damage increases more and more when hit. It's a character that gets stronger and stronger the more you fight at the front, and it's always hungry for battle.

description: "Puppy" barks loudly at enemies! This is a great addition to the battle, as many enemies will stiffen after hearing his bark. By the way, this guy is nice and doesn't bite, so don't be scared.

description: Experience 7 games like enjoying a music album. An omnibus work featuring a dark and mysterious world view with the theme of "death and life" and a unique game system with a music player motif.

title: Sugar Sweet Temptation
description: On the whimsical Night of the Fairies, Crow Yamada lands on the rooftop of a quaint patisserie known as Folkroll. Without any memories, he strives to help the cute employees by becoming the best baker around in this sugary sweet visual novel.

title: Survival for Treasure
description: Welcome to the world of "Zombie Treasure Hunt," an exciting survival game where you must face hordes of zombies to reach your goal. The game is divided into two thrilling modes: campaign mode and online mode.

title: Survival Shooter
description: This is a first-person shooter game where you use various weapons to defeat enemies and explore the world. You must manage your health, use limited resources wisely, in order to survive in this challenging world.

title: Space Guardian
description: Robots have launched an attack on humans, and the space guardian force is dispatched to fight to defend the earth! This is a fast-paced arcade-style casual car battle game. The levels are all randomly generated by the program and can be challenged forever.

description: Square wave is an Arcade game inspired from the old classics. Push Away the Squares before they pass through the arena, And Survive for as long as you can and Get The Highest Score.

title: Square Brain
description: In this fast-paced puzzle game, rearrange squares of different colors, as quickly as you can, to match the winning arrangement. Do so with as large a grid as you can.

title: Catacomb Master
description:
Catacomb Master is a 2d platform game in which you have to play as a treasure hunter cat. Go down into the depths of the catacombs for treasures, use your bow and arrows, test your ingenuity.

Find treasures to become a true Catacomb Master.

description: Lost on a desert island with a wounded enemy pilot and no resources, can you cooperate even though you are enemies? or will you kill each other? Sky division is a visual novel that deals with themes such as the meaninglessness of war and unrequited love.

title: Skiing Frenzy
description: It's skiing day! Skiing Frenzy is a 2D top-down, retro-style ski game where you can play Slalom and Free Ski modes, each one giving you different challenges and lots of fun.

title: Simply Survive
description: Simply Survive is a 2D bullet hell survival experience where you the player battle through waves of enemies to just survive as long as possible.

title: Shovelboy
description: Shovelboy is a retro-style platformer where you have to collect shovels in 21 increasingly difficult small levels. How fast can you go?

title: Shadow Saboteur
description: Shadow Saboteur is an exciting 2D side-scrolling adventure game where players take on the role of Robin Hood, robbing from the rich and giving to the poor. Players must avoid the sight of enemy soldiers and steal money

title: Serene Hike
description: Serene Hike is the perfect game for anyone looking to unwind and escape from the stresses of daily life. With its beautiful graphics and tranquil atmosphere, you'll feel like you're really in the heart of the forest. So why wait? Start your journey today and experience the serenity of Serene Hike.

title: Sea Dove
description: The man in the black sphere needs you to catch him some fish, but to what end?

title: Russell's Range
description: Complete tasks and keep the range running while following the rules and avoiding the creatures that lurk in the shadows.

title: Poly Jigsaw: Dinosaurs
description: Poly Jigsaw: Dinosaurs is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game, with a dinos.

title: Puncherman!: First Day
description: Puncherman!: First Day is a first-person comedy physics dad simulator where you play as a retired FPS hero/generally manly man trying to become the best dad ever. One problem: the only way he can interact with the world is with an incredible punch. Use your fists of fury to prove your heart of gold!

title: Runic Defenders: Trials of Ascension
description: Runic Defenders:Trials of Ascension is an action game where you control four humanoid characters with unique abilities and weapons. Your goal is to survive by defeating enemies using your characters' skills.As you kill enemies, you earn XP materials to upgrade your characters and make them stronger.

title: Robots: Invaders
description: Robots: Invaders is a first-person 3D adventure game. You wake up early in the morning and realize that the robots no longer obey you, they were attacked by a virus. Alien forces have taken over their minds. Grab your weapons and fight back the invaders!

title: Roach Invasion
description: You are about the same size as a cockroach, and you must use every means at your disposal to destroy the massive numbers of "Gs" that are crawling on the ground, on the walls, and even falling from the ceiling.

title: Mage Tower, A Tower Defense Card Game
description: Draft a deck of cards against an AI opponent then battle them in tower defense-inspired card combat. A 2013 adaptation of the card game, released the same year.

title: Meatgun
description: The top-down roguelike shooter where your ammunition is edible. Delve into The Facility and fight off hordes of mutant vegetables with your Meatgun: Shoot meat to damage enemies, and eat meat to heal. Collect various items and combine their effects to become a powerful, veggie-killing machine.

title: Mech Mastery
description: Mech Mastery is an exciting new game that combines tower defense strategy with epic robot battles against alien invaders

title: Murder Cases
description: You find yourself locked in your own home, in the middle of a crime scene, and without your recent memories. In this horror scenario, you will find a stranger wandering the house and making your escape unlikely. Solve all the puzzles, find out what happened, and recover your missing memories.

title: Mystic Blast
description: Mystic Blast is an exciting puzzle defense game that will test your skills and strategic thinking. In this game, you need to connect two or more matching tiles to clear them from the board and defend against waves of attacking enemies.

title: Noel the Mortal Fate: Season Final Part 1
description: This is the tale of a girl who loses everything in her deal with a devil and her quest for revenge. Noel and her team are ready for the final battle and split into two groups to begin their actions. Their long revenge story is finally running to an end!

title: Laruaville Match 3 Puzzle
description: That's the first game in the Laruaville series! It has some new interesting Match 3 mechanics you won't see in other games, plus Mahjong ( try it! This mahjong is totally different from regular mahjongs! ) and some Spot The Difference scenes. Plus building the town.

title: Lichkeeper
description: Build traps and fling magic to protect the crystal heart that holds your immortal soul from an onslaught of wizards who are hell bent on destroying you!

title: Hyper Hentai Bikini Party
description: Hyper Hentai Bikini Party is a relaxing puzzle game. With the theme of bikini and multiple unique sexy girls. Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

title: Hypno-Mart
description: A short visual novel about a stylish blonde-dyed part-timer who works the night shift.

title: I Commissioned Some Frogs
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many frogs and flies as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: In His Time
description: This is a 2D adventure game of puzzle solving. As you control Ollie, a young boy, use your head to overcome the many obstacles that stand in your way. To obtain items, you may need to persuade characters or win mini-games. Through these, players will get to know the world even better.

title: Interstellar Expedition
description: Interstellar Expedition is a futuristic side-scrolling shooter game, where players can control their spacecraft using the mouse and engage in thrilling space battles. In the game,

title: Invasion: Family Ties
description: Rick travels to Indiana to visit his mother, but during his stay, unexpected events occur that lead him on a thrilling adventure. However, little does he know that a major threat looms on the horizon that will change everything. Will Rick be able to save the day and protect those he cares about?

title: Jump Up, Jerry!
description: Jump Up, Jerry! is an arcade platformer where you have to jump your way through different types of cable cars and enemies in order to reach for your highest score.

title: Jump, Dodge, Die, Repeat
description: Jump, Dodge, Die, Repeat is a rage fueling, adventure game, filled with unpredictable obstacles. Help Isani complete his impossible task, a task that was given to him by his maker at the moment of his creation.

title: Japanese Rail Sim: Operating the Meitetsu Line
description: A railway operating game that puts you behind the controls of a train in Japan on the Nagoya Meitetsu Railway! Take on and experience the role of a professional train operator and challenge yourself to this high-speed, FMV game.

title: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure
description: Play as Jane Austen, English novelist, in this 2D platforming adventure. Explore 8-bit England, fight enemies with your quill, and confront characters from Jane Austen's novels!

title: It Belongs in a Museum
description: It Belongs in a Museum is a Rogue-lite, treasure hunting, artifact collection VR story game. Join a shadow organization and help its weakened, resurrected goddess search for magic treasures to undo the curse they unleashed in procedural dungeons, tombs, lost cities, and ancient ruins.

title: LaborSurviveManual
description: 2D pixel TPS game, Through the keyboard control move and attack, Defeat the enemy gain experience to upgrade and strengthen weapons to live as much as possible.

title: Kreeps
description: Kreeps is a tower defense game where you choose how your towers and the enemies scale as the game progresses. Use any combination of 7 different types of towers and weapons to defend against the growing Kreep horde.

title: Fire and Maneuver: Expansion - Boshin War
description: Join the Boshin War as Imperialists or Shogunate loyalists in the second expansion to The Armchair Historian's Fire & Maneuver. Take charge during the turbulent end of Japan's samurai era, or ignite East vs. West clashes with inventive scenarios!

title: G.O.P.O.T.A
description: And you're a chubby guy?

title: Ghost Fake
description: Multiplayer masked action game "Ghost Fake" is an online game where players are divided into the masked ones and survivors to compete against each other. The masked ones use the power of the mask to capture survivors, while survivors use gimmicks to escape!

title: Forever In The Backrooms
description: Explore and survive levels based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level offers various escape routes but also introduces perilous obstacles. Players can immerse themselves in the seemingly boundless and unsettling levels of the backrooms, experiencing the game's eerie and intricate mazes.

title: Fish 'N' Chips
description: A fisherman must find his cat "Chips". Take up the challenge, swing through the levels, and save your friend!

description: The offensive of 4A of Volkhov Front on Tikhvin, in November 1941. The Red Army is trying to block the German forces from 39AC in the Tikhvin area. German units are transferring reserves to this sector of the front.

title: Grandma's Cheese
description: You play as Grandpa, you come home after a long day out drinking with the lads, and there is nobody there so you call out for your wife (Grandma) and she doesn't answer. You see that tasteful-looking cheese on the counter, and you can't resist.

title: Horror Maze 2

title: Dirty Room: Chapter 4
description: Dirty Room Chapter 4 DLC

description: It is a game that clears the dungeon by avoiding numerous monsters using the main character's skills. It's a 3D quarter view game. Let's use gas, punch, uppercut, rolling, defense, running, throwing, etc. well. Let's solve the dungeon puzzle well. Let's make good use of the dungeon traps.

title: Ed's world story
description: Protagonist 'Ed' lives in Kakariko village. He wants to become an adventurer who explore this great world. You can join Ed's adventure... find out a secret of the world.

description: "Cluster Tower" is an Arkanoid-style game where you'll have to help a skeleton return to the tower and reclaim its rightful place at the top.
