description: Season 2 Episode 3: Blessnote! Kitty attempts to prove her true identity to Juvie but the journey to Hella from Haven is loaded with distractions.

title: Cursed House Match 3 Puzzle
description: One of the most innovative Match 3 games with 10 unique mechanics you won't see in other games! Use your Match 3 skills to banish evel spirits!

title: Day Of Dead
description: 'Day Of Dead' is a casual game with the theme of terror. The game simulates a pinball machine. The player controls the left and right baffles to hit the marbles out, so as not to let the marbles fall into the middle hole.

title: 3D Puzzle: Vintage House
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: Amalgamare
description: In this 2D horror adventure game, play as the protagonist May as she is siphoned into a horrific new world on Halloween night. In a brave feat of love for her cat Matilda, May embarks on a gruesome journey through an otherworldly environment where she must utilize her wits to find her way out.

title: Ancient Saga: Vikings Journey - End of the story
description: Discover the full saga of Ancient Saga: Vikings Journey with this enthralling Full-Story-Unlock DLC! Uncover Fenrir's untold story, unveil the secrets behind his fury, and rescue Midgard from doom.

title: Blooby Block
description: Help Block rescue his friends from the terrible bluebies. This cube pushing puzle Game is an evolution of the clasic sokoban/box pushing type games in a multilevel 3D. Enemies, spells and traps add another level of complexity. The difficulty grows fast, and the puzles become unforgiving very soon.

title: Biki Biki Flip
description: Biki Biki Flip - The Ultimate Jumping Adventure!

title: Ball Wall
description: Can you avoid all enemies in time? In this fun game you have to get as far as possible between the enemies and you can collect coins. You can use the bottom wall, but also the top wall. The further you progress in the game, the more types of enemies you will encounter.

title: Auto Mechanic Sim
description: Auto Mechanic Sim is an exciting game that puts you in the driver's seat of a car service business.

title: Busy Bee
description: Build cells, guard home, collect nectar, store honey and survive the winter.

title: Car Parkour
description: Are you bored of doing the same thing? Take a break and try this racing game of Car Parkour!

title: Burger Impact: Solar Strike
description: Burger Impact is a surreal high-speed physics-based 3d action game built in Unreal Engine 5. As Burger, a space-faring fast food on an adventure to rescue French Fries, engage in the original “space-billiards realtime combat system,” orbiting and launching objects to battle and overcome challenges!

title: Akai Ito: HD Remaster
description: Japanese adventure game. Set in the present age, the game unfolds from the point of view of Kei Hato, a girl who has a special blood called "Nieno Chi". A special system called the blood sucking system is used.

title: Aoi Shiro: HD Remaster
description: Japanese adventure game. Aoi Shiro is an adventure game that sets stage in both the modern real world and a mythical world. Aoi Shiro takes place in the same universe as its predecessor, Akai Ito.

title: Atelier Marie Remake: The Alchemist of Salburg - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
It’s not about saving the world. In this "leisure adventure RPG," failing student Marie pursues alchemy, adventures, and quests while aiming to graduate in five years. "Atelier Marie," the origin of the Atelier series, has been remade with new elements!

Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

Full original game “Atelier Marie Plus: The Alchemist of Salburg”
Gust Extra BGM Pack
"Another Look" Costume Set（Set of 33)

title: Bocchi the Escape
description: In Bocchi the Escape you play as Bocchi, who has a nightmare about box mazes being chased by her friends.

title: Dig Deep: Chunky Pets
description:
Unleash new bonuses and dominate the game - upgrade now!
Our new animal companions are here to take your gameplay to the next level by providing you with new bonuses such as increased basket capacity and faster experience gain. With Working animals DLC you'll be able to collect more items and level up faster than ever before!

title: Perquisite Strata X
description: A Boom-compatible port of the exclusive levels found in the PSX port of DOOM.

title: PowerWash Simulator: The Muckingham Files
description: The Muckingham Files will take you to never-before-seen places from the original universe of the base game, with new characters, locations and stories. Get to know more about your stomping ground and its inhabitants as the most in-demand power washer in town.

title: Daydream: Prologue
description: Little Griffin is trapped in an ominous new world with his only friend, Birly the teddy bear. Solve clever puzzles and encounter terrifying creatures as the pair embark on a journey to discover what lurks beyond their nightmares.

title: DOOMpad
description: DOOM mirrored in a text editor

title: Camper Van: Make it Home
description: Decorate and organize the camper van of your dreams! Embark on a journey of self-discovery as you build your own home-on-wheels, using a combination of creative block organization puzzles and relaxing interior design. Make your heart feel at ease and your camper van feel like home.

title: Green Reaper
description: Play as Rubin, a rose ensorcelled by the goddess Antheia and entrusted with her sacred scythe. Mushroom marauders have invaded the greenhouse, targeting the garden goddess and choking the life out of her children. It is your duty to traverse the expanse of the greenhouse and slay these invaders.

title: Cards of the Realm
description: A lightweight deck builder. Explore over a dozen unique zones and collect heroes for your deck.

title: Underground Blossom
description: Underground Blossom is an adventure game by Rusty Lake. Fulfil various tasks at every station to find the metro that will take you through each important event from Laura Vanderboom's life.

title: 2 Volt
description: Use electric beams to interact with the environment and discover its secrets.

title: God of Weapons
description: Embark on a thrilling journey in God of Weapons, an action roguelike where you must ascend the tower of Zhor to reclaim the last light for the world. To survive the monster onslaught on each tower's level, you'll need to obtain and carefully organize weapons and accessories in your inventory.

title: VTube Studio: VNet Multiplayer Collab
description: VNet is VTube Studio's built-in multiplayer collab system!! Just select the collab participants, load your model and you're ready to go!!

title: Project: InfoGrid
description: Project InfoGrid is 2.5d scifi rocket game. You are tasked with maneuvering through tight obstacles to reach the other end of each level. Starting simple but progressively becoming more unnatural as you progress through the tests. You'll need to adapt when to be patient or quick. Best of luck pilot.

title: Don't Take It Personally, I Just Don't Like You
description: The lo-fi anime dating sim to cry to. A love letter to cassette tapes, old computers, and unrequited romance.

title: Stickman and the Sword of Legends
description: Stickman needs to get the Sword of Legends to be able to leave his planet that is about to explode.

title: Bad Times at the Silver Lake
description: Immerse yourself in the story of Sarah and her dog Shibu. Solve the mystery of the terrible virus infection and save the city of Salt Lake. Solve puzzles, shoot zombies and learn the terrible secrets of this city.

title: Missile Collector Man
description: Play game. Solve puzzle. Collect missile.

title: Aru Kanrinin no Koi: Spring + Summer
description: The original Aru Kanrinin no Koi game released in 2011 for PC.

title: Aru Kanrinin no Koi: Spring + Summer Free Edition
description: This was originally released with the bonus episodes, but they were later removed and rereleased in the Complete Edition.

title: Aru Kanrinin no Koi: Spring + Summer Complete Edition
description: A port of Aru Kanrinin no Koi: spring + summer Free Edition with additional content.

title: Disney's Mulan Training Game
description: Disney's Mulan Training Game is an Adobe Shockwave game made to promote the release of Mulan.

title: Madness Chambers
description: Madness Chambers is an incredibly addictive and action packed physics platform shooter

title: The Goblins are Coming
description: Arm Yourself! The Goblins Are Coming! Become the last line of defense to protect your lords treasure from unrelenting attacks from goblin hordes. In this action based tower defense style game protect your lords treasure chests from goblin raiders.

title: Pixels N Pistols
description: Take aim at cute little (blood thirsty) pixel enemies and send them to the void with an arsenal of over 25 weapons. Fight against soldiers, zombies, ninjas, and both the living and undead versions of Fascist Frank.

title: City of Dusk
description: Twilight City is a thrilling 3D block zombie defense shooter set in The end of the world is coming, face the endless attacking zombies, please live to the end...

title: Bone Boy
description: Feeling bad to the bone? Shred through the body as Bone Boy - learn rad tricks, help your friends and collect epic hats along the way. Get out there and tear it up, kid!

title: Hotdog Samurai
description: Hotdog Samurai! As a skilled hotdog, you'll battle through real world elements with one main goal in sight. Battle 20+ enemies throughout 7 adventure seeking levels, all while trying to complete in-game achievements.

title: Jackpot
description: Jackpot is a casual game. After starting the game, it has five wheels to turn. When the wheel stops, the icon stopped at the winning line matches the winning pattern, and the player will get the winning amount indicated by the winning pattern.

title: Category Challenge
description: Category Challenge is a quiz game. The game will ask questions randomly, and there will be four answers below. The correct answer will enter the next question.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: The Dark Throne
description: Patch 6.4 introduces the next raid dungeon Pandæmonium: Anabaseios, a new trial and a new Instanced, Variant and Criterion dungeon.

title: Barro T23
description: The new gen for the T version!

title: Adventure Mosaics: Autumn Journey
description: Ellie used to think that autumn was a bad time to travel. This journey proved her wrong!

title: Farm Keeper
description: A tile-based farming game where success means maximizing yields, conquering rent, and expanding your farm through random tile choices.

title: Island Clicker
description:
Welcome to Island Clicker – where every click opens the door to an unexplored world!

Explore the Island: Chop down your first tree, crack open your first stone, and step by step, delve deeper into the mysteries of this enigmatic island. The further you venture, the more resources you find, and with each upgraded tool, you become even stronger!

Tame Loyal Companions: Don’t face this adventure alone! Find and tame a monkey to work tirelessly by your side, a wolf ready to tear through your enemies, or a cat that brings you the kind of luck you’ve only dreamed of.

What Do the Shadows Hide?: The island is filled with secrets – from a strange broken totem by the lake to a mysterious bunker hidden among the trees. What are these places, and how can you access them? What secrets do they hold? Perhaps the answers lie behind doors that are still locked. Can you unravel all the mysteries that this land holds?

title: Zup! Q
description: Minimal physical puzzle with explosions. The player's goal to keep the blue ball on the platform for 3 seconds in order to pass the level.

title: Great God Grove
description:
Way up high on a mountaintop sits the Grove, a realm peacefully inhabited by charismatic deities and their devoted human worshippers. That was, until the pantheon's King began spreading insults and disinformation.

Now the gods and their followers have devolved into bickering and fighting! In Great God Grove, players assume the role of Godpoke, the mail carrier for this fractured pantheon. Creatively deliver messages and set the story straight... before the apocalypse consumes us all!

title: Mega Man X Innocent Impulse
description: Mega Man X Innocent Impulse is a story-rich open-world Mega Man X fangame in active development. Featuring an enhanced 8-bit graphical style and soundtrack.

title: Asura The Striker
description: Respect and homage to the arcade games of the 80s and 90s, This is an arcade-style 3D shooter with speed and exhilaration. Play as Asura, a humanoid combat weapon, and destroy the invaders from outer space.

title: Dynasty Warriors 5: Special
description:
Dynasty Warriors 5: Special includes content from Dynasty Warriors 5 and Dynasty Warriors 5 Xtreme Legends (excluding the Edit Mode and Destiny Mode features). Sports higher resolution graphics and includes the Japanese and English tracks.

The game was exclusive to East Asian regions.

title: Uldor Dread Arena
description: Uldor Dread Arena is a 3d rogue-lite where you face off against endless waves of the undead minions. Players choose from one of multiple characters with varying stats and weapons, and after each wave, you are able to upgrade stats, weapons, or unlock special abilities.

title: Ends
description: A highway gothic horror. Your bus was late and now you can't catch your next bus home. You'll need to walk the next couple of miles... alone... at night.

title: 200 Days Zombie Apocalypse
description: You must survive a Zombie-infested world.

title: 200 Tolerance
description: When everything is tired and it can't go on like this anymore. Improve three characters, fight the regime in this dystopian arcade!

title: Paranormal Mission
description: Welcome to Paranormal Mission, the thrilling spot-the-difference game that will put your powers of observation to the ultimate test!

title: Green Memories
description: Green Memories is an action RPG with sandbox and shooter elements, featuring beautiful pixel art inspired by other works from Gameboy Advance and retro games.

title: Galactic Gluttony
description: Agent Red has one job, to hide the existence of aliens. But when a UFO shows up and starts dropping their food everywhere, things start to get a little troublesome. The fastest way to get rid of all the food? Eating it, obviously.

title: Nature is Hungry
description: After a plane crash, fight for survival against deadly predators. Gather essential supplies to stay alive and uncover the mystery behind two long-dead skeletons and the crocodiles' presence. In this horror FPS game, the night is your greatest enemy. Can you survive until dawn and solve the mystery?

title: Pinball FX: Jurassic World️ Pinball
description: With one pinball table based on Jurassic World and two more inspired by Jurassic Park, you know what that means - Life found a way!

title: Tap Shap
description: Tap Shap is a unique, free-to-play, addictive game & the world's first multi-platform reaction game!

title: Rest House III: Chlorophilia
description: Explore Rest House III intriguing world and step into a dark and wet Chlorophilia. Psychological first person adventure. All the population moved to the capital. You are special correspondent of the famous journal. Disaster! What will happen to the earth in the future? Psychological human dilemmas.

title: Family Farm 2023
description: Welcome to Family Farm 2023, the ultimate farming stimulation game where you own an entire island and can crop, breed, and build to your heart's content. With over 22 crops and a variety of animals, factories, and decorations, the possibilities are endless. Play now and build your dream farm!

title: Brave Adventurer
description: Brave Adventurer - The story of a vagabond who travels through Middle-earth and is the victim of an attack by bandits, resulting in serious injury. You enter the world of demons through the use of dark magic.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Hidden Paradise
description:
A perfect place for a weekend getaway with friends. This DLC includes:
- Roller coaster map: Hidden Paradise.
- One roller coaster cart.

title: Intervallic
description: In this 2D sidescrolling rhythm game use your MIDI instrument or computer keyboard to guide a robot alien cat through space!

title: Cities of the World Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 30, 42, 117, or 285 pieces.

title: Derpy Dino
description: Derpy Dino is a game where you are the last dinosaur alive. You try your best to survive and keep the dinosaurs from becoming extinct but be aware... meteors are crashing down.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Return of Rome
description:
Welcome to Return of Rome, a completely new type of expansion pack which brings Age of Empires, the title that started it all, into Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition as a brand new self-contained experience. This new expansion will allow you to challenge friends with the original sixteen Age of Empires civilizations - plus one brand-new Return of Rome exclusive civilization, the Lac Viet- and relive the triumph and trials of antiquity. Battle your way across the ancient world with three new campaigns featuring conquerors, empire-builders, and gifted tacticians fighting desperately against fate! As an additional bonus, the Romans will no longer be bound by time as they become a new playable civilization within Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, ready to battle in the new Age.

Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Return of Rome is the fourth expansion of Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition. It was announced on 25 October 2022, on the 25th Anniversary of Age of Empires. It ports Age of Empires content into the Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition client.

title: DungeonSmash
description: A simple and addictive game where you break blocks in medieval dungeons.

title: I Made Myself an AI
description: Build circuits and manage heat as you complete tasks in this surprisingly intuitive puzzle game unlike anything you've ever played before.

title: Abscission
description:
Abscission is a dark and moody 32-map vanilla megawad with an original ambient/noise soundtrack composed by me.
Each map loosely follows the style of the original iwad levels, but with distinct and new layouts rather than being a remake. Visuals are classic since I stuck to stock textures other than custom skies.
The difficulty is slightly above average - expect difficult fights that don't become tedious or frustrating.

title: Snakedate
description: Welcome to Charmr, the premier dating app for snakes! Looking for love? Cruise around the club and wrap around your dates to show your affection!

title: Antbassador
description: Take control of The Antbassador, a giant human finger with a tophat, as he makes his way through a bustling ant colony. You must use your prodigious digit to help the citizens of Antopia without causing an international incident!

title: IndependAnt
description: Explore the vast Living Room to find food for your struggling ant colony in this cute and casual collectathon!

title: Bale Out
description: Bale Out is a short, relaxing puzzle game with a unique puzzle mechanic: AI prediction. Save barnyard animals by learning their movement patterns and manipulating the environment!

title: Celestial Crowns
description: The King is dead! Take the throne in this choice-rich fantasy game and save your Kingdom by reviving ancient magic that's been lost to your family for generations. Customize your character and play through three different romantic routes!

title: Grant of God
description: This is a synchronous turn-based card battle game where you build your card deck through the combination of characters, weapons and equipment to meet any challenge. welcome to my world:the land of godgrant.

title: Medusa VR
description: Medusa, the Croatian word for jellyfish. Medusa VR is 10 minute solo-developed VR film. Join Russel and Zlatan - two Croatian actors in Califonia for a coffee by the canal as they discuss grief, change and loss. When on strange shores, would you swim with Medusas?

title: Inspector Gadget: Mad Time Party
description: Go Go Gadget! Become the famous Inspector Gadget and have fun with your friends in this brand-new adventure!

title: Under the Witch's Trial
description:
What happens when you transmigrate into a story… where everyone's a villain?

After leaving a critical review of a tropey and grimdark RPG where the main character experiences and perpetuates nothing but tragedy, you… accidentally reincarnate into that very game.

Unfortunately for you, your role is that of a cannon fodder two-bit villain, who exists only for the protagonist to murder in his first act of vengeance against those who've wronged him.

To make matters worse, an alluring villainess offers to help you out—At a price, of course. With both the protagonist's and villainess's eye on you, you must find a way to obtain power and ensure your survival—before it’s too late.

title: Car Cops
description: It is up to you to make sure everyone has no contraband!

title: Night of Horror
description: You are on the night shift at the bank. You hear noises all the time. You need to find out what they are and find your partner. As you pass, you will need to find the keys and open locked rooms.

title: Trainz 2022: Ferrovia Appennino Centrale 1899
description: Drive through the Italian countryside in 1899 with this 133km long 950mm narrow gauge route with steep grades and 32 stations. Featuring a Couillet 0-6-0T steam locomotive, this route will present the challenges faced by pioneering steam locomotive crews!

title: Trainz Plus: Ferrovia Appennino Centrale 1899
description: Drive through the Italian countryside in 1899 with this 133km long 950mm narrow gauge route with steep grades and 32 stations. Featuring a Couillet 0-6-0T steam locomotive, this route will present the challenges faced by pioneering steam locomotive crews!

title: Rescue Team: Magnetic Storm
description: You find your world in danger once again, but this time by unprecedented natural disasters caused by intense solar activity. As you navigate a city in chaos, you'll act as the head of a team of rescuers tasked with helping people in need.

title: Green New Deal Simulator
description: Achieve zero emissions and full employment in this casual card-driven game.

title: Just Find It
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Just Find the Difference!

title: Hell of a Racket
description:
Play as a fallen angel seeking redemption by punishing satanic worshipers who don't play the holiest of sports....tennis! Use your blessed racket to wreak havoc and show these satanic practices have no standing in God's land!

Hell of a Racket is a unique twist on an old-school genre: First-Person Shooter? No. First-Person Swinger! Engage with enemies in a unique way by reflecting projectiles at them with your racket or simply smacking them! Jump, dash, run, or wall-climb your way around the arena and kill your enemies as you work your way to the final boss: Pickle Ball Satan!

title: Idle Dragon Clicker
description: The land has been overrun by evil dragons It needs a leader to bring peace to the land. Start by clicking on the dragon to kill them, and collect coins. Spend that coin on your power and allied Heroes to get more damage. The more damage you deal, the more coins you will get.

title: Infected Backrooms
description: Enter the surreal world of Backrooms in our multiplayer 2-8 players Co-Op & PvP game. Become monsters or survivors, where players must infect others or use their guns to stay alive. With fast-paced gameplay and a creepy atmosphere, it's perfect for Backrooms fans for having fun with friends

title: Stellaris: Galactic Paragons
description: Add Galactic Paragons to your empires and experience a new level of character and story as great leaders follow your lead to the stars. With exclusive additions to the all-new Council mechanic, leaders who you can shape to amplify the vision for your empire, new civics and more.

title: Mais qui est le vrai Roro?
description:
Enter the wacky and crazy world of "Mais qui est le vrai Roro?" - an exciting game of hide-and-seek that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very last second! But beware, this time you're facing off against your Twitch community in a fierce battle to uncover the true Roro.

Take on the role of the famous streamer and podcaster Roro, who must complete his daily tasks in his apartment invaded by fake Roros. Among them, you'll find racing Roros, an adorable cat named Fluffy, and even the expert in decoration, Marc-Emmanuel!

At the end of each round, your audience must vote to determine who the real Roro is. Each completed or failed task will eliminate fake Roros or unlock powers to muddy the waters!

So, are you ready to take on the challenge and prove to your community that you're the master of the game? Play "Mais qui est le vrai Roro?" now and find out if you're the best Twitch detective!

title: RoboSquad Revolution
description: Welcome to the Revolution, where you are an insurgent robot marching to the beat of your own motherboard in the name of rebellion. Level up your components and rewrite the future of AI, one Hologram Throwdown at a time. Well what are you waiting for, metalhead? Join a squad for free today!

title: Muzzle Run
description:
Greyhounds are running on the Polygon Blockchain!
Breed, train, and race to win money on your way to podium glory with your NFT Greyhound collection.

title: Mind Over Magnet
description: An attractive puzzle platformer where you use magnetism to escape a factory. Meet a cast of magnet characters and work together to solve logical conundrums.

title: A Good Place To Die
description: Kill as many zombies as possible, collect points by hitting them, upgrade your weapons and reach the final boss!

title: Mini Taoism
description: "Mini Taoism" is a realistic Taoism simulation game based on match-3. You'll need to collect resources, use skills, refine elixirs, unlock talents, slay demons, constantly improve yourself, and finally become immortal.

title: Pixel Tank
description: Pixel Tank is a really simple game. It's a pixelated fish tank! Use it to relax or as ambiance in the background of your work day or even while you sleep! Every minute in game you gain a coin. You can use those coins to unlock any fish you want in the game. It's like Pixelated ASMR!

title: The Adventures of LinShanHai: Chapter 4 - Vanishing Masterpiece
description: A famous painting called 'The Rhapsody of the Goddess' worth over 100M has been stolen from the Treasure Chamber on the top floor of the Central Art Museum in City F. The municipal bureau has ordered that the case must be solved within three days due to the involvement of this national treasure.

title: Charged: RC Racing - Starter Edition
description: Charged: RC Racing is all about speed and making use of random items. Drive RC Cars in different locations and use items to defeat your opponents.

title: The Unfallens: Awakening
description: Returning from exile underground, a shattered world awaits you. The once-thriving civilization of Unfallens now lies in ruins. The ruthless guardian wait to attack. Journey through remains, use your skills to overcome intense boss battles. Awaken your true power. Reclaim what was lost.

title: Re:Curse
description: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

title: Hookscrap
description: Fight as the owner of Hookscrap in a thrilling 2D rogue-like. Unleash the power of your Harpoon, by launching ships & asteroids at enemies. Upgrade your ship with loot from your foes, and become even stronger. Explore 5 unique levels in a randomly generated map & take down the fearsome SC Judgement!

title: Gate Zero
description: Travel through time to ancient Israel in this compelling story-rich adventure. Explore a rich historical world as you engage with familiar events from the 1st century. Gather resources to help the locals, use stealth to avoid danger, and unlock riddles to unravel an age-old secret.

title: Chamberbound
description: Chamberbound is an atmospheric 3D ball roller puzzle game where you maneuver your way through chambers while solving puzzles with a brilliantly engineered ball which functions in unknown ways.

title: KartMania
description: "KartMania" is a real-oriented racing kart game. Changing settings such as seat position and sprocket diameter, Let's capture the circuit course with driving technique!

title: Holmes Sherlock & Mycroft
description: Play and get the most clues, ask witnesses for help and manage to solve the case by the end of the week before your opponent with your clues.

title: The Great War 3032
description: We are in the year 3032. For some time now, there has been a war between the Northern and Southern nations. Choose a side and enter the battle as an advanced combat robot. Play against friends in multiplayer deathmatch or team up with up to three others in co-op mode.

title: The Enemy Weapons Are Better
description: Goofy Ahh stories that take place in the world of data. The game simply has to press the move button to run around and kill enemies with their weapons.

title: Half-Life: Enriched
description: Half-Life: Enriched aims to update the look and feel of Half-Life with reworked maps and artwork.

title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
description:
Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes is a unique mix of puzzle, strategy and RPG: Plan your every move and combine your attacks to defeat your enemies in matching puzzle inspired battle scenarios, upgrade your heroes and creatures to unleash increasingly devastating attacks onto your opponents, and let the strategic thinker in you lead your troops to victory.

Originally developed by Capybara Games, Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes is getting a Definitive Edition including its DLC, refreshed character portraits, many quality-of-life improvements and an expanded, fully reworked and re-balanced online mode!

title: Faith of Danschant: Hereafter
description: Faith of Danschant: Hereafter is an Action RPG inspired by Chinese mythology. Developed by Beijing Joyfun, it is a sequel to the 2017 RPG Faith of Danschant, featuring Chinese martial arts and sword fighting, but now with a realtime action-RPG combat system for even more thrilling and complex battles.

title: Caona
description: In Caona, you take part in an Action Adventure Game set in a fictional world based on South American mythology.

title: F1 Manager 2023
description: F1 Manager 2023 gives you unparalleled control of your chosen F1 team, with rich and detailed management features, refined racing spectacle, deeper authenticity and a brand-new mode that allows you to rewrite the season on your terms.Drive every decision and become the best team on the grid across the official 2023 F1 season and beyond.

title: Like a Dragon: Ishin! - Ryoma Growth Support
description:
The Ryoma Growth Support Kit contains consumable items that will increase Sakamoto Ryoma's Experience Points, as well as a battle revival item.

It contains:
- Red Daifuku X3
- Yellow Daifuku x3
- Blue Daifuku x3
- Green Daifuku x3
- Training Daifuku x3
- Sacrifice Stone x1

title: Golden Idol Mysteries: The Spider of Lanka
description: The Spider of Lanka begins in 1741, one year before the first scenario in The Case of the Golden Idol, and uncovers the awful origins of this five-decade tale of betrayal, greed, ambition and death. Set in the fictional Kingdom of Lanka, this DLC offers three brand new scenarios that will demand the utmost of your deduction powers to unravel.

title: Commander: World War II
description: Commander: World War II is a turn-based tactical game where you lead either the Allies or the Axis to victory. Deploy infantry, tanks, planes, and naval units, capture locations, use the terrain, and counter specialized units in intense battles. Design your own maps and dominate the battlefield.

title: Enid
description: Help Enid stay aflame while exploring the forest and playing minigames with woodland creatures!

title: Cursed Fables: Twisted Tower
description: Can you stop a soul-stealing monster from terrorizing the kingdom?

title: Everlasting Abundance
description: A greedy AAA game company rules the world with an iron fist. You must join a faction of independent rebels and defeat the tyranny of Everlasting Abundance. Can you succeed? Is it all just a pointless dream?

title: Eukarion Tales 2
description: Embark on a dangerous adventure and do battle against the forces of Kaos. Complete quests to gain experience, learn new spells and abilities, and equip yourself with powerful weapons and armor. Relive this Flash Classic Today!

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Supernova
description: You are the leader of a space-faring civilization at the dawn of the 24th century whose choices for domination are endless: planetary conquest, cultural domination, political alliances, technological supremacy. Your mission is to spread your civilization across the known universe.

title: Top PUA
description: This is an LVG, a GALGAME, a visual novel, a super hilarious game. This story happend in Mainland China. In this game, our protagonist Willie dated a top pick-up artist Lilie. Although she is pretty young, but she know everything about dating with a man.

title: Doppa
description: Guide the lost Doppas to the spirit world by controlling their path in this endless journey.

title: Flora Domina
description: In this unique take on turn-based 4X strategy, play as a nature goddess that defends her island by playing cards to use nature as your ally.

title: Eternal Survivor
description: A fast paced twin stick shooter with roguelite elements. Trapped inside a dungeon room you must endure and survive.

title: Ink Neko Maid
description: A relaxing puzzle game with cat-girls.

title: Digital Exorcist Case_(0);
description: Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-Agency operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.

title: Nox Archaist: Lord of Storms
description: An expansion pack for Nox Archaist, containing the original story plus a new scenario and new features. Puzzles and powerful magic items await, along with dangerous traps and monsters. Those foolhardy enough to brave these perils will come face to face with the Lord of Storms! 15+ hours gameplay.

title: Piano at 5 am
description: "Piano at 5 am." is a short text adventure game. A girl who is the main character wanders in a fog forest while adjusting the four factors of "drowsiness," "thirst," "madness," and "recharge," which increase or decrease depending on the choices she makes.

title: Unalive 010
description: Welcome to the captivating world of Unalive - a game where the hero must battle fierce monsters using their shooting skills. You will navigate randomly generated room labyrinths and face challenging bosses, while mysterious events unfold throughout the game. Be prepared for unpredictable challenges and tests at every turn, creating an immersive atmosphere that draws the player deeper into the world's mysteries and enigmas. Will you be able to unravel all the secrets of Unalive? Only time will tell...

title: Xenon Runner
description: Xenon Runner is a fast paced speedrunning parkour FPS where you compete against yourself, your friends, and the world. Utilize grappling, power sliding, recoil knockback, and wallrunning to complete the levels as fast as possible.

title: Paws of Coal
description:
Paws of Coal is a cozy, slow-paced detective adventure with gameplay influenced by the scientific method – quests are solved by connecting evidence. If you get it right, the mystery is solved. If you get it wrong, everyone could be in danger. So, tread carefully.

In the game, you play as Charles, a scholar on a mission sent by His Majesty (the lion king Lav) to help the critters of The Burrows where the outbreak is on the rise. Is it dangerous, or just a mere nuisance? It is up to Charles to find out what is going on.

But there would be problems on his path, both scientific and social.

The Burrows is a mining town, and miners are on a strike
There is no cure for the outbreak, and productivity is suffering. The miners won't tolerate the current scenario and are on strike. The problem? The foreman of The Burrows isn't having any of it and wants to shut down the strike. Unless Charles finds a creative solution.

Paws of Coal is a short, stand-alone game set in the larger Trip the Ark Fantastic universe that is currently in development in Gamechuck. Paws of Coal offers around 3 to 4 hours of gameplay (depending on your play style), and even multiple endings.

The investigation is solved by talking to each resident of The Burrows, finding the clues in the environment, making a lot of notes, and connecting the dots (literally) using the interface in Charles' journal.

When you're sure you got it right - submit the report, and... hope for the best. Good luck!

title: Sol: Last Light
description: Sol: Last Light is a third-person, action-adventure RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world. Learn to control your newly discovered power to harness energy from the sun and battle against robots on your journey up the mountain to find your captured sister.

title: I Read a Post Online about Monarch Butterflies
description:
Made with bitsy for the pollinators bitsy jam,
very, very, very last minute

title: Cafe Venus Flytrap
description: You're a fly. A fly whose hobbies consist of writing novels and eating sweets. One day you decide to check out a new cute cafe that promises an abundance of pastries, sweets and drinks. A cafe that is run by adorable froggos.

title: Yuka: Scattered Shards of the Yokai
description:
Due to a kappa's careless mistake, Yuuka's common sense and sexual reasoning broke out of her mind into fragments and were scattered all around the world... but by strange coincidence, a mortal from the nearby village just happened to be there and as consequence, he was forced to explain what happened...
The pieces could not be seen with the naked eye and yet the mortal could... so he was forced by Yuuka to help collect the pieces in order to regain the fragments of her mental mind but there was one slight problem...
The fragments were very delicate and easy to break, and if they did then Yuuka's common sense and sexual reasoning will be lost meaning her plump body will be for anyones taking...​

title: Fossil Sweeper
description: Fossil Sweeper is a game about excavating fossils and building skeletons of prehistoric animals.

title: Raimodula
description: Raimodula is a dynamic arcade platformer, featuring customizable characters and randomized progression. Unlock habilities, fight modular enemies and navigate surreal environments with polished controls and intense gameplay!

title: Coffee Dates
description: Coffee Dates is a fun and lighthearted visual novel about hanging out with your crazy co-workers and the comedic shenanigans that unfold. There's even a few bits of game play that aren't just reading. Isn't that cool!

title: Neptunia GameMaker R:Evolution
description: Hyperdimension Neptunia GameMaker R:Evolution is set during an era where game makers are competing with each other. There were three goddesses of game makers who were defeated in the race to win "market share" of game sales and perished. Will they be branded as "goddesses of failure" and disappear? However, Adult Neptune who travels many dimensions suddenly appears in their world, asked by the three goddesses to become their president in order to revive the fallen game maker.

title: I Spy School Days
description: I Spy is the fourth game in an educational game series based on the series of children's hidden object books. It is the same as the first game, I Spy, with the addition of Craft Project levels.

title: Ducklyte
description: Ducklyte is a top-down shooter with roguelite elements where you play as a constipated little duck trying to stay alive as long as possible in a randomly generated farm with progressively stronger enemies.

title: The Stoevi Curse
description: Unravel the mystery of The Stoevi Curse, a first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria. Protect your farm, save your family.

title: Wandering Skies
description: Navigate through the Sky Lands and uncover its secrets to restore their lost harmony. In this first person platformer, use your abilities to reach the end of each level. Observation and skill are the keys to success !
